text.body:
[847]
kandarpamadamūḍhā yā yadi vā madyamohitā ||
svayaṃ vipratipannā vā yadi vā vipramāditā |
ṛtukālena śudhyet tu dharmāpetā ca yā bhavet ||
śudhyetta rajasā nārī nadī vegavatī yathā |
puṣpakālam upāsīnā puṃsā saha viśudhyati ||
tathā |
striyaḥ pavitra matulaṃ naitā duṣyanti karhicit |
māsi māsi rajaḥ strīṇāṃ duṣkṛtāny apakarṣati ||
mṛnmayasyāgninā śuddhir dāravasya tu takṣaṇāt |
bhasmanā caiva tu kāṃsyasya strīṇāṃ tu rajasā smṛtā ||
nāgnis tṛpyati kāṣṭhānāṃ nāpagānāṃ mahodadhiḥ |
nāntakaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ na puṃsāṃ vāmalocanā ||
vasiṣṭhaḥ |
rajasā śudhyate nārī nadī vegena śudhyati |
bhasmanā śudhyate kāṃsyaṃ punaḥpākena mṛnmayam ||
śaṅkhalikhitau |
na vai strīṇāṃ vrataṃ na mantrakriyā na kāryam || iti |
prajāpatiḥ |
pāṇigṛhītāḥ santānārthinā parair avakīrṇā na duṣyantīti smṛ| vādaḥ (?) | tā hy ārtavena śudhyantīti vaivasvataḥ | kāmānupagamapravṛttir akāryam iti |
hārītaḥ |
[848] tadvṛtatvād ātmasaṃbhavāc ca doṣa iti |
gautamaḥ |
cāndrāyaṇam āsāṃ pāvanam ity ācāryāḥ | prājāpatyo vā |
hārītaḥ |
garbhaghnīṃ madhye varṇaśiṣyasutagāminīṃ pānavyasanāsaktāṃ dhanadhānyakṣayakarīṃ tu varjayet | nābhicāriṇīṃ rajasā śudhyatīty eke | vyaktibhogān parair asṛjya na duṣyatīty anye |
vasiṣṭhaḥ |
somo dadau śaucam āsāṃ gandharvaḥ śikṣitāṃ giram |
agniś ca sarvabhakṣyatvaṃ tasmān niṣkasamāḥ striyaḥ || iti |
apare |
ekavrataskannabhāvatvāt parendriyopahatattvāc ca duṣyāḥ kulasaṃkarakāriṇyo bhavanti |
yamaḥ |
svacchandagā hi yā nārī tasyās tyāgo vidhīyate |
naiva strīvapanaṃ kuryāt na caivāṅgavikartanam ||
svacchandavyabhicāriṇyā vivasvāṃ tyāgam abravīt |
catasras tu parityājyāḥ śiṣyagā gurugā ca yā |
patighnī ca viśeṣeṇa jaghanyopagatā ca yā ||
śātātapaḥ |
grāme tu yatra saṃspṛṣṭaṃ yātrāyāṃ kalahādiṣu |
grāmasaṃdūṣaṇe caiva spṛṣṭidoṣo na vidyate ||
[849] 'grāme' rājamārgīdau |
devayātrāvivāheṣu yajñeṣu prakṛteṣu ca |
utsaveṣu ca sarveṣu spṛṣṭāspaṣṭir na duṣyati ||
bṛhaspatir api |
tīrthe vivāhe yātrāyāṃ saṃgrāme deśaviplave |
nagaragrāmadāhe ca spṛṣṭāspṛṣṭir na duṣyati ||
etac ca vākyatrayaṃ yatrāham anena spṛṣṭa iti jñānaṃ nāsti tadviṣayam iti kecit | ucchiṣṭāśucisaṃspṛṣṭaviṣayam ity anye ||
śrāha viṣṇuḥ |
ity aśuddhyapavādaḥ |
atha snānam ucyate |
tatra snānapraśaṃsā | āha viṣṇuḥ |
snāto ’dhikārī bhavati daive pitye ca karmaṇi |
pavitrāṇāṃ tathā japye dāne ca vidhicodite ||
alakṣmīḥ kālakarṇī ca duḥsvapnaṃ durvicintitam |
apmātrenābhiṣikasya naśyanta iti dhāraṇā ||
yāmyaṃ hi yātanāduḥkhaṃ nityasnāyī na paśyati |
nityasnānena pūyante ye ’pi pāpakṛto narāḥ ||
uṣasy uṣasi yat snānaṃ saṃdhyāyām udite ravau |
prājāpatyena tat tulyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam ||
atyantamalinaḥ kāyo navacchidrasamanvitaḥ |
sravaty eṣa divārātrau prātaḥsnānaṃ viśodhanam ||
[850] klidyanti ca suṣuptasya indriyāṇi sravanti ca |
aṅgāni samatāṃ yānti uttamāny adhamāni ca ||
asnātvā nācaret karma japahomādi kiṃcana |
lālāsvedasamākīrṇaḥ śayanād utthitaḥ pumān ||
ataḥ snānaṃ praśaṃsanti dṛṣṭādṛṣṭakaraṃ śubham |
sarvam arhati śuddhātmā prātaḥsnāyī japādikam ||
satyavrataḥ |
balaṃ rūpaṃ yaśo dharmo jñānam āyuḥ sukhaṃ dhṛtiḥ |
ārogyaṃ puṣṭim āpnoti samyak snānena mānavaḥ ||
yogayājñavalkyaḥ |
agamyāgamanāt pāpāt pāpebhyaś ca pratigrahāt |
rahasy ācaritāt pāpān mucyate snānam ācaran ||
prakartum asamarthaś cet juhotiyajatikriyāḥ |
snānadhyānajapadānair ātmānaṃ śodhayed budhaḥ ||
yad eva snānaṃ kurute viśuddhenāntarātmanā |
tenaiva sarvam āpnoti vidhiyajñakriyāphalam ||
manaḥprasādajananaṃ rūpasaubhāgyavardhanam |
śokaduḥsvapnahaṃ snānaṃ mokṣadaṃ jñānadaṃ tathā ||
snānamūlāḥ kriyāḥ sarvāḥ śrutismṛtyuditā nṛṇām |
tasmāt snānaṃ niṣeveta śrīpuṣṭyārogyavardhanam ||
guṇā daśa snānaparasya sādhye
rūpaṃ ca tejaś ca balaṃ ca śaucam |
āyuṣyam ārogyam alolupatvaṃ
duḥsvapnaghātaś ca tapaśca medhā ||
iti snānapraśaṃsā |
atha snānabhedāḥ |
tatrāha dakṣaḥ |
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ trividhaṃ snānam ucyate |
teṣāṃ madhye tu yan nityaṃ tat punar bhidyate tridhā ||
malāpakarṣaṇaṃ pārśve samantraṃ tu jale smṛtam |
saṃdhyāsnānam ubhābhyāṃ tat snānadeśāḥ prakīrttitāḥ ||
mṛdgomayābhyāṃ śarīrakṣālanaṃ 'malāpakarṣaṇam' | 'pārśve' taṭe | ‘saṃdhyāsnānaṃ' mārjanam | tat ‘ubhābhyāṃ' jalasthalābhyāṃ kāryam ||
śaṅkhaḥ |
snānaṃ tu dvividhaṃ proktaṃ gauṇamukhyaprabhedataḥ |
tayos tu vāruṇaṃ mukhyaṃ tat punaḥ ṣaḍvidhaṃ bhavet ||
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ kriyāṅgaṃ malakarṣaṇam |
kriyāsnānaṃ tathā ṣaṣṭhaṃ ṣoḍhā snānaṃ prakīrtyate ||
eteṣāṃ krameṇa lakṣaṇāny āha sa eva |
asnātas tu pumān nārho japāgnihavanādiṣu |
prātaḥsnānaṃ tadarthaṃ ca nityaṃ snānaṃ prakīrtitam ||
caṇḍālaśavapūyādi spṛṣṭvā snānaṃ (?) rajasvalām |
snānārhaṃs tu yadā snāti snānaṃ naimittikaṃ hi tat ||
puṣpasnānādikaṃ yat tu devajña vidhicoditam |
[852] snānaṃ samācared yat tu kriyāṅgaṃ tat prakīrtitam ||
malāpakarṣaṇaṃ nāma snānam abhyaṅgapūrvakam |
malāpakarṣaṇāthā tu pravṛttis tasya nānyathā ||
saraḥsu devakhāteṣu tīrtheṣu ca nadīṣu ca |
kriyāsnānaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ snānaṃ tatra matā kriyā ||
snānam eva tatra 'kriyā' kāryaṃ, 'matā' vihitety arthaḥ |
tatra kāmyaṃ tu kartavyaṃ yathāvad vidhicoditam |
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ caiva kriyāṅgaṃ malakarṣaṇam ||
tīrthābhāve tu kartavyaṃ uṣṇodakaparodakaiḥ |
snātasya vahnitaptena tathaiva paravāriṇā ||
śarīraśuddhir vijñeyā na tu snānaphalaṃ bhavet |
adbhir gātrāṇi śudhyanti tīrthe snānāl labhet phalam ||
saraḥsu devakhāteṣu tīrtheṣu ca nadīṣu ca |
snānam eva kriyā yasmāt snānāt puṇyaphalaṃ smṛtam ||
gobhilaḥ |
nityaṃ satatanirvartyaṃ kāmyaṃ kāmāya yad dhitaṃ |
nimittād atha jātaṃ tu snānaṃ naimittikaṃ smṛtam ||
anena madhyandinasnānasyāpi nityatvam uktaṃ bhavati | tasyāpi nityanirvartyatvāt |
tathā ca vaiyāghrapādaḥ |
prātaḥsnāyī bhaven nityaṃ saṃdhyasnāyī (?) sadā bhavet |
[853] yathoktasnānāsamarthaṃ praty anyāny api snānāny āha yoga-yājñavalkyaḥ |
asāmarthyāc charīrasya kālaśaktyādyapekṣayā |
mantrasnānāditaḥ sapta kecid icchanti sūrayaḥ ||
māntraṃ bhaumaṃ tathāgneyaṃ vāyavyaṃ divyam eva ca |
vāruṇaṃ mānasaṃ caiva sapta snānāny anukramāt ||
eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇam āha sa eva |
āpohiṣṭhādibhir mantraṃ mṛdālambhaś ca pārthivam |
āgneyaṃ bhasmanā snānaṃ vāyavyaṃ gorajaḥ smṛtam ||
yat tu sātapavarṣeṇa snānaṃ tad divyam ucyate |
vāruṇaṃ cāvagāhantu mānasaṃ viṣṇucintanam ||
śastaṃ snānaṃ yathoddiṣṭaṃ mantrasnānāt krameṇa tu |
kālād deśād asāmarthyāt sarvaṃ tulyaphalaṃ smṛtam ||
mānasaṃ pravaraṃ snānaṃ kecid icchanti sūrayaḥ |
ātmatīrthapraśaṃsāyāṃ vyāsena paṭhitaṃ yataḥ ||
tathā |
śanna āpas tu drupadād āpohiṣṭhāghamarṣaṇam |
etaiś caturbhir ṛkmantrair mantrasnānam udīritam ||
aprāyatye samutpanne snānam evaṃ tu kārayet |
pūrvoddiṣṭais tathā mantrair anyathā mārjanaṃ bhavet ||
āha gautamaḥ |
divyavāyavyam āgneyaṃ brāhmaṃ sārasvataṃ tathā |
mānasaṃ ceti vijñeyaṃ gauṇasnānaṃ tu ṣaḍvidham ||
[854] parāśaro ’pi |
pañca snānāni puṇyāni yāny abhāṣanta tadvidaḥ |
samyak tāni pravakṣyāmi yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ ||
āgneyaṃ vāruṇaṃ caiva tṛtīyaṃ brāhmam eva ca |
caturthaṃ caiva vāyavyaṃ pañcamaṃ divyam ucyate ||
āgneyaṃ bhasmanā snānam avagāhya tu vāruṇam |
āpohiṣṭheti ca brāhmaṃ vāyavyaṃ gorajobhavam ||
kāle vā yadi vākāle sūrye meghavivarjite |
tasmin dṛṣṭe tu yat nānaṃ tad divyam iti cocyate ||
chāgaleyaḥ |
āgneyaṃ bhasmanā snānam adbhir vāruṇam ucyate |
āpohiṣṭheti ca brāhmaṃ vāyavyaṃ gorajaḥ smṛtam ||
adbhir ātapavarṣābhir divyaṃ snānam ihocyate |
etais tu mantrataḥ snātvā tīrthānāṃ phalam āpnuyāt ||
atra viśeṣaḥ kūrmapurāṇe darśitaḥ |
āgneyaṃ bhasmanā pādamastakād dehadhūlanam |
bṛhaspatiḥ |
vāyavyaṃ gorajaḥ proktam astaṃ gacchati gopatau |
vidvatsarasvatīprāptaṃ sārasvatam ity arthaḥ
tatsvarūpaṃ vyāsaḥ |
svayam evopasannāya vinayena dvijātaye |
tajjñaḥ sampādayet snānaṃ śiṣyāya ca sutāya ca ||
[855] dākṣāyaṇamayaiḥ kumbhaiḥ mantravij jāhnavījalaiḥ |
kṛtamaṅgalapuṇyāhaiḥ snānama stu tavānagham ||
ityuktvā jāhavīsthāne tīrthāny anyāni kīrtayet |
sarvatīrthābhiṣekas te bhūyād ity antato vadet ||
ity evaṃ vipravaryāṇāṃ vacanena mahātmanām |
sarvatīrtheṣu susnātaḥ pūto bhavati nānyathā ||
'upasannāya' samīpe upaviṣṭāya, 'dākṣāyaṇaṃ' hiraṇyam |
jābālaḥ |
aśiraskaṃ bhavet snānaṃ snānāśakau tu karmiṇām |
ārdreṇa vāsasā vāpi mārjanaṃ daihikaṃ viduḥ ||
etat kāpilaṃ snānam |
tad āha bṛhaspatiḥ |
ārdreṇa karpaṭenāṅgaśodhanaṃ kāpilaṃ smṛtam |
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ trividhaṃ snānam ucyate |
tarpaṇaṃ tu bhavet tasya aṅgatvena prakīrtitam ||
kvacin naimittike tarpaṇāpavādam āhāpastambaḥ |
aspṛśyasparśane vānte aśrupāte kṣure bhage ||
snānaṃ naimittikaṃ kāryaṃ daivapitryavivarjitam ||
atra viśeṣam āha viṣṇuḥ |
snānārho yo nimittena kṛtvā bhūyo ’vagāhanaṃ |
[856] ācamya prayataḥ paścāt snānaṃ vidhivad ācaret ||
'kṛtvāvagāhanaṃ' tūṣṇīm iti śeṣaḥ |
tathā yogayājñavalkyaḥ |
tūṣṇīm evāvagāheta yadā syād aśucir naraḥ |
ācamya prayataḥ paścāt snānaṃ vidhivad ācaret ||
vṛddhavasiṣṭhaḥ |
caṇḍālādes tu saṃsparśe vāruṇaṃ snānam ācaret |
itarāṇi tu catvāri yathāyogaṃ smṛtāni vai ||
'itarāṇi' brāhmādīṇi |
vāruṇasnāne ’pi nityaviśeṣam āha gārgyaḥ |
kuryāḥ naimittikaṃ snānaṃ śītādbhiḥ kāmyam eva ca |
nityaṃ yādṛcchikaṃ caiva yathāruci samācaret ||
'yādṛcchikaṃ' malāpakarṣaṇārtham,
malavyapohanaṃ snānaṃ prāhur yādṛcchikaṃ punaḥ |
iti tenaivoktatvāt |
āturasnānaṃ praty āha parāśaraḥ |
āture snāna utpanne daśakṛtvo hy anāturaḥ |
snātvā snātvā spṛśed enaṃ tataḥ śuddhet sa āturaḥ ||
snāne naimittike prāpte nārī yadi rajasvalā |
pātrāntaritatoyena snānaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ caret ||
siktagātrā bhaved adbhiḥ sāṅgopāṅgaṃ kathaṃcana |
na vastrapīḍanaṃ kuryān nānyad vāsaś ca dhārayet ||
uśanāḥ |
[857] jvarābhibhūtā yā nārī rajasā ca pariplutā |
kathaṃ tasyā bhavec chaucaṃ śuddhiḥ syāt kena karmaṇā ||
caturthe ’hani saṃprāpte spṛśed anyā tu tāṃ striyam |
sā sacailāvagāhyāpaḥ snātvā snātvā punaḥ spṛśet ||
daśadvādaśakṛtvo vā ācāmec ca punaḥ punaḥ |
ante ca vāsasāṃ tyāgas tataḥ śuddhā bhavet tu sā |
dadyād bhaktyā tato dānaṃ puṇyāhena viśudhyati ||
sūtikārajasalayor maraṇe viśeṣam āha chāgaleyaḥ |
smūtikāyāṃ mṛtāyāṃ ca kathaṃ kurvanti yājñikāḥ |
kumbhe salilam ādāya pañcagavyaṃ tathaiva ca ||
puṇyargbhir abhimantrayāpo vācā śuddhiṃ labhet tataḥ |
tenaiva snāpayitvā tu kuryāt snānaṃ yathāvidhi ||
pañcabhiḥ snāpayitvā tu mṛtāṃ gavyai rajasvalām |
vastrāntarāvṛtāṃ kṛtvā dāhayed vidhipūrvakam ||
iti snānabhedāḥ |
atha snānakartuḥ pratiṣedhāḥ |
tatrāha vyāsaḥ |
rātrau snānaṃ na kurvīta dānaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ |
naimittikaṃ tu kurvīta snānaṃ dānaṃ ca rātriṣu ||
etan mahāniśābhiprāyam |
yad āha manuḥ |
na snānam ācared bhuktvā nāturo na mahāniśi |
[858] na vāsobhiḥ sahājasraṃ nāvijñāte jalāśaye ||
jābāliḥ |
na pārakaye sadā snāyān na bhuktvā na mahāniśi |
nārdram ekaṃ ca vasanaṃ paridadhyāt kadācana ||
mahāniśālakṣaṇam āha mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |
mahāniśā dve ghaṭike rātrau madhyamayāmayoḥ |
naimittikaṃ tadā kuryāt kāmyaṃ na tu manāg api ||
kāmyam atrāvihitakālaviśeṣam | dvitīyayāmasyāntyā tṛtīyasya cādyeti ghaṭikādvayam |
madhyamayāmadvayasyaiva mahāniśātvam āha devalaḥ |
mahāniśā tu vijñeyā madhyamaṃ praharadvayam |
tasyāṃ snānaṃ na kurvīta kāmyanaimittikād ṛte ||
kāmyaṃ tatkālavihitam | yathā –
pratiyāmaṃ tato rātreḥ snāyāc chītair ghaṭāmbubhiḥ |
ityādi | paiṭhīnasir api |
apeyaṃ hi sadā toyaṃ rātrau madhyamayāmayoḥ |
snānaṃ caiva na kartavyaṃ tathaivācamanakriyā ||
viśvāmitraḥ |
mahāniśā tu vijñeyā rātrau madhyamayāmayoḥ |
tasyāṃ snānaṃ na kurvīta kāmyam ācamanaṃ tathā ||
ṣaṭatriṃśanmate ’pi |
apeyaṃ hi sadā toyaṃ rātrau madhyamayāmayoḥ |
[859] snānaṃ tatra na kurvīta kāmyam ācamanakriyā ||
nimittaviśeṣe tv ācamanapratiprasavo ’pi tatraiva |
mūtroccāre mahārātrau kuryād ācamanaṃ tu yaḥ |
prāyaścitīyate vipraḥ prājāpatyārdham arhati ||
'uccāraḥ' purīṣotsargaḥ |
tad eva mahāniśāyām eva snānaniṣedhād anyatra rātrāv apy aviruddham iti gamyate |
ata eva parāśaraḥ |
mahāniśā tu vijñeyā madhyasthaṃ praharadvayam |
pradoṣe paścime yāme dinasnānaṃ samācaret ||
'pradoṣaḥ' pūrvayāmaḥ | etac ca dine snānāsambhave sati veditavyam |
yad āha sa eva |
divākarakaraiḥ pūtaṃ divāsnānaṃ praśasyate |
apraśastaṃ niśi snānaṃ rāhor anyatra darśanāt ||
vyāsaḥ |
apraśastaṃ niśi snānaṃ rāhor anyatra darśanāt |
parāmbhasi tathaivālpe nāśiraskaṃ kathaṃcana ||
'rāhudarśanaṃ' grahaṇaṃ, saṃkrāntyāder api pradarśanārtham |
ata eva devalaḥ |
rāhudarśanasaṃkrāntivivāhātyayavṛddhiṣu |
snānadānādikaṃ kuryur niśi kāmyatrateṣu ca ||
[860] ‘atyayaḥ' maraṇam | ‘vṛddhiḥ' jananam |
yogayājñavalkyo ’pi |
grahaṇodvāhasaṅkrāntiyātrārttiprasaveṣu ca |
snānaṃ naimittikaṃ jñeyaṃ rātrāv api tad iṣyate ||
'arttiḥ' maraṇam |
parāśaro ’pi |
putrajanmani yajñe ca tathā saṃkramaṇe raveḥ |
rāhoś ca darśane snānaṃ praśastaṃ nānyathā niśi ||
'yajñe' avabhṛthe |
yas tu rātrau nadīsnānapratiṣedha ukto vyāsena,
nadyām astamite snānaṃ varjayet sarvathā naraḥ |
nadyāṃ snāto nadīm anyāṃ na praśaṃset tu dharmavit ||
antardhāya na ca snāyān na ca tīrthe jalāntare |
na meheta jaladroṇyāṃ snātuṃ ca na nadīṃ taret ||
so ’yam aspṛśyaspṛṣṭaviṣayaḥ |
yad āha vṛddhaśātātapaḥ |
āditye ’stamite rātrāv avaspṛśya spṛśed yadi |
bhagavan kena śuddhiḥ syāt tan me brūhi suniścitam ||
anastamita āditye saṃgṛhītaṃ tu yaj jalam |
tena sarvātmanā śuddhiḥ śavasparśaṃ ca varjayet ||
parāśaraḥ |
astaṃ gate yadā sūrye caṇḍālaṃ patitaṃ striyam |

jātavedāḥ suvarṇaṃ ca somam arkaṃ tathaiva ca |
brāhmaṇānumate caiva snātvā spṛṣṭvā ca śudhyati ||
ācāntam anugantaṃ vā niśi snānaṃ na vidyate |
snānam ācamanaṃ proktaṃ divāhṛtajalena tu ||
yamaḥ |
vipraḥ spṛṣṭo niśāyāṃ tūdakyayā patitena vā |
divānītena toyena snāpayed agnisaṃnidhau ||
divāhṛtaṃ toyam api kṛtvā svarṇayutaṃ tu tat |
rātrisnāne tu saṃprāpte snāyād analasaṃnidhau ||
yadā tu divāhṛtaṃ toyaṃ na saṃbhavati tadā viśeṣam āha marīciḥ |
divāhṛtaṃ tu yat toyaṃ gṛhe yadi na vidyate |
prajvālyāgniṃ tataḥ snāyān nadīpuṣkariṇīṣu ca ||
atra viśeṣam āha kātyāyanaḥ |
pracetā varuṇaś cāpsu na rātrau jalam uddharet |
anyatra dhāmna ity etat tīrasthaḥ snānam ācaret ||
dhāmnodhāmna iti pratīkopalakṣitamantram antareṇa rātrau jalaṃ noddhared ity arthaḥ | evam uddhṛtena ca jalena nadyāditīrasthaḥ snāyāt | māpo mauṣadhīr hiṃsīr dhāmno dhāmno rājann ityādiyājurvediko mantraḥ |
jaloddharaṇe viśeṣam āha paiṭhīnasiḥ |

dhāmno dhāmna iti mantreṇa gṛhīṇyād agnisaṃnidhau ||
‘agnisaṃnidhau’ jalasyopari jvalantam agniṃ dhārayitvety arthaḥ |
tathā ca hārītaḥ |
dhāmno dhāmna ity agnim upariṣṭād dhārayan gṛhṇīyāt |

yad āha vyāsaḥ |
candrasūryagrahe caiva yo ’vagāheta jāhnavīm |

devīpurāṇe |

pādena pāṇinā vāpi yaṣṭyā vastreṇa codakam |

ācaren nābhiṣekaṃ tu karmāṇy anyāni vācaret ||

nānyat praśaṃset tatrasthas tīrtheṣv āyataneṣu ca ||

jābāliḥ |
nityaṃ na hāpayet snānaṃ kāmyaṃ naimittikaṃ ca yat |

daśamīṃ pañcamīṃ caiva pūrṇamāsīṃ trayodaśīm |
ekādaśīṃ tṛtīyāṃ ca yas tailam upasevate |
uttīrṇā tasya vṛddhiḥ syād anāpattibalāyuṣām ||
baudhāyano ’pi |
nandāsa caiva riktāsa pūrṇasu ca jayāsu ca |

ravisaṃkramaṇe caiva nābhyaṅgaṃ snānam ācaret ||

atra pracetāḥ |
sārṣapaṃ gandhatailaṃ ca yat tailaṃ puṣpavāsitam |
anyad dravyayutaṃ caiva na duṣyati kadācana ||
yamo ’pi |

na doṣaḥ pakvataileṣu snānābhyaṅge tu nityaśaḥ ||
brahmavaivartapurāṇe |
pakṣayor ubhayo rājan saptamyāṃ niśi saṃdhyayoḥ |
vidyāputrakalatrārthī tilaiḥ snānaṃ vivarjayet ||
tilasnānaṃ sadā puṇyaṃ kuryād āmalakaiḥ śriyam |
saptamīnavamīdarśa-ravisaṃkramaṇād ṛte ||
vāyupurāṇe |
navamyāṃ darśa-saptamyoḥ saṃkrāntau ravivāsare |

vyāsaḥ |
daśamyāṃ ca tṛtīyāyāṃ trayodaśyāṃ tathaiva ca |
na varṇair vāruṇaṃ snānaṃ kartavyaṃ kṣatriyādibhiḥ ||
jābālir api |
trayodaśyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ daśamyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ |
śūdraviṭkṣatrajāḥ snānaṃ nācareyuḥ kathaṃcana ||
atra pratiprasavam āha gargaḥ |
putrajanmani saṃkrāntau śrāddhe janmadine tathā |
nityasnāne ca kartavye tithidoṣo na vidyate ||
gāruḍapurāṇe ’pi |

bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
na snāyād utsave ’tīte maṅgalyāni nivartya ca |
anuvrajya suhṛdbandhūn arcayitveṣṭadevatāḥ ||
pratiprasavo ’pi tatraiva |

snehamantrasamāyukaṃ madhyāhnāt prāg viśeṣataḥ ||
iti snānakartuḥ pratiṣedhāḥ |
atha snānārthaṃ grāhyāṇi varjyāni codakāni |
tatra manuḥ |
nadīṣu devakhāteṣu taḍāgeṣu saraḥsu ca |
snānaṃ samācaren nityaṃ gartaprasravaṇeṣu ca ||
‘nadī' aśoṣyasalilā sravantī | grīṣmśoṣyasalilāsu svalpasaritsu snānaniṣedhāt | devaiḥ khātam iti yat smaryate tat 'devakhātam | sahasradvayahastādhikaparimāṇaḥ kṛtrimo jalāśayaḥ 'taḍāgaḥ' | hastasahasrādhikaparimāṇaṃ taḍāgāc ca nyūnaṃ 'saraḥ |
garttasvarūpam uktaṃ kātyāyanena |
dhanuḥsahasrāṇy aṣṭau ca gatir yāsāṃ na vidyate |

apām uttarottaraṃ puṇyatvam āha mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |

vivasvān api |

padmapurāṇe |

sarvā raktavahā nadyaḥ karatoyāmbuvāhinī ||'

tathā |
karkaṭādau rajoduṣṭā gomatī vāsaratrayam |
candrabhāgā satī sindhuḥ śarayūr narmadā tathā ||
uktavyatiriktānāṃ sarvāsām api nadīnāṃ māsadvayaṃ rajodoṣe prāpte viśeṣam āha sa eva |
yavyadvayaṃ śrāvaṇādi sarvā nadyo rajasvalāḥ |

‘yavyāḥ’ māṣāḥ, “yurekaḥ saṃvatsara" iti śatapathaśruteḥ | samudragāminīnāṃ tu ṣaḍrātraṃ rajoyoga ity uktaṃ bhagavatīpurāṇe |
māsadvayaṃ karkaṭādi sarvā nadyo rajasvalāḥ |

sarasvatī nadī puṇyā tathā vaitaraṇī nadī |
āpagā narmadā caiva gaṅgā mandākinī nadī ||
madhusravā aṃśumatī kauśikī yamunā tathā |
dṛṣadvatī mahāpuṇyā tathā hairaṇvatī nadī ||
varṣākālavahāḥ sarvā varjayitvā sarasvatīm |
etāsām udakaṃ puṇyaṃ varṣākāle prakīrtitam |
rajasvalātvam etāsāṃ vidyate na kadācana ||
kātyāyano ’pi |

rajasā nābhibhūyante ye cānye nadasaṃjñakāḥ ||
kurukṣetre yā sarasvatī mā 'plakṣajātā' |

yasyāṃ rajakatīrthaṃ ca daśahastena copari ||
pratyāvarte āvartayukte |
baudhāyano ’pi |

mārkaṇḍeyo 'pi |

anutsṛṣṭeṣu na svāyāt tathaivāsaṃskṛteṣu ca ||
'asaṃskṛtaṃ' akṛtapratiṣṭham | 'anutsṛṣṭaṃ' sarvārthatvenātyaktaṃ parakīyam iti yāvat |
ata eva jābāliḥ |
na pārakye sadā snāyāt |
manur api |
parakīyanipāneṣu svāyān naiva kadācana |
[875] nipānakartuḥ snāyī hi duṣkṛtāṃśena lipyate || iti |
yat punar vyāsenoktam,
pañcapiṇḍān anuddhṛtya pārakye snānam ācaret|
iti, yac ca yājñavalkayena |
pañcapiṇḍān samuddhṛtya na svāyāt paravāriṣu |
yac ca śaṅkhalikhitau |
naiṣṭhikacite pitṝṃs tarpayet | vāpīkūpataḍāgodapāneṣu sapta pañca trīn vā piṇḍān uddhṛtya devapitṝṃs tarpayet |
iti, yac ca paiṭhīnasinā |
parakṛtān setukūpāṃś ca varjayet | aṃśabhāk tatra setos trīn piṇḍān uddhṛtya snāyāt |
iti, tan nadyādyalābhaviṣayam |
tathā ca manuḥ |
alābhe devakhātānāṃ sarasāṃ saritāṃ tathā |
uddhṛtya caturaḥ piṇḍān pārakye snānam ācaret || iti |
baudhāyano ’pi |
tasmāt parakṛtān setūn kūpāṃś ca parivarjayet |
uddhṛtya vāpi trīn piṇḍān kuryād āpatsu no sadā ||
niruddhāt pañcamṛtpiṇḍān kūpāc ca trīn ghaṭāṃs tathā |
śaunako ’pi |
vāpīkūpataḍāgeṣu yadi svāyāt kadācana |
uddhṛtya mṛttikāpiṇḍān daśa pañcātha vā kṣipet ||
yogayājñavalkyo ’pi |
[876] parakīyanipāneṣu yadi snāyāt kadācana |
saptapiṇḍāṃs tadoddhṛtya tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret ||
viṣṇur api |
paranipāneṣu na snāyāt snānam ācared vā pañcapiṇḍān uddhṛtyāpadīti |
atra yathāsāmarthyaṃ vyavasthā | evaṃ ca yatrānuddhṛtya parakīye snānaṃ tatraiva taddoṣabhāktvam ity uktaṃ bhavati |
tad āha śaunakaḥ |
anuddhṛtya tu yaḥ snāyāt parakīyajalāśaye ||
vṛthā bhavati tat snānaṃ kartuḥ pāpena lipyate || iti |
'vṛthā' niṣphalam ity arthaḥ | sarvārthatvenotsṛṣṭe tu parakīyatvābhāvād anuddharaṇe na doṣa iti bhāvaḥ |
evam uṣṇodakasnāne ’pi naiṣphalyam āha śaṅkhaḥ |
snātasya vahnitaptena tathaiva paravāriṇā |
śarīraśuddhir vijñeyā na tu snānaphalaṃ bhavet ||
yogayājñavalkyo ’pi |
vṛthā uṣṇodakasnānaṃ vṛthā japyam avaidikam |
vṛthā tv aśrotriye dānaṃ vṛthā bhuktam asākṣikam || iti |
yat tu yamenoktam,
āpa eva sadā pūtās tāsāṃ vahnir viśodhakaḥ |
tasmāt sarveṣu kāleṣu uṣṇāmbhḥ pāvanaṃ smṛtam ||
iti, yad api ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
apaḥ svabhāvato medhyāḥ kiṃ punar vahnitāpitāḥ |
[877] tena santaḥ praśaṃsanti snānam uṣṇena vāriṇā ||
iti, tad āturasnānaviṣayam |
tathā ca yamaḥ |
ādityakiraṇaiḥ pūtaṃ punaḥ pūtaṃ tu vahinā |
āmnātam āturasnāne praśastaṃ tu śṛtodakam || iti |
yadā tu nadyādikaṃ na labhyate tadānīm anāturasyāpy uṣṇodakasnānam aviruddham ity āha sa eva |
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ caiva kriyāṅgaṃ malakarṣaṇam |
tīrthābhāve tu kartavyam uṣṇodakaparodakaiḥ || iti |
yat tu vṛddhamanunoktam,
mṛte janmani saṃkrāntyāṃ śrāddhe janmadine tathā |
aspṛśyasparśane caiva na snāyād uṣṇavāriṇā ||
saṃkrāntyāṃ bhānuvāre ca saptamyāṃ rājadarśane |
ārogyaputramitrārthī na snāyād uṣṇavāriṇā ||
paurṇamāsyāṃ tathā darśe yaḥ snāyād uṣṇavāriṇā |
sa gohatyākṛtaṃ pāpaṃ prāpnotīha na saṃśayaḥ ||
iti, tenāpy ukteṣu maraṇādiṣu tīrthābhāve ’pi noṣṇodakaḥ snāyāt, kiṃ tu paraudakair uddhṛtair vety uktam ity avirodhaḥ |
uṣṇasnāne tu viśeṣam āha vyāsaḥ |
śītāsv apsu niṣicyoṣṇā mantrasaṃbhārasaṃbhṛtāḥ |
gṛhe ’pi śasyate jñānam aphalaṃ syāt tadanyathā ||
'saṃbhārāḥ' mṛdādayaḥ |
[878] ata eva madhyandinasnānādhikāre vivasvān |
mantrasaṃbhārasaṃyuktam upasparśanam ucyate |
snāne ’vagāhane caiva plāvanaṃ vidhivarjitam || iti |
iti snānārthaṃ grāhyāṇi varjyani codakāni |
atha snānasaṃbhārāḥ |
tatrāha dakṣaḥ |
caturthe tu tathā bhāge snānārthaṃ mṛdam āharet |
tilapuṣpakuśādīni snānaṃ vā kṛtrime jale ||
aṣṭadhā vibhakaś caturtho bhāgo ’tra jñeyaḥ |
yogayājñavalkyaḥ |
mṛttilān gomayaṃ darbhān puṣpāṇi surabhīni ca |
āharet snānakāle tu snānārthaṃ prayataḥ śuciḥ |
gatvodakāntaṃ vidhivat kramāt sthāpyaṃ pṛthak kṣitau ||
śaunakaḥ |
nadītīre śucau deśe āharen mṛttikāṃ kuśān |
prayato mṛdam ādāya dūrvāpāmārgagomayam |
ekadeśe pṛthak kuryān mṛdaḥ stokaṃ tataḥ kramāt ||
jābāliḥ |
tataś ca mṛttikāṃ śuddhām adurgandhām anūṣarām |
śucideśād atiślakṣṇāṃ kāyaśuddhyartham āharet ||
amedhyāśanaśūnyānāṃ nīrujānāṃ tathā gavām |
avyaṅgānāṃ ca sadyaskaṃ śuci gomayam āharet ||
[879] ārdrapratāninīṃ deśāt śmaśānādivivarjitāt |
mārjanārthaṃ haret dūrvāṃ apāmārgaṃ tathaiva ca ||
sarvakarmopayogārthaṃ kuśān kāśān athāpi vā |
ānayet tarpaṇārthaṃ tu yavān api tilāṃs tathā ||
devatārcanakarmārthaṃ navāḥ sumanasaḥ śubhāḥ |
ādadīta viśuddhātmā dhautavāsoyugaṃ tathā ||
tathābhyukṣaṇam āhartuṃ pātram audumbaraṃ dṛḍham |
japārtham akṣamālāṃ ca rudrākṣādivinirmitām |
evaṃ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāraḥ snānakarma samārabhet ||
atra śātātapaḥ |
valmīkākhūtkarāl lepāj jalāc ca pathivṛakṣayoḥ |
kṛtaśaucāvaśiṣṭā ca na grāhyāḥ sapta mṛttikāḥ ||
śucau deśe tu saṃgrāhyā śarkarāśmādivarjitā |
raktā gaurā tathā śvetā mṛttikā trividhā smṛtā ||
na mṛdaṃ nodakaṃ vāpi na niśāyāṃ tu gomayam |
na gomūtraṃ pradoṣe tu gṛhṇīyād buddhimān naraḥ ||
tilodvartī tilasnāyī śucir nityaṃ tilodakī |
hotā bhoktā ca dātā ca ṣaṭtilau nāvasīdati ||
marīciḥ |
mṛddarbhatilapuṣpāṇi dūrvāpāmārgagomayam |
tilāmalakavāsāṃsi pātram abhyukṣaṇasya ca ||
ekāntam udakaṃ gatvā taṭaṃ prakṣālya pāṇinā |
[880] saṃbhārān sthāpayet tatra yathādeśaṃ pṛthak pṛthak ||
aṅgirāḥ |
vinā darbheṇa yat snānaṃ yac ca dānaṃ vinodakam |
asaṃkhyātaṃ ca yaj japyaṃ tat sarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet ||
vyāsaḥ |
ādāya parayā bhaktyā gaṅgātīrodbhavāṃ mṛdam |
saṃvarddhayati gātrāṇi tasya dharmo mahān bhavet ||
vasiṣṭhaḥ |
prayato mṛdam ādāya dūrvam ādrāṃ ca gomayam |
sthāpayitvā tathācamya tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret ||
iti snānasaṃbhārāḥ |
atha prātaḥsnānaṃ |
tatrāha dakṣaḥ |
divasasyādyabhāge tu kṛtyaṃ tasyopadiśyate |
uṣaḥkāle tu saṃprāpte śaucaṃ kuryād yathārthavat |
tataḥ snānaṃ prakurvīta dantadhāvanapūrvakam ||
śaunakaḥ |
prātar ācamanaṃ kṛtvā śraddhāyukto yathārthavat |
dantaśaucaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā prātaḥ snānaṃ samācaret ||
gautamaḥ |
[881] kṛtaśaucavidhiḥ samyak svācānto dantadhāvanam |
vidhāyoṣasi kurvīta snānaṃ ca vidhipūrvakam ||
jātūkarṇyaḥ |
sarvair varṇaiḥ prakartavyaṃ prātaḥsnānaṃ dine dine |
mantravat tu dvijāḥ kuryuḥ śūdrā mantravivarjitam ||
satyavrataḥ |
caturṇām api varṇānāṃ prātaḥsnānaṃ viśodhanaṃ |
dvijātibhiḥ prakartavyaṃ mantrais tu śruticoditaiḥ ||
baudhāyanaḥ |
ambho’vagāhanaṃ snānaṃ vihitaṃ sārvavarṇikam |
mantravat prokṣaṇaṃ cāpi dvijātīnāṃ viśiṣyate ||
mahābhārate |
brahmakṣatraviśāṃ caiva mantravat snānam iṣyate |
tūṣṇīm eva hi śūdrasya strīṇāṃ ca kurunandana ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
nityam abhyudayāt pūrvaṃ snātavyaṃ śuddhim icchatā |
eṣa sādhāraṇo dharmaś cāturvarṇyasya kīrtitaḥ |
strībhiḥ śūdraiś ca kartavyaṃ mantravarjaṃ vigāhanam ||
gobhilaḥ |
kuryād ahar ahaḥ snānaṃ uṣasy anudite ravau |
nityam apliṅgakair mantrais tarpayec ca tathā pitṝn ||
viṣṇuḥ |
[882] prātaḥsnāyy aruṇakaragrastāṃ prācīm avalokya snāyāt |
yat tu caturviṃśatimate,
uṣasy uṣasi yat snānaṃ ṃdhyāyām udite ’pi ca |
iti tad api pūrvavacanāviruddham, 'udite' udayābhimukha iti vyākhyānāt | anyathā “prātaḥsaṃdhyāṃ sanakṣatrām” ityādivirodhaḥ syāt | “snāto ’dhikārī bhavati" ityādibhiḥ snātasyaiva saṃdhyādyadhikārāt | na caitadvacanabalād eva saṃdhyotkṛṣyatām iti yuktam |
saṃdhau saṃdhyām upāsīta nāstage nodgate ravau |
iti yogayājñavalkyenodite niṣedhasmaraṇāt | yājñavalkyaḥ |
ubhe saṃdhye tu snātavyaṃ brāhmaṇaiś ca gṛhāśritaiḥ |
tisṛṣv api ca saṃdhyāsu snātavyaṃ tu tapasvinā ||
'ubhe saṃdhye' prātarmadhyāhnākhye | 'gṛhāśritaiḥ' gṛhasthaiḥ | 'tapasvī' yatiḥ |
viśvāmitraḥ |
prātarmadhyāhnayoḥ snānaṃ vanasthagṛhamedhinoḥ |
dine dine yatīnāṃ tu snānaṃ triṣavaṇaṃ smṛtam |
sakṛd eva hi tat prokaṃ niyataṃ brahmacāriṇaḥ ||
dakṣaḥ |
prātarmadhyāhnayoḥ snānaṃ vāṇaprasthagṛhasthayoḥ |
yates triṣavaṇaṃ prokaṃ sakṛt tu brahmacāriṇaḥ ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
yathāhani tathā prātar nityaṃ snāyād atandritaḥ |
dantān prakṣālya nadyādau gṛhe caitad amantravat ||
[883] 'amantravad" iti sarvathā mantraniṣedhaparaṃ na bhavati kiṃ tu mantrabahutvaniṣedhārtham |
yad āha jaiminiḥ |
gṛhe ’pi hi dvijātīnāṃ mantravat snānam iṣyate |
vidher lopaṃ na te kuryuḥ sāmarthye sati karhicit || iti |
sarvathā mantraniṣedhe doṣam āha vivasvān |
aviditvaiva yaḥ smārtaṃ vidhānaṃ snānam ārabhet |
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoram iti dharmasya dhāraṇā ||
vyāso ’pi |
mantrapūtaṃ tu yat snānaṃ prāhuḥ snānaṃ phalapradam |
na vṛthā vārim agnānāṃ yādasām iva tatsamam ||
'yādasāṃ' jalajantūnām |
yogayājñavalkaro ’pi |
upasthānādir yas tāsāṃ mantravat kīrttito vidhiḥ |
nivedanāntas tat snānam ity āhur brahmavādinaḥ ||
niṣekāt prabhṛti yāvat śmaśānaṃ śrutidarśanāt |
nāmantravad dvijātīnāṃ karma kiṃcit pravartate ||
vidhidṛṣṭaṃ tu yat karma karoty avidhinā tu yaḥ |
na phalaṃ kiṃcid āpnoti kleśamātraṃ hi tasya tat ||
matsyakacchapamaṇḍūkās toye magnā divāniśam |
vasanto ’pi ca te snānāt phalaṃ nārhanti karhicit ||
[884] śraddhāvidhisamāyukaṃ karma yat kriyate nṛbhiḥ |
śuciśuddhena bhāvena tad ānantyāya kalpyate ||
vidhihīnaṃ bhāvaduṣṭaṃ kṛtam aśraddhayā ca yat |
tad dharanty asurās tasya mūḍhasya tv akṛtātmanaḥ ||
brahmakṣatraviśāṃ caiva mantravat snānam iṣyate |
tūṣṇīm eva hi śūdrasya sanamaskārakaṃ smṛtam || iti |
ato homādikarmalopasaṃbhavāt saṃkṣepeṇa prātaḥsnānaṃ tv amantrakaṃ kuryāt |
yad āha śāṭyāyaniḥ |
kālālpatvād dhi śaṅketa yadi homādibādhanam |
tadā saṃkṣepataḥ kuryāt sarvathā tat tv amantrakam ||
kātyāyano ’pi |
alpatvād dhomakālasya bahutvāt snānakarmaṇaḥ |
prātaḥ saṃkṣepataḥ snānaṃ homalopo vigarhitaḥ || iti |
saṃkṣepasnānaprakāram āha yogayājñavalkāḥ |
yo ’sau vistarataḥ proktaḥ snānasya vidhir uttamaḥ |
asāmarthyān na kuryāc cet tatrāyaṃ vidhir ucyate ||
snānam antarjale caiva mārjanācamane tathā |
jalābhimantraṇaṃ caiva tīrthasya parikalpanam ||
aghamarṣaṇasūktena trirāvṛttena nityaśaḥ |
snānācaraṇam ity etat samuddiṣṭaṃ mahātmabhiḥ |
[884] anyān vā vāruṇān mantrān kāmataḥ saṃprayojayet ||
snānaṃ caturviṃśatau |
snānam abdaiś ca tair mantrair vāruṇaiś ca mṛdā saha |
kuryād vyāhṛtibhir vātha yat kiṃ cedam ṛcāpi vā ||
drupadād iveti vā snānaṃ tarpayed devamānuṣān |
idaṃ ca tarpaṇaṃ snānāṅgam,
tarpaṇaṃ tu bhavet tasya aṅgatvena prakīrtitam |
iti brahmāṇḍapurāṇasmaraṇāt |
baudhāyanaḥ |
tapasyam apām avagāhanaṃ devatās tarpayitvā pitṛtarpaṇam anutīrtham apa ucchiñcaty ūrjaṃ vahantīr ity athāpy udāharanti |
sravantīṣv aniruddhāsu trayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ |
prātar utthāya kurvīran devarṣipitṛtarpaṇam ||
caturviṃśatau |
snānasyānantaraṃ tāvat tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ |
idaṃ ca tarpaṇaṃ jalasthenaiva kartavyam | yad āha vyāghraḥ |
nābhimātre jale sthitvā cintayann ūrdhvamānasaḥ |
āgacchantu me pitaro gṛhṇantv etān jalāñjalīn ||
pitṝṇām ambarasthānām ambhastho dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ |
trīṃs trīn jalāñjalīn dadyād uccair uccatarān budhaḥ || iti |
prādeśamātram uddhṛtya pitruddeśenāñjalitrayaṃ deyam | tato hastamātram uddhṛtya pitāmahod-deśena, tato gośṛṅgamātram uddhṛtya prapitāmahoddeśeneti krameṇocair ucataratvam |
[886] tad ukaṃ gāruḍapurāṇe |
prādeśamātram uddhṛtya hastamātraṃ tataḥ param |
tato gośṛṅgamātraṃ ca pitrādibhyo jalaṃ kṣipet |
prādeśamātram uddhṛtya tarpayed devamānuṣān ||
brahmavaivarte |
nābhimātre jale sthitvā kuryāt snānāṅgatarpaṇam |
devān ṛṣīn pitṛgaṇān svapitṝṃś cāpi tarpayet ||
uddhṛtair udakaiḥ snāto na kuryād anyadā punaḥ |
snānāṅgatarpaṇaṃ vidvān kadācin naiva hāpayet ||
ato madhyāhnāne ’pi snānāṅgatarpaṇam ambhasthenaiva kāryam | na cāparāhṇaḥ pitṝṇām iti śruteḥ kathaṃ prātaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam iti śaṃkanīyam | tathātve pūrvohṇo vai devānām iti śruter madhyandine snāne devatarpaṇaṃ na syāt | na ca mobhūd iti vācyam,
snāneṣu caiva sarveṣu tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ |
kāmye nitye viśeṣeṇa tat prakuryāt prayatnataḥ ||
iti vyāsasmaraṇāt | ataḥ śrutidvayaṃ tarpaṇavyatiriktaviṣayam ity avagantavyam |
kiṃ ca akaraṇe doṣo ’pi vasiṣṭhena darśitaḥ |
nāstikyabhāvād yaḥ snātvā na tarpayati vai pitṝn |
pibanti dehaniḥsrāvaṃ pitaro ’sya jalārthinaḥ || iti |
'dehaniḥsrāvaḥ' dehamalaḥ |
kaśyapaḥ 1
devān ṛṣīn manuṣyāṃś ca śuciḥ pitṛgaṇān api |
snātaḥ saṃtarpayed vidvāṃs tadādhārā hi te yataḥ ||
[887] evaṃ kṛte phalam āha dakṣaḥ |
prātar utthāya yo vipraḥ prātaḥsnāyī sadā bhavet |
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tribhir varṣair vyapohati ||
śaunako ’pi |
prātar utthāya yo vipraḥ prātaḥsnāyī sadā bhavet |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati ||
iti prātaḥsnānaṃ |
atha madhyāhnasnānaṃ |
tatra yogayājñavalkyaḥ |
etac chrutvā tu vacanaṃ yājñavalkyasya vai tadā |
ṛṣayaḥ śaṃsitātmānaḥ pṛcchanti snānanirṇayam ||
snānam abdevatair mantrair yat tvayoktaṃ purānagha |
tadācakṣa viśeṣeṇa snānasya tu vidhiṃ prabho ||
tān pratyuvāca prītātmā yājñavalkyo ’mitadyutiḥ |
śṛṇudhvaṃ vakṣyate snānaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ||
mṛdādīni samāhṛtya gatvā śuddhaṃ jalāśayam |
kuryād ahar ahaḥ snānaṃ prātarmadhyānhayor dvijaḥ ||
sumantuḥ |
tato madhyāhnasamaye punaḥ snānaṃ samācaret |
sūryasya cāpy upasthānaṃ japahomādikaṃ tataḥ ||
vasiṣṭha-hārītāv api |
pavitrapāṇir ekāgraḥ pārśvān anavalokayan |
[888] arug divācaret snānaṃ madhyāhnāt prāg viśeṣataḥ ||
'aruk' rogarahitaḥ | ato rogiṇā na snātavyam ity uktaṃ bhavati |
uktaṃ ca vyāsena |
snānaṃ madhyandine kuryāt sujīrṇo ’nne nirāmayaḥ |
na bhuktvālaṃkṛto rogī nājñātāmbhasi nākulaḥ ||
śaṅkhaḥ |
prātaḥ saṃkṣepataḥ snānaṃ śaucārthaṃ tu tad iṣyate |
mantrais tu vidhiniṣpādyaṃ mādhyahne tu savistaram ||
pāraskaraḥ |
mṛdgomayakuśatilaṃ sumanasa ādāyodakāntaṃ gatvā śucau deśe saṃsthāpya pāṇipādaṃ yajñopavītaṃ ca prakṣālya śikhām baddhvācāmet |
skandapurāṇe |
prakṣālayed yajñasūtraṃ mṛdbhir adbhiḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
bhṛguḥ |
mantrapūtaṃ sthitaṃ kāye yasmād yajñopavītakam |
nottārayet tataḥ prājño ya icchec chreya ātmanaḥ ||
dehastham eva tat kṣālyam uttāryaṃ na kadācana |
vyāsaḥ |
smṛtvauṅkāraṃ ca gāyatrīṃ nibadhīyāc chikhāṃ tataḥ |
pavitrapāṇir ācamya nābhiskandhau ca saṃspṛśet ||
baudhāyanaḥ |
[889] atha hastau prakṣyālya kamaṇḍaluṃ mṛtpiṇḍaṃ ca parigṛhya tīrthaṃ gatvā triḥ pādau prakṣālayet | trir ātmānam atha haike bruvate śmaśānam āpo devagṛhaṃ goṣṭhaṃ yatra brāhmaṇā aprakṣālya pādau tan na praveṣṭavyam iti |
yogayājñavalkyaḥ |
tridhā kṛtvā mṛdaṃ tāṃ tu gomayaṃ ca vicakṣaṇaḥ |
adhamottamamadhyānām aṅgānāṃ kṣālanaṃ tu taiḥ ||
bhāgaiḥ pṛthak pṛthak kuryāt kṣālane mṛdasaṃkaraḥ |
adbhir mṛdbhiś ca caraṇau prakṣālyācamya vai śuciḥ ||
atra nābher ūrdhvabhāgaṃ dakṣiṇahastenādhobhāgaṃ vāmahastena prakṣālayet,
dharmavid dakṣiṇaṃ hastam adhaḥ śauce na yojayet |
tathaiva vāmahastena nābher ūrdhvaṃ na śodhayet ||
iti bhṛgusmaraṇāt |
nandipurāṇe |
āyuṣkāmaḥ śirolepaṃ mṛdā kuryād dvijaḥ purā |
śrīkāmaḥ pādayoḥ śaucaṃ mṛdā pūrvaṃ samācaret ||
malaśodhanaṃ prakṛtya vyāso ’pi |
ṣaḍbhiḥ pādau catasṛbhir jaṅghā nābhikaṭau tribhiḥ |
mṛdaikayā śiraḥ kṣālyaṃ tataḥ kuryāt pramārjanam ||
vasiṣṭho ’pi |
mṛdaikayā śiraḥ kṣālyaṃ dvābhyāṃ nābhes tathopari |
adhaś ca tisṛbhiḥ kāryaṃ pādau ṣaḍbhis tathaiva ca |
prakṣālya sarvakāyaṃ tu dvir ācamya yathāvidhi ||
pāraskaraḥ |
[890] ekayā tu śiraḥ kṣālyaṃ dvābhyāṃ nābhiṃ tathopari |
mṛdbhiś catasṛbhiḥ kāryaṃ ṣaḍbhiḥ pāyuṃ tathaiva ca ||
kaṭivastyūrujaṅghāś ca pādau ca tisṛbhis tataḥ |
tathā hastau parikṣālya dvir ācāmet samāhitaḥ ||
atra yathāsvaśākhaṃ vyavasthā |
mṛdādiparimāṇaṃ tu kūrmapurāṇe darśitam |
mṛttikā ca samuddiṣṭā tv ādrāmalakamātrikā |
gomayasya pramāṇaṃ tu yenāṅgaṃ lepayet tataḥ ||
etac ca malaśodhanaṃ taṭe kāryam |
tathā ca nṛsiṃhapurāṇe |
śucau deśe samabhyukṣya sthāpayet kuśamṛttilān |
mṛttoyena svakaṃ dehaṃ bahiḥ saṃśodhayet tataḥ ||
yamaḥ |
malasnānaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā ācamya prāṅmukhaḥ śuciḥ |
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā tato dhyātvā divākaram ||
ācamya dvir iti śeṣaḥ | etac cācamanam ekaṃ pādaṃ jalāntar nidhāya kāryam |
yad uktaṃ catuरviṃśatimate |
sthale jalasya ācānto jalāntas tu sthale śuciḥ |
pādau sthāpyobhayatraiva hy ācāntaḥ śucitām iyāt || iti |
snānaśāṭī taṭe śodhayitvedam ācamanaṃ kāryam,
mṛttoyena svakaṃ dehaṃ bahir udvartya yatnataḥ |
snānaśāṭīṃ ca saṃśodhya kuryād ācamanaṃ budhaḥ ||
[891] iti marīcismaraṇāt |
upaveśanādyayogye ca tīre jānubhyām ūrdhvasya tiṣṭhato ’py ācamane na doṣa ity āha jātūkarṇyaḥ |
ūrdhvajānur jale tiṣṭhann ācānto na praduṣyatīti |
vyāsaḥ |
śucir bhūtvā śucau deśe udakānte samāhitaḥ |
nityaṃ trir āyamet prāṇāṃs tataḥ snānam upakramet ||
'śucir bhūtvā' malaśuddhiṃ kṛtvety arthaḥ | nityagrahaṇān malaśuddhiprāṇāyāmau snānādāv āvaśyakau |
prāṇāyāmasvarūpam āha saṃvartaḥ |
praṇavena tu saṃyuktā vyāhṛtīḥ sapta nityaśaḥ |
gāyatrī śirasā sārdhaṃ manasā triḥ paṭhed dvijaḥ |
nigṛhya tv ātmanaḥ prāṇān prāṇāyāmā vidhīyate ||
atra ca prathamaṃ nāsikāyā vāyor āpūraṇam | tataḥ pūritasya vāyor niścalīkaraṇam | tatas trir mantrajapaḥ | tato recanakrameṇa pūrakakumbhakarecakānuṣṭhānam | tathā coktaṃ vasiṣṭhena |
nāsikākṛṣṭa ucchvāso dhyātaḥ pūraka ucyate |
kumbhako niścalaśvāso ricyamānas tu recakaḥ ||
pūrakādiṣu ca sthānaviśeṣe devatāviśeṣadhyānam abhihitaṃ tenaiva |
nīlotpaladalaśyāmaṃ nābhimadhye pratiṣṭhitam |
caturbhujaṃ mahātmānaṃ pūrakeṇa tu cintayet ||
[892] kumbhakena hṛdi sthāne dhyāyet tu kamalāsanam |
brahmāṇaṃ raktagaurāṅgaṃ caturvaktraṃ prajāpatim ||
recakeṇeśvaraṃ dhyāyel lalāṭasthaṃ maheśvaram |
śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ nirmalaṃ pāpanāśanam || iti |
kūrmapurāṇe |
tato deśaviśeṣakālāvayavānanusmṛtyopāttaduritakṣayārthaṃ madhyandinasnānam ahaṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt | tataḥ uruṃ hi rājā varuṇaś cakārety udakaprārthanaṃ kṛtvā ye te śataṃ varuṇeti pradakṣiṇam udakam āvartya sumitriyāna ity añjalinodakam ādāya durmitriyāna ity anena kāmakrodhādīn uddiśyottarataḥ prakṣipet |
tad āha yogī |
uruṃ hīti tryṛcā toyam upasthāya pradakṣiṇam |
āvartayet tad udakaṃ ye te śatam iti tryṛcā ||
sumitriyāna ity añjalim uddhared daivataṃ smaran |
durmitriyāna iti dveṣyaṃ dhyāyaṃś cāpaḥ prasecayet ||
atra mṛdo bhāgadvyaṃ vidhāya tridhākṛtena prathamabhāgena pūrvoktaṃ malasnānaṃ vidhāyāvaśiṣṭaṃ bhāgaṃ mṛttikāsnānārthaṃ aśvakrānta iti mantreṇābhimantrayet |
tathā ca matsyapurāṇe |
snānaṃ kuryān mṛdā tadvad āmantrya ca vidhānataḥ |
aśvakrānte rathakrānte viṣṇukrānte vasundhare iti ||
tad anantaram |
[893] uddhṛtāmi varāheṇa kṛṣṇena śatabāhunā |
mṛttike brahmadattāsi kāśyapenābhimantritā ||
mṛttike hana tat sarvaṃ yan mayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam |
mṛttike dehi me puṣṭiṃ tvayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam |
tvayā hatena pāpena jīvāmi śaradaḥ śatam ||
ity anena brahmāṇḍapurāṇoktena mantreṇa mṛdam uddhṛtya namo mitrasya varuṇasyety anayarcā suryāya darśayitvā |
āruhya mama gātrāṇi sarvaṃ pāpaṃ pramocaya |
mṛttike tvā gṛhṇāmi prajayā ca dhanena ca ||
ity anena kaśyapoktena mantreṇa śiraḥprabhṛtigātrāṇi vilipya dvir ācamet |
tad uktaṃ śivapurāṇe |
aśvakrānta iti smṛtvā mantreṇāmantrya mṛttikām |
uddhared uddhṛtāsīti mantreṇa susamāhitaḥ ||
namo mitrasyeti ṛcā darśayitvā ca bhānave |
aruhyeti ca gātrāṇi samālabhya dvir ācamet ||
āha jamadagniḥ |
aśvakrānteti vai śuddhāṃ mṛttikām āharec chanaiḥ |
namo mitrasyety ādityāya darśayet samṛdau kare |
gandhadvārām iti japtvā svāny aṅgāni vilepayet |
aṅgalepane mantrāntaram āha yogī |
alabheta mṛdāṅgāni idaṃ viṣṇur iti tryṛcā |
tathā |
[894] adbhir adbhiś ca gātrāṇi kramaśas tv avane japet |
śīrṣādyā nābhisarvāṇi smaran viṣṇum anāmayam |
kaṭivastyūrujaṅghe ca caraṇau ca tribhis tribhiḥ ||
tathaiva hastāv ācamya namaskṛtya jalaṃ tataḥ |
yat kiṃ cedam iti mantreṇa namasyet prayatāñjaliḥ ||
jamadagniḥ |
hiraṇyaśṛṅgaṃ varuṇam ity apo ’bhiprapadyate |
mumitryā ity apaḥ spṛṣṭvā durmitrās tu bahiḥ kṣipet ||
yad apāṃ krūrabhity apas trir āloḍya tu pāṇinā |
baudhāyanaḥ |
athāpobhiprapadyate |
hiraṇyaśṛṅgaṃ varuṇaṃ prapadye tīrthaṃ me dehi yācitaḥ |
yan mayā muktam asādhūnāṃ pāpebhyaś ca pratigrahaḥ |
yan me manasā vācā karmaṇā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam ||
tan ma indro varuṇo bṛhaspatiḥ savitā ca punantu na ity athāñjalinā apa upahanti sumitriyāna āpa oṣadhayaḥ santv iti tāṃ diśaṃ nirukṣati yasyām asya diśi dveṣyo bhaviṣyati durmitrās tasmai bhūyāsuḥ yo 'smāṃ dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣma ity athāpa upaspṛśya triḥpradakṣiṇam udakam āvartayati yad apāṃ krūraṃ yad amedhyaṃ yad aśāntaṃ tad apagacchatām iti |
matsyapurāṇe |
anuddhṛtair uddhṛttair vā jalaiḥ snānaṃ samācaret |
tīrthaṃ kalpyaṃ dvihastaṃ ca caturasraṃ samantataḥ ||
darbhapāṇis tu vidhinā ācāntaḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ |
tīrthaṃ tu kalpayed vidvān mūlamantreṇa mantravit ||
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāyeti mūlamantra udāhṛtaḥ |
caturhastasamāyuktaṃ caturasraṃ samantataḥ ||
prakalpyāvāhayed gaṅgām ebhir mantrair vicakṣaṇaḥ |
viṣṇoḥ pādaprasūtāsi vaiṣṇavī viṣṇudevatā ||
trāhi nas tv enasas tasmād ājanmamaraṇāntikāt |
tisraḥ koṭyorddhvakoṭiś ca tīrthānāṃ vāyur abravīt ||
divi bhuvy antarīkṣe ca tāni te devi jāhnavi |
nandinīty eva te nāma deveṣu nalinīti ca ||
dakṣā pṛthvī ca vihagā viśvakāyā śivāmṛtā |
vidyādharī suprasannā tathā lokapramādhanī ||
kṣemā ca jāhnavī caiva śāntā śāntipradāyinī |
etāni puṇyanāmāni snānakāle prakīrtayet |
bhavet saṃnihitā tatra gaṅgā tripathagāminī ||
tathā gaṅgāvākyam api |
nandinī nalinī sītā mālatī ca mahāyaṇā |
viṣṇupādārghyasaṃbhūtā gaṅgā tripathagāminī ||
bhāgīrathī bhogavatī jāhnavī tridaśeśvarī ||
dvādaśaitāni nāmāni yatra yatra jalāśaye |
snānodyataḥ smaren nityaṃ tasya tatra bhavāmy aham ||
vasiṣṭhaḥ |
kṛtvaivaṃ mārjanaṃ mantrair aśvakrāntādibhis tataḥ |
ihaiva devīr amṛtaṃ pārāvaryasyarādiṣu |
ye te śatam iti dvābhyāṃ tīrthāny āvāhayed budhaḥ ||
vyāsaḥ |
kurukṣetraṃ gayāṃ gaṅgāṃ prabhāsaṃ puṣkarāṇi ca |
tīrthāny etāni sarvāṇi snānakāle bhavantu me ||
etat sarvaṃ kṛtrimeṣv eva jaleṣu kartavyam,
gaṅgādipuṇyatīrthāni kṛtrimādiṣu saṃsmaret |
iti yogayājñavalkyasmaraṇāt |
yatra sthāne tu yat tīrthaṃ nadī puṇyatamā ca yā |
tāṃ dhyāyan manasā snāyād anyatreṣṭhavicintanam ||
ity akṛtrimeṣu tattīrthadhyānasyaiva bhṛguṇā smṛtatvāt na nadīṣu nadīṃ brūyād iti tīrthe tīrthāntarasmaraṇaniṣedhāc ca | evaṃ tīrthāny āvāhya svaśāstrokena vidhinā snāyāt |
yogayājñavalkyaḥ |
ud uttamam iti viśet taj jalaṃ prāṅmukhaḥ śuciḥ |
yena devāḥ pavitreti kuryād ālambhanaṃ tribhiḥ ||
mahāvyāhṛtibhiḥ paścād ācāmet prayato ’pi san |
bhāskarābhimukho majjed āpo asmān iti tryṛcā ||
jamadagniḥ |
[897] ādityābhimukho majjed āpo śrasmānn iti tryṛcā |
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
āpo asmānn iti hy uktvā bhāskarābhimukhaḥ sthitaḥ |
idaṃ viṣṇur japitvā ca pratisroto nimajjati ||
āpastambaḥ |
śanair apo 'bhyupeyād anabhighnann abhimukhādityam udakam upaspṛśed iti sarvatrodakopasparśanavidhiḥ |
ādityābhimukhatvaṃ ca sthāvarodakaviṣayaṃ |
tathā ca narasiṃhapurāṇe |
nadyāṃ sravatsu ca snāyāt pratisrotaḥ sthito dvijaḥ |
taḍāgādiṣu toyeṣu pratyarkaṃ snānam ācaret ||
vāmanapurāṇe |
śrotaso ’bhimukho majjed yatrāpaḥ pravahanti vai |
sthāvareṣu ca toyeṣu ādityābhimukhaḥ sadeti ||
yogayājñavalkyaḥ |
tato ’vaghṛṣya gātrāṇi nimajyonmajya vai punaḥ |
ācamya gomayenāpi mānastokyā samālabhet ||
atrācamanamantram āha jamadagniḥ |
madhyandine ya ācāmen mantreṇāpaḥ punantv iti |
agniś ca me ca sāyaṃ ca prātaḥ sūryaśca me iti ||
etaṃ cācamanaṃ tīram āgatya kartavyam |
tad āha baudhāyanaḥ |
[900] darbhais tu pāvayen mantrair avyaṅgaiḥ pāvanaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
āpohiṣṭheti tisṛbhir idam āpo haviṣmatīḥ ||
devīr āpa iti dvābhyām āpo devīr iti tryṛcā |
drupadād iva ity ṛcā śannodevīr apāṃ rasam ||
āpo devīḥ pāvamānyaḥ punantv ādyās tṛco nava |
citpatir meti ca śanaiḥ pāvyātmānaṃ samāhitaḥ ||
hiraṇyavarṇa iti ca pāvamānyas tathāparāḥ |
taratsamāḥ śuddhavatīḥ pavitrāṇy api śaktitaḥ ||
vāruṇyaś ca ṛcaḥ sūktaṃ śaktitaḥ saṃprayojayet |
jalamadhye sthitā vipraḥ śuddhabhāvo hariṃ smaret ||
oṃkāreṇa vyāhṛtibhir gāyatryā tu samāhitaḥ |
ādāv ante ca kurvīta abhiṣekaṃ yathākramam |
apāṃ madhyasthitasyaivaṃ mārjanaṃ ca vidhīyate ||
viṣṇuḥ |
mṛttoyaiḥ kṛtamalāpakarṣaṇo ’psu nimajjyopaspṛśyāpohiṣṭheti tisṛbhir hiraṇyavarṇeti catasṛbhir idam āpaḥ pravahateti ca tīrtham abhimantrayet | tato ’psu nimagnaḥ trir aghamarṣaṇaṃ japet | tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam iti vā drupadāṃ sāvitrīṃ vā yuñjate mana ity anuvākaṃ puruṣasūkaṃ vā |
paiṭhīnasiḥ |
hiraṇyavarṇā iti sūktena snātvā śaucaṃ kṛtvā apāṃ madhye trīn prāṇāyāmān kuryāt |
jamadagniḥ |
[901] ṛtaṃ cety etad apsvantas triḥ paṭhed aghamarṣaṇam |
yathāśvamedhe 'vabhṛthas tathā snāne ’ghamarṣaṇam ||
antarjala ity anuvṛttau vaśiṣṭhaḥ |
prāṇāyāmāṃś ca kurvīta gāyatrīṃ vāghamarṣaṇam |
yathoktaiḥ kṣobhitas tais tu majjet trir daṇḍavat tataḥ ||
yathoktair vāyor ādānarodhotsargarūpair it yarthaḥ |
baudhāyanaḥ |
mārjayitvāntarjalagato ’ghamarṣaṇena trīn prāṇāyāmān dhārayitveti |
yogayājñavalkyaḥ |
antarjale japen mantraṃ triḥkṛtvas tv aghamarṣaṇam |
drupadāṃ vā trir abhyaset āpaṃ gaur iti vā tryṛcam ||
haṃsaḥ śuci ṣad ity ṛcaṃ trir āvartya japed atha |
anyāni caiva sūktāni smārtadṛṣṭāny anusmaret ||
savyāhṛtiṃ sapraṇavāṃ gāyatrīṃ trir japed atha |
āvartayed vā praṇavaṃ smared vā viṣṇum avyayam ||
viṣṇor āyatanaṃ hy āpaḥ sa hy apāṃ patir ucyate |
tasyaiva sūnavaś caitās tasmāt taṃ hy apsu saṃsmaret ||
narād āpaḥ prasūtā vai tena nārā iti smṛtāḥ |
tā evāsyāyanaṃ hy āpas tasmān nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
yo hi vratānāṃ vedānāṃ yamasya niyamasya ca |
bhoktāraṃ yajñatapasāṃ dhyāyināṃ dhyānam eva ca ||
dhyāyen nārāyaṇaṃ nityaṃ snānādiṣu ca karmasu |
[902] prāyaścitteṣu sarveṣu duṣkṛtān mucyate pumān ||
pramādāt kurvatāṃ karma pracyavaty adhvareṣu yat |
smaraṇād eva tad viṣṇoḥ sapūrṇa syād iti śrutiḥ ||
tad viṣṇor iti mantreṇa majjed apsu punaḥ punaḥ |
gāyatrī vaiṣṇavī hy eṣā viṣṇoḥ saṃsmaraṇāya vai ||
bṛhaspatiḥ |
drupadād iva yo mantro vede vājasaneyake |
antarjale trir āvartya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
viśvāmitraḥ |
drupadā nāma sā devī yajurvede pratiṣṭhitaḥ |
antarjale trir āvartya mucyate brahmahatyayā ||
vyāso ’pi |
drupadā nāma gāyatrī brāhmī vājasaneyake |
sakṛd antarjale japtvā brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati ||
drupadāṃ prakṛtya kūrmapurāṇe |
apaḥ pāṇau samādāya japtvā vai mārjane kṛte |
vinyasya mūrdhni tat toyaṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||
bhṛguḥ |
apaḥ pāṇau samādāya triḥ paṭhed drupadām ṛcam ||
tat toyaṃ mūrdhni vinyasya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate |
vyāsaḥ |
antarjale trir āvartya sāvitrīṃ prayatas tathā |
[903] mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvair yadi na brahmahā bhavet ||
hārīto ’pi |
jumbakā nāma gāyatrī vede vājasaneyake |
antarjale sakṛj japtvā brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati ||
jumbakāya svāhā iti mantraḥ |
sumantur api |
mātaraṃ bhaginīṃ gatvā mātṛsvasāraṃ snuṣāṃ sakhīṃ vānyad vāgamyāgamanaṃ kṛtvā aghamarṣaṇasuktam antarjale trir āvartya tad etasmāt pūtā bhavati |
hārīto ’pi |
āpaṅ gauḥ pṛthvir akramīd ity etām ṛcaṃ trir antarjale japan sarvasmāt pāpāt pramucyate | haṃsaḥ śūci ṣad ity etām ṛcaṃ trir antarjale japan sarvasmāt pāpāt pramucyata iti |
gautamo ’pi |
api vā gāyatrīṃ pacchorddhvarcaśaḥ sarvām iti trir antarjale paṭhan sarvasmāt pāpāt pramucyata iti |
dakṣaḥ |
mārjanaṃ jalamadhye tu prāṇāyāmo yatas tataḥ |
upasthānaṃ japaḥ paścāt sāvitrījapa ucyate ||
śāṭyāyanagṛhyam |
savastro ’har ahar āplavetāplutyātyudakonyad vastram ācchādayet |
atrāpi jalamadhye snānāṅgatarpaṇaṃ vidheyam | asāmarthye tu pūrvoktena prakāreṇa saṃkṣepasnānaṃ kartavyaṃ | [904]
vaśiṣṭhaḥ |
yo ’nena vidhinā snāti yatra tatrāmbhasi dvijaḥ |
sa tīrthaphalam āpnoti tīrtheṣu dviguṇaṃ phalam ||
manovākkarmabhiś cāpi yat pāpaṃ kurute tu saḥ |
nāśam āyāti tat sarvam āmapātram ivāmbhasā ||
śaṅkhaḥ |
anena vidhinā snātaḥ puṇyaṃ phalam upāśnute |
iti madhyāhanānaṃ |
atha kriyāsnānaṃ |
tatrāha śaṅkhaḥ |
kriyāsnānaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvad vidhipūrvakam |
mṛdbhir adbhiś ca kartavyaṃ śaucam ādau yathāvidhi ||
jale nimagnas tūnmajjya upaspṛśya yathāvidhi |
tīrthasyāvāhanaṃ kuryāt tat pravakṣyāmy ataḥ param ||
prapadye varuṇaṃ devam ambhasāṃ patim ūrjitam |
yācitaṃ dehi me tīrthaṃ sarvapāpānupattaye ||
tīrtham āvāhayiṣyāmi sarvāghaviniṣūdanam |
sāṃnidhyam asmin sve toye bhajatāṃ madanugrahāt ||
rudrān prapadye varadān sarvān apsuṣadas tv aham |
sarvān apsuṣadaś caiva prapadye praṇataḥ sthitaḥ ||
devam apyuṣadaṃ vahniṃ prapadye ’ghaniṣūdanam |
āpaḥ puṇyāḥ pavitrāś ca prapadye śaraṇaṃ tathā ||
[905] rudrāś cāgniś ca sarpaś ca varuṇaś cāpa eva ca ||
śamayantv āśu me pāpaṃ punantu ca sadā mama |
ity evam uktvā kartavyaṃ tataḥ saṃmārjanaṃ kusaiḥ ||
āpohiṣṭheti tisṛbhir yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ |
hiraṇyavarṇya iti ca ṛṣiś catasṛbhis tathā ||
śannodevīti ca tathā śanna āpas tathaiva ca |
idam āpaḥ pravahata tathā mantram udīrayet ||
evaṃ saṃmārjanaṃ kṛtvā chanda ārṣaṃ sadaivatam |
aghamarṣaṇasūktasya saṃsmaret prayataḥ sadā ||
chanda ānuṣṭubhaṃ tasya ṛṣiś caivāghamarṣaṇaḥ |
devatā bhāvavṛttaṃ ca pāpaghnasya prakīrtitā ||
tato ’mbhasi nimajjaṃs tu triḥ paṭhed aghamarṣaṇam |
yathāśvamedhaḥ kraturāṭ sarvapāpapranādanaḥ ||
tathāghamarṣaṇaṃ sūktaṃ sarvapāpāpanodanam |
prapadyān mūrddhani tathā vyāhṛtībhir jalaṃ tataḥ ||
anena vidhinā snātvā amedhye snānavāsasī |
parivartitavāsāś ca tīrthatīra upaspṛśet ||
iti kriyāsnānam |
atha jalād uttīrṇasya kṛtyam |
tatrāha baudhāyanaḥ |
uttarvya vāsaḥ pīḍayitvā prakṣālitopavātāny akliṣṭāni vāsāṃsi [906] paridhāyāpa ācamya darbheṣv āsīno darbhān dhārayamāṇaḥ prāṅmukhaḥ sāvitrīṃ sahasrakṛtvaḥ āvartayet |
'prakṣālitopavātāni' prakṣālanānantaraṃ śuṣkāṇi |
atra vyāsaḥ |
pīḍanāt pūrvam asaṃskṛtapramītoddeśena sthale jalāñjalir deyaḥ | iti |
uktaṃ padmapurāṇe |
prācīnāvītasaṃyuktaḥ kuśapāṇiḥ tilaiḥ saha |
asaṃskṛtapramītānāṃ sthale dadyāj jalāñjalim ||
prekṣyamāṇo diśaṃ yāmyāṃ mantreṇānena yatnataḥ |
asaṃskṛtapramītā ye gotrajā durgatiṃ gatāḥ |
teṣāṃ hi dattam akṣayyam idam astu tilodakam ||
vyāso ’pi |
asaṃskṛtapramītānām ekam evāvaṭe kṣipet |
anagnidagdhā ye jīvā ye ’py adagdhāḥ kule mama |
bhūmau dattena tṛpyantu tṛptā yāntu parāṃ gatim ||
sa cāyaṃ jalāñjalir jalasthenaiva sthale prakṣepaṇīyaḥ | yato ’nyathākaraṇe doṣam āha sumantuḥ |
jalārdravāsāḥ sthalago yaḥ pradadyāj jalāñjalim |
vastraniścyotanaṃ pretā apavārya pibanti te ||
'apavārya' jalāñjaliṃ tyaktvety arthaḥ |
vastrodakasrāvaṇārthaṃ ca kiṃcit kālaṃ taṭe sthātavyam |
tad āha bharadvājaḥ |
[907] vastrodakam apekṣante ye mṛtā dāsavargiṇaḥ |
kiṃcit kālaṃ sthitas tasmāj jalaṃ bhūmau nipātayet ||
tataḥ snānavastraṃ niṣpīḍayet |
pulastyaḥ |
kṛtvā tarpaṇam evaṃ tu samuttīrya jalāśayāt |
pīḍayet snānaśāṭīṃ tu taṭa eva vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
taṭa eva niṣpīḍayed ity atra hetur ukto vāyupurāṇe |
vastraniṣpīḍaitaṃ toyaṃ śrāddhe cocchiṣṭabhāginām |
bhāgadheyaṃ śrutiḥ prāha tasmān niṣpīḍayet sthale ||
jalamadhyaniṣpīḍane niṣedha ukto nāradīyapurāṇe |
jalamadhye tu yaḥ kaścid brāhmaṇo jñānadurbalaḥ |
niṣpīḍayati vastraṃ tat snānaṃ tasya vṛthā bhavet ||
kṛtvā tarpaṇam iti vacanāt pūrvaṃ vastraniṣpīḍanaṃ na kuryāt |
tad āha yogayājñavalkyaḥ |
yāvad devān ṛṣīṃś caiva pitṝṃś caiva na tarpayet |
tāvan na pīḍayed vastraṃ yena snāto na codake ||
yena vastreṇa snātas tan na pīḍayet |
niṣpīḍayati yaḥ pūrvaṃ snānavastraṃ tu tarpaṇāt ||
nirāśāḥ pitaras tasya yānti devaiḥ saharṣibhiḥ |
parāśaraḥ |
nirāśāḥ pitaro yānti vastraniṣpīḍane kṛte |
tasmān na pauḍayed vastram akṛtvā pitṛtarpaṇam ||
[908] devatāḥ pitaraś cety anuvṛttau śātātapaḥ |
nirāśās te nivartante vastraniṣpīḍane kṛte |
tasmān na pīḍayed vastram akṛtvā pitṛtarpaṇam ||
śaṅkhaḥ |
udakasyāpradānād dhi snānaśāṭīṃ na pīḍayet |
viṣṇuḥ |
akṛtvā devapitṛtarpaṇaṃ snānaśāṭīṃ na pīḍayet |
vastraniṣpīḍane prakāram āha sumantuḥ |
dakṣiṇābhimukhas tiṣṭhan prācīnāvītavān api |
veṣṭayann apasavyena snānavastraṃ tu pīḍayet ||
atra mantram āha kārṣṇājiniḥ |
ye cāsmākaṃ kule jātā aputrā gotriṇo mṛtāḥ |
te gṛhṇantu mayā dattaṃ vastraniṣpīḍanodakam ||
vastraniṣpīḍanānantaram ācamanaṃ kartavyaṃ ity āha sa eva |
snānavastraṃ tataḥ pīḍya punar ācamanaṃ caret || iti |
etac cācamanaṃ kevalaṃ sthalasthitena kartavyam |
yad āha hārītaḥ |
jalārdravāsā sthalago ya ācāmen narādhamaḥ |
vastraniścyotanaṃ tasya pibanti pitaro ’śuci ||
tasmād ekaṃ jalasyāntaḥ pādam ekaṃ sthale tathā |
kṛtvācāman vidhānajñaḥ pūto bhavati nānyathā ||
paiṭhīnasir api | [909]
antarudaka ācānto ’ntaḥ śuddho bhavati | bahir udaka ācānto bahir eva śuddhaḥ syāt | tasmād antar ekaṃ bahir ekaṃ ca kṛtvā pādam ācamet sarvatra śuddho bhavati |
matsyapurāṇe |
evaṃ snātvā tataḥ paścād ācamya tu vidhānataḥ |
utthāya vāsasī śuddhe śukle tu paridhāya vai ||
dvir ācamed iti śeṣaḥ |
tathā ca vyāghraḥ |
tato vastradvayaṃ śuddhaṃ gṛhītvā dvir upaspṛśet |
vasiṣṭho ’pi |
prāg vodag vā śucau deśa upaviśya dvir ācamet |
vastraparidhānācamanayor madhye jaṅghādiśodhanaṃ kartavyam |
tathā ca jābāla-parāśarau |
snātvā nivasya vāso ’nyaj jaṅghe śodhye mṛdambhasām |
apavitrīkṛte te hi kaupīnāsnānavāriṇā ||
atrāpavitrīkṛta iti hetuvidhānāt jaṅghāgrahaṇam apavitrīkṛtāṅgopalakṣaṇārtham |
ata eva yogayājñavalkyaḥ |
snātvaivaṃ vāsamī dhaute acchinne paridhāya ca |
prakṣālyorū mṛdādbhiś ca hastau prakṣālayet tataḥ ||
snānārdravāsāś ca viṇmūtrotsargaṃ na kuryyāt |
tathā ca liṅgapurāṇe |
[910] snānaṃ kṛtvārdravāsās tu viṇmūtraṃ kurute yadi |
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ snānena śudhyati ||
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
avamṛjyān na ca snāto gātrāṇy ambarapāṇibhiḥ |
na ca nirddhunuyāt keśān vāsaś caiva na nirdhunet ||
atra hetum āha vyāsaḥ |
tisraḥ kāṭyorddhakoṭiś ca yāvanty aṅgaruhāṇi vai |
sravanti sarvatīrthāni tasmān na parimārjayet ||
gobhilo ’pi |
pibanti śiraso devāḥ pibanti pitaro mukhāt |
madhyataḥ sarvagandharvā adhastāt sarvajantavaḥ |
tasmāt toyaṃ nāvamṛjyāt snānaśāyyā na pāṇinā ||
viṣṇupurāṇe |
snāto na mārjayed aṅgaṃ snānaśāṭyā na pāṇinā |
snānaśāṭyeti viśeṣagrahaṇāt vastrāntareṇa mārjanam anumatam iti kecit |
manuḥ |
śiraḥsnānas tu tailena nāṅgaṃ kiṃcid api spṛśet |
laghuhārītaḥ |
snānaṃ kṛtvā tu yaḥ kaścit puṣpaṃ gṛhṇāti vai dvijaḥ |
devatās tan na gṛhṇanti bhasmau syāt sa ca dāruvat ||
viṣṇuḥ |
snātaḥ śiro nāvadhunuryāt | nāṅgebhyas toyam uddharen na tailaṃ spṛśen [911] nāprakṣālitaṃ pūrvadhṛtaṃ vāso bibhṛyāt ?) | na mlecchāntyajapatitaiḥ saha saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ kuryāt |
vyāsaḥ |
na cānulimped asnātvā vāso vāpi na nirdhunet |
ārdra eva tu vāsāṃsi snātvā seveta mānavaḥ ||
hārītaḥ |
snātvā na gātram avamṛjyāt na śiro vidhunuyāt na vāso vidhunuyāt nottarīyaviparyāsaṃ kuryāt |
vyāsa-vasiṣṭhau |
nottarīyam adhaḥ kuryan noparyyādhastyam ambaram |
nāntarvāso vinā jātu vivased vasanaṃ budhaḥ ||
ācamanānantaraṃ tīrthamṛdāditilakaṃ vidhāya yathāśakti gāyatryādijapaṃ kuryāt |
tathā ca bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
dhautavastrayugaṃ śuklaṃ paridhāya samāhitaḥ |
ūrū jaṅge ca saṃśodhya parikṣālya tathā karau ||
dvir ācamya kuśāsīnaḥ sāvitrījapam ācaret
anyāni puṇyasuktāni mantrāṃś ca niyato japet ||
iti jalottīrṇakṛtyam |
śatha paridheyavastrāṇi |
tatrāha bhṛguḥ |
brāhmaṇasya sitaṃ vastraṃ nṛpate raktam ujbaṇam |
[912] pītaṃ vaiśyasya śūdrasya nīlaṃ malavad iṣyate ||
'ulbaṇaṃ' niviḍaraktam, tac ca dhāturatam eva |
"na veṣṭitaśirāḥ kṛṣṇakaṣāyavāsā vā devapitṛkāryāṇi vā kuryad" ity uśanasā kaṣāyaraktasya niṣedhasmaraṇāt,
ahataṃ dhāturaktaṃ ca tat pavitram iti sthitiḥ |
iti tasyānugrahasmaraṇāc ca |
anenaivābhiprāyeṇa gautamo ’pi |
na raktam ulbaṇam anyadhṛtaṃ ca vāso bibhṛyād iti |
ahatalakṣaṇam uktam ācchādanaprakaraṇe ||
atra viśeṣam āha devalaḥ |
svayaṃ dhautena kartavyāḥ kriyā dharmā vipaścitā |
na tu nejakadhautena nāhatena ca karhicit ||
'ahatena' adhautena, tatrāpy ahataśabdaprayogāt |
yathoktaṃ satyatapasā |
hṛtaṃ yantranirmuktam uktaṃ vāsaḥ svayaṃbhuvā |
śastaṃ tan māṅgalikyeṣu tāvatkālaṃ na sarvadā ||
'māṅgalikyaṃ' vivāhādi |
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
anyad eva bhaved vāsaḥ śayanīye narādhipa |
anyad rathyāsu devānām arcāyām anyad eva hi |
anyac ca lokayātrāyām anyad īśvaradarśane ||
baudhāyanaḥ |
uttaraṃ vāsaḥ kartavyaṃ pañcasvceteṣu karmasu |
[913] svādhyāyotsargadāneṣu bhuktācamanayos tathā ||
'utsargaḥ' mūtrādeḥ, 'bhuktaṃ' bhojanam |
yogayājñavalkyaḥ |
snānaṃ dānaṃ japaṃ homaṃ svādhyāyaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam |
naikavastro dvijaḥ kuryac chrāddhabhojanasatkriyāḥ ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
na dānajapahomeṣu śrāddhādhyayanakarmasu |
ekavastraḥ pravarteta dvijavācanake tathā |
'dvijavācanakam' puṇyāhavācanam |
viṣṇupurāṇe |
homadevārcanādayas tu dvijānāṃ vācanaṃ tathā |
naikavastraḥ pravarteta dvijo nācamane jape ||
gobhilaḥ |
ekavastro na bhuñjīta na kuryād devatārcanam |
na cārcayed dvijān nānyaṃ kuryād evaṃvidho naraḥ ||
ekavastrasya lakṣaṇam āha sa eva |
savyād aṃsāt paribhraṣṭakaṭideśadhṛtāmbaraḥ |
ekavastraṃ tu taṃ vidyāt daive pitrye ca varjayet ||
savyāt skandhāt pariluptaṃ kaṭideśadhṛtam ambaraṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | evaṃ dvitīyavāsovihīnasyāpi veditavyam | |
śrautaṃ smārtaṃ tathā karma na nagnaś cintayed api |
iti viṣṇupurāṇe nagnalakṣaṇam ukतaम |
[914] āha jātūkarṇyaḥ |
svādhyāye tu jape caiva dānahomārcane tathā |
badhnīyān nāsurīṃ kakṣāṃ daive pitrye ca karmaṇi |
paridhānād bahiḥ kakṣā nibaddhā hy āsurī bhavet ||
atra vāsaḥparidhāne pāraskareṇa mantro darśitaḥ |
paridhāsyai yaśodhāsyai dīrghāyuṣ ṭvāya jaradaṣṭir asmi śataṃ ca jīvāmi śaradaḥ purīcīrāyaspoṣam abhisaṃvyapiṣyata iti |
tathottarīye ’pi |
yaśasā mā dyāvāpṛthivī yaśasendrābṛhaspatī yaśobhagaś ca mā vidadyaśo mā
pratipadyatām iti |
etac ca mantradvayaṃ navavastraparidhāne paṭhitavyam | vāsaḥchatropānahaś cāpūrvāṇi cen mantra iti tenaivoktatvāt |
atra varjyāny āha bhṛguḥ |
na raktam ulbaṇaṃ vāso na nīlaṃ ca praśasyate |
daśāhīnaṃ malāktaṃ ca varjayet kutsitaṃ budhaḥ ||
jātūkarṇyaḥ |
kaṣāyaṃ kṛṣṇavastraṃ vā malinaṃ keśadūṣitam |
chinnāgraṃ copavastraṃ ca kutsitaṃ dharmato viduḥ ||
ayaṃ ca malinavāsoniṣedhaḥ sati sāmarthye |
yad āha gautamaḥ |
sati vibhave na jīrṇamalavāsāḥ syāt || iti |
tatrānukalpam āha yogayājñavalkyaḥ |
[915] abhāve dhautavastrasya śāṇakṣaumāvikāni ca |
kutapaṃ yogapaṭṭṃ vā dvivāsā yena vai bhavet ||
gṛhṇīyād iti śeṣaḥ | 'kutapaḥ' pārvatīyājaromanirmitakambalaḥ |
viśvāmitro ’pi |
yajñopavīte dve dhārye śraute smārte ca karmaṇi |
tṛtīyam uttarīyaṃ ca vastrābhāve tad iṣyate ||
uttarīyalakṣaṇam āha jātūkarṇyaḥ |
vastrottarīyābhāve tv ekāṅgulaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ caturaṅgulaṃ vā sūtrair eva kṛtaṃ parimaṇḍalaṃ tad uttarīyaṃ kuryāt || iti |
iti paridheyāparidheyavastrāṇi |
atha tarpaṇam |
tatra kāladeśau tāvat | āha śātātapaḥ |
tarpaṇaṃ tu tataḥ kuryāt pratyahaṃ snātako dvijaḥ |
yājñavalkyo ’pi |
snātvā devān pitṝṃś caiva tarpayed arcayet tathā |
vyāsaḥ |
tarpaṇaṃ dvividhaṃ prāhur munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ |
ekaṃ jale sthitaḥ kuryād aparaṃ tu sthale sthitaḥ ||
anayor vyavasthām āha viṣṇuḥ |
snātaś cārdravāsā devapitṛtarpaṇam ambhaḥstha eva kuryāt parivartitavāsāś ca tīrthatīram uttīryya |
[916] hārīto ’pi |
ārdravāsā jale kuryāt tarpaṇācamanaṃ japam |
śuṣkavāsaḥ sthale kuryāt tarpaṇācamanaṃ japam ||
jale sthita iti (?) śeṣaḥ |
uktavyavasthātikrame doṣam āha likhitaḥ |
śuṣkeṇāntarjale caiva bahir apy ārdravāsasā |
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homo niṣphalaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam |
snānaṃ brāhmam | ata eva hārītaḥ |
brāhmaṃ snānaṃ tathā dānaṃ devatāpitṛtarpaṇam |
jalamadhye tu kurvāṇaḥ śuṣkavastro ’tiduṣyati ||
mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |
nārdravāsā sthale sthitvā budhas tarpaṇam ācaret |
jānudaghnajalastho vā vigalatsnānaśāṭakaḥ ||
marīciḥ |
snānāṅgam eva kurvīta tarpaṇaṃ salilasthitaḥ |
snānāṅgād itarat kuryān madhyāhne sthala eva tu ||
madhyāhnasnānānantaraṃ japavidhim abhidhāya satyavrataḥ |
japtvānena vidhānena devarṣipitṛtarpaṇam |
svaśākhāvihitaṃ kuryāt snānāṅgaṃ pṛthag eva hi ||
vasiṣṭho ’pi |
ṛksāmātharvavedoktān japen mantrān yajūṃṣi ca |
japitvaivaṃ tataḥ kuryād devarṣipitṛtarpaṇam ||
[917] yat tu yogayājñavalkayena,
japed vedādim ekāgras taṭe baddhāñjaliḥ śanaiḥ |
brahmayajñaprasiddhyarthaṃ brahmavidyām athāpi vā |
japtvā vā praṇavaṃ śaktyā tatas tarpaṇam ācaret ||
iti, brahmayajñānantaryam uktaṃ, tat prātarāhuter anantaraṃ brahmayajñākaraṇaviṣayaṃ tatrāpi tasya vidhānāt | tathā ca bṛhaspatiḥ |
sa cārvāk tarpaṇāt kāryaḥ paścād vā prātarāhuteḥ |
vaiśvadevāvasāne vā nānyadā tv animittataḥ || iti ||
yadā tu sthale sthitas tarpaṇaṃ kuryāt tadā tarpaṇodakam udakamadhye na nikṣiped ity āha viṣṇuḥ |
sthale sthitvā jale yas tu prayacched udakaṃ naraḥ |
nopatiṣṭhati tad vāri pitṝṇāṃ tan nirarthakam ||
sthalatarpaṇam eva prakṛtyāha gobhilaḥ |
nodakeṣu na pātreṣu na kruddho naikapāṇinā |
nopatiṣṭhati tat toyaṃ yan na bhūmau pradīyate ||
ataḥ sthalasthena bhūmāv eva deyam ity abhiprāyaḥ |
śaṅkho ’pi |
udake nodakaṃ kuryāt pitṛbhyas tu kadācana |
uttīrya tu śucau deśe kuryād udakatarpaṇam || iti |
atra viśeṣam āha hārītaḥ |
vasitvā vasanaṃ śuktaṃ sthale vistīrṇabarhiṣi |
vidhijñas tarpaṇaṃ kuryān na pātre tu kadācana ||
[918] pātrād vā jalam ādāya śubhe pātrāntare kṣipet |
jalapūrṇe ’thavā gartte na sthaleṣu vibarhiṣu ||
pātraṃ cātra pitāmahenoktam |
hemarūpyamayaṃ kāryaṃ tāmrakāṃsyasamudbhavam |
pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇe pātraṃ mṛnmayaṃ tu parityajet || iti |
paristaraṇaviśeṣo yogayājñavalkyena darśitaḥ |
āvāhya pūrvavan mantrair āstīrya ca kuśān śubhān |
prāgagreṣu surān samyag dakṣiṇāgreṣu vai pitṝn || iti |
tarpayed iti śeṣaḥ |
yatra punar neṣṭakācite pitṝṃs tarpayed ityādinā pratiṣiddham aśuci vā sthalaṃ tatra jale dadyād ity āha viṣṇuḥ |
yatrāśuci sthalaṃ tu syād udake devatāpitṝn |
tarpayet tu yathākāmam apsu sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||
yadā tūdakamadhyasthitas tarpaṇaṃ kuryāt tadā tarpaṇodakaṃ sthale na nikṣipet | tad uktaṃ ṣatriṃśanmate |
na tarpayet pitṝn devān jalasaṃsthaḥ sthale kvacit |
sthalasthas tu kvacit kuryāt jale 'py aśuci cet sthalam ||
asaṃskṛtapramītāñjaliṃ (?) tu sarvadā sthala eva kṣepaṇīya ity āha kārṣṇājiniḥ |
devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca jale dadyāj jalāñjalim |
asaṃskṛtapramītānāṃ sthale dadyāj jalaṃ punaḥ || iti |
[919]
iti tarpaṇakāladeśanirūpaṇam |
atha tarpaṇasādhanāni |
tatrāha laugākṣiḥ |
khadgamauktikahastena kartavyaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam |
maṇikāñcanayukrena na śuddhena kadācana ||
‘khaḍgaṃ’ gaṇḍakāsthi | ‘śuddhena' kevalena |
yogayājñavalkyaḥ |
anāmikādhṛtaṃ hema tarjanyāṃ rūpyam eva ca |
kaniṣṭhikādhṛtaṃ khaḍgaṃ tena pūto bhaven naraḥ ||
kātyāyano ’pi |
aśūnyaṃ tu karaṃ kṛtvā suvarṇarajataiḥ kuśaiḥ |
prayatas tarpaṇaṃ kuryān maṇikhaḍgatilair api ||
śaṅkho ’pi |
vinā rūpyasuvarṇena vinā tāmratilais tathā |
vinā darbhaiś ca mantraiś ca pitṝṇāṃ nopapadyate ||
sauvarṇarājatābjābhyāṃ khaḍgenodumbareṇa vā |
dattam akṣayatāṃ yāti pitṝṇāṃ tu tilodakam ||
himena saha yad dattaṃ kṣīreṇa madhunātha vā |
tad apy akṣayatāṃ yāti pitṝṇāṃ tu tilodakam ||
'himaṃ' karpūraṃ candanaṃ vā |
marīciḥ |
[920] rajate manasā yāyāt suvarṇe hastanirgatam |
tileṣu ca kṣaṇād gacchet tāmre tu dvimuhūrttataḥ ||
darbhe saptamuhūrttena mantrayuktaṃ tad akṣayam |
yatra yatra hi yo yasya tasya tatropatiṣṭhate ||
naitāni suvarṇādisamuccayārthāni vacanāni |
yad āha sa eva |
eṣām anyatamenāpi yuktapāṇiḥ samācaret |
dvābhyāṃ vātha tribhir vāpi sarvair vā tarpaṇaṃ budhaḥ ||
yājñavalko ’pi |
tilānām apy alābhe tu suvarṇarajatānvitam |
tadabhāve niṣiñcet tu darbhair mantreṇa vā punaḥ ||
anena mantrasyāvaśyakatvaṃ bhavati |
ata eva jābāliḥ |
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ darbhān yathālābhaṃ prayojayet |
na mantreṇa vinā kāryaṃ kadācit tarpaṇaṃ budhaiḥ ||
marīciḥ |
bahugoṣu yathā naṣṭāṃ mātaraṃ labhate sutaḥ |
manunā yasya yad dattaṃ tad dhi tasyopatiṣṭhate ||
yogayājñavalkāḥ |
nāmagotrasvadhākārais tarpayed anupūrvaśaḥ |
mantraiś ca deyam udakaṃ pitṝṇāṃ prītivardhanam ||
[921] gautamaḥ |
kuśānām apy alābhe tu kāśān dūrvām athāpi vā |
saṃyojya tarpaṇaṃ kuryān na tu śūnyakaraḥ kvacit ||
atra viśeṣam āha prajāpatiḥ |
tarpaṇādīni kāryāṇi pitṝṇāṃ yāni kānicit |
tāni syur dviguṇair darbhaiḥ sapavitrair viśeṣataḥ ||
bhṛguḥ |
prāgagrais tarpayed devān udagagrais tu mānuṣān |
tān eva dviguṇīkṛtya tarpayet prayataḥ pitṝn ||
tān eveti devatarpaṇaviniyuktānām api teṣāṃ pitṛtarpaṇayogyatety uktam |
tathā ca gṛhyapariśiṣṭe |
darbhāḥ kṛṣṇājinaṃ mantrā brāhmaṇā havir agnayaḥ |
ayātayāmāny etāni niyojyāni punaḥ punaḥ ||
chāgaleyaḥ |
laghupātraṃ kare kṛtvā sauvarṇaṃ khaḍgam eva ca |
rājataṃ tāmrajaṃ vāpi tena saṃtarpayet pitṝn ||
śaṅkhaḥ |
sauvarṇena pātreṇa rājatena audumbareṇa khaḍgapātreṇa vā śaṅkunāpy udakaṃ pitṛtīrthaṃ spṛśan dadyāt |
'audumbaraṃ' tāmramayam | 'śaṅkunā' suvarṇādinirmitayā śalākayā |
viṣṇuḥ |
yavodakena devebhyaḥ pitṛbhyas tu tilodakaiḥ |
[922] tarpaṇaṃ kuryād iti śeṣaḥ |
kūrmapurāṇe |
devān brahmaṛṣīṃś caiva tarpayed akṣatodakaiḥ |
pitṛbhaktyā tilaiḥ kṛṣṇaiḥ svasūtroktavidhānataḥ ||
matsyapurāṇe |
yavais tu tarpayed devān manuṣyān sanakādikān |
tilair viśeṣataḥ kṛṣṇair agniṣvāttādikān pitṝn |
ātmanaś ca pitṝn sarvān suhṛtsaṃbandhibhiḥ saha ||
vṛddhamanuḥ |
yathā yodhasahastrais tu rājā gacchati dhārmikaḥ |
evaṃ tilasamāyuktaṃ jalaṃ preteṣu gacchati ||
yat tu rāmāyaṇe,
pādaśaucam anabhyaṅgaṃ tilahīnaṃ ca tarpaṇam |
sarvaṃ tat trijaṭe tubhyaṃ yac ca śrāddham adakṣiṇam ||
iti, tat tilalābhe ’pi tadvihīnatarpaṇābhiprāyaṃ, anyathā tilānām apy alābhe ityādivacanavirodhaḥ syāt |
gobhilaḥ |
śuklais tu tarpayed devān manuṣyān śabalais tilaiḥ |
pitṝṃs tu tarpayet kṛṣṇaiḥ tarpayan sarvadā dvijaḥ ||
tilagrahaṇe viśeṣam āha marīciḥ |
muktahastena dātavyaṃ na mudrāṃ tatra darśayet |
vāmahaste tilā grāhyā muktahastas tu dakṣiṇaḥ ||
[923] 'mudrā' pradeśinyaṅguṣṭhāgrasaṃyogaḥ | etad anuddhṛtodakatarpaṇābhiprāyam |
yathā ca yogayājñavalkyaḥ |
yady uddhṛtaṃ niṣiñcet tu tilān saṃmiśrayej jale |
ato ’nyathā tu savyena tilā grāhyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||
‘ato ’nyathā’ anuddhṛtodakatarpaṇe |
tatra jalasthasya viśeṣam āha śālaṅkāyanaḥ |
bāhuṃ pūrṇaṃ tilaiḥ kṛtvā jalasthas tarpayet pitṝn |
sthalasthena na kartavyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptim icchatā |
evaṃ ca yad ukaṃ gobhilena,
romasaṃsthān tilān kṛtvā yas tu tarpayate pitṝn |
pitaras tarpitās tena rudhireṇa malena ca ||
iti, tat sthalatarpaṇaviṣayam ity avagantavyam | yadā tu sthalastho ’py anuddhṛtena codakena tarpaṇaṃ kuryāt tadā vāmahastasyālomake pradeśe śāṭyāṃ vā tilān nidhāya tarpaṇaṃ kāryam |
tad āha kārṣṇājiniḥ |
romasaṃsthān tilān kṛtvā tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ |
jale sthale talasthāṃs tu kṛtvā śāṭyām athāpi vā ||
ukta tilatarpaṇasya kvacid apavādam āha marīciḥ |
saptamyāṃ ravivāre ca gṛhe janmadine tathā |
bhṛtyaputrakalatrārthī na kuryāt tilatarpaṇam ||
pakṣayor ubhayo rājan saptamyāṃ niśisaṃdhayoḥ |
vidyāputrakalatrārthī tilān pañcasu varjayet ||
[924] nimbasya bhakṣaṇaṃ tailaṃ tilais tarpaṇam añjanam |
saptamyāṃ naiva kurvīta tāmrapātre ca bhojanam ||
kālikāpurāṇe |
raviśukratrayodaśyāṃ saptamyāṃ niśisaṃdhayoḥ |
tilatarpaṇasaṃyogāt tajjalaṃ rudhiraṃ smṛtam ||
adhikāriviśeṣeṇa tilatarpaṇapratiṣedham āha kauṇḍilyaḥ |
darśaśrāddhaṃ gayāśrāddhaṃ śrāddhaṃ cāparapakṣikaṃ |
na jīvatpitṛkaḥ kuryāt tilais tarpaṇam eva ca ||
iti tarpaṇasādhanāni |
athāñjaliśaṃkhyā |
tatrāha vyāsaḥ |
ekaikam añjaliṃ devā dvau dvau tu sanakādayaḥ |
arhanti pitaras trīṃs trīn striyas tv ekaikam añjalim ||
āha satyatapāḥ |
devapitṛmanuṣyādi svaśākhāvidhicoditām |
ekaikāñjalinā tṛptiṃ prathamāntena vācayet ||
viṣṇupurāṇe |
trir apaḥ prīṇanārthāya devānām apavarjayet |
tatharṣīṇāṃ yathānyāyaṃ sakṛd vāpi prajāpatiḥ |
pitṝṇāṃ prīṇanārthāya trir apaḥ pṛthivīpate ||
'apavarjayet' dadyāt |
kūrmapurāṇe |
[925] devatānāṃ tu sarvāsām ekaikāñjalir iṣyate |
ṛṣīṇām eka eva syān manuṣyāṇāṃ dvayaṃ tathā |
trayas trayaḥ pitṝṇāṃ tu strīṇām ekaika eva hi ||
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
añjalidvitayaṃ dadyād devān saṃtarpayan budhaḥ |
ṛṣīṇāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ sakṛd eva pradāpayet ||
tris triḥ pitṛbhyo dadyāt tu strīṇāṃ tu sakṛd eva hi |
dvau dvau mātāmahānāṃ ca mātulānāṃ sakṛt tathā |
gurvācāryaśvaśurāṇāṃ suhṛtsaṃbandhināṃ sakṛt ||
baudhāyanaḥ |
jalāñjalitrayaṃ deyaṃ ye cānye saṃskṛtā bhuvi |
asaṃskṛtapramītānām ekam evāvaṭe kṣipet ||
tatra yathāsvaśākhaṃ vyavasthā veditavyā | yeṣāṃ tu śākhinām anāmnātaṃ teṣāṃ vikalpa iti |
ity añjalisaṃkhyā |
atha tarpaṇīyagaṇakramaḥ |
tatra chāgaleyaḥ |
devān devagaṇāṃś caiva munīn munigaṇān api |
pitṝn pitṛgaṇāṃś caiva nityaṃ saṃtarpayet tataḥ ||
śātātapaḥ |
devebhyaś ca ṛṣibhyaś ca pitṛbhyaś ca yathākramam |
vasiṣṭho ’pi |
[926] devān ṛṣīn manuṣyāṃś ca bhūtagrāmaṃ carācaram |
vasūan rudrāṃs tathādityāṃs tataḥ pitṛgaṇān api |
pramītān ātmanaś cāpi kramaśas tarpayed budhaḥ ||
brahmapurāṇe |
prathamaṃ tarpayed devān brahmādīn susamāhitaḥ |
tataḥ saṃtarpayed vidvān marīcipramukhān ṛṣīn ||
vasūn rudrāṃs tathādityān kramaśas tadanantaram |
yakṣān paśūn suparṇaṃś ca bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham ||
acāryan itarāṃś caiva kālasyāvayavān api |
sanakapramukhāṃś caiva manuṣyāṃs tadanantaram ||
kavyabālanalādīṃś ca tataḥ pitṛgaṇān api |
svapitṛbhyas tato dadyān mātṛbhyas tasya cāpy anu |
tato mātāmahānāṃ ca pitṛvyāṇāṃ tataḥ param ||
patnīnāṃ ca sutānāṃ ca pitṛmātṛsvasus tataḥ |
mātulānī ca duhitā svasācāryartvijas tathā ||
śiṣyāś ca jñātayaś caiva suhṛtsaṃbandhinas tathā |
eteṣāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kāryaṃ yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ ||
jñātājñātān samuddiśya pradeyaś cāñjalis tataḥ |
asaṃskṛtapramītānāṃ pṛthag deyo ’ñjalis tataḥ ||
iti krameṇa yaḥ kuryād devādīnāṃ tu tarpaṇam |
tena syus tarpitās te tu sudhābhir nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
skandapurāṇe |
[927] pūrvaṃ modapramodādaīn tarpayet ṣaḍvināyakān |
tato brahmādayo devās tarpaṇīyā mahāmate |
tataś ca sanakādīnāṃ prayatas tṛptim ācaret ||
agniṣvāttādikānāṃ tu pitṝṇām apy anukramāt |
yamāya dharmarājāya kuryāt saṃtarpaṇaṃ tataḥ ||
pitṝṇām atha mātṝṇāṃ tato mātāmahasya ca |
patnīśvaśurabandhūnāṃ sutasaṃbandhināṃ tataḥ ||
nāradīyapurāṇe |
agniprabhṛtayo devās tarpyāh syuḥ prathamaṃ nṛpa |
tataḥ śatarcinādyās tu munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ ||
tataḥ kāṇḍaṛṣīn sarvāṃs tarpayec chraddhayānvitaḥ |
manuṣyāṃś ca pitṝṃś caiva yathāpūrvaṃ pratarpayet ||
satyavrataḥ |
pūrvaṃ svapitaras tarpyāḥ paścād anyāṃś ca tarpayet |
pitṛbhyaḥ pratyahaṃ dadyāt tato mātṛbhya eva ca |
tato mātāmahānāṃ ca pitṛvyasya sutasya ca ||
pitrāditarpaṇānantaraṃ yājñavalkāḥ |
suhṛtsaṃbandhibandhūnāṃ tataḥ kuryāt tu tarpaṇam ||
yamaḥ |
sapiṇḍānāṃ ca bandhūnāṃ kṛtvādāv udakakriyām |
suhṛtsaṃbandhivargāṇāṃ tato dadyāj jalāñjalim ||
viṣṇuḥ | [928]
ādau svavaṃśyānāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kuryāt tataḥ saṃbandhibāndhavānāṃ, tataḥ suhṛdām evaṃ ca nityasnāyī syāt |
śaṅkhaḥ |
ā saptamāt tu puruṣāt pitṛpakṣe yāvatān tu nāma jānīyāt tāvatāṃ pitṛpakṣāṇām udakatarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā gurūṇāṃ kuryāt | gurūṇāṃ kṛtvā mātṛpakṣāṇāṃ kuryāt | mātṛpakṣāṇāṃ kṛtvā tatsaṃbandhibāndhavānāṃ kuryāt | teṣāṃ kṛtvā suhṛdāṃ kuryāt |
iti tarpaṇīyagaṇakramaḥ | 1
atha hastatīrthopavītajānudiṅniyamāḥ |
tatra yamaḥ |
dvau hastau yugmataḥ kṛtvā pūrayed udakāñjalim |
gośṛṅgamātram uddhṛtya jalamadhye jalaṃ kṣipet ||
yat tu vyāghreṇoktam,
ubhābhyām atha pāṇibhyām udakaṃ yaḥ prayacchati |
sa mūḍho narakaṃ yāti kālasūtram avākśirāḥ ||
tac chrāddhādiviṣayam |
tathā ca kārṣṇājiniḥ |
śrāddhe vivāhakāle ca pāṇinaikena dīyate |
tarpaṇaṃ tu bhaven naivaṃ vidhir eṣa purātanḥ || iti |
ata eva bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
ubhābhyām atha hastābhyām ābadhyāñjalim ādarāt |
devān ṛṣīn manuṣyāṃś ca pitṝṃś caivābhitarpayet ||
matsyapurāṇe |
[929] ubhayor hastayoḥ kṛtvā salilaiḥ pūrṇam añjalim |
devānāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ ca śucis tarpaṇam ācaret ||
atra viśeṣam āha yogayājñavalkyaḥ |
ubhābhyām atha hastābhyām aparājitadiṅmukhaḥ |
saṃvṛtāṅguṣṭhakābhyāṃ tu savyopagraham eva vā ||
prakṣipet toyam iti śeṣaḥ |
vāyupurāṇe |
ubhābhyām atha hastābhyāṃ pitṝn devāṃś ca tarpayet |
savyopagrahayuktena dakṣiṇenaiva vā punaḥ ||
vasiṣṭhaḥ |
ekena vā hastena kuryād devapitṛtarpaṇaṃ savyārabdhenobhābhyāṃ veti |
kūrmapurāṇe |
anvārabdhena savyena pāṇinā dakṣiṇena tu |
devarṣīṃs tarpayed dhīmān udakāñjalibhiḥ pitṝn ||
anvārabdhena dakṣiṇapāṇinā sahāñjaler vikalpaḥ |
viṣṇupurāṇe |
śucivastradharaḥ snāto devarṣipitṛtarpaṇam |
teṣām eva hi tīrthena kurvīta susamāhitaḥ ||
'teṣāṃ' devādīnāṃ, tataś ca devatīrthena devānāṃ, prajāpatitīrthena ṛṣīṇāṃ, pitṛtīrthena pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kartavyam ity ukaṃ bhavati |
narasiṃhapurāṇe |
devatīrthena kurvīta devānāṃ tarpaṇaṃ sadā |
[930] sanakādimanuṣyāṇāṃ ṛṣīṇām api sarvaśaḥ ||
prājāpatyena siñcet tu salilaṃ śraddhayā śuciḥ |
pitṛtīrthena kartavyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ budhaiḥ |
anyathā tarpaṇaṃ kurvann enasā yujyate naraḥ ||
agnipurāṇe |
daivenaiva hi tīrthena devānāṃ tarpaṇaṃ smṛtam |
prājāpatyena tīrthena tarpayet brahmaṇaḥ sutān |
pitṝṇām api tīrthena teṣām eva hi tarpaṇam ||
viṣṇuḥ |
ādāv eva divyena tīrthena devānāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kuryāt pitryeṇa pitṝṇāṃ |
tīrthalakṣaṇam uktaṃ yogayājñavalkyena |
pañca tīrthāni viprasya kare tiṣṭhanti dakṣiṇe |
brāhmaṃ devaṃ tathā pitryaṃ prājāpatyaṃ ca saumikam ||
aṅguṣṭhamūle brāhmaṃ tu daivaṃ hy aṅgulimūrddhani |
prājāpatyaṃ tu mūleṣu madhye saumyaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||
aṅguṣṭhasya pradeśinyā madhye pitryaṃ prakīrtitam |
evaṃ jñātvā na muhyanti sarvakarmasu vai dvijāḥ ||
hārītena tu |
madhye agneyam uktam | aṅguṣṭhasyottarato rekhā brāhmaṃ tīrthaṃ, kaniṣṭikāyāḥ paścāt prājāpatyaṃ; agre ’ṅgulīnāṃ daivaṃ, aṅguṣṭhapradeśinyor antarā pitryaṃ, madhye āgneyaṃ | kṣutaniṣṭhīvitāśatapītalīḍheṣu mūtrapurīṣayor daśanotsarge striśūdrocchiṣṭābhibhāṣaṇe devatām abhigantukāmo ’dhyeṣyamāṇo vā brāhmeṇa tīrthenācāmet | āvapanahomatarpaṇāni [931] prājāpatyena kuryān mārjanārcana-balikarmabhojanāni daivena, pitrārthān pitryeṇa, pratigraham āgneyeneti |
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
nāndīmukhānāṃ kurvīta prājñaḥ piṇḍodakakriyām |
prājāpatyena tīrthena yac ca kiṃcit prajāpateḥ ||
jamadagniḥ |
yajñopavītī devebhyaḥ pradadyāt salilāñjalīn |
nivītī tu manuṣyāṇāṃ kuryāt tarpaṇam ādṛtaḥ |
prācīnāvītasaṃyuktaḥ pitṛbhyo nirvapej jalam ||
yajñopavītādilakṣaṇam āha bharadvājaḥ |
dakṣiṇaṃ bāhum uddhṛtya vāmaskandhe niveśitam |
yajñopavītam ity ukaṃ devakāryeṣu śasyate ||
kaṇṭābalanvitaṃ (?) caiva brahmasūtraṃ yadā bhavet |
tan nivītam iti khyātaṃ śastaṃ karmaṇi mānuṣe ||
utkṣipte vāmabāhau ca dakṣiṇaskandham āśritam |
prācīnāvītam ity āhus tat pitryeṣv eva karmasu ||
satyavrataḥ |
kṛtopavīto devebhyo nivītī ca bhavet tataḥ |
manuṣyāṃs tarpayed bhaktyā brahmaputrān ṛṣīṃs tathā ||
apasavyaṃ tataḥ kuryāt savyaṃ jānvācya bhūtale |
darbhapāṇis tu vidhinā pretān saṃtarpayet tataḥ |
pitrādīn nāmagotreṇa tato mātāmahān api ||
pulastyaḥ |
anvācya dakṣiṇaṃ jānuṃ prāgagrais tu kuśair dvijaḥ |
devān saṃtarpayen nityaṃ śraddhāpūtena cetasā ||
anvācya jānuṃ savyaṃtu kuśaiś ca dviguṇai rapi |
saṃtarpayet pitṝn bhaktyā dhyāyaṃs tadgatamānasaḥ ||
gobhilaḥ |
devaṃ saṃtarpayan prājño dakṣiṇaṃ jānu bhūtale |
nidadhyād atha vāmaṃ tu pitṝn api vicakṣaṇaḥ I
manuṣyatarpaṇaṃ kurvan na kiṃcij jānu pātayet ||
sumantuḥ |
nubjaṃ jānuṃ niveśyādho dakṣiṇaṃ tarpayet surān |
tathaiva savyaṃ vinyasya pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ caret ||
brahmavaivartte |
pūrvāśābhimukho bhūtvā pūrvāgreṣu kuśeṣu ca |
aponiṣañcet (?) prayato devān uddiśya dharmavit ||
saumyāśābhimukho nityam udagagre ca barhiṣi |
manuṣyāṇāṃ ca tṛptyarthaṃ nirvapet tu jalāñjalīn ||
yamāśāsaṃmukhaḥ sthitvā dakṣiṇāgrakuśeṣu ca |
pitṛbhyaḥ salilaṃ dadyāt tṛptyarthaṃ prītamānasaḥ ||
viśvāmitraḥ |
ubhābhyām atha hastābhyām aparājitadiṅmukhaḥ |
ādāya salilaṃ samyag ṛṣīn devāṃś ca tarpayet ||
[933] āgneyam atha vā yāmyāṃ prekṣamāṇo diśaṃ naraḥ |
dadyāt pitṝn samuddiśya trīṃs trīn atha jalāñjalīn ||
nandipurāṇe |
aindrīdigābhimukhyena tridaśānāṃ tu tarpaṇam |
aiśānyām atha kauveryāṃ brahmaputrāṃś ca tarpayet |
dakṣiṇasyāṃ tu kāṣṭhāyāṃ vidheyaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam ||
iti hastatīrthopavītajānudiṅniyamāḥ |
atha pratyekatarpaṇīyadevādinirūpaṇam |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
prathamaṃ tarpayed devān upavītī vināyakān |
modaś caiva pramodaś ca sumukho durmukhas tathā |
avighno vighnakartā ca ity ete ṣaḍ vināyakāḥ ||
yogayājñavalkyaḥ |
brahmāṇaṃ tarpayet pūrvaṃ viṣṇuṃ rudraṃ prajāpatim |
devān chandāṃsi vedāṃś ca ṛṣīṃś caiva tapodhanān ||
ācāryaś caiva gandhavān ācāryā nitarāṃs tathā |
saṃvatsaraṃ sāvayavaṃ devīr apsarasas tathā ||
tathā devānugān nāgān sāgarān parvatān api |
sarito ’tha manuṣyāṃś ca yakṣān rakṣāṃsi caiva hi ||
piśācāṃś ca suparṇāṃś ca bhūtāny atha paśūṃs tathā |
vanaspatīn oṣadhīṃś ca bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham ||
[934] śaunako ’pi |
agnir viṣṇuḥ prajāpatir brahmā vedā ṛṣayaḥ sarvaṇi chandāṃsy oṅkāro vaṣaṭkāro vyāhṛtayaḥ sāvitrī yajño dyāvā pṛthivī antarikṣam ahorātrāṇi saṅkhyāḥ siddhāḥ samudrā nadyo girayaḥ kṣetrauṣadhivanaspatigandharvāpsaraso nāgāḥ vayāṃsi gāvaḥ sādhyā viprā yakṣā rakṣāṃsi bhūtāny evam anyāny atharṣayaḥ śatarcino mādhyamā gṛtsamado viśvāmitro vāmadevo ’trir bharadvājo vasiṣṭhaḥ pragāthāḥ pāvamānyaḥ kṣudrasūktā mahāsūktā iti prācīnāvītī sumantujaiminivaiśampāyanapailasūtrabhāṣyabhārata-
