paiṭhinasiḥ |
gautamo 'tha bharadvājo viśvāmitras tathaiva ca |
jamadagnir vasiṣṭhaś ca kaśyapo ’tris tathaiva ca ||
svārociṣaś cottamaś ca tāmaso raivatas tathā |
cākṣuṣaś ca mahātejās tarpyo vaivasvatas tathā ||
ity evaṃ yajñopavītī prāṅmukhaḥ anvācitadakṣiṇajānuḥ prāgagreṣu kuśeṣu prāgagraiḥ kuśair devatīrthena śuklatilamiśrair yavamiśrair vā udakaiḥ devān ṛṣīṃś ca tarpayitvā nivītīśānadigabhimukha udaṅmukho vā udagagreṣu [935] kuśeṣu kuśamadhyena prajāpatitīrthena śabalatilamiśrair yavamiśrair vā udakaiḥ sanakādīna marīcyādīṃś ca tarpayet |
tad āha saṃvartaḥ |
nivītaṃ tu tataḥ kṛtvā yajñasūtraṃ udaṅmukhaḥ |
prājāpatyena tīrthena manuṣyāṃs tarpayet pṛthak ||
evaṃ devān ṛṣīṃś caiva tarpayitvātha bhaktitaḥ |
manuṣyān brahmaputrāṃś ca nivītī tarpayed ṛṣīn ||
sanakaś ca sanandaś ca tṛtīyaś ca sanātanaḥ |
kapilaś cāsuriś caiva voḍhuḥ pañcaśikhas tathā |
ete brahmasutāḥ sapta manuṣyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||
marīcir atryaṅgirasau pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ |
pracetāś ca vasiṣṭhaś ca bhṛgur nārada eva ca |
devabrahmaṛṣīn etāṃs tarpayed akṣatodakaiḥ ||
atha prācīnāvītī dakṣiṇāmukho ’nvācitasavyajānur dakṣiṇāgreṣu kuśeṣu diguṇīkṛtaiḥ kuśaiḥ pitṛtīrthena kuśatilamiśrair udakaiḥ ptṛatarpaṇam ārabhet |
āha yogayājñavalkāḥ |
āvāhya pūrvavan mantrair āstīrya ca kuśāñ chubhān |
savyaṃ jānu tato ’nvācya pāṇibhyāṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ||
talliṅgais tarpayen mantraiḥ sarvān pitṛgaṇāṃs tathā |
prācīnāvīty udakaṃ prasiñced vai tilānvitam ||
tathā |
[936] kavyavālanalaṃ somaṃ yamam aryamaṇaṃ tathā |
agniṣvāttān seāmapāṃś ca tathā barhiṣadaḥ pitṝn ||
yadi syāj jīvapitṛkaḥ etān divyān pitṝṃs tathā |
yebhyo vāpi pitā dadyāt tebhyo vāpi pradāpayet ||
etāṃś ca vakṣyamāṇāṃś ca pramītapitṛko dvijaḥ |
vasūn rudrāṃs tathādityān namaskārasvadhānvitān ||
ete sarvasya pitara eṣv āyattāś ca mānuṣāḥ |
ācāryaś ca pitṝn svāṃś ca pitṛprabhṛtināmataḥ ||
yadi jīvapitṛkas tarpaṇaṃ kuryāt tadā devaṛṣimanuṣyatarpaṇānantaraṃ kavyavālaprabhṛtīn aṣṭau devapitṝn saṃtarpya tarpaṇaṃ samāpayet |
yebhyaḥ pitā dadyāt tebhyo vāpi tarpaṇaṃ kuryāt | pramītapitṛkas tv etān kavyabālaprabhṛtīn vacyamāṇān vasūn rudrādityān svān pitṛpitāmahāṃś ca tarpayet |
pitṛtarpaṇaṃ prakṛtya paiṭhīnasiḥ |
apasavyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā sthitvā ca pitṛdiṅmukhaḥ |
pitṝn divyān adivyāṃś ca pitṛtīrthena tarpayet || iti |
'divyāḥ' vasvādayaḥ | 'adivyāḥ' svapitrādayaḥ |
te ca divyās tenaiva darśitāḥ |
dhruvo ’dhvaraś ca somaś ca āpaś caivānalo nalaḥ |
pratyūṣaś ca prabhāvaś ca vasavo ’ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ ||
ajaikapād ahirbudhno virūpākṣo ’tha raivataḥ |
haraś ca bahurūpaś ca tryambakaś ca sureśvaraḥ ||
[937] sāvitraś ca jayantaś ca pinākī cāparājitaḥ |
ete rudrāḥ samākhyātā ekādaśa surottamāḥ ||
indro dhātā bhagaḥ pūṣā mitro ’tha varuṇo ’ryamā |
atrir vivasvāṃs tv aṣṭā ca savitā viṣṇur eva ca ||
ete vai dvādaśādityā devānāṃ pravarā matāḥ |
ete ca divyāḥ pitaraḥ pūjyāḥ sarvaiḥ prayatnataḥ || iti |
jaiminiḥ |
divyān pitṝṃś ca saṃtarpya svapitṝn atha tarpayet |
jābāliḥ |
svapitrādīn atha dhyāyan dakṣiṇābhimukhaḥ sthitaḥ |
tarpayed atha mātrādīn mātāmahagaṇāṃs tathā ||
ācāryāṃś ca pitṛvyāṃś ca bandhūn anyāṃś ca tarpayet |
suhṛtsaṃbandhinaś cānyān yājyaśiṣyartvijo ’pi ca ||
iti pratyekaṃ tarpaṇīyadevatānirūpaṇam |
atha tarpaṇetikartavyatā |
āha yogayājñavalkyaḥ |
anvārabdhena savyena pāṇinā dakṣiṇena tu |
tṛpyatām iti sektavyaṃ nāmnā tu praṇavādinā ||
tṛpyatām ity atra tarpaṇīyavyāpārasya pratīyamānatvāt abhihite kartari prathamaiva yukteti praṇavādiprathamāntaṃ nāma saṃkīrtya tadante tṛpyatām iti vaktavyaṃ iti prayogaṃ darśitavān |
jānūkarṇyas tu parasmaipadenāpi prayogaṃ darśitavān |
[938] tṛpyatv iti samuccārya tṛpyatām ity athāpi vā |
vidhijñaḥ prakṣipet toyaṃ devādīnām aśeṣataḥ ||
'devādīnāṃ' devarṣimanuṣyapitṝṇām |
kātyāyanas tu uttamapuruṣāntasyākhyānapadasya prayogam uktavān |
athādbhis tarpayed devān satilābhiḥ pitṝn api |
nāmānte tarpayāmīti ādāv om iti ca bruvan ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
tataḥ saṃtarpayed devān pitṝn ṛṣigaṇāṃs tathā |
ādāv oṅkāram uccārya namo ’nte tarpayāmi ceti |
tarpayāmīty atra tarpaṇīyasya karmatvenābhisaṃbandhāt praṇavādidevatānāma dvitīyāntam uccārya tarpayāmi namaḥ ityante samuccārayet | tataś ca oṃ brahmā tṛpyatāṃ | oṃ brahmā tṛpyatu | oṃ brahmāṇaṃ tarpayāmi nama iti vā ekavacanena | oṃ vedās tṛpyantāṃ | oṃ vedās tṛpyantu | oṃ vedāṃs tarpayāmi nama iti vā bahuvacanena prayogaḥ kartavya ity ukaṃ bhavati | atra yathāsvaśākhaṃ vyavasthā |
atra, vasvāditarpaṇe viśeṣam āha kaśyapaḥ |
vasūn rudrāṃs tathādityān namaskārasamanvitān |
adbhiḥ saṃtarpayen nityaṃ nāmabhiḥ praṇavādibhiḥ |
tarpayan yamarājaṃ ca namaskāraṃ prakīrtayet ||
atra, smṛticandrikākārādibhiḥ oṃ dhruvāya namaḥ ityevaṃ prayogo darśitaḥ | anye tu vākyaparipūrttaye oṃ dhruvaṃ tarpayāmi namaḥ iti prayogam āhuḥ | ataḥ svācāro ’nusartavyaḥ | yamatarpaṇe tu smṛtivacanasya [939] caturthyantanamo'ntanām ānukīrtanāt oṃ yamāya namaḥ ityādaya eva prayogā vidheyāḥ |
tathā ca chāgaleyaḥ |
yamāya dharmmarājāya ity anukīrtayan |
yamaṃ saṃtarpayann adbhir nirayaṃ naiva paśyati || iti |
atrāpi, oṃ yamāya namaḥ iti | yamaṃ saṃtarpayāmīty eke |
ṛṣyaśṛṅgeṇa tu pitṛtarpaṇe madhyamapuruṣāntasyāpi padasya prayogo darśitaḥ |
pitrādibhyo ’ñjaliṃ dadyāt japan mantrān yathāvidhi |
tṛpyadhvam iti ca trir vai tato mātṛbhya eva ca ||
mantrān udīratām ityādi vakṣyamāṇāt trir iti ekaikasya puruṣasya trīṃs trīn jalāñjalīn dadyād ity arthaḥ |
tathā ca paiṭhīnasiḥ |
sanāmagotragrahaṇaṃ puruṣaṃ puruṣaṃ prati |
tilodakāñjalīṃs trīṃs trīn uccair ucair viniḥkṣipet ||
ucair ucair iti pitur añjalibhyaḥ pitāmahāñjalayaḥ kiṃcid uccair utkṣiptapāṇinā deyāḥ | tato ’pi prapitāmahāñjalaya iti snānaprakaraṇe vyākhyātam |
yogayājñavalkyaḥ |
dakṣiṇe pitṛtīrthena jalaṃ siñced yathāvidhi |
dakṣiṇenaiva gṛhṇīyāt pitṛtīrthasamīpataḥ ||
savarṇebhyo jalaṃ deyaṃ nāmavarṇebhya eva ca |
gotranāmasvadhākārais tarpayed anupūrvaśaḥ ||
nāmādigrahaṇe ’pi viśeṣam āha baudhāyanaḥ |
[940] śarmāntaṃ brāhmaṇasyoktaṃ varmantaṃ kṣatriyasya tu |
guptāntaṃ caiva vaiśyasya dāsāntaṃ śūdrajanmanaḥ ||
caturṇām api varṇānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ pitṛgotratā |
pitṛgotraṃ kumārīṇām ūḍhānāṃ bhartṛgotratā ||
atra saṃbandhānukīrtanam api kartavyam,
gotrasaṃbandhanāmāni pitṛkarm\maṇi kīrtayet |
iti bhṛgusmaraṇāt |
atra guruṣu gauravārtham ācārānusārād bahuvacanaṃ, kaniṣṭheṣu patnīṣu caikavacanaṃ
prayoktavyam | tataś ca oṃ amukasagotrān asmatpitṝn amukaśarmaṇas tarpayāmi svadhā namaḥ iti | oṃ amukasagotrāḥ asmatpitaraḥ amukaśarmāṇas tṛpyadhvaṃ svadheti vā prayogaḥ kartavyaḥ | kaniṣṭheṣu tu amukasagotram asmanmitraṃ amukaśarmaṇaṃ tarpayāmi svadhā namaḥ iti | oṃ amukasagotra asmanmitra amukaśarman tṛpyasva svadheti vā prayogaḥ |
atrāha paiṭhīnasiḥ |
pavitrair abhyukṣyācamya vasubhyo brahmaṇe vaiśravaṇāyety udakaṃ ninayed udīratām iti tribhir mantrais trīn udakāñjalīn ninayet | pitṛvaṃśasya nāma gṛhṇan ācāryāya mātre mātāmahāya mātulebhyaś ceti |
yogayājñavalkāḥ |
mantraiś ca deyam udakaṃ pitṝṇāṃ prītivarddhanaiḥ | iti |
te ca mantrās tenaiva darśitāḥ | udīratām aṅgirasa āyantv ity ūrjam ity api pitṛbhya iti ye ceha madhuvātā iti tryṛcam |
pitṝn dhyāyan prasiñced vai japan mantrān imān kramāt |
tṛpyadhvam iti tu trir vai tataḥ prāñjalir ānataḥ ||
asyārthaḥ | udīratām iti mantrānte amukagotrāḥ asmatpitaraḥ [941] amukaśarmāṇas tṛpyadhvaṃ svadheti prathamaṃ tilāñjaliṃ dadyāt | tataś cāṅgirasena iti mantrānte tathaiva vākyam uccārya dvitīyaṃ | tata āyantu na iti mantreṇa tathaiva tṛtīyam ity evaṃ pitre ’ñjalitrayaṃ dadyāt | tata ūrjaṃ vahantīr iti mantrānte oṃ amukasagotrāḥ asmatpitāmahāḥ amukaśarmaṇas tṛpyadhvaṃ svadheti prathamam | pitṛbhyaḥ svadhā iti tathaiva dvitīyam | ye ceha pitara iti tathaiva tṛtīyam ity evaṃ pitāmahāyāñjalitrayaṃ dadyāt | tato madhuvātā iti mantrānte oṃ amukagotrāḥ asmatprapitāmahāḥ amukaśarmāṇas tṛpyadhvaṃ svadheti prathamam | madhunaktam iti tathaiva dvitīyam | madhumān na iti tathaiva tṛtīyam ity evaṃ prapitāmahāyāñjalitrayaṃ dadyāt | atrāvasare prathamaṃ mātrādīnāṃ tarpaṇantato mātāmahādīnām,
pūrvaṃ pitrādayas tarpyās tato mātrādayo ’pi ca |
tato mātāmahāś caiva mātāmahyas tataḥ param ||
iti vyāsasmaraṇāt |
oṃ amukasagotrāḥ asmanmātaraḥ amukadās tṛpyadhvaṃ svadheti mātre | amukasagotrāḥ asmatpitāmahyaḥ amukadās tṛpyadhvaṃ svadheti pitāmahyai | amukagotrā asmatprapitāmahyaḥ amukadās tṛpyadhvaṃ svadheti prapitāmahyai | ity evaṃ mātrādibhya ekaikam evāñjaliṃ svadhākāravatā nāmamātreṇa dadyāt |
tathā ca pitṛmātāmahādimantravidher anantaram āha yogayājñavalkyaḥ |
mātā mātṛsvasā caiva mātulānī pitṛsvasā |
duhitā ca svasā caiva śiṣyartvikjñātibāndhavāḥ |
nāmatas tu svadhākārais tarpyāḥ syur anupūrvaśaḥ || iti |
tadanantaraṃ namo va iti mantrānte oṃ amukasagotrāḥ asmanmātāmahā [942] amukaśarmāṇas tṛpyadhvaṃ svadheti prathamaṃ, tathaiva dvitīyatṛtīyāv ity evaṃ mātāmahāyāñjalitrayaṃ dadyāt | evam eva pramātāmahavṛddhapramātāmahayos trīṃs trīn añjalīn dadyāt | mantras tu namo va ity eka eva punaḥ punar āvartate |
tathā ca yogayājñavalkyaḥ |
namo va iti japtvā vai tato mātāmahān api |
tarpayed ānṛśaṃsyārthaṃ dharmaṃ paramam āśritaḥ ||
atha mātṛvat prayogam uccārya mātāmahyādīnām ekaikāñjalir deyaḥ | tataḥ patnībhyaḥ kṛtvā pitṛvyādīnāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kāryaṃ mātāmahatarpaṇānantaram |
tad uktaṃ garuḍapurāṇe |
atha mātāmahīnāṃ ca svapatnīnām anantaram |
tarpaṇaṃ ca pitṛvyāṇāṃ tatpatnībhyas tato ’pi ca ||
pitṛsvasuś ca tadbhartur mātulasyāpi nityaśaḥ |
mātulānyās tato mātṛsvasus tatpatyur eva ca ||
śvaśurasya ca kartavyaṃ śvaśrūṇām api tarpaṇam |
ācāryāṇāṃ tataḥ kuryād ācāryāṇībhya eva ca ||
bandhūnāṃ bhrātṛpatnīnāṃ putraṃ caiva snuṣām api |
putrīṃ tasyāḥ patiṃ caiva bhaginīṃ tatpatiṃ tathā ||
bhāgineyaṃ ca pautraṃ ca dauhitraṃ yājyam ṛtvijam |
śiṣyaṃ mitraṃ ca saṃtarpya tatpatnīs tu tathaiva ca ||
anyeṣām api dātavyaṃ yebhyo ’yaṃ dātum icchati |
mātāmahyādisarveṣām ekaikaṃ salilāñjalim |
dadyāt tīrthe viśeṣeṇa dharmaṃ paramam āsthitaḥ ||
[943] vārāhapurāṇe |
pretebhyas tu pṛthag dadyān manasā tatparaḥ smaran |
ātmano ’pi jalaṃ dadyād iti dvaipāyano ’bravīt ||
atrāvasānāñjalim āha kātyāyanaḥ |
pitṛvaṃśyā mātṛvaṃśyā ye cānye matta udakam arhanti tāṃs tarpayāmīty antena tilāñjaliṃ dadyāt |
brahmavaivarte ’pi |
yatra kvacana saṃsthānāṃ kṣuttṛṣṇopahatātmanām |
teṣāṃ hi dattam akṣayyam idam astu tilodakam ||
ye me kule luptapiṇḍāḥ putradāravivarjitāḥ |
teṣāṃ hi dattam akṣayyam idam astu tilodakam ||
mātṛvaṃśyā mṛtā ye ca pitṛvaṃśyās tathaiva ca |
teṣāṃ hi dattam akṣayyam idam astu tilodakam |
ity uccārya tato dadyāt salile salilāñjalim || iti |
kāmodakākhyam anyam apy añjaliṃ dadyāt, tad uktaṃ viṣṇupurāṇe |
idaṃ cāpi japed ambu daded ātmecchayā nṛpa |
upakārāya bhūtānāṃ kṛtadevāditarpaṇaḥ ||
devāsurās tathā yakṣā gandharvoragarākṣasāḥ |
piśācā guhyakāḥ siddhāḥ kūṣmāṇḍās taravaḥ khagāḥ ||
jalecarā bhūnilayā vāyvādhārāś ca jantavaḥ |
tṛptim ete na yāntv āśu maddattenāmbunākhilām ||
narakeṣu samasteṣu yātanāsu ca ye gatāḥ |
[944] teṣām āpyāyanāyaiva dīyate salilaṃ mayā ||
yo 'bāndhavā bāndhavā vā ye ’nyajanmani bāndhavāḥ |
te tṛptim akhilāṃ yāntu yaś cāsmatto ’bhivāñchati || iti |
vistarāsamarthas tu saṃkṣiptaṃ matsyapurāṇoktaprakāreṇa tarpaṇaṃ kuryāt |
devā yakṣās tathā nāgā gandharvāpsaraso’surāḥ |
sarpāḥ krūrāḥ suparṇāś ca taravo jṛmbhakāḥ khagāḥ ||
vāyvādhārā jalādhārās tathaivākāśagāminaḥ |
nirādhārāś ca ye jīvā ye ca dharmaratās tathā ||
kṛtopavītī datvaivaṃ nivītī ca bhaven tataḥ |
sanakaś ca sanandaś ca tṛtīyaś ca sanātanaḥ ||
kapilaś cāsuriś caiva voḍhuḥ pañcaśikhas tathā |
sarve te tṛptim āyāntu maddattenāmbunākhilām ||
marīcim atryaṅgirasaṃ pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum |
prācetasaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca bhṛguṃ nāradam eva ca |
devabrahmaṛṣīn sarvān tarpayāmy akṣatodakaiḥ ||
apasavyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā savyaṃ jānv ācya bhūtale |
agniṣvāttās tathā saumyā haviṣmantas tathoṣmapāḥ ||
vikālino barhiṣadas tathānye kāmacāriṇaḥ |
tarpayāmi pitṝn bhaktyā satilaiś candanodakaiḥ |
darbhapāṇis tu vidhinā pretān saṃtarpayet tataḥ ||
viṣṇupurāṇe atisaṃkṣepatarpaṇam uktaṃ |
ābrahmastabhaparyantaṃ jagat tṛpyatv iti bruvan |
[945] kṣipet payo'ñjalīn trīṃs tu kurvan saṃkṣepatarpaṇam |
atrāvasare snānavastraniṣpīḍanaṃ kartavyam | tadāha vasiṣṭhaḥ |
tīre jalāśayasyaivaṃ nirvartya pitṛtarpaṇam |
niṣpīḍayet snānavastraṃ dakṣiṇābhimukhaḥ sthale |
ato madhyāhnasnāne jalamadhyasthitaḥ snānāṅgatarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā bahir nirgato vastram niṣpīḍyaivācamanaṃ kuryāt |
vastraniṣpīḍanaṃ tu sthalatarpaṇānantaraṃ kuryāt |
tad uktaṃ brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
tataḥ snātvā vidhānena saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ |
jalāśayād vinirgatya dvir ācāmet samāhitaḥ ||
snānavastram aniṣpīḍya sthāpyam āsthalatarpaṇāt |
sthale ’pi tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā tato vastraṃ nipīḍayet ||
tad anu dvir upaspṛśya sūryāyārghyaṃ nivedayet |
tato devārcanaṃ kuryāt eṣa mādhyāhiko vidhiḥ ||
yogayājñavalkyaḥ |
pūrvaṃ niṣpīḍanaṃ kecit prāg devapitṛtarpaṇāt |
snānavastrasya necchanti tasmād ūrdhvaṃ nipīḍayet ||
annaprakaravat tasya apasavyena pīḍanam |
niṣpīḍya snānavastraṃ tu ācamya prayataḥ śuciḥ |
devānām arcanaṃ kuryāt brahmādīnām amatsaraḥ ||
atra viśeṣam āha bṛhaspatiḥ |
prakṣālya pādau hastau ca svayam eva dvir ācamet || iti |
[946] evaṃ kurvataḥ phalam āha śaṅkhaḥ |
snātaḥ saṃtarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā pitṝṇāṃ tu tilāmbhasā |
pitṛlokam avāpnoti prīṇāti ca tathā pitṝn ||
manu-śātātapa-yogayājñavalkyāḥ |
yad eva tarpayaty adbhiḥ pitṝn snātvā dvijottamaḥ |
tenaiva sarvam āpnoti pitṛyajñakriyāphalam ||
atra pitṛgāthāsu yamaḥ |
api naḥ sakule bhūyād yo no dadyāj jalāñjalīn |
nadīṣu bahutoyāsu śītalāsu viśeṣataḥ ||
atra tathaiva viṣṇuḥ |
kule ’smākaṃ sa jantuḥ syāt yo no dadyāj jalāñjalīn |
nadīṣu bahutoyāsu śītalāsu viśeṣataḥ ||
tarpaṇākaraṇe doṣa ukto brahmavaivarte |
devatāś ca munīṃś caiva pitṝn vai yo na tarpayet |
devādīnām ṛṇī bhūtvā narakaṃ sa vrajaty adhaḥ ||
hārītaḥ |
na sravantīṃ vṛthākrāmed evaṃ hy āha pitāmahaḥ |
devāś ca pitaraś caiva kāṅkṣanti saritaṃ prati |
adatte tu nirāśāste pratiyānti yathāgatam ||
parāśara-śātātapau |

vaivasvatāya kālāya sarvabhūtakṣayāya ca ||

atra viśeṣam āha vṛddhamanuḥ |

padmapurāṇe |

vyāsaḥ |

yamāya dharmarājāya mṛtyave cāntakāya ca|
vaivasvatāya kālāya sarvabhūtakṣayāya ca ||

yamaḥ |

anarkābhyudite kāle māghakṛṣṇacaturdaśīm |

saṃtarpya dharmarājānaṃ mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ||

saṃvatsarakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇād eva naśyati ||
atrāyaṃ mantraḥ |

iti yamabhīṣmatarpaṇe |

parvataṃ lokapālāṃś ca indraṃ śacīṃ vajram airāvataṃ mātaliṃ citrasenapramukhān gandhavāṃs tu apsarasaḥ pramudonāmāpsarasaḥ pṛṣṭayonāmāpsarasaḥ āyuvonāmāpsarasaḥ stāvānāmāpsarasaḥ bhekurayonāmāśarasaḥ ūrjjonāmāpsarasaḥ agniṃ santaṃ svāhāṃ santaṃ agnīdhraṃ yamaṃ dharmaṃ priyaṃ satyaṃ tapaḥ santaṃ | yajñadakṣiṇāṃ dīkṣāṃ brahmacaryaṃ vyavasāyaṃ dharmarājānaṃ daṇḍapiṅgalaṃ pāśau āyudham | svargaṃ mṛtyuṃ citraguptaṃ yamapuruṣān śyāmaśabalau virūpākṣaṃ nirṛtiṃ dharmapradhānān | daityadānavān | vidyādharān | yakṣān | rākṣasān | piśācān | rogān | jvaraṃ rogādhipam ārogyaṃ varuṇaṃ gaurīṃ nāgān | vāsukim anantam | sarpān | vanaspatīn vāyūn sarvān prāṇāpānasamānodānavyānān | indriyāṇi indriyārthān jīvam | somaṃ nakṣatrāṇi vartamānaṃ nakṣatraṃ pitṝn abhāsvarān barhiṣado ’gniṣvāttān kravyādān upahūtān ājyapān sukālinaḥ mahādevaṃ pārvatīṃ senānyaṃ skandaṃ viśākhaṃ skandagrahān | bālahān mātṛgrahān skandapāriṣadān skandapāriṣadīḥ bhūtāni | bhaumān rudrīyāntarikṣān rudrān divyān rudrān saṅgatān rudrān mātṛḥ yogīśvarīḥ devapatnīḥ devamātṛḥ gaṇān dhanādhipān | vināyakaṃ mitaṃ saṃmitaṃ santaṃ śālaṃ saṅkaṭaṃ kūṣmāṇḍaṃ rājaputraṃ dharmam arthaṃ kāmaṃ gatiṃ prītiṃ nidrāṃ kṣudham aditiṃ āyatiṃ niyatiṃ kīrtiṃ prajñāṃ vṛttiṃ medhāṃ ākṛtiṃ ruciṃ śraddhāṃ vāṇīṃ sarasvatīṃ ṛkṣaṃ dākṣāyaṇīḥ prajāṃ [955] prajāpatiṃ sanakaṃ sanātanaṃ sanatkumāraṃ kratuṃ pitṝn brahmarṣīn devarṣīn rājarṣīn ṛṣikān | ṛṣipatnīḥ ṛṣiputrān gāyatrīm uṣṇiham anuṣṭubhaṃ paṅktiṃ jagatīṃ sarvacchandāṃsi garuḍam aruṇaṃ havyaṃ jātaṃ surabhiṃ dinārdhaṃ gām ucaiḥśravasaṃ dhanvantariṃ bhuvananāgān diṅnāgān kulanāgān viśvakarmāṇaṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ ṛddhiṃ nalaṃ kuberaṃ revantaṃ śaṅkhapadmau bahuputraṃ tatpatnīṃ tatprajāṃ kaśyapaṃ tatpatnīṃ tatprajām | dhanadaṃ tatpatnīṃ tatprajāṃ | prajāpatiṃ tatpatnīṃ tatprajām | candraṃ tatpatnīṃ tatprajām | ariṣṭanemiṃ tatpatnīṃ tatprajām | kṛśānuṃ tajjāyāṃ tatprajāś ca śastrāṇi śāstrāṇi astrāṇi | ṛgvedaṃ yajurvedaṃ sāmavedaṃ atharvavedam itihāsān purāṇaṃ dhanurvedaṃ gāndharvavedam āyurvedaṃ phalavedaṃ jyotiṣaṃ śikṣāṃ kalpaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ chandovicitiṃ dharmaśāstrāṇi bhārataṃ manuṃ viṣṇu yamaṃ aṅgirasaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ nāradaṃ dakṣaṃ saṃvartaṃ śātātapaṃ parāśaram āśvalāyanam auśanasaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ kātyāyanaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ gautamaṃ śaṅkhaṃ likhitaṃ hārītam atriṃ yājñavalkyam atha bhagavantaṃ dharmam uttānapādaṃ yajñaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ nāsatyaṃ varuṇāryamāṇau saṃvatsaraṃ mitram indrāgnī marīcikaśyapau dhruvam agastyaṃ dhātāraṃ mārtaṇḍaṃ rāmaṃ vālmīkiṃ kalpaṃ mahākalpaṃ manvantaraṃ vartamānam indram ojasvinaṃ svāyaṃbhuvaṃ svārociṣam auttamaṃ tāmasaṃ raivataṃ cākṣuṣaṃ mahātaijasaṃ vaivasvatam arkaṃ sāvarṇiṃ brahmasāvarṇiṃ rudrasāvarṇiṃ dakṣasāvarṇiṃ dharmasāvarṇiṃ raucyaṃ bhaugyaṃ yugaṃ vartamānaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ vartamānam ayanaṃ vartamānam ṛtuṃ vartamānaṃ māsaṃ vartamānaṃ pakṣaṃ vartamānam ādityaṃ somaṃ kujaṃ budhaṃ jīvaṃ śukaṃ śanaiśvaraṃ rāhuṃ ketūn ṛkṣāṇi vartamānaṃ divasaṃ rātriṃ saṃdhye kiṃpuruṣān sarvāṇi bhūtāni devānucarān devāṃśān |
[956] oṃ ekajyotiṣaṃ dvijyotiṣaṃ trijyotiṣaṃ caturjyotiṣaṃ ekaśakraṃ
dviśakraṃ triśakram īdṛśam anyādṛśaṃ śāntaṃ prītaṃ prītasadṛśaṃ mitaṃ saṃmitam asitaṃ ṛtajitaṃ satyajitaṃ suṣeṇaṃ senajitam atimitram amitraṃ puruṣamitraṃ ṛtaṃ satyaṃ dhartāraṃ vidhartāraṃ varuṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ vidhārayam īdṛkṣam etādṛkṣam asitaṃ sitam | prītinaṃ prītisadṛkṣaṃ sakṣarasam atidhartāram ugraṃ dhuniṃ bhīmam abhiyuktam ṛkṣpādam | sahaṃ dyutiṃ vasum anādhṛṣyaṃ vāsaṃ kāmajayaṃ vijayaṃ jayam ity ekonapañcāśanmarutaḥ bhuvanaṃ bhāvanam ajanyaṃ sudhājanaṃ kratuṃ vasuṃ mūrdhānaṃ vājaṃ vyasruvaṃ prasravam āpyāyanam ṛkṣāmati dvādaśabhṛgūn | manuṃ mantāraṃ prāṇam apānaṃ citiṃ nayaṃ rūpaṃ haṃsaṃ naraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ vibhuṃ prabhum iti dvādaśasādhyān | savitāraṃ dhātāraṃ mitram aryamaṇaṃ pūṣaṇam aṃśuṃ tvaṣṭāraṃ vivasvantam indraṃ viṣṇuṃ varuṇaṃ bhagam iti dvādaśādityān | aṅgārakaṃ sūryaṃ nirṛtiṃ sakham ajaikapādam ahirbudhnaṃ dhūmaketuṃ bahaṃ mṛtyuṃ kapālinaṃ haram ity ekādaśa rudrān | ātmānaṃ apaṃ samaṃ ṛkṣaṃ vṛmaṃ prāṇaṃ haviśmantaṃ gariṣṭhaṃ ṛtaṃ satyam iti dvādaśāṅgirasaḥ | kratuṃ dakṣaṃ vasuṃ satyaṃ kāmaṃ dhuriṃ kālaṃ rācanaṃ purūravasam ārdravasam iti daśaviśvān | devān dharaṃ dhruvaṃ somaṃ āpaṃ analaṃ anilaṃ pratyūṣaṃ prabhāmaṃ ity aṣṭau vasūn | nāsatyaṃ dasram ity aśvinau | etān navadevagaṇān sānucarān svayaṃbhuvaṃ sāvitrīṃ sarvān devān satīṃ devīṃ lakṣmīṃ carīṃ (?) aniruddhaṃ pradyumnaṃ saṅkarṣaṇaṃ vāsudevaṃ bhūrlokaṃ bhuvarlokaṃ svarlokaṃ maharlokaṃ janalokaṃ tapolokaṃ satyalokaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ pṛthivīṃ apaḥ vahnim | vāyum ākāśaṃ manaḥ buddhiṃ āsanaṃ avyaktaṃ puruṣaṃ tarpayāmīti ante śabdaḥ prayuktaḥ | atyṛcaṃ puruṣasūktenāñjalīn dadyāt puṣpāṇi ca bhaktyā | atha kṛtāpasavyo dakṣiṇābhimukhaḥ [957] antajānuḥ pitryeṇa tīrthena pitṝṇaṃ yathāśraddhaṃ yathāprakāśam udakaṃ dadyāt |
iti śaṅkhoktatarpaṇam |
athācamanam ucyate |
sakalakarmaṇām ācamanapūrvakatvāt karmaṇi vyāpriyamāṇānām api kṣutādinimittopanipāte cācamanasyāvaśyakāryatvād asti śrāddhakartṝṇām ācamanavidhijñānāpekṣeti | tatra karmaṇām ācamanapūrvakatvam āha mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |
samyag ācamya toyena kriyāḥ kurvīta vai śuciḥ |
devatānām ṛṣīṇāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ caiva yatnataḥ ||
akṛtācamanasya kriyākaraṇe doṣa ukto brahmapurāṇe |
yaḥ kriyāṃ kurute mohād anācamyaiva nāstikaḥ |
bhavanti hi vṛthā tasya kriyāḥ sarvā na saṃśayaḥ ||
tatrācamananimittāni manuḥ |
kṛtvā mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca khāny ācānta upaspṛśet |
vedam adhyeṣyamāṇaś cāpy annam aśnaṃś ca sarvadā ||
anekārthatvāt karoteḥ ‘kṛtvā’ utsṛjyeti pratīyate| utsṛjya mūtraṃ purauṣaṃ ca pāyūpasthaṃ kṣālayitvā yathoktavidhinācānta ‘khāni' indriyāṇi, upaspṛśet | vedam adhyeṣyamāṇa iti laukikāni kriyāntarāṇi kṛtvānācānto vedākṣarāṇi noccārayet | 'annam aśnan' annaṃ bhokṣyamāṇaḥ |
manu-aṅgiro-bṛhaspatayaḥ |
suptvā kṣutvā ca bhuktvā ca niṣṭhīvyoktvānṛtāni ca |
[958] pītvāpo ’dhyeṣyamāṇaś cāpy ācāmet prayato ’pi san ||
'suptvā' śayitvā, kṣutvā' kṣutaṃ kṛtvā, 'bhuktvā' bhojanaṃ kṛtvā, 'niṣṭhīvya' mukhena śleśmāṇam utsṛjya, 'anṛtaṃ' asatyaṃ, 'apaḥ pītvā' jalaṃ nipīya, prayata ity adhyeṣyamāṇapadenaiva saṃbadhyate | prayato 'py adhyeṣyamāṇa ācamyādhīta adhyayanavidhyaṅgatayā ācamaṇaṃ kuryād ity arthaḥ |
viṣṇuḥ |
kṣutvā suptvā bhuktvā bhojanādhyayanepsuḥ pītvā snātvā niṣṭhīvya vāso viparidhāya rathyām ākramya kṛtamūtrapurīṣaḥ pañcanakhāsthyasnehaṃ spṛṣṭvācāmet cāṇḍālamlecchasaṃbhāṣaṇe ca |
śaṅkhaḥ |
kṛtvā mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca snātvā bhokumanās tathā |
bhuktvā kṣutvā tathā suptvā pītvā cāmbho 'vagāhya ca |
rathyām ākramya cācāmed vāso viparidhāya ca ||
āpastambaḥ |
mūtraṃ kṛtvā purīṣaṃ vā mūtrapurīṣānnaśeṣalepān retasaś ca ye lepās tān prakṣālya pādau cācamya prayato bhavati |
ācamanavidhyanantaraṃ devalaḥ |
retomūtraśakṛnmokṣe bhojane ’dhvapariśrame |
śaucam evaṃvidhaṃ proktam īṣac cānyac ca vartate ||
viśeṣaśaucaṃ vakṣyāmi bhojanakṣurakarmaṇoḥ |
sāmānyena hi nirdiṣṭaḥ sarvatrācamanakramaḥ ||
ucchiṣṭaṃ mānavaṃ spṛṣṭvā bhojyaṃ cāpi tathāvidham |
[959] tathaivaṃ hastau pādau ca prakṣyālyācamya śudhyati ||
tathā |
yad ambhaḥ śaucasaṃyuktaṃ kṣitiṃ prāpya vinaśyati |
prakṣālyāśuciliptaṃ ca tat spṛṣṭvācamya śudhyati ||
ācamane vakṣyamāṇe hārītaḥ |
rathyām ākramya suṣupsuḥ kṛtamūtrapurīṣo bhakṣitvā |
'suṣupsuḥ' nidrāṃ kariṣyan |
bṛhaspatiḥ |
adhovāyusamutsarge ākrande krodhasaṃbhave |
mārjāramūṣakasparśe prahāse ’nṛtabhāṣaṇe |
nimitteṣv eṣu dharmārthaṃ karma kurvan upaspṛśet ||
'upasparśanaṃ' ācamanam |
kūrmapurāṇe |
caṇḍālamlecchasaṃbhāṣe strīśūdrocchiṣṭabhāṣaṇe |
ucchiṣṭaṃ puruṣaṃ spṛṣṭvā bhojyaṃ cāpi tathāvidham |
ācāmed aśrūpāte ca lohitasya tathaiva ca ||
agner gavām athālambhe spṛṣṭvāprayatam eva vā |
strīṇām athātmanaḥ sparśe nīvīṃ vā paridhāya ca ||
nīvīśabdenātrādhovāso lakṣyate sāhacaryāt | adhovāso granthanaṃ hi nīvī |
āpastambaḥ |
svapne kṣavathau siṅghāṇikāśrvālambhe lohitasya keśānām agner gavāṃ [960] brāhmaṇasya striyāś cālambhe mahāpathaṃ gatvāmedhyaṃ copaspṛśyāprayataṃ ca manuṣyaṃ nīvīṃ ca paridhāya upaspṛśed ārdraṃ vā śakṛdoṣadhīr bhūmiṃ vā |
'kṣavathuḥ' kṣutam | 'siṅghāṇikā' nāsikāmalaḥ | 'aśru' netrajalam | ārdram iti śakṛdādibhiḥ sarvaiḥ saṃbadhyate | 'śakṛt' gomayam |
baudhāyanaḥ |
nīvīṃ visasya paridhāyācamet upaspṛśed ārdratṛṇaṃ bhūmiṃ gomayaṃ
vā saṃspṛśet |
ārdratṛṇādisparśanaṃ tu kathaṃcid apyācamanāsaṃbhave veditavyam, anyathā viṣamaśiṣṭavikalpāpatteḥ | evaṃ ca saty ācamane na sahaṃ vikalpamānatayā dakṣiṇaśravaṇasparśanam |
yad uktaṃ yamapurāṇe |
caṇḍālādīn jape home dṛṣṭvācāmed dvijottamaḥ |
śvādīn dṛṣṭvā tathaivāpi karṇaṃ vā dakṣiṇaṃ spṛśet ||
japahomādikriyāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāṃ caṇḍālādiśvādidarśane vācamanaṃ kuryād dakṣiṇakarṇaṃ vā spṛśed iti |
yad api vasiṣṭhena,
kṣute niṣṭhīvane supte paridhāne ’śrupātane |
pañcasv eteṣu vācāmec chrotraṃ vā dakṣiṇaṃ spṛśet ||
iti, yac ca sārthavādaṃ parāśareṇa |
kṣute niṣṭhīvite caiva dantaśliṣṭe tathānṛte |
patitānāṃ ca sambhāṣe dakṣiṇaṃ śravaṇaṃ spṛśet ||
[961] prabhāsādīni tīrthāni gaṅgādyāḥ saritas tathā |
viprasya dakṣiṇe karṇe santīti manur abravīt ||
ādityo varuṇaḥ somo vahnir vāyus tathaiva ca
viprasya dakṣiṇe karṇe nityaṃ tiṣṭhanti devatāḥ ||
iti, tad etad ācamanāsaṃbhavavihitārdratṛṇādisparśasyāpy asaṃbhave sati veditavyam |
tad uktaṃ mārkeṇḍeyapurāṇe |
kṣutādau samyag ācāmet spṛśed ārdratṛṇādikam |
kurvītālambhanaṃ vāpi dakṣiṇaśravaṇasya vai ||
yathāvibhavato hy etat pūrvālābhe tataḥ param |
na vidyamāne pūrvatra uttaraprāptir iṣyate || iti |
aprāyatyakāraṇe samutpanne jhaṭiti yathāsaṃbhavaṃ śuddhyai prayatanīyam ity āha baudhāyanaḥ |
śaktiviṣaye muharttam api nāprayataḥ syāt ||iti |
āpastambo ’pi |
riktapāṇiḥ payase udyamyāpa upaspṛśec chakriviṣaye muhartam apy aprayato na syāt | nagno vā nāpsu sataḥ prayamaṇaṃ vidyata uttīrya tv ācāmet |
'riktapāṇiḥ' jalapātraśūnyahastaḥ | 'payase udyamya' jalārtham udyamaṃ kṛtvā | jalasthitas tu prāpte 'py ācamanakāraṇe jalād uttīryācāmet | atra hetum āha 'apsu sataḥ' jale vartamānasyācamato ’pi, 'prathamaṇaṃ' prayatatā śuddhiḥ, na vidyata iti |
jalam ity anuvṛttau hārītaḥ |
[962] nottared anupaspṛśya |
yamaḥ |
uttīryodakam ācamya avatīrya upaspṛśet |
evaṃ syāc chreyasā yukto varuṇaś caiva pūjitaḥ ||
pūrvam ācamyodakaṃ 'avatīrya' praviśya, tadanantaraṃ 'uttīrya' jalān nirgatyāpi, acāmet ||
dakṣaḥ |
snānād anantaraṃ tāvad upasparśanam iṣyate |
prajāpatiḥ |
upakrame viśiṣṭasya karmaṇaḥ prayato ’pi san |
ācāmed iti śeṣaḥ |
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
devārcanādikāryāṇi tathā gurvabhivādanam |
kurvīta samyag ācamya tadvad eva bhujikriyām ||
kamaṇḍalvadhikāre vasiṣṭhaḥ |
kṛtvā vāvaśyakāryāṇi ācāmec chaucavittamaḥ |
'avaśyakāryāṇi' nityāni karmaṇi |
hārītaḥ |
devatām abhigantukāma ācāmet |
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
sandeheṣu ca sarveṣu śikhāmokṣe tathaiva ca |
vinā yajñopavītena nityam evam upaspṛśet ||
[963] śātātapaḥ |
acāmec carvaṇe nityaṃ muktvā tāmbūlacarvaṇam |
oṣṭhau vilomakau spṛṣṭvā vāso viparidhāya ca ||
āpastambaḥ |
śyāvāntaparyantāv oṣṭhāv upaspṛśet |
'śyāvāntaparyantau' iti dantamūlād ārabhya śmaśrusamīpavartiśyāmalekhāvadhi ity arthaḥ |
mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |
ucchiṣṭena tu saṃspṛṣṭo dravyahasto nidhāya ca |
ācamya dravyam abhyukṣya punar ādātum arhati ||
ucchiṣṭaśabdenātrācamanārheṇāprāyatyena yuktaḥ puruṣa ucyate | bhuktāvaśiṣṭam atra vā dravyamātrābhyavahāryam |
tathā ca vasiṣṭhaḥ |
pracarann abhyavahāryeṣūcchiṣṭaṃ yadi saṃspṛśet |
bhūmau nikṣipya tad dravyam ācamya pracaret punaḥ ||
‘pracaram' pariveṣaṇaṃ kurvan | 'abhyavahāryeṣu' annapāneṣu, hastagṛhīteṣv iti śeṣaḥ |
bṛhaspatir api |
pracarann annapāneṣu yadocchiṣṭam upaspṛśet |
bhūmau nidhāya tad dravyam ācāntaḥ pracaret punaḥ ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
taijasaṃ vai samādāya yady ucchiṣṭo bhaved dvijaḥ |
[964] bhūmau nikṣipya tad dravyam ācāntaḥ pracaret punaḥ ||
baudhāyanaḥ |
taijasaṃ ced ādāyocchiṣṭī syāt tad udasyācamyādāsyann adbhiḥ prokṣet | sa cet tadanyenocchiṣṭī syāt tad udasyācamyādāsyann adbhiḥ prokṣet| sa ced adbhir ucchiṣṭī syāt tadudasyācāmyādāsyann adbhiḥ prokṣet |
'udasya' nidhāya, 'tadanyat' tasmāt taijasād anyad abhyavahāryaṃ, tena hastasthena satety arthaḥ |
yat tu manunoka,
ucchiṣṭena tu saṃspṛṣṭo dravyahastaḥ kathaṃcana |
anidhāyaiva tad dravyam ācāntaḥ śucitām iyāt ||
iti, tatra medhātithinoktā vyavasthā “garīyo dravyaṃ nidhīyate anyad anidhāyaivācamyata” iti | “anabhyavahāryasya vastrāder anidhānam itaratra nidhānavidhānād” iti smṛticandrikākāraḥ | atha vā amantrākhyasya dravyasyānidhānaṃ abhyavahāryataijasayor nidhānaṃ tadvyatirikteṣu vastrādiṣu vikalpaḥ |
tad uktaṃ kūrmapurāṇe |
yadyamantraṃ samādāya bhaved uccheṣaṇānvitaḥ |
anidhāyaiva tad dravyam ācāntaḥ śucitām iyāt |
vastrādiṣu vikalpaḥ syāt tatspṛṣṭāv evam eva hi ||
'tatspṛṣṭau' uccheṣaṇaspṛṣṭau, nidhānam anidhānaṃ vā kāryyam ity arthaḥ | nidhānaṃ prakṛtya baudhāyanaḥ |
etad eva viparītam amantre vānaspatye vikalpaḥ |

gautamaḥ |
nāñjalinā piben na tiṣṭhan nānuddhṛtenodakenācāmet |
na paśuvan mukhena pibed ity arthaḥ |
ācāmed ity anuvṛttau vasiṣṭhaḥ |
na varṇarasaduṣṭābhir yāś ca syur aśubhāgamāḥ |
hārītaḥ |
vivarṇaṃ gandhavat toyaṃ phenilaṃ ca vivarjayet |
śaṅkhaḥ |
vinā yajñopavītena tathā muktaśikho dvijaḥ |
aprakṣālitapādas tu ācānto ’py aśucir bhavet ||
bahirjānur upaspṛśya ekahastārpitair jalaiḥ |
sopānatkas tathā tiṣṭhan naiva śuddhim avāpnuyāt ||
[979] ācāmed ity anuvṛttau devalaḥ |
na gacchan na śayānaś ca na skhalan na parān spṛśan |
na hasan naiva vā jalpan nātmānaṃ cāpi vīkṣayan ||
keśān nīvīm adhaḥkāyaṃ na spṛśan dharaṇīm api |
yadi spṛśati caitāni bhūyaḥ prakṣālayet karam || |
'skhalan' pracalan |
tathā |
sopānatko jalastho vā muktakeśo ’pi vā punaḥ |
uṣṇīṣī vāpi nācāmed vastreṇāveṣṭya vā śiraḥ ||
śmaśrudeśe ’pi veṣṭanavān 'uṣṇīṣī’|
vyāsaḥ |
śiraḥ prāvṛtya kaṇṭhaṃ vā muktakacchaśikho ’pi vā |
akṛtvā pādayoḥ śaucam ācānto ’py aśucir bhavet ||
apaḥ pāṇinakhāgreṣu ācāmed yas tu brāhmaṇaḥ |
surāpānena tat tulyam ity evam ṛṣir abravīt ||
viṣṇuḥ |
na gacchan na śayānaś ca na sthitaḥ prahva eva ca |
na spṛśan na hasan jalpan na śvacāṇḍāladarśane ||
‘sthitaḥ' urddhībhūtaḥ (?), 'na spṛśan' anyam iti śeṣaḥ |
gobhilaḥ |
nāntarīyaikadeśasya kṛtvā caivottarīyatām |
ācāmed iti śeṣaḥ | 'antarīyaṃ' adhovāsaḥ, yasyādhovastraikadeśasya [980] prathamaparidhānasamaye mantrapūrvam uttarīyatā na kalpitā tadviṣayam etat | dvitīyavastrābhāve hi paridhānavastrottarārddhasyaivottarīyatvaṃ kriyate | “ekaṃ ced vāso bhavati tasyaivottaravargeṇa pracchādayati” iti samantrakottarīyagrahaṇavidher anantaraṃ pāraskarasmaraṇāt |
saṃvartaḥ |
śūdrāśucyekahastaiś ca dattābhir na kadācana |
ārūḍhapādukaś cāpi na śuddhyeta (?) dvijottamaḥ ||
marīciḥ |
na bahirjānus tvarayā nāsanastho na cotthitaḥ |
na pādukāstho nācittaḥ śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ |
bhukvāsanastho ’thācāmen nānyakāle kadācana ||
bhṛguḥ |
vinā yajñopavītena tathā dhautena vāsasā |
muktvā śikhāṃ vācāntasya kṛtasyaiva punaḥ kriyā ||
soṣṇīṣo baddhaparyaṅkaḥ prauḍhapādaś ca yānagaḥ |
durdeśe prapadasthaś ca nācāman śuddhim āpnuyāt ||
'baddhaparyaṅkaḥ' vastrādinā veṣṭitajaghanabhāgaḥ |
prauḍhapādalakṣaṇam āha gobhilaḥ |
āsane rūḍhapādo vā jānvor vā jaṅghayos tathā |
kṛtāvasaktiko yaś ca prauḍhapādaḥ sa ucyate ||
yogapaṭṭākṛtinā (?) vastreṇa veṣṭitapṛṣṭhajānudvayam avasthānam 'avasaktikā' 'prapadaṃ' pādāgram |
[981] brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
kaṣṭhaṃ śiro vā prāvṛtya rathyāpaṇagato ’pi vā |
akṛtvā pādayoḥ śaucam ācānto 'py aśucir bhavet ||
'āpaṇaḥ' krayavikrayabhūḥ |
kauśikaḥ |
apavitrakaraḥ kaś cit brāhmaṇo ya upaspṛśet |
apūtaṃ tasya tat sarvaṃ bhavaty ācamanaṃ tathā ||
viṣṇuḥ |
jānvor ūrdhvaṃ jale tiṣṭhan nācāntaḥ śucitām iyāt |
adhastāc chatakṛtvo 'pi samācānto na śudhyati ||
jānvor adhastād ācamananiṣedhāj jānumātre 'py aviruddham ācamanam iti jñāyate |
tad āha jātūkarṇyaḥ |
jānumātre jale tiṣṭhan nāsīnaḥ prāṅmukhaḥ sthale |
sarvataḥ śucir ācāntas tayos tu yugapat sthitaḥ ||
'tayoḥ' jalasthalayor ity arthaḥ |
ata eva hārītaḥ |
jalastho vā sthalastho vā dayor vā samataḥ sthitaḥ |
jalastho jalakṛtyeṣu sthalasthaḥ sthalakarmasu |
ubhayos tūbhayasthas tu karmasv adhikṛto bhavet ||
yadi jalasthita ācamati tadā jalakṛtya evādhikṛto bhavati | yadā tu sthalasthaḥ tadā sthalakṛtya eva, yadi punar ubhayasthaḥ tadobhayor api kriyamāṇeṣu karmasv adhikṛto bhavati |
[982] dakṣo ’pi |
snātvācāmed yadā vipraḥ pādau kṛtvā jale sthale |
ubhayor apy asau śuddhaḥ tataḥ kāryakṣamo bhavet ||
yamaḥ |
apaḥ karanakhaspṛṣṭā ya ācāmati vai dvijaḥ |
surāṃ pibati suvyaktaṃ yamasya vacanaṃ tathā ||
uddhṛtya vāmahastena yat pibet brāhmaṇo jalam |
surāpālena tat tulyaṃ manuḥ svāyambhūvo ’bravīt ||
atra viśeṣaḥ kūrmapurāṇe darśitaḥ |
na vāmahastenoddhṛtya pibet vaktreṇa vai jalam |
'vaktreṇa' śuddheneti śeṣaḥ |
śāṭyāyaniḥ |
alābutāmrapātrasya karakasthaṃ ca yat payaḥ |
gṛhītvā svayam ācāman na tenāprayato bhavet ||
chāgaleyaḥ |
karakālābukāṣṭhena tāmracarmapuṭena ca |
svahastācamanaṃ kāryaṃ snehālāpāṃś ca varjayet ||
karapatre ca yat toyaṃ yat toyaṃ tāmrabhājane |
sauvarṇe rājate caiva naivāśudyet tu karhicit ||
ity ācamananiṣedhaḥ |
athācamanodakāni |
[983]
tatra manuḥ |
anuṣṇābhir aphenābhir aduṣṭābhiś ca dharmataḥ |
śaucepsuḥ sarvadācāmed āsīnaḥ prāgudaṅmukhaḥ ||
anuṣṇābhir ity atrāgnisaṃyogajam auṣṇyaṃ pratiṣiddhyate,
anagnyuṣṇābhir aphenilābhir śūdraikakarāvarjitābhir akṣārābhir
adbhir ācāmet |
iti viṣṇusmaraṇāt | 'aduṣṭābhiḥ' amedhyasaṃsargādidoṣarahitābhiḥ |
samupaspṛśed ity anuvṛttau yājñavalkyaḥ |
adbhistu prakṛtisthābhir hīnābhiḥ phenabuhudaiḥ |
'prakṛtisthābhiḥ' avikṛtagandhavarṇarasābhiḥ |
śaṅkhaḥ |
adbhiḥ samuddhṛtābhis tu hīnābhiḥ phenabuhudaiḥ |
vahninā ca na taptābhir akṣārābhir upaspṛśet ||
uddhṛtagrahaṇaṃ jalāśayasthānām apāṃ mukhena grahaṇaṃ nirākartum |
gautamaḥ |
uddhṛtodakenācāmet |
ācāmed ity anuvṛttau śaṅkhalikhitau |
uddhṛtaparipūtābhir adbhir avekṣitābhir akṣārābhir anadhiśritābhir aphenābhir abuddudābhiḥ | -
'paripūtābhiḥ' vastraparisrutābhiḥ | 'anadhiśritābhiḥ avahnitaptābhiḥ |
āpastambaḥ |
bhūmigatāsv apasv ācamya prayato bhavati yaṃ vā prayata ācāmayati |
pradarodakena nācāmed ity uktaṃ tac ca viśeṣam āha vasiṣṭhaḥ |
pradarād api yā gos tarpaṇāḥ syuḥ tābhiḥ |
ācāmed iti śeṣaḥ |
ācāmed ity anuvṛttau paiṭhīnasiḥ |
aśṛtābhir aphenābhir abududābhiḥ |
'aśṛtābhiḥ' apakvābhiḥ | etac cānāturaviṣayam |
ata eva yamaḥ |
rātrāv anīkṣitenaiva śuddhir uktā manīṣiṇām |
udakenāturāṇāṃ ca tathoṣṇenoṣṇapāyinām ||
'uṣṇapāyināṃ’ āturāṇāṃ, na punar āturamātrāṇām ity arthaḥ |
yatra punar uktalakṣaṇā āpo na labhyante tatra katham ity apekṣite devalaḥ |
yeṣu deśeṣu ye devā yeṣu deśeṣu ye dvijāḥ |
yeṣu deśeṣu yat toyaṃ yā ca yatraiva mṛttikā ||
yeṣu sthāneṣu yac chaucaṃ dharmācāraś ca yādṛśaḥ |
tatra tān nāvamanyeta dharmas tatraiva tādṛśaḥ ||
etac codakaṃ yāvad vāmena na spṛśati tāvan nācāmed ity āha yamaḥ |
tāvan nopaspṛśed vidvān yāvad vāmena na spṛśet |
vāme hi dvādaśādityā varuṇaś ca jaleśvaraḥ ||
ity ācamanodakāni |
athācamanodakaparimāṇam |
[985]
tatra manuḥ |
hṛdgābhiḥ pūyate vipraḥ kaṇṭhagābhis tu bhūmipaḥ |
vaiśyo 'dbhiḥ prāśitābhis tu śūdrāḥ spṛṣṭābhir antataḥ ||
hṛdayaṃ gacchanti prāpnuvantīti 'hṛdgāḥ', 'pūyate' pavitratāṃ prāpnoti | 'kaṇṭhagābhiḥ' kaṇṭhamātrasparśinībhiḥ, 'bhūmipaḥ' kṣatriyaḥ | 'prāśitābhiḥ' mukhāntaḥpraveśitābhir api kaṇṭham aprāptābhiḥ, vaiśyaḥ | antata iti tṛtīyārthe tasiḥ | samīpavacanaś cāntaśabdaḥ | sa ca saṃbandhyāntaram apekṣate | tataś ca yatra sthāne vaiśyasyācamanaṃ vihitaṃ tatsamīpavarttinā sthānena spṛṣṭābhir adbhiḥ śūdraḥ pūyate | vaiśyasya ca sthānaṃ jihvā tatsamīpavartisthānaṃ dantā eva | atra yady api dantanihitasyodakasya dravatvāj jihvāsparśo ’parihāryaḥ | tathāpi pūrvaparimāṇāt kiṃcin yūnatājñāpanārtham idam |
śaṅkhalikhitau |
hṛdayaṃgābhir adbhir brāhmaṇaḥ śuciḥ | gaṇṭhagābhiḥ kṣatriyaḥ | tālavyābhir vaiśyaḥ | strī śūdraḥ sparśāntikābhiḥ |
vasiṣṭhaḥ |
hṛdaṃgamābhir abudbudābhir aphenābhir brāhmaṇaḥ | kaṇṭhagābhis tu kṣatriyaḥ śuciḥ | vaiśyo ’dbhiḥ prāśitābhiḥ | strī śūdraḥ spṛṣṭābhir eva tu |
śaṅkhaḥ |
vipraḥ śudhyati hṛdgābhiḥ kaṇṭhagābhis tu bhūmipaḥ |
tālugābhis tathā vaiśyaḥ śūdraḥ spṛṣṭābhir antataḥ ||
devalaḥ |
[986] apsu pītāsu hṛdayaṃ prāptāsu brāhmaṇaḥ śuciḥ |
rājanyaḥ kaṇṭham āsyaṃ vai viṭśūdraḥ sparśanāc chuciḥ ||
paiṭhīnasiḥ |
hṛdayaṃgamābhir adbhir brāhmaṇaḥ | rājanyaḥ kaṇṭhagābhiḥ | āsyaṃ prāptābhir vaiśyaḥ | strī śūdraḥ spṛṣṭābhiḥ |
baudhāyanaḥ |
athāpy udāharanti |
gatābhir hṛdayaṃ vipraḥ kaṇṭhyābhiḥ kṣatriyaḥ śuciḥ |
vaiśyas tv adbhiḥ prāśitābhiḥ strīśūdrau sparśato ’ntataḥ ||
yājñavalkya-viṣṇū |
hṛtkaṇṭhatālugābhis tu yathāsaṃkhyaṃ dvijātayaḥ |
śudhyeyuḥ strī ca śūdraś ca sakṛt spṛṣṭābhir antataḥ ||
hārītaḥ |
gatābhir hṛdayaṃ vipraḥ kaṇṭhyābhiḥ kṣatriyaḥ śuciḥ |
vaiśyo ’ntaḥprāśitābhiḥ syāt strīśūdrau sparśanād api ||
śālaṅkāyanaḥ |
apsu prāptāsu hṛdayaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ śuddhim āpnuyāt |
kaṇṭhaṃ rājā ca nābhau ca vaiśyaḥ śūdrastriyo ’ntataḥ ||
śudrādhikāre gautamaḥ |
ācamanārthe pāṇipādaprakṣālanam evaike |
hṛdayaṃgamādīnām api parimāṇam āhośanāḥ |
māṣamajjanamātrā hṛdayaṃgamā bhavanti |
[987]
tadekaikapādahānyā kaṇṭhatāludantagās tābhis traivarṇikāḥ | strīśūdrāś cācāmerann iti |
bharadvājo ’pi |
māṣamajjanamātrās tu saṃgṛhya triḥ pibed apaḥ || iti |
hṛdayaṃgamānāṃ parimāṇajñāne prakārāntaram āha kaṇvaḥ |
saṃhatāṅgulinā toyaṃ gṛhītvā pāṇinā dvijaḥ |
muktvāṅguṣṭhakaniṣṭhe tu śeṣeṇācamanaṃ caret || iti |
ity ācamaṇodakaparimāṇam |
śathācamane diṅnayamaḥ |
tatra vṛddhaparāśaraḥ |
kṛtvātha śaucaṃ prakṣālya pādau hastau ca mṛjjalaiḥ |
nibaddhaśikhakacchas tu prāgudaṅmukha ācamet ||
pādaprakṣālanam ā jaṅghāmūlāt, hastaprakṣālanam ā maṇibandhāt kartavyam, "ā maṇibandhāt pāṇī prakṣālya ā jaṅghābhyāṃ pādau” iti hārītasmaraṇāt,
ity evam adbhir ājānu prakṣālya caraṇau pṛthak |
hastau cāmaṇibandhābhyāṃ pañcād āsīta saṃyataḥ ||
iti devalasmaraṇāc ca | 'śikhā' cūḍā | paridhānavastraguhyasaṃsakro ’ñcalaḥ 'kacchaḥ' | tasya nibandhanaṃ kaṭideśe nigūhanam | 'prāgudaṅmukha' iti mukhaśabdaḥ pratyekam abhisaṃbadhyate | ataḥ prāṅmukha udaṅmukho vācāmed iti | vigrahaś caivam | prāgudaṅmukham asyeti | na caiṣa dvandvagarbho bahuvrīhir iti vācyam | dvandvagarbhatāyāṃ samāhāre tāvat samāsāntenākāreṇa bhavitavyam | itaretarayogo 'pi tathaiva | na hi yugapat prāgudaṅmukhatā saṃbhavati | tatra kaścid ācamanabhāgaḥ prāṅmukhena [988] kartavyaḥ | kaścid udaṅmukhenety āpatati | na caikadeśa ācamanaṃ, na ca digartha upādeyaḥ, yena parasparāpekṣe diśau saṃbadhyeyātām | nāpi dakṣiṇapūrvādivat prāgudakśabdo ’parājitāyā diśo vācakatvena prasiddhaḥ, yena diksamāsabahuvrīhipūrvako bahuvrīhir vijñāyeta | tasmān nāyaṃ vṛttyantaragarbho bahuvrīhiḥ | ato ’tra prācyudīcyor vikalpaḥ | yathā bṛhadrathantaraṃ sāma paṭhatīty atra keṣucid ahaḥsu bṛhat keṣucid rathantaraṃ na tv ekaikasminn ahani samastobhayasāmatvam iti |
tathā ca yājñavalkyaḥ |
antarjanu śucau deśe upaviṣṭa udaṅmukhaḥ |
prāg vā brāhmeṇa tīrthena dvijo nityam upaspṛśet ||
'antarjānu' jānunor madhye hastau kṛtvā, 'śucau' aśucidravyāsaṃspṛṣṭe, 'deśe' bhuvi nopānacchayanāsanādau | 'upaviṣṭaḥ' āsīnaḥ, na sthitaḥ, śayānaḥ, prahvo gacchan vā | 'prāk' prāṅmukhaḥ | dvijagrahaṇāt strīśūdrayor naite niyamā iti vijñāyate | 'nityaṃ' sarvakālaṃ, āśramāntarastho ’pi |
śaṅkhaḥ |
antarjānu śucau deśe upaviśyendradiṅmukhaḥ |
udaṅmukho vā prayato diśaś cānavalokayan |
gautama-baudhāyanau |
prāṅmukha udaṅmukho vā śaucam ārabhet |
vasiṣṭhaḥ |
prāg vodag vāsīna ācāmet |
hārītaḥ | [989]
pāṇipādau prakṣālyotkramya ca nīviṃ prāṅmukha udaṅmukho
vopaviśyāpaḥ pibet |
viṣṇuḥ |
śucau deśe svāmīno ’ntajānuḥ prāṅmukha udaṅmukho vā
tanmanāḥ sumanāś cācāmet |
śaṅkhalikhitau |
prāṅmukha udaṅmukho vā śucau deśa upaviṣṭo ’ntarjānur upaspṛśet |
īśānyabhimukhatvam apy āha hārītaḥ |
īśānyabhimukho bhūtvāpaḥ spṛśet tu yathāvidhi |
atra manuṣyadevapitṛkāryeṣu digvyavasthām āha paiṭhīnasiḥ |
atha prathamakalpaḥ | prāṅmukha udaṅmukho vopaviśyāntarūrvor hastau kṛtvā śuddhā āpaḥ saṃgṛhya āmaṇibandhanāt pāṇī prakṣālyābhimukhaṃ brahmadvāraṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ prācīnaṃ caiva devānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ dakṣiṇaṃ smṛtam |
'abhimukhaṃ brahmadvāraṃ' dhruvamaṇḍalākhyam,
maṇḍalasyāsya pucchaṃ tu śiśumārākṛter bhuvaḥ |
madhye nārayaṇaś ceti brahmadvāram idaṃ jagu ||
iti gāruḍapurāṇe 'bhidhānāt | dhruvamaṇḍale na cottarā dik lakṣyate | ataś codīcīprācīdakṣiṇā manuṣyadevapitṝṇāṃ diśaḥ | manuṣyādikarmasu tattaddigabhimukhenācāntavyam ity arthaḥ |
devalo ’pi |
prathamaṃ prāṅmukhaḥ sthitvā pādau prakṣālayec chanaiḥ |
udaṅmukho vā devatye paitṛke dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ||
śikhām baddhvā vasitvā ca nirṇikte vāsasī śubhe |
[990] tṛṣṇīṃ bhūtvāpa ācāmed akupyan na vilokayan || iti |
ity ācamane diṅniyamaḥ |
athācamane tīrthaniyamaḥ |
tatra vyāsaḥ |
bāhū jānvantarā kṛtvā tīrthena śucir ācamet |
tāraṇāya pāpapramocanāya tiṣṭhatīti tīrthaśabdena kaścit pāvanatamo deśa ucyate | taraty anena tīrtham iti kvacij jalāvataraṇamārgaḥ | iha tūdakādhāre karatalaikadeśe stutyarthaṃ tīrthaśabda-prayogaḥ | ataḥ karaviśeṣatalaikadeśenācāmed ity arthaḥ | pātrādinirākaraṇārtham etat |
atra viśeṣam āha devalaḥ |
athāpaḥ prathamāt tīrthād dakṣiṇāt triḥ pibet samam |
aśabdam anavasrāvam abahirjānv abudbudam ||
'prathamāt tīrthāt ' brahmatīrthāt | 'dakṣiṇāt' dakṣiṇahastasthitāt | 'triḥ' vāratrayaṃ | 'samaṃ' tulyakālaṃ, avyavadhānenety arthaḥ |
śaṅkhalikhitau |
brahmatīrthenācāmet |
viṣṇuḥ |
brāhmeṇa tīrthena triḥ pītvā dviḥ parimṛjyāt |
brāhmeṇeti stutyarthaṃ brahmā devatāsyeti | na hi tīrthasya devatā saṃbhavati | ahaviḥsūktarūpatvāt | tadrūpatān tu kenacid dharmeṇa śuddhihetutvādinādhyāropya devatā taddhitaḥ | parimṛjyān mukham it iśeṣaḥ |
baudhāyanaḥ |
[991] śucau deśa āsīno dakṣiṇaṃ bāhuṃ jānvantarā kṛtvā prakṣālya pādau pāṇī cāmaṇibandhanāt brāhmeṇa tīrthenācāmet |
brāhmatīrthaṃ lakṣayann āha paiṭhīnasiḥ |
aṅguṣṭhamūlasyottarato rekhā brāhmaṃ tīrthaṃ trir ācāmet |
vasiṣṭhaḥ |
prakṣālya pādau pāṇī cāmaṇibandhanād aṅguṣṭhamūlasyottarato rekhā brāhmaṃ tīrthaṃ, tena trir ācāmed aśabdavat |
prājāpatyatīrthenāpy ācamanam āha śaṅkhaḥ |
prājāpatyena tīrthena triḥ prāśnīyāj jalaṃ śuciḥ |
devatīrthasyāpy ācamanāṅgatvam āha manuḥ |
brāhmeṇa vipras tīrthena nityakālam upaspṛśet |
kāyatraidaśakābhyāṃ vā na pitryeṇa kadācana ||
vipragrahaṇaṃ kṣatriyāder apy upalakṣaṇārtham, “dvijo nityam upaspṛśet” iti smaraṇāt | nityakālaṃ śaucārthaṃ karmāṅgatvena vā | kaḥ prajāpatiḥ sa devatā asyeti 'kāyam' prajāpatyam | tridaśā devās te devā asyeti 'traidaśakam' daivam | tridaśaśabdād devatāṇi kṛte svārthikaḥ kapratyayaḥ | kadācaneti sphoṭapiṭakādinā brahmāditīrtheṣv ayogyatām āpanneṣv api 'pitryeṇa' pitṛtīrthena, na ācāmet |
ity ācamanatīrthe niyamaḥ |
athācamane gaṇḍūṣasaṅkhyā |
tatra viṣṇupurāṇe |
[992] niṣpāditāṅghriśaucas tu pādāv abhyukṣya vai punaḥ |
triḥ pibet salilaṃ tena tathā dviḥ parimārjayet ||
tena sodakena hastena dvirabhyāsena parimṛjyāt | parimārjanaṃ cātra oṣṭhaśliṣṭānām udakānām apanayanam |
yājñavalkyaḥ |
triḥ prāśyāpo dvir unmṛjya khāny adbhiḥ samupaspṛśet |
'khāni' indriyachidrāṇi | adbhir hastagṛhītābhiḥ |
manuḥ |
triḥ prāśayed apaḥ pūrvaṃ dvir unmṛjyāt tato mukham |
khāni caiva spṛśed adbhir ātmānaṃ śira eva ca ||
'mukham' oṣṭhadvayam | mukhaśabdasyātraikadeśavṛttitvāt | mukhyānām eva khānām eṣa sparśavidhiḥ mukhasya prakṛtatvāt | 'ātmānam' iti hṛdayaṃ nābhiṃ vā nirdiśati | upaniṣatsu "antarhṛdaya ātmānaṃ paśyet" iti kathyate | ato hṛdasyāyaṃ sparśaḥ | kṣetrajñasyātmano vibhor amūrttasya sparśāsaṃbhavāt | smaryate ca “nābhim ālabheteti" |
vyāsaḥ |
triḥ prāśayed apaḥ pūrvaṃ dviḥ pramsṛjyāt tato mukham |
pādāv abhyukṣya mūrddhānam abhyukṣet tadanantaram ||
atra viśeṣam āha dakṣaḥ |
anenaiva vidhānena ācāntaḥ śucitām iyāt |
prakṣālya pādau hastau ca triḥ pibed ambu vīkṣitam ||
anenaiveti vakṣyamāṇasyācamanavidheḥ parāmarśaḥ | uttarakālam eva [993] tasyābhidhānāt, 'vīkṣitam" iti divasābhiprāyam,
rātrāv anīkṣitenaiva śuddhir uktā manīṣiṇām |
iti yamasmaraṇāt |
viśeṣāntaram āha hārītaḥ |
antarūrvor aratnī kṛtvā trir apo hārdaṃ pibet |
'antaḥ' madhye, 'ūrvoḥ' jānunoḥ 'aratnī' hastau, kṛtvā trir apaḥ 'hārdaṃ' hṛdayasaṃbandhi yathā bhavati tathā phutkārādiśabdam antareṇaiva, pibet | ata eva baudhāyanaḥ |
śabdam akurvaṃs trir apo hṛdayaṃgamāḥ pibet |
etac codakapānam upaviṣṭenaiva kāryam |
tathā cāpastambaḥ |
āsīnas trir ācāmet hṛdayaṃgamābhir adbhiḥ | iti |
tritvena saha vaikalpikam |
saṃkhyāntaram āha pracetāḥ |
anuṣṇābhir aphenābhir aśūdrāhṛtābhir aśabdābhis triś catur vādbhir ācāmet |
gautamo 'pi |
śucau deśe āsīno dakṣiṇaṃ bāhuṃ jānvantarā kṛtvā yajñopavīty āmaṇibandhanāt pāṇī prakṣālya vāgyato hṛdayaspṛśas triś catur vāpa ācāmet pādau cābhyukṣyet |
'hṛdayaspṛśaḥ' hṛdayaṃgamāḥ |
etac ca saṃkhyādvayaṃ dvijātiviṣayam eva | strī ca śūdraś ca sakṛt spṛṣṭābhir iti yājñavalkyena strīśūdrayoḥ sakṛttvavidhānāt |
upasparśanaparimārjane prakṛtya baudhāyanenāpy uktam |
[994] sakṛd ubhayaṃ śūdrasya striyāś ceti |
uktaṃ ca vṛddhamanunā |
trir ācāmed apaḥ pūrvaṃ dviḥ pramṛjyāt tato mukham |
śārīraṃ śaucam anvicchan strīśūdraṃ tu sakṛt sakṛt ||
strīśūdram iti samāhāradvandaḥ |
ācamane hastasya saṃsthānaviśeṣa ukto bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
dakṣiṇaṃ tu karaṃ kṛtvā gokarṇākṛtivat punaḥ |
triḥ pibed dakṣiṇenāmbu dvir āsyaṃ parimārjayet ||
dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ gokarṇākṛtiṃ kṛtvā trir ambu pibet | dakṣiṇena hastena dvir āsyaṃ parimārjayed iti saṃbandhaḥ | punargrahanāt pūrvaṃ gokarṇākṛtinā hastenodakaṃ gṛhītvā tato ’ṅguṣṭhakaniṣṭhe bahiḥkṛtya punar api gokarṇākṛtihastaṃ kuryāditi gamyate | kathitaṃ cāṅguṣṭhakaniṣṭhābahiḥkaraṇaṃ parimāṇaprakaraṇe |
hastasya viśeṣāntaram apy āha mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |
sapavitreṇa hastena kuryād ācamanakriyām |
nocchiṣṭaṃ tat pavitraṃ tu bhuktocchiṣṭaṃ tu varjayet ||
hastenety ekavacanam avivakṣitaṃ hastadvaye ’pi pavitradhāraṇasya praśastatamatvāt |
tathā ca gobhilaḥ |
ubhayatra sthitair darbhaiḥ samācamati yo dvijaḥ |
somapānaphalaṃ tasya bhuktvā yajñaphalaṃ labhet ||
yat tūktaṃ vaśiṣṭhena |
[995] vāmahaste kuśān kṛtvā samācāmati yo dvijaḥ |
upaspṛṣṭaṃ bhavaty eva rudhireṇa malena ca || iti |
tat kevalavāmahastaviṣayam |
ity ācamane gaṇḍūṣasaṃkhyā |
atha dvādaśāṅgasparśanam |
tatra saṃvartaḥ |
parimṛjya dvir āsyaṃ tu dvādaśāṅgāni cālabhet |
mukhaṃ nāsikādvayaṃ netradvayaṃ śrotradvayaṃ nābhir hṛdayaṃ mūrdhā bāhudvayaṃ ceti dvādaśāṅgāṇi | parimārjanaṃ ca triḥprāśanānantaraṃ kāryam |
tathā ca śaṅkhalikhitau |
triḥ prāsya dvir unmṛjya śiraś cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ ghāṇaṃ hṛdayaṃ
mūrdhānaṃ cālabhet |
parimārjane saṃkhyāntaram apy āha baudhāyanaḥ |
triḥ parimṛjyāt dvir ity eke |
āpastambo ’pi |
trir oṣṭhau parimṛjyād dvir ityeke |
oṣṭhaśabdenātra tatsamīpasthaḥ salomakaḥ pradeśo vivakṣitaḥ |
atharvavedetihāsapurāṇāni dhyāyan brāhmeṇa tīrthena oṣṭhayoḥ salomadeśam unmṛjyād iti kaṇvasmaraṇāt | brāhmaṃ tīrtham aṅguṣṭhamūlam |
devalaḥ |
dvis tathāṅguṣṭhamūlena parimṛjyāt tato mukham |
etac coṣṭhathor alomakapradeśe yathā hastasparśo na bhavati tathā vidheyam |
ata eva dakṣaḥ |
saṃvṛtyāṅguṣṭhamūlena dviḥ pramṛjyāt tato mukham |
nāgrāṅgulyā na pṛṣṭhair vā parimṛjyāt kadācana ||
saṃmṛjya nirlomakam oṣṭhadeśam iti śeṣaḥ | etac ca kṣālitapāṇinā kartavyam |
ata eva paiṭhīnasiḥ |
aṅguṣṭhamūlena dviḥ parimṛjyān nirlepapāṇiḥ kṛtaśaucaḥ |
'nirlepapāṇiḥ' kṣālanād apanītācamanodakalepapāṇiḥ |
parimārjanānantaraṃ khasparśanaṃ kuryāt | tad āha śaṅkhaḥ |
dviḥ pramṛjyān mukhaṃ paścāt khāny ante samupaspṛśet |
khāni ca mukhasthitāny eva spṛśed ity āha gautamaḥ |
khāni copaspṛśec chīrṣaṇyāni mūrdhani ca dadyāt |
apa iti śeṣaḥ |
tāni ca jalena spṛśed ity āha viṣṇuḥ |
khāny adbhir mūrdhānaṃ hṛdayaṃ ca spṛśet |
vasiṣṭho ’pi |
dviḥ parimṛjyāt khāny adbhiḥ saṃspṛśet mūrddhany apo ninayet savye pāṇau ca | atraivaṃ kramaḥ | trir apaḥ pītvā prakṣālitapāṇir dvir oṣṭhau parimṛjya dakṣiṇahastena savyapāṇau jalaṃ niṣicya śeṣeṇa pādau mūrdhānaṃ ca prokṣya savyapāṇisthitam udakaṃ gṛhītvā vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa mukhādīni saṃspṛśyānte ’paḥ spṛśet |
[997] tad āha āpastambaḥ |
dakṣiṇena pāṇinā savyaṃ prokṣya pādau śiraś cendriyāṇy upaspṛśec cakṣuṣī nāsikāśrotre cety athāpa upaspṛśet |
vaiyāghrapād api |
śrotrasthānāni sarvāṇi spṛṣṭvā caiva jalaṃ spṛśet |
ācāman brāhmaṇo nityam ity āha bhagavān bhṛguḥ ||
vyāsaḥ |
akṣiṇī nāsike karṇav oṣṭhau ca tadanantaram |
tataḥ spṛśen nābhideśaṃ punar āpaś ca saṃspṛśet ||
saṃsparśanānte punaḥ savyapāṇiṃ prokṣyed ity āha baudhāyanaḥ |
khāny adbhiḥ saṃspṛśya pādau nābhiṃ śiraḥ savyaṃ pāṇim antataḥ |
prokṣayed iti śeṣaḥ |
paiṭhīnasis tu pādaprokṣaṇapūrvakaṃ savyapāṇiprokṣaṇam āha |
tatra ślokaḥ |
nāsikā cakṣuṣī śrotre mukhaṃ nābhiṃ tataḥ śiraḥ |
spṛṣṭvā prāṇān yathāsaṃkhyaṃ pādau prokṣya tataḥ śuciḥ ||
saṃsparśanaṃ ca sakṛt sakṛd vidheyam ity āha hārītaḥ |
dviḥ parisṛjyoṣṭhau sakṛn mūrdhanaṃ cakṣuḥ śrotre nāsikāṃ hṛdayaṃ pādau cābhyukṣyopaspṛśya prayato bhavati nāprayatāya havyaṃ kavyaṃ na svādhyāyam |
saṃkhyāntaram apy āha āpastambaḥ |
sakṛd upaspṛśet dvir ity eke |
[998] kāmenāviśeṣeṇa saṃsparśanāt pūrvaṃ kartavyāntaram āha hārītaḥ |
jñātiśraiṣṭhyakāmo ’nnādyakāmo vā dakṣiṇacaraṇāṅguṣṭhe pāṇim avasthāpya prāṇān ālabhya nābhim upaspṛśet | pāṇim ācamanodakasaṃpṛktam |
oṣṭhau parimṛjya prathamaṃ mukhasparśaṃ kuryād ity āha bhārgavaḥ |
auṣṭhau parimṛjya tato mukhaṃ parimṛśed agniṃ dhyāyan |
āsyasparśanānantaram api dhyānam āha vyāghrapāt |
āsyaṃ spṛṣṭvā karāgreṇa toyaṃ spṛṣṭvā samāhitaḥ |
saṃsmṛtya padmanābhaṃ tu vipraḥ samyag viśudhyati ||
atra soṅkāraṃ yajñeśaṃ manasā smared iti nārāyaṇaḥ |
saṃsparśanaṃ cāṅgulībhir vidheyam ity āha devalaḥ |
tataḥ kṛtvāṅgulisparśaṃ dṛkghrāṇaśrotranābhiṣu |
mūrdhānaṃ caraṇau cādbhiḥ saṃprokṣyātha śucir bhavet ||
sthānaviśeṣeṇāṅgulīviśeṣam āha dakṣaḥ |
saṃhatya tisṛbhiḥ pūrvam āsyam evam upaspṛśet |
aṅguṣṭhena pradeśinyā ghrāṇaṃ paścād anantaram ||
aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tu cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ punaḥ punaḥ |
nābhiṃ kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhena hṛdayaṃ tu talena vai |
sarvābhis tu śiraḥ paścād bāhū cāgreṇa saṃspṛśet ||
śaṅkhas tu pūrvam eva mūrdhni sparśanam aṅgulīnāṃ sthānāntaraṃ kramāntaraṃ cāha |
tato ’ṅgulicatuṣkeṇa spṛśen mūrdhanam āditaḥ |
madhyamāṅguṣṭhayogena spṛśen netradvayaṃ pṛthak ||
[999] aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tu spṛśen nāsāpuṭe kramāt |
aṅguṣṭhena kanīyasyā karṇau saṃyogataḥ spṛśet |
tarjanyaṅguṣṭhayogena nābhiṃ hṛdi talaṃ nyaset ||
'talaṃ' hastamadhyaṃ, hṛdaye nyaset |
paiṭhīnasis tu prakārāntareṇa sārthavādasaṃsparśanam āha |
aṅguṣṭhena pradeśinyā ca nāsike spṛśed aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ ca netre kaniṣṭhikāṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ ca śrotre madhyamikayā mukham aṅguṣṭhena nābhiṃ sarvābhiḥ śiraḥ, pradeśinī vāyur anāmikā sūryaḥ kanīnikā maghavān madhyamikā prajāpatir agnir aṅguṣṭhas tasmāt tenaiva saha sarvāṇi sthānāni spṛśati vāyuḥ sūryaḥ indraḥ prajāpatir agnir ity etā devatā enaṃ punīyur iti |
vṛddhaśaṅkhas tv anyathā saṃsparśanam āha |
tarjanyaṅguṣṭhayogena spṛśen nāsāpuṭadvayam |
aṅguṣṭhamadhyāyogena spṛśen netradayaṃ tataḥ ||
aṅguṣṭhānāmikayā ca yogena śravaṇau spṛśet |
kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhayogena spṛśet skandhadvayaṃ tataḥ ||
sarvāsām eva yogena nābhiṃ ca hṛdayaṃ tathā |
saṃspṛśec ca tathā śīrṣaṃ ayam ācamane vidhiḥ ||
iha yeṣāṃ śākhinām aṅgasparśanaṃ nāmnātaṃ teṣāṃ vikalpa eva | yeṣāṃ tu tad uktaṃ teṣām avirodhāt vacanāntarānusārāc ca aṅgāntaropasparśanam apy astīty avagantavyam |
[1000] atrārthavādam āha sa eva |
triḥ prāśnīyād yad ambhas tu prītās tenāsya devatāḥ |
brahmā viṣṇuś ca rudraś ca bhavantīty anuśuśrumaḥ ||
gaṅgā ca yamunā caiva prīyete parimārjanāt |
nāsatyadasrau prīyete spṛṣṭe nāsāpuṭadvaye ||
spṛṣṭe locanayugme tu prīyete śaśibhāskarau |
karṇayugme tathā spṛṣṭe prīyete cānilānalau ||
skandhayoḥ sparśanād eva prīyante sarvaparvatāḥ |
nābhisaṃsparśanān nāgāḥ prīyante cāsya nityaśaḥ ||
saṃspṛṣṭe hṛdaye cāsya prīyante sarvadevatāḥ |
mūrdhasaṃsparśanād asya prītas tu puruṣo bhavet ||
evam ācamanaṃ kurvataḥ phalam āha vaiyāghrapāt |
ya evaṃ brāhmaṇo nityam upasparśanam ācaret |
brahmādistambhaparyantaṃ jagat sa paritarpayet ||
iti dvādaśāṅgasparśanam |
ity ācamanaprakaraṇam |
atha niyamāḥ |
tatra nimantritaniyamas tāvat āha kātyāyanaḥ |
aninditenāmantrito [aninditena nimantrito?] nāpakrāmet |
'aninditena' bhojyānnena, 'nimantrito' nimantryamāṇaḥ | 'nāpakrāmet' nimantraṇaṃ necchet | kiṃ tu tad abhyupagacched eva |
[1001]
tathā cāṅgirasāṃ dūtatayā samāgatenāgninā tatparisparddhinām ādityānāṃ varaṇe svīkṛte sati kruddheṣv aṅgiraḥsv agneḥ prativacanaṃ śatapathe śrūyate | maho vā cānindyā vai māvṛṣata so ’nindyair vṛto nāśakam apakramītum iti | tasmād uhānindya vṛto nāpakrāmed iti |
anindyāmantraṇam avaśyam abhyupagamyam (?) ity āha devalaḥ |
kāmaṃ pratiśravas teṣām anindyāmantraṇe kṛte |
'anindyāmantraṇe kṛte' teṣāṃ nimantritānāṃ kāmam astv ity evaṃ, 'pratiśravaḥ' aṅgīkāra eva yukta ity arthaḥ | etac ca sāmarthye satīti veditavyam |
tathā ca gautamaḥ |
aninditenāmantritena śaktena na pratyākhyānaṃ kartavyam || iti |
anenārthān nindyāmantraṇe bhoktum asāmarthye ca pratyākhyānaṃ kartavyam ity avagamyate | aṅgīkṛtanimantraṇasyāṅgīkārād ūrdhvam api bhoktum asāmarthye saty atikramo na yukta ity arthāt jñāpayitum āha sa eva |
vidhivat ketanaṃ pratigṛhya śaktaḥ san nāpakrāmet || iti |
'ketanaṃ pratigṭahya' āmantraṇam aṅgīkṛtyety arthaḥ |
ata eva |
āmantritas tu vidhivat brāhmaṇo havyakavyayoḥ |
kathaṃcid apy atikrāman pāpaḥ śūkaratāṃ vrajet ||
brāhmaṇaṃ ca mukhaṃ kṛtvā devatāḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha |
yad annaṃ samupāśnanti tasmāt sa na vyatikramet ||
iti yamavacanam api anindyāmantritaśaktaviṣayam eveti vyākhyeyam |
[1002] yas tu nimantraṇam aṅgīkṛtya bhojanasamartho ’pi tat parityajati taṃ praty āha manuḥ |
ketitas tu yathānyāyaṃ havye kavye dvijottamaḥ |
kathaṃcid apy atikrāman pāpaḥ śūkaratāṃ vrajet ||
'ketitaḥ' upanimantritaḥ | nimantraṇam abhyupagamya yady atikrāmet tadā śūkaraḥ syāt | 'kathaṃcit' kāmād vismṛtya vā | anye tv āhuḥ, prārthyamānasyānabhyupagama evātikrama iti | tatra medhātithinā [on MDh 3.181] dūṣaṇam uktam | "tathā hi lipsayā hi pravṛttiḥ śrāddhe na punaḥ śāstrataḥ | atra satyāṃ lipsāyāṃ yadi nāṅgīkaroti ko doṣaḥ" iti | tad etac chatapathīyaliṅgadarśanaviruddham ity upekṣaṇīyam |
yamaḥ |
āmantritas tu yo vipro bhokum anyatra gacchati |
narakāṇāṃ śataṃ gatvā cāṇḍāleṣv abhijāyate ||
nārāyaṇaḥ |
āmantritas tu yaḥ śrāddhe kurvītānyasya tu kṣaṇam |
saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ tasya naśyati durmateḥ ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
āmantrito brāhmaṇo vai yo ’nyasmin kurute kṣaṇam |
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ śūkaratvaṃ prayāti ca ||
matsyapurāṇe |
āmantritas tu guṇinā nirdhanenāpi ca dvijāḥ |
nānyamiṣṭānnalobhena tam atikramayanti hi |
[1003] nimantritās tu yenādau tasmād gṛhṇanti nānyataḥ ||
tad etat sarvam ādyaviṣaya,
vidyamānadhano vidvān bhojyānnena nimantritaḥ |
kathaṃcid apy atikrāman pāpaḥ śūkaratāṃ vrajet ||
iti ṣaṭtriṃśanmate ’bhidhānāt | ato ’tyantanirdhanasya bahudakṣiṇādilābhalobhāt kadācid atikrame ’pi na doṣo ’stīti gamyate |
yas tu gṛhītanimantraṇo 'nyasmād api pratigṛhṇāti taṃ prati niṣedham āha kātyāyanaḥ |
āmantrito 'nyadannaṃ na pratigṛhīyāt |
'āmantritaḥ' pūrvam anyena nimantritaḥ, anyadīyād annād anyat pañcān nimantrakasyānnaṃ śrāddhopakḷptaṃ taṇḍulādirūpam apy annaṃ na pratigṛhṇīyād ity upādhyāyakarko vyākhyātavān | anye tv evaṃ vyācakṣate | yac chrāddhārthaṃ nimantritas tadarthād annād anyad āmam api śrāddhavyatirekeṇāpi kenacid dīyamānaṃ tac chrāddhopalakṣitāhorātraparyantaṃ na pratigṛhṇīyād iti |
yaḥ punaḥ pratigṛhṇāti tasya doṣam āha devalaḥ |
pūrvaṃ nimantrito ’nyena kuryād anyapratigraham |
bhuktāhāro ’tha vā bhuṅkte sukṛtaṃ tasya naśyati ||
'nimantritaḥ' pūrvaṃ bhuktāhāraḥ, yadi tasminn ahorātre punar bhuṅkte tadā tasya pūrvakṛtaṃ sukṛtaṃ naśyati |
yaś cāmantritaḥ kṛtāhvāno 'py anāgamanena kutapādikālātipattiṃ karoti tasya doṣa ādityapurāṇe darśitaḥ |
āmantritaś ciraṃ naiva kuryād vipraḥ kadācana |
devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca dātur anyasya caiva hi ||
[1004] cirakārī bhaved droḍhā pacyate narakāgninā |
'droḍhā' drohakārī |
yājñavalkyaḥ |
taiś cāpi saṃhatair bhāvyaṃ manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ |
'taiḥ' nimantritabrāhmaṇaiḥ |
yamasmṛti-kūrmapurāṇayoḥ |
amantritāś ca ye viprāḥ śrāddhakāla upasthite |
vaseyur niyatāḥ sarve brahmacaryaparāyaṇāḥ ||
'brahmacaryaṃ' aṣṭaprakāraṃ strīsaṅgavarjanam ||
tad ukaṃ gobhilena |
smaraṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ keliḥ prekṣaṇaṃ guhyabhāṣaṇam |
saṃkalpo ’dhyavasāyaś ca kriyānirvṛttir eva ca ||
etan maithunam aṣṭāṅgaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ |
viparītaṃ brahmacaryam etad evāṣṭalakṣaṇam ||
pūrvānubhūtasya suratasya strīrūpasya vānucintanaṃ 'smaraṇam' | suratasya yoṣito vā sarāgatayā śabdena pratipādanaṃ 'kīrtanam' | upalakṣaṇaṃ cedaṃ hastasaṅketādipratipādanasya | strībhiḥ saha krīḍā 'keliḥ' | paraprayukasya suratasya strīṇāṃ vā saspṛham avalokanaṃ 'prekṣaṇam' | strībhiḥ saha suratānukūlakathākaraṇaṃ 'guhyabhāṣaṇaṃ', strīvyatirekeṇāpy aśīlabhāṣaṇaṃ vā | evam idaṃ kariṣya iti strīsaṃbhogasaṃbaddho manovyāpāraḥ 'saṃkalpaḥ' | suratonmukhaśarīravyāpāraḥ 'adhyavasāyaḥ' | āphalaprāpteḥ suratasaṃpādanaṃ ‘kriyānirvṛttiḥ’, ‘aṣṭāṅgaṃ’ aṣṭaprakāraṃ, 'maithunaṃ' mithunakarma | etad eva [1005] viparītam iti | etasyaiva smaraṇāder vaiparītyam asmaraṇādi 'brahmacaryaṃ' kim etāny ekaikaśo brahmacaryaṃ nety āha 'aṣṭalakṣaṇaṃ' asmaraṇādīny aṣṭāpi samuccitāni lakṣaṇaṃ svarūpaṃ yasya tat tathā |
uktaniyamācaraṇe hetum āha manuḥ |
akrodhanāḥ śaucaparāḥ satataṃ brahmacāriṇaḥ |
nyastaśastrā mahābhāgāḥ pitaraḥ pūrvadevatāḥ ||
'akrodhanāḥ' krodhavarjitāḥ | 'śaucaparāḥ' śaucaṃ śuddhatā mṛdvāribhyāṃ prāyaścittena ca, 'satatam' iti śuddher viśeṣaṇaṃ, tena niṣṭhīvādāv ācamanādi tatkṣaṇam eva kartavyam | 'brahmacāriṇaḥ' parihṛtastrīsaṃbhogāḥ | ‘nyastaśastrāḥ' nyastaṃ tyaktaṃ śastraṃ yaiḥ | śastragrahaṇaṃ daṇḍapāruṣyopalakṣaṇārtham | 'mahābhāgāḥ' dayaudāryadīnatvādiguṇayuktāḥ | yata evaṃvidhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ rūpaṃ te ca brāhmaṇān āviśanti | atas tais tadrūpadhāribhir bhavitavyam ity arthavādenāyam artho ’vasīyate |
yad uktaṃ tenaiva |
nimantritāṃs tu pitara upatiṣṭhanti tān dvijān |
vāyuvac cānugacchanti tathāsīnān upāsate ||
yasmān nimantritān brāhmaṇān divyena rūpeṇa pitaraḥ 'upatiṣṭhanti' tac charīram āviśanti | yathā bhūtagrahāḥ svagṛhītaṃ vāyuvad anugacchanti, yathā vāyuḥ prāṇaḥ puruṣe gacchaty anugacchati nirgacchantaṃ prāṇo jahāti evaṃ pitaro vāyubhūtāḥ brāhmaṇān upāsate gacchatsv anugacchanti upaviṣṭeṣūpaviśanti nimantritāḥ pitṛrūpāpannā bhavantīty arthaḥ | ato nimantritais tacchīlair bhavitavyam |
[1006] devalaḥ |
tasmād doṣān parityajya trīn etān aparān api |
brahmacārī śucir bhūtvā śrāddhaṃ bhuñjīta śaktimān ||
‘trīn’ strīsaṃbhogāny apratigrahapunarbhojanākhyān |
tathā |
śrāddhe nimantrito vipro vṛṣalīṃ yadi gacchati |
dātuḥ pāpaṃ samagraṃ yat kṣayāt tat pratipadyate ||
yama-uśanasau |
āmantritas tu yaḥ śrāddhe vṛṣalyā saha modate |
bhavanti pitaras tasya taṃ māsaṃ śukrabhojanāḥ ||
manuḥ |
āmantritas tu yaḥ śrāddhe vṛsalyā saha modate |
dātur yad duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃcit tat sarvaṃ pratipadyate ||
vṛṣalīśabdaḥ strīmātropalakṣaṇārthaḥ, sāmānyena brahmacaryasya vidhānāt | vṛṣasyantī vṛṣaṃ bhartāraṃ lāti svīkuruta iti vyutpattyā brāhmaṇy api vṛṣaly eva | tenāyam arthaḥ | nimantraṇam aṅgīkṛtya tad ahar yaḥ striyā saha modate tasyāyaṃ doṣaḥ | 'modanaṃ' harṣotpattiḥ | tena saṃlāpāliṅganādy api na kartavyam | 'dātuḥ' śrāddhakartuḥ, 'yad duṣkṛtaṃ' pāpaṃ yat kiṃcit, 'tat sarvaṃ', tasmin saṃkrāmati | abhīṣṭaphalayogamātram anena ca nirdiśyate ’nyathā yatra dātā puṇyakṛt tatra na kaścid doṣaḥ syāt |
brahmavaivarta-vāyupurāṇayoḥ |
[1007] āmantritas tu yaḥ śrāddhe yoṣitaṃ sevate naraḥ |
pitaras tasya taṃ māsaṃ tasmin retasi śerate |
kūrmapurāṇe |
śrāddhe nimantrito vipro maithunaṃ yo ’dhigacchati |
brahmahatyām avāpnoti tiryagyonau ca jāyate ||
atra ca maithunaṃ svabhāryāyām ṛtumatyām api devarādinā niyuktenāpi na kartavyam | tad āha vṛddhamanuḥ |
ṛtukāle niyukto vā naiva gacchet striyaṃ kvacit |
tatra gacchan samāpnoti hy aniṣṭaṃ phalam eva tu ||
niyukta ity anena rāgataḥ pravṛttyabhāve ’pi doṣa it yukaṃ bhavati | kūrmapurāṇe |
nimantritas tu yo vipro hy adhvānaṃ yāti durmatiḥ |
bhavanti pitaras tasya taṃ māsaṃ pāṃsubhojanāḥ ||
yamaḥ |
āmantritas tu yaḥ śrāddhe adhvānaṃ tūpapadyate |
bhavanti pitaras tasya taṃ māsaṃ pāṃsubhojanāḥ ||
uśanāḥ |
āmantritas tu yaḥ śrāddhe adhvānaṃ vahati dvijaḥ |
bhavanti pitaras tasya taṃ māmaṃ pāṃsubhojanāḥ ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
[1008] āmantritas tu yaḥ śrāddhe kuryād vai kalahaṃ dvijaḥ |
bhavanti pitaras tasya taṃ mājhaṃ malabhojanāḥ ||
yamaḥ |
āmantritas tu yaḥ śrāddhe kalahaṃ kurute dvijaḥ |
bhavanti pitaras tasya taṃ māsaṃ kṛcchrabhojanāḥ ||
uśanāḥ |
amantritas tu yaḥ śrāddhe kalahaṃ kurute dvijaḥ |
pitaras tasya taṃ māsaṃ duḥkham ṛcchanti dāruṇam ||
yama-uśanasau |
āmantritas tu yaḥ śrāddhe bhāram udvahati dvijaḥ |
pitaras tasya taṃ māsam bhavanti svedabhojanāḥ ||
āmantritas tu yaḥ śrāddhe hiṃsāṃ vai kurute dvijaḥ |
taṃ māsaṃ pitaras tasya bhavanti rudhirāśanāḥ ||
āmantritas tu yaḥ śrāddhe āyāsaṃ kurute dvijaḥ |
bhavanti pitaras tasya taṃ māsaṃ pittabhojanāḥ ||
uśanāḥ |
āmantritas tu yaḥ śrāddhe dyūtaṃ saṃsevate dvijaḥ |
bhavanti pitaras tasya taṃ māsaṃ malabhojanāḥ ||
tasmān nimantritaḥ śrāddhe niyatātmā bhavet dvijaḥ |
akrodhanaḥ śaucaparaḥ satyavādī jitendriyaḥ ||
yamaḥ |
ahiṃsā satyam akrodho dūre cāgamanakriyā |
[1009] abhārodvahanaṃ kṣāntiḥ śrāddhe ’syopāsanāvidhiḥ ||
dūre sīmnaḥ purastād agamanavidhānāt sīmamadhye gacchato na doṣa iti |
tathā ca brahmāṇḍapurāṇam |
na sīmānam atikrāmec chrāddhārthaṃ vai nimantritaḥ |
paryaṭan sīmamadhye tu kadācin na praduṣyati || iti |
yamaḥ |
punarbhojanam adhvānaṃ bhārādhyayanamaithunam |
saṃdhyāṃ pratigrahaṃ homaṃ śrāddhabhug varjayet sadā ||
homaṃ svayaṃ na kuryāt anyena tu kārayet |
yad āha kātyāyanaḥ |
mṛtake ca pravāse ca aśakau śrāddhabhojane |
evamādinimitteṣu hāvayed iti yojayet ||
hāvayed iti yad gobhilādibhir uktaṃ tad evamādinimitteṣu yojayed ity arthaḥ |
hotur anyasyālābhe bhaviṣyatpurāṇe uktam |
daśakṛtvaḥ pibed āpo gāyatryā śrāddhabhug dvijaḥ |
tataḥ saṃdhyām upāsīta japec ca juhuyād api ||
iti nimantritaniyamāḥ |
atha śrāddhakartur niyamāḥ |
ādityapurāṇe |
tad ahas tu śucir bhūtvākrodhano ’tvarito bhavet |
[1010] apramattaḥ satyavādī yajamāno ’tha varjayet ||
adhvānaṃ maithunaṃ caiva śramaṃ svādhyāyam eva ca |
'tad ahaḥ' tasmin śrāddhopalakṣite kāle, sa ca nimantraṇāt prabhṛti śrāddhabhuktānnapariṇāmāvadhiḥ kālo ’haḥśabdārthaḥ,
vinītaḥ prārthayan bhaktyā viprān āmantrya yatnataḥ |
śrāddhabhuktānnapākāntaṃ niyamān ācaret tataḥ ||
iti logākṣismaraṇṇat |
'śuciḥ' snānādibhiḥ śuddhadehaḥ | 'akrodhanaḥ' krodhavarjitaḥ | upalakṣaṇaṃ caitan mātsaryadambhādīnāṃ manodoṣāṇām | 'atvaritaḥ' drutakāritvahīnaḥ | tathātve hi kadācid yathāvat kāryāniṣpattiḥ syāt | 'apramattaḥ' anavadhānavidhuraḥ | pramāṇavat padārthaviṣayo lakṣaṇopetaś ca śabdaḥ 'satyaḥ' tadvadanaśīlaḥ 'satyavādī' | adhvaśabdena lakṣaṇayā dūrādhvagamanam avasīyate | ‘maithunaṃ' strīsaṃbhogaḥ | 'śramaḥ' bhārodvahanādijanitaḥ kleśaḥ | svādhyāyaśabdena sāṅgasya vedasyādhyayanam adhyāpanaṃ ca vivakṣitam |
kūrmapurāṇe |
akrodhano ’tvaro ’mattaḥ satyavādī samāhitaḥ |
bhāramaithunam adhvānaṃ śrāddhakṛad varjayej japam ||
‘atvaraḥ' tvarāśūnyaḥ |‘apramattaḥ' apramādī | 'japaḥ' svādhyāyādhyayanam |
vṛddhamanuḥ |
nimantrya viprāṃs tad ahar varjayen nmathunaṃ kṣuram |
pramattatāṃ ca svādhyāyaṃ krodhāśaucaṃ tathānṛtam ||
'kṣuraṃ' kṣurakarma |
etac ca nakhanikṛntanāder apy upalakṣaṇam |
[1011] jābālaḥ |
tāmbūlaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca snehasnānam abhojanam |
ratyauṣadhaparānnāni śrāddhakartā tu varjayet ||
śrāddhaṃ prakṛtya hārītaḥ |
trīṇi cātra praśaṃsanti śaucam akrodham atvaram |
devalaḥ |
akrodho nirvṛtaḥ svasthaḥ śraddhāvān atvaraḥ śuciḥ |
samāhitamanāḥ śrāddhakriyāyām asakṛd bhavet ||
paiṭhīnasiḥ |
śrāddhe satyaṃ cākrodhaṃ ca śaucaṃ cātvarāṃ ca praśaṃsanti |
viṣṇuḥ |
kopaṃ pariharen nāśru pātayen na tvarāṃ kuryāt |
uśanāḥ |
na tvarayā na krodhena kurvīta |
varāhapurāṇe |
dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca visṛjed brahmacārī śucir bhavet |
vāyupurāṇe |
na dīno nāpi vā kruddho na caivānyamanā naraḥ |
ekāgram ādhāya manaḥ śrāddhaṃ kuryāt sadā budhaḥ ||
nimantritabrāhmaṇaparityāgena brāhmaṇāntaranimantraṇapratiṣedhaḥ kūrmapurāṇe |
āmantrayitvā yo mohād anyaṃ cāmantrayed dvijaḥ |
[1012] sa tasmād adhikaṃ pāpī viṣṭhākīṭo ’bhijāyate ||
yo brāhmaṇo ’nyena nimantrito ’nyasmai kṣaṇaṃ kurute tasmād brāhmaṇāt pūrvaślokoktād uktalakṣaṇo yajamāno ’dhikaṃ pāpīty arthaḥ |
doṣāntaram āha nārāyaṇaḥ |
ketanaṃ kārayitvā tu nivārayati durmatiḥ |
brahmavadhyām avāpnoti śūdrayonau ca jāyate ||
etasminn enasi prāpte brāhmaṇo niyataḥ śuciḥ |
yaticāndrāyaṇaṃ kṛtvā tasmāt pāpāt pramucyate ||
'enaḥ' pāpaṃ | yaticāndrāyaṇaṃ nāma cāndrāyaṇaviśeṣaḥ | tad etad aṅgīkṛtaketanasya bhojanayogyasya nirākaraṇe sati draṣṭavyam |
yamaḥ |
āmantrya brāhmaṇaṃ yas tu yathānyāyaṃ na pūjayet |
atikṛcchrāsu ghorāsu tiryagyoniṣu jāyate ||
hārītaḥ |
daive vā yadi vā pitrye nimantrya brāhmaṇaṃ yadi |
tarpayen na yathānyāyaṃ sa tat tasya phalaṃ haret ||
pramādād vismṛtaṃ jñātvā pramādyainaṃ ca yatnataḥ |
tarpayitvā viśeṣeṇa sarvaṃ tat phalam āpnuyāt ||
gautamas tu śrāddhakartur vṛṣalīgamane doṣādhikyam āha |
sadyaḥ śrāddhī śūdrātalpagas tatpurīṣe (?) māsaṃ nayate pitṝn |
śrāddhaṃ kariṣyamāṇaṃ kṛtaṃ vāsya vidyata iti 'śrāddhī' dātā | 'sadyaḥ' tatkṣaṇam ārabhya, māsaṃ nayatīty arthaḥ |
[1013] nimantraṇaprabhṛti śrāddhakarmasamāptiparyantaṃ śrāddhakartur nirāhāratvam āha āpastambaḥ |
ārabdhe cābhojanam ā samāpanāt || iti |
nimantraṇadine tu bhojananiyamam āha jātūkarṇyaḥ |
nirāmiṣaṃ sakṛd bhuktvā bhuktasarvajane gṛhe |
nimantrayīta pūrvedyur upagamya dvijottamān ||
eteṣāṃ niyamānām avaśyakāryatvam uktam agnipurāṇe |
amaithunādayaḥ sarve niyamāḥ śrāddhakāriṇā |
apramattena kartavyāḥ pramādya nirayaṃ vrajet ||
gurutarakāryādyupanipāte tu svayam apārayan yadi kadācit putraśiṣyartvigādinānyena śrāddhaṃ kārayet tadānena yajamānena cety ubhābhyām api brahmacaryādiniyamā yathāvad anuṣṭheyāḥ |
tad uktaṃ vārāhapurāṇe |
na śaknoti svayaṃ kartuṃ yadā hy anavakāśataḥ |
śrāddhaṃ śiṣyeṇa putreṇa tadānyenāpi kārayet ||
niyamān ācaret so ’pi vihitāṃś ca vasundhare |
yajamāno 'pi tān sarvān ācaret susamāhitaḥ |
brahmacaryādibhir bhūriniyamaiḥ śrāddham akṣayam |
anyathā kriyamāṇaṃ tu mogham eva na saṃśayaḥ ||
iti śrāddhakartur niyamāḥ |
athobhayaniyamāḥ |
tatra hārītaḥ |
āmantritāḥ āmantrayitā ca śucayas tāṃ rātriṃ vaseyuḥ |
[1014] nimantraṇānantaraṃ śātātapaḥ |
vaset tu prayato nityaṃ saha vipraiḥ kṛtavrataḥ |
brāhma-mārkaṇḍeya-nāgarakhaṇḍeṣu |
taiś ca saṃyamibhir bhāvyaṃ yaś ca śrāddhaṃ kariṣyati |
manur yamaś ca |
nimantrito dvijaḥ pitrye niyatātmā bhavet sadā |
na ca chandāṃsy adhīyīta yasya śrāddhaṃ ca tad bhavet ||
pitrye śrāddhe nimantrito niyatātmā bhavet saṃyatātmā brahmacaryaṃ parirakṣet | anyāṃś ca yamaniyamān anutiṣṭhet | atra "snātakavratādīnāṃ puruṣavratādīnāṃ nṛtyagītādipratiṣedhānāṃ karmāṅgatā vidhīyate" [on MDh 3.178] iti medhātithiḥ | tathā kartavyaṃ śrāddhakṛtā yathāsau brāhmaṇo nimantraṇāt prabhṛti saṃyatendriyo bhavati anyathā śrāddhaṃ duṣyeta | na ca 'chandāṃsi ' vedān, adhīyīta vācā vedākṣaroccāraṇam adhyayanaṃ | japas tu mantropāsanādāv apratisiddhaḥ | yasya ca tat kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ bhavet so ’pi niyatātmā bhaved iti yojanā | ato bhoktuḥ kartuś ca nimantraṇāt prabhṛti tulyo niyamo ’nadhyayanaṃ ca |
kātyāyanaḥ |
tadahaḥ śucir akrodhano ’tvarito ’pramattaḥ satyavādī syād adhvamaithunaśramasvādhyāyāṃś ca varjayed āvāhanādi vāgyata upasparśanād (?) āmantritāś caivam || iti |
'āvāhanādi' āvāhanaprabhṛti, upasparśanaparyantaṃ yajamānaḥ 'vāgyataḥ' maunī syād iti | 'āmantritāś caivam' iti āmantritā brāhmapāś cāpy evaṃ śucitvādivāgyamādiniyamavanto bhaveyuḥ |
[1015] kūrmapurāṇe |
tasmān nimantritaḥ śrāddhe niyatātmā bhaved dvijaḥ |
akrodhanaḥ śaucaparaḥ kartā caiva jitendriyaḥ ||
ādityapurāṇe |
tāṃ niśāṃ brahmacārī syāc chrāddhakṛc chrāddhakaiḥ saha |
anyathā vartamānau tau syātāṃ nirayagāminau ||
pādma-mātsyayoḥ |
punarbhojanam adhvānam bhāram āyāmamaithunam |
śrāddhakṛc chrādbhabhuk caiva sarvam etad vivarjayet |
smayaṃ ca kalahaṃ caiva divāsvāpaṃ tathaiva ca ||
viṣṇupurāṇe |
tataḥ krodhavyavāyādi nāyāmaṃ ca dvijaiḥ saha |
yajamāno na kurvīta doṣas tatra mahān ayam ||
atrādiśabdena hiṃsā dyūtānṛtādīni gṛhyante |
tathā śrāddhe niyukto vā bhojayitvā niyujya ca |
vyavāyī retaso gartte majjayaty ātmanaḥ pitṝn ||
‘niyuktaḥ' nimantrito brāhmaṇaḥ, śrāddhabhojanāt prāk bhuktvā śrāddhabhojanottarakālaṃ vā yadi 'vyavāyī' maithunakartā, syāt tad āsau svapitṝn retogartte majjayet | evaṃ yajamāno 'pi 'niyujya' nimantraṇaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇabhojanāt pūrvaṃ, tathā 'bhojayitvā' brāhmaṇabhojanānantaram api bhuktānnapariṇām aparyantaṃ yadi 'vyavāyī' syāt tadā so 'py uktadoṣaṃ prāpnuyāt | tathā ca pracetāḥ |
[1016] syād annapariṇāmāntaṃ brahmacaryaṃ dvayos tataḥ |
tata iti nimantraṇāt prabhṛtīty arthaḥ | brahmacaryagrahaṇaṃ (?) dvayor nimantritayajamānayor vihitaniyamopalakṣaṇārtham,
bhuktānnapariṇāmāntaṃ niyamān na vivarjayet |
niṣiddhaṃ kurvatāṃ doṣāt tadvad vaidham akurvatā ||
iti bṛhaspatismaraṇat |
śaṅkhaḥ |
nimantritas tu yaḥ śrāddhe maithunaṃ sevate dvijaḥ |
śrāddhaṃ datvā ca bhuktvā ca yuktaḥ syān mahatainasā |
nāgarakhaṇḍe |
śrāddhaṃ datvā ca bhuktvā ca maithunaṃ yo ’nutiṣṭhati |
pitaras tasya taṃ māsaṃ tasmin retasi śerate ||
gatvā tu yoṣitaṃ śrāddhe yo bhuṅkte yaś ca gacchati |
retomūtrakṛtāhārās taṃ māsaṃ pitaras tayoḥ ||
brahmavaivarta-vāyupurāṇyoḥ |
śrāddhadātā ca bhoktā ca maithunaṃ yadi gacchataḥ |
pitaras tu tayor māsaṃ reto ’śnanti na saṃśayaḥ ||
ubhayor niyamācaraṇe hetum āha hārītaḥ |
pūrvedyur āmantritān viprān pitaraḥ saṃviśanti |
yajamānaṃ ca tāṃ rātriṃ vaseyur niyatās tataḥ ||
ity ubhayaniyamāḥ |
atha śrāddhabhoktur niyamāḥ |
[1017]
tatra pracetāḥ |
pītvāpośānam aśnīyāt pātre dattam agarhitam |
sarvendriyāṇāṃ cāpalyaṃ na kuryāt pāṇipādayoḥ ||
indriyādiṣu cāpalyaṃ bhojanārthavyāpārād abhyadhikavyāpāraḥ |
manuḥ |
abhyuṣṇaṃ sarvam annaṃ syād bhuñjīraṃś caiva vāgyataḥ |
na ca dvijātayo brūyur dātrā pṛṣṭā havirguṇān ||
īṣaduṣṇam 'abhyuṣṇaṃ' | uṣṇatve ’pi yathā mukhe sukhasparśaṃ bhavati | yasyoṣṇasya bhojanam ucitaṃ tatraivedam uṣṇatāvidhānaṃ na tu dadhyodanādes tv auṣṇyaṃ vyādhikaram aprītikaraṃ ca | tādṛśasya ca pradāne harṣayet brāhmaṇān iti virudhyate | uṣṇabhojanavidhānāc ca na sarvam annaṃ sakṛt pariveṣṭavyam | tathā hi bahubhojinaḥ śītalībhaved annaṃ tasmāt pūrvapariviṣṭe bhukke punar anyad dadyāt| na ca bhuñjānebhya ucchiṣṭatvād dānam ayuktam iti vācyam | bhojanavidhir evaṃrūpa eva | ā tṛpter bhojayitur vyāpāraḥ | na hy atra odanādipratigrāhyatayā saṃbadhyate | ata eva na tatra pratigrahamantra odanādiṣu yujyate,
dṛṣṭam uṣṇaṃ haviṣyaṃ ca dadyād annaṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
iti jābālismaraṇāc ca | 'vāgyataḥ' niyamitavācaḥ | vyāpāranirodhaḥ 'niyamanam' | vācaś ca vyāpāraḥ śabdoccāraṇam, tannirodhavidhānāt | vyaktāvyaktaṃ śabdoccāraṇaṃ na kartavyam ity uktaṃ bhavati | dātrety avivakṣitaṃ | anyenāpi pṛṣṭair havirguṇā na vaktavyāḥ | nanu vāṅniyamād evaitat siddhaṃ | satyaṃ | abhinayādināpi na kartavyam iti pratipādayituṃ bhaviṣyati | na
brūyūr iti kathaṃcid vyākhyeyam |
[1018] tathā ca atriḥ |
huṅkāreṇāpi yo brūyād dhastād vāpi guṇān vadet |
bhūtalāc codvaret pātraṃ muñced dhastena vā pibet ||
prauḍhapādo bahiḥkakṣo bahirjanukaro ’tha vā |
aṅguṣṭhena vināśnāti mukhaśabdena vā punaḥ ||
pītvāvaśiṣṭatoyāni punar uddhṛtya vā pibet |
khāditārdhāt punaḥ khāden modakāni phalāni vā ||
mukhena vā dhamed annaṃ niṣṭhīved bhājan e’pi vā |
ittham aśnan dvijaḥ śrāddhaṃ datvā gacchaty adhogatim ||
'prauḍhapādaḥ' āsanāropitapādaḥ,
āsanārūḍhapādas tu prauḍhapādaḥ sa ucyate |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇe ’bhidhānāt | 'bahiḥkakṣaḥ' uttarīyavāsobahir bhūtakakṣadvayaḥ | bhūtalāt pātroddharaṇe doṣo ’nnādyādhāramahābhājanaviṣayaḥ | pānādyādhāralaghupātrasya “punar uddhṛtya vā pibet" ity anenoddhārābhyanujñāvagamāt |
yat tu devalenoktam,
annapānakaśītodaṃ dadadbhyo hy avalokitaḥ |
vaktavye kāraṇe saṃjñāṃ kurvan bhuñjīta pāṇinā | iti |
apekṣānusāreṇānnapāna śītalavāryādi dātṛbhir apekṣāṃ jñātum avalokitaḥ, kṣutpipāsālakṣaṇe apekṣādeḥ kāraṇe vaktavye pāṇinā saṃjñāṃ saṃketam apekṣādisūcakaṃ kurvan bhuñjīteti tasyārthaḥ pratyetavyaḥ | na tu svādutvādihavirguṇarūpe apekṣākaraṇe saṃjñāṃ kurvann iti | evaṃvidhārthaparigrahe pūrvoktavacanavirodhāpatteḥ |
[1019] abhyuṣṇaṃ sarvam annaṃ syād ityādividher arthavādam āha manuḥ |
yāvad annaṃ bhavaty uṣṇaṃ yāvad aśnanti vāgyatāḥ |
tāvad aśnanti pitaro yāvan noktā havirguṇāḥ ||
vāyupurāṇe ’pi |
yāvan na stūyate cānnaṃ yāvad auṣṇyaṃ na muñcati |
tāvad aśnanti pitaro yāvad aśnanti vāgyatāḥ ||
prabhāsakhaṇḍe |
rasā yatra praśasyante bhoktāro bandhugotriṇaḥ |
rājavārtādisaṃkrando rakṣaḥśrāddhasya lakṣaṇam ||
havirguṇakathanapratiṣedhas tu śrāddhasamāpteḥ prāg eva |
śrāddhasamāptau tu havirguṇapraśaṃsā kartavyety āha vṛddhavasiṣṭhaḥ |
śrāddhāvasāne kartavyā dvijair annaguṇaiḥ stutiḥ | iti |
śaṅkhalikhitau |
brāhmaṇaṇā annaguṇaṃ doṣaṃ nābhivadeyuḥ nānṛtaṃ brūyur anyonyaṃ na praśaṃseyur annapānaṃ na prabhūtam iti brūyur anyatra hastasaṃjñāyāḥ |
abhyadhikasyānnasyāpratigrahārthaṃ pūrvapariviṣṭaṃ prabhūtam atrāsti kim anyeneti bhoktṛbhir na vaktavyaṃ kiṃ tu hastasaṃketena sūcanīyam ity arthaḥ |
nigamo ’pi |
nānnapānādikaṃ śrāddhe vārayen mukhataḥ kvacit |
aniṣṭatvād bahutvād vā vāraṇaṃ hastasaṃjñayā ||
evam abhīṣṭayācanam api na mukhataḥ kuryāt maunabhaṅgaprasaṅgāt | tena tad api hastasaṃjñayā kāryam |
[1020] apekṣitaṃ cāvaśyaṃ yācanīyam evety āha vṛddhaśātātapaḥ |
apekṣitaṃ yācitavyaṃ śrāddhārtham upakalpitam |
na yācate dvijo mūḍhaḥ sa bhavet pitṛghātakaḥ ||
yat tu vāyupurāṇe ’bhihitam,
yācate yadi dātāraṃ brāhmaṇo jñānavarjitaḥ |
pitaras tasya ruṣyanti dātur bhoktur na saṃśayaḥ ||
yac ca yamena,
kṛcchradvādaśarātreṇa mucyante karmiṇas tataḥ |
tasmād dvijo naiva dadyān na yācen na ca hāpayet || iti |
tac chrādbhārtham ananukalpitavastuviṣayam, sāmānyenābhidhānāt | śrāddhārtham upakalpitam apy annādikam atyantādhikaṃ dātā na dadyāt bhoktā ca na pratigṛhṇīyāt | tad āhatuḥ śaṅkhalikhitau |
nāgrāsanasthaḥ pūrvam aśnīyān nādhikaṃ dadyān na pratigṛhīyāt |
vṛddhaśātātapaḥ |
āsane pādam āropya yad bhuṅkte tu dvijottamaḥ |
hanti daivaṃ ca pitryaṃ ca tadannaṃ ca prajāḥ paśūn ||
baudhāyanaḥ |
pādena pādam ākramya yo bhuṅkte ’nāpadi dvijaḥ |
naivāsau bhaujyate śrāddhe nirāśāḥ pitaro gatāḥ ||
tathā tūṣṇīṃ bhuñjīrann avilokayamānā anuddhṛtya pātram iti |
avilokayamānā itas tata iti śeṣaḥ |
pātroddharaṇe doṣāntaram uktaṃ vārāhapurāṇe |
[1021] uddhared yadi pātraṃ tu brāhmaṇo jñānavarjitaḥ |
haranti rākṣasās tasya bhuñjato ’nnaṃ ca sundari ||
manuḥ |
yad veṣṭitaśirā bhuṅkte yad bhuṅkte dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ |
sopānatkaś ca yad bhuṅkte tad vai rakṣāṃsi bhuñjate ||
veṣṭitam uṣṇīṣādinā | dakṣiṇābhimukhasya doṣavacanād anavakāśe deśe dakṣiṇetarayatkiñcidabhimukhānām api bhojanam anumataṃ bhavatīti jñāyate | anyathodaṅmukhānāṃ vidhānāt kuto dakṣiṇābhimukhatvaprāptiḥ | 'upānahau' carmapāduke |
devalaḥ |
yo ’prasannamanā bhuṅkte sopānatko ’pi vā punaḥ |
pralāpaśīlaḥ kruddho vā sa vipraḥ pitṛdūṣakaḥ ||
viṣṇuḥ |
aśnīyur brāhmaṇā na sopānatkā na pīṭhopanihitapādāḥ |
śaṅkhaḥ |
ekavāsāś ca yo ’śnīyān nirāśāḥ pitaro gatāḥ |
prabhāsakhaṇḍe |
yaś ca satkāravad bhuṅkte yaś ca pāṇitale dvijaḥ |
na tad aśnanti pitaro yaś ca vāyuṃ samutsṛjet ||
'satkāravat' satkāraphurutkārādiśabdavat | pāṇitale niṣedhād aṅgulyagreṇa grāso grāhyaḥ | grāsaṃ gṛhītvā uṣṇasyānnasya nirvāpaṇārthaṃ yo vāyuṃ mukhamārutam utsṛjet |
[1022] yamaḥ |
yaś ca pāṇitale bhuṅkte yaś ca vāyuṃ samutsṛjet |
na tasya pitaro ’śnanti yaś caivāgre praśaṃsati ||
'agre' śrāddhasamāpteḥ pūrvam |
hārītaḥ |
ūrddhvapāṇiḥ pravihasan sakrodho vismayānvitaḥ |
śrāddhakāle tu yad bhuṅkte na tat prīṇāti vai pitṝn ||
śātātapaḥ |
bhagnapṛṣṭhas tu yo bhuṅkte bahirjānukaras tathā |
hasate vakti cājasraṃ sa jñeyaḥ pitṛghātakaḥ ||
tathā |
abhyuṣṇāvirasaṃ sarvam anivāritam adrutam |
alolupo jitakrodho bhuñjītānnaṃ manohitam ||
kārṣṇājiniḥ |
bhuñjīta cāpariśrānto dambhāhaṃkāravarjitaḥ |
krodhaṃ lābhaṃ tathā mohaṃ varjaye cchrāddhakarmaṇi ||
bahuvṛcapariśiṣṭe |
yac ca pāṇitale dattaṃ yac cānnam upakalpitam |
ekībhāvena bhoktavyaṃ pṛthagbhāvo na vidyate ||
pāṇitale dattam agnaukaraṇānnam | 'upakalpitaṃ ' dvijabhājaneṣu pitruddeśenotsṛṣṭam | etad dvayam api miśrayitvā bhoktavyam |
pracetāḥ |
[1023] na spṛśed vāmahastena bhuñjāno ’nnaṃ kadācana |
na pādau na śiro vastiṃ padā na bhājanaṃ spṛśet ||
yamaḥ |
yat tu bhuktvā punar bhuṅkte yac ca tailābhighāritam |
rajasvalābhir yad dṛṣṭaṃ tad vai rakṣāṃsi gacchati ||
rajasvalādibhir iti vyākhyeyaṃ bahuvacanopadeśāt |
vāyupurāṇe |
śrāddhe niyuktā ye viprā dambhaṃ krodhaṃ ca cāpalam |
anyonyasparśanaṃ kāmāt varjayeyur madaṃ tathā ||
kāmagrahaṇād buddhipūrvam anyonyasparśaparihāraṃ kuryuḥ | pramādād itaretarasparśe tu yat kartavyaṃ tad āha śaṅkhaḥ |
śrāddhapaṅktau tu bhuñjāno brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇaṃ spṛśet |
tad annam atyajan bhuktvā gāyatryaṣṭaśataṃ japet ||
vasiṣṭhaḥ |
niyuktas tu yadā śrāddhe daive vā māṃsam utsṛjet |
yāvanti paśuromāṇi tāvan narakam ṛcchati ||
māṃsagrahaṇam upalakṣaṇārthaṃ yato ’nyad api śrāddhe pariviṣṭam annam aparityājyam eva |
tad āha yamaḥ |
niyuktaś caiva yaḥ śrāddhe yat kiṃcit parivarjayet |
pitaras tasya taṃ māsaṃ nairāśyaṃ pratipedire ||
bṛhaspatiḥ |
[1024] daive niyuktaḥ śrāddhe vā niyamaṃ na visarjayet |
niṣiddhaṃ kurvatāṃ doṣas tad vai dvaidham akurvatām ||
jātūkarṇyaḥ |
bhājanaṃ pariviṣṭānnaṃ hastena brāhmaṇaḥ spṛśet |
rakṣobhyas trāyate yasmād dhāraṇīyaṃ prayatnataḥ ||
śrāddhānnam apahartukāmebhyo rakṣobhyo hastena pātraṃ spṛśan brāhmaṇas trāyate “brāhmaṇo hi rakṣasām apahantā” iti śatapathaśruteḥ | ataḥ pariveṣaṇāt prabhṛti hastena pātraṃ dhāraṇīyam |
vasiṣṭhaḥ |
ubhayor hastayor muktaṃ pitṛbhyo ’nnaṃ niveditam |
tadantaraṃ pratīkṣante hy asurā duṣṭacetasaḥ ||
tasmād śūnyaṃ hastena kuryād annam upāgatam |
bhājanaṃ vā samālabhya tiṣṭhed occheṣaṇād dvijaḥ ||
ubhayor brāhmaṇahastayor anyatamenāpi yadā tad annam anadhiṣṭhitaṃ bhavati tadantarālam asurāḥ sarvadā pratīkṣante labdhāntarāś ca tad annam apaharantīty arthaḥ | tasmād yadaivānnam upāgataṃ bhavati, tataḥ prabhṛtyoccheṣaṇāt bhuktaśiṣṭānnasya bhājanād bahiḥkaraṇaparyantaṃ vāmahastena bhājanaṃ vidhṛtya tiṣṭhet | kaṇḍūyanādyarthaṃ vāmahastavyāpārasamaye tu dakṣiṇahastena bhājanaṃ samālabhya vartteteti tātparyārthaḥ |
devatoddeśena tyāgāt pūrve pariviṣṭam annaṃ hastena na spraṣṭavyam ity āha atriḥ |
asaṃkalpitam annādyaṃ pāṇibhyāṃ ya upaspṛśet |
[1025] abhojyaṃ tad bhaved annaṃ pitṝṇāṃ nopatiṣṭhate ||
nigamaḥ |
māṃsāpūpaphalekṣvādi dantacchedaṃ na bhakṣayet |
grāmaśeṣaṃ na pātre ’syet pītaśeṣaṃ tu nā pibet ||
'dantacchedaṃ na bhakṣayet' hastena māṃsādi dhṛtvā svalpaṃ svalpaṃ dantaiḥ chittvā na bhakṣayet | ‘grāsaśeṣaṃ' mukhārpitagrāsaśeṣaṃ, punar bhojane nāsyet' na nikṣipet |
pracetāḥ |
dantacchedaṃ hastapānaṃ varjayec cātibhojanam |
'hastapānaṃ' hastena pāṇīyādipānaṃ, varjayet | api tu laghupātre naiva kuryāt | 'atibhojanaṃ' tṛptau satyām api bhojanam |
śātātapaḥ |
arddhaṃ bhuṅkte tu yo viprastasmin pātre jalaṃ pibet |
yad bhukaṃ tat pitṝṇāṃ tu śeṣaṃ vindyād athāsuram ||
jamadagniḥ |
na chideyur nāvaśeṣayeyuḥ |
nāvaśeṣayeyur iti niṣedho tṛptasya krodhamadādivaśāt svecchayā yad avaśeṣaṇaṃ tadviṣayaḥ |
yataḥ āha sumantuḥ |
ā tṛpter bhojanaṃ teṣāṃ kāmato nāvaśeṣaṇam |
tṛptau jātāyāṃ dadhyādīni vihāya yat kiṃcid avaśeṣaṇīyam |
tad āha uśanāḥ |
[1026] bhojanaṃ tu na niḥśeṣaṃ kuryāt prājñaḥ kathaṃcana |
anyatra dadhnaḥ kṣīrād vā kṣaudrāt saktubhya eva ca ||
'kṣaudraṃ' madhu |
jamadagnir api |
anyat punar utsraṣṭavyam | tasyāsaṃskṛtapramītānāṃ bhāgadheyatvāt |
'anyat' dadhyādibhyaḥ |
iti śrāddhabhoktṛniyamāḥ |
atha bhojayitṛniyamāḥ |
tatrāha manuḥ |
harṣayed brāhmaṇāṃs tuṣṭo bhojayec cāśanaṃ śanaiḥ |
annādyenāsakṛc cainān guṇaiś ca paricodayet ||
tuṣṭa iti saty api nimitte na svaduḥkhaṃ dīrghaśvāsocchvāsādinā kenacit prakāreṇa prakaṭayet | api tu hṛṣṭavat syāt | brāhmaṇān harṣayet | gītādinā paraprayuktena | aviruddhena svayaṃ prayuktena vā | prasaṅgāgatena parihāsena vā | tena cirakālaṃ svādhvāye paṭhyamāne yadi kaścid udvijet tato vīrasyākhyānaiḥ gītādibhir vā rañjayet | 'śanair bhojayet' katicid grāsān gṛhītvā tat svādv etat samyag vyañjanam ity evamādibhiḥ priyavacanair asaṃrambhena vadan bhojayet | 'annādyena' pāyasādinā, 'guṇaiḥ' vyañjanaiḥ | 'asakṛt' punaḥ punaḥ, 'paricodayet' sādhvya imāḥ śaṣkulyaḥ saraseyaṃ kṣīriṇīti pātrastham evamādi hastena gṛhītaṃ kṛtvā puraḥ sthitaḥ punaḥ punar brūyād ity eṣā paricodanā |
tathā |
[1027] yad yad roceta viprebhyas tat tad dadyād amatsaraḥ |
brahmodyāś ca kathāḥ kuryāt pitṝṇām etad īpsitam ||
brāhmaṇair ūdyante kathyante yās tāḥ brahmodyāḥ | devāsurayuddhaṃ, vṛtravadhaḥ, saramādūtam ityādyāḥ | atha vā kaścid ekākī caratītyādyāḥ | brahmādyā iti vā pāṭhaḥ, brahmapradhānā vā mantrārthavādanirūpaṇādyāḥ, 'kathāḥ' saṃlāpān laukikaiḥ śabdaiḥ kuryāt | pitṝṇām etad īpsitam ity arthavādaḥ |
yājñavalkyaḥ |
annam iṣṭaṃ haviṣyaṃ ca dadyād akrodhano ’tvaraḥ |
'iṣṭaṃ' brāhmaṇānāṃ priyam | vācaṃ yamatvādakathayatsv api brāhmaṇeṣu teṣām ādarātiśayād vā tat kṛtahastasaṃketena vānumāya yad yad abhīṣṭaṃ jānīyāt tat tat prayatnena dadyād ity arthaḥ |
sumantur api |
akrodhano rasān samyag dadyād yad yasya rocate |
apekṣitāpradāne doṣam āha śātātapaḥ |
apekṣitaṃ yo na dadyāc chrāddhārtham upakalpitam |
kṛpaṇo mandabuddhiś ca na sa śrāddhaphalaṃ labhet ||
na kevalaṃ śrāddhaphalālābhaḥ api tu kaṣṭatarajanmaprāptir api |
tathā ca nigamaḥ |
apekṣitaṃ yo na dadyāc chrāddhārtham upakalpitam |
adhaḥkṛcchrāsu ghorāsa tiryagyoniṣu jāyate ||
yama-śātātapau |
yāvad dhaviṣyam bhavati yāvat sviṣṭaṃ pradīyate |
[1028] tāvad aśnanti pitaro yāvan nāha dadāmy aham |
'nāhetyādi' | bhuñjāneṣu brāhmaṇeṣu punar annadānasamaye nābhyadhikaṃ bhaviṣyatīti jñāpanārtham īṣad dadāmīti dātrā mukhato na vaktavyaṃ kiṃ tu tūṣṇīṃ kiṃcit pradarśanābhyanujñāsūcakahastasaṃkete saty annādyaguṇān anukīrtya dātavyam |
yata āha bṛhaspatiḥ |
bhakṣyabhojyaguṇān uktvā bhojayet brāhmaṇān śanaiḥ |
ākhyānaiḥ setihāsaiś ca pūrvavṛttaiś ca harṣayet ||
tāṃś ca havirguṇadeśau na pṛcched ity āha śaṅkhaḥ |
śrāddhe niyuktān bhuñjānān na pṛcchel lavaṇādiṣu |
ucchiṣṭāḥ pitaro yānti pṛcchato nātra saṃśayaḥ |
dātuḥ patati bāhur vai jihvā bhoktus tu bhidyate ||
lavaṇādiṣu nyūnādhikyābhāvena haviṣaḥ sādguṇyaṃ punar api pradānārthaṃ na pṛcchet | na ca pṛṣṭvā samyak tena jñātaṃ dadyāt | dātuḥ patati bāhur iti doṣasmaraṇāt | jihvā bhoktus tu bhidyata iti nindābalād dhaviṣaḥ sādguṇyaṃ saṃketenāpi bhoktā na sūcayed iti niṣedhavidhir gamyate |
brahmapurāṇe |
ekāgraḥ paryupāsīta prayataḥ prāñjaliḥ sthitaḥ |
tatparaḥ śraddadhānaś ca kāmān āpnoti mānavaḥ ||
yamaḥ |
niroṅkāreṇa yad bhukaṃ pariviṣṭaṃ samanyunā |
durātmanā ca yad bhukaṃ tad vai rakṣāṃsi gacchati ||
[1029] avedavratacāritrās tribhir varṇair dvijātayaḥ |
mantravat pariviṣyante tad vai rakṣāṃsi gacchati ||
vidhihīnam amṛṣṭānnaṃ mantrahīnam adakṣiṇam |
aśraddhayā hutaṃ japtaṃ tad vai rakṣāṃsi gacchati ||
manuḥ |
nāstram āpādayej jātu na kupyen nānṛtaṃ vadet |
na pādena spṛśed annaṃ na vai tad avadhūnayet ||
'asraṃ' rodanaṃ na kuryāt | prāyeṇa pretaśrāddhādāv iṣṭaviyogajanitaḥ duḥkhānusmaraṇād aśrupāto jāyate tasya niṣedhaḥ nānandāśruṇaḥ | anṛtavadanasya puruṣārthatayā niṣiddhasya karmārtho 'yaṃ niṣedhaḥ | ucchiṣṭam anucchiṣṭaṃ vā annaṃ pādena na spṛśet | vastreṇa cānnaṃ nāvadhūnayet | asyārthavādaḥ |
astraṃ gamayati pretaṃ kāpo ’rīn anṛtaṃ śunaḥ |
pādasparśas tu rakṣāṃsi duṣkṛtīn avadhūnanam ||
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
na cāśru pātayej jātu na śuklāṃ giram īrayet |
