brāhmaṇaṃ ca yathāśaktyā ekaikasya pṛthak pṛthak |
ekaikaṃ ca trayāṇāṃ vāpy ekam eva nimantrayet ||
dvijaṃ mātāmahānām apy eṣa eva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
tataḥ pādau parispṛśya dvijasyedam udīrayet ||
śraddhāpūtena manasā pitṛbhaktiparāyaṇaḥ |
pitā me tava kārye ’smiṃs tathaiva ca pitāmahaḥ |
svapitrā sahito ’bhyetu tvaṃ ca vrataparo bhava ||
evaṃ pitṝn samāhūya tathā mātāmahān atha |
savyaṃ kṛtvā namaskṛtya tān viprān svagṛhaṃ vrajet ||
atra pracetovākye praṇipatya nimantrayed ity uktaṃ, tat tu smṛticandrikākāraḥ śūdrakartṛviṣayam ity abhidhāya brahmāṇḍapurāṇavākyaṃ pramāṇatvena darśitavān |
[1158] dakṣiṇaṃ caraṇaṃ vipraḥ savyaṃ vai kṣatriyas tathā |
pādāv ādāya vaiśyo dvau śūdraḥ praṇatipūrvakam |
nimantrayīta pūrvedyuḥ śrāddhakartā dvijottamān || iti |
dakṣiṇacaraṇopādāne pradeśaviśeṣo nimantraṇīyaṃ pratinimantrapitṛprayojyaṃ vākyaṃ niyamaśrāvaṇaṃ ca pādma-mātsyayoḥ purāṇayor darśitam |
pūrvedyur aparedyur vā vinītātmā nimantrayet |
dakṣiṇaṃ jānum ālabhya tvaṃ mayātra nimantritaḥ ||
evaṃ nimantrya niyamān śrāvayet pitṛbāndhavaḥ |
akrodhanaiḥ śaucaparaiḥ satataṃ brahmacāribhiḥ |
bhavitavyaṃ bhavadbhiś ca mayātra śrāddhakāriṇā ||
'pitṛbāndhavaḥ' prakṛtaśrāddhasaṃbandhipitṛsapiṇḍasamānodakādis tatpreṣito vā nimantraṇakartā | atra kecid dakṣiṇajānvālambhanaṃ vaiśvadevikadvijanimantraṇaviṣayam āhuḥ | tad ayuktaṃ, tatpurāṇasthitanimantraṇaviṣayanikhilavacanapaurvāparyaparyālocanāyāṃ sādhāraṇasyaiva pratīyamānatvāt | atrir api niyamaśrāvaṇam āha |
prathame 'hni nivāsasthān śrotriyādīn nimantrayet |
kathayec ca tadaivaiṣāṃ niyogān pitṛdaivikān ||
sarvāyāsavinirmukaiḥ kāmakrodhavivarjitaiḥ |
bhavitavyaṃ bhavadbhir vai śvobhūte śrāddhakarmaṇi || iti |
'prathame ’hni' pūrvedyur ity arthaḥ | evaṃ nimantraṇakartrā vākye ’bhihite nimantraṇīyabrāhmaṇābhidheyam āha sa eva |
tatas tathety avighnena gateyaṃ rajanī yadi |
[1159] yathāśrutaṃ pratīkṣeran śrāddhakālam atandritāḥ ||
tena nimantritā viprās taṃ nimantraṇakartāraṃ tathāstu yady avighneneyaṃ rajanīgatety uktvā dharmaśāstrādau yathāniyamajātaṃ śrutaṃ tathaiva tanniyamajātaṃ 'pratīkṣeran' paripālayeyuḥ | 'śrāddhakāle' svāditānnapariṇāmaparyantam ity arthaḥ |
yamenāpi nimantraṇīyābhidheyam uktam |
tenoṃ tathety avighnena gateyaṃ rajanī yadi || iti |
'tena' nimantraṇīyena, oṃ tathetyādyabhidheyam ity arthaḥ |
devalaḥ |
kāmaṃ pratiśravas teṣām anindyāmantraṇe kṛte |
'teṣāṃ' brāhmaṇānāṃ anindyenāmantraṇe kriyamāṇe kāmaṃ nikāmaṃ atyarthaṃ, 'pratiśravaḥ' abhyupagamaḥ, kartavyo bhavati | abhyupagatanimantras tu ābrahmaṇeo brahmavarcasī jāyatām ityādīni yogakṣemo naḥ kalpatām ityantāni yajūṃṣi japet, āmantrito japed dogdhrīm iti bhṛgusmaraṇāt
iti nimantraṇetikartavyatā |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasamastakaraṇādhipati-
paṇḍitaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau
pariśeṣakhaṇḍe śrāddhakalpe nimantraṇaprakaraṇaṃ
nāma ekādaśo ’dhyāyaḥ ||
[1160]
atha dvādaśo ’dhyāyaḥ |
goṣṭhīśālākalānāṃ kulagṛhamalaghuḥ ślāghyapuṇyodayānāṃ
vidyānāṃ parṣadādyo madhumadhuravacaḥ saṃpadāṃ yaś ca koṣaḥ |
so ’yaṃ hemādrisūriḥ kuśamukulaśikhātīkṣṇabuddhiḥ prasiddhaḥ
śrāddhe pūrvāhṇakṛtyaṃ nigadati dalayan saṃśayaṃ tatparāṇām ||
atha śrāddhadinapūrvāhṇatyam |
tatra pākādikṛtyam |
atha śrāddhakartā brāhme muhūrte utthāya yathopadeśaṃ śaucavidhiṃ vidhāyācāmet | dantadhāvanaṃ tu na kuryāt |
tathā ca śrutiḥ |
klinnadantaḥ pitṝn yajeta || iti |
'klinnadantaḥ' anapanītamalalepadantaḥ |
śātātapo ’pi śrāddhadine dantadhāvananiṣedham āha |
śuddhyarthaṃ prātar utthāya bhakṣayed dantadhāvanam |
śrāddhe yajñe ’tha niyame patyau ca proṣite na tu ||
śrāddhādau niṣpādyatvena prastute sati dantadhāvanaṃ na kuryād anyatra kuryād ity arthaḥ |
prabhāsakhaṇḍe |
upavāse tathā śrāddhe na khāded antadhāvanam |
dantānāṃ kāṣṭhasaṃyogo hanti saptakulāni vai |
[1161] ayaṃ ca niṣedhaḥ śrāddhakartur eva na punaḥ śrāddhabhoktur api |
ata eva pracetaḥsmṛti-bhaviṣyottarayoḥ |
śrāddhabhuk prātar utthāya prakuryād dantadhāvanam |
śrāddhakartā na kurvīta dantānāṃ dhāvanaṃ budhaḥ ||
ataḥ śrāddhakartā dantadhāvanam akṛtvaiva śaucācamanavidhiṃ niṣpādayet | tato nadyādau yathālābhaṃ mukhyakalpike vā jalāśaye yathoktasnānaṃ kuryāt, "snāto ’dhikārī bhavati" ityādiviṣṇuvacanāt | tataḥ pūrvoktavidhinā tarpaṇaṃ vidhāya jalād avatīrya svayaṃ vā sutaśiṣyādinā dhaute ahate site vāsasī paridhānād bahiḥ kakṣābandham akurvan paridadhīta | anantaraṃ saṃdhyām upāsya prokṣaṇam ādāya gṛhaṃ gatvā naityikaṃ prātarhomaṃ kṛtvā pākabhūmim upalepanādibhiḥ saṃskuryāt |
tathā ca brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
bhūmiḥ śrāddhe pañcagavyaiḥ liptā śodhyā tatholmukaiḥ |
gauramṛttikayācchannā prakīrṇatilasarṣapā ||
devalasmṛti-kūrmapurāṇayoḥ |
tikhān avakiret tatra sarvato bandhayed ajān |
āsuropahataṃ sarvaṃ tilaiḥ śudhyaty ajena ca || iti |
anantaraṃ pākārambhaṃ cikīrṣan pākabhūmeḥ sakāśād apāsanīyaprakaraṇoktān bībhatsamatsari-mattadhūrtaśūdraśūdrīpatitapāṣaṇḍaṣaṇḍakāṇakuṇibhrūṇahantṛśvitrikuṣṭhirajasvalāsvairiṇī-saṃkīrṇayonikubjavāmanachinnahīnātiriktāṅgapaṅguviḍvarāhakharakarabhakaraṭakukkuṭa - śunakanakulabiḍāla caṇḍālanīlīkaṣāyavāsaso dūrataram [1162] utsārya bhojanabhāṇḍādīni yathārhaṃ cālayet | athaivaṃ saṃskṛtāyāṃ bhuvi śodhiteṣu naveṣu ca bhāṇḍeṣu pākaṃ kartum upakramet |
tathā ca devalaḥ |
tathaiva yantrito dātā prātaḥ snātvā sahāmbaraḥ |
ārabheta navaiḥ pātrair annārambhaṃ ca bāndhavaiḥ ||
ayam arthaḥ | snātaḥ snātayā parihitādhāvakadhautaśvetavāsasā patnyā saha śaktiyuktaḥ svayam eva samastapākārambhasamāptī kuryāt | aśaktaś cet svayam ārambhamātraṃ kṛtvā anvārambhaṃ bāndhavaiḥ svajanaiḥ kārayet | atra pāṭhāntaraṃ anvārambhaṃ ca bāndhavair iti | pāṭhāntaraṃ ca annārambhavatāṃ vidhir iti |
patnyā svahastena pākaḥ kartavya ity atrārthe liṅgadarśanaṃ camatkārakhaṇḍe |
tataś ca śrapayāmāsa tadarthaṃ janakodbhavā |
rāmādeśāt svayaṃ sādhvī vinayena samanvitā ||
prabhāsakhaṇḍe ’pi |
athaitāni papācāśu sītā janakanandinī |
ayaṃ ca pākārambho ’gnimatā mantravan nirvāpapūrvakaḥ kartavyaḥ |
tathā ca pādma-mātsyapurāṇayoḥ |
agnimān nirvapet paitre caruṃ cāsamamuṣṭibhiḥ |
pitṛbhyo nirvapāmīti sarvaṃ dakṣiṇato nyaset ||
carugrahaṇād odana eva nirvāpo vijñāyate na sūpaśākādiṣu | 'asamamuṣṭibhiḥ' viṣamasaṃkhyakair muṣṭibhiḥ |
atra navaiḥ pātrair ity asya sāṃvatsarika evāvaśyakatvaṃ nānyatreti vadantaḥ kecid vacanaṃ darśayanti |
[1163] nūtanāmantrakaraṇaṃ brāhmaṇābhyañjanaṃ tathā |
śrāddhāt pūrvam adānaṃ ca pratyabde tritayaṃ bhavet || iti |
tad ayuktaṃ, pratyabdagrahaṇasyādarātiśayārthatvenābhyupapatteḥ, darśaśrāddhaprakaraṇāmnātānāṃ nūtanabhāṇḍādīnāṃ utkarṣīpatteś ca |
bhūbhāṇḍasaṃskārānantaram uktaṃ devalasmṛti-kūrmapurāṇayoḥ |
tato ’nnaṃ bahusaṃskāraṃ naikavyañjanabhakṣyavat |
coṣyapeyasamṛddhaṃ ca yathāśakti prakalpayet ||
asyārthaḥ | vicitrasaṃskāram aticamatkāribahuprakāravesavarasāraṃ vrīhiyavagodhūmavikāra- prāyam abhiprāyānukūlamūlamukulaphalakusumakandakandalaśakalakalpitālpavyañjanam atirucyakūrcikāpānakapāyasarasālārasāraṃ asitatilamudgakhaḍgacchāgameṣāmiṣa-māṣaviracitarucirapākaviśeṣam upacitamarīcaguḍakhaṇḍamātsyaṇḍikāhiṅgusaindhavakarpūra-
kuṅkumailādhūpādisādhitaṃ bhakṣyabhojyalehyacoṣyapeyādibhedabhinnaṃ gandhavarṇarasasaṃpannam annaṃ niṣpādayet | etac ca yathāśakti saṃpādanīyam |
ata evāha gautamaḥ |
śaktitaḥ prakarṣayed guṇasaṃskāravidhīn annasyeti |
annānāṃ samīcīnajātirūparasagandhasparśavattvaṃ 'guṇāḥ' | dravyakriyādibhir atiśayādhānaṃ 'saṃskāraḥ', etayoḥ 'vidhīn' prakārān, yathāśakti ‘prakarṣayet' śaktyanusāreṇa prakṛṣṭāt saṃpādayed ity arthaḥ |
āha parāśaraḥ |
iṣṭāpūrtamṛtāheṣu parvavṛddhyaṣṭhakāṣu ca |
[1164] pātrebhyas tu yathāśakti svādv annaṃ pratipādayet ||
atra sāgnikena vaiśvadevārthaṃ pṛthakpākaḥ kartavya iti vaiśvadevādiprakaraṇe ’bhihitam |
samāpte ca pāke śrāddhabhūmisaṃskāraḥ kartavyaḥ | tatra śrāddhayogyā bhūmir viṣṇudharmottare |
gomayenopalipteṣu śrāddhakāryagṛheṣu ca |
manojñeṣu vicitreṣu rucireṣūttameṣu ca |
udyāneṣu vicitreṣu saikateṣu sameṣu ca ||
padmapurāṇe |
tīrthāyatanagoṣṭheṣu dvīpodyānagṛheṣu ca |
vivikteṣūpalipteṣu śrāddhaṃ deyaṃ vijānatā ||
yamaḥ |
dakṣiṇapravaṇaṃ snigdhaṃ viviktaṃ śubhalakṣaṇam |
śubhaṃ deśaṃ parīkṣyāśu gomayenopalepayet ||
matsya-pādmapurāṇayoḥ |
gomayenopalipte tu dakṣiṇāpravaṇe sthale |
śrāddhaṃ samārabhed bhaktyā goṣṭhe vā jalasaṃnidhau ||
atra prayatnenāpi dakṣiṇāpravaṇatvaṃ saṃpādayed ity āha manuḥ |
śuciṃ deśaṃ viviktaṃ ca gomayenopalepayet |
dakṣiṇāpravaṇaṃ caiva prayatnenopapādayet ||
'śuciḥ' bhasmāsthikapālikādyanupahataḥ | 'viviktaḥ' vistīrṇaḥ bahubhir janair anākīrṇaś ca, ‘dakṣiṇāpravaṇaḥ' dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśy avanataḥ, tādṛśaṃ deśaṃ prayatnena saṃpādayet | taṃ ca gośakṛtopalāpayet |
[1165] kūrmapurāṇe |
dakṣiṇāpravaṇaṃ snigdhaṃ viviktaṃ śubhalakṣaṇam |
śuciṃ deśaṃ vivikaṇ ca gomayenopalepayet ||
paiṭhīnasiḥ |
śucau deśe gavāṃ goṣṭhe ’gnyāgāre vā gomayenopalipya
puṣpopahāraṃ kṛtvā |
puṣpāṇāṃ ‘upahāraḥ' upaharaṇaṃ vikiraṇam iti yāvat, dvijān upaveśayed ity uttareṇa saṃbandhaḥ|
āha viṣṇuḥ |
saṃvṛte ca śrāddhaṃ kuryāt na rajasvalāṃ paśyen na śvānaṃ na viḍvarāhaṃ na
grāmyakukkuṭaṃ prayatnāc chrāddham ajasya darśayet |
rajasvalādigrahaṇam apāsanīyaprakaraṇoktānāṃ sarveṣāṃ nagnādīnāṃ upalakṣaṇārtham | ‘ajaḥ' chāgaḥ | sa yathā saṃnidhau nibaddhaḥ kriyamānaṃ śrāddhaṃ paśyet tathā prayatnena kartavyam |
viṣṇudharmottare |
rajasvalā ca ṣaṇḍaś ca śvānaḥ śukarakukkuṭāḥ |
yathā śrāddhaṃ na paśyanti tathā kāryaṃ vijānatā |
rakṣārthaṃ cāsya vai teṣāṃ guptiḥ kāryā nareśvara |
tathā |
vastasaṃdarśanaṃ śastaṃ śrāddhe nityam arindama |
kutapasya ca sāṃnidhyaṃ tathā kṛṣṇājinasya ca ||
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
tasmāt parivṛte dadyāt tilaiś cānvavakīrayet |
[1166] rākṣasānāṃ tilarakṣā śunāṃ vai saṃvṛtena ca |
mahābhārate |
śvānaś ca paṅktidūṣāś ca nāvekṣeran kathaṃcana |
tasmāt parivṛte dadyāt tilāṃś cānvavakīrayet ||
brahmapurāṇe |
jaghāna dānavau viṣṇuḥ pūrvaṃ tu madhukaiṭabhau |
vṛtraṃ mahendraś ca tataḥ pṛthvī tan medasāvṛtā ||
tato ’rthaṃ medinī sā tu loke vai jñāyate janaiḥ |
tasmāc chrāddhe pañcagavyair lepyā śodhyā tatholmukaiḥ |
gauramṛttikayācchannā prakīrṇā tilasarṣapaiḥ ||
'ulmukaiḥ' samantād ulmukanidhānena, tatra 'ye rūpāṇīti piṇḍapitṛyajñopadiṣṭo mantraś ca prayojyaḥ |
kolāyāṃ varāhakṛtaṃ śrāddham adhikṛtya brahmapurāṇe |
daṃṣṭrayollikhya ca mahīm abhyukṣya salilena ca |
dharmodbhavenopalipya kuśair ullikhyitāṃ punaḥ |
pariṇīyolmukenainām abhyukṣya ca punaḥ punaḥ ||
atra śrāddhaṃ kurvatā varāheṇaivaṃvidho bhūsaṃskāraḥ kṛta ity ato liṅgadarśanād anyenāpy evam eva kartavya ity avagamyate | śrāddhaprakṛtibhūte ’pi pitṛyajñe vajrasyollekhanasādhanatvena vidhānād daṃṣṭragrahaṇam avivakṣitam | 'dharmodbhavaḥ' gomayam | 'pariṇīya' samantād apradakṣiṇaparibhramitenolmukena parigatāṃ kṛtvety arthaḥ |
evaṃ samāpte gṛhakarmāṇi gṛhajanakṛtyam āha hārītaḥ |
kṛtakarmāṇaḥ sastrībālavṛddhāḥ surabhisnātāḥ śucayaḥ
śucivāsasaḥ syuḥ |
'surabhisnātāḥ' sugandhitailādidravyasnātāḥ | etac ca prāyeṇābhyudayikaviṣayaṃ
bhavitum arhati |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
strībālavṛddhaiḥ snātavyaṃ taddine śrāddhakāribhiḥ |
niyataiś caiva tair bhāvyaṃ yāvac chrāddhaṃ samāpyate ||
athāhuḥ sārddhaprahare vyatīte nimantritānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ nakharomakalpanaṃ kārayet |
vārāhapurāṇe |
prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvayām udite ca divākare |
divākīrttiṃ samānīya viprāya vidhipūrvaśaḥ ||
śmāśrukarma ca karttavyaṃ nakhacchedas tathaiva ca |
snāpanābhyañjanaṃ dadyāt pitṛbhaktas tu sundari ||
'divākīrttiḥ' nāpitaḥ |
bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
tailam udvartanaṃ snānaṃ dadyāt pūrvāhṇa eva tu |
śrāddhabhumau nakhaśmaśrucchedanaṃ cāpi kārayet ||
tailodvartanādidāne pātraviśeṣo devalasmṛti-kūrmapurāṇayor darśitaḥ |
tato nivṛtte madhyāhne luptaromanakhān dvijān |
abhigamya yathāmārgaṃ prayacched dantadhāvanam ||
tailam udvartanaṃ snānaṃ snānīyaṃ ca pṛthagvidham |
pātrair audumbarair dadyād vaiśvadevikapūrvakam |
[1168]
'luptaromanakhān’ kṛttaromanakhān | 'yathāmārgaṃ' yathāvidhi | 'snānaṃ' snānārthaṃ uṣṇodakaṃ, 'snānīyaṃ' snānopakaraṇabhūtaṃ surabhidravyādi | ‘audumbaraiḥ’ tāmramayaiḥ | udumbarādiyajñiyavṛkṣajair vā | tailadānaṃ tv aniṣiddhatailāsu tithiṣu veditavyam | 'tato’nivṛtte madhyāhnae' ity atra anivṛtte madhyāhna ity akārapraśleṣo draṣṭavyaḥ | anyathā pradhānakarmakālātipātaḥ syāt pūrvoktapūrvāhṇakālavirodhaś ca |
ata eva mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |
ahnaḥ ṣaṭsu muhūrteṣu gateṣu tv atha tān dvijān |
pratyekaṃ preṣayet preṣyān snānāyāmalakodakān ||
dvādaśaghaṭikābhya ūrdhvaṃ nimantritabrāhmaṇānāṃ snānārthaṃ paricārakāṇāṃ haste āmalakakalkaṃ pradāya nimantritabrāhmaṇebhyaḥ pratyekaṃ dīyatām iti tān prati paricārakān preṣayed ity arthaḥ | etad āmalakakalkadānaṃ pratiṣiddhatailāsu tithiṣu draṣṭavyam | tāsv apy amāvāsyādivyatiriktāsu deyam iti smṛticandrikākāraḥ | dhātrīphalair amavāsyāyāṃ na snāyād ity āmalakodakasnānasyāmāvāsyāyāṃ niṣedhāt | aniṣiddhatailāyāṃ tu tithau snānārthaṃ tailādi deyam iti devalavacane darśitam eva |
kātyāyanasmṛti-prabhāsakhaṇḍayor api |
tailam udvartanaṃ snānaṃ dantadhāvanam eva ca |
kṛttaromanakhebhyas tu dadyāt tebhyo ’pare ’hani ||
kṛttaromanakhebhyo nimantritebhyas tailādikaṃ snānasādhanaṃ dantadhāvanasādhanaṃ ca kāṣṭhādikaṃ dadyād ity arthaḥ |
yat tu pracetasoktam |
tailam udvartanaṃ snānaṃ dadyāt pūrvāhna eva tu |
śrāddhabhugbhyo nakhaśmaśrucchedanaṃ na tu kārayet || iti ||
tatra śrāddhabhujāṃ nakhādicchedananiṣedho niṣiddhakṣurakarmatithiviṣayaḥ | atha vā śrāddhakartā śrāddhabhugbhyaḥ tailādikaṃ dadyāt | ātmanaś ca nakhādicchedanaṃ na kārayed iti vyākhyeyam | brāhmaṇānāṃ gṛhaṃ prati tailodvartanādi preṣaṇīyam ity uktam | yeṣāṃ tu grāmāntarād āgatānāṃ gṛhaṃ nāsti teṣāṃ yajamānena svagṛham āgatānāṃ śmaśrukarmābhyañjanādi kārayitavyam ity āha yamaḥ |
śrāddhakāle samāhūtān alaṃkurvīta tān dvijān |
śmaśrukarmaśiraḥsnānadhūpanābhyañjanāñjanaiḥ |
āsanaṃ kutapaṃ dadyād itarad vā pavitrakam ||
śrāddhārthānāṃ ca bhājanāsanagandhapūṣpadhūpādīnāṃ dravyāṇāṃ pūrvāhṇa eva saṃbharaṇaṃ kartavyam | atha yajamāno yathālābhaṃ tīrthe mādhyāhnikaṃ karmaṅgaṃ ca snānaṃ tantreṇa nirvartayet |
uktaṃ hi karmārambhe snānaṃ matsyapurāṇe |
nairmalyaṃ bhāvaśuddhiś ca vinā snānaṃ na vidyate |
tasmān manoviśuddhyarthaṃ snānam ādau vidhīyate ||
nāgarakhaṇḍe ’pi |
pitṝn uddiśya yad dravyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradīyate |
snātair dhautāmbarair martyais tad bhavet tṛptidaṃ mahat |
pitṝṇaṃ sarvadeveśa ity eṣā vaidikī śrutiḥ ||
atra śrāddham adhikṛtya viśeṣo bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
[1170] kartuḥ snānaṃ bhavet tīrthe prātar madhyāhna eva tu |
uṣṇodakena vāśaktaḥ kurvīta sakṛd eva tat ||
tato devarṣipitṛtarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā jalād avatīryāhate dhaute śvete vāsasī pūrvavat paridadhīta |
tathā ca vasiṣṭaḥ |
japahomopavāseṣu dhautavastraḥ sadā bhavet |
alaṃkṛtaḥ śucir maunī śrāddhādau vijitendriyaḥ ||
āha pracetāḥ |
śrāddhakṛc chuklavāsāḥ syāt || iti |
yat tu vastraprakaraṇoktavyāsavacane dhāturaktasyāpi pavitratvaṃ smaryate tat śrāddhavyatiriktaviṣayaṃ kṣatriyādiviṣayaṃ vā |
kāṣāyaraktasya nindām āha baudhāyanaḥ |
kāṣāyavāsāḥ kurute japahomapratigrahān |
na tad devagamaṃ bhavati havyakavyeṣv atho haviḥ || iti |
'havyakavyeṣu' iti tatsādhyeṣu karmaṣv ity arthaḥ |
viśeṣāntaraṃ bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
avāgyato dhautapādaḥ pāṭitāmbarasaṃyutaḥ |
tasmād bahir baddhakakṣo bahirjānukaras tathā ||
evaṃ vāsasī paridhāya dvir ācamya mādhyāhnikaṃ saṃdhyāvidhiṃ vidhāya karmārthaṃ tīrthodakāny āharet |
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
udakānayanaṃ kṛtvā paścād viprāṃś ca bhojayet |
[1171] atra viśeṣasahitaṃ jalāharaṇaṃ kuśāharaṇaṃ ca kūrmapurāṇe |
śvobhūte dakṣiṇāṃ gatvā diśaṃ darbhān samāhitaḥ |
samūlān āhared vāri dakṣiṇāgraṃ tu nirmalam ||
'dakṣiṇāgraṃ' dakṣiṇāpravāhaṃ jalāśayaṃ dakṣiṇabhāgasthitaṃ vā | pūrvedyur nimantraṇaṃ vidhāyāha hārītaḥ |
atha śvobhūte dakṣiṇāṃ diśaṃ gatvā dakṣiṇāpraṇatān samūlān darbhān āharet | aparigṛhītāś cāpa iti |
'aparigṭahītāḥ' pūrvam anyenāsvīkṛtāḥ |
aha yamaḥ |
samūlas tu bhaved darbhaḥ pitṝṇāṃ śrāddhakarmaṇi |
mūlena lokān jayati śakrasya tu mahātmanaḥ ||
atra vistareṇa darbhalakṣaṇaṃ jalalakṣaṇaṃ tadubhayāharaṇe vidhiś ca pūrvoktaḥ |
śrāddhārthodakāharaṇe viśeṣo mahābhārate |
udakānayane caiva stotavyo varuṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
atra stutisvarūpaviśeṣānabhidhānād imaṃ me varuṇa ityādinā yena kenacid varuṇadaivatyena mantraṇa stotavya iti gamyate | tīrthād abhyukṣaṇajalāharaṇāsaṃbhave maṇikād api tadāharaṇaṃ pūrvam eva pratipāditam |
tīrthān maṇikāder vā samāhṛtasyodakasya kāryam āha yogayājñavalakyaḥ |
tenodakena dravyāṇi prokṣyācamya punar gṛhe |
tataḥ karmāṇi kurvīta vihitāni ca kānicit ||
prokṣaṇetikartavyatā tu pṛthivīstutyādikṛtyaprakaraṇe vakṣyate |
tato nṛvarāhapūjāṃ kuryād ity uktaṃ viṣṇudharmottare |
[1172] śrāddhāhni prayataḥ snātaḥ svācāntaḥ susamāhitaḥ |
śuklavāsāḥ samabhyarcya nṛvarāhaṃ janārdanam ||
śrāddham ārabheteti śeṣaḥ |
śivapurāṇe |
pūjayitvā śivaṃ bhaktyā pitṛśrāddhaṃ prakalpayet |
kṛtvā tu vidhivac chrāddhaṃ bhuñjīta pitṛsevitam ||
atra sāgniko ’māvāsyāśrāddhaṃ kariṣyan pūrvaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ piṇḍapitṛyajñaṃ ca krameṇa kuryāt | śrāddhāntaraṃ kariṣyaṃs tu pūrvaṃ vaiśvadevabaliharaṇādi kuryāditi pūrvaṃ prapañcitam |
iti pākādikṛtyam |
atha śrāddhasaṃpadaḥ |
tatra saṃpādanīyoddeśaḥ |
manu-vasiṣṭha-yama-hārīta-śātātapāḥ |
aparāhṇas tilā darbhā vāstusaṃpādanaṃ tathā |
sṛṣṭir mṛṣṭir dvijāś cāgryāḥ śrāddhakarmasu saṃpadaḥ ||
atrāparāhṇatiladarbhāḥ pūrvam eva svaprakaraṇe vyākhyātāḥ | 'vāstu' śrāddhārthaṃ veśma, tasya 'saṃpādanaṃ' avidyamānasyotpādanaṃ vidyamānasya ca parakīyasya krayādyupāyena svīkaraṇaṃ dakṣiṇāpravaṇatvasamīkaraṇopalepasaṃmārjanādīnāṃ saṃskaraṇaṃ ca | 'sṛṣṭiḥ' utsṛṣṭir utsargas tyāga ity anarthantaram akārpaṇyenātra vyañjanādidānam iti yāvat | 'mṛṣṭiḥ' mārjanaṃ svādutā vā | 'agryāḥ' śrotriyatvādiviśeṣaśālinaḥ | etāni vastūni [1173] 'śrāddhasaṃpadaḥ' śrāddhārthaṃ dravyasamṛddhayaḥ | saṃpacchabdāc ca śrāddhārthinā sarvāṇy etāni saṃpādanīyānīti sūcitam |
evaṃ pitryakarmasaṃpado ’bhidhāya daivikakarmasaṃpado ’pi ta evāhuḥ |
darbhāḥ pavitraṃ pūrvāhṇo haviṣyāṇi ca sarvaśaḥ |
pavitraṃ yac ca pūrvoktaṃ vijñeyā havyasaṃpadaḥ ||
atrādyapavitraśabdena mantrā jalādigālanārthaṃ vastraṃ vā kuśapavitrāṇi vā | 'pūrvāhṇaḥ' pūrvam eva vyākhyātaḥ | 'pavitram' pāvanaṃ śucyācāratādi | yac ca pūrvoktaṃ vāstusaṃpādanādi havyaśabdena daivikaṃ karma tat saṃbandhibrāhmaṇabhojanādi copalakṣyate |
mahābhārate |
śrāddhasya brāhmaṇaḥ kālaḥ pātraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ payaḥ |
somakṣayaś ca māsaś ca tadāraṇyaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ||
śrāddhasyety atraitāḥ saṃpada iti puraṇīyam |
āha parāśaraḥ |
kālaḥ pātraṃ tathā deśo dravyaṃ kartā pitāmahaḥ |
niṣpattikāraṇany āhuḥ karmaṇo ’sya vipaścitaḥ ||
satyavrataḥ |
pitṛprītinimittāni dravyaṃ pātraṃ suto vidhiḥ |
pradhānapātram eteṣāṃ pātrasiddhyai yated ataḥ ||
brahmapurāṇe |
upamūlaṃ sakṛl lūnān kuśāṃs tatropakalpayet |
yavāṃs tilān vṛśīḥ kāṃsyaṃ āpaḥ śuddhaiḥ samāhṛtāḥ ||
[1174] pārṇarājatatāmrāṇi pātrāṇi syuḥ samin madhu |
puṣpadhūpasugandhādi kṣaumasutraṃ ca mekṣaṇam ||
'tatra' śrāddhadeśa ity arthaḥ | 'vṛśī' vratiyogyāni kuśādinirmitāny āsanāni | ‘kāṃsyaṃ' kaṃsyamayam agnaukaraṇādyarthaṃ bhājanaṃ 'śuddhaiḥ’ āhartṛbhiḥ,‘samāhṛtāḥ' ity apāṃ viśeṣaṇam | anena ca niṣiddhānām apām upakalpananiṣedhaḥ sūcyate | 'pārṇarājatatāmrāṇi' parṇarajatatāmranirmitāni | yathāsāmarthyaṃ caitāny upakalpanīyāni | 'kṣaumasūtraṃ' dukūlasūtraṃ, 'mekṣaṇaṃ' yajñiyadārumayī darvī, vṛśīṇāṃ bhojanabhājanānāṃ copakalpanaṃ pratibrāhmaṇaṃ kartavyam | sugandhādīty atrādigrahaṇād akṣatadīpācchādanādikaṃ gṛhyate |
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
yatis tridaṇḍī karuṇā rājataṃ pātram eva ca |
dauhitraḥ kutapaḥ kālaṃ chāgaḥ kṛṣṇājinaṃ tathā ||
gaurāḥ kṛṣṇās tathāraṇyās tathaiva trividhās tilāḥ |
pitṝṇaṃ tṛptaye sṛṣṭā daśaite brahmaṇā svayam ||
atra tridaṇḍīti yater viśeṣaṇaṃ rājatam iti pātrasya, kutapa iti kālasya | gaurās tilāḥ kṛṣṇās tilāḥ āraṇyās tilā iti guṇānurūpeṇa trayaḥ padārthāḥ, evaṃ ca daśasaṃkhyā ghaṭate |
āha devalaḥ |
pradhānaṃ ca pavitraṃ ca śaucam evāṣṭakāvidhau |
pitaraḥ śaucakāmā hi niḥspṛhā dhautakalmaṣāḥ ||
darbhās tilā gajacchāyā dauhitro madhusarpiṣī |
kutapo nīlaṣāṇḍaś ca pavitrāṇy āha paitṛke ||
[1175]
'aṣṭakāvidhau' śrāddhavidhau | aṣṭakāvidhiśabdaḥ pitryakarmopalakṣaṇārtham iti hariharaḥ | 'nīlaṣāṇḍaḥ' nīlavṛṣaḥ |
paiṭhīnasiḥ |
tilā dauhitrakutapā iti pavitrāṇi śrāddhe satyaṃ cākrodhaṃ ca śaucaṃ cācāraṃ ca praśaṃsanti || iti |
viṣṇuḥ |
kutapakṛṣṇājinatilasiddhārthākṣatāni pātrāṇi rakṣoghnāni
vā dadyāt |
āha manuḥ |
trīṇi śrāddhe pavitrāṇi dauhitraḥ kutapas tilāḥ |
trīṇi cātra praśaṃsanti śaucam akrodham atvarām ||
padmapurāṇe |
pitṝṇām ambarasthānāṃ dakṣiṇā dik praśasyate |
prācīnāvītam udakaṃ tilāḥ savyāṅgam eva ca ||
dattaṃ svadhāṃ purodhāya pitṝn prīṇāti sarvadā |
yavanīvāramudgekṣuśuklapuṣpaghṛtāni ca |
vallabhāni praśastāni pitṝṇām iha sarvadā ||
matsyapurāṇe |
prācīnāvītam udakaṃ tilāḥ savyāṅgam eva ca |
yavanīvāramudgāś ca śuklapuṣpaghṛtāni ca |
vallabhāni praśastāni pitṝṇām iha sarvadā ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
[1176] sthalodumbaravastrāṇi rajataṃ khaḍgam eva ca |
śrāddhe mahāpavitrāṇi phalāni samidhas tathā ||
‘sthalodumbaraḥ’ sthalodumbaramayāni pātrāṇi |
atra śrāddhe pavitratayā pitṛvallabhatayā coktāni vastūni śrāddhāt pūrvaṃ śrāddhadeśe saṃpādanīyāni |
tatra caiṣāṃ samāharaṇavidhiḥ mātsya-pādmayoḥ |
udapātraṃ ca kāṃsyaṃ ca mekṣaṇaṃ ca samit kuśam |
tilāḥ pātrāṇi sadvāsogandhadhūpavilepanam |
āhared apasavyena sarvaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ śanaiḥ ||
'apasavyena' prācīnāvītena aprādakṣiṇyena vā | atrodapātrādigrahaṇam anyeṣām api puṣpādīnāṃ śrāddhopayoginām upalakṣaṇārtham |
śrāddhasaṃbhārān prakṛtya brahmāṇḍa-bhaviṣyapurāṇayoḥ |
uttareṇāhared vedyā dakṣiṇena visarjayet |
'vediḥ' śrāddhabhūmiḥ | śrāddhadeśāt deśāntaraṃ prati nayanaṃ 'visarjanam' |
iti śrāddhasaṃpādanīyoddeśāḥ |
atha teṣāṃ śrāddhasaṃpādanīyeṣu keṣāṃ cit svarūpasaṃpādanīyeṣu keṣāṃcit svarūpapraśaṃsāviniyogāḥ kathyante |
tatra prabhāsakhaṇḍe |
brāhmaṇāḥ kambalo gāvo rūpyāgnyatithayas tathā |
tilā darbhāś ca kālaś ca navaite kutapāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
paiṭhīnasinā tu kambale viśeṣaḥ kutapaśabdanirvacanaṃ coktam |
madhyāhnaḥ khaḍgapātraṃ ca tathā nepālakambalaḥ |
[1177] rūpyaṃ darbhās tilā gāvo dauhitraś cāṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
pāpaṃ kutsitam ity āhus tasya santāpakāriṇaḥ |
aṣṭāv ete yatas tasmāt kutapā iti viśrutāḥ ||
nepāladeśaprabhavakambalaḥ 'nepālakambalaḥ' | harihareṇa tu pārvatīyājalomasūtrair nirmitaḥ kambalākāraḥ paṭa udīcyeṣu prasiddha ity evaṃ vyākhyātaḥ |
śātātapaḥ |
divasasyāṣṭame bhāge mandībhavati bhāskaraḥ |
sa kālaḥ kutapo nāma pitṝṇāṃ dattam akṣayam ||
paiṭhīnasiḥ |
kuto ’pi śrāddhavelāyāṃ śrotriyo yadi dṛśyate |
śrāddhaṃ punāti vai yasmāt kutapas tena saṃjñitaḥ ||
vṛddhaśātātapaḥ |
duhitraṃ khaḍgaśṛṅgaṃ tu lalāṭe yat tu dṛśyate |
tasya śṛṅgasya yat pātraṃ dauhitram iti kīrtitam ||
kṣīṇendvapaḥ pibed yā gaus tatkṣīrād yat ghṛtaṃ bhavet |
tad dauhitram iti proktaṃ daive pitrye ca pūjitam ||
kṣīṇendāv amāvāsyāyāṃ yā gaur yā apaḥ pibet tasyā gos tatpariṇāmajanyāt kṣīrāt yad ghṛtaṃ jāyate tad dauhitraśabdenocyata ity arthaḥ | atrāpa ity auṣadhīnām upalakṣaṇārtham, amāvāsyāyāṃ hy auṣadhīṣv apsu ca somaḥ praviśati | “sa ihāpaś cauṣadhīś ca praviśati" iti śruteḥ |
amāvāsyāvyatirekeṇāpi goviśeṣaprabhavasya ghṛtasya dauhitratvam uktaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
[1178] apatyaṃ duhituś caiva khaḍgaṃ pātraṃ tathaiva ca |
dhṛtaś ca kapilāyā gor dauhitram iti kīrtitam ||
uśanāḥ |
kuśā darbhāḥ samākhyātāḥ kutapāḥ vṛsayas tathā |
duhituś caiva ye putrā dauhitrās te prakīrtitāḥ ||
kuśākhyā darbhāḥ, kutapaśabdavācyāś ca padārthāḥ, vṛsayāḥ, duhituḥ putrās tv ete dauhitrāḥ |
aha yamaḥ |
yatnena bhojayec chrāddhe dauhitraṃ vratinaṃ śiśum |
datvāsanaṃ tu kutapaṃ tilair anvavakīrya ca ||
śiśutvena vidyādyatiśayānādhārabhūtam api vratastham upanītaṃ duhituḥ putraṃ 'yatnena' ādaraviśeṣeṇa, bhojayet | 'kutapaṃ' prāgukaṃ kambalaviśeṣaṃ tasyāsanaṃ dadyāt | na cāsyāsanasya tilānāṃ vā dauhitreṇaiva saṃbandha iti mantavyam | yato ’mum eva lokaṃ paṭhitvā etām eva śaṅkāṃ nivartayitum,
trīṇi śrāddhe pavitrāṇi dauhitraṃ kutapas tilāḥ |
ityādyanyataraśloke sāmānyenaiva kutapādeḥ śrāddhasaṃbandho manunoktaḥ |
viṣṇuḥ |
tilaiś ca sarṣapair vāpi yātudhānān visarjayet |
parito vikīrṇair iti śeṣaḥ |
yamaḥ |
rakṣanti darbhā asurāṃs tilā rakṣanti rākṣasān |
vedavid rakṣati tv annaṃ yatayed dattam akṣayam ||
hārītaḥ |
tilā rakṣanti daiteyān darbhā rakṣanti rākṣasān |
[1179] rakṣanti śrotriyāḥ paṅktiṃ sarvaṃ rakṣati cātithiḥ ||
prabhāsakhaṇḍe |
viṣṇor dehasamudbhutāḥ kuśāḥ kṛṣṇatilās tathā |
śrāddhasya rakṣaṇārthāya etat prāhur divaukasaḥ ||
hārītaḥ |
darbhair adbhis tilair dattaṃ tūṣṇīm apy āpnute divam |
vidhinā cānupūrveṇa akṣayaṃ parikalpate ||
kāñcanādiṣu darbhādyair mantravat pratipāditāḥ |
pitṝṇām akṣayā yānty amṛtā bhūtvā mahormibhiḥ ||
brahmapurāṇe |
darbhair mantrais tilair hemnā rajatena vinā jalam |
dattaṃ haranti rakṣāṃsi tasmād dadyān na kevalam ||
darbhādibhir jalena ca vinā dattaṃ tad rakṣāṃsi harantīty arthaḥ |
vāyupurāṇe |
kṛṣṇājinasya sāṃnidhyaṃ darśanaṃ dānam eva ca |
rakṣoghnaṃ brahmavarcasyaṃ paśūn putrāṃś ca dāpayet ||
śeṣāṇāṃ tu svarūpapraśaṃsāviniyogās tattatprakaraṇa eva draṣṭavyāḥ |
iti śrāddhasaṃpādanīyānāṃ svarūpapraśaṃsāviniyogāḥ |
iti śrāddhasaṃpadaḥ |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasakalakaraṇādhipati-
paṇḍitaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau pariśeṣakhaṇḍe
śrāddhakalpe pūrvāhṇakṛtyaṃ nāma dvādaśo ’dhyāyaḥ ||
[1180]
atha trayodaśo ’dhyāyaḥ |
niḥśeṣasāmantakirīṭakūṭa-
ratnāṅkuropāsitapādapīṭhaḥ |
hemādrisūriḥ saguṇaṃ tanoti
śrāddhe ’parāhṇāśritakṛtyajātam ||
athāparāhṇakṛtyam |
tatra brāhmaṇāhvānādiśrāddhasiddhivācanāntaṃ iha brāhmaṇebhyaḥ snānopakaraṇapreṣaṇaṃ tasya ca dṛṣṭārthatvenārthāt snānakaraṇaṃ cābhidhāyoktam prabhāsakhaṇḍe |
tato ’parāhṇasamaye śrāddhakartā samāhitaḥ |
svayaṃ samāhvayed viprān savarṇair vā samāplutān ||
‘samāplutān’ snātān |
vārāha-viṣṇupurāṇayoḥ |
pādaśaucādinā geham āgatān arcayed dvijān |
'arcayet' satkuryāt | ādiśabdād ācamanīyadānenāpi |
tathā ca devalasmṛti-kūrmapurāṇayoḥ |
tataḥ snānān nivṛttebhyaḥ pratyutthāya kṛtāñjaliḥ
pādyam ācamanīyaṃ ca saṃprayacched yathākramam ||
[1181] 'snānān nivṛttebhyaḥ' iti snānasamāptyuttarakālam āhvānena yajamānagṛham āgatebhyaḥ, ‘pratyutthāya' añjalim ābadhya svāgataṃ bhavatām iti praśnaṃ kṛtvā rathyāprasarpaṇanibandhanāprāyatyanivṛttaye pādaprakṣālanārtham ācamanārthaṃ codakaṃ prayacchet | pādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvācamanaṃ dadyād ity arthaḥ |
atrāhvānād gṛham āgatebhyaḥ pṛthak pṛthak svāgatapraśnakaraṇam āha mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |
snātaḥ snātān samāhūtān svāgatenārcayet pṛthag iti |
‘svāgatena’ bhavatāṃ svāgatam iti praśnavākyena, 'arcayet' saṃmānayet | 'pṛthak' ekaikaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ, praśnasya cottarāpekṣitvād evaṃvidhe ca viṣaye prativacanasya sādhukartavyatvasmaraṇāt susvāgatam asmākam iti prativacanaṃ pratyekaṃ te brūyuḥ |
svāgatapraśnaś cāyaṃ prayatatvādiviśeṣaṇavatā kartavya ity āhatuḥ śaṅkhalikhitau |
prayato ’parāhṇe śuciḥ śuklavāsāḥ darbheṣu tiṣṭhan
svāgatam iti brūyāt || iti |
prayataḥ śucir iti padadvayaṃ bāhyābhyantararūpadvividhaśuddhiyukto yathāsyād ity evamartham |
atra yādṛgvidhadeśāvasthitānāṃ svāgatapraśnaḥ kāryas tathāvidhadeśam upadiśan svāgatāder aparāhṇakṛtyatvaṃ sphuṭīkaroti dharmaḥ |
sthitān deśe vivikte tu prakīrṇatilabarhiṣi |
aparāhṇe samabhyarcya svāgatenāgatāṃs tu tān ||
'tān' snātān āgatān viprān yajamānagṛham āgatān aparāhṇe [1182] dvidhāvibhaktasyāhno dvitīye bhāge tridhāvibhaktasya vā tṛtīye bhāge pañcadhāvibhaktasya vā caturthe sārdhayāmadvayād uparitane yāmārdhe vā svāgatena yathoktena samabhyarcya āsaneṣūpaveśayed iti vakṣyamāṇena saṃbandhaḥ |
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe brahmāṇḍapurāṇe ca |
saṃpūjya svāgatenaitān abhyupetān gṛhe dvijān |
pavitrapāṇir ācāntān āsaneṣūpaveśayet ||
"asminn avasare pūrvedyur nivedanam" ityādyāpastambavacanaṃ pramāṇayatā pūrvadinanimantritānām api brāhmaṇānāṃ pūrvavad dvitīyaṃ nimantraṇam ācaraṇīyam |
sukhopaviṣṭāṃś ca brāhmaṇān śrāddhakāle samāhūtān
alaṃkurvīta |
iti yamavacanād gandhamālyāñjanadhūpanair alaṃkuryāt | uktaṃ ca devalasmṛti-kūrmapurāṇayoḥ |
yathopaviṣṭān sarvāṃs tān alaṃkuryād vibhūṣaṇaiḥ |
sragdāmabhiḥ śiroveṣṭair dhūpadīpānulepanaiḥ ||
nigamaḥ |
śvaḥ svanāpitābhyaṅgodvartanasnānadantadhāvanādibhir abhyarcya snātān pādyācamanīyasadarbhāsanānulepanadhūpasumanobhir abhyarcya pitṝn āvāhāyiṣya iti pṛcchatīti |
'śvaḥ' nimantraṇād uttaradine | abhyaṅgagrahaṇaṃ nakhādikalpanopalakṣaṇārtham | tac ca 'svanāpitena' mūlyādi pradāya yajamānopakalpitena nāpitena | etac ca pratyutthānāt prabhṛti nimantraṇaṃ varjamalaṅkaraṇāntaṃ manuṣyasatkārādirūpatvān mānuṣam eva na pitryaṃ ato yathālokaṃ yajñopavītādidharmavataiva kāryaṃ na pitryadharmavatā |
[1183]
yat tu vakṣyamāṇamaṇḍalatadarcanapādaprakṣālanāditatparibhāṣāprakaraṇoktena vaiśvadevikena paitṛkeṇa vā dharmeṇa yuktaṃ kartavyaṃ, tatra tāvat maṇḍalakaraṇam āha baudhāyanaḥ |
upalipte same sthāne śucau śuklasamanvite |
caturasraṃ trikoṇaṃ tu varttulaṃ cārdhacandrakam |
kartavyam ānupūrveṇa brāhmaṇādiṣu maṇḍalam ||
'brāhmaṇādiṣu' yajamāneṣu | ānupūrveṇety asyāyam arthaḥ | brāhmaṇe yajamāne caturasraṃ, kṣatriye trikoṇaṃ, vaiśye vartulaṃ, śūdre ’rddhacandrākāram iti |
atra śūdraṃ prati viśeṣa uktaḥ saurapurāṇe |
caturasraṃ brāhmaṇasya kṣatriyasya trikoṇakam |
varttulaṃ caiva vaiśyasya śūdrasyābhyukṣaṇaṃ smṛtam ||
atra viśeṣam āha śambhuḥ |
saṃmārjitopalipte tu dvāri kurvīta maṇḍale |
udakplavam udīcyaṃ syād dakṣiṇaṃ syād dakṣiṇāplavam ||
dvārīti gṛhadvārābhimukhasthite aṅgaṇapradeśe | maṇḍale iti dvivacanāt dve, tatraikam uttarataḥ, tasya dakṣiṇato ’param | tatra yad uttaratas tad udakplavam | udīcīpravaṇaṃ udīcyābhimukhyena kramanimnam ity arthaḥ | evam itarad dakṣiṇāplavam | tatrādāv uttaraṃ oṃ vaiśvadevikamaṇḍalaṃ karomīti vaiśvadevikadharmeṇa kuryāt | tadanantaraṃ dakṣiṇa oṃ pitryamaṇḍalaṃ karomīti pitryadharmeṇa kuryāt |
ete ca gomūtragomayābhyāṃ kartavye, tad uktaṃ mātsya-pādmayoḥ purāṇayoḥ |
[1184] evam āsādya tat sarvam avanasyāgrato bhuvi |
gomayenānuliptāyāṃ gomūtreṇa tu maṇḍale ||
'evaṃ' “āhared apasavyena sarvaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ” iti pūrvoktena prakāreṇa, 'sarvam' śrāddhopakaraṇaṃ, 'āsādya' śrāddhapradeśe sthāpayitvā, 'anuliptāyām agrato bhuvi' gomayopalepanādisaṃskṛte gṛhadvārasaṃmukhāvasthite ’ṅgaṇapradeśe, gomayena gomūtreṇa ca maṇḍale kuryāt |
atra gomaye viśeṣam āha jābāliḥ |
amedhyāśanaśūnyānāṃ nīrūjānāṃ tathā gavām |
avyaṅgānāṃ ca sadyaskaṃ śuci gomayam āharet ||
gomayaviśeṣe niṣedham āha bhṛguḥ |
atyantajīrṇadehāyā bandhyāyāś ca viśeṣataḥ |
ārtāyā navasūtāyā na gor gomayam āharet ||
maṇḍalaparimāṇam āha laugākṣiḥ |
hastadvayamitaṃ kāryaṃ vaiśvadevikamaṇḍalam |
taddakṣiṇe caturhastaṃ pitṝṇām aṅghriśodhane ||
etayor maṇḍalayoḥ krameṇākṣatakuśādibhir arcanam āha vyāghrapāt |
dakṣiṇapravaṇe kāryaṃ maṇḍaladvayam eva ca |
uttare ’kṣatasaṃyuktān pūrvāgrān vinyaset kuśān |
dakṣiṇe dakṣiṇāgrāṃś ca satilān vinyased dvijaḥ ||
akṣatādigrahaṇaṃ gandhapuṣpopalakṣaṇārthaṃ vakṣyamāṇamatsyapurāṇavacanāt | atrodīcīsthitatvādinā vaiśvadevikadharmeṇa uttarasya maṇḍalasya vaiśvadevikatvaṃ jñāyate | dakṣiṇāsthitatvādinā paitṛkadharmeṇa [1185] dakṣiṇasya pitratvam | ataś ca gandhapuṣpayavair ārjavaviśiṣṭaiḥ prāgagraiḥ kuśaiś ca prāṅmukha udaṅmukho vā yajñopavītī dakṣiṇaṃ jānv ācya oṃ vaiśvadevikamaṇḍalam arcayāmi ity uttarataḥ sthitaṃ maṇḍalam arccayet | evaṃ gandhapuṣpatilair dviguṇabhugnair dakṣiṇāgraiḥ kuśaiś ca dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ prācaunāvītī savyaṃ jānv ācya oṃ pitryamaṇḍalam arcayāmīti dakṣiṇataḥ sthitaṃ maṇḍalam arcayet | brāhmaṇāhvānāt prabhṛti maṇḍalārcanāntaṃ kiṃcid viśeṣasahitam uktaṃ nāgarakhaṇḍe |
praṇamyāmantritā ye ca śrāddhārthaṃ brāhmaṇottamāḥ |
ānīya kutape kāle tān sarvān prārthayet tataḥ ||
āgacchantu mahābhāgā viśvedevā mahābalāḥ |
ye yatra vihitāḥ śrāddhe sāvadhānā bhavantu te ||
apasavyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pitṝṃs tān prārthayet tataḥ |
ye mayāmantritāḥ pūrvaṃ pitaro mātṛpakṣajāḥ |
āśritya pitṛkāryeṣu sāvadhānā bhavantu te ||
evam abhyarcya tān sarvāṃs tataḥ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam |
jānunī bhūtale nyasya tataś cārghyaṃ pradāpayet |
mantreṇānena rājendra sapuṣpākṣatacandanaiḥ |
arghyam enaṃ pragṛhṇantu mayā dattaṃ dvijottamāḥ |
pādaprakṣālanārthāya prakurvantu mama priyam ||
evam uktvā mahīpṛṣṭhe anulipte tataḥ param |
sākṣatān prakṣiped (?) darbhān viśvedevān prakīrtayet ||
apasavyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā darbhāṃs tilasamanvitān |
dviguṇān prakṣipet tatra pitṝn uddiśya cātmanaḥ ||
[1186] evam abhyarcitayor maṇḍalayor brāhmaṇapādapracālanaṃ kartavyam ity ukaṃ saurapurāṇe |
prakṣālayet tataḥ pādāv arcite maṇḍale śubhe |
mātsya-padmapurāṇyor api |
akṣatābhiḥ sapuṣpābhis tad abhyarcyāpasavyavat |
viprāṇāṃ kṣālayet pādān abhivandya punaḥ punaḥ ||
akṣatābhiḥ sapuṣpābhir iti devamaṇḍalārcanaṃ devadharmayuktatvāt | etac ca tilaiḥ sapuṣpair ityādikasya pitryamaṇḍalārcanasyopalakṣaṇārtham | apasavyavad viprāṇāṃ kṣālayet pādāv iti pitryadharmakatvāt pitryaviprapādaprakṣālanaṃ kartavyam | tac ca pūrvabhāvino vaiśvadevikapādaprakṣālanasyopalakṣaṇam | tata ādāv uttarato ’vasthite maṇḍale vaiśvadevikaviprapādaprakṣālanaṃ kartavyam |
tathā ca brahmaniruke |
pādyaṃ caiva tathārghyaṃ ca daiva ādau pradāpayet || iti |
vārāhapurāṇe ’pi |
svāgataṃ hy arghyapādyaṃ ca dadyād darbhāsanaṃ dvijaḥ |
vaiśvadevakṛte pūrvaṃ tarpayitvā hutāśane ||
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
idaṃ vaḥ pādyam arghyaṃ ca caturthyantaṃ nivedayet |
pādaprakṣālanamantro brahmanirukte |
śan no devīti mantreṇa pādyaṃ caiva pradāpayet | iti |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe ’pi |
[1187] prakṣālayed viprapādān śan no devīr iti tv ṛcā |
pādaprakṣālanaṃ kuryāt svayam eva vinītavat ||
satyāṃ śaktau svayam eva asatyāṃ tu kartrantareṇāpīti |
atra pādaprakṣālanaprayogaḥ | yajñopavīti dakṣiṇāṃ jānv ācyodaṅmukhaḥ śan no devīr abhiṣṭaye āpo bhavantu pītaye | śaṃyor abhisravantu na iti mantram uccārya oṃ purūrava ārdravaḥsaṃjñakā viśvedevāḥ idaṃ vaḥ pādyaṃ svāhā namaḥ iti prayujyaikaikasyaiva brāhmaṇasyottaramaṇḍalāvasthāpitāsanopaviṣṭasya maṇḍalam ākramya tiṣṭhato vā svācārānusāreṇa gandhapuṣpākṣatakuśajalopetam añjaliṃ devatīrthena pādayor ninīyānyena jalena pādau prakṣālayet | atra cakāreṇa pādaprakṣālanānantaram arcanam arghyadānaṃ sūcyate | ataḥ pratyekaṃ gandhapuṣpākṣatair vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa pādādi mūrdhāntaṃ sahasraśīrṣety abhyarcya gandhapuṣpākṣatakuśādipraśastadravyamiśrajalapūrṇena yathālābhaṃ suvarṇādipātreṇa pādyavat prayogavākyam uccāryārghyaṃ datvā,
maṇḍalād uttare deśe (?) dadyād ācamanīyakam |
iti laugākṣismaraṇān maṇḍalād uttarata upaviṣṭānām ācamanīyaṃ dadyāt | brāhmaṇaiś ca tathācāntavyaṃ yathā tadācamanodakaṃ pādaprakṣālanodakena na saṃbadhyate, tatsaṃgame nāradīyapurāṇe doṣābhidhānāt |
yatrācamanavārīṇi pādaprakṣālanodakaiḥ |
saṃgacchante budhāḥ śrāddham āsuraṃ tat pracakṣate || iti |
atrāhatuḥ śaṅkhalikhitau |
pādyārghyācamanīyodakāni datvā brāhmaṇān upasaṃgṛhyopaveśayed āsanam anvālabhyeti |
[1188] 'ācamanīyodakaṃ' ācamanārtham udakam | 'upasaṃgṛhya' dakṣiṇakareṇa gṛhītvā, ‘anvālabhya’ vāmahastena śrāddhadeśāvasthāpitam āsanam upaspṛśya, tatropaveśayet | atha vaiśvadevīkabrāhmaṇānām ācamanīyadānānantaraṃ dakṣiṇamaṇḍalāvasthāpitāsaneṣu paścimādiprāgapavargaṃ pitryādikrameṇodaṅmukhopaviṣṭānāṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ prācīnāvītyanvācitasavyajānuḥ pitryabrāhmaṇānāṃ pādyādidānam ārabheta | devatāprakaraṇoktadivyamānuṣapitrabhedadṛṣṭinyāyāt dvijaḥ somapākhyapitṛrūpeṇa, kṣatriyo haviṣmadākhyapitṛrūpeṇa, vaiśyas tv ājyapākhyapitṛrūpeṇa, śūdras tu sukālyākhyapitṛrūpeṇa sarvān pitṝn dhyāyan kīrtayaṃś ca brāhmaṇādir yaḥ ko ’pi vā śrāddhakartā pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahān kramād vasurudrādityarūpeṇa brahmaviṣṇumaheśvararūpeṇa vā pradyumnasaṃkarṣaṇavāsudevarūpeṇa vā māsartusaṃvatsararūpeṇa vā dhyāyan kīrtayaṃś ca pādyārcanārghyasaṃkalpadarbhāsanadānādīn sarvān paitṛkān padārthān kuryāt | tatra ca,
nāmagotraṃ pitṝṇāṃ tu prāpakaṃ havyakavyayoḥ |
iti vacanāt,
saṃbandhanāmagotrāṇi pitṝṇāṃ pratipādayet
iti vacanāc ca pratyekaṃ pitrādīn gotrasaṃbandhanāmabhiḥ saṃbudhya taiḥ saṃkīrtya yathoktavibhāgena saṃbuddhyantair eva ājyapādināmabhiḥ kīrtayan gandhapuṣpatilakuśajala-pūrṇam añjaliṃ pitryasyaikaikasya brāhmaṇasya pādayor ninīyābhivandyānyena jalena pādau prakṣālayet | tatra prayogavākyam | śan no devīr ityādy uccārya oṃ amukagotrā asmatpitaro ’mukaśarmāṇaḥ sapatnīkā vasurūpā idaṃ vaḥ pādyaṃ svadhā nama iti pitṛsthāne, śan no devīr ity uccārya oṃ amukagotrā asmatpitāmahā amukaśarmāṇaḥ sapatnīkāḥ rudrarūpā idaṃ vaḥ pādyaṃ svadhā [1189] nama iti pitāmahasthāne, śan no devīr ityādy uccārya oṃ amukagotrā asmatprapitāmahāḥ amukaśarmāṇaḥ sapatnīkāḥ ādityarūpāḥ idaṃ vaḥ pādyaṃ svadhā nama iti prapitāmahasthāne samuccārayet |
atha yathoktaprakāreṇa śan no devīr iti mantrānte oṃ amukagotrā asmanmātāmahāḥ amukaśarmāṇaḥ sapatnīkā vasurūpāḥ idaṃ vaḥ pādyaṃ svadhā nama iti mātāmahasthāne, śan no devīr ityādi mantram uccārya oṃ amukagotrā asmatpramātāmahāḥ mātuḥ pitāmahāḥ iti voccārya amukaśarmaṇaḥ sapatnīkāḥ rudrarūpāḥ idaṃ vaḥ pādyaṃ svadhā nama iti pramātāmahasthāne, atha tathaiva śan no devīr ityādi mantraṃ paṭhitvā oṃ amukagotrā asmavṛddhapramātāmahāḥ mātuḥ prapitāmahāḥ iti vābhidhāyāmukaśarmāṇaḥ sapatnīkā ādityarūpā idaṃ vaḥ pādyaṃ svadhā nama iti vṛddhapramātāmahasthāne samuccārayet |
pādaprakṣālanānantaraṃ ca gandhapuṣpatilair vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa mūrdhādipādāntaṃ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhā pitṛbhya ityādinā mantreṇa pratyekaṃ kramāt pitṛvargīyabrāhmaṇān arcayet | evam eva namo vaḥ pitara ityādinā mantreṇa mātāmahavargīyān | tadanantaraṃ gandhapuṣpatilakuśādipraśastadravyamiśrajalapūrṇena yathālābhaṃ rājatādipātreṇa pādyavat prayogavākyam uccārya pādyakrameṇaivārghyaṃ datvā vaiśvadevikamaṇḍalād uttarata upaviṣṭānāṃ dvijānām ācamanīyaṃ dadyāt | te ’py ācamanodakapādaprakṣālanodakāny asaṅgamayanta ācameyuḥ |
atha maṇḍalārcanapādaprakṣālanādyācamanāntapadārthopayuktadravyaśeṣānati-nipuṇaśiṣṭasaṃpradāyānusrārāt tattanmaṇḍalopari nikṣipet | tato [1190] darbhapāṇir dvir ācamyetyādivakṣyamāṇakratuvacanād yajamāno brāhmaṇacaraṇakṣālanodakasaṃsargam akurvan svapādaprakṣālanapūrvakaṃ dvir ācamya brāhmaṇaiḥ saha śrāddhabhūmim āgatya śrāddhasiddhir astv iti bhavanto bruvantv iti brāhmaṇān pratyuktvā taiś cāstu śrāddhasiddhir ity ukte tadupaveśanārtham āsanāny upakalpayet |
tathā ca yamaḥ |
tataḥ siddhim iti procya kalpiteṣv āsaneṣu ca |
ādhvam ityādinottareṇa saṃbandhaḥ |
iti brāhmaṇāhvānādiśrāddhasiddhivācanāntam |
atha brāhmaṇopaveśanārtham āsanopakalpanam |
āha atriḥ |
tatrāsanāni deyāni tilāṃś caiva kuśaiḥ saha |
pṛthak pṛthag āsaneṣu tilatailena dīpikāḥ ||
tatra śrāddhadeśe āsanāni deyāni kunaiḥ sahitās tilāś ca deyāḥ śrāddhabhūmau prakṣepaṇīyā ity arthaḥ | pṛthak pṛthag ekaikasyāsanasya samīpe ekaikā dīpikety evaṃ tāḥ deyāḥ, ayaṃ ca deyānīty asya vipariṇatasyānuṣaṅgaḥ | atha vā teṣv āsaneṣu pṛthak pṛthak kuśaiḥ saha tilā deyā iti saṃbandhaḥ | tilatailagrahaṇaṃ ghṛtādipraśastasnehopalakṣaṇārtham | vasādyapraśastasnehanivṛttyarthaṃ ca | āsanāni ca praśastataratvāt sati saṃbhave kutapākhyakambalamayāni vṛṣīrūpāṇi vā deyāni | praśastataratvaṃ ca teṣāṃ śrāddhasaṃpatprakaraṇe ’bhihitaṃ, tadalābhe praśastaśvetakambalaśrīṇydidārumayāṇi tadalābhe 'py aniṣiddhadārumayāṇi |
āsanaviśeṣe niṣedham āha gārgyaḥ |
[1191] gośakṛnmṛnmayaṃ bhinnam ākṣaṃ pālāśam eva ca |
lohabaddhaṃ sadaivārkaṃ varjayed āsanaṃ budhaḥ ||
gośakṛnmayaṃ mṛnmayaṃ ca, ‘bhinnaṃ' sphuṭitam | yat kiṃcit prakṛtikasyāyaṃ niṣedhaḥ | 'ākṣaṃ' vibhītakamayam | 'pālāśaṃ' kiṃśukavṛkṣamayam | 'lohabaddhaṃ' kālāyasapaṭṭikākīlakādiyuktam | anena ca sarvāyasasya sutarāṃ niṣedhaḥ sūcitaḥ | lohaśabdaś cāpraśastasīsakādidhātūpalakṣaṇārthaḥ | 'ārkaṃ' rūpikāmayam | sadaiva varjayed ity anvayaḥ |
kālikāpurāṇe |
upalipte dvijān sthāne pitryarthaṃ śuddhiyojite |
kuśottare tilāstīrṇe abhinne lohavarjite ||
dātā ca svāsane pūte viprān āveśayet sudhīḥ |
klṛptāsane samācāntān praviṣṭaḥ pūrvam eva tu ||
daivikapaitṛkāsanasthāpane prakārabhedo devalasmṛti-kūrmapurāṇayoḥ |
ye cātra viśvedevānāṃ viprāḥ pūrvaṃ nimantritāḥ |
prāṅmukhāny āsanāny eṣāṃ dvidarbhopahitāni ca ||
dakṣiṇāmukhayuktāni pitṝṇām āsanāni ca |
dakṣiṇāgraikadarbhāṇi prokṣitāni tilodakaiḥ ||
prāṅmukhāni dakṣiṇāmukhayuktānīty atra mukhaśabdo vṛṣīpīṭhādiṣu mukhasthānīyakalpitāvayavābhiprāyeṇa, kambalādiṣu daśādirūpāgrābhiprāyeṇa prayukta iti veditavyam, 'dvidarbhopahitāni' pratyekam uparisthāpitapūrvagradarbhaśikhāyugalāni, 'dakṣiṇāgraikadarbhāṇi' uparisthāpitadakṣiṇāgraikaikadarbhaśikhāni |
[1192] mahābhārate ’pi vṛṣīṁ prakṛtya śrāddhakartāraṃ nimiṃ praty āha |
kuru caināṃ pūrvaśīrṣāṃ bhava codaṅmukhas tathā |
tvaṃ daive iti śeṣaḥ |
tathā dānadharmeṣu śrāddhakalpe |
amāvāsyāṃ mahāprājño viprān ānāyya pūjitān |
dakṣiṇāvṛttikāḥ sarvā vṛṣīḥ svayam athākarot ||
dakṣiṇāgrās tato dabhā viṣṭareṣu niveśitāḥ |
pādayoś caiva viprāṇāṃ ye tv annam upabhuñjate |
'ānāyya' āhvānena svagṛhaṃ praveśya | 'pūjitān' pūjārhān, añjanābhyañjanādibhir alaṃkṛtān vā | dakṣiṇāvṛttīni śirāṃsi yāsāṃ tā dakṣiṇāvṛttikāḥ dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi kṛtaśīrṣā ity arthaḥ, dakṣiṇabāhubhāge kṛtaśīrṣā iti kecit | viṣṭareṣu vṛṣyādyāsanopari dvijapādayoś ca sthāpanārthaṃ dakṣiṇāgrā darbhā niveśitāḥ | ato liṅgadarśanād anyenāpy evaṃ kartavyam iti gamyate | tāni cāsanāni tathā viviktāni sthāpanīyāni yathā tatropaviṣṭānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ parasparasparśo na syāt |
ata evāha kratuḥ |
darbhapāṇir dvir ācamya laghuvāsā jitendriyaḥ |
pariśrite śucau deśe gomayenopalepite ||
dakṣiṇāpravaṇe samyag ācāntān prayatāñ chucīn |
āsaneṣu sadarbheṣu vivikeṣūpaveśayet ||
‘laghuvāsāḥ' prakṣālanena malādikṛtagauravarahitavastraḥ sūkṣmavastro [1193] vā | 'pariśrite' paritaḥ paṭādināvaraṇadravyeṇāvṛte | 'vivikteṣu' upaviṣṭānām anyonyasparśaparihārakṣamāntarālavatsu | 'śeṣaṃ' gatārtham |
atra hetum āha gārgyaḥ |
sparśe sparśe bhavet pāpam ekapaṅktiniyogataḥ |
hīnavṛttādipaṅktau tu yuktaṃ tasmāt vivecanam ||
yāvatkṛtvo hy uttamavṛttānāṃ ekapaṅktyupaviṣṭahīnavṛttasparśo bhavet tāvatkṛtvas teṣām aprāyatyam | aprayatānāṃ ca karmaṇi vyavaharatāṃ teṣāṃ pratyavāyaḥ | prakṛtasya karmaṇo vaiguṇyaṃ cety ubhayavidhapāpaṃ syāt, ataḥ kāraṇād vivecanaṃ kartavyam | tac ca hīnavṛtatvānirddhāraṇe saty āsanānāṃ tannirdhāraṇe tu paṅkter eveti |
paṅktibhedasādhanāny āha bṛhaspatiḥ |
ekapaṅktyupaviṣṭā ye na spṛśanti parasparam |
bhasmanā kṛtamaryādā na teṣāṃ saṃkaro bhavet ||
parasparāsparśanam antarāle bhasmalekhākaraṇaṃ cety ubhayam iha paṅktibhedasādhanatvenopadiṣṭam |
bārhaspatyasmṛti-prabhāsakhaṇḍayoḥ |
agninā bhasmanā vāpi stambenāpy udakena vā |
dvārasaṃkramaṇenāpi paṅktibhedaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
'stambaṃ ' gulmaṃ, stambheneti kvacit pāṭhaḥ, dvārasaṃkramaṇaṃ ceti sādhanadvayam | 'saṃkramaṇaṃ' mārgaḥ |
iti brāhmaṇopaveśanārtham āsanopakalpanam |
atha brāhmaṇopaveśanam |
[1194]
tatrāhatur manu-bṛhaspatī |
āsaneṣu tu kḷpteṣu barhiṣmatsu pṛthak pṛthak |
upaspṛṣṭodakān samyag viprāṃs tān upaveśeyet ||
‘kḷpteṣu' sthāpiteṣu | ‘barhiṣmatsu' darbhottareṣu | pṛthak pṛthag iti pratibrāhmaṇaṃ viviktatayā ca | 'upaspṛṣṭodakān' kṛtācamanān |
vārāha-viṣṇupurāṇayoḥ |
pavitrapāṇir ācāntān āsaneṣūpaveśayet |
atra viśeṣam āha śāṭyāyaniḥ |
pāṇipādamukhārdrāś ca svācāntāḥ susamāhitāḥ |
teṣv āsaneṣu saṃsthāpyā viprās tena krameṇa tu ||
'pāṇipādamukheṣv ādrāḥ aśuṣkaprakṣālanācamanasaṃlagnajalāḥ ' yāvanmukhapāṇipādamārdratāṃ na jahāti tāvad avilambitam upaveśanīyā ity arthaḥ |
tathā ca viṣṇuḥ |
aparāhne viprān susnātān svācāntān yathābhūyovidyaṃ krameṇa kuśottareṣv āsaneṣūpaveśayet |
'yathābhūyovidyaṃ' vidyābāhulyānusāreṇa | etac ca tapobāhulyādīnām upalakṣaṇārtham |
yata āha sumantaḥ |
vidyātapodhikānāṃ vai prathamāsanam ucyate |
ekapaṅktyupaviṣṭānāṃ samaṃ gandhādibhojanam ||
'prathamaṃ' prathamasthāne sthāpitaṃ guṇaiś ca śreṣṭham | anyad anyeṣāṃ gandhapuṣpādikaṃ bhojyaṃ cānnaṃ sarveṣāṃ 'samaṃ' tulyaṃ, notkṛṣṭāpakṛṣṭavibhāgena viṣamaṃ deyam |
[1195] āśramaviśeṣeṇāpy agryāsanārhān āha yamaḥ |
yasya vai yajamānasya nāgre bhuṅkte yatis tathā |
aniṣṭam adbhutaṃ tasya harate rakṣasāṃ gaṇaḥ ||
tasmād agrāsane bhojyo yajatāṃ saṃyato yatiḥ |
śrotriyo brahmacārī vā yajñas tena na lupyate ||
uktakramātikrame doṣam āha sumantuḥ |
arheṣu vidyamāneṣu nānarhāya bhaved varam |
duṣkṛtaṃ harate paṅktyā āyuṣā ca viyujyate ||
'arheṣu' yogyeṣu, 'anarhāya' ayogyāya, 'varaṃ' variṣṭham āsanaṃ na bhavet | ayogyo variṣṭham āsanaṃ nādhyāsītety arthaḥ | yadi punar adhyāsīta tarhi paṅktyāḥ duṣkṛtaṃ ‘harate’ prāpnoti | 'āyuṣā ca' jīvitena, parityajyate |
hārīto ’pi |
saṃtiṣṭhamāneṣv arhatsu yo ’narho 'grām āsanaṃ śrayet |
gṛhṇāti sa malaṃ paṅkter āyuṣā ca viyujyate ||
'saṃtiṣṭhamāneṣu' vidyamāneṣu | 'malam' duṣkṛtam |
yamaḥ |
prāyeṇa mūrkhaḥ smṛtimantrahīno
yo ’grāsanaṃ gacchati mukhyabhāvāt |
nānyad bhayaṃ paśyati mūḍhacetāḥ
dehapranāśe narakaṃ sughoram ||
yo vai na vidvān na ca brahmacārī
na cāśramastho na ca mantrapūtaḥ |
[1196] havīṃṣi cāśnāti dhuri sthitas tu
so ’śnāti paṅtkyā malakilbiṣāṇi ||
'dhuristhitaḥ' agrāsane sthitaḥ |
arheṇāpīhāsyatām ity evaṃ yajamānābhyanujñātenaivāgrāsane upaveṣṭavyaṃ nānanujñātena |
tathā ca paṅktipāvanānantaraṃ paiṭhīnasiḥ |
teṣām ekaikaḥ punāti paṅktiniyukto mūrdhani sahastrair apy upahatāṃ tasmān nāniyukto ’grāsaṇaṃ gacchet yadi gacchet paṅktyā harati duṣkṛtam |
sahastrair api paṅktidūṣakaiḥ upahatāṃ paṅktiṃ teṣāṃ pūrvoktānāṃ paṅktipāvanānāṃ madhye ekaiko 'pi yajamānaniyuktaḥ san mūrdhany agrim āsane samupaviṣṭaḥ punāti pāvayatīti |
śaṅkhalikhitau |
nāniyukto ’grāsanaṃ gacchet |
atra vaiśvadevikānām ādāv upaveśanaṃ kāryaṃ pitryāṇāṃ tu paścāt | ucchiṣṭhāvaliptahastakṣālanaṃ visarjanaṃ ca varjayitvā sarveṣāṃ śrāddhīyapadārthānāṃ vaiśvadevikapūrvakatvāt |
tatrāha kātyāyanaḥ |
devapūrvaṃ śrāddhaṃ piṇḍapitṛyajñavad upacāraḥ pitrya iti |
kartavya iti śeṣaḥ |
daivapūrvakatvakāraṇam āhatuḥ śaṅkhalikhitau |
devādiśrāddham ātmānaṃ ca rakṣanti pitṝṇām agre niyuktāḥ
pūrvam upaveśitāḥ |
[1197] hārīto ’pi |
amṛtaṃ daivam ity āhur mṛtaṃ pitryaṃ vidhīyate |
tasmād daivāt pravartante tiṣṭhanti hy amareṣu ca ||
'amṛtāḥ' amarā devāḥ, tatsaṃbandhitvāt karmāpy amṛtam | mṛtā hi pitaraḥ, tatsaṃbandhitvāt karmāpi mṛtam | ataḥ kāraṇād daivikāt prabhṛti śrāddhakriyāḥ 'pravartante' prārambhaṇīyāḥ | tathā amareṣu vaiśvadevika eva karmaṇi 'tiṣṭhanti' saṃsthāpanīyā ity arthaḥ | evaṃ kṛte sati mṛtākhyam amaṅgalaṃ karma maṅgalarūpeṇāmṛtena karmaṇobhayataḥ pariveṣṭitaṃ maṅgalam eva bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | uktadaivapitryapaurvāparyaviparyayadoṣaḥ “daivādyantaṃ tad īheta" ityādimanuvākaye darśitaḥ |
yamo ’py āha |
āsuraṃ tad bhavec chrāddhaṃ pūrvaṃ daivavivarjitam |
tasmāc chrāddheṣu sarveṣu pitryaṃ pūrvaṃ vivarjayet ||
daivaṃ pūrvaṃ niyuñjīta paścāt pitryaṃ yathāvidhi |
pūrvaṃ pitryaṃ niyuñjānaḥ kṣipraṃ paśyati sānvayaḥ ||
'āsuraṃ' asuropabhogyam, asuranivārakāṇāṃ vaiśvadevānāṃ pūrvam aniveśitatvāt | ato vaiśvadevikānāṃ pūrvam upaveśanaṃ paścāt pitryāṇām | tac ca yathākramaṃ pūrvābhimukhānām uttarābhimukhānāṃ ca kartavyam |
tathā brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
viprau tu prāṅmukhau devau dvau tu pūrve niveśayet |
uttarābhimukhān viprāṃs trīn pitṛbhyaś ca sarvadā ||
dvāv iti vaiśvadevikārthanimantritabrāhmaṇasaṃkhyāyāḥ upalakṣaṇārtham | [1198] trīn iti ca pitryārthanimantritabrāhmaṇasaṃkhyāyāḥ |
ata eva vārāha-viṣṇupurāṇayoḥ |
prāṅmukhān bhojayed viprān devānām ubhayātmakān |
pitṛpaitāmahānāñ ca bhojayec cāpy udaṅmukhān ||
'ubhayātmakān' pitrādimātāmahādiśrāddhadvayārthe vaiśvadevikadvayasaṃbandhinaḥ |
pṛthak tayoḥ kecid āhuḥ śrāddhasya karaṇaṃ nṛpa |
ekatraikena pākena kurvanty anye maharṣayaḥ ||
'tayoḥ' pitṛmātāmahavargayoḥ |
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe brahmapurāṇe ca |
prāṅmukho daivasaṃkalpān pitṝn kuryād udaṅmukhaḥ |
yājñavalkyaḥ |
pavitrapāṇir ācāntān āsaneṣūpaveśayet |
dvau daive prāk trayaḥ pitrye udag ekaikam eva vā ||
viṣṇur api |
dvau daive prāṅmukhau trīn pitrye udaṅmukhān ekaikam ubhayatra vā |
śaṅkho ’pi |
dvau daive prāk trayaḥ pitrye brāhmaṇāṃs tu udaṅmukhān |
bhojayed vidhivad vidvān ekaikam ubhayatra vā ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
dvau daive prāk trayaḥ pitrye ekaikam ubhayatra vā |
udaṅmukhāṃś ca pitrarthān snātān vidyāguṇakramāt |
[1199] tiladarbhāvakīrṇeṣu āsaneṣūpaveśayet |
kātyāyano ’pi |
snātān śucīn ācāntān prāṅmukhān upaveśya daive yugmān ayugmān yathāśakti pitrya ekaikasyodaṅmukhān |
uśanāḥ |
klṛptasmaśrunakharomāṇaḥ śucau deśe prāṅmukhā vaiśvadevikā udaṅmukhāḥ śeṣā darbhāsaneṣūpaveśyā iti |
vedaviśeṣeṇopaveśanaviśeṣaḥ |
śātātapasmṛti-prabhāsakhaṇḍayoḥ |
dvau deve ’tharvaṇau viprau prāṅmukhān upaveśayet |
pitrye tūdaṅmukhāṃs trīṃś ca bahvṛcādhvaryum āmagān ||
atrāha paiṭhīnasiḥ |
prāṅmakhān viśvedevān upaveśayet barhiṣmatsv āsaneṣu pitṝn
dakṣiṇapūrveṇety uktam |
‘viśvedevān' vaiśvadevikān brāhmaṇān, prāṅmukhān upaveśayet, 'pitṝn' pitryarthān brāhmaṇān, 'dakṣiṇapūrveṇa' dakṣiṇapūrvābhimukhān | athopaviṣṭān vaiśvadevikān apekṣya dakṣiṇāpūrvasyām āgneyāṃ diśi niveśitapaṅktīn uttarābhimukhān ity etat sarvaṃ 'uktam', gṛhya iti śeṣaḥ |
hārītas tūttarābhimukhānāṃ pitryabrāhmaṇānām upaveśanam ity asya pakṣasya nindāṃ kṛtvā teṣāṃ pūrvābhimukhatayā vaiśvadevikānāṃ cottarābhimukhyenopaveśanam uktavān | śubhān upaspṛṣṭācamanīyān śucau dakṣiṇāgreṣu darbheṣu prāṅmukhān brāhmaṇaṇan bhojayet udaṅmukhān ity ekena vā prāṅnirdeśāt [1200] krūrā hy ete 'bhimukhā hiṃsakā bhavantīti maitrāyaṇiḥ | tasmāt prāṅmukhān brāhmaṇān bhojayet | atra prādhānyād dakṣiṇāgradarbhaliṅgāc ca pitryarthā eva brāhmaṇā vivakṣitāḥ | eke tu manyante tān udaṅmukhān bhojayed iti | athavaitat pitryāṇām udaṅmukhatvaṃ na kartavyam | atra hetuḥ prāṅ nirdeśād ityādiḥ | yata ete brāhmaṇāḥ pūrvanimantraṇena pitrādisthāne bhoktṛtvena nirdiṣṭāḥ parikalpitāḥ tataś ca,
nimantritān hi pitara upatiṣṭhanti tān dvijān |
iti vacanāt te krūrātmakapitradhiṣṭhitāḥ santa uttarābhimukhāḥ pitryaṃ karma kurvato dakṣiṇābhimukhasya yajamānasyābhimukhāḥ santo hiṃsakā bhavantīti maitrāyaṇir ācāryo manyate | tasmāt pūrvābhimukhān eva bhojayet | vaiśvadevikāṃs tu udaṅmukhān yatas te dakṣiṇādigabhimukhasya yajamānasya karma kurvataḥ śrāddharakṣakaviśvedevādhiṣṭhitatvād abhimukhāḥ santo rakṣakā bhavanti |
baudhāyano ’pi |
sadarbhopakḷpteṣv āsaneṣu dvau daive trīn pitrya ekaikam ubhayatra (?) vā prāṅmukhān upaveśayet udaṅmukhān vā |
tad evam atra digviśeṣābhimukhye pañca pakṣā bhavanti | tatra vaiśvadevikāḥ prāṅmukhāḥ pitryā udaṅmukhā ity ekaḥ, vaiśvadevikā udaṅmukhāḥ pitryāḥ prāṅmukhā iti dvitīyaḥ, ubhaye udaṅmukhā iti tṛtīyaḥ, ubhaye prāṅmukhāḥ iti caturthaḥ, daivikāḥ prāṅmukhāḥ pitryāś cāgneyābhimukhā iti pañcamaḥ, eteṣu ca vaiśvadevikānāṃ prāṅmukhatvaṃ pitryāṇāṃ codaṅmukhatvam ity ayam eva pakṣo bahubhir āśritaḥ | atra ca “pradakṣiṇaṃ tu devānāṃ pitṝṇām apradakṣiṇaṃ” iti baudhāyanavacanād yad yad devānāṃ kāryaṃ tat tat [1201] pradakṣiṇapracāreṇa kartavyam | tataś ca dakṣiṇādigupakramam udagapavargaṃ vaiśvadevikānām upaveśanaṃ kāyaṃ paścimopakramaṃ sarvadigapavargaṃ ca paitṛkāṇām | yat tu yamenoktaṃ,
dakṣiṇasaṃsthā āsīran na spṛśeyuḥ parasparaḥ |
iti, tatra dakṣiṇabāhubhāge saṃsthā yeṣāṃ te dakṣiṇasaṃsthā iti vigrahaḥ | etac ca paṅkteḥ paścimopakramaprāgapavargale ghaṭate |
ata eva chāgaleyaḥ |
pratīcyāṃ samupakramya prācyāṃ niṣṭhā yadā bhavet |
dakṣiṇāsaṃsthatā hy eṣā pitṝṇaṃ śrāddhakarmaṇi ||
atha vā pitryāṇāṃ prāṅmukhopaveśanam āśrityedaṃ dakṣiṇāsaṃsthitatvābhidhānam |
upaveśanaprakāras tu śaṅkhalikhitābhyām uktaḥ |
brāhmaṇān upasaṃgṭahyopaveśayed āsanam anvālabhyeti |
atra brāhmaṇopasaṃgrahe āsanasparśe cākāṅkṣitaṃ viśeṣam upaveśanavākyaṃ
cāha yamaḥ |
āsanaṃ saṃspṛśan savyena pāṇinā dakṣiṇena brāhmaṇān upasaṃgṛhya samādhvam iti coktvopaveśayet |
ślokenopaveśanavākyāntaram api sa evāha |
āsadhvam iti tān brūyāt āsanaṃ saṃspṛśann api |
kūrmapurāṇe ’pi |
teṣūpaveśayed etān āsanaṃ saṃspṛśann api
āsadhvam iti saṃjalpya āsīraṃs te pṛthak pṛthak ||
vyāsas tu vākyāntaram āha |
[1202] āsyatām iti tān brūyād āsanaṃ saṃspṛśann api |
upastīrṇeṣu cāsīran na spṛśeyuḥ parasparam ||
'upastīrṇeṣu' upari samīpe vā āstīrṇadarbheṣu |
upaveśane mantram āha dharmaḥ |
anvālabhya tato devān upaveśya tataḥ pitṝn |
samas tābhir vyāhṛtibhir āsaneṣūpaveśayet ||
atra paitṛkāṇām evopaveśane vyāhṛtaya ity aparārka-smṛticandrikākārābhyāṃ vyākhyātam | tatra viśeṣāgrahaṇād ubhayeṣām apy upaveśane vyāhṛtiprayoga iti sūcitam | anvārabhyety atra jānvārabhyeti paṭhitvā brāhmaṇasya jānūpasparśanapūrvakam upaveśanaṃ smṛticandrikākāreṇoktam | tan na bahuṣv api mūlasmṛtipustakeṣv anupalabhyamānaṃ kutas tena samānīto ’yaṃ pāṭha iti na vidmaḥ | avisaṃvādena brāhmaṇasya dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇiṃ upasaṃgṛhānāḥ śiṣṭāś ca kathaṃ na dṛṣṭā iti |
bhaviṣyatpure 'pi |
oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar ity uktvā tān samyag upaveśayet || iti |
atra samantrakam upaveśanaprayogavākyam | oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ samādhvam iti vā atrāsyatām iti vā yajamānenoccāraṇīyam | tadanantaraṃ dvijair apy oṃ susamāsmaha iti prativadadbhir upaveṣṭavyam | evaṃ pitryādiśrāddhārthān brāhmaṇān upaveśya mātāmahaśrāddhārtham apy upaveśayet |
tathā ca pitryādiśrāddhārthabrāhmaṇopaveśanaṃ pratipādyāha yājñavalkyaḥ |
mātāmahānām apy evaṃ tantraṃ vā vaiśvadevikam |
' evaṃ ' pitṛśrāddhārthadaivapitryavat, mātāmahaśrāddhārthān api pṛthag daivapitryān [1203] brāhmaṇān upaveśayet | atha vā pitryān eva pṛthag upaveśayet | devāṃs tūbhayatra tān eva kalpayet | tad etad āha, 'tantraṃ vā' iti | 'vaiśvadevikaṃ' viśvedevadaivatyaṃ karma sakṛd anuṣṭhāya śrāddhadvayāṅgatāṃ neyam iti |
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe brahmapurāṇe ca |
tathā mātāmahānāṃ ca tantraṃ vā vaiśvadevikam |
pṛthak tayos tathā cānye kecid icchanti mānavāḥ ||
āsanāsīnānāṃ kartavyam āha sumantuḥ |
pavitrapāṇayaḥ sarve te ca maunavratānvitāḥ |
ucchiṣṭocchiṣṭasaṃsparśaṃ varjayantaḥ parasparam ||
te viprāḥ sarve devārthāḥ pitrarthāś ca pavitrapāṇayo maunavratānvitāḥ pramādasaṃbhavam ucchiṣṭocchiṣṭasaṃsparśaṃ varjayantaḥ ā bhojanasamāpter varterann ity arthaḥ | caśabdāt śrāddhakartāpi maunavratānvito vartateti gamyate | pramādān maunalope tu prāyaścittam uktaṃ niyamaprakaraṇe | etac ca pūrvoktānāṃ niyamānām upalakṣaṇārtham |
maunavratānvayasya kvacid apavādam āha yamaḥ |
brahmodyāś ca kathāḥ kuryuḥ pitṝṇām etad īpsitam |
evam upaveśiteṣv api brāhmaṇeṣv āgatam atithim api śrāddhapaṅkāv upaveśayed iti prāg evoktam |
iti brāhmaṇopaveśanam |
atha pṛthivīstutyādikṛtyam |
tatra tāvad āsanopaviṣṭānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ purataḥ kuśopaskṛtāyāṃ bhuvi yajñopavitī prāṅmukha upaviśya pramādakṛtāvijñātāśucitvanivṛttyarthaṃ [1204] śucitvātiśayārthaṃ vā prathamataḥ puṇḍarīkākṣasmaraṇaṃ kuryāt | yataḥ puṇḍarīkākṣamaraṇasya śucitvāpakatvam āha kratuḥ |
apavitraḥ pavitro vā sarvāvasthāṃ gato 'pi vā |
yaḥ smaret puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ sa bāhyābhyantaraḥ śuciḥ |
anantaraṃ ca pṛthivīstutiḥ kartavyā | tathā ca mahābhāratīyaśrāddhakalpe nimantritaṃ praty atrivākyam |
stotavyā ceha pṛthivī nivāpāścyotadhāriṇī |
vaiṣṇavī kāśyapī ceti tathaiveha kṣayeti ca ||
'nivāpe' pitṛdevatyatyāge, yaḥ 'āścyotaḥ' prakṣiptavyaṃ dravyaṃ, tasyādhārabhūtā yasmāt tasmāt pūrvaṃ pṛthivī stotavyā | 'iti' karaṇe, vaiṣṇavyādināmnāṃ stutau karaṇatvapradarśanārtham | tataś ca stutyabhivyaktyarthaṃ vaiṣṇavyasīty evamādīni nāmāny uccāraṇīyāni, ārādhanavacano vā stautiḥ | tasmin pakṣe praṇavādīni namo’ntacaturthyantāni vaiṣṇavyādināmāni prayojyāni | oṃ vaiṣṇavyai namaḥ | oṃ kāśyapyai namaḥ | oṃ kṣayāyai nama iti | kṣayeti kṣīnivāsagatyor ity asya dhāto rūpam |
vārāhapurāṇe |
praṇamya śirasā bhūmiṃ nivāpasya ca dhāriṇīm |
vaiṣṇavī kāśyapī ceti akṣayeti ca nāmataḥ ||
pṛthivīṃ prati varāhavākyam api tatraiva |
praṇamya śirasā devi nivāpasthānam āgataḥ |
stuvītānena mantreṇa tvāṃ ca bhaktyā vyavasthitaḥ ||
[1205] medinī lokamātā ca kṣitir urvī dharā mahī |
bhūmiḥ śailaśilā ca tvaṃ sthirā tubhyaṃ namo namaḥ ||
dharaṇī kāśyapī kṣauṇī rasā viśvambharā ca bhūḥ |
jagatpratiṣṭhā vasudhā tvaṃ hi mātar namo ’stu te |
vaiṣṇavī bhūtadevī ca pṛthivī tvaṃ namo ’stu te ||
tataḥ śrāddhapradeśaṃ gayātmakatvena tadekadeśasthitaṃ gadādharaṃ ca dhyātvā tayoś ca namaskāraṃ kṛtvottaraṃ karma pravartayet |
tad uktaṃ brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
śrāddhabhūmiṃ gayāṃ dhyātvā dhyātvā devaṃ gadādharam |
tābhyāṃ caiva namaskṛtya tataḥ śrāddhaṃ pravartayet ||
'tābhyām' iti caturthī dvitīyārthe | namaskāraś ca manovākkāyair vidheyaḥ | tatra vācikas tannāmabhyāṃ evaṃ kartavyaḥ | oṃ bhagavatyai gayāyai namaḥ | oṃ bhagavate gadādharāya nama iti |
śrāddhārambhāt pūrvaṃ japyam āha pracetāḥ |
apasavyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā japtvā mantraṃ tu vaiṣṇavam |
gāyatrīṃ praṇavaṃ vāpi tataḥ śrāddham upakramet ||
'vaiṣṇavamantrāḥ' tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam ityādayaḥ |
brahmapurāṇe |
upaveśya japed dhīmān gāyatrīṃ tadanujñayā |
atha sthalasūkṣmavibhāgāvasthitayoḥ karmaṅgabhūtayor deśakālayoḥ [1206] śiṣṭācāraprāmāṇyena saṃkīrtanaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇābhyanujñāgrahaṇārthaṃ vacyamāṇetikartavyatāyāṃ pṛcchāṃ kuryāt |
tatra varāhakṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ pragṛhya liṅgadarśanaṃ brahmapurāṇe |
kuśān ādāya prāgagrān romakūpāntarasthitān |
ṛṣīṇāṃ hṛdi papraccha kariṣye pitṛtarpaṇam ||
‘prāgagrān' purato ’grān svābhimukhībhūtadiksaṃmukhāgrān ity arthaḥ | 'romakūpāntarasthitān', yajñavarāhasya barhirmayaromatvād idam ucyate | manasā dhyātān ṛṣīn 'hṛdi' manasy eva, papraccha |
apṛcchāyāṃ doṣaḥ kālikākhaṇḍe |
apṛcchan pracared yas tu naro viprāṃś ca pārvati |
tasya priyaṃ matpramukhā nācaranti divaukasaḥ ||
itikartavyatā brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
ubhau hastau samau kṛtvā jānubhyām antare sthitau |
sapraśrayaś copaviṣṭān sarvān pṛcchet dvijottamān ||
'sapraśrayaḥ' vinayānvitaḥ, pṛcchet | vinayābhivyaktaye śarīrasaṃsthānam āha | 'ubhāvityādi' | jānubhyāṃ jānunor antaraṃ dvāv api pāṇī 'samau' samadeśau samasaṃsthānau sthitāv ābhimukhyenāvasthitau baddhāñjaliṃ kṛtvety arthaḥ | atha vā 'jānubhyāṃ samau' jānudvayena tulyasaṃsthānau, jānunor evāntare kṛtvā pṛcchet | etac ca saṃsthānam upaviṣṭasyaiva saṃbhavati | sapraśrayo brāhmaṇān pṛcched ity anena brāhmaṇabhimukhībhāvo 'pi kartavyam iti gamyate | tataś ca brāhmaṇābhimukhyenaivam upaviṣṭastān sarvān pṛcchet sarvapraśnapakṣaś ca vaikalpikaḥ |
[1207] ata eva kātyāyanaḥ |
praśneṣu paṅktimūrddhanyaṃ pṛcchati sarvān veti |
'praśneṣu' iti bahuvacananirdeśāt sarvapraśnaviṣayatvam asya vijñāyate | 'paṅktimūrddhani' paṅktyādau, upaviṣṭaḥ 'paṅktimūrddhanyaḥ' | atraikaṃ prati praśne sa eva pratibrūyāt, sarvān prati praśne sarve pratibrūyuḥ | asādhāraṇyena tattatpaṅktikartavye karmaṇi yo yasyāṃ paṅktau mūrddhanyaḥ sa eva praṣṭavyaḥ | tattatpaṅktisthā eva vā sarve praṣṭavyāḥ |
atra śrāddhakartuḥ praśnavākyaṃ brahmapurāṇe |
pitṛn pitāmahān yakṣye bhojanena yathākramam |
prapitāmahān sarvāṃś ca tatpitṝṃś cānupūrvaśaḥ ||
'pitṝn' ityādibahuvacanaṃ pūjārtham | evam anyatrāpi samācārānusārāt kvacit bahuvacanaṃ prayojyam |
dvijottaravākyasahitaṃ praśnavākyaṃ brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
śrāddhaṃ kariṣya ity evaṃ pṛcched viprān samāhitaḥ |
kuruṣveti sa tair ukto dadyād darbhāsanaṃ tataḥ ||
atra yajñapuruṣaparabrahmarūpaśrīviṣṇusmaraṇapūrvakaprāṇāyāmatritayānuṣṭhānānantaraṃ prācīnāvītī dakṣiṇāgreṣu darbheṣu pūrvoktasaṃsthānena pitryadvijābhimukham upaviṣṭaḥ śiṣṭācāraprāptena vākyena pṛcchet | iha sarvatra praśnottareṣu praṇavapūrvakāḥ prayogā vidheyāḥ |
tathā ca mahābhārate śrībhagavadgītāsu |
tasmād om ity udāhṛtya yajñadānatapaḥkriyāḥ |
pravartante vidhānoktāḥ satataṃ brahmavādinām ||
[1208] praśnavākyaracanā tu oṃ iha pṛthivyām ityādi pitṛtṛptikāmo ’ham ityantaṃ nimantraṇaprakaraṇe pradarśitaṃ saṃkalpavākyam uccāryaṃ yuṣmadanujñayā kariṣya ityante ’nukīrtayed iti, ayam eva ca praśnaḥ smṛticandrikākāreṇāvāntarasaṃkalpaśabdenoktaḥ praśnānantaraṃ kuruṣveti brāhmaṇair abhyanujñāto vaiśvadevikapūrvakaṃ darbhāsanāni dadyāt | darbhāsanadānāt pūrvaṃ trivāraṃ japyaḥ saptārcirmantra uktaḥ viṣṇudharmottara-brahmavaivarta-brahmapurāṇa-vāyupurāṇa-prabhāsakhaṇḍa-bhaviṣyottareṣu |
pāpmāpahaṃ yāvatīyam aśvamedhasamaṃ tathā |
mantraṃ vakṣyāmy ahaṃ tasmād amṛtaṃ brahmanirmitam ||
devatābhyaḥ pitṛbhyaś ca mahāyogibhya eva ca |
namaḥ svadhāyai svāhāyai nityam eva namo nama iti ||
ādyāvasāne śrāddhasya trirāvartaṃ japet sadā |
piṇḍanirvapaṇe vāpi japed enaṃ samāhitaḥ || iti |
anyam api prabhāsakhaṇḍa-brahmapurāṇa-viṣṇupurāṇoktasya saptārciḥstotrasya prathamaślokaṃ śrāddhasyādimadhyāvasāneṣu śrotriyās trir āvartayanti |
amūrtīnāṃ samūrtīnāṃ pitṝṇāṃ dīptatejasām |
namasyāmi sadā teṣāṃ dhyāyināṃ yogacakṣuṣām || iti |
anye tu vyāsoktaṃ mantrāntaram apy anukīrtayanti |
caturbhiś ca caturbhiś ca dvābhyāṃ pañcabhir eva ca |
hūyate ca punar dvābhyāṃ sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu || iti |
atrāvasare nīvībandho vidheyaḥ, “pitṛdaivatyā vai nīvir" iti śatapathīyaliṅgadarśanena pitṛdaivatyaṃ karma nīvimatā kartavyam ity avagamāt |
[1209] bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
badhnīyāt tu tathā nīvīṃ na ca prekṣeta durjanam |
syāt kartā niyatas tv evaṃ yāvacchrāddhaṃ samāpyate ||
tathā śrāddhaprakṛtibhūtapiṇḍapitṛyajñaprakaraṇāntarvartti "nīviṃ visraṃsya namo va ity añjaliṃ karoti" iti kātyāyanasūtraṃ vyācakṣāṇenopādhyāyakarkeṇaivam abhihitam | atra nīvīvisraṃsanavidhānāt kamārambhe nīvībandhaḥ kartavya ity arthād gamyata iti | iha nibaddhā ceyaṃ vacanād vaiśvadevikakarmāvasareṣv anunmocyamānā piṇḍanamaskāraparyantam anuvartate, nīvir nāmātra tilakuśānvitānāṃ parihitavastrottarāñcaladaśānāṃ vāmakaṭisaṃlagnavastrabahirbhāgena saṃveṣṭya gopanam | nīvībandhe śraddhālavaḥ śrāddhakṛtaḥ “nihanmi sarvaṃ yad amedhyavat" ityādikaṃ tilavikiraṇe darśayiṣyamāṇaṃ mantraṃ paṭhanti, tadanantaraṃ ca rakṣārthaṃ prathamaṃ vaiśvadevikapradeśe yavān vikiret |
ukaṃ hi brahmapurāṇe varāhakṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ prakṛtya yavānāṃ daivarakṣārthatvam |
akṣatair devatārakṣāṃ cakre cakragadādharaḥ |
akṣatās tu yavauṣadhyaḥ sarvadevāstrasaṃbhavāḥ ||
rakṣanti savāṃs tridaśān rakṣārthaṃ nirmitā hi te |
devadānavadaityeṣu yakṣarakṣaḥsu caiva hi ||
na hi kaścit kṣataṃ teṣāṃ kartuṃ śaktaś carācare |
devānāṃ te hi rathārthaṃ niyuktā viṣṇunā purā ||
evaṃ ca sati vaiśvadevikasthāne ’pi tilānām eva vikiraṇaṃ kartavyaṃ, na tu yavānāṃ teṣām anupadeśāt | na ca tilaiḥ kriyamāṇam adaivaṃ bhavatīti [1210] yad upādhyāyakarkeṇoktaṃ tat purāṇāparyalocanamūlam iti jñeyam | evaṃ devapradeśe yavān vikīrya paitṛkapradeśe paritas tilān gaurasarṣapāṃś ca vikiret |
tathā ca mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
rakṣoghnāṃs tu paṭhen mantrāṃs tilaiś ca vikiren mahīm |
siddhārthakaiś ca rakṣārthaṃ śrāddhe hi pracuraṃ chalam ||
'chalaṃ' yātudhānādikṛto vighnaḥ |
saurapurāṇe |
upaveśya tato viprān datvā caiva kuśāsanam |
paścāt śrāddhasya rakṣārthaṃ tilāṃś ca vikiret tataḥ ||
kuśāsanaṃ datvopaveśyeti saṃbandhaḥ | tilāś cātra kṛṣṇā grāhyāḥ |
tathā bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
siddhārthakaiḥ kṛṣṇatilaiḥ kāryaṃ cāpy avakīraṇam |
kurū sūryāgnivastrānāṃ darśanaṃ cāpi yatnataḥ ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
tilāvakiraṇaṃ kāryaṃ yātudhānavināśanam |
tathā |
apayantv asurā dvābhyāṃ yātudhānavivarjanam |
tilaiḥ kuryāt prayatnena atha vā gaurasarṣapaiḥ ||
“apayantv asurāḥ pitṛrūpā ye rūpāṇi pratimucyācaranti parāpūronipuro ye bhayanty agniṣṭhān lokān praṇudātv asmāt” | “apayantv asurā ye pitṛṣadaḥ udīratām avara utparāsa unmadhyamāḥ pitaraḥ [1211] saumyāsa asuṃ ya īyur avṛkā ṛtajñās te no ’vantu pitare haveṣu" iti |
tathā |
nihanmi sarvaṃ yad amedhyavad bhaved
dhatāś ca sarve ’suradānavā mayā |
ye rākṣasā ye ca piśācaguhyakāḥ
hatā mayā yātudhānāś ca sarve ||
etena mantreṇa susaṃyatātmā
tilān kṣiped dikṣv atha sarṣapāṃś ca |
yasmin deśe paṭyate hyeṣa mantras
taṃ vai deśaṃ rākṣasā varjayanti ||
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
tatra siddhārthakān bhūmau kṣiped rakṣo’panuttaye |
dikṣu sarvāsu ca tilān mantreṇānena nikṣipet ||
nihanmi sarvaṃ yad amedhyavad bhaved
dhatāś ca sarve ’suradānavā mayā |
rakṣāṃsi yakṣāḥ sapiśācaguhyakā
hatā mayā yātudhānāś ca sarve || iti |
dvāradeśe tilakuśaprakṣepaṇe mantraḥ skandapurāṇoktaḥ śiṣṭācāre dṛśyate |
tilā rakṣantv asurān darbhā rakṣantu rākṣasān |
paṅktiṃ vai śrotriyo rakṣed atithiḥ sarvarakṣakaḥ || iti |
śrāddhapradeśasya paritaḥ prācyādidikṣu madhye ca tilāvakiraṇe mantrāḥ bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
[1212] agniṣvāttāḥ pitṛgaṇāḥ prācīṃ rakṣantu me diśam |
tathā barhiṣadaḥ pāntu yāmyāṃ ye pitaraḥ sthitāḥ ||
pratīcīm ājyapās tadvad udīcīm api somapāḥ |
adhordhvam api koṇeṣu vikoṇeṣu ca sarvaśaḥ ||
rakṣobhūtapiśācebhyas tathaivāsuradoṣataḥ |
sarvataś cādhipas teṣāṃ yamo rakṣāṃ karotu me |
vāyubhūtapitṝṇāṃ ca tṛptir bhavatu śāśvatī ||
ity etān mantrān yathāliṅgaṃ vibhajya prācyādidikṣu adha ūrddhvaṃ koṇeṣu sarvataś ca tilān vikiret | tad yathā |
agniṣvāttāḥ pitṛgaṇāḥ prācīṃ rakṣantu me diśam iti prācyām | tathā barhiṣadaḥ pāntu yāmyāṃ ye pitaraḥ sthitā iti dakṣiṇasyām | pratīcīm ājyapās tadvad iti pratīcyām | udīcīm api somapāḥ ity udīcyām |
adhordhvam api koṇeṣu vikoṇeṣu ca sarvaśaḥ |
rakṣobhūtapiśācebhyas tathaivāsuradoṣataḥ ||
sarvataś cādhipas teṣāṃ yamo rakṣāṃ karotu me |
vāyubhūtapitṝṇāṃ ca tṛptir bhavatu śāsvatī ||
ity adhastād ūrdhvaṃ koṇeṣu sarvataś ca tilān vikiret |
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
rakṣārthaṃ pitṛsatrasya triḥkṛtvaḥ sarvato diśam |
tilāṃs tu prakṣipen mantram uccāryāpahatā iti ||
[1213] asyārthavādo ’pi tatraivoktaḥ |
ya idaṃ śrāddhakāle tu kuryād vai pitṛpūjanam |
akṣayaṃ tat bhavec chrāddhaṃ pitṛbhiḥ parirakṣitam || iti |
nigame tu tilādivikiraṇe mantrāntaram uktam |
apahatāsurarakṣāṃsi vediṣada iti tilān gaurasarṣapāṃś ca śrāddhabhūmau
ghanaṃ vikired iti |
'ghanaṃ' niviḍaṃ ||
smṛticandrikākārādayas tu nigamavākyam evaṃvidhaṃ paṭhitavantaḥ | apaha tilān vikired iti | atra pratīkena gṛhītaṃ mantraṃ ca pradarśitavantaḥ | apahatā asurā rakṣāṃsi piśācāyekṣayanti pṛthivī | manu |
atreto gacchantu yatraiṣāṃ gataṃ mana iti |
mantrāntaram api brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
paritaḥ pitṛviprāṇām apeto yantv itīrayan |
asuṃ ya īyur iti cāpasavyaṃ vikiret tilān ||
apeto yantu paṇayo ’sumnā devapīyavaḥ dyubhir ahobhir akṣubhir vyaktaṃ yamo dadātv avasānam asmai ity eko mantraḥ | asuṃ ya īyur ity etaḥ padair upalakṣita udīratām avara ityādir aparaḥ |
tad yathā |
udīratām avara utparāsa unmadhyamāḥ pitaraḥ saumyāsaḥ | asuṃ ya īyur avṛakā ṛtajñās te no ’vantu pitaro haveṣv iti tilādivikiraṇānantaraṃ pramādopajātasya pramitasya śaṅkitasya vā mārjārādidṛṣṭidoṣasya nivṛttaye kasmiṃścit pātre nidhāya kuśaśuddhavatyādibhiś ca mantritena [1214] prāguktenābhyukṣaṇajalena duṣṭadṛṣṭinipātādidūṣitaḥ pākaḥ pūto bhavatīti saṃkīrtyāśeṣapākaprokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā śrāddhadeśāsāditān anyān apy upayoginaḥ kuśakusumādīn sarvān padārthān prokṣeta |
tathā ca vaśiṣṭhaḥ |
śuddhavatībhiḥ kuṣmāṇḍībhiḥ pāvamānībhiś ca pākādi prokṣet | śuddhavatyādayo vyākhyātāḥ | chandogo yajamānaḥ śuddhavatībhiḥ | yajurvedādhyāyī kūṣmāṇḍībhiḥ | bahvṛcaḥ pāvamānībhir iti | upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat pākaśuddhiprakaraṇoktānāṃ taratsamandīnām | ādiśabdenānyeṣām api śrāddhopayogināṃ puṣpādīnāṃ grahaṇam |
ata eva brahmāṇḍa-bhaviṣyatpurāṇayoḥ |
puṣpādīnāṃ tṛṇānāṃ ca prokṣaṇaṃ haviṣāṃ tathā |
parāhṛtānāṃ dravyāṇaṃ nidhāyābhyukṣaṇaṃ punaḥ ||
nāprokṣitaṃ spṛśet kiṃcid daive pitrye ’tha vā punaḥ |
uccāvacāḥ śrāddhadharmāḥ sādhāraṇyāt prakīrtitāḥ ||
'uccāvacāḥ' anekaprakārāḥ |
uktaniṣedhātikrame doṣaṃ pradarśayan prokṣaṇavidhim āha yājñavalkyaḥ |
anabhyukṣyānupaspṛśya juhoti ca dadāti ca |
nairṛtaṃ bhāgadheyaṃ syāt tasmāt prokṣaṇam ācaret ||
iti pṛthivīstutyādikṛtyam |
hemādriṇā guṇaśreṇiśobhamānaśriyādhunā |
vaiśvadevārcanasyedaṃ kāṇḍam evaṃ vitanyate ||
atha darbhāsanādayaḥ padārthaḥ |
te ca sarvasya daivapūrvakatvāt pūrvaṃ devadvijeṣv anuṣṭheyāḥ | tataḥ paitryadvijeṣu | tatra yady api prayogavidhyanumatapradhānapratyāsattyanugraharūpanyāyaparyālocanayā daivapitryakriyāsamavāyinaḥ sarve ’pi padārthaḥ padāthānusamayenānuṣṭheyā ity avagamyate | tathāpi yājñavalkyādivacanaprāmāṇyād darbhāsanadānādyācchādanāntā daiveṣu pitryeṣu ca kāṇḍānusamayenānuṣṭheyā iti pūrvam evoktam | tatra tāvad darbhāsanadānaṃ tac cikīrṣan jānupātanaṃ kuryāt |
tathā ca ṛṣyaśṛṅgaḥ |
dakṣiṇaṃ pātayej jānu devān paricaran sadā |
pātayed itaraj jānu pitṝn paricarann atha ||
jānupātanānantaram āsanadānāc ca pūrvaṃ dvijahaste jalaṃ prakṣipet |
tathā ca yājñavalkyaḥ |
pāṇiprakṣālanaṇ datvā viṣṭarārthān kuśān api |
yady api cātra pāṇiprakṣālanārtham udakaṃ brāhmaṇahaste datvā viṣṭarārthāḥ kuśā api tatraiva deyā ity āpātato ’pi śabdāt pratibhāti, tathāpi viṣṭarārthān kuśān āsane datveti viṣṭarārthaśabdaprayogāt pratyetavyam iti smṛticandrikākāraḥ |
ata evoktaṃ kāṭhake |
pradadyād āsane darbhān na tu pāṇau kadācaneti |
pracetasāpy uktam |
darbhāṃś caivāsane dadyān na tu pāṇau kadācana |
[1216] pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāṃ syāt ruṣṭiḥ śāsvatī tathā || iti |
'ruṣṭiḥ' kalahaḥ | brāhmaṇahaste devapitṛmanuṣyaprajāpatyagnitīrthānāṃ sadbhāvād dhastavinyasteṣu darbheṣu mamedaṃ mamedam iti devādīnāṃ kalahaḥ syāt |
ata eva nāgarakhaṇḍe haste darbhāsanadānasya vaiphalyam uktam |
haste toyaṃ parikṣepyaṃ no darbhās tu kathaṃcana |
yo haste cāsanaṃ dadyāt taṃ darbhaṃ buddhivarjitaḥ |
pitaro nāsane tatra prakurvanti niveśanam ||
yat tu pracetasoktaṃ gṛhṇīyus te tu tān kuśān iti, tad api manasā svīkuryur iti vyākhyeyaṃ na tu haste gṛhṇīyur iti, ato na virodhaḥ | devasvāmī tu manyate | yaḥ pāṇau darbhadānapratiṣedhaḥ sa āsanāstaraṇārthadarbhaviṣayaḥ | yas tu grahaṇavidhiḥ sa yājñavalkyavacanāntasya paryālocanayā pāṇāv eva viṣṭarārthaṃ kuśaviṣaya iti | tad ayukam | āsanastaraṇārthānāṃ darbhāṇāṃ viprahaste pradānāprasakteḥ pratiṣedhānavakāśāt |
atra kutupādyāsanopari pradeyasya kuśāsanasya pradeśaviśeṣo brahmāṇḍapurāṇe darśitaḥ |
āsane cāsanaṃ dadyād vāme vā dakṣiṇe ’pi vā | iti |
vāmeti brāhmaṇasya āsanāvasthitasya vāmabhāgāvasthite āsanapradeśe, evaṃ dakṣiṇe | atra dakṣiṇa iti vaiśvadevikaviṣayam | vāma iti paitṛkaviṣayam |
tathā ca tatraivānantaram uktam |
[1217] pitṛkarmaṇi vāme vai daive karmaṇi dakṣiṇa iti |
etac cāsanaṃ devānāṃ yad yavasahitair darbhair deyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tu tilasahitaiḥ | ata eva pradadyād āsane darbhān ity abhidhāyoktaṃ kāṭhake |
devānāṃ sayavā darbhāḥ pitṝṇaṃ ca tilaiḥ saha || iti |
baudhāyanena tu viśeṣāntaram apy uktam |
pradakṣiṇaṃ tu devānāṃ pitṝṇām apradakṣiṇam |
devānāṃ sayavā darbhāḥ pitṝṇāṃ dviguṇās tilaiḥ ||
sahitā iti śeṣaḥ |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
pradadyād āsane darbhān pitṝṇāṃ dviguṇāṃs tilaiḥ |
'dviguṇān' madhyabhaṅgena dviguṇīkṛtān |
ata eva śaunakaḥ |
apaḥ pradāya darbhān dviguṇabhagnānāsane pradāyeti |
anena bhaṅgaparyantaṃ dviguṇīkaraṇam uktam | apaḥ hastakṣālanārthāḥ |
brahmapurāṇe varāhakṛtaśrāddhaprayoge |
śliṣṭamūlāgradarbhāṃs tu satilān vedavādavit |
tān āropyāmane tatra dadau savyena vāsanam |
dviguṇīkaraṇena śliṣṭāni parasparaṃ saṃlagnāni mūlāny agrāṇi ca yeṣāṃ te 'śliṣṭamūlāgrāḥ' |
savyena upaviṣṭabrāhmaṇavāmabhāge pitṝṇāṃ dviguṇā iti vadatā baudhāyanenārthāt devānām ṛjava ity abhihitaṃ bhavati |
ata evāha bṛhaspatiḥ |
[1218] ṛjūn savyena vai kṛtvā daive darbhāḥ pradakṣiṇam |
dviguṇān apasavyena dadyāt pitrye ’pasavyavat ||
'ṛjavaḥ' dvaiguṇyarahitāḥ | 'savyena' savyaskandhasthitayajñopavītena, 'apasavyena' tadviparītena, 'apasavyavat' apradakṣiṇam |
nāgarakhaṇḍe |
ṛjubhiḥ sākṣatair darbhaiḥ sodakair dakṣiṇādiśi |
devānām āsanaṃ dadyāt pitṝṇāṃ tv anupūrvaśaḥ |
viṣamair dviguṇair darbhaiḥ satilair vāmapārśvagaiḥ |
'dakṣiṇādiśi' brāhmaṇasya dakṣiṇabhāge 'viṣamaiḥ' viṣamasaṃkhyaiḥ | tena devānāṃ samasaṃkhyair darbhair āsanaṃ deyam |
pracetās tu vaiśvadevikāsanadarbhāṇāṃ dānaṃ prati brāhmaṇam upadiśan pratigrahamantram āha |
daive tu ṛjavo dabhāḥ pradātavyāḥ pṛthak pṛthak |
dharmo ’smīty atha mantreṇa gṛhṇīyus te tu tān kuśān ||
dharmo 'smi viśi rājā pratiṣṭhitaḥ ity anena mantreṇa yajuṣā vaiśvadevikabrāhmaṇāḥ kuśān gṛhṇīyuḥ | atra gṛhṇīyur ity asyārthaḥ pūrvam eva vyākhyātaḥ | kecit tu 'dharmāsīti' pāṭhāntaram āhuḥ | tasmin pakṣe ayaṃ mantraḥ | dharmāsi sudharmā me ’nyasmai brahmāṇi dhāraya kṣatrāṇi dhāraya viśaṃ dhāraya tena tv ācāntaḥ skandayāt iti |
āsanādidāne diṅniyamam āha kratuḥ |
udaṅmukhas tu devānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ |
[1219] āsanārghyādikaṃ dadyāt savyam eva yathāvidhi ||
āsanadāne vibhaktiviśeṣas tu akṣayyāsanayoḥ ṣaṣṭhītyādinā caturthī tv āsane nityam ityādinā ca vaikalpikaḥ pūrvam eva darśitaḥ |
ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakṛtya nāgarakhaṇḍe ’py uktam |
vibhaktyā pūrvayā teṣāṃ āsanaṃ ca pradāpayet | iti |
iṣṭiśrāddhe kratur dakṣa ityādivacanāvagataiḥ śrāddhavibhāgena vyavasthitair viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ nāmabhir āsanadānādikaṃ pradeyam | tad evam etāvadvacanasaṃdarbhasaṃpanno vaiśvadevikāsanadānaprayoga ucyate | udaṅmukho dakṣiṇaṃ jānv ācya yajñopavīty antarjānukaro dvijadakṣiṇahastam uttānaṃ nijavāmahastena dhṛtvā jalayavasamanvitaṃ darbhaśikhādvayaṃ ṛjv evādāya purūrava-ārdravaḥsaṃjñakānāṃ viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ idam āsanaṃ purūrava-ārdravaḥsaṃjñakebhyo viśvebhyo devebhya idam āsanam iti voccārya dvijahaste tad udakam āsicya kambalādyāsanadakṣiṇabhāgasyopari devatātīrthena taddarbhaśikhādvayaṃ prakṣipet | vipro ’pi dharmo ’smi viśi rājā pratiṣṭhita iti yajur uccārya svāsanam astv iti brūyāt |
tathā ca nāgarakhaṇḍe |
gandhamālyāsanādīnāṃ pradāneṣu dvijottamaḥ |
sugandho ’stu sudīpo ’stu cetyādi samudāharet ||
atrāsanadānānantaraṃ dvijakare jalam āsiñcet | tathā ca āśvalāyanagṛhyasūtram |
apaḥ pradāya darbhān dviguṇabhugnān āsanaṃ pradāya apaḥ pradāyeti |
iti darbhāsanadānaṃ |
[1220]
atha tṛtīyanimantraṇaṃ |
tathā ca pādma-mātsyayor uktam |
āsaneṣūpakḷpteṣu darbhavatsu vidhānataḥ |
upaspṛṣṭodakān viprān upaveśya nimantrayet ||
nanv āsaneṣūpaveśyety anena kambalādimayāsanopaveśanasya nimantraṇāt pūrvakālatocyate na punar dabhāsanadānasyeti bahusaṃmatam | ato yadi kambalādyāsanopaveśanānantaramantarā darbhāsanadānaṃ kṛtvā nimantraṇaṃ kriyeta tadopaveśyety eṣā pūrvakālatāśrutir bādhyeta |
maivam, bhuktvā gacched ity ādau bhojanagamanayoḥ padārthāntaravyavadhāne 'pi pūrvakālatāśruter virodhādarśanāt | ktvāpratyayānuśāsanam api pūrvakālatāmātre na punar avyavahitapūrvakālatāyām | astu vā tasyām api tat tathāpy atrāntarāpadārthāntara-vidhāyakavākyānugrahārthaṃ vyavahitāyām eva pūrvakālatāyāṃ tātparyyaṃ parikalpanīyam | śakyate cāsanaśrutisādhāraṇyād anena vacanena darbhāsanopaveśanānantaryam apy abhidhātuṃ | ata eva darbhāsanadānānantaram āha gṛhyasaṃgrahakāraḥ | tataḥ punar apo datvā nimantrayed daive kṣaṇaḥ kriyatām iti, tata oṃ tatheti vipro brūyāt, prāpnotu bhavān iti kartā punar brūyāt, prāptavān iti vipraḥ punar brūyāt iti | baudhāyanas tu viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ kṣaṇaḥ karttavya iti nimantraṇavākyaṃ darśitavān | yat tu niraṅguṣṭhaṃ gṛhītvā tu viśvān devān samāhvayed ity asya brahmapurāṇavacanasya niraṅguṣṭhaṃ viprakaraṃ gṛhītvā nimantraṇe kṛte saty anantaraṃ viśvedevāhvānaṃ kartavyam iti vyākhyānaṃ kṛtvā nimantraṇe niraṅguṣṭhadvijahastagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam iti smṛticandrikākāro 'bhihitavān | tad ayuktam, atra nimantraṇarūpapadārthadhyāhāre pramāṇābhāvāt | [1221] brahmapurāṇe ca devān āvāhayiṣya ity āvāhanaṃ prakṛtya niraṅguṣṭhagrahaṇasyoktatvāt padārthāntaropanyāsaśūnye ca niraṅguṣṭhavākaye anyasaṃbandhitvenānavabhāsād āvāhanenaivāsya saṃbandho ’vagamyate | ataḥ pūrvavat brāhmaṇajānuvinyastahastenaivedam api nimantraṇaṃ vidheyam iti |
iti tṛtīyanimantraṇam |
athāvāhanam |
tatrāvāhanavidhipraśnānujñāḥ kālikāpurāṇe |
rakṣaṇāya tato devān viśvākhyāṃs tatra yojayet |
rakṣaṇāya śrāddhasyeti śeṣaḥ | 'tatra yojayet' teṣu brāhmaṇeṣu āvāhanena saṃnidhāpayet| 'tataḥ' tṛtīyanimantraṇānantaram | kecit tu brāhmaṇānāṃ purato ’rghyapātrasthāpanānantaram āvāhanaṃ kurvate |
tathā ca mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇa-viṣṇupurāṇayoḥ |
viṣṭarārthaṃ kuśān datvā saṃpūryārghyaṃ vidhānataḥ |
kuryyādāvāhanam || iti |
nāgarakhaṇḍe ’pi "gandhapuṣpaiś ca saṃpūrya" ityādyabhidhāyāvāhanam uktam |
nimantraṇānantaryaṃ tu bahuśāstrasaṃmatam ity ādriyate |
āha chāgaleyaḥ |
viṣṭarārtham ṛjūn darbhān pradāyāpas tathaiva ca |
āvāhayed anujñāto viśvedevān anusmaran ||
atra darbhān pradāyety anena darbhāsanadānasyāvāhanāt pūrvakālatāyām abhidhīyamānāyām api smṛtyantarānusārān madhye nimantraṇānuṣṭhāne ’pi pūrvakālatāśrutivirodhābhāvaḥ pūrvavad atrāpy anusaṃdheyaḥ | 'anusmaran' iti viśveṣāṃ devānām utpattimahimasvarūpāṇi pūrvoktāni canucintayan | [1222] 'anujñāta' ity atra saṃnidhānād āvāhyādhiṣṭhānabhāvād aucityāc ca vaiśvadevikair dvijair iti viśeṣo ’vagamyate |
uktaṃ ca viṣṇupurāṇe |
kuryād āvāhanaṃ prājño devānāṃ tadanujñayā |
tadanujñayety āvāhanīyadevādhiṣṭhānabhūtadvijānujñayā | tathā ca yajamānakartṛkaḥ praśno ’pi lakṣyate praśnābhāve 'nujñāprasaṅgāvirahāt | prāśnānujñayoḥ svarūpaṃ tu brahmapurāṇe darśitaṃ |
devān āvāhayiṣye taṃ prāhur āvāhayeti ca |
niraṅguṣṭhaṃ gṛhītvā tu viśvān devān samāhvayet ||
'niraṅguṣṭham' ity atra dvijahastam iti śeṣaḥ | anye tu viprāṅguṣṭham iti pāṭhāntaram āhuḥ | dakṣiṇācāreṇa kartavyam iti vacanāc ca dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭham iti jñeyam | 'gṛhītvā' nijadakṣiṇakareṇa dhṛtvā | 'devān āvāhayiṣye' iti yajamānena vaiśvadevikadvijān prati praśne kṛte taṃ yajamānaṃ pratyāvāhayeti te viprā brūyur ity arthaḥ | ataḥ praśnavākye devān ity etasmāt pūrvaṃ viśvān iti padaṃ prayojyam |
yata āha kātyāyanaḥ |
āsaneṣu darbhān āstīrya viśvān devān āvāhayiṣya iti pṛcchaty
āvāhayety anujñāta iti |
pṛcchati yajamānaḥ, anujñāto dvijaiḥ |
atra ceṣṭiśrāddhe kratur dakṣaḥ saṃkīrtyo vaiśvadevika ityevamādivacanārthavattvārthaṃ viśvān devān ity etasmāt pūrvam ṛtudakṣādike dve dve viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ viśeṣanāmanī tattacchrāddhakartā prayojye, te ca dvandvasamāseneti [1223] devatāprakaraṇe varṇitaṃ dvitīyayā ca vibhaktyeti vibhaktiprakaraṇe sthitam | bahuvacanānte ceti devatāprakaraṇa evoktam | ihāpi viśvān devān iti bahuvacanāntapadasāmānādhikaraṇyārthaṃ tadante eveti gamyate | tathā ca pārvaṇādiṣu pururava-ārdravaḥsaṃjñakān viśvān devān āvāhayiṣye ityādiprakārakaṃ praśnavākyaṃ niṣpadyate | yeṣāṃ tu viśeṣanāmajñānaṃ nāsti tais tu viśvān devān āvāhaviṣya ity etāvanmātraṃ prayojyam |
sahitānāṃ devapitṝṇāṃ āvāhanapraśnottare prārthanāviśeṣaṃ cāha paiṭhīnasiḥ |
devāṃś ca pitṝṃś cāvāhayiṣya ity anujñāpya saumyāḥ santv ity uktvā agnau kariṣyāmīti anujñāpyeti
saumyāḥ santv iti prārthanānurūpaṃ saumyāḥ santv ity eva dvijānāṃ prativacanam anumīyate |
tathā ca śaunakasūtre |
tato ’nujñāpayed devāṃś ca pitṝṃś cāvāhayiṣyāmīty āvāhayet | saumyās te santv ity anujñātaḥ pūrvaṃ devān āvāhayet |
anujñāto dvijair iti śeṣaḥ |
pippalādasūtre 'pi |
devāṃś ca pitṝṃś cāvāhayiṣya ity anujñāpyāvāhayet saumyāḥ santv ity ukte pūrvaṃ devān āvāhayet |
ayaṃ ca praśno yavahastena yajamānena kārya ity āha yamaḥ |
yavahastas tato devān vijñāpyāvāhanaṃ prati |
āvāhayed anujñāto viśvedevāsa ity ṛcā ||
[1224] devān vijñāpyeti vaiśvadevikadvijān savinayaṃ yathoktaprakārena pṛcched ity arthaḥ | atra devānāṃ sayavā darbhā iti paribhāṣayā sadarbhayavayuktahasta iti jñeyam | tadyuktatā ca hastasya teṣām āvāhane sādhanatvaṃ kartum | āvāhanaṃ ca prādakṣiṇyena kāryam |
ata evoktaṃ bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
āvāhayed yavair devān apasavyaṃ tilaiḥ pitṝn |
yavair iti tṛtīyayā yavānām āvāhane sādhanatvam uktam | tatra vakṣyamāṇāvāhanāṅgabhūtavikiraṇadvārā | apasavyam ity anena pitṛṣv aprādakṣiṇyavidhānāt prādakṣiṇyena devān iti sūcitam | atra vināśapratibandhārthaṃ śiṣṭācāraparipālanāya ārjavena paramasaṃbodhanarūpakāryaniṣpattyaye ca prāṅmukhopaviṣṭavaiśvadevikadvijasaṃmukhatayā praśnakartavyatā yady api pratibhāti tathāpy udaṅmukhatvavidhibalena sā tyājyā |
uktaṃ hi kūrmapurāṇe |
tatas tv āvāhayed devān brāhmaṇānām anujñayā |
udaṅmukho yathānyāyaṃ viśvedevāsa ity ṛcā ||
atra hy udaṅmukhatvasyāvāhanabhāvanayā sāṅgayā saha saṃbandho ’vagamyate ataḥ praśno ’py udaṅmukhenaiva kāryaḥ | sa cāyaṃ vaiśvadevikapaṅktimūrdhanyam ekaṃ tatpaṅktibhājaḥ sarvān vā prati kāryaḥ |
ity āvāhanavidhipraśnānujñāḥ |
atha mantrādayaḥ padārthaḥ |
tatra mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
pavitrakāṇi datvā ca tebhyo ’nujñām avāpya ca |
[1225] kuryād āvāhanaṃ prājño devānāṃ mantrato dvijaḥ ||
'pavitrakāṇi' arghyapātrasthitāni, datvā dvijapāṇāv iti śeṣaḥ | etac ca yeṣāṃ dvijāgrato ’rghyapātrasthāpanānantaram āvāhanaṃ tanmateneti veditavyam | 'mantrataḥ' iti mantreṇa |
kena mantreṇety apekṣāyām āha yājñalkyaḥ |
āvāhayed anujñāto viśvedevāsa ity ṛcā |
'yavair anvavakīryeti āvāhanaṃ nāma devatāyāḥ svasthānāt karmadeśaṃ prati preṣaṇānayanaṃ, tasya ca prakāśikeyam ṛk 'yavaranvavakīryeti (?) brāhmaṇahastam aṅguṣṭhaṃ conumucya svakarasthitaṃ kuśayavaṃ dvijānāṃ purato bhuvi pradakṣiṇaṃ vikīryety arthaḥ | kecit tv āvāhanamantraṃ paṭhanto brāhmaṇaśarīra evārcanaprakāreṇa yavavikiraṇaṃ kurvanti |
tathā ca bhartṛyajñaḥ |
viśvedevāsa āgatamantreṇānena pārthiva |
teṣām āvāhanaṃ kāryam akṣataiś ca śiro ’ntataḥ || iti |
dakṣiṇapadāt prabhṛti śiraḥparyantam ity arthaḥ, tatprakāras tu vakṣyate |
āha kātyāyanaḥ |
viśvedevāsa āgatety anayāvāhyāvakīrya viśvedevāḥ śṛṇutemam iti
japitveti |
viśvedevāsa āgata śṛṇutām imaṃ havaṃ idaṃ varhir niṣīdatety anayāco (?), 'āvāhya' āvāhanaṃ kṛtvā tadanantaraṃ viśvedevāḥ śṛṇutemaṃ havaṃ me ye antarikṣe ye upadyaviṣṭha ye agnijihvā uta vā yajatrā āsad yāsmin barhiṣi mādayadhvaṃ ity etām ṛcaṃ kṛtāñjalir japet |
[1226] pādma-mātsyayos tu purāṇayor etanmantrajapānantaraṃ samantrakaṃ yavavikiraṇam uktam |
viśvedevāsa ity ābhyām āvāhya vikired yavān |
yavo 'si dhānyarājas tvaṃ vāruṇo madhumiśritaḥ |
nirṇodaḥ sarvapāpānāṃ pavitram ṛṣisaṃstutam ||
atrābhyām iti dvivacanāt ṛgdvayam āvāhanasādhanatvenoktam iti gamyate | tadanantaraṃ yavavikiraṇam | yavaprakāśanadvārakaś ca tadvikiraṇe yavo 'sītyādimantro 'py uktaḥ |
yamena tu vikiraṇe prādakṣiṇyaṃ mantrāntaraṃ coktam |
viśvedevāḥ śṛṇuteti japtvādāya tato ’kṣatān |
oṣadhaya iti mantreṇa vikiret tu pradakṣiṇam ||
atra pratīkena oṣadhayaḥ samavadanta somena saha rājñā | yasmai kṛṇoti brāhmaṇas taṃ rājan pārayām asīty eva mantro darśitaḥ |
brahmapurāṇe cāvāhane maunaṃ mantrāś coktāḥ |
tato mantraṃ japen maunī viśvedevāsa āgata |
dvitīyaṃ ca japen mantraṃ viśvedevāḥ śṛṇuteti ca ||
japet tṛtīyaṃ mantraṃ tu paurāṇaṃ puṇyavardhanam |
āgacchantu mahābhāgā viśvedevā mahābalāḥ |
ye yatra vihitāḥ śrāddhe sāvadhānā bhavantu te ||
atra yas tṛtīyo mantra uktaḥ sa vaiśvadevikotpattiviśeṣanāmānabhijñaṃ prati veditavyaḥ | tathā ca viśveṣāṃ devānām utpattidhyānaṃ nāmānukīrtanaṃ vābhidhāyoktaṃ bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
[1227] ajānan lokam ekaṃ tu paṭhed viprasamīpataḥ |
sadaiveṣu tu sarveṣu śrāddheṣv ādau sakṛd budhaḥ ||
