tatra pātre ’rghyadravyanidhānānantaraṃ oṃ pitryārghyapātrāṇāṃ saṃpattir astv iti kṛtāñjaliḥ pitṛbrāhmaṇān pṛcchet | oṃ astu pitrarghyapātrāṇāṃ sampattir iti taiḥ pratyukte teṣv arghyapātreṣv adhonihitadarbhaiḥ saha pāṇibhyām ekaikam uddhṛtya oṃ svadhārghyā iti mantreṇa pitrādibrāhmaṇānāṃ purato yathākramaṃ dakṣiṇāgratayā sthāpayet |
tad āha jātūkarṇyaḥ |
tato ’rghyapātrasaṃpattiṃ vācayitvā dvijottamān |
tadagre cārghyapātrāṇi svadhārghyā iti vinyaset ||
[1288] tadanantaraṃ "dattadarbhodake hasta ityādidarśayiṣyamāṇabrahmapurāṇavacanāt brāhmaṇahaste prathamam apo ninīyārghyapātrasthitaṃ kuśapavitraṃ ca dakṣiṇāgraṃ nidhāya brāhmaṇam abhyarcyārghyaṃ dadyāt |
tathā ca dakṣa-gārgyāv āhatuḥ |
haste prādeśamātraṃ tu trivṛd datvā pavitrakam |
abhyarcya pūrvato ’rghyaṃ vai dadyāt tu pitṛdiṅmukhaḥ ||
'trivṛt' triśalākam | 'pūrvataḥ' ādau | atra yat pūrvam arghyapātrasthāpitaṃ pavitram āsīt tad eva brāhmaṇahaste deyaṃ nānyad iti gatyantareṇa darśayiṣyamāṇe mānava-maitrāyaṇīyasūtre draṣṭavyam | prakṛtatvenāpi tasyaiva buddhisthatvāt | kecit tu tasya prayojanatvād anyad upādadate | tad ayukaṃ | anyatropayuktānām api darbhāṇām anyatra viniyogadarśanād ity upādhyāyakarkeṇāpy evam evākṣipya siddhāntitam |
arcanaṃ ca gandhapuṣpaiḥ kāryam ity ukaṃ vārāhapurāṇe |
gandhapuṣpārcanaṃ kṛtvā dadyād dhaste tilodakam |
arcanaprakāras tūktaḥ kālikāpurāṇe |
abhyarcya vidhivad bhaktyā sṛṣṭinyāyena mantravit |
arghyaṃ dadyāt tataḥ pātrair brahmavṛkṣadalodbhavaiḥ ||
śirasto ’dho’dhaḥ karaṇaṃ sṛṣṭinyāyena karaṇaṃ, śīrṣato vāgre jāyamāno jāyata iti śatapathe śīrṣataḥ sṛṣṭiśruteḥ vaikalpikaṃ caitat |
ata eva gārgya-ślokagautamāv āhatuḥ |
śirastaḥ pādato vāpi samyag abhyarcayet tataḥ |
pūrvavat pṛthag ekaikam ekaikenārcayet kramāt ||
[1289] atra pitṝn pādataḥ śirasto vā pūjayed devāṃs tu pādata eveti śaṅkhadharo vyākhyātavān | pūrvavad iti yā divyā ity anena mantreṇa ekaikaṃ pitrādim ekaikenārghyeṇa pūjayet | smṛticandrikākāras tu ekaikaṃ brāhmaṇam ekaikenārghyeṇa pūjayed iti manyamānaḥ pitṛpakṣe trīn ity etatpakṣaviṣayatām asyoktavān | pādato yad abhyarcanaṃ tat mūrdhāntaṃ yac ca śirastaḥ tat pādāntaṃ mantraviśeṣeṇa kartavyam ity āha pracetāḥ |
pādaprabhṛti mūrddhantaṃ devānāṃ puṣpapūjanam |
śiraḥprabhṛti pādāntaṃ namo va iti paitṛke ||
atra namo va iti mantro vājasaneyaśākhīyas tāval likhyate | namo vaḥ pitaro rasāya namo vaḥ pitaraḥ śoṣāya namo vaḥ pitaro jīvāya namo vaḥ pitaraḥ svadhāyai namo vaḥ pitaro ghorāya namo vaḥ pitaro manyave namo vaḥ pitaraḥ pitaro namo vo gṛhān naḥ pitaro datta sato vaḥ pitaro deṣmeti | śākhāntarīyās tu piṇḍapradāne darśayiṣyante |
pūjāyām ayam eva krama uktaḥ skandapurāṇe |
śīrṣaṇam āditaḥ skandhapāṇijānupadadvaye |
satilair gandhakusumair arcayīta pitṛdvijān ||
asyārthaḥ | prathamaṃ śirasi, tataḥ savyāṃse, dakṣiṇāṃśe, savyakare, dakṣiṇakare, savyajānuni, dakṣiṇajānuni, savyapāde, dakṣiṇapāda iti krameṇa tilagandhakusumaiḥ pitṛviprārcanaṃ kuryāt | iha prācīnāvītyācitasavyajānur dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ pitṝn dhyāyan arghyapātrasthitam udakaṃ yā divyā iti mantreṇa pitrādināmagotroccāraṇapūrvakam eva eṣa te’ rghya [1290] iti sapavitreṣu brāhmaṇahasteṣu pitṛtīrthena prakṣepaṇīyam iti kriyākramaḥ | etena prācīnāvītādayaḥ padārthāḥ sāmānyavacanaprāpitā api yāvaddṛṣṭavacanasaṃgrāhibhir asmābhir viśeṣato ’pi smṛtipurāṇavacanārūḍhāḥ pradṛśyante tatra pitṛdhyānaṃ prācīnāvītaṃ cokaṃ pracetasā |
pitṝn dhyāyan brāhmaṇeṣv apasavyaṃ ninayet || iti |
brāhmaṇaśarīreṣu pitṝn dhyāyan prakṣiped ity arthaḥ ||
dakṣiṇābhimukhatvaṃ, yā divyā iti mantraḥ, prakṣepaṇīyaṃ, prakṣepādhikaraṇaṃ coktaṃ nāgarakhaṇḍe |
paitṛke yābhyavaktreṇa pitṝṇāṃ parituṣṭaye |
yā divyā iti mantreṇa hasteṣv arthaṃ pradāpayet || iti |
'yāmyavaktreṇa' dakṣiṇādikprekṣakeṇa mukhena viśiṣṭaḥ kartā, 'arghyaṃ' arghyārtham udakaṃ, 'pradāpayet' pradadyāt | yā divyā iti mantrasvarūpaṃ kātyāyanādivacaneṣu sphuṭī bhaviṣyati |
hastānāṃ brāhmaṇasaṃbandhaṃ teṣu ca pavitrāntarhiteṣv arghyodakaniṣecanam āhatuḥ śaṅkhalikhitau |
pavitrāntarhiteṣu brāhmaṇahasteṣūdakaṃ ninayet || iti |
pavitrāntardhānaṃ ca kecid brāhmaṇahaste pavitraṃ nidhāya kurvate, apare tv arghyapātrasyāgre tiraścīnaṃ pavitraṃ vidhārayantas tat saṃpādayanti | pitṛtīrthavidhis tu piṭatīrthena tato ’yam ityādau brahmapurāṇavacane darśayiṣyate |
pitrādināmoccāraṇapūrvakatvam uktaṃ sāṅkhyāyanagṛhye |
udapātrāṇi tilair avakīryāsāv etat ta ity anudiśya brāhmaṇānāṃ
pāṇiṣu ninayet || iti |
asāv iti pitrādipāvakasya viśeṣanāmnaḥ parāmarśaḥ kriyate |
[1291] ata eva nāmagotroccāraṇapūrvakatvam uktaṃ pādma-mātsya purāṇayoḥ |
evaṃ pātrāṇi saṃkalpya yathālābhaṃ vimatsaraḥ |
yā divyeti pitṛāmagotrair darbhakare nyaset ||
pitrādīnāṃ nāma gotraṃ coccārya darbhayukte brāhmaṇakare ’rghyaṃ nyased ity arthaḥ | kare ity ekavacanād ekasmin dakṣiṇa eva dvijakare ’rghyadānaṃ kartavyam ity abhimatam |
vaijavāpena tv añjalāv arghyadānam uktam |
pātrāṇy anudiśati pitar etat te ’rghyaṃ, pitāmahaitat te ’rghyaṃ, prapitāmahaitat te 'rghyām iti brāhmaṇāñjaliṣu pātrāṇi ninayet || iti |
pātrāṇīti pātrasthāni jalādiny arghyavastūni, atra pitrādiśabdān saṃbuddhyekavacanāntān prayuñjānena nāmagotrayor api tadantayor eva prayogaḥ sucitaḥ |
tathā ca praceto-vṛddhavasiṣṭhau |
apradakṣiṇam eteṣāṃ ekaikaṃ tu pitṛkramāt |
saṃbodhya nāmagotrābhyām eṣa te ’rghyaṃ itīrayan ||
'eteṣāṃ' pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahānāṃ, 'pitṛkramāt' pitrādikramāt 'ekaikaṃ', 'nāmagotrābhyāṃ saṃbodhya' nāmagotroccāraṇena saṃmukhīkṛtya, anenārthāt saṃbodhanavibhaktiprayogo gamyate | eṣa te ’rghya ity uccārayan pitrādyadhiṣṭhānabhūtabrāhmaṇahaste ’rghyaṃ dadyād iti śeṣaḥ | 'te' ity anena sahānvayopapattyarthaṃ nāmagotrayor ekavacanāntayoḥ prayogo ’nusaṃdheyaḥ | atra nāmagotragrahaṇaṃ saṃbandhābhidhānasyopalakṣaṇaṃ ceti vijñeyam |
tathā ca vyāsaḥ |
[1292] gotrasaṃbandhanāmāni pitṝṇām anukīrtayan |
ekaikasya tu viprasya arghyapātraṃ vinikṣipet ||
'ekaikasya tu viprasya' ity etat kecid evaṃ vyācakṣate | yady apy ekaikasya pitrādeḥ sthāne bahavo brāhmaṇā nimantritās tathāpy ekadevatādhiṣṭhānabhūteṣu brāhmaṇeṣv ekam eva brāhmaṇaṃ taduddeśaparikalpitenārgheṇa pūjayet, na tu tadadhiṣṭhānabhūtadvitīyādikam apīti |
anye tv āhuḥ | ekadevatāsaṃbandhena yāvanto brāhmaṇāḥ saṃpāditās tāvatāṃ hasteṣu tatpātrastham arghyodakaṃ pradeyam | ekaikasyeti pratibrāhmaṇaṃ pṛthak pṛthak kriyārambhārtham | asmiṃś ca pakṣe hasteṣv arghyaṃ pradāpayed ity ekasyārghyodakasthān ekahastasaṃbandhābhidhānam asamañjasaṃ syāt | pratyadhiṣṭhānaṃ pratipādyamānagandha-
puṣpādisārūpyamarghyadānasya kṛtaṃ syāt |
saṃbuddhyantānāṃ saṃbandhābhidhānānām prayogast u mānava-maitrāyaṇīyasūtre ’bhihitaḥ |
pavitraṃ viprapāṇau pradāya nāmagotre samuccārya mama pitar etat te ’rghyaṃ mama pitāmaha prapitāmaheti |
atra kecid dakṣiṇapāṇer eva sakalakarmasādhanatvaṃ manyamānāḥ pātrodakam arghyadānaninayanaṃ ca tenaivācaranti | anye tu pāṇibhyāṃ pātram uddhṛtya tābhyām eva pātreṇārghaṃ ninayanti |
tathā ca dharmaḥ |
yā divyā āpa iti pātraṃ pāṇibhyām uddhṛtya nāma gotraṃ ca gṛhītvā sapavitre haste ’rghyaṃ dadyāt || iti |
[1293] brahmapurāṇe tv anya eva prakāro ’rghyaninayane darśitaḥ |
tato vāmena hastena gṛhītvā camasān kramāt |
pitṛtīrthena tat toyaṃ dakṣiṇena ca pāṇinā ||
dattadarbhodake haste viprāṇāṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak |
dadyān mantraṃ japaṃś cātha yā divyā āpa ity api |
amukāmukagotraitat tubhyam astu tilodakam ||
vāmahastagṛhītena pātreṇa dakṣiṇahaste jalaṃ srāvayan dakṣiṇahastapitṛtīrthena viprahaste tan ninayed iti vacanārthaḥ | atra eṣa te ’rghya ity etasya sthāne etat tubhyam astu tilodakam ity uccāraṇīyam | ayaṃ ca mantraḥ prāyeṇāgnimatkartṛkaśrāddhaviṣaya iti gamyate, sāgnikaśrāddhe hy arghyaśabdam antareṇaivodakaniṣecanavidher upālambhāt |
ata eva baudhāyanaḥ |
athaitās tilamiśrā apaḥ pratigrāhayiṣyann amuṣmai svadhā namo ’muṣmai svadhā nama iti tris tilodakam eke samāmananti, puro ’nnaṃ dvis tilodakaṃ dadyāt, bhuktavatsu ca tṛtīyam || iti |
'apaḥ pratigrāhayiṣyan' brāhmaṇān apaḥ svīkārayiṣyan, pitrādināmānantaraṃ svadhā nama ity uccārayet | 'trir' ityādi, 'eke' sūtrakārāḥ, śrāddhaprayoge trivāraṃ tilodakam āmananti | tatra kālān āha, 'puro ’nnaṃ dviḥ' annatyāgāt pūrvaṃ dvivāram | tatra gomayamaṇḍale caraṇakṣālanānantaram ekaṃ, agnaukaraṇāt pūrvaṃ dvitīyam | 'bhuktavatsu ca tṛtīyam' iti bhuktvācānteṣu dvijeṣv akṣayyodakākhyaṃ tṛtīyam ity arthaḥ | ata eva pradeśāntare sa evāha, pitṛbhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ pitāmahebhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ prapitāmahebhyaḥ [1294] svadhā nama iti svadhā dattveti | svadhā pūrvam eva vyākhyātā, tāḥ brāhmaṇahaste dattvāgnaukuryād ity uttareṇa saṃbandhaḥ |
nigamo ’pi |
tebhyo vyatiṣaṅgam avadānavad dhṛtvā hasteṣv apo niṣiñcaty amuṣyeti nāmagrāhaṃ caturthena mātāmahādīnām avanejyeti |
‘tebhyaḥ’ camasebhyaḥ, caturthena mātāmahādīnām ity uktatvāt | tribhyaś camasebhyaḥ apo datvā hastenoddhṛtya amuṣyeti ṣaṣṭhyantam ekaikasya pitrāder nāma gṛhītvā tattadbrāhmaṇahasteṣu niṣiñcet | uddharaṇaprakāram āha | 'vyatiṣaṅgam avadānavad' iti | yathā cāturmāsyeṣu paitre mahāhaviṣi vyatiṣaṅgam avadānāni gṛhyante evam atrāpīti | tad yathā paitre pitāmahaprapitāmahacamasebhyo gṛhītvā prathamaṃ pitṛbrāhmaṇahaste niṣiñcet | tataḥ paitāmahaprapaitāmahapaitracamasebhyo gṛhītvā pitāmahadvijakare niṣiñcet | tataś ca prapaitāmahapaitrapaitāmahacamasebhyo gṛhītvā prapitāmahadvijakare niṣiñcet || iti |
āśvalāyanīyās tu sārghyapātraṃ vāmahastaṃ dakṣiṇahastāṅguṣṭhatarjanyantarāle niveśya pātrāntaraparisrutenodakenārghyaṃ kurvanti, savyopasṛṣṭadakṣiṇakaragṛhītena pātreṇa vā | tac ca prasavyenetarapāṇyaṅguṣṭhāntareṇetyādāv āśvalāyanavacane prāg eva darśitam | pātrānumantraṇamantrād arghyadāne mantrāntaraṃ, yā divyā ity asya brāhmaṇahastagalitodakānumantraṇe viniyogaṃ cāha āśvalāyanaḥ |
pitar idaṃ te ’rghyaṃ pitāmahedaṃ te ’yam ity anupūrvantāḥ pratigrāhayiṣyan sakṛt svadhārghyā iti prasṛṣṭāsv anumantritāsu yā divyā āpaḥ pṛthivyāṃ saṃbabhūvur yā antarikṣā uta pārthivīr yāḥ | hiraṇyavarṇā yajñiyās tā na āpaḥ saṃsyonāḥ suhavā bhavantu || iti |
[1295] atra tilāvāpānantaraṃ pitar idaṃ te ’rghyaṃ pitāmahedaṃ te ’rghyaṃ prapitāmahedaṃ te ’rghyam ity ānupūrvyeṇa pitrādikrameṇa ekaikasmin pātre ekaikamantreṇārghyaṃ prayojayet na tv etāny arghyadānavākyānīti bhāṣyakārāḥ |
'tāḥ' pātrasthā apaḥ, brāhmaṇān pratigrāhayiṣyan sakṛt sakṛt svadhārghyā iti mantraṃ japet | anena pratigrāhayed ity arthaḥ | sakṛtsakṛdvacanād asya trir evoccāraṇaṃ kartavyaṃ, brāhmaṇabhedānurodhenāvṛttiḥ | tāsu prasṛṣṭāsu brāhmaṇahastebhyo bhūmigatāsu yā divyā ity anayarcānumantrayet, anumantraṇaṃ ca sakṛd eva sarveṣām iti prāg evoktam |
kātyāyanas tu pṛthivyām ity etasya sthāne payaseti paṭhitavān, ekaikasyaikaikena dadāti sapavitreṣu hasteṣu | yā divyā āpaḥ payasā saṃbabhūvur yā antarikṣā uta pārthivīr yāḥ hiraṇyavarṇā yajñiyās tā na āpaḥ saṃsyonāḥ suhavā bhavantv iti asāv eṣa te ’rghyaṃ iti |
gobhilas tu śivā iti padādhikam amum eva mantraṃ paṭhitavān, ekaikasyaikaikena dadāti sapavitreṣu hateṣu | yā divyā āpaḥ payasā saṃbabhūvur yā antarikṣā uta pārthivīr yā hiraṇyavarṇāḥ yajñiyās tā na āpaḥ śivāḥ saṃsyonāḥ suhavā bhavantv asāv etat te ’rghyam iti |
ye viṣṇusmṛti-viṣṇudharmottara-brahmapurāṇeṣu yās tiṣṭhantītyādayo ’rghyamantrāḥ uktāḥ te pādyādipratipādana eva darśitāḥ |
maitrāyaṇīyasūtre ekaikaṃ pitre pitāmahāya prapitāmahāya cānudiśya brāhmaṇasya pāṇau ninayet | pitre pitāmahāyetyādicaturthyantanirdeśāt amukagotrāya amukaśarmaṇe asmatpitre ’yam arghya ityādīny arghyadānavākyāni prayojyāni iti gamyate |
[1296] āha hārītaḥ |
brāhmaṇair anujñātaḥ samitsvetīdhyam āvāhyāgniṣvāttādīn brāhmaṇasthān udapātrair yathārtham arcayitveti |
atra samitsveti brāhmaṇakartṛkānujñāśravaṇād agnisamindhanaṃ karavāṇītyādiprārthanāvākyaṃ draṣṭavyam | evam anujñāpya 'idhya' agnau samindhanārthaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ kṣiptvā, pūrvapradarśitair eta pitara ityādibhir mantraiḥ pitṝn āvāhya tataḥ pūrvakalpitair udapātrair upaviṣṭān brāhmaṇasyāgniṣvāttādīn ādigrahaṇād dhavirbhukprabhṛtīn yathāpūrvaṃ yasya varṇasya yair arcitair arthaḥ śrāddhaṃ sidhyati tānn arcayet | te tu "somapā nāma viprāṇām" ityādinā manuvacanena pūrvapradarśitāḥ |
yadā āvāhana eva mṛtapitrādyadhiṣṭhātṛbhāvenāgniṣvāttādisaṃkalpārcanaṃ tu pitrāditrayasyaiva nāmabhir yathārtham iti vacanāt | anenaiva ca jīvatpitṛkāder dvayārcanam iti jñāyate | yamaḥ |
tataḥ salilam ānīya tuṣṇīṃ dadyāt pavitravat |
tuṣṇīm ity anena mantrarāhityaṃ tena yā divyā ityādayo 'numantraṇamantrā vikalpena karaṇamantrā vety anusaṃdheyam | atha vaitad arghyadāne mantrarāhityaṃ yeṣāṃ vṛddhaparaṃparayā caryate teṣām eva na sarveṣām iti vyavasthayā boddhavyam | 'pavitratrat' pavitrādisakalārghyadravyasahitam | asmiṃś ca mate brāhmaṇahaste ’nye eva kuśā nidheyāḥ | evam eva mātāmahādīnām api arghyapātrasaṃskārādi brāhmaṇahaste ’rghyadānaṃ tattannāmagotrasaṃbandhābhidhānasahitaṃ padārthānusamayena kuryāt | mātāmahānām apy evam iti [1297] atideśasmaraṇāt arghyadānānantaram ācamanaṃ kartavyam iti pūrvapradarśitāt brahmapurāṇavacanād avagantavyam |
ity arghyadānam |
atha saṃsravaviniyogādi |
tatra āśvalāyanagṛhye |
saṃsravān samavanīya tābhir adbhiḥ putrakāmo mukham anaktīti |
'saṃsravāḥ' arghyapātrasthitā jalaśeṣāḥ | atra liṅgadarśanaṃ śatapathe |
saṃstravo hy eva khalu pariśiṣṭo bhavatīti |
kecit tu brāhmaṇakarāṅgulivivaraviniḥsṛtam arghyodakaṃ saṃsravaśabdenocyata iti vyācakṣate | tanmate tu arghyadānasamaye eva saṃsravad udakaṃ prathamapātre saṃsriyate | 'samavanīya' ekatra sambhṛtya | tathā ca kātyāyanaḥ | "ekasmin saṃsravān samavanīya puttrakāmo mukham anaktīti" | mukhasya saṃbandhyapekṣāyāṃ saṃnidhānād adhikāriṇa eva saṃbandhitvenāvagamāt putrakāmo yajamānaḥ svamukham añjyād ity avagamyate | 'ekasmin' prathamapitṛpātre |
tathā ca vṛddhaśātātapaḥ |
prathame pitṛpātre tu sarvān saṇbhṛtya saṃsravān |
anakti vadanaṃ paścāt putrakāmo bhaved yadi ||
pitrārghyapātreṣu yat prathamaṃ pātraṃ tatra sarvān saṃsravān saṃbhṛtya, atra pitṛpātrasaṃnidhānāt sarvaśabdena pitṛpātragatā evaṃ saṃsravā gṛhyante, na vaiśvadevapātrasthā apīti |
ślokakātyāyanas tu saṃsravābhimantraṇe mukhāñjane ca mantram uktavān |
arghyaṃ svadhāyā ity uktvā saṃsravān abhimantrayet |
[1298] ye devā iti mantreṇa putrakāmo mukhaṃ spṛśet |
atra pratīkagṛhīto mantro likhyate |
ye devāḥ pitaro ye ca mānuṣā ye garbhe ’stu maruta ye parāstā | ya udbhatā uta ye nikhātās te sasyaṃ iha mādayantām |
brahmapurāṇe tu tatpātrasthiteṣv eva saṃsravajaleṣu puttrakāmasya yajamānasya svamukhapratibimbāvalokanam uktam |
teṣu saṃsravapātreṣu jalapūrṇeṣu tatra saḥ putrakāmo mukhaṃ paśyen mantaṃ pūrvamukho japet |
śundhantāṃ lokāḥ pitṛsadanāḥ pitṛsadanam asīti ca |
nāgarakhaṇḍe tv āyuṣkāmasya saṃsravajalena locanāvasecanam uktam |
pitṛpātre samādhāya arghyapātrāṇi kṛcchraśaḥ |
āyuṣkāmas tu tat toyaṃ locanābhyāṃ parikṣipet ||
'pitṛpātre' pitur arghyapātre | arghyapātrāṇīti lakṣaṇayā pātrasthitā jalaśeṣāḥ | 'samādhāya' nikṣipya, locanābhyāṃ parikṣipet | anye tu pitur arghyapātre śeṣāṇy arghyapātrāṇy eva nidhāya tebhyas tadavasthebhyo haste jalaṃ saṃsrāvya tena locanasrakṣaṇaṃ kāryam ity āhuḥ | prathamapātrasaṃbhṛtaṃ saṃsravodakaṃ haste gṛhītvā āpaḥ śivāḥ śivatamāḥ śāntāḥ śāntatamās tās te kṛṇvantu bheṣajam iti prāṅmukhopaviṣṭasya yajamānasyānyenābhiṣekaḥ kriyata iti vājasaneyināmācāraḥ | etāni ca mukhāñjanādīni kāmyāni karmaṇi yajñopavītinā yajamānena kāryāṇi | pūrvamukhatvaliṅgenāpaitṛkakarmakatvāvagateḥ [1299] phalasādhanatvena godohanavat prakṛtakriyāṅgabhāvābhāvāc ca | evam iha mukhamārjanādiṣu kāmyakriyāviśeṣeṣu viniyoga uktaḥ | tatra yadi teṣūpayujyamānānāṃ teṣāṃ kriyānaṃśo 'vaśiṣyate tadā vā kāmavirahe vā pratipattiviśeṣaḥ kāryaḥ | so ’pi tadaiva vā svadhāvācanaparyantaṃ saṃgṛhya vā tatra prathamapitṛpātranyubjīkaraṇapakṣe tadaiva uttānadhāraṇapakṣe tu svadhāvācanāvyavahita-pūrvakāle | yais tu karāṅguligatāny arghyodakāni saṃsravaśabdenocyate iti pakṣāśrayaṇaṃ kriyate taiḥ prāguktamukhāñjanādikāryeṣu tāny evopayojyāni | vakṣyamāṇapratipattis tu pātrasthānām arghyaśeṣāṇām eva kartavyā, ye tu saṃsravasahitaṃ pātraṃ nyubjīkurvanti tanmate dvividhānām api saṃsravāṇāṃ śaucaniṣṭheti |
tatrārghyadānānantaram eva pratipattir vaijavāpagṛhye |
pitṛbhyo ’kṣyayyam astv iti śeṣaṃ darbheṣv avane japatīti |
arghye datte yatpātre avaśiṣṭaṃ jalaṃ tad bhūmāv āstīrṇeṣu darbheṣu niṣiñced ity arthaḥ | tadanantaraṃ tatpātram anupahate kvacit pradeśe sthāpayet | tathā ca maitrāyaṇīyasūtre “śiṣṭaṃ barhiṣi ninayed abhyukṣya pratyāsādayet” iti | abhyukṣyapātraṃ pratyāsādanasthānaṃ vā | 'pratyāsādanaṃ' nāma pūrvam āsādya gṛhītasya kṛtakāryasya punaḥ kvacit pradeśe sthāpanam | saṃsravāṇaṃ saṃgrahaṃ kṛtvā svadhāvācanāt pūrvakālaṃ teṣāṃ pratipattis tv atriṇoktā |
apasavyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā piṇḍapātre samāhitaḥ |
kṣiptvā darbhapavitrāṇi mocayet saṃsravāṃs tataḥ ||
etac ca saṃsravadhāraṇaṃ pātrasyottānatayā sthāpane saty eva nānyathā, ato ’nenārthād uttānatayaiva pātrasya sthāpanam uktaṃ veditavyaṃ | asmiṃs tu [1300] pakṣe saṃsravādhārīkṛtasya pitṛpātrasya pitāmahapātreṇa nyubjenottānena vā pidhānaṃ kartavyam |
tathā ca yama-kātyāyanau |
paitṛkaṃ prathamaṃ pātraṃ tasmin paitāmahaṃ nyaset |
prapitāmahaṃ tato nyasya noddharet na ca cālayet ||
atrir api |
tṛtīyenāpidhāpayet | tṛtīyābhāve cānyeneti |
pitṛpātraṃ pitāmahapātreṇa pidhāya prapitāmahapātreṇāpidadhyāt, prapitāmahapātrābhāve anyena yena kenacit pātreṇa vṛddhaprapitāmahapātreṇa vāpidadhīta | prapaitāmahapātrābhāvas tu jīvatprapitāmahake śrāddhe ’nusaṃdheyaḥ | etac ca pātranidhānaṃ viśeṣāgrahaṇād uttānasthāpananyubjīkaraṇobhayapakṣasādhāraṇam | tatra saṃsravasahitanyubjīkaraṇamantraś coktaḥ kūrmapurāṇe |
saṃsravāṃś ca tataḥ sarvān pātre kuryāt samāhitaḥ |
pitṛbhyaḥ sthānam asīti nyubjaṃ pātraṃ nidhāpayet ||
'pātra iti pitur arghyapātraṃ (?) pitṛbhyaḥ sthānam asīty anena mantreṇa 'nyubjaṃ' adhomukhaṃ, 'nidhāpayediti nidadhītety arthaḥ |
pitur arghyapātre saṃsravanidhānam uktaṃ kātyāyanasūtre |
prathame pātre saṃsravān samavanīya pitṛbhyaḥ sthānam asīti nyubjaṃ
pātraṃ karotīti |
pitrārghyapātreṣu pitur arghyapātram eva prathamam iti vyaktam evāvagamyate |
gobhilas tu nyubjīkaraṇānantaram etanmantrajapam āha |
prathame pātre saṃsravān samavanīya pātraṃ nyubjaṃ kṛtvā pitṛbhyaḥ
sthānam asīti |
[1301] japed iti śeṣaḥ |
saṃsrvapātranyubjīkaraṇāya pradeśaviśeṣas tu nāgarakhaṇḍe |
adhomukhaṃ ca tat pātraṃ vijane sthāpayet tataḥ |
'tad' iti yasmin pitṛpākṣe saṃsravāḥ saṃgṛhītāḥ | 'vijane' śrāddhīyadravyānayanāpanayana-pariveṣaṇādikartṛjanasaṃcaraṇadoṣarahite pradeśe |
evaṃvidhe ’pi na yasmin kasmiṃścit kiṃ tu vaiśvadevikadvijapaṅkter uttarata evety āha pracetāḥ |
pitṛpātre nidhāyātha nyubjam uttarato nyaset |
pitṛbhyaḥ sthānam asīti nidhāyāthārcayed dvijān ||
pitṛpākṣe saṃsravān nidhāya tatpātraṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ purataḥ pitṛbhyaḥ sthānam asīti anena mantreṇa nyubjam adhomukhaṃ sthāpayet | tadanantaraṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ śrāddhabhoktṝn arcayet |
pādma-mātsyapurāṇayor apy uktam |
yā divyety arghyam utsṛjya dadyād gandhādikaṃ tataḥ |
vastrottaraṃ cānupūrvaṃ datvā saṃsravam āditaḥ ||
pitṛpātre nidhāyātha nyubjam uttarato nyaset |
pitṛbhyaḥ sthānam asīti nidhāya pariveṣayet ||
asyārthaḥ | yā divyety anena mantreṇārghyaṃ 'utsṛjya' datvā tadanantaraṃ 'āditaḥ' prathamaṃ, pitṛpātre saṃsravān pitāmahāyapātrasthitān jalaśeṣān nidhāya tat pātraṃ pitṛbhyaḥ sthānam asīty anena mantreṇa bhoktṛdvijapaṅkter uttarato nyubjaṃ ‘nyaset' nidadhīta, nidhāya ca 'gandhādikaṃ' gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpaṃ, 'vastrottaraṃ vastram uttaraṃ yasya yasya dīyate [1302] tadanupūrvakrameṇa datvāgnaukaraṇaṃ ca kṛtvā pariveṣayed iti |
saṃsravapātrasya bhūmāv eva nyubjīkaraṇaṃ na tu pīṭhavṛśīkutupādyuparīty āha yājñavalkyaḥ |
datvārghyaṃ saṃsravāṃs teṣāṃ pātre kṛtvā vidhānataḥ |
pitṛbhyaḥ sthānam asīti nyubjaṃ pātraṃ karoty adhaḥ ||
adha iti bhūmāv eva |
ata eva pracetāḥ |
prathame pitṛpātre tu sarvān saṃbhṛtya saṃsravān |
pitṛbhyaḥ sthānam ity ukvā kuryād bhūmāv adhomukham ||
etac ca kuśāntaritāyām eva bhūmāv adhomukhaṃ kartavyam |
tathā cātra bhāḍalācāryeṇa smṛtir darśitā ||
kuryād darbheṣv adhomukham || iti |
asmābhir apy atra kātyāyanavacanaṃ darśayiṣyate |
pātrasthāpanabhūmeḥ samantrakaṃ prokṣaṇam āha dakṣaḥ |
śundhantāṃ lokā iti tu siñced bhūmiṃ kṣipet kuśān pitṛbhyaḥ
sthānam asīti |
śundhantāṃ lokāḥ pitṛṣadanā ity etāvatparimāṇaṃ yajuḥ |
śaṅkhadhara-aparākābhyāṃ pradarśite tu kātyāyanavacane nyubjīkaraṇe mantrāntaram uktam | śundhantāṃ lokāḥ pitṛṣadanā ity anena mantreṇa tilodakenāvasicya tatra pitṛṣadanam asīti anena mantraṇa tat pātram adhomukhaṃ sthāpayet | atra dvārakāryaikyāt pitṛbhyaḥ sthānam asīti anena sahāsya vikalpa iti śaṅkhadharaḥ |
[1303] pracetasā tu śudhyantām ity asya sthāpayiṣyamāṇapātrasparśane viniyogaḥ sapavitrasya ca pātrasya nyubjīkaraṇaṃ tadupari kuśanidhānaṃ coktam |
arghyasaṃsravapātraṃ tu śundhantām iti saṃspṛśet |
pitṛbhyaḥ sthānam asīti nyubjaṃ kuryāt pavitravit ||
tasyopari kuśān datveti |
yāny arghyapātrebhyaḥ samuddhṛtya brāhmaṇahasteṣu dattāni pavitrāṇy āsan tāny ādāya taiḥ saha nyubjaṃ kuryāt, sahabhāvaś caivam | atra teṣv eva pavitreṣu yaiḥ svadhāninayanaṃ kriyate te nyubjīkṛtapātrapārśve dakṣiṇāgrāṇi tāni sthāpayanti | ye tu tadvyatirikteṣv eva darbheṣu svadhāninayanaṃ kurvate teṣām eva pavitrāṇām upari pātraṃ nyubjī kurvanti |
vaijavāpo ’pi |
tasyopari kuśān datvā pradadyād devapūrvakam |
pradadyād ityādir uttaravākyasyāvayavaḥ |
kātyāyana āha |
atra gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpānāṃ pradānam || iti |
atreti kṛte nyubjīkṛte pātre | kecit tu atrety etasminn avasare brāhmaṇebhyo gandhādīnāṃ pradānam iti vyācakṣate | tad apy aviruddhaṃ vacanāntarasaṃvādadarśanāt | atris tu gandhapuṣpādibhir abhyarcita eva deśe pātrasya nyubjīkaraṇam, nyubjīkṛtasyārcanamantreṇaivāpidhānam, pidhāyakapātrasyāpy arcanam āha |
gandhādibhis tad abhyarcya tṛtīyenāpidhāpayet |
pitṛbhyaḥ sthānam asīti śucau deśe ’rcite 'rcayet ||
[1304] atra dvitīyenāpidhāyayed ity avagantavyam |
brahmapurāṇe tu nyubjīkṛteṣu pātreṣu pitṝṇāṃ pādyādibhir arcanam uktam |
tatas teṣv arghyapātreṣu sāpidhāneṣu vai pitṝn |
pūjayet pitṛpūrvaṃ tu pādyārghyakusumādibhiḥ ||
yady api sāpidhāneṣu pūjayed ity uktaṃ tathāpy apidhānarahite sarvottare pātre pūjanaṃ kartavyam | sāpidhānaśabdasyānapidhāne 'pi bhūmnā pravṛttatvāt | ato 'trārghyapātreṣu sāpidhāneṣv iti vacanārjavāya nāparam anarghyapātram arghapātrapidhāyakaṃ kalpanīyam |
etac ca nyubjīkṛtyārcitaṃ pātraṃ brāhmaṇavisarjanādikālāt pūrvaṃ noddharaṇīyam ity āpastamba-yamāv āhatuḥ |
noddharet prathamaṃ pātraṃ pitṝṇām arghyapātitam |
āvṛtās tatra tiṣṭhanti yāvad vipravisarjanam ||
'prathamaṃ' vipravisarjanāt pūrvaṃ vipravisarjanapūrvakālāt pūrvaṃ vā prītipraśnapūrvakālāt pūrvaṃ vā | 'pitṝṇām arghyapātitam' pitṝṇām arghyakarmaṇi nyubjīkṛtapātraṃ, noddharet | yatas tena pātreṇa āvṛtāḥ santaḥ pitaras tatra tiṣṭhanti te tasyoddharaṇe sati pradhvastagṛhā gṛhamedhina ivāvṛtāḥ santo ’pasarantīty arthavādaḥ | ataḥ pūrvoktakālatrayāt pūrvaṃ noddharet, vipravisarjanagrahaṇasya kālatrayopalakṣaṇārthatvāt |
āśvalāyanagṛhye ’pi |
noddharet prathamaṃ pātraṃ pitṝṇām arghyapātitam |
āvṛtās tatra tiṣṭhanti pitaraḥ śaunako ’bravīt ||
uddharaṇe doṣo ’pi tatraivoktaḥ |
[1305] uddhared yadi cet pātraṃ brāhmaṇo jñānadurbalaḥ |
abhojyaṃ tad bhavec chrāddhaṃ kruddhe pitṛgaṇe gate ||
āpastamba-yamābhyām api doṣo ’bhihitaḥ |
uddhareta yadā pātraṃ vivṛtaṃ tu yadā bhavet |
abhojyaṃ tad bhavec chrāddhaṃ devaiḥ pitṛgaṇaiḥ saha ||
uśanasā tūdghāṭane ’pi doṣo ’bhihitaḥ |
uttānaṃ vivṛtaṃ cāpi pitṛpātraṃ yadā bhavet |
abhojyaṃ tad bhaved annaṃ kruddhaiḥ pitṛgaṇair gataiḥ ||
vivṛtam ity udghāṭitam |
yama-kātyāyanābhyāṃ tu tasya sparśe doṣo ’bhihitaḥ |
spṛṣṭam uddhṛtam anyatra nītam udghāṭitaṃ tathā |
pātraṃ dṛṣṭvā vrajanty āśu pitaraḥ praśapanti ca ||
'spṛṣṭaṃ' hastādinā saṃyojitaṃ, 'uddhṛtam' utkṣiptaṃ, 'anyatra nītaṃ' sthānāntaraṃ prāpitaṃ, 'udghāṭitam' apanītapidhānaṃ, 'pātraṃ' arghyapātraṃ, dṛṣṭvā pitaraḥ 'vrajanti' śrāddhadeśaṃ tyajanti, 'śapanti ca' yajamānaṃ prati tvam asuto 'nāyur adhano bhava ityādiprakārām aniṣṭaphalāṃ vācam utsṛjanti | atra sparśanam antareṇoddharaṇādikriyākaraṇasāmarthyavirahāt sparśamātre doṣābhidhānenoddharaṇādāv api sidhyaty eva doṣaḥ, tathāpi doṣātiśayārthaṃ teṣāṃ pṛthag upanyāsaḥ | atha vā sparśam antareṇa yaṣṭyādinābhyuddharaṇe doṣaprāpyarthaṃ teṣāṃ pṛthagabhidhānam iti |
iti saṃsravaviniyogādi |
atha prayogapaddhatiḥ |
yathoktapitryadharmayuktaḥ kartā prokṣitāyāṃ bhuvi dakṣiṇāpavargatayāstīrṇeṣu triṣu darbheṣv ekaikam ity evaṃ pitṛvarge trīṇi taijasāśmamayamṛṇmayānīty evaṃ bhinnajātīyāni pātraprakaraṇoktataijasādyanyatamaikajātīyāni vā pātrāṇi “āmāgantu" ityādinā mantreṇa tūṣṇīṃ vā sāgniko ’gnisamīpe anagniko brāhmaṇasamīpe dakṣiṇāpavargaṃ dakṣiṇāgratayā nyubjāny āsādya teṣāṃ paścimatas tathaiva mātāmahavarge trīṇy ekaṃ vāsādyāsādanakrameṇa prokṣyottānāni kuryāt uttānāny eva vāsādayet | teṣu ca pratyekaṃ triśikhāni dviguṇīkṛtāni dakṣiṇāgrāṇi pavitrāṇi nidhāya “śannodevīr" ity anena mantreṇa samanyāyantīmahāvyāhṛty-āpohiṣṭīyair vaikaikasmin pātre dakṣiṇapāṇipradeśinyaṅguṣṭhāntarālasaṃyuktasya vāmasya vāmopaspṛṣṭasya dakṣiṇasya vā karasya pitṛtīrthena jalaṃ niṣiñcet | tadanantaram eva tilosītyādinā tatra tilān prakṣipya gandhadvārām ityādinā mantreṇa tūṣṇīṃ vā gandhaṃ nidhāya śrīś ca ta ityādinā tūṣṇīṃ vā puṣpāṇi prakṣipet | baudhāyanānusārī tu kartā madhuvātetyādibhir mantrair madhughṛtaprakṣepam api kuryāt | gandhapuṣpākṣataprakṣepaṃ tu pitṛbhyo nama ityādinā mantratrayeṇa nirvartayet | nigamānusārī tu pūrvoktāni dravyāṇi sakṣīradadhīni nidadhīta | kālikāpurāṇaṃ brahmapurāṇaṃ cādriyamāṇas tu yavasarṣapatilataṇḍulakuśāgrāṇy api prakṣipet | tadanantaraṃ sarvo ’pi kartā nirastaṃ na mumucer ity anenāvakaran nirasya devo vaḥ savitā ityādinā mantreṇa tṛṣṇīṃ vā hastadvayāṅguṣṭhopakaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ pātrasthaṃ kuśapavitraṃ gṛhītvotpūya tadupari kuśatrayaṃ nidhāya sāvitryānumantrya [1307] kṛtāñjaliḥ oṃ pitryarghyapātrāṇāṃ saṃpattir astv iti pitṛbrāhmaṇān pṛṣṭvā taiś ca oṃ astu pitrarghyapātrāṇāṃ saṃpattir iti prativacane kṛte saty āstīrṇadarbhasahitāni dakṣiṇāgrāṇy arghyapātrāṇi svadhārghyā iti dvijānāṃ purataḥ sthāpayet | tataḥ pitryaprathamadvijahaste ’po datvādimārghyapātrasthaṃ kuśapavitraṃ ca dakṣiṇāgraṃ tatkare nidhāya svena rūpeṇa pitaram anudhyāyan tilagandhakusumaiḥ śirastaḥ pādāntaṃ pādato vā śiro’ntaṃ namo va iti mantreṇa brāhmaṇam abhyarcya pāṇidvayenārghyapātram uddhṛtya yā divyetyādikaṃ mantram uccārya oṃ amukagotrāmukaśarmann asmatpitaḥ sapatnīka vasurūpedaṃ te ’rghyaṃ svadhā nama eṣa te ’rghyaḥ svadhā nama iti vā prayujya pūrvadattapavitrasahite haste tatpātrasthitam arghyodakaṃ dakṣiṇahastapitṛtīrtham anvavanatena pātreṇa kiṃcit ninayet | āśvalāyana-śaunakamatānusārī tu kartā savyakareṇārghyapātram uddhṛtya dakṣiṇakarapitṛtīrtham anvavanāmitena pātreṇa | vakṣyamāṇabrahmapurāṇam ādriyamāṇas tu sambuddhyantagotrādyuccāraṇānantaram etat tubhyam astu tilodakam ity uccārayan vāmakareṇoddhṛtena pātreṇa dakṣiṇahastena jalaṃ srāvayan dakṣiṇahastapitṛtīrthenārghyaṃ dadyāt | tadanantaraṃ tasmāt pavitram ādāya pitradhiṣṭhānabhūtadvitīyādidvijakare pradāya tatra tatpātrasthitaṃ kiṃcit kiṃcid arghyodakaṃ pūrvavan niṣicya kiyatsaṃsravaśabdavācyam avaśeṣayet | brāhmaṇakaragalitasya saṃsravaśabdavācyatvaṃ manyamānas tu nāvaśeṣayet kiṃ tu tatkaragalitaṃ saṃsravakāryārthaṃ kasmiṃścit pātre dhārayet | tataḥ paitāmahaprathamadvijahaste apo datvā pitāmahapātrasthitaṃ kuśapavitraṃ ca dakṣiṇāgraṃ tatkare nidhāya svena rūpeṇa ca pitāmaham anudhyāyan brāhmaṇam abhyarcya pātram uddhṛtya yā divyetyādy uccārya [1308] oṃ amukagotrāmukaśarmann asmatpitāmaha sapatnīka rudrarūpety abhidhāya pitāmahārghyapātreṇa pitāmahādhiṣṭhānabhūtadvijahasteṣu sarvaṃ pūrvavat kuryāt | evaṃ prapitāmahadvijahaste ’po datvā prapitāmahapātrasthitaṃ pavitraṃ tatkare dakṣiṇāgraṃ nidhāya svena rūpeṇādityarūpeṇa ca prapitāmaham anudhyāyan yā divyetyantaṃ kṛtvāmukaśarmann asmatprapitāha sapatnīkādityarūpety abhidhāya prapitāmahārghyapātreṇa prapitāmahādhiṣṭhānabhūtadvijakareṣu sarvaṃ pūrvavat kuryāt | etadanantaraṃ ca pitṛvargavan mātāmahavarge ’pi tattadgotrādyuccāraṇapūrvakam arghyaṃ dadyāt | vargadvaye 'pi ca gotrādyuccāraṇe saṃbuddhyā saha vikalpamānāyāś caturthyā api prayogo ’nusaṃdheyaḥ | nigamamatam anusaraṃs tu paitrapaitāmahaprapaitāmahacamasebhyo ’rghyodakaṃ gṛhītvā yathoktayaivetikartavyatayā prathamaṃ pitṛbrāhmaṇahaste ṣaṣṭhyantagotrādyuccāraṇapūrvakaṃ tan niṣicya paitāmahaprapaitāmahapaitracamasebhyo gṛhītvā pitāmahadvijakare ’vasicya prapaitāmahapaitrapaitāmahacamasebhyo gṛhītvā prapaitāmahadvijakare nikṣipya śeṣaṃ pūrvavat kuryāt | tataḥ sarvo 'pi yajñopavītī prāṅmukhaḥ pitrarghyapātrasthitān jalaśeṣān pitryabrāhmaṇakarāṅguligalitāny arghyodakāni vā pitur arghyapātre saṃbhṛtya arghyaṃ svadhā yā ity anena mantreṇābhimantrya tatpātrasthaṃ saṃsravodakaṃ dakṣiṇakare gṛhītvā ye devā iti mantreṇa putrakāmo yajamānaḥ svamukham añjyāt |
brahmapurāṇam ādriyamāṇas tu prāṅmukho yajñopavītī putrakāma eva pitrāditatpātrāvasthiteṣv evārghyodakaśeṣeṣu śundhantāṃ lokā ityādinā mantreṇa svamukhapratibimbāvalokanaṃ kuryāt | āyuṣkāmas tu yajñopavītādidharmayukraḥ san pitrarghyasaṃsravān pitur arghyapātre nikṣipya pitṛpātre [1309] vā pitāmahapātraṃ tasmiṃś ca prapitāmahapātraṃ nidhāya tadavasthebhya eva tebhyaḥ svadakṣiṇahaste jalaṃ saṃsrāvya tūṣṇīm eva svalocanāñjanaṃ kuryāt | vājasaneyināmācāram anusaraṃs tu prāṅmukhasyāsīnasya yajñopavītino yajamānasya prathamapitṛpātrasaṃbhṛtaiḥ saṃsravaiḥ āpaḥ śivāḥ śivatamā ity anena mantreṇa pitryabrāhmaṇapaṅkāv upaviṣṭaḥ kaścid abhiṣekaṃ kuryāt | tataḥ prācīnāvīto dakṣiṇāmukho mukhāñjanādikriyopayuktasaṃsravaśeṣān akāmas tu sarvān eva saṃsravān pātrādhobhāganihitadarbheṣu pitṛbhyo ’kṣayyam astv ity anena mantreṇa dakṣiṇakarapitṛtīrthasthitena pātreṇa ninīyāninīyaiva vā vaiśvadevikadvijapaṅkter uttarataḥ śundhantāṃ lokā ity anena jalasaṃcaraṇadūṣitaṃ pradeśaṃ prokṣya tatra dakṣiṇāgrān kuśān āstīrya pitṛbhyaḥ sthānam asīti pitṛṣadanam asīti vā sapavitraṃ pitṛpātraṃ nyubjaṃ kuryāt | tac ca pitāmahapātreṇa tad api prapitāmahapātreṇa pidhāya tadupari kuśān nidadhīta | atha vā śundhantāṃ lokā ity anena pātrasparśaṃ kṛtvā nyubjīkaraṇādikuśanidhānāntaṃ kuryāt | svadhāvācanaparyantaṃ saṃsravadhāraṇakārī tu tatrottānam eva pātraṃ sthāpayitvā pūrvavat pidhānādi kuryāt | anantaraṃ ca tatra śrāddhadevatābhūtān pitrādīn gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpair arcayet | evaṃ mātāmahādiśrāddhe ’pi kuryāt |
ity arghyanirūpaṇam |
atha gandhādidānam |
tatra tāvad vidhim āhatur manu-bṛhaspatī |
upaveśya tu tān viprān āsaneṣu jugupsitān |
gandhamālyaiḥ surabhibhir arcayed devapūrvakam ||
[1310] asyārthaḥ | upaveśanānantaraṃ tān upaviṣṭān viprān gandhamālyair arcayet | 'gandhān' kuṅkumakarpūrādīn dadyāt | 'mālyāni' kusumasrajaḥ | surabhigrahaṇaṃ mālyaviśeṣaṇam | ato nirgandhāni puṣpāṇi na dadyāt | gandheṣv apīdaṃ viśeṣaṇam asurabhigandhanivṛttyarthaṃ yuktam | atha vā surabhigrahaṇaṃ svatantram eva dhūpasaṃgrahārthaṃ vyākhyeyam | pūrvakam iti devebhyo brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pūrvaṃ datvā tataḥ pitṛbhyo dātavyam | idaṃ ca devapūrvakatvasya punargrahaṇaṃ prāgbhojanapravṛttau tu pānavyañjanādidāne na niyama ity evamartham āhuḥ | anyathā ko ’rthaḥ punarabhidhāne bhavet | 'ajugupsitān' anindyān viprān | anuvādo 'yaṃ tādṛśānām eva vidhānāt | atha vā saty api bhūtapratyayanirdeśe prakṛtyarthakartavyatāniṣedha evāyam | upaviṣṭān na jugupseta na ninded ity uktaṃ bhavati, pratyayārthat tyāgo varaṃ na sarvapadārthatyāga iti manyate | anuvāde hi kṛtsnam eva padam anarthakaṃ syād iti |
baudhāyanas tu gandhādidānasyārghyanantaryam āha |
athaitas tilamiśrā apaḥ pratigrāhya gandhamālyena cālaṃkṛtveti |
‘atha’ upaveśanānantaraṃ, 'etān' pitryabrāhmaṇān, 'apaḥ' arghyārthāḥ |
dhūpasyāpi dānam āhatuḥ śaṅkhalikhitau |
gandhamālyadhūpair alaṃkṛtyeti |
nāgarakhaṇḍe |
tatas tu candanādīni dīpanāni samādadet |
' tataḥ' arghyadānānantaram |
kauśikasūtre tv añjanādarśayor api pradānam uktam | gandhamālyadhūpāñjanādarśa-pradīpasyāharaṇam | [1311] āharaṇasya dṛṣṭārthatvād brāhmaṇeṣu tatsaṃpādanakartavyatāvagantavyā |
āśvalāyanagṛhye tv ācchādanadānam apy uktam |
etasmin kāle gandhamālyadhūpadīpācchādanānāṃ pradānam |
'etasmin' arghyadānānantaram |
bodhāyanasūtre ’pi |
athaitān vastragandhadhūpadīpamālyair yathopapādaṃ saṃpūjya
pṛcchaty uddhriyatām iti |
'yathopapādaṃ' yathopapattiguṇajātiprakarṣam, 'pṛcchati' upaviṣṭān brāhmaṇān agnaukaraṇārthaṃ sarvaprakāram annam udhriyatām iti praśnaṃ kuryāt | tathā "svadhāṃ datvā vastrabhojanagandhapuṣpadhūpādibhir arcayitvā pitṝn anujñāpya" iti 'svadhā' arghyodakam | atra yady api gandhādidānāt pūrvaṃ vastrapradānam āmnātaṃ tathāpi pāṭhakramaṃ bādhitvā dhūpadīpadānānantaram eva tat kāryam |
tathā coktaṃ kālikāpurāṇe |
tato ’bhyarcya surān pūrvaṃ sāṃnidhyaṃ kalpya vai pitṝn |
gandhādyair gandhamālyaiś ca vidhivad yatnato ’rcayet |
dhūpadīpāvasāne tu ācchādanaṃ niyojayet ||
'sāṃnidhyaṃ kalpya' āvāhanena pitṝṇāṃ saṃnidhānaṃ parikalpya, atha vā viśvedevārcanānantaraṃ pitṛbrāhmaṇānāṃ saṃnidhānaṃ parikalpya kṛtvā tatra pitṝn arcayet | 'gandhādyaiḥ' saurabhayuktaḥ | 'gandhaiḥ' candanādibhiḥ | mālyaiś cārcayet | 'ācchādanaṃ niyojayet' putrādibhiḥ saṃyojayet taduddeśena dadyād ity arthaḥ |
[1312] pādma-mātsyayor api |
yā divyety arghyam utsṛjya dadyād gandhādikaṃ tataḥ |
vastrottaraṃ cānupūrvaṃ datvā saṃsravam āditaḥ ||
'yā divyā' ity anena mantreṇārghyaṃ datvā 'gandhādikaṃ' gandhapūṣpadhūpadīpaṃ, 'vastrottaraṃ' vastram uttaraṃ, yasya dīyate tat pitṛbhyo datvā pātrasthaṃ jalaśeṣaṃ pitṛpātre nidhāya tat pātram uttarapradeśe nyubjaṃ kuryād ity anena saṃbandhaḥ | 'anupūrvaṃ' ānupūrvyeṇa, prathamaṃ gandhaṃ datvā tataḥ puṣpāṇi tato dhūpadīpam ācchādanaṃ dadyād iti |
vaijavāpena tu ācchādanadānāntaraṃ yajñopavītadānam uktam |
tasyopari kuśān datvā pradadyād devapūrvakam |
gandhapuṣpāṇi dhūpaṃ ca doṣaṃ vastropavītake ||
'tasya' nyubjīkṛta pitṛpātrasya, upari kuśagandhapuṣpāṇi datvā vaiśvadevikabrāhmaṇapūrvakaṃ pitrādibrāhmaṇakareṣu gandhādi dadyāt | anena pitryagandhādidānasya daivagandhādidānena saha kramopadeśena daive pitre cārcanaṃ padārthānusamayena kāryam iti jñāyate | tena yājñavalkyoktena kāṇḍānusamayena saha asya padārthānusamayasya vikalpo veditavyaḥ | na cāyaṃ gandhādidānāt prabhṛty eva tatpūrvaṃ tu kāṇḍānusamaya eveti vācyam, prayogavairūpyāpatteḥ | devāṃś ca pitṝṃś cāvāhayiṣya ity anujñāpyetyādinā gandhādidānāt prāg evānuṣṭhānasya paiṭhīnasinā smṛtatvāc ca | asya ca gandhādidānasya nyubjīkṛtapātropari kuśanidhānānantaryam api vaikalpikaṃ veditavyam | nirantaradarśitamatsapurāṇavacane tatpūrvam evāvaśyakartavyatāyā avagamāt | 'vastrayajñopavītake' iti | vastraṃ yajñopavītaṃ [1313] ca dadyāt | na caitat “vastrābhāve yajñopavītakaṃ” iti
vṛddhaśātātapavihitaṃ vastrapratinidhirūpaṃ yajñopavītam iti mantavyaṃ, samuccayābhidhāyakasamāsavirodhāt yajñopavītaprakaraṇapradarśitasvatantrayajñopavīta-dānopadeśabādhāpatteś ca |
viṣṇunā tv alaṃkāradānam apy uktam |
nivedya cānulepanavastrapuṣpālaṃkāradhūpaiḥ śaktyā viprān samabhyarcya |
nivedyety anulepanādīni pitrādyuddeśena brāhmaṇeṣu saṃpādya tais tān abhyarcyālaṃkṛtya vakṣyamāṇaṃ kuryād ity arthaḥ |
iti gandhādidānavidhiḥ |
atha gandhādidānetikartavyatā |
tatra tāvad viśvedevagandhādidāne pradarśitā mantrāḥ pitryagandhādidāne ’pi veditavyāḥ | “dīpaṃ cedaṃ jyotir daive pitrye ca karmaṇi" ityāder bhaviṣyottaravacanasya tatsādhāraṇyapratipādakasya viśvedevagandhādidānaprakaraṇe pradarśitatvāt | evam eva śrāddhakartrā gandhair gātrānulepane kriyamāṇe ’pi pavitrakaratvam aṅgaṃ punar dvijaiḥ kriyamāṇa iti tatprakaraṇapradarśitavacanavaśād ihāpy avagantavyam | evam eva gandhādipūjāsiddhyarthaṃ śrāddhakartrā brāhmaṇena cottarīyopavītayoḥ brāhmaṇaskandhād anuttāraṇaṃ vartulapuṇḍrākaraṇaṃ brāhmaṇena śikhāyām eva mālyadhāraṇaṃ gandhādidānasyodakapūrvakatvam ityevamādayo niyamāḥ samānā veditayāḥ | viśeṣas tūcyate | gandhadānādau gandhadvārām ityādimantroccāraṇānte pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahānāṃ nāmagotroccāraṇaṃ kartavyam |
tathā coktaṃ ādityapurāṇe |
[1314] ato ’rthaṃ pradahed dhūpaṃ pitṝn uddiśya dharmavit |
saṃkīrtya nāmagotrādi pratyekaṃ ca prakalpayet ||
yasmād dhūpadānena pitṝṇām akṣayā prītir jāyate ata etadarthaṃ nāmagotrādyuccāraṇapūrvakaṃ pitṝn uddiśya brāhmaṇānāṃ purato ghṛtamadhuyukaṃ guggulvādikaṃ dhūpaprakaraṇokaṃ dhūpaṃ pradahet taṃ ca pitrādibhyaḥ kalpayet taduddeśena dadyād ity arthaḥ | atra yady api dhūpadāna eva nāmagotrādyuccāraṇaṃ pratīyate tathāpi gandhādidānādāv apy anusaṃdheyam |
ata āha paiṭhīnasiḥ |
nāmagotre samuccārya dadyāc chraddhāsamanvitaḥ |
pitṝn uddiśya viprebhyo gandhādīn devapūrvakam ||
ādiśabdena puṣpadhūpācchādanāni saṃgṛhyante | ata evāha hārītaḥ |
gandhān pitṛgotranāma gṛhītvāpa upaspṛśyaivam evetarayor dhūpadīpamālyācchādanam || iti |
pitrarthaṃ brāhmaṇahaste ’po ninīya gandhān candanakuṅkumakarpūrādīn ādāya vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa pitur nāmagotre samuccārya brāhmaṇahasta eva gandhaṃ datvāpa upaspṛśyaivam eva puṣpadhūpadīpācchādānaṃ dadyāt | 'itarayoḥ' pitāmahaprapitāmahayoḥ, 'evam eva' pitur iva, gandhācchādanāntaṃ tattadbrāhmaṇahaste datvodakaṃ saṃspṛśed ity arthaḥ | tad evaṃ gandhādidānaṃ kṛtvā kṛtāñjaliḥ śrāddhakartā ādityā rudrā vasava ity etām ṛcaṃ japet |
tathā ca liṅgadarśanaṃ brahmapurāṇe |
tān arcya bhūyo gandhādyair dhūpaṃ datvā ca bhaktitaḥ |
ādityā rudrā vasava ity ṛcam ajapat prabhuḥ ||
[1315] 'tān' pitrādaīn, gandhapuṣpair abhyarcyācchādanāntaṃ kṛtvā,
ādityā rudrā vasavaḥ suniṣpādya vā kṣāmā pṛthivīm antarikṣam |
sajoṣaso yajñaṃ muñcantu devā ūrdhvaṃ kṛṇvantv adhvarasya ketuḥ || ity etām ṛcaṃ varāhaḥ paṭhitavān | ato ’nyenāpi śrāddhaṃ kurvatā gandhādidānānte ṛk paṭhitavyeti gamyate | viṣṇudharmottare tu dvijān avalokayan amum eva mantraṃ japed ity uktam |
saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyair brāhmaṇān prayataḥ sadā |
ādityā rudrā vasavo dvijān vīkṣaṃs tato japet ||
atra yady api vīkṣan japed iti japāvekṣaṇayos tulyakālatā pratīyate tathāpi mantroccāraṇānta eva dvijāvekṣaṇaṃ kartavyam, tatra tasya karaṇamantratvāt |
tathā ca viṣṇuḥ |
viprān samabhyarcyādityā rudrā vasava iti vīkṣa |
atretikaraṇād imām agṛbhṇāt raśanāmṛtasyetivat karaṇamantratvaṃ pratīyate |
kaṭhasūtre tu mantrāntaram uktam |
yās tiṣṭhanty abhṛtā vāg yan me māteti tribhiḥ pādyārghyācamanīyodakāni cānayed etābhir evādityā rudrā vasava ity etān samīkṣāgnau karavāṇīti pṛcchati |
atra etābhir iti sarvanāmnā mantropādānasya kṛtatvād ādityā rudrā vasava itītikaraṇasvarūpamātrārthaparo vyākhyeyaḥ |
atraivaṃ gandhādidānādau prayogaḥ | yathoktaprācīnāvītitvādi[1316]pitryadharmayuktaḥ kartā prathamopaviṣṭapaitrabrāhmaṇakareṇa sugandhicandanādikalkam ādāya gandhadvārā ityādikaṃ mantram uccārya oṃ amukagotrā asmatpitaraḥ amukaśarmāṇaḥ sapatnīkāḥ vasurūpāḥ ayaṃ vo gandhaḥ svadhā namo nama ity abhidhāya siktodake brāhmaṇahaste ’rpayet | brāhmaṇena ca sugandha ity ukte jalam upaspṛśyaivam eva pitṛsthānopaviṣṭadvitīyādidivjeṣu gandhadānaṃ pravartayet | tataḥ pitṛpadasyāne pitāmahapadaṃ vasupadasthāne rudrapadaṃ prayujya paitāmahadvijeṣu tayor eva sthānayoḥ krameṇa prapitāmahapadaṃ ādityapadaṃ prayujya prapaitāmaheṣu dvijeṣu pūrveṇaiva vākye na gandhadānaṃ kuryāt | tadanantaraṃ mantroccāraṇāntaṃ kṛtvā amukagotrāḥ asmanmātāmahāḥ amukaśarmāṇaḥ sapatnīkā vasurūpā ity uccāryāyaṃ vo gandha ityādinā vākyena māśāmaheṣu dvijeṣu gandhaṃ datvā mātāmahapadasthāne pramātāmahapadaṃ mātuḥ pitāmahā iti vā prayujya vasupadasyāne rudrapadaṃ ca prayujya pramātāmahadvijeṣu mātāmahapadasthāne vṛddhapramātāmahapadaṃ mātuḥ prapitāmahā iti vā prayujya rudrapadasthāne cādityapadaṃ prayujya prapaitāmaheṣu dvijeṣu mātāmahavākyenaiva gandhaṃ dadyāt | tatas tatkarasthitair gandhaiḥ śrāddhakartā krameṇa tān brāhmaṇān bhālādyaṅgeṣu vilimpet | ta eva vā svayaṃ limpeyuḥ | anantaraṃ gandhavat praśastāni puṣpāṇi patrāṇi cādāya puṣpavatīm ṛcam uccārya gandhapadasthāne puṣpapadaṃ prayujya pūrvavat pūrveṇaiva vākayena brāhmaṇakareṣu puṣpaṃ patraṃ ca dadyāt | evam eva dhūr asīty uccārya gandhapadasthāne dhūpapadaṃ prayujya pūrvavat pūrveṇa vākyena dhūpaṃ dadyāt | evam eva dhūpapadasthāne ayaṃ dīpa ayaṃ vo jyotiḥ ayaṃ dīpaprakāśa [1317] ity eteṣām anyatamaprayogena dīpaṃ dadyāt | evam eva tattaddeyadravyavācakapadāni datvā vastrālaṃkārādikaṃ dadyāt | tadanantaraṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ kartā pitṝṇām arcanaṃ saṃpūrṇam astv iti pitryadvijān prativadet | taiś cāstv arcanaṃ saṃpūrṇam iti prativacane kṛte saṃkalpasiddhir astv ityādikaṃ ācamanāntaṃ vaiśvadevikavat kuryāt | tadanantaram ādityā rudrā vasava ityādikaṃ mantram uccārya brāhmaṇāvekṣaṇaṃ kuryāt | tad evaṃ gandhādidānaṃ nirvartya śrāddhabhūmiśodhanādikaṃ kuryāt | tathā ca kālikāpurāṇe |
nirvartya brāhmaṇādeśāt kriyām evaṃ yathāvidhi |
punar bhūmiṃ tu saṃśodhya paṅkter antaram ācaret |
bhājanāni tato dadyād dhastaśaucaṃ punaḥ kramāt ||
'evaṃ' anena prakāreṇa, 'brāhmaṇādeśāt' brāhmaṇānujñayā, gandhādidānāntāṃ kriyāṃ niṣpādyārcanaprasaṅgapatitakuśakusumādidravyayuktām arcakapadapātopahatāṃ bhūmiṃ patitakuśādyapanayanena karaparimārjanena 'saṃśodhya' śucīkṛtya, 'paṅkter antaraṃ' bhojanapātrasthāpanaparyāptaprapradeśaṃ, parito bhasmādirekhādiracitamaṇḍalair anyonyavyavadhānaṃ kuryāt | 'bhājanāni' bhojanapātrāṇi, 'dadyāt' yathokamaṇḍalamadhye sthāpayet | tato brāhmaṇahastakṣālanāya jalaṃ datvā pātrakṣālanaṃ kuryāt |
maryādākaraṇahastaprakṣālanayoḥ paurvāparyaviparyaye doṣo matsyapurāṇe ’bhihitaḥ |
[1318] akṛtvā bhāmaryādāṃ yaḥ kuryāt pāṇiśodhanam |
āsuraṃ tad bhavec chrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ nopatiṣṭhate ||
maryādāśabdenātra yathāvyākhyātaṃ paṅkter antaram evocyate | bhasmagrahaṇaṃ nīvāracūrṇādyupalakṣaṇārtham |
ata eva brahmapurāṇe |
maṇḍalāni ca kāryāṇi naivāraiś cūrṇakaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
gauramṛttikayā vāpi praṇītenātha bhasmanā |
pāṣāṇacūrṇasaṃkīrṇam āhṛtaṃ ca vivarjayet ||
bhṛguṇā tu brāhmaṇādivarṇavibhāge maṇḍalānāṃ saṃsthāpanaviśeṣas tatsādhanaṃ coktam |
bhasmanā vāriṇā vāpi kārayen maṇḍalaṃ tataḥ |
catuṣkoṇaṃ dvijāgryasya trikoṇaṃ kṣatriyasya tu |
maṇḍalākṛti vaiśyasya śūdrasyābhyukṣaṇaṃ smṛtam ||
'maṇḍalākṛti' vartulākāram |
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe tu hastapātrakṣālanodakasya pratipattir uktā |
prakṣālya hastapātrādi paścād adbhir vidhānavit |
prakṣālanajalaṃ darbhais tilair miśraṃ kṣipet śucau ||
etac ca pādaprakṣālanamaṇḍale prakṣipyata iti śiṣṭācāraḥ |
iti gandhādidānetikartavyatā |
samāptaṃ ca pitryarcanakāṇḍam |
mahādevamahīpālamānyo hemādrir ādarāt |
karoti nipuṇaṃ puṇyam agnaukaraṇanirṇayam ||
athāgnaukaraṇanirṇayaḥ |
tatrāgnaukaraṇahomaḥ kiṃ prācīnāvītinā kāryaṃ yajñopavītinā veti saṃdehe cintyate | tatra tāvat pitṛrūpadevatāyogamantragatasvadhāśabdaprayogābhyāṃ prācīnāvītinā kārya iti manyante | tathā hi | agnaye kavyavāhanāya svāhā somāya pitṛmate svāheti śaṅkhalikhitādipradarśitamantra-varṇaprakāśyasya kavyavāhanatvaviśiṣṭasyāgneḥ pitṛmattvaviśiṣṭasya ca somasya devatātvam avagamyate | tatra kavyaṃ nāma yat pitṛbhyo dīyate ’nnādi tad ucyate | tasya ca devair asaṃbandhād agninā pitṛbhya eva tad voḍhavyam | pitryeṣṭau ca śrūyate |
agniṃ kavyavāhanaṃ yajati ya eva pitṝṇām agnis tam eva tad yajati || iti |
śatapathaśrutiś cāha |
havyavāhano vai devānāṃ kavyavāhanaḥ pitṝṇāṃ tasmād āhāgnaye kavyavāhanāyānubrūhi || iti |
ato ’tra pitṛrūpo 'gnir devatā |
nanu yena śabdena vidhīyate devatā tenaiva sā nirūpyā nānyena, anyena nirūpyamāṇāny eva bhavet | ata evendramahendrayoḥ karmasamavāyidevatāsvarūpaṃ bhinnam eveti samarthayante | ataḥ kavyavāhanaśabdena vihitā devatā kathaṃ pitṛrūpety ucyate |
maivaṃ | pitṛpitāmahādiśabdair vihitānāṃ yathā pitṛśabdena nirūpaṇam aviruddhaṃ tathā tatrāpi bhaviṣyati | tatrāpi viruddham iti cet | tan na | evaṃ hi sati pitāmahādidaivatye karmaṇi pitryakarmavihitadharmānvayo na sidhyet | atha vākyāntareṇa teṣāṃ pitṛtvābhidhānāt pitṛbhyo dadyād iti devatātvāvagamāc ca pitṛśabdena nirūpaṇaṃ na viruddhyata ity ucyate | tarhi kavyavāhanasyāgner api pramāṇāntareṇaiva pitṛrūpatvāvagatau pitṛśabdena nirūpaṇaṃ na mandībhavati | pitṛmattvaṃ nāma [1320] somasya somādipitṛgaṇādhāratvaṃ tadupayojyatvaṃ vā | tad etad ubhayavidhaṃ pitṛsaṃnidhānaṃ liṅgāt somasya pitṛrūpatvaṃ gamayati | tathā ca śrutiḥ | “pitṛdevatyo vai somaḥ" iti | pitṛmattvaṃ ca na somasyopalakṣarṇaṃ kiṃ tu viśeṣaṇam | tac ca dṛṣṭārthatvam ālocya viśeṣaṇībhūtānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ sahabhāvena devatārthatvam iti gamyate | yat tu " tvaṣṭā somaṃ piba” ity atra tvaṣṭur devatātvaṃ nirākṛtaṃ taddevatāvidhivākaye kavalapātrīvat śruter ity adoṣaḥ | hārītasmṛtiś cānayoḥ pitṛrūpatvaṃ gamayati |
mekṣaṇapāṇir anujñāto yat somāya pitṛmate juhoti somajyeṣṭhāṃs tena somapāṃś ca pitṝn prīṇāti | yad yamāyāṅgirasvate yamajyeṣṭhān barhiṣadas tenāgnijyeṣṭhān agniṣvāttāṃś ca yad agniṃ kavyavāhanaṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ tena yan mekṣaṇam ādadhāty ātmānaṃ tena prīṇāti || iti |
kiṃ ca kavyavāhanāgnipitṛmatsomayoś cāturmāsyāntargatāyāṃ pitryeṣṭau devatātvadarśanāt pitṛrūpatvam avasīyate | iṣṭau cānayoḥ prācīnāvītavatījyā dṛṣṭā, ataḥ piṇḍapitṛyajñahome ’gnaukaraṇe ca tadvad eva bhavitum arhati | tad evam asya karmaṇaḥ pitṛdaivatatve sthite “prācīnāvītaṃ pitṝṇāṃ” iti ca smṛteḥ prācīnāvītinā homaḥ kāryaḥ | homamantre svadhāśabdaprayogaś ca dṛśyate |
somāya pitṛmate svadhā namo ’gnaye kavyavāhanāya svadhā namaḥ |
iti | svadhākāraś cāsādhāraṇyena pitṛtṛptihetuḥ | tathā ca śatapathaśrutiḥ |
vācaṃ dhenum upāsīta tasyāś catvārastanāḥ svāhākāro vaṣaṭkāro hantakāraḥ svadhākāras tasyai dvau stanau devā upajīvanti svāhākāraṃ ca vaṣaṭkāraṃ ca hantakāraṃ ca manuṣyāḥ svadhākāraṃ pitaraḥ ||
iti | ato prācīnāvītinā kāryaḥ |
[1321] manusmṛtiś ca sākṣāt prācīnāvītaṃ vidadhāti |
apasavyam agnau kṛtvā sarvam āvṛtparikramam |
apasavyena hastena nirvaped udakaṃ śuci || iti |
chandogapariśiṣṭe kātyāyano ’pi “agnau dve āhutī juhoti devebhyaḥ” iti piṇḍapitṛyajñaprakaraṇāmnātadevaśrutisāmarthyāt pitṛyajñātmakasya homasya daivikatvam abhipretya tadvikṛtibhūtasyāgnaukaraṇahomasyāpi daivikatvaṃ manyamānaḥ,
agnaukaraṇahomas tu kartavya upavītinā |
prāṅmukhenaiva devebhyo juhoti ||
iti śruteḥ yajñopavītinā kartavyatvaṃ pūrvam abhidhāya nyāyāntareṇa siddhāntatayā prācīnāvītikartavyatvam uktavān |
apasavyena vā kāryo dakṣiṇābhimukhena ca |
nirupya havir anyasmā anyasmai na hi hūyate || iti |
asyārthaḥ | piṇḍapitṛyajñe pitṛbhyo vo juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmīti mantre sakṛd eva homadevatārthaṃ piṇḍadevatārthaṃ ca nirvāpaḥ kriyate | tataś ca nirvāpamantrasāmarthyāt pitṛrūpayor eva somāgnyor devatātvam iti gamyate | devarūpayor devatātvābhyupagame anyasmai niruptam anyasmai hūyata ity ayuktam āpadyeta | ataḥ pitṛyajñahomaḥ pitryatvāt prācīnāvītādipitryadharmayuktena kriyata iti tadvikṛtibhūtaḥ agnaukaraṇahomo ’pi taddharmayuktenaiva kārya iti ayam eva pakṣaḥ śreyān iti manyamāna āśvalāyanaḥ piṇḍapitṛyajñasūtre svamatatvena piṇḍapitṛyajñahomaṃ paitṛkadharmayuktam uktvā paramatatvena daivikadharmayuktam uktavān prācīnāvītītvam upādhāya mekṣaṇenādāyāvadānasaṃpadā juhuyāt somāya pitṛmate svadhā namo ’gnaye kavyavāhanāya svadhā nama iti svāhākāreṇāgniṃ pūrvaṃ yajñopavītīti | ato ’yam agnaukaraṇahomaḥ prācīnāvītayuktena kāryaḥ |
[1322] atrocyate | kavyavāhanatvādiliṅgānumīyamānapitṛtvayuktadevatānurodhena homasya pitratvam āpādya prācīnāvītam ucyamānaṃ pratyakṣaśrutinirdiṣṭadevatvayukta-devatānvayaniṣpāditadaivakarmatvopanītayajñopavītapratītyā bādhyate | tathā ca śrutiḥ |
sa udvāsyāgnau dve āhutī juhoti devebhyo devān vā eṣa upāvarttate |
ya āhitāgnir bhavati yo darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajate athaitat pitṛayajñenaivācārīt tad u devebhyo nihnute sa devaiḥ prasūto ’py etat pitṛbhyo dadātīti |
daivaṃ ca karma yajñopavītinā kāryaṃ tathā ca piṇḍapitṛyajñe śrūyate tato devā yajñopavītino bhūtvā dakṣiṇaṃ jānv ācyopāsīdantīti |
anyathānupapattyā hi śruter asyāḥ sadaiva tu |
kartavyaṃ daivike savyam ānarthakyam ato 'nyathā ||
ato ’sya homasya daivikatvād ayaṃ yajñopavītinā kāryaḥ |
nanv asya daivikatve 'pitṛbhyo juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmīti' nirvāpamantravirodhaḥ |
maivaṃ | yathā darśapūrṇamāsayāge ’nekadevatāsaṃbandhitvena nirupteṣu vrīhiṣu prokṣitavyeṣu agnaye vo juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmīty atra vaḥ ity eṣa śabdaḥ keṣucid eva vrīhiṣu paryavasyati na sarveṣu | tathā 'pitṛbhyo vo juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmīty' ayam api keṣucit piṇḍārtheṣv eva paryavasyati na tan miśrān api homārthān vyāpnoti | tūṣṇīm eva sarvanirvāpa ity etasmiṃs tu pakṣe mantravirodhaśaṅkaiva nāsti | asti cāyam api pakṣaḥ | tathā ca āpastambaḥ mṛnmaye nirvapati pitṛbhyo vo juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmīti tūṣṇīṃ veti | tūṣṇīṃ pṛthaṅ nirvāpa ity asmiṃs tu pakṣe sutarāṃ na virodhaśaṅkā asti, cāyaṃ pakṣaḥ, tathā ca carakādhvaryusūtrakṛdvat saḥ,
pavitrāntarhite caruṃ trir nirvapati yajñopavītī dakṣiṇena hastena [1323] triḥ prācīnāvītī savyena hastena yajñopavītī mekṣaṇena juhuyāt somāya pitṛmate svadhā yamāyāṅgirasvate pitṛmate svadhā namo ’gnaye kavyavāhanāya svadhā nama iti |
tasmān na nirvāpamantravirodhaḥ | agnaukaraṇaprakṛtibhūte piṇḍapitṛyajñahome copavītopadeśo dṛśyate |
tatra tāvad vaijavāpaḥ |
ājyam āsicyodvāsya yajñopavīty anvāhāryapacane mekṣaṇena dve āhutī juhoty agnaye iti pūrvāṃ somāyety uttarām || iti |
'anvāhāryapacanaḥ' dakṣiṇāgniḥ |
āpastambo ’py āha |
adhvaryur upavītī dakṣiṇaṃ jānv ācya mekṣaṇa upastīrya tenāvadāyābhighārya somāya pitṛmate svadhā nama iti dakṣiṇāgnau juhoti yamāyāṅgirasvate pitṛmate svadhā nama iti dvitīyām agnaye kavyavāhanāya svadhā nama iti tṛtīyāṃ mekṣaṇena taṇḍulān hutvā tūṣṇīṃ mekṣaṇam ādadhāti na yamāya juhototy eka iti |
āha sāṃkhyāyanaḥ |
dakṣiṇaṃ jānv ācya yajñopavītī prāg āsīno mekṣaṇena juhoty agnaye kavyavāhanāya svāhā somāya pitṛmate svāheti |
nanu sutrakāraiḥ piṇḍapitṛyajñam adhikṛtyaivopavītaṃ home vihitaṃ tasya ca prakṛtahomagṛhītatvāc chrautatvāc ca nāprakṛtasmārtāgnaukaraṇahome tad bhavitum arhati | kiṃ tu smṛtivihitaṃ prācīnāvītam eva tatrānvayaṃ labhate |
maivaṃ | yathā śrauto ’pi piṇḍapitṛyajño vacanāt smārtāgnau kriyate, yathā ca [1324] prakṛtāgneyādigṛhītāprayājādayo ’prakṛtasauryādiyāgānvayaṃ labhante | tathā śrautaprakṛtapiṇḍapitṛyajñasaṃbandhyupavītam apy atideśāt smārtāprakṛtāgnaukaraṇahomānvayaṃ lapsyate | vācanikaś cātideśaḥ |
tathā ca āśvalāyanagṛhyam |
uddhṛtya ghṛtāktam annam anujñāpayati agnau kariṣye karavai karavāṇīti vā pratyabhyanujñā kriyatāṃ kuruṣva kurviti athāgnau juhoti yathoktaṃ purastāt || iti |
'purastāt' pūrvaṃ piṇḍapitṛyajñaprakaraṇa ity arthaḥ |
kātyāyanagṛhye 'pi |
uddhṛtya ghṛtāktam annaṃ pṛcchati agnau kariṣya iti kuruṣvety anujñātaḥ piṇḍapitṛyajñavad hutveti |
atha yady api piṇḍasādhyaḥ pitṛyajña iti mukhyayā vṛttyā piṇḍadānasyaivedaṃ nāmadheyaṃ tathāpi daṇḍival lakṣaṇayā homasyāpi kalpanā ity ūhanīyaṃ, cāturmāsye prathame parvaṇi vaiśvadevanāmavat | tad evaṃ piṇḍapitṛyajñavad ity anena hometikartavyatātideśe siddhe yajñopavītadharmakatāgnaukaraṇasyopapannā |
yājñavalkyo ’py āha |
kuruṣvety abhyanujñāto hutvāgnau pitṛyajñavat || iti |
pracetā api |
kuruṣvety abhyanujñāto hutvāgnau pitṛyajñavat || iti
pāraskaro ’py āha |
paitṛkair abhyanujñāto juhoti pitṛyajñavat |
[1325] ato 'tideśād upavītināgnaukaraṇahomaḥ kāryaḥ | upadeśaś ca bhavati |
tathā ca gṛhye vaijavāpaḥ |
yajñopavīty agnau karavāṇīty āmantryāgnaukaraṇaṃ kuryāt || iti |
āha gobhilaḥ |
mekṣaṇenopaghātaṃ juhuyāt svāhā somāya pitṛmata iti pūrvāṃ svāhāgnaye kavyavāhanāyeti dvitīyāṃ ata ūrdhvaṃ prācīnāvītīti |
chandogagṛhye |
agnau kariṣyāmīty āmantraṇaṃ hoṣyataḥ kurvity uktaḥ kāṃsyamaye caroḥ samavadāya mekṣaṇenopaghātaṃ juhuyāt svāhā somāya pitṛmata iti pūrvāṃ svāhāgnaye kavyavāhanāyety uttarām ata ūrdhvaṃ prācīnāvītīti |
atra homottarakāle prācīnāvītivacanād dhomakāle yajñopavīty etad uktaṃ bhavati |
nanv evaṃ tarhy apasavyam agnau kṛtvā sarvam āvṛtparikramam ityādikāyā manusmṛteḥ kā gatiḥ |
ucyate | yadi tāvat prācīnāvītapratipādanapareyaṃ smṛtiḥ tadā virodhe tv anapekṣyaṃ syād iti nyāyāt pratyakṣayā śrutyā bādha eva | vastutas tu prācīnāvītaprātipādakatvam asyāḥ smṛter nāsty eva | tathā ca medhātithināsya ślokasya svamatena paramatena cānyathaiva vyākhyānaṃ kṛtam | agnaye kavyavāhanāya svadhā nama ity āhutiprakṣepalakṣaṇaṃ yat kāryaṃ tad apasavyaṃ dakṣiṇena hastena kartavyam | na punar ubhayor hastayor muktam ityādiniṣedhabhayād ubhābhyāṃ savyopasṛṣṭena dakṣiṇena vā savyena kevaleneti paramatena vyākhyāya svamatena vyākhyānaṃ kṛtaṃ yā agnāv āhutayo hūyante tāsāṃ yaḥ āvṛtparikramaḥ āvartamānānāṃ yaḥ kramaḥ taṃ sarvam apasavyaṃ kuryāt | dakṣiṇasaṃsthā āhutīḥ [1326] kuryān nodaksaṃsthā ity arthaḥ | apasavyena hastena nirvaped udakaṃ śucīti avanejanākhyo 'yam udakanirvāpiḥ | tatra cāthodapātram ādāyāvane japatīti vājasaneyaśākhāyāṃ piṇḍapitṛyajñāmnātasyodapātrasyātideśikīṃ prāptiṃ nivartayitum idaṃ dakṣiṇahastavidhānaṃ, ato na prācīnāvītavidhāyikeyaṃ smṛtiḥ | atha vāstu śaṅkhyadhara-smṛticandrikākārānusārād vidhāyikāpi tathāpi kātyāyana-āśvalāyanādisūtrānusārikatipayakartṛviṣayiṇy eva bhaviṣyati | kātyāyanena hi śrāddhakalpe ’gnaukaraṇahome piṇḍapitṛyajñavat hutvety uktam | piṇḍapitṛyajñahome ca mekṣaṇena juhoty agnaya iti somāyeti ca tenaivoktam | etatsūtravyākhyānāvasare ca upādhyāyakarkeṇoktaṃ homaś ca yajñopavītinā prāṅmukhena ca kartavyaḥ daivatvāt | sa udvāsyāgnau dve āhutī juhoti devabhya iti śruteḥ | na vā yajñopavītinā kartavyaḥ kiṃ tu prācīnāvītinaiva pitryakarmāṅgatvāt pradhānanyāyopacārāc cāṅgānāṃ mahāpitṛyajñe ca daivājyagrahaṇe yajñopavītividhānāt | sa yajñopavītī bhūtvājyāni gṛhṇātīti | ayaṃ ca pitryakarmāṅgatvena prasajyamānaṃ prācīnāvītaṃ nivartayituṃ vidhir bhavann ājyagrahaṇād anyatra prācīnāvītam abhyanujānātīti gamyate | daivatvena prāptasyāsya prācīnāvītasyānuvādo ’stv iti cet | na, anuvādaprayojanāsaṃbhavād vākyasya prācīnāvītāpavādaparatvāt | atra yady api pakṣadvayaṃ dṛśyate tathāpi prācīnāvītapakṣasya paścād upamāsākṣāt kātyāyanānuyāyibhiś cānuṣṭhīyamānatvāt siddhāntatā kalpyate taiś cāṅgaukaraṇānujñābhyarthanād ārabhya prācīnāvītam ādriyamāṇaṃ dṛśyate | ato yat nāgarakhaṇḍe praśnād ārabhya prācīnāvītam uktaṃ, tat kātyāyanamatānusāribhir evāśrayaṇīyam |
[1327] tataḥ pākaṃ samādāya pṛcched viprān nṛpottama |
aham agnau kariṣyāmi homaṃ pitṛsamudbhavam ||
anujñā dīyatāṃ mahyam apasavyāśritasya bhoḥ |
'tataḥ' pitryabrāhmaṇārcanānantaram | apasavyāśritasyānujñā dīyatām iti vacanād abhyarthanād ārabhya prācīnāvītaṃ gamyate | āśvalāyanasūtraṃ tu pūrvam eva darśitam | tatra yady api prācīnāvītaṃ pūrvam uktaṃ paścāc ca yajñopavītaṃ tathāpi tacchākhīyair ādṛtatvāt prācīnāvītasyaiva siddhāntatā vyavasīyate | kaiścit punar anujñābhyarthanaṃ yajñopavītibhir evānuṣṭhāya taduttarabhāvini kriyākalāpe prācīnāvītaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ dṛśyate | matsyapurāṇe tv anujñābhyarthanottarakālīneṣv api paryukṣaṇaparyanteṣu padārtheṣu yajñopavītam uktvā parataḥ prācīnāvītam uktam |
yajñopavītī nirvartya tataḥ paryukṣaṇādikam |
prācīnāvītinā kāryam ataḥ sarvaṃ vijānatā ||
etad api yacchākhāgṛhyādau vihitaṃ sarvathā vā yeṣāṃ yajñopavītaṃ prācīnāvītaṃ vā nāmnātaṃ tair eva grahītavyam | yat tu kavyavāhanatvādiliṅgenāgnyādeḥ pitṛrūpatvam uktam |
tan na | na hi kavyavāhanena pitṛmatā vā pitṛrūpeṇa bhāvyam ity atra kiṃcit pramāṇam asti, ato na tadyogāt pitryatvaṃ homasya |
atha yadi
agnau hutena devasthāḥ pitṛsthās tarpitair dvijaiḥ |
bhūmau dattena tiryaksathās tṛpyantu pitaraḥ sadā ||
iti śātātapādivacanair homasya pitryatvam ucyate |
tan na | asya vākyasyārthavādarūpatvena vidhiśaktyabhāvān nātra homādeḥ pitryatvaṃ vidhīyate | kiṃ tu pramāṇāntarāvagataṃ yathāsthitaṃ śrāddhaṃ stuyate, svadhāśabdaprayogo pitryatve liṅgam | vacanād daive ’pi svadhāśabdaḥ aindyāgārhapatyopasthānavat | pitrye 'pi nāndīmukhadaivatye [1328] 'py agnaukaraṇahome svadhāśabdaprayogopapatteḥ, vikalpo vā prācīnāvītopavītayoḥ daivapitryobhayarūpatvān miśrarūpaṃ hīdaṃ karma | tac ca devena pitryeṇa vā dharmeṇa yuktaṃ kāryaṃ kathaṃ punar miśraṃ svadhā nama iti mantre ubhayadarśanāt | svadhā hi pitryaṃ liṅgaṃ namo devasya tathā ca śrutiḥ |
svadhākāraḥ pitṝṇāṃ namaskāro devānām ubhaye hījyanta iti |
atrāhuḥ upavītavidhivacanānāṃ bhūyastvāt bhūyasāṃ syāt sadharmatvam iti nyāyenopavītinaiva kāryo homa iti | anye tu yathāśākhaṃ vyavasthām eva prācīnāvītopavītayor manyante |
tathā ca kātyāyanaḥ |
svāhā svadhā namaḥ savyam apasavyaṃ tathaiva ca |
āhutīnāṃ ca yā saṃkhyā sā vā gamyā svasūtrataḥ || iti ||
iti prācīnāvītādinirṇayaḥ |
athāgnaukaraṇahomādhikaraṇanirṇayaḥ |
agnirūpam anagnirūpaṃ ceti dvividham adhikaraṇam | tatra tāvad agnirūpasya nirṇaye kecid āhuḥ, piṇḍapitṛyajñaprakaraṇe "dakṣiṇāgnau juhoti” iti vacanād agnaukaraṇe ca “juiyāt pitṛyajñavat” iti smaraṇād atideśaprāpte dakṣiṇāgnau homa iti | anye tv āhuḥ, śrāddhasya gṛhyokatvāt tadantarbhūtasyāgnaukaraṇahomasya gṛhyatve prakṛtagṛhyāgnyanvayāvagamād aupāsane 'gnāv iti | kiṃ ca, smārtaṃ hīdaṃ karma ato gṛhyāgnāv eva kartavyam |
yata āha yājñavalkyaḥ |
karma smārtaṃ vivāhāgnau kurvīta pratyahaṃ gṛhī |
dāyakālāhṛte vāpi śrautaṃ vaitānikāgniṣu || iti ||
[1329] 'smārtaṃ karma' vaiśvadevopāsanāgnaukaraṇādirūpaṃ, 'vivāhānau' vivāhasamayasamutpādite | 'dāyakālāhṛte' rikthavibhāgakāle, vaiśyakulād āhṛtya saṃskṛte caupāsane ’gnau kurvīta śrautaṃ karmāgnihotrādirūpaṃ vaitānikāgniṣv āhavanīyadakṣiṇāgnyādiṣu kurvītety anuṣajyate |
manur apy āha |
aupāsanāgnau kurvīta gṛhyaṃ karma yathāvidhi |
pañcayajñānnapaktiṃ ca yac cānyad gṛhyakṛtyakam || iti |
atropadeśād atideśabādho nyāyya ity aupāsanāgnyadhikaraṇatvavādino manyante | dakṣiṇāgnyadhikaraṇatvavādinas tu bādhalāghavanyāyasthirātideśikasyāpy anugrahābhimatau prāptabādhasya cātyantaduṣṭatvāvagatāv upadeśātideśayoḥ parasparābādhenaiva saṃniveśāpapattāv ananyagatinyāyābhyupagamasyātideśikapadārthabādhasyānyāyyatvam anusaṃdadhānāḥ karma smārtam ityādisāmānyavacanasyopāsanādikarmasu sāvakāśatvād agnaukaraṇavyatiriktaviṣayatvaṃ manyante | nanūpadeśādatideśo durbalaḥ | kim ataḥ | na hi durbalaḥ ity eva bādhaḥ, kiṃ tu atulyaviṣayo durbalaḥ | kiṃ ca vācaniko 'yam atideśaḥ upadeśān na bhidyate, ataḥ sarvādhānopāsanāgnyabhāve ’py arddhādhānena tatsadbhāve ’pi vāhitāgnināmāvāsyāśrāddhe dakṣiṇāgnau agnaukaraṇahomaḥ kāryaḥ | tithyantaraśrāddhe tu viharaṇābhāvena dakṣiṇāgner asaṃbhave sarvādhāninā dvijapāṇāv ardhādhāninā āhitāgninā caupāsane 'gnāv agnaukaraṇahomaḥ kāryaḥ |
nanu vācanikātideśopanītena dakṣiṇāgninā sāmānyavacanaprāpyamāṇo gṛhyāgnir agnaukaraṇahomān nivartitaḥ kutaḥ pratyāvṛttyā tadadhikaraṇatāṃ labheta |
maivaṃ | vidyamāneo hi dakṣiṇāgnis tan nivarttayen na [1330] punar vandhyāsutopamo ’pi ataḥ sāmānyavacanaṃ dakṣiṇāgnimatkarttṛkāgnaukaraṇahomaprayogān nivartate nānagnikakartṛkāt tatprayogāt | ato dakṣiṇāgnyabhāve sa upāsanāgnau kartavyaḥ |
tad etad āha viṣṇudharmottare mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |
āhitāgnis tu juhuyād dakṣiṇāgnau samāhitaḥ |
anāhitāgnis tv aupasade ’gnyabhāve dvije ’psu vā ||
‘aupasadaḥ' gṛhyāgniḥ | atrāpsu vety asya pakṣasya viṣayaviśeṣaḥ kātyāyanena darśitaḥ |
agnaukaraṇahomaṃ tu kuryād apsv iti yan matam |
sa yadāpāṃ samīpe syāc chrāddhe jñeyo vidhis tadā || iti |
yat tu,
aupāsanenānnasiddhir agnaukaraṇam eva ca |
iti prajāpativacanaṃ tat kevalaupāsanāgnimadviṣayam | tad evaṃ tāvad dakṣiṇāgnau homas tadasaṃbhave tūpāsanāgnāv iti śambhu-śaṅkhadharaprabhṛtayaḥ | anye upāsanāgnisadbhāve tatraiva homas tadabhāve dakṣiṇāgnāv ity āhuḥ | te hi “juhuyāt pitṛyajñavat” ity asyātideśavacanasyāpi sāmānyavacanatvād upadeśasāmānyavacanānurodhena dakṣiṇāgnivyatirikaprākṛtapadārthātideśaviṣayatāṃ manyante |
tathā ca vāyupurāṇam |
āhṛtya dakṣiṇāgniṃ tu homārthaṃ vai prayatnataḥ |
agnyarthaṃ laukikaṃ vāpi juhuyāt karmasiddhaye || iti |
asya aparārkena artho vyākhyātaḥ | atra vākye ’gniśabdaḥ prakṛte ’gnau vartate, śrāddhaprayogavidhau ca gṛhyāgniḥ prakṛtaḥ śrāddhaprayogasya gṛhyaśāstravidheyatvāt | gṛhyāgnyadhikāreṇa ca gṛhyaśāstrāṇāṃ pravṛttir iti tadabhāva [1331] eva tatkārye dakṣiṇāgnilaukikāgnyor vidhir yujyate, tatsadbhāve tu tenaivāsya kāryasiddhau kim anyāgnividhānena | yo ’pi dharmaśāstreṣu śrāddhaprayogavidhiḥ sa gṛhyoktād abhinnaḥ pratyabhijñānāt | tena dharmaśāstreṣv api gṛhya evāgniḥ prakṛtaḥ | ato 'gnyartham ity atrāgniśabdo gṛhyapara eva prakṛtatvād iti yuktam iti | evam asya vākyasyārthaṃ vyākhyāya “āhitāgnis tu juhuyād dakṣiṇāgnau” ityāder mārkaṇḍeyavākyasyāpy arthaḥ svamatānusāry eva varṇitaḥ | tathā hi yadaitad āhitāgner dakṣiṇāgnau homavidhānaṃ tat sarvādhānenopāsanāgnyabhāve arddhādhānapakṣe tu saty aupāsanāgnau tatraiva homo na dakṣiṇāgnāv iti | yat punar anāhitāgniś caupasada iti vacanaṃ tad dakṣiṇāgnaukaraṇavidhānād anāhitāgner dakṣiṇāgnyabhāvena homaniṣpādanaśaktivirahe ’nadhikāra eva pārvaṇaśrāddhe bhaved ity āśaṅkayādhikārapratipādanārtham | tataś cānāhitāgniś caupasade kuryān na tv anāhitāgnir evaupasada iti tasyārtha iti | idaṃ tv ayuktaṃ nāhitāgnis tu juhuyād dakṣināgnāv ity asmin vacane sarvādhānyopāsanāgnirahito vety āhitāgner viśeṣaṇaṃ śrūyate | nāpi kalpayituṃ śakyaṃ, kalpakānupalambhāt | “karma smārtaṃ vivāhāgnau" ity asya vidher bādho mā bhūd ity evaṃvidhānuyāyikī matiḥ kalpiketi cet | na | na hi viśeṣavidhiviṣaye ’pavādaśāstraviṣaye vā utsargaśāstrāṇy anuvartante, tathābhyupagame hi brāhmaṇebhyo dadhi dīyatāṃ takraṃ kauṇḍinyāyety atrāpi viśeṣavidhyapavādayor dadhyabhāvaviṣayatāprasaṅgaḥ | athāhṛtya dakṣiṇāgnim ity etasmin vacane agnyartham ity abhidhānāt gṛhyāgnikārye dakṣiṇāgnividhyavagatau gṛhyāgner mukhyatve dakṣiṇāgnividhais tadabhāvaviṣayatety abhimatam | tan na | avikṛtau tāvat kārye ’pi vidhau [1332] vaikṛtena prākṛtasya bādho dṛṣṭaḥ prakṛtāv api phalacamasena somasya | ataḥ kārye ’pi vidhau dakṣiṇāgninā gṛhyāgner bādha eva nyāyyaḥ | vastutas tu agnyartham ity atrāgniśabdenaikavākyopātto dakṣiṇāgnir evābhidhātuṃ nyāyyo na gṛhyāgniḥ, balavān hi prakaraṇasaṃnidher vākyasaṃnidhiḥ | ato dakṣiṇāgnikārye laukiko ’tra vidhīyata iti yukam | laukikaś cātra smārto gṛhyāgnir eva vivakṣito na punar asaṃskṛto ’nyaḥ | tasya hi na paitṛkayajñiyo homo laukikāgnau vidhīyata iti niṣedhāt | yat tu,
śālāgnau tu paced annaṃ laukike vāpi nityaśaḥ |
yasminn eva paced annaṃ tasmin homo vidhīyate ||
ity aṅgirovacane śālāgniśabdena gṛhyam agnim abhidhāya tadanyam asaṃskṛtaṃ laukikaśabdenoktvā tatra homavidhānam uktaṃ tad vaiśvadevaviṣayam |
tad āhuḥ |
śālāgnāv iti yatraitad vākyam aṅgirasoditam |
vaiśvadevavidhānaṃ tan nāsya homasya yujyate || iti |
ato laukikaśabdena gṛhyāgnir evocyate | tasya ca tadupalakṣitakāryoddeśena vidheḥ prayojanābhāvaḥ | na hy anupalakṣite vidhīyamānaḥ padārtho ’nyatra bhavati | na ca tadupalakṣite vidhiḥ saṃbhavati, prakṛtau kārye prakḷpteḥ padārthavidhyuttarakālabhāvitvāt | ato 'gnyartham ity atrāgniśabdena dakṣiṇādbhir evābhidhātuṃ nyāyyaḥ | yā cātrāhitāgniś caupasada ity asyānadhikāraśaṅkānivṛttyarthatoktā sāpy aupāsanābhāve dakṣiṇāgnividhau śaṅkānutpatter na ghaṭate | ataś cāhitāgniś ced dakṣiṇānāv anāhitāgniś ced aupāsane tadubhayāgnyasaṃnidhāne sarvathā tadabhāve pāṇyādāv agnaukaraṇahoma [1333] kārya iti sthitam | atra aparārkamatam evānusṛtya smṛticandrikākāreṇoktam | anāhitāgner aupāsanavata āhitāgner apy arddhadhānenaupāsanavataḥ aupāsana evāgnaukaraṇahomaḥ, pravāsādinā tadasaṃnidhāne tu dvijapāṇau jalādau vā | sarvādhānenaupāsanādhānenaupasanāgnirahitatvād āhitāgner dakṣiṇāgnau | tadasaṃnidhāne laukikānau pāṇyādau vā yaḥ svīkṛtopāsanatayā samucchinnāgnitayā bhāryāvidhuratayā vāgnirahitaḥ tasya dvijapāṇau jalādau vā, na jātu laukike ’gnau | tathā ca smṛtiḥ |
sāgnir agnāv anagnis tu dvijapāṇau tathāpsu vā |
kuryād agnau kriyāṃ nityaṃ laukikeneti niścitaṃ || iti |
atra laukikaniṣedho ’nagnikasānikaṃ cārddhadhāninam evāśrayate, na sarvādhāninam | taṃ prati, agnyarthaṃ laukike vāpi juhuyāt karmasiddhaye |
ity atra laukikāgnividher darśitatvāt
haste ’gnaukaraṇaṃ kuryād agnau vā sāgniko dvijaḥ |
iti parāśarasmaraṇāc ca | atrāgniśabdena gṛhyāgnir ucyate, tasmin vidyamāne hastapakṣānavakāśāt | tenātrāgniśabdena dakṣiṇāgniḥ laukiko vābhidhīyate | sāgnikaṃśabdena ca sarvādhāny evocyate iti | tatra tāvad aupāsanābhāva eva dakṣiṇāgnau homa ity etāvat pūrvam eva nirākṛtaṃ, sarvādhāninaś ca laukikāgnau homa ity etad apy agnyarthaṃ laukikaṃ vety atra vacane laukikaśabdasya smārtāgnivācakatvoktyā sarvādhānaśabdaśravaṇābhāvoktyā nirastam eva | yat tūktaṃ saty aupāsane hastapakṣānavakāśāt parāśaravacame ’gniśabdena dakṣiṇāgnir laukikaś cocyate na punar aupāsano 'pīti, [1334] tad dakṣiṇāgnisadbhāve ’pi samānam | atha dakṣiṇāgnisaṃnidhau pāṇipakṣāvakāśaḥ sa tarhy upāsanāgnisadbhāve ’pi bhaviṣyati | anyad api smṛticandrikākāreṇābhyadhāyi | sarvādhānenaupāsanāsaṃbhave tv āpastamboktāgnaukaraṇahomasya lopa eva | tatra hi smārtatvāc chrautaṃ vaitānikāgniṣv ity upadeśato dakṣiṇāgniprāptir na vidyate | piṇḍapitṛyajñadharmakatvābhāvāt “juhuyāt pitṛyajñavat" ityatideśato ’pi nāsti | agneś cāpratinidheyatvāt pratinidhinyāyena dakṣināner laukikasya vāgneḥ prāptir na saṃbhavati, ato ’dhikaraṇābhāvāl lopa eva homasya | ata eva sarvādhānenaupāsanasyābhāve dhūrttasvāminoktaṃ śrāddham ūrdhvaṃ homāt kartavyaṃ brāhmaṇā āhanīyārtha iti tasyāpi pradhānatvād iti | sarvādhāninā homād uparitanaṃ brāhmaṇabhojanapiṇḍadānātmakaṃ yāvac chrāddhaṃ tad evānuṣṭheyaṃ “ brāhmaṇaṇā āhavanīyārthe” ityādivacanaparyālocanayā brāhmaṇabhojanasyāpi pradhānatvāvagamād iti | tad etat pitṛyajñadharmakatvābhāve ’pi vacanātideśena dakṣiṇāgniprāptisaṃbhavād agnirūpādhikaraṇāsaṃbhave ’pi sarvasādhāraṇasmṛtipurāṇavihitapāṇirūpādhikaraṇasaṃbhāvād vicāraṇīyam eveti |
atra gṛhyapariśiṣṭam |
anvaṣṭakyaṃ ca pūrvedyur masi māsy atha pārvaṇam |
kāmyam abhyudaye ’ṣṭamyām ekoddiṣṭam athāṣṭamam ||
caturṣv ādyeṣu sāgnīnāṃ vahnau homo vidhīyate |
pitryabrāhmaṇahaste syād uttareṣu caturṣv api || iti |
atra kilāṣṭau śrāddhāni bhavanti | aṣṭakānāṃ hy uparitanā navamyo ’nvaṣṭakāḥ tannimittaṃ śrāddham anvaṣṭakyaṃ, aṣṭakāpūrvadinarūpāsu saptamīṣu [1335] kriyamāṇaṃ śrāddhaṃ pūrvedyuḥ | māsi māsīti yasyāṃ kasyāṃcit tithau pratikṛṣṇapakṣaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ śrāddhaṃ amāvāsyānimittakaṃ śrāddhaṃ pārvaṇam | putrādikāmanayā kriyamāṇaṃ kāmyam | abhyudaye putrajanmavivāhādau, kriyamāṇaṃ aṣṭakāsaṃjñakāyām aṣṭamyāṃ kriyamāṇam | mukhyaikoddiṣṭe ’gnaukaraṇābhāvād ekoddiṣṭapārvaṇobhayātmakatvāt sapiṇḍīkaraṇasyaikoddiṣṭaśabdena lakṣaṇyā sapiṇḍīkaraṇam uktam | tatrādyeṣu caturṣu śrāddheṣu sāgner agnāv eva homaḥ | tatra yadāpi kasyacid āhitāgner aṣṭakādiṣu śrautakarmārthavihitadakṣiṇāgnisaṃnidhir na vidyate sarvādhānenaupāsanāgnisaṃnidhiś ca nāsti tathāpy agnau homavidhānāt tadartham eva viharaṇaṃ kṛtvā homaḥ kāryaḥ | yeṣām idaṃ pariśiṣṭaṃ teṣām evāyaṃ vidhir veditavyo na sarveṣām |
ity agnirūpahomādhikaraṇanirṇayaḥ |
atha homādhikaraṇabhūtāgnilakṣaṇam |
brahmavaivarta brahmāṇḍapurāṇayoḥ |
bahuśuṣkendhane vahnau susamiddhe viśeṣataḥ |
vidhūme śuddhavarṇe ca hotavyaṃ karmasiddhaye ||
arciṣmān piṇḍitaḥ śītaḥ sarpiḥ kāñcanasaṃnibhaḥ |
snigdhaḥ pradakṣiṇaś caiva vahniḥ syāt kīrtivṛddhaye ||
evaṃlakṣaṇake homaṃ yas tu vahnau samācaret |
naranārīgaṇebhyaḥ sa pūjāṃ prāpnoti śāśvatīm |
akṣayaṃ pūjitās tena bhavanti pitaras tathā ||
athābuddhaḥ sadhūme ca juhuyād yo hutāśana |
[1336] yajamāno bhaved andhaḥ saputra iti ca śrutiḥ ||
alpendhano ’tha rūkṣo vā visphuliṅgāvṛto ’tha vā |
apradakṣiṇam āvṛttaḥ sa ca vahnir asiddhaye ||
durgandhaś caiva nīlaś ca kṛṣṇaś caiva viśeṣataḥ |
bhūmiṃ ca gāhate yaś ca sa tu kuryāt parābhavam ||
brahmapurāṇe |
kṣuttṛṭkodhatvarāyukto hīnamantraṃ juhoti yaḥ |
apravṛddhe sadhūme ’gnau so ’ndhaḥ syād anyajanmani ||
svalpe rūkṣe sasphuliṅge vāmāvarte bhayānake |
sārdhakāṣṭaiś ca saṃpūrṇe phūtkāravati pāvake ||
kṛṣṇārciṣi sadurgandhe tathā lihati medinīm |
āhutiṃ juhuyād yas tu tasya nāśo bhaved dhruvam ||
devīpurāṇe |
taptahāṭakavarṇābhaḥ sūryasindūrakāntibhṛt |
śaṅkhakundendusaṅkāśo ghṛtakṣīranibhaḥ śubhaḥ ||
japābho ’śokapuṣpābholākṣādaradasaṃnibhaḥ |
śubhadaḥ sarvakāryāṇāṃ viparīto hy asiddhidaḥ ||
meghadundubhiśaṅkhaughaveṇuvīṇāsvanaḥ śubhaḥ |
vṛṣabhaśikhikokānāṃ pūjitaḥ kokilasvanaḥ ||
kuṅkumāgurukarpūrasitagandhis tu pūjitaḥ |
haṃsacchatrebhagokumbhapadmākṛtidharaḥ śubhaḥ ||
siṃhabarhiṇaśailānāṃ cāmarākṛtiviṣyadaḥ |
[1337] sadhūmāmṛtagandhiś ca śukaṣaṭcaraṇopamaḥ |
chinnajvālo ’tha vā rodī neṣṭaḥ karmasu pāvakaḥ ||
samunnataśikhaḥ śasta ūrddhaṃ vāte ’pi yāti yaḥ |
lelihānaḥ śubhaḥ kuṇḍaṃ dīptimān varado ’nalaḥ ||
bahvṛcapariśiṣṭe |
yo ’narciṣi juhoty agnau vyaṅgāriṇi ca mānavaḥ |
mandāgnir āmayāvī ca daridraś caiva jāyate ||
tasmāt samiddhe hotavyaṃ nāsamiddhe kadācana |
ārogyam icchatāyuś ca śriyam ātyantikīṃ tathā ||
susamiddhe hotavyam ity uktam |
tataḥ samindhanaprakāram āha |
juhūṣaṃś ca hute caiva pāṇisūrpasruvādibhiḥ |
na kuryād agnidhamanaṃ kuryāt tu vyajanādinā ||
mukhenaiva dhamed agniṃ mukhād dhy eṣo ’bhyajāyata |
nāgniṃ mukheneti tu yal laukike yojayanti tat || iti |
ity agnilakṣaṇam |
athānagnirūpahomādhikaraṇanirṇayaḥ |
tatra tāvat sāgnikasyāpi pravāsādinā kadācid agnisaṃnidhānābhāve 'nagnirūpe ’pi dvijapāṇau homa iti prāg evoktam,
haste ’gnaukaraṇaṃ kuryād agnau vā sāgniko dvijaḥ |
ity anena | adhunānagnikasya pāṇyādau homa ucyate |
atra manu-śātātapau |
agnyabhāve tu viprasya pāṇāv evopapādayet |
[1338] yo hy agniḥ sa dvijo viprair mantradarśibhir ucyate ||
yo hy agnir ityādinā hetuvannigadena homādhikaraṇabhūtāgnikāryasāmarthyāviṣkāreṇa prastuyate | 'mantradarśibhiḥ' vedavidbhir ity arthaḥ | taittirīyaśrutāv api dṛśyate ca stutiḥ |
eṣa evānir vaiśvānaro yad brāhmaṇo ’gnāv evainaṃ vaiśvānare
juhoti || iti |
agnyabhedavacanasya sādṛśyaparatvād alaukikāgnirūpatvābhidhānasyāpy āropaikanibandhanatvād brāhmaṇasyānukalpatvaṃ na virudhyate |
ata eva yamavacane ’gnisādṛśyenaiva stutiḥ kriyate |
yathāgnayas tathā viprā yathā viprās tathāgnayaḥ |
agnyabhāve tu viprasya pāṇau homo vidhīyate || iti |
agnyabhāvo ’tra bhāryāparigrahābhāvakṛtatatparigrahottarakālikāgnisvīkārābhāvakṛtaḥ svīkṛtasamucchedakṛtaḥ saṃnidhānābhāvakṛtaś ceti kecid āhuḥ |
eke tu samucchinnāgneḥ pārvaṇaśrāddhānadhikāre ’gnaukaraṇābhāvān na samucchedanibandhane ’gnyabhāve pāṇividhir ity āhuḥ |
anye tu |
agnyabhāve tu viprasya pāṇau dadyāt tu dakṣiṇe |
agnyabhāvaḥ smṛtas tāvad yāvad bhāryaṃ na vindati ||
iti gārgya-jātūkarṇayor vacane upasaṃhāradarśanād bhāryāparigrahottarakālikāsvīkārakṛte ’py agnyabhāve na pāṇividhir iti manyante |
anye tu bhāryāparigrahāt pūrvaṃ niyato ’gnyabhāvaḥ | ataḥ sphuṭapratītinā tena bhāryāparigrahottarakālīno ’py agnyabhāvo vacanena lakṣyate, na punar abhāvaśrutir upasaṃhriyata iti |
apare tu agnyabhāve tu viprasya pāṇāv evopapādayed ity atraivaśabdena [1339] yal laukikāgnyabhāvādyadhikaraṇāntaranirākaraṇaṃ kriyate tadbhāryāparigrahābhāvakṛte ’gnyabhāve nānyasminn iti gārgyavacane pratipādyate, na punar vivāhottarakālīneṣv agnyabhāveṣu pāṇer api homādhikaraṇatvaṃ nivartata iti | atrācāryair vicārya nyāyyapakṣaparigrahaḥ kriyatām |
iha jayantasvāmimataṃ harihareṇopanyastam | "agnyabhāve tu viprasya" iti ślokasya kadācit kvacid asaṃnihitāgniḥ sāgnir eva viṣayaḥ | yasya hi yatsambandho ’sti tasya kadācit kvacid asaṃnidhāv evaṃvidhāḥ prayogāḥ bhavanti | saṃbhavaty evāśvasaṃbandhe yathāśvābhāve ’śvataram āruhya tvayā gantavyam iti prayuñjate, na punar atyantāsaṃbhavaty aśvasaṃbandha iti | tad etaj jayantasvāmisaṃmataṃ, traivarṇikamātraviṣayatvam asya tenaiva dūṣitam |
matsyapurāṇe hy āmānnaśrāddhe kaṇṭharaveṇāgnau karaṇam uktam |
āmaśrāddhaṃ yadā kuryād vidhijñaḥ śrāddhadas tadā |
tenāgnaukaraṇaṃ kuryāt piṇḍāṃs tenaiva nirvapet || iti |
tenaivety āmadravyeṇa |
āmaśrāddhaṃ cāgnisaṃskārarahitasya śūdrasya sākṣād uktaṃ, anyasya tu pakvānnābhāve ’nityatvena nyāyaprāptaṃ,
evaṃ śūdro ’pi sāmānyaṃ vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ tathaiva ca |
namaskāreṇa mantreṇa kuryād āmānnavad budhaḥ || iti |
ato ’nagnaḥ (?) śūdrasyāmānnaśrāddhe agnaukaraṇānuvādenāmadravyakatvākhyaviśeṣāvidhānād anagner vācanikam agnaukaraṇaṃ tadākṣitaṃ cānagnirūpaṃ pāṇyadhikaraṇam iti | atra yady api viprasyeti sāmānyenoktaṃ tathāpi prakṛtatvāt saṃnihitaparityāge kāraṇābhāvāc ca śrāddhabhokur eva viprasyeti manyate | pradhānasya pratyaṅgam āvṛtter niṣedhāt viprasyeti vivakṣitakavacanāc [1340] caikasyaiva śraiṣṭhaprāthamyābhyāṃ prathamopaviṣṭasyaiveti | yair daivikakarmadharmeṇa yajñopavītena svāhākāreṇa cāyaṃ homaḥ kriyate tair daivikaviprakare kartavyaḥ | yaiś ca paitṛkakarmadharmeṇa prācīnāvītena svadhāśabdena ca kriyate tais tu paitṛkaviprakare kāryaḥ | sarvair vā devakare paitṛkakare vā vikalpena kāryaḥ | yady api karaśabdaḥ sādhāraṇas tathāpi dakṣiṇakareṇa kartavyam iti dakṣiṇasya sarvakarmāhartāsmaraṇāt "pāṇau dadyāt tu dakṣiṇa iti" vacanāc ca dakṣiṇa eva kare homaḥ | tatra tāvat prathamopaviṣṭasya paitṛkasya pāṇau homa ity āha kātyāyanaḥ |
paitryo yaḥ paṅktim ūrddhvaṇyas tasya pāṇāv anagnikaḥ |
hutvā mantravad anyeṣāṃ tūṣṇīṃ pātreṣu nikṣipet ||
anagnikaḥ śrāddhakartā pitṛpitāmahādyuddeśena tyajyamānahaviradhikaraṇabhūtavipra-paṅktimūrddhaṇy upaviṣṭasya dakṣiṇe kare agnaye kavyavāhanāyetyādimantrayuktaṃ hutvā hutaśiṣṭaṃ annaṃ tūṣṇīm eva paṅktimūrddhaṇyād anyeṣāṃ tatpaṅktyupaviṣṭānām eva pātreṣu vibhajya nidadhyān na tu devapaṅktyupaviṣṭānāṃ pātreṣu | śeṣapratipattau cedam abhidhāsyate |
nanu samudvāsyāgnau dve āhutī juhoti devebhya iti pitṛyajñasaṃjñake home kavyavāhanasyāgneḥ somasya pitṛmato devasyānaukaraṇahomasyāpi daivikatvena samānadharmakatvena saṃnidhānād daivikaviprakare home prāpte kathaṃ paitṛkaviprakara evoktaḥ | athocyeta | yo ’gnāv agnaukaraṇahomaḥ sa daivikaḥ, yas tu viprakare sa paitṛkaḥ
pāṇiṣv eva vā juhoty agnimukhā vai devāḥ pāṇimukhāḥ pitara
iti ha brāhmaṇaṃ |
ity āśvalāyanagṛhye śruter udbhāvanād iti |
maivaṃ | “juhoti debebhyaḥ” iti vidhiśruter devadevatyatve ’sya homasyāvadhārite “pāṇimukhāḥ [1341] pitaraḥ" iti pāṇividhistutyarthavādamātreṇa na pitṛdevatyatvaṃ pratyetuṃ śakyapitṛdevatyaviprabhojanapiṇḍapradānarūpakarmasāhityāt paitṛkatvāropeṇārthavādopapatteḥ | atha vā agnaukaraṇahomasyāpi pitṛtṛptir eva bhāvyeti paramparayā pāṇer api tṛptikāraṇatvena pitṛmukhatvam āropya stutyupapatteḥ ato ’yam agnaukaraṇahomaḥ kvacid daivikaḥ kvacit paitṛka ity etad ayuktam |
tad āhuḥ |
devam agnau kare pitryam ity etad asamañjasam |
daivaṃ cet sarvadā daivaṃ pitryaṃ cet pitryam eva tu || iti |
ato daivaviprakare homaḥ kāryaḥ |
tathā cāha kāśyapaḥ |
anamiko yadā vipraḥ śrāddhaṃ kuryāt tu pārvaṇam |
agnaukaraṇavat tatra homo daivakare bhavet || iti |
atra prativaiśvadevikadvijaṃ homāvṛttau nyāyāsaṃbhavād ekaśeṣe gauravāc ca viprasya kara ity ekavacanāntasyaiva samāsaḥ, tathā ca vivakṣitaikavacanavaśād ekasyaiva devasya |
tad uktaṃ vāyupurāṇe |
vaiśvadeve yadaikasmin bhaveyur bahavo dvijāḥ |
tadaikapāṇau hotavyaṃ syād vidhir vihitas tathā || iti |
yadā tāvad "ekaikam ubhayatra vā" ity etat pakṣāśrayaṇenaika eva vaiśvadevike dvijas tadaikasyaiva pāṇāv iti siddham eva | yadāpi dvau deva ityādiyugmasaṃkhyānekadvija-pakṣāśrayaṇe dvau catvāraḥ ṣaḍ aṣṭau vā daivike dvijās tadāpy ekasyaiva pāṇau homaḥ kāryaḥ | tāvataiva hi homavidhiḥ kṛtārthaḥ [1342] syāt vihitahomaś ca samagro ’pi kṛtārthaḥ syāt | atra vihitakṛtatvaṃ vidhikṛtatvaṃ vidhikṛtārthatvaṃ pratihetutvenopanyastam iti nyāyānarthakyaṃ tasmād ekasyaiva kare homaḥ pūrvokanyāyāc ca prathamopaviṣṭasyaiva dakṣiṇa eva kare homaḥ | tad evaṃ pūrvoktayā kartṛvyavasthayā sarvair vā samavikalpena devaviprakare pitryaviprakare vā homaḥ kāryaḥ | yas tu
agnaukaraṇavat kuryād dvijātau vaiśvadevike |
pāṇāv eva (?) tu tad dadyāt na tu pitrye kadācana ||
iti pitryapāṇiniṣedha iva pratīyate sa daivapāṇistutyartho na pitryapāṇinivṛttyarthaḥ | atha vā daivikapaṅktimūrddhanyakare kṛtvā punaḥ pitryapaṅktimūrddhanyakare’pi homo na kartavya ityevamarthaḥ | atra pitrādidevatye pitāmahādidevatye vāmāvāsyāśrāddhe yadāgnau homaḥ kriyate yadā vā vaiśvadevikatantrānuṣṭhānavati prayoge vaiśvadevikadvijapāṇau tadā deśakālakartradhikaraṇādikārakaikyād vaiśvadevavad agnaukaraṇasyāpi tantreṇaivānuṣṭhānam | atas tadvidhavaiśvadevikapāṇau hoṣyan daivikapaṅktimūrddhany upaviṣṭasyaikasyaiva pāṇau juhuyāt | yadā tu bhedena vaiśvadevikānuṣṭhānaṃ tadā vaiśvadevikadvijapāṇāv api homaṃ kariṣyann adhikaraṇabhedād bhedenaiva homaṃ kuryāt | tathā ca veśvadevikapaṅktidvayopaviṣṭamukhyadvijadvayapāṇyoḥ homadvayaṃ kartavyam |
nanu tathāpi tatprayogasaṃnihitadeśakāle ’gnau tantravaiśvadevikārthadvijapāṇau vā kriyamāṇo homaḥ śrāddhadvayopakārako bhavati | tathā vaiśvadevikabhedo ' py astu | anyathādhikaraṇākhyaguṇānurodhena pradhānāvṛttiḥ kṛtā syāt |
maivaṃ | na hy adhikaraṇāntaraṃ kṛtārtham astv ity evam atra homo ’bhyasyate, kiṃ tu mātāmahaśrāddhākhyaṃ pradhānāntaraṃ kathaṃ nu nāma saguṇaṃ syād ity evaṃ pāṇihomasya cānanyaśrāddhārthabrāhmaṇapāṇāv [1343] anuṣṭhitasyaivopakārakatvaṃ niścitam | ataḥ pṛthaganuṣṭhīyamānavaiśvadevikadvijapāṇau hoṣyan dvitīyavaiśvadevikadvijapāṇāv agnaukaraṇam āvartayed eva | anenaiva pitryaviprapāṇāv api homo vyākhyāta iti aparārkasmṛticandrikākāra-madhumiśrādayaḥ | tatra tv eṣa viśeṣaḥ | yadāpi vaiśvadevikaṃ tantraṃ tadāpy adhikaraṇabhedāvṛttir eva homasya |
tad āha kātyāyanaḥ |
mātāmahasya bhede ’pi kuryāt tantre ca sāgnikaḥ || iti |
asyārthaḥ | yadā mukhyapārvaṇādau pitryaviprakare homaṃ cikīrṣet tadā pitṛpitāmahādipaṅktyupaviṣṭamukhyadvijakare hutvā mātāmahasya saṃbandhī yo brāhmaṇas tasyāpi kare pṛthak homaṃ kuryāt | etac ca pṛthaṅ mātāmahasaṃbandhidvijakare homānuṣṭhānaṃ bhedena vaiśvadevikānuṣṭhāne tantreṇa cānuṣṭhāne jñeyam | asti kadācit sāgnikasyāpi dvijapāṇau homaḥ | sāgnika ity etad upalakṣaṇaṃ evaṃvidhādhikaraṇake ’nagnikakartṛke ’pi pāṇihome ’syāvṛttinyāyasya samatvāt | paryavasitaḥ pāṇirūpahomādhikaraṇanirṇayaḥ |
athānyāny apy anagnirūpāṇi homādhikaraṇāni |
matsyapurāṇe |
agnyabhāve tu viprasya pāṇau vātha jale ’pi vā |
ajakarṇe ’śvakarṇe vā goṣṭhe vātha śivāntike ||
ajakarṇe ’śvakarṇa ity atra liṅgāvivakṣāhetvabhāvād vivakṣitam eva puṃstvam | atra yady api brāhmaṇapāṇer mukhyakalpatve ’gnaukaraṇavati śrāddhe ca tasyāvaśyasaṃbhave ’jakarṇādīnām anavakāśa eva | tathāpi "eṣa vā agnir vaiśvānaro [1344] yad brāhmaṇaḥ” iti pratyakṣaśrutyā brāhmaṇasyāgnitvābhidhānāt parokṣaśrutimūlakasmṛtimātradṛṣṭānām ajakarṇādīnāṃ jaghanyatvenātyantabādhāya samavikalpa evābhyupeyaḥ | brāhmaṇasthāne darbhavaṭuniveśe vājādīnām avakāśaḥ kāryaḥ |
āha śaṅkhaḥ |
ajasya dakṣiṇe karṇe pāṇau viprasya dakṣiṇe |
apsu caiva kuśastambe agniṃ kātyāyano ’bravīt |
rajate ca suvarṇe ca nityaṃ vasati pāvakaḥ || iti |
atrāgnisadbhāvapratipādanenāgnikārye viniyogo darśitaḥ | arthavādamātratve 'syānarthakyāpatteḥ |
saurapurāṇe |
agnyabhāve tu viprasya pāṇāv evopapādayet |
mahādevāntike vātha goṣṭhe vā susamāhitaḥ ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
agner abhāvād viprasya pāṇau homo vidhīyate |
mahādevasya purato goṣṭhe vā śraddhayānvitaḥ || iti |
ity anagnirūpahomādhikaraṇanirṇayaḥ |
athāgnaukaraṇahomāṅgabhūtāni praśnottaradravyāṇi |
tatrāha yājñavalkyaḥ |
agnau kariṣyann ādāya pṛcchaty annaṃ ghṛtaplutam |
kuruśvety abhyanujñāto tv āgnau pitṛyajñavat ||
śrāddhakartāgnau homaṃ kartum icchan bahutarājyasaṃmiśram annaṃ praśaste [1345] darvyādirūpe pātre samādāyāgnau kariṣya iti śrāddhabhoktṝn brāhmaṇān anujñāpanarūpeṇa pṛcchet | taiś ca brāhmaṇaiḥ kuruṣvety evaṃvidhena vākyenābhyanujñātaḥ san svakalpasūtroktapiṇḍapitṛyajñahomavaj juhuyāt | atra vacane agnau kariṣya ādāyet yapi paṭhanti | tatra ghṛtaplutam annam ādāyāgnau kariṣya iti pṛcched ity anvayaḥ |
kātyāyano ’py āha |
uddhṛtya ghṛtāktam annaṃ pṛcchaty agnau kariṣya iti kuruṣvety anujñātaḥ piṇḍapitṛyajñavad dhutvā hutaśeṣaṃ datvā pātram ālabhya japatīti |
atrānnam ādāyāgnau kariṣya iti pṛcchatīty ukte adṛṣṭārthatvam ālocyānnasya homadravyasyāvagatau tātparyāt tasyaivānnasya grahaṇe ’vadhṛte prakṛtapākāt pṛthagbhāvabhāvanātmakasyoddharaṇasyārthasiddhatvād uddhṛtyetivacanam utkṣepaṇārtham iti gamyate |
āha pracetāḥ |
agnau kariṣyann ādāya pṛcchaty annaṃ ghṛtaplutam |
oṃ kuruṣvety anujñāto juhuyāt pitṛyajñavat || iti |
saurapurāṇe |
agnau kariṣya ity uktvā kuruṣvety abhyanujñayā |
annaṃ ghṛtaplutaṃ vahnau juhuyāt pitṛyajñavat ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
kṛtvā samāhitaṃ cittaṃ mantrayed vai karomi ca |
anujñātaḥ kuruṣveti tatheti dvijasattamaiḥ |
patnīm ādāya putrāṃś ca juhuyād dhavyavāhane ||
nigamaḥ |
annam uddhṛtyābhighāryāgnau kariṣya iti pṛcchati
viṣṇupurāṇe |
agnau kariṣya ity uktvā tair uktaḥ kriyatām iti |
gṛhyoktenaiva vidhinā hutvā pātreṣu dāpayet ||
hutvā hutaśeṣaṃ pitryaviprapātreṣu prakṣiped ity arthaḥ | gṛhyoktenaivety evakāro na smṛtipurāṇoktavidhinivṛttyarthaḥ pratyabhijñānāt sarvatraikakarmye sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ parasparasāpekṣatve ca sthite sarvadharmopasaṃhārasya nyāyyatvāt | ato vidhinaivety evam ayam evakāro yojyaḥ |
āha baudhāyanaḥ |
athaitaṃs tilamiśrāpaḥ pratigrāhya gandhena mākhyena cālaṃkṛtyāgnau kariṣyāmīty anujñāto agnim upasamādhāya saṃparistīrya tisra ājyāhutīḥ juhoti | somāya pitṛmate svadhā namaḥ svāhā | yamāyāṅgirasvate pitṛmate svadhā namaḥ svāhā | agnaye kavyavāhanāya sviṣṭikṛte svadhā namaḥ svāheti taccheṣeṇānnam abhighāryāsyaitā eva tistro juhuyāt |
'atha' iti brāhmaṇopaveśanād anantaram | 'etān' iti brāhmaṇān | 'agnim upasamādhāya' agnyāyatane agniṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ prajvālya, ‘saṃparistīrya’ darbhaiḥ samantāt paristīrya | 'iti'śabda ājyahomasamāptau | 'taccheśeṣeṇa’ ājyāhutiśeṣeṇa | 'annaṃ' homārtham uddhṛtam odanaṃ, 'tad abhighārya' tasyopari hutaśeṣam ājyaṃ kṣārayitvety arthaḥ | annasyāvadāya 'etā evety etair eva mantrais tisra āhutīr juhuyāt |
matsyapurāṇe |
agnau kuryād anudjñāto (?) vipro viprair yathāvidhi |
svagṛhyoktena vidhinā kāṃsye kṛtvā caruṃ tataḥ ||
agnīṣomayamānāṃ tu kṛtvāpy āyanam āditaḥ |
dakṣiṇāgnau praṇīte vā ya ekāgnir dvijottamaḥ ||
hārītaḥ |
