āsādyodapātreṣu samanyāyantītyapa āsicya sumanasaś cotpūya brāhmaṇair anujñātaḥ sāmidhenyedhmam ādhāyāvāhyāgniṣvāttādīn brāhmaṇasthān udapācair yathārtham arcayitvā mekṣaṇapāṇir anujñāto yat somāya pitṛmate juhoti somajyeṣṭhāṃs tena somapāṃś ca pitṝn prīṇāti yamāyāṅgirasvate yamajyeṣṭhān barhiṣadas tenāgnijyeṣṭhān agniṣvāttāṃś ca yad agniṃ kavyavāhanaṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yan mekṣaṇam ādadhyād ātmānaṃ tena prīṇāti | hutocchiṣṭaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradāya piṇḍebhyo ’vaśeṣayed iti |
'sāmidhenyety' atra harihareṇa samītsv etīti pāṭho darśitaḥ | vacanaṃ ca vyākhyātam | tad yathā |
'samanyāyanty upayanty anyā' ity anena mantreṇārghyapātreṣu jalaṃ prakṣipya tadupari sumanasaḥ puṣpāṇi ca kṣiptvā prokṣaṇīvan mantrarahitam evotpavanaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇaiḥ samītsvety evam anujñātaḥ san idhmam agnisamindhārthakāṣṭham agnau kṣipet | anujñāvacanadarśanād arthāt pūrvakāle ’gnisamindhanaṃ karavāṇītyādiprārthanāvākyaṃ śrāddhakartrā prayojyam ity anumīyate | evam idhmādhāyāvāhanamantraiḥ pitṝn āvāhyānantaraṃ pūrvopakalpitair udapātrair brāhmaṇarūpādhiṣṭhānasthitān agniṣvāttādīn ādigrahaṇād dhavirbhukprabhṛtīn yathārthaṃ yasya varṇasya yair acitair arthaḥ [1348] śrāddhaprayojanasaṃpattis tān arcayet | te ca 'somapā nāma viprāṇām' ityādinā manvādibhir nirdiṣṭāḥ | yad vāvāhana eva mṛtapitrādyadhiṣṭātṛbhāvenāgniṣvāttādisaṃkalpaḥ | arcanaṃ tu pitrāditrayasyaiva nāmabhir yathārtham iti vacanāt | evaṃ ca jīvatpitṛkāder dvayārcanam iti siddhyati | atha mekṣaṇapāṇir agnau kariṣyāmītyādi pṛṣṭvā kuruṣvety anujñātaḥ somādibhya āhutitrayaṃ hutvā mekṣaṇam ante ’gnāv ādadhyāt | hutāvaśeṣaṃ tu pitryaviprapātreṣu kiyan nikṣipyānyat piṇḍārtham avaśeṣayet || iti |
uddhṛtyānnam ity ukaṃ, tatrānne viśeṣo brahmapurāṇe darśitaḥ |
tato ghṛtāktam annaṃ tu soṣṇam ādāya sādhitam |
tān agnau kariṣya iti prayataḥ prārthayet dvijān ||
mahābhārate ’pi |
juhuyād vyañjanakṣāravarjam annaṃ tato naraḥ |
anujñāto dvijais tais tu kṛtvā oṃ bharatarṣabha || iti |
vyañjanaśabdenātra dadhipayastakraguḍamarīcādīni | lavaṇarasasaṃskāryāṇāṃ śākasūpādīnāṃ tu lavaṇarasavarjanenaiva pratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ | 'kṣārāṇi' lavaṇarasavanti dravyāṇi |
yat tu brahmāṇḍapurāṇe,
puṣpāṇāṃ ca phalānāṃ ca bhakṣyāṇāṃ ca prayatnataḥ |
ayam uddhṛtya sarveṣāṃ juhuyāj jātavedasi ||
iti pitrarthapākasiddhalavaṇādisaṃsṛṣṭaśākādihomasmaraṇaṃ, tad yeṣāṃ gṛhye 'gnaukaraṇahomānantaraṃ tadaṅgatayā haviṣyavyatiriktenānyasaṃsṛṣṭena cānnenoṣṇe bhasmany amantrako homa uktas tadviṣayam ity avirodhaḥ |
[1349] sa ca homa āpastambasūtre darśitaḥ |
na kṣāralavaṇahomo vidyate tathā parānnasṛṣṭasyāhaviṣyasya homa udīcīnam uṣṇaṃ bhasmāpohy etasmin juhuyāt taddhutam ahutaṃ cāgnau bhavatīti |
atha vā annābhāve yadā kandamūlaphalādibhir eva śrāddhaṃ tadviṣayam idaṃ brahmāṇḍapurāṇavacanam | atra pakvānnena yadā śrāddhaṃ tadaiva homapiṇḍakriye pravartate | tayoḥ pakvānnadravyakatvaniyamād ity etaj jayantasvāmimataṃ harihareṇopanyasyāmaśrāddhaṃ yadā kuryyād ityādipūrvapradarśitamatsyapurāṇavirodham udbhāvya dūṣitam |
agnau kariṣyan pṛcchatīty uktam | tatra sarvān vaikaṃ vety apekṣāyām āha manuḥ |
teṣām udakam ānīya sapavitrāṃs tilān api |
agnau kuryād anujñāto brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇaiḥ saha ||
gandhamālyādibhiḥ brāhmaṇān arcayitvā 'teṣāṃ' brāhmaṇānāṃ, haste jalaṃ prakṣipya pavitrasahitāṃs tilāṃś ca datvā 'saha' saṃbhūya yugapat sarvair brāhmaṇair anujñātaḥ san kartāgnau homaṃ kuryāt | anujñāvacanāt praśno 'py anumīyate | sahetivacanāt sarvān prati praśnaḥ kartavya iti gamyate | ekaṃ prati praśne kṛte sarvair abhyanujñāne kriyamāṇe praśnasyādṛṣṭārthatvaṃ prasajyeta | ayaṃ ca sarvapraśnapakṣo vaikalpikaḥ | athoddhṛtyāgniṃ paṅktimūrddhanyaṃ sarvān pṛcchaty agnau kariṣya iti hārītavacanāt atraikābhimukhyenaikaṃ prati sarvābhimukhyena sarvān prati praśno ’yam iti sujñeyatvān nābhyanujñāvacane dvijānām anadhyavasāyaḥ praśnābhiprāyaḥ praśnaprasaṅgo vā vācyaḥ |
abhyanujñāto juhuyād ity ukam | kair abhyanujñāta ity apekṣāyām āha pāraskaraḥ |
dattvā gandhādi dhūpāṃś ca sarpiṣmaddhavir uddharet |
[1350] paitṛkair abhyanujñāto juhoti pitṛyajñavat || iti |
paitṛkair ity atra brāhmaṇair iti śeṣaḥ | anena praśno ’pi paitṛkān pratyeveti gamyate | atrāgnau kariṣye kuruṣveti praśnottarayoḥ prakāro ’vagata eva | prakārāntaram apy āśvalāyanagṛhye darśitam |
uddhṛtya ghṛtāktam annam anujñāpayaty agnau kariṣye karavai karavāṇīti vā pratyanujñā kriyatāṃ kuruṣva kurv ity athāgnau juhoti yathoktaṃ purastād iti |
āpastambas tūdīcyānāṃ praśnottaraprakāram āha |
udīcyavṛttis tv āsanagatānāṃ hasteṣūdakapātrānayanam uddhriyatāṃ agnau ca kriyatām ity āmantrayate kāmam uddhriyatāṃ kāmam agnau ca kriyatām ity atisṛṣṭa uddharej juhuyāc ceti |
atra
prāgudañcau vibhajate haṃsaḥ kṣīrodake yathā |
viduṣāṃ śabdasiddhyarthaṃ sā naḥ pātu sarasvatī ||
iti purātanānāṃ vākyāt sarasvatyuttaradeśasaṃbandhino ye te udīcyāḥ teṣāṃ vṛttir ācāraḥ kathyata iti śeṣaḥ | 'udakapātrānayanaṃ' arghyapradānam | brāhmaṇān 'āmantrayate' anujñābhyarthanavākyenābhimukhān kurute | 'atisṛṣṭaḥ' brāhmaṇair anujñātaḥ |
atra pitṛyajñavad ity anena agnaukaraṇahome pitṛyajñetikartavyatātideśaḥ kṛtaḥ, sā cetikartavyatā āpastambādibhiḥ piṇḍapitṛyajñaprakaraṇe darśitā | tatra āpastambaḥ |
samūlaṃ sakṛd ācchinnaṃ barhir āharati sakṛd ācchinnāni vā tṛṇāny upamūlaṃ dinānīti dakṣiṇāprāgagrair darbhaiḥ dakṣiṇam agniṃ paristīrya dakṣiṇaṃ jānv ācya mekṣaṇe upastīrya tenāvadāyābhighārya somāya pitṛmate svadhā nama iti dakṣiṇāgnau juhoti yamāyāṅgirasvate pitṛmate svadhā nama [1351] iti dvitīyāṃ agnaye kavyavāhanāya svadhā nama iti tṛtīyāṃ ye mekṣaṇe tandulās tān hutvā tūṣṇīṃ mekṣaṇam ādadhāti ityādi |
āśvalāyano ’pi |
prācīnāvītī idhmam upasamādhāya mekṣaṇenāvadāya avadānasaṃpadā juhuyāt | somāya pitṛmate svadhā namo ’gnaye kavyavāhanāya svadhā nama iti svāhākāreṇa vā agniṃ pūrvaṃ yajñopavītīti |
evam anyāny api piṇḍapitṛyajñasūtrāṇi prācīnāvītayajñopavītanirṇaye draṣṭavyāni | ayaṃ ca piṇḍapitṛyajñadharmātideśo hārītavacane vistareṇa vivṛtaḥ |
kuruṣvety abhyanujñātaḥ pūrvoddhṛte 'gnau sakṛdācchinair upamūlalūnaiḥ paristīrṇe samit tantreṇa prāṅmukho mekṣaṇenāhutidvayaṃ hutvā mekṣaṇam agnāv eva kuryāt || iti
asyārthaḥ smṛticandrikākāreṇa vyākhyātaḥ |
'pūrvoddhṛte ’gnau' paristaraṇakālāt pūrvam evodbodhite ’gnau, mūlasamīpadeśe sakṛd ekayatnena chinnair darbhaiḥ paristīrṇe samit tantreṇāhutidvayārtham ekām eva samidham ādāya mekṣaṇena yajñīyakāṣṭhakṛtenāhutidvayaṃ hutvāgnāv eva mekṣaṇaṃ prakṣipet | samit tantreṇety anena pitṛyajñadharma uktaḥ pitṛyajñe samidādhānasyābhāvāt kiṃ tv iha dharmāntaram upadiṣṭam || iti |
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe ’py atra samidādhānam uktam |
antar nidhāya samidhaṃ juhuyāt kavyavāhanam || iti |
brahmapurāṇe tu ghṛtāktaprādeśamātrasamittrayādhānam uktam |
oṃ kuruṣveti tair ukto dakṣiṇāgniṃ samāhvayet |
dakṣiṇāgrāṃś caturdikṣu darbhān āstīrya vāgyataḥ ||
dadyāt tu samidhas tisras tasmin prādeśamātrikāḥ |
[1352] ghṛtāktaḥ samidho hutvā dakṣiṇāgrāḥ samantrakāḥ
mekṣaṇena ghṛtāktena juhuyāc cāhutitrayam ||
samidarhāś ca drumās tatraivoktāḥ |
palāśaphalgunyagrodhaplakṣāśvatthavikaṅkatāḥ
udumbaras tathā bilvaś candanaṃ yajñiyāś ca ye ||
saralo devadāruś ca sālaś ca khadiras tathā |
samidarthe praśastāḥ syur ete vṛkṣā viśeṣataḥ ||
grāhyāḥ kaṇṭakinaś caiva yajñiyā ye ca kecana |
pūjitāḥ samidarthena pitṝṇāṃ vacanaṃ yathā ||
samidbhis tv ājyaliptābhir juhuyād yo hutāśanam |
phalaṃ yat karmaṇas tasya tan me nigadataḥ śṛṇu |
akṣayaṃ sarvakāmīyaṃ aśvamedhaphalaṃ hi tat ||
samidanarhās tu |
ślemātako naktamālaḥ kapitthaḥ śālmalis tathā |
nīpovibhītakaś caiva śrāddhakarmaṇi garhitāḥ ||
cirabilvas tathā ṭaṅkas tindukāmrātakau tathā |
tilbakaḥ kovidāraś ca ete śrāddhe vigarhitāḥ ||
nivāsaś caiva kīṭānāṃ garhitāḥ syur ayajñiyāḥ |
gulmaiś ca veṣṭitā ye ca vallībhiś ca samantataḥ ||
śakunīnāṃ nivāsāś ca varjayet tān dvijottamaḥ |
anyāṃś caivaṃvidhān sarvān varjayed vai ayajñiyān ||
‘palāśaḥ' kiṃśukaḥ | ‘phalguḥ' kākodumbarikā | 'nyagrodhaḥ' vaṭaḥ | 'plakṣaḥ' [1353] jaṭī | 'aśvatthaḥ ' pippalaḥ | 'vikaṅkataḥ' sruvavṛkṣaḥ | 'udumbaraḥ' jantuphalaḥ | ‘bilvaḥ' śrīphalaḥ | 'candanaṃ' malayajam | 'yajñiyāḥ' kāśmaryaśamīprabhṛtayaḥ | 'saralaḥ' pītadrumaḥ | 'sālaḥ' sālavṛkṣaḥ | 'khadiraḥ' bālapatraḥ | ‘kaṇṭakinaḥ’ iṅgudīprabhṛtayaḥ | 'śleśmātakaḥ' seluḥ | 'naktamālaḥ' karañjaḥ | 'kapitthaḥ' dadhitthaḥ | ‘śālmaliḥ' sthirāyuḥ | 'nīpaḥ' kadambaḥ | ‘cirabilvaḥ' pūtikarañjaḥ | 'ṭaṅkaḥ' ahimārakaḥ | 'tindukaḥ' sphūrjakaḥ | 'āmrātakaḥ' kapītanaḥ | 'tilbakaḥ' rodhraḥ | ‘kovidāraḥ’ kāñcanāraḥ | 'ayajñiyāḥ' picumardapāribhadrādayaḥ |
āha suyajñaḥ |
parisamuhya paryukṣya paristīrya dakṣiṇaṃ jānv ācya yajñopavītī prāg āsīno mekṣaṇena juhotīti |
śaṅkhalikhitau|
dhūpagandhamālyair alaṃkṛtya brāhmaṇān saghṛtam annam anujñāpya darbhair dakṣiṇāgrair agniṃ paristīrya juhuyāt || iti |
ity agnaukaraṇāṅgabhūtāni praśnottaradravyāṇi |
athāgnaukaraṇadevatāhutisaṃkhyāmantravikalpāḥ ||
manu-bṛhaspatī |
agneḥ somayamābhyāṃ ca kṛtvāpy āyanam āditaḥ |
havirdānena vidhivat paścāt saṃtarpayet pitṝn ||
agnisomayamākhyānāṃ devatānāṃ prathamena homenāpyāpanaṃ kṛtvā havirdānena yathoktānnapradānena brāhmaṇādhiṣṭhānān pitṝn paścāt tarpayet |
medhātithi-hariharābhimatā vyākhyā | agner iti caturthyarthe [1354] ṣaṣṭhī | agnir ekā devatā, soma-yamarūpādhiṣṭhānadvayaniṣṭhaikadevatātvayuktā dvitīyā | somayamābhyām iti dvandvād agnīṣomavad ekatvāvagateḥ | etac ca yeṣāṃ gṛhye īdṛgvidhaṃ devatātvam uktaṃ teṣām eva veditavyam iti |
atra brūmaḥ | yady apy atra somayamayoḥ devatātvāc caturthyantatocitā, tathāpi poṣaṇaparyāyeṇāpy āyanaśabdenānvaye kriyamāṇe ṣaṣṭhyantatayaiva bhāvyam | atha devatātvān nātra ṣaṣṭhīty ucyeta, tarhy agner itīyam api na syāt | caturthyarthe vyākhyātā seti cet | na | āpyāyanapadenānvayāt | ṣaṣṭhyās tu saṃbandhasāmānyavācinyā viśeṣaparyavasāyitvam abhyupagatam eveti na devatārūpavirodhitvam | svatantrayoḥ somayamayor devatātvapratipādakānāṃ vacanānām āhutimantrāṇāṃ ca darśanān nānyonyasahitayor devatātvam | na ca kvacid gṛhye tadavasthayor devatātvam upalabhante śiṣṭāḥ | dṛśyate copanibandhanāntareṣu pāṭhāntaram asya vacanasya | "agnisomayamānāṃ ca kṛtvāpy āyanam āditaḥ” iti |
yamaḥ |
agnaye caiva somāya yamāya juhuyāt tataḥ |
agnaye kavyavāhanāya svāheti juhuyād dhaviḥ ||
somāya pitṛmate yamāyāṅgirase tathā |
somasyāpyāyanaṃ kṛtvā vahner vaivasvatasya ca ||
hute tv agnau tataḥ samyak vidhinānena mantravit |
svadhety eva haviḥśeṣaṃ ādadhīta samīkṣya ca ||
śaṅkhalikhitau |
juhuyād agnaye kavyavāhanāya svāhā somāya pitṛmate svāheti |
[1355] mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
agnaye kavyavāhanāya svāheti prathamāhutiḥ |
somāya vai pitṛmate svāhety anyā tathā bhavet ||
vaiśabdaḥ pādapūraṇārthatvān na prayogakāle prayojyaḥ | gobhile tv etāv eva mantrau purastāt svāhākārau viparītena ca krameṇoktau |
mekṣaṇenopaghātaṃ juhuyāt svāhā somāya pitṛmate iti pūrvāṃ, svāhāgnaye kavyavāhanāyeti dvitīyām ata ūrdhvaṃ prācīnāvītīti |
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe tv āhutitrayaṃ svadhānamo’ntās trayo mantrās tathā pratyāhutyadhikaraṇabhūtāgnipradeśānāṃ vibhajya viniyogaś coktaḥ |
āhṛtya dakṣiṇāgniṃ tu homārthaṃ vai prayatnataḥ |
agnaye kavyavāhanāya svadhā nama iti bruvan ||
somāya ca pitṛmate svadhā nama iti bruvan |
yamāyāṅgirasāmpatye svadhā nama iti bruvan |
ity ete homamantrās tu trayāṇām anupūrvaśaḥ ||
dakṣiṇato ’gnaye nityaṃ somāyottaratas tathā |
etayor antare nityaṃ juhuyād vai vivasvate || iti |
'aṅgirasāmpatya' iti yamaviśeṣaṇaṃ |
brahmavaivarte tu vaivasvatāyeti yamasya, aṅgirasa ity agneḥ somasya ca viśeṣaṇaṃ darśitam |
agnaye kavyavāhanāya svadhā cāṅgirase namaḥ |
somāya ca pitṛmate svadhā cāṅgirase namaḥ ||
yamāya vaivasvatāya svadhā nama iti bruvan |
[1356] ity ete vai homamantrās trayāṇām anupūrvaśaḥ ||
dakṣiṇenāgnaye nityaṃ somāyottaratas tathā |
etayor antare nityaṃ juhuyād vai vivasvate || iti |
piṇḍapitṛyajñam adhikṛtyāha āśvalāyanaḥ |
mekṣaṇenādāyāvadānasaṃpadā juhuyāt somāya pitṛmate svadhā namaḥ agnaye kavyavāhanāya svadhā nama iti svāhākāreṇa vāgniṃ pūrvam || iti |
piṇḍapitṛyajñaprakaraṇa evāha āpastambaḥ |
somāya pitṛpītāya svadhā nama iti dakṣiṇānau juhoti | yamāyāṅgirasvate pitṛmate svadhā nama iti dvitīyām agnaye kavyavāhanāya svadhā nama iti tṛtīyāṃ, na yamāya juhotīty eka iti |
pitṛyajñam evādhikṛtya sāṃkhyāyanaḥ |
mekṣaṇena jahoty agnaye kavyavāhanāya svāhā somāya pitṛmate svāhā yamāyāṅgiraksvate pitṛmate svāheti |
pitṛyajñam evādhikṛtya vaijavāpaḥ |
anvāhāryapacane mekṣaṇena dve āhutī juhoty agnaya iti pūrvāṃ
somāyety uttarām iti |
atra nirviśeṣaṇayor evāgnīṣomayor devatātvam | anvāhāryapacano dakṣiṇāgniḥ piṇḍapitṛyajñoktā apy ete devatāhutimantravikalpāḥ atideśato ’gnaukaraṇe bhavanty eveti | ete ca devatādividhayo yadīyeṣu kalpasūtragṛhyeṣūktās te tadīyā eveti vyavasthayā boddhavyāḥ | ataś ca yadā āpastambena svagṛhye trayodaśāhutikam agnaukaraṇam uktaṃ tady eṣāṃ tat sūtraṃ teṣām eveti smṛticandrikākāraḥ | sa hy evam āha |
uddhriyatām agnau ca [1357] kriyatām ity āmantrayate kāmam uddhriyatāṃ kāmam agnau ca kriyatām ity atisṛṣṭa uddharej juhuyāc ceti |
evaṃ dharmaśāstra-sūtroktapraśnaprativacanānantaram annam uddhṛtyāgnyupasamādhānādyājyabhāgāntaṃ kuryāt | asyāgnyupasamādhānādyājyabhāgāntasya karmaṇaḥ sarvapradhānahomaprācyāṅgakalāpatvenāpastambīyagṛhyopakrame ’bhidhānāt | ājyabhāgānantaram annenājyena ca dravyeṇa yan me mātetyādibhir mantrair agnaukaraṇasaṃjñakaṃ pradhānahomaṃ kuryāt |
tathāca āpastambīyagṛhyasūtram |
annasyottarābhir juhoty ājyāhutīr uttarā iti |
uddhṛtasyānnasya kiṃcit kiṃcid avadānadharmeṇāvadāyāvadāya pitrāditrayasya ṣaṇmātāmahāditrayāya ṣaḍāhutīr uttarābhir ṛgbhir juhuyāt | mantraprapāṭhakapaṭhitānāṃ madhye yāḥ pūrvamuktaviniyogās tāsām ūrdhvaṃ paṭhyamānā ṛca uttarāḥ annāhutīnām uttarāḥ pāścātyāḥ ṣaḍāhutīś ca juhuyād ity arthaḥ | atra yady api ṣaṇṇām uttarāṇām ṛcāṃ svasvadevatāliṅgena pāṭhakrameṇa ca pitrādidevatyājyāhutivibhāgena viniyogo ’vagamyata eva, tathāpi spaṣṭatvārtham āhutisaṃkhyājñānārthaṃ prayogapradarśanārthaṃ ca dvayor dvayor viniyogam āha, yan me mātā pralulobha carati yās tiṣṭhanti dvābhyām ṛgbhyāṃ amuṣmai svāhetyantābhyām iti | atra juhotīty anuṣajyate | amuṣmā ity atra caturthyantaṃ pitur nāma gṛhītvā dve āhutī juhuyāt | evaṃ yan me pitāmahī pralulobha carati antardadhe parvatair iti dvābhyām ṛgbhyām amuṣmai svāhetyantābhyām iti | amuṣmā ity atra caturthyantaṃ pitāmahasya nāma gṛhītvā dve āhutī juhuyāt | yan me prapitāmahī pralulobha carati antardadhe ṛtubhir iti dvābhyām ṛgbhyām amuṣmai [1358] svāhetyantābhyām iti | amuṣmā ity atra prapitāmahasya nāma gṛhītvā dve āhutī juhuyād iti | evaṃ pitrāhutiviniyuktābhyām ṛgbhyāṃ mātāmahāyāhutidvayaṃ, pitāmahāhutiviniyuktābhyāṃ mātuḥ pitāmahāyāhutidvayaṃ, prapitāmahāhutiviniyuktābhyāṃ mātuḥ prapitāmahāyāhutidvayaṃ juhuyāt | ūhas tv atra kāryaḥ | tatra prathamamantre yan me mātāmahī pralulobha tan me reto mātāmaho vṛddhām ity ūhaḥ | dvitīye mantre antaranyaṃ mātāmahād vṛdha ity ūhaḥ | mantradvaye 'py amuṣmā ity atra caturthyantasya mātāmahanāmno grahaṇaṃ kartavyam | tṛtīye mantre yan me mātuḥ pitāmahī pralulobha tan me reto mātuḥ pitāmaho vṛddhām ity ūhaḥ | caturthe mantre antaranyaṃ mātuḥ pitāmahād vṛdha ity ūhaḥ | mantradvaye 'py amuṣmā ity atra caturthyantasya mātṛpitāmahanāmno grahaṇaṃ kartavyam | pañcame mantre yan me mātuḥ prapitāmahī pralulobha tan me reto mātuḥ prapitāmaho vṛddhām ity ūhaḥ | ṣaṣṭhe mantre antaranyaṃ mātuḥ prapitāmahād vṛdha ity ūhaḥ | mantradvaye 'py amuṣmā ity atra caturthyantasya mātṛprapitāmahanāmno grahaṇaṃ kartavyam |
tad etad āha gṛhyabhāṣyasaṃgrahakāraḥ |
yojyaḥ pitrādiśabdānāṃ sthāne mātāmahādikaḥ |
annahome tathā sparśe jalapiṇḍādidānake |
yan me mātāmahītyādi tatrodāharaṇaṃ bhavet || ityādi |
'sparśe' eṣa te tata madhu māṃ ūrmiḥ sarasvān ityādimantratrayeṇa brāhmaṇabhojanārthasyānnasya sparśe, tataḥ pūrvavad avadāya ye ceha pitara ity ṛcā ekām āhutiṃ juhoti | evam annāhutīr hutvā ṣaḍ ājyāhutīr juhoti | [1359] tatra svāhā pitre iti purastāt svāhākāreṇa mantreṇa prathamadvitīye, etābhyām eva mantrābhyāṃ tṛtīyacaturthe ājyājatīr hutvā svadhā svāheti mantreṇa pañcamīṃ juhoti | agnaye kavyavāhanāya svāheti mantreṇa ṣaṣṭhīm | tataḥ sviṣṭikṛdāhutiṃ hutvā bhakṣyabhojyādisarvavidhahaviṣyānnāt kiṃcid ādāyodīcīnam uṣṇaṃ bhasmāpohya tasminn uṣṇe bhasmani tūṣṇīṃ juhoti | tato lepayoḥ prasravābhyāṃ tūṣṇīṃ barhiraṅktāgnau (?) praharatītyādikaṃ pariṣecanāntam āgneyasthālīpākoktaṃ caruṃ homeṣv atideśaprāptam udīcyāṅgakalāpaṃ kṛtvā hutaśeṣaṃ brāhmaṇapātreṣu nidadhyāt |
tad etat sarvam apy āha gṛhyabhāṣyasaṃgrahakāraḥ |
agnīndhanādipratipādyakarma kṛtvājyabhāgāntam athāvadāya yan meti mantraiḥ pratimantram agnaukāryās tathā saptabhir annahomāḥ svāhādimantrair api sarpiṣā syur homās tataḥ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ tu hutvā bhasmāpy apohyāhavirannahomo lepaṃ tu darvyoś ca samañjanādiśeṣaṃ ca kṛtvā pariṣecanāntaṃ pātreṣu dadyād dhutaśeṣam annam || iti |
saptabhir annahomā ity anūhitamantrābhiprāyeṇoktam | ūhitamantrasāhitye hi trayodaśasaṃkhyāpatteḥ | saptabhir ity ayuktaṃ syāt | ayaṃ cāgnaukaraṇahomaḥ prācīnāvītinā kāryaḥ paitṛkatvāt | tathā ca āpastambena svagṛhyagranthādāv ity uktam |
aparapakṣe pitryāṇi prācīnāvītināpasavyaṃ dakṣiṇato ’pavargaḥ || iti |
atrāpi yadā paitṛkam āghārasamindhanādikaṃ tad yajñopavītinā kāryam |
tad āha bhāṣyārthasaṃgrahakāraḥ |
[1360] āghāradārvagnimukhājyabhāga-
pradakṣiṇānuvrajaneṣu tāvat |
āghārayoḥ sviṣṭakṛti pradiṣṭaṃ
yajñopavītaṃ hi kapardinaḥ syāt |
ity agnaukaraṇadevatāhutisaṃkhyāmantravikalpāḥ |
atha pāṇyadhikaraṇasya homasya praśnādīni |
śaunakagṛhye |
anagniś ced ājyaṃ gṛhītvā bhavatsv evāgnaukaraṇam iti
pūrvavat tathāstu || iti |
asyārthaḥ ājyam ājyayuktam annaṃ tad arghyādipātre sthāpayitvā pātraṃ coddhṛtya kare dhārayitvā bhavatsv evāgnaukaraṇam ity adhikaraṇakarmakārakayor nirdeśaṃ kṛtvā śeṣaṃ pūrvavat | agnyadhikaraṇakahomavat kariṣye karavai karavāṇīti vā ākhyātapadaṃ prayuñjītety arthaḥ | tathāstv iti brāhmaṇā anujñāṃ dadyur iti yāvat | atrāpi kākākṣigolakavat pūrvavad iti saṃbandhanīyam | tathā ca kriyatāṃ kuruṣva kurv ity abhyanujñāvacanaṃ labhyate | tatrāgnaukaraṇadharmāntarātideśo ’pi pāṇihome jñātavyaḥ | tathā ca homārthe ’nne pūrvārddhāparārddhakalpanā | abhighāraṇapratyabhighāraṇe dvir avadānaṃ mekṣaṇenāvadāya homa iti | atra smṛtyarthasārakṛtā mekṣaṇedhmaviprānujñāḥ na santi parisamūhanaparyukṣaṇe bhavataḥ ity uktam |
tatrāha smṛticandrikākāraḥ |
yātra smṛtyarthasārakartur viprānujñābhāvoktiḥ sānagniś ced ityādinirantaroktaśaunakavacanādarśananibandhanety upekṣaṇīyā | mekṣaṇābhāvoktir api [1361] mekṣaṇakārye anyasya vidhyadarśanāc cintyā, paryukṣaṇaparisamūhanasadbhāvoktiś ca pāṃsunirasanalakṣaṇasya dṛṣṭakāryasya lopān niyamādṛṣṭamātrasya cāprayojakatvād ayuktā | yasya tv adṛṣṭarūpa eva saṃskāraḥ kāryaṃ paristaraṇasya tad asty eva |
tathā ca yamaḥ |
agnaukaraṇavat tatra homo daivakare bhavet |
paryastadarbhān āstīrya yato hy agnisamo hi saḥ || iti |
'daivakaraḥ' vaiśvadevikabrāhmaṇapāṇiḥ | daivagrahaṇaṃ pitryasyāpy upalakṣaṇārtham | ‘paryastadarbhāḥ' paritaḥ sarvato nyasanīyāḥ darbhāḥ paristaraṇadabhāḥ iti yāvat | anye tu nibandhakārāḥ “paryukṣya darbhān āstīrya" iti paṭhanti | "idhmasya tv indhanārthaṃ samid bhavet" iti agnisamindhanārthatvasmaraṇāt tadabhāve sarvasaṃmata eva lopaḥ | parisamūhanaparyukṣaṇayos tu dharmamātratvād alopa eva | upādhyāyakarkas tu kuruśvety abhyanujñātaḥ piṇḍapitṛyajñavad dhutvety atra kātyāyanasūtre piṇḍapitṛyajñavad ity asya piṇḍapitṛyajñavad upacāra ity anena paunaruktyam āśaṅkya yathāsaṃbhavaṃ paristaraṇaparisamūhanādītikartavyatāparisaṅkhyārthatām eva samarthitavān | tataś ca parisamūhanaparyukṣaṇamekṣaṇādītikartavyatāśūnyahomamātrācāras tu tanmatānusāribhir eva pravartita iti jānīmaḥ | yad atra yuktaṃ tad grāhyam |
iti pāṇyadhikaraṇasya homasya praśnādīni |
pāṇyadhikaraṇakahomadharmaka evājākarṇādyadhikaraṇako ’py agnaukaraṇahomaḥ | agnaukaraṇaṃ kariṣya ity etāvān eva praśno ’treti viśeṣaḥ |
ity ajakarṇādyadhikaraṇakasya homasya praśnādīni |
[1362]
atha hutāvaśiṣṭapratipattiḥ |
tatrāgnau homam uktvāha yājñavalkyaḥ |
hutaśeṣaṃ pradadyāt tu bhājaneṣu samāhitaḥ |
yathālābhopapanneṣu raupyeṣu tu viśeṣataḥ ||
atra pitṛpriyaraupyavacanāt paitṛkaviprabhājaneṣv iti gamyate |
tathā ca yamaḥ |
agnaukaraṇaśeṣaṃ tu pitryeṣu pratipādayet |
pratipādya pitṝṇāṃ tu na dadyād vaiśvadevika iti ||
atrāgnaukaraṇaśabdād vacanasyāgnihomaviṣayatvaṃ agnyanagnirūpobhayavidhādhikaraṇa-homaviṣayatvaṃ vāstu | agnaukaraṇaśabdasya nāmadheyatvāt |
tathā ca paṅktimūrddhanyapitryapāṇau homam uktvāha kātyāyanaḥ |
hutvā mantravad anyeṣāṃ tūṣṇīṃ pātreṣu nikṣipet | iti |
anyaśabdasya prakṛtasajātīyavacanatvāt pitryapaṅktyupaviṣṭaviprapātreṣv iti labhyate |
ata evāha yamaḥ |
pitryapāṇihutāc cheṣaṃ pitṛpātreṣu nikṣipet |
agnaukaraṇaśeṣaṃ tu na dadyād vaiśvadevike ||
atra pitryapāṇigrahaṇam upalakṣaṇam | ato vaiśvadevikadvijapāṇau home ’pi śeṣasya pitṛpātreṣv eva prakṣepo na devapātreṣu | ata eva sarvasādhāraṇyenaiva hutaśeṣasya vaiśvadevikapātraprakṣepaḥ pratiṣiddho brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
agnaukaraṇaśeṣaṃ tu na dadyād vaiśvadevike |
[1363] na hi smṛtāḥ śeṣabhājo viśvedevāḥ purāṇagaiḥ || iti ||
yamenāpi pratiṣiddhaḥ |
agnaukaraṇaśeṣaṃ tu pitryeṣu pratipādayet |
hutaśeṣaṃ kadācit tu na dadyād vaiśvadevike ||
na kadācid ity asyāyam arthaḥ | yadā vaiśvadevikapaṅktimukhyaviprapāṇau homaḥ tadā tasyaiva vā vaiśvadevikadvijāntarasya pātre hutaśeṣaprakṣepo na kartavyaḥ | yadā vā pitryapāṇau vahnyādāv adhikaraṇāntare vā homaḥ tadānīm api vaiśvadevikadvijapātre hutaśeṣaprakṣepo na kartavya iti viśeṣataś ca vaiśvadevikapātreṣu hutaśeṣaprakṣepas tenaiva niṣiddhaḥ |
daivaviprakare ’nagniḥ kṛtvāgnaukaraṇaṃ dvijaḥ |
śeṣayet pitṛviprebhyaḥ (?) piṇḍārthaṃ śeṣayet tatheti ||
vāyupurāṇe |
hutvā daivakare ’nagniḥ śeṣaṃ pitrye nivedayet |
na hi smṛtāḥ śeṣabhājo viśvedevāḥ purāṇagaiḥ || iti |
pitrye pātra iti śeṣaḥ | 'purāṇagaiḥ' purāṇajñaiḥ | upalakṣaṇaṃ caitac chrutismṛtītihāsakalpasūtrādyabhijñānam |
vājasaneyapariśiṣṭanigame tu śeṣapratipattir brāhmaṇahas teṣūkā |
śeṣam annaṃ hastena hasteṣu piṇḍavat pradāyeti |
'piṇḍavad' ity anena svadhākāroccāraṇamātram atidiśyate | na punar avanejanapratyavanejanolmukādīni | svadhety eva haviḥśeṣam ādadīteti yamavacane dharmāntaraparisaṅkhyānāt | atha vaivam asyārthaḥ | 'piṇḍavat' yathā piṇḍeṣu, etad uktaṃ bhavati yathā piṇḍārthaṃ piṇḍapātre ’gnaukaraṇaśeṣaḥ prakṣipyate tathā [1364] brāhmaṇahasteṣv apīti | atha vā piṇḍavad iti matuvantam | śeṣam annakiyatāpy aṃśena piṇḍavat piṇḍasaṃbandhi yathā bhavati tathā brāhmaṇahasteṣu prakṣepaṇīyaṃ na kṛtsnam ity arthaḥ | piṇḍārthaṃ śeṣayed ity etac ca yadāgnau pitryaviprakarādau vā homas tadāpi veditavyam | avaśeṣaṇasya piṇḍārthavāvagamāt |
nanu daivapāṇihutāvaśeṣaṇasyaiva piṇḍārthatvopadeśāt pitryapāṇihutāvaśeṣaṇasya tādarthyaṃ na labhyate |
maivaṃ | daivakare hūyamānasyānnasyaikadeśaṃ piṇḍārtham avaśeṣayed ity atra daivakarādiviśeṣaṇa vivakṣāyāṃ viśiṣṭoddeśaprasaṅgaḥ | ato ’gnipāṇyādyadhikaraṇahutaikadeśenāpi saha śeṣayed ity etat saṃbadhyate |
ata evāha vṛddhavasiṣṭhaḥ |
pritryaviprakare hutvā śeṣaṃ pātreṣu nikṣipet |
piṇḍebhyaḥ śeṣayet kiṃcin na dadyād vaiśvadevike ||
atra yady api piṇḍaparyāptaśeṣasaṃpādanaṃ kartuṃ śakyaṃ tathāpi piṇḍārthaṃ prakṛtasarvarūpānnoddharaṇasya vakṣyamāṇatvād uddhṛtānnamiśrībhāvamātreṇāgnaukaraṇa-śeṣasya piṇḍopakārakatvam avagamyate | evaṃ ca piṇḍapātraprakṣepo 'syārthad eva siddhaḥ | yady api cātra śeṣayed iti vidhiśravaṇāt piṇḍārtham ity arthakarmatvāvagamāc ca śeṣadhāraṇasyāvaśyakatvaṃ pratīyate tathāpy upayuktadravyasaṃskārakatvena pratipattitvāvagamād anāvaśyakatvaṃ śeṣaṃ praty aprayojakatvaṃ cāvasīyate | śeṣakarmaṇām aprayojakatvāt | arthakarmarūpāṇām apy āśrayikarmaṇāṃ prastarayāgādīnāṃ pratipattirūpasaṃbhedena dravyaṃ praty aprayojakatvam evābhimatam |
āha yamaḥ |
[1365] hute tv agnau tataḥ samyag avidhinānena mantravit |
svadhety eva haviḥśeṣam ādadīta samīkṣya ca ||
homāvaśiṣṭam annam avalokya 'svadhety evam ādadīta' pitryaviprapātreṣu kiyat prakṣipya śeṣaṃ piṇḍārtham āhared ity arthaḥ | atas tūṣṇīṃ pātreṣu nikṣiped ity anenāsya vikalpaḥ | yathāgṛhyaṃ vyavasthā veti | atra yady apy āhuter agniprāptimātreṇaiva pāṇitalaprāptimātreṇa ca homasamāptir jātaiva śeṣapratipattisamāptiś ca pātraprāptimātreṇa jātā tathāpi hutaśeṣayor vacanād brāhmaṇair bhojanaṃ kāryam |
tad āha gārgyaḥ |
yad annaṃ dīyate pāṇau pātre vāpi nidhīyate |
bhuñjīran brāhmaṇās tat tu pitṛpaṅkau niveśitāḥ ||
tac ca prakṣepakāla eva na bhoktavyam | nāpi bhojanārtham upakalpayamānād annāntarāt pṛthak kṛtya |
tathā ca bahvṛcapariśiṣṭe |
annaṃ pāṇitale dattaṃ pūrvam aśnanty abuddhayaḥ |
pitaras tena tṛpyanti śeṣānnaṃ na labhanti te ||
yac ca pāṇitale dattaṃ yac cānyad upakalpitam |
ekībhāvena bhoktavyaṃ pṛthagbhāvo na vidyate ||
āśvalāyanagṛhye |
yadi pāṇiṣv ācānteṣv anyad annam anudiśaty athāgnau hutaśeṣam annaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ dattam arddhukam iti |
iha homānantarapariveṣaṇāc ca pūrvaṃ vidhīyamānam ācamanaṃ svanimittam [1366] ākṣipat tatkāla eva hutabhakṣaṇam āpādayatīti bhramo mā bhūd iti manyamānena harihareṇāsyārtho vyākhyātaḥ | yadā dvijapāṇiṣu juhuyāt tadā homādhikaraṇīkṛtapāṇiṣu dvijeṣv ācānteṣu kṛteṣu kṛtācamaneṣu satsv anyad annaṃ 'anudiśāta' dadāti | ācamanaṃ cātrābhyavahārasaṃyogāt | abhyavahāraś cātra “pāṇyāsyo hi dvijaḥ smṛtaḥ" iti vacanād abhyavahāryasya pāṇitalena saha saṃyogamātraṃ na mukhyaṃ bhakṣaṇam | mukhye hi bhakṣaṇe “yac ca pāṇitale dattam" ityādivacanavirodhaḥ syāt | 'atha' anantaraṃ, agnau hutād annāc cheṣabhūtam annaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadyāt pitryabrāhmaṇapātreṣu nikṣiped ity arthaḥ | yatas tena saṃsṛṣṭaṃ samiśraṃ dīyamānam anyad annaṃ 'arddhukaṃ' ṛddhikṛd bhavati viśeṣeṇa pitṝṇām upakāri bhavatīty arthaḥ | atrāgnāv ity upalakṣaṇārtham, vacanāntarānurodhāt | pāṇyādāv ity api jñeyam |
baudhāyanena tu somāya pitṛmate svadhā nama ityādimantratrayeṇājyāhutitrayaṃ vidhāyājyaśeṣeṇa annābhighāraṇam abhidhāya tenānnenāhutitrayam uktvānnaśeṣabhakṣaṇe kālaprakārau darśitau |
agnaukaraṇaśeṣeṇa yad annam abhighārayet |
tasmiṃs tu prāśite dadyād yad annaṃ prakṛtam bhavet ||
iyaṃ ca śeṣapratipattir baudhāyanoktāgnaukaraṇaviṣayaiveti |
iti hutāvaśiṣṭapratipattiḥ |
ity agnaukaraṇanirṇayaḥ |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasakalakaraṇādhipatipaṇḍita-
śrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau pariśeṣakhaṇḍe śrāddhakalpe
śrāddhadināparahṇakṛtye agnaukaraṇaṃ nāma trayodaśo ’dhyāyaḥ ||
[1367]
caturdaśo ’dhyāyaḥ |
atha pariveṣaṇaṃ |
asya cāgnaukaraṇaśeṣapratipatyuttarakāle kartavyatām āha pracetāḥ |
hutaśeṣaṃ pitṛbhyas tu datvānnaṃ pariveṣayet |
haviṣyaṃ madhumāṃsāni pāyasāpūpam eva ca ||
paiṭhīnasis tv āha |
brāhmaṇān alaṃkṛtya māṃsāpūpadadhimadhughṛtapāyasakṛsaraphalavikārān iti matsyāṃś cāpasādayet |
brāhmaṇān gandhapuṣpādibhir alaṃkṛtya māṃsāpūpādikaṃ 'upasādayet' pariveṣayet |
alaṃkṛtyety anenālaṃkaraṇasya pariveṣaṇāt pūrvakālatvamātram ucyate, na tv avyavahitapūrvakālatvaṃ, ato ’laṃkaraṇānantaram agnaukaraṇaṃ kṛtvāpi kriyamāṇe pariveṣaṇe vacanārthopapatteḥ pūrveṇa mahāvirodhenaitad vyākhyeyam | itiśabdaḥ prakāravacano bhakṣyabhojyaprakārāṇāṃ supaśākādīnāṃ saṃghahārthaḥ | matsyagrahaṇaṃ ca māṃseṣu matsyamāṃsātiśayitapitṛṭṛptikaratvadyotanārtham | pariveṣaṇāt pūrvaṃ ca yajñopavīty eva pātreṇājyam ādāya tūṣṇīm eva devapūrvakaṃ bhojanapātreṣūpastaraṇaṃ kuryāt | teṣāṃ devatoddeśena tyakṣyamāṇahavirādhāratayā sragāditulyatvāt śiṣṭācārāc ca | kecit tūpastaraṇe ’muṃ mantraṃ prayuñjate |
āmāsupakvamairaya āsūryaṃ rohayodivi |
dharmaṃ na sāmantapanatā suvṛktibhir juṣṭaṃ girvaṇase bṛhad || iti |
tataḥ pariveṣaṇasaukayārthaṃ śrāddhadeśaṃ prati pākasaṃbhṛtabhāṇḍāharaṇaṃ karttavyam |
[1368] tatra prakāram āha manuḥ |
pāṇibhyām upasaṃgṛhya svayam annasya vardhitam |
viprāntike pitṝn dhyāyan śanakair upanikṣipet ||
'annasya vardhitaṃ' annapūrṇabhājanaṃ, rasavaty agārāt dvābhyāṃ karābhyā̍ṃ gṛhītvā samānīya prakṛtaśrāddhasaṃbandhinaḥ pitṝn ucchiṣṭasparśaprasaṅgarahite bhojanīyaviprasamīpadeśe sthāpayet | 'śanakaiḥ' yathā bhāṇḍabhedaḥ śabdo vā notpadyate | 'svayam' iti mukhyapakṣatvenoktam | smṛtyantaroktasya patnyādeḥ pariveṣaṇasahāyasya tadupakārake bhājanānayane sutarāṃ saṃbhavāt |
smṛticandrikākāras tu 'annasya vardhitam' annapūrṇapariveṣaṇapātraṃ, pāṇibhyām upasaṃgṛhya tatratyam annaṃ bhojanapātreṣu nikṣiped iti vyākhyātavān | medhātithis tu saha pūrvayā vyākhyayaitad api vyākhyānam anvamanvata | ekena tu pāṇinā samuddhṛtyānayane pariveṣaṇe ca doṣam āha sa eva |
ubhayor hastayor muktaṃ yad annam upanīyate |
tad vipralumpanty asurāḥ sahasā duṣṭacetasaḥ ||
ubhābhyāṃ hastābhyāṃ ‘muktaṃ' aparigṛhītaṃ yad annaṃ, pariveṣaṇārtham upanīyate tat 'sahasā' balena 'duṣṭacetasaḥ' pāpātmānaḥ, 'asurāḥ' devadviṣaḥ, 'lumpanti' luṭhanti | ubhayor ity adhikaraṇasaptamī, muktam ity anāśritam asthitam iti yāvat | evaṃ samānītam annaṃ pariveṣaṇīyam ity āha sa eva |
bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca vidhivat mūlāni ca phalāni ca |
hṛdyāni caiva māṃsāni pānāni surabhīṇi ca ||
upanīya sarvam etacc hanakaiḥ susamāhitaḥ |
pariveṣayet prayato guṇān sarvān pracodayan ||
[1369] 'bhakṣyaṃ' śaskulīmodakādi | 'bhojyaṃ' ghṛtapūrādi | atrānyāny api pariveṣaṇīyāny annāni grāhyānnaprakaraṇe draṣṭavyāni | 'upanīya' viprāntikam ānīya, ‘pariveṣayet' bhojanapātreṣu prakṣipet | mādhuryādīn annaguṇān ‘pracodayan' idaṃ madhuram idam amlam idaṃ kaṣāyam iti vacanenāvedayamānaḥ | atra pitryam api pariveṣaṇaṃ yajñopavīty eva kuryād iti yajñopavītaprakaraṇe pratipāditam |
kālikāpurāṇe |
niyato vāgyataḥ so ’tha karābhyāṃ caiva bhājanam |
viprāgre ca tato nītvā bhakṣāṃś ca pariveṣayet ||
āha yamaḥ |
tato viśadam ānīya bhojayet prayato dvijān |
anaṃ rūpaṃ ghṛtaṃ śākaṃ māṃsaṃ dadhi payo madhu |
sarvam etat samānīya prīṇayet tu yathāsukham ||
sarvam etat samānīya pariveṣaṇapūrvakaṃ pitṝn uddiśya tyakvā yathāsukhaṃ brāhmaṇān saṃbhojya tarpayed ity arthaḥ | etac ca pariveṣaṇaṃ daivapūrvakaṃ kartavyam ity āha śaunakaḥ |
pākaṃ sarvam upānīya saṃvedya ca pṛthak pṛthak |
vidhinā daivapūrvaṃ tu pariveṣaṇam ārabhet ||
'saṃvedya' idaṃ madhuram ityādiprakārakeṇa vākyena brāhmaṇān prati saṃviditaṃ kṛtvā | etac ca daivapūrvakaṃ bhojanārambhāt prācīnapariveṣaṇaviṣayam | tadūrdhvaṃ tu yatheṣṭaṃ yena kenacit krameṇa pariveṣaṇaṃ kāryam |
yad yad roceta viprebhyas tat tad dadyād amatsarī |
iti pariveṣaṇe brāhmaṇecchānusārasya [1370] yamenoktatvāt | etac ca yajamānena bhāryayā śucinā paricārakeṇa vā kartavyam | tatra yajamānena kriyamāṇe pariveṣaṇe phalānantatām āha dharmaḥ |
phalasyānantatā proktā svayaṃ ca pariveṣaṇe |
'svayam' iti yajamānena | atra praśastataratvapratipādanapareṇa phalānantyavacanena bhāryādinā kriyamāṇasya praśastasyānujñā gamyate |
tathā ca bhaviṣyottare |
bhāryayā śrāddhakāle tu praśastaṃ pariveṣaṇam |
vāyupurāṇe ’pi |
pariveṣaṇaṃ praśastaṃ syāt pitṛkarmaṇi bhāryayā |
pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāṃ strī sahāyo yataḥ smṛtā ||
iti hetuvan nigadān mukhyatayā yajamānakartṛka eva pariveṣaṇe bhāryāyāḥ sahakārimātratvaṃ na tu mukhyatvam iti gamyate | praśastavacanād anyasyāpi paricārakasya pariveṣaṇe ’nujñā kriyate | bhāryayāpi svarṇayaiva kartavyaṃ nānyavarṇayā |
tathā ca nārāyaṇaḥ |
yad dravyaṃ yat pavitraṃ ca yat pitryaṃ yat sukhāvaham |
dvijātibhyaḥ savarṇāyānāryāhastena dīyate ||
atra guṇātiśayārthaṃ tilasahitadarbhayuktapāṇinā pariveṣaṇaṃ kāryam iti pādma-mātsyayor uktam |
ubhābhyām atha hastābhyām āhṛtya pariveṣayet |
praśāntacittaḥ satiladarbhapāṇir viśeṣataḥ ||
[1371] etac ca pariveṣaṇaṃ pitrye savyopasṛṣṭena dakṣiṇena kartavyam | āśvalāyanādibhir evaṃvidhasya dakṣiṇasya pitryadravyaprakṣepe sādhanatvena vidhānād ācārāc ca |
evaṃvidhenāpi hastena kevalena na kāryaṃ kiṃ tv ayomayavarjadravyādipariveṣaṇa-pātrāntarhitena tadabhāve parṇādyantarhitenāpīty uktaṃ brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
nāpavitreṇa naikena hastena na vinā kuśam |
nāyasenāyasenaiva śrāddhe tu pariveṣayet ||
'āyasena' kṛṣṇāyasamayena, āyasena vā naiva pariveṣayet | atra pariveṣaṇe pātrāntarhitahastavidhāyakāni kevalahastaniṣedhakāni ca sauvarṇarajatādipātravidhāyakāny āyasaniṣedhakāni ca bahutarāṇi vākyāni pariveṣaṇapātraprakaraṇe draṣṭavyāni |
atra darvyāḥ kasyacid evānnasya pariveṣaṇe vidhiṃ kasyacit tu niṣedham āha kārṣṇājiniḥ |
darvyā deyaṃ śṛtānnaṃ ca samastaṃ vyañjanāni ca |
udakaṃ yac ca pakvānnaṃ yo darvyā dātum icchati |
sa cauraḥ sa ca pāpiṣṭho brahmaghnaṃ taṃ vinirdiśet ||
'śṛtānnaṃ' pāyasaudanādi | 'pakvānaṃ' modakādi | udakādidāne darvīniṣedhāt pātrāntareṇa dānaṃ kartavyaṃ, kevalahastaniṣedhasyāpi darśitatvāt |
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe ’pi |
hastadeyaṃ tu yo darvyā darvyā deyaṃ tu hastataḥ |
[1372] viparītāni yo ’śnīyāt so ’śnīyāt pūyaśoṇitam ||
kārṣṇāyasadarvīniṣedhas tu bhaviṣyottare darśitaḥ |
kārṣṇāyasyā hi yad dattaṃ darvyānnaṃ śrāddhakarmaṇi |
hastenāpi hi yad dattaṃ tad rakṣobhiḥ prayujyate ||
pariveṣaṇaṃ bhūmāv eva sthiteṣu pātreṣu kartavyaṃ, na tu dāruśilādipātrāntarādyuparisthiteṣu ||
tad āha manuḥ |
guṇāṃś ca sūpaśākādyān payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ madhu |
vinyaset prayataḥ samyak bhūmāveva samāhitaḥ ||
'bhūmāv eveti' bhūmāv eva nihiteṣu bhājaneṣv ity arthaḥ | ‘guṇān' guṇaśabdavācyān | kāṃs tān ity apekṣāyāṃ 'sūpaśākādīn' ity uktam | 'sūpaṃ' mudgādisādhitaṃ varānnaśabdābhidheyam odanādinā saha miśrīkṛtya bhojyam annam | 'śākaṃ' pakvaṃ kandamūlaphalapatrādi | caśabdāt “bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca vividham" ityādinā pūrvapradarśitam annaṃ samuccīyate | evaṃ ca sati yāni pāyasaudanāpūpādyādhārabhūtāni mahāpātrāṇi yāni ca mahābhājanopariniveśyatvena prasiddhāni khalu jalakāmbalikaghṛtapayaḥpānakādyādhārabhūtāni laghupātrāṇi teṣūbhayeṣu bhūmāv eva sthiteṣu pariveṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ na punar ādhārāntarasthiteṣv ity uktaṃ bhavati |
ata eva hārītaḥ |
bhūmāv eva nidadhyān nopary uparipātrāṇīti |
'uparipātrāṇi' pātrāntaroparinidheyatvena prasiddhāni pātrāṇi | tāny api bhūmāveva sthāpayen na pātrāntarasya na cādhārāntarasyoparīty arthaḥ | [1373] mānavamaitrāyaṇīyasūtre tu pāyasādipariveṣaṇe mantrā viniyuktāḥ | payaḥ pṛthivyām iti pāyasaṃ dadyāt | madhuvātā ṛtāyate iti madhu | āyur deti ghṛtaṃ dadyāt | atra madhuvātety ayaṃ mantraḥ pūrvaṃ darśitaḥ | avaśiṣṭaṃ tu mantradvayam evaṃ | payaḥ pṛthivyāṃ paya oṣadhīṣu payo divy antarikṣe payodhāḥ payasvatīḥ pradiśaḥ santu mahyam | āyurdā agne haviṣā juṣāṇo ghṛtapratīko ghṛtayonir edhi | ghṛtaṃ pītvā madhu cāru gavyaṃ piteva putram abhirakṣatād imān ||
kaṭhasūtre tu pāyasaudanādyannasyābhimarśanaṃ ghṛtapayaḥprakṣepe ca mantrāntaram uktaṃ | kalpitānnam abhimṛśyaiṣāvormbīmāsu pakvam iti ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ cāsicyeti |
skānde prabhāsakhaṇḍe tu mantrāntarāṇy uktāni |
pāyamaṃ guḍasaṃyuktaṃ haviṣyaṃ guḍapūritam |
namo vaḥ pitaro rasāḥ pariviṣann abhimantrayet ||
tejo ’si śukram ity ājyaṃ dadhikrāvneti vai dadhi |
kṣīram āpyāyamantreṇa vyañjanāni ca yāni tu ||
bhakṣyabhojyāni sarvāṇi mahān indreṇa dāpayet |
saṃvatsaro ’si mantraṃ tu japtvā tenodakaṃ dvijaḥ ||
dāpayed iti sarvatra saṃbadhyate |
atra yāni yāvanti yāvad guṇotkarṣaśīlāny annāny ekasya pātre pariviṣṭāni 'tāni' tāvanti tāvad guṇotkarṣaśīlāny evānyasyāpi pātre pariveṣyāṇi, na tu vaiparītyenety āha hārītaḥ |
paṅktyāṃ caivopaviṣṭebhyaḥ samaṃ gandhādibhojanam |
na paṅktyāṃ viṣamaṃ dadyān na yācen na ca dāpayet ||
[1374] vaiṣamyeṇa tu dāne doṣam āha yamaḥ |
ekapaṅktyupaviṣṭānāṃ viṣamaṃ yaḥ prayacchati |
duṣkṛtaṃ harate paṅktyā dātā gṛhṇāti yaś ca tat ||
kunadīsetukārasya kanyāvighnakarasya ca |
paṅktyāṃ viṣamadātuś ca niṣkṛtir nopapadyate ||
yama-vyāsāv apy āhatuḥ |
yas tv ekapaṅktyāṃ viṣamaṃ dadāti
snehād bhayād vā yadi vārthahetoḥ |
pūrvapraṇītāṃ śrutibhiś ca gītāṃ
tāṃ brahmahatyām ṛṣayo vadanti ||
atra yad yad annaṃ brāhmaṇapātre pariveṣyate tat tat kāla eva piṇḍapātre ’pi pariveṣaṇīyam ity atra liṅgadarśanaṃ brahmapurāṇe |
tato ’nnaṃ surasaṃ svādu dadau pāyasapūrvakam |
pratyagram ekadā svinnam aparyuṣitam uttamam ||
alpaśākaṃ bahuphalaṃ ṣaḍrasaṃ tv amṛtopamam |
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca pradadau piṇḍapātre tathaiva ca ||
iti pariveṣaṇam |
atha pātrālambhajapāṅguṣṭhaniveśanāni |
tatrāha kātyāyanaḥ |
hutaśeṣaṃ datvā pātram ālabhya japati pṛthivī te pātraṃ dyaur apidhānaṃ brāhmaṇasya mukhe 'mṛtaṃ juhomi svāheti vaiṣṇavyarcā yajuṣā vāṅguṣṭham anne 'vagāhyāpahatā iti tilān prakīryoṣṇaṃ svinnam annaṃ dadyāditi |
[1375]
pṛthivī te pātram ityādisvāhāntam uccāryānantaram idaṃ viṣṇur vicakrame tredhā nidadhe padaṃ sanūḍham asya pāṃsure ity etāṃ vaiṣṇavīm ṛcaṃ japtvānantaraṃ viṣṇā havyaṃ rakṣasveti yajuś coccārya pitryapātranihite 'gnaukaraṇaśeṣe ’nne ’ṅguṣṭam avagāhya niveśyāpahatā ityādi kṛtvānnaṃ dadyāt pariveṣayed ity arthaḥ |
nigame tv aṅguṣṭhāvagāhanānantaraṃ pariveṣaṇam uktvā pātrālambhajapau pāṭhāntaraṃ ca mantre darśitam |
śeṣam annaṃ hastena hasteṣu piṇḍavat pradāyāṅguṣṭham anne ’vagāhya soṣṇam annnaṃ bahu ca dadyād abhimṛṣya pātraṃ japati | pṛthivī te pātraṃ dyaur apidhānaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tvā prāṇāpānayor madhye ’mṛte ’mṛtaṃ juhomi svāheti |
maitrāyaṇīyasūtre tv agnaukaraṇaśeṣa evāṅguṣṭhāvagāhanam uktvā pātrālambhe mantrāntaram uktam |
avaśiṣṭe ’nne brāhmaṇāṅguṣṭham upayamya dyauḥ pātraṃ svadhāpidhānaṃ brāhmaṇas tvā pitṛmukhe ’mṛtaṃ juhomi svadheti |
'avaśiṣṭe' agnaukaraṇahomāvaśiṣṭe, pitṛpātrapradatte 'nne |
baudhāyanasūtre tu niveśanīyasyāṅguṣṭhasya nakhaśūnyatvarūpo viśeṣaḥ pitrādisyānavibhāgena mantrāntarāṇi coktāni |
athetarad brāhmaṇebhyo nivedya brāhmaṇasya aṅguṣṭhenānakhenānudiśati pṛthivīsamantasya te ’gnirūpadṛṣṭarcas te mahimā dattasyāpramādāya pṛthivī te pātraṃ dyaur apidhaṃ brāhmaṇasya mukhe ’mṛtaṃ juhomi brāhmaṇānāṃ tvā vidyāvatāṃ prāṇāpānayor juhomi akṣatam asi mā pitṝṇāṃ śreṣṭhā amutrāmuṣmiṃl loke iti | dvitīyam anudiśati antarikṣasamantasya te vāyurūpaśrotā yajūṃṣi te mahimā dattatsyāpramādāya pṛthivī te pātraṃ [1376] dyaur apidhānaṃ brāhmaṇasya mukhe ’mṛtaṃ juhomi brāhmaṇānāṃ tvā vidyāvatāṃ prāṇāpānayor juhomy akṣatam asi mā pitāmahānāṃ śreṣṭhā amutrām amusmin loke | tṛtīyam anudiśati dyusamantasya te ādityo 'nukhyātā sāmāni te mahimā dattasyā pramādāya pṛthivī te pātraṃ dyaur apidhānaṃ brāhmaṇasya mukhe ’mṛtaṃ juhomi brāhmaṇānāṃ tvā vidyāvatāṃ prāṇāpānayor juhomy akṣatam asi prapitāmahānāṃ śreṣṭhā amutrāmasmin loka iti |
'itarat' agnaukaraṇāvaśiṣṭam annaṃ, 'brāhmaṇebhyo nivedya' pitryaviprapātreṣu prakṣipya | tad evam etena vacanasaṃdarbheṇa pariveṣaṇāt pūrvam eva pātrālambhanajapau agnaukaraṇaśeṣe cāṅguṣṭhāvagāhanam uktam |
pracetasā tu pātrālambhajapāṅguṣṭhāvagāhanāni pariveṣaṇāt paścād evoktāni |
sarvaṃ ca prakṛtaṃ datvā pātram ālabhya saṃjapet |
'prakṛtaṃ' prastutaśrāddhārthatayā saṃpāditaṃ bhakṣyabhojyādikaṃ sarvaṃ, 'datvā' pariveṣya, japet | pṛthivī te pātram ityādīti śeṣaḥ |
nāgarakhaṇḍe ’pi |
dṛṣṭam annaṃ tateā datvā pātram ālabhya saṃjapet |
'tataḥ' ity agnaukaraṇaśeṣapratipattyuttarakālam | 'dṛṣṭaṃ' pitṝṇāṃ dvijānāṃ ca apekṣitam |
atra japyaṃ pratīkenāha yājñavalkyaḥ |
datvānnaṃ pṛthivīpātram iti pātrābhimantraṇam |
kṛtvedaṃ viṣṇur ity anne dijāṅguṣṭhaṃ niveśayet ||
paiṭhīnasis tu samagraṃ mantram āha | [1377]
pṛthivī te pātraṃ dyaur apidhānaṃ brāhmaṇasya mukhe ’mṛtaṃ juhomi svadhā, idaṃ viṣṇur vicakrama ity anenāṅguṣṭham anne codake cāvadhāya |
atra kecid anne niveśitasyāṅguṣṭasya prakṣālanārthaṃ udake avadhānam iti vyācakṣate | anye tu bhojanārthaṃ pūrvam eva pariviṣṭe ’nna iva pānārthaṃ pūrvam evopanītam udake ’vadhānam ity āhuḥ | tad etan matadayam api dṛśyate | mānavamaitrāyaṇīyasūtre tu,
idaṃ viṣṇur ity anayarcāṅguṣṭhasya grahaṇaṃ, viṣṇur vicakrama iti brāhmaṇānām aṅguṣṭham ādāya viṣṇo havyaṃ rakṣasveti vaiśvadevike, viṣṇo kavyaṃ rakṣasveti pitrye niveśyodakaṃ pāṇau pradāyeti |
yamas tv āha |
viṣṇo havyaṃ ca kavyaṃ ca brūyāt rakṣeti ca kramāt |
vāriṣv agrapradatteṣu tam aṅguṣṭhaṃ niveśayet ||
viṣṇo havyaṃ rakṣasveti daive brūyāt, viṣṇo kavyaṃ rakṣasveti pitrye brūyād ity arthaḥ | 'tam' iti pūrvamantre niveśitam | 'agrapradatteṣu' brāhmaṇāgre sthāpiteṣu annavat pūrvam eva pariviṣṭeṣu vā |
ata eva brahmapurāṇe |
atha datvā samagraṃ tu jalāntaṃ bhojanaṃ kramāt |
viśvebhyas tv atha devebhyaḥ kuryāc ca pratipādanam ||
dvijāṅguṣṭhaṃ gṛhītvā tu paṭhen mantraṃ ca vāgyataḥ |
pṛthivī te pātram ity annam amṛtaṃ cintayet paṭhan ||
viṣṇo havyam idaṃ rakṣa madīyam iti kīrtayet |
punas tenaiva mantreṇa pitṛbhyaś ca nivedayet |
ekaikasyātha viprasya gṛhītvāṅguṣṭham ādarāt || iti |
[1378] 'bhojanam' iti bhojyaṃ bhakṣabhojyalehyacoṣyapeyādikaṃ, 'datvā' pariveśya, ‘pratipādanaṃ’ tyāgaḥ | dvijāṅguṣṭhaṃ gṛhītvetyādinā tyāgapūrvam anuṣṭheyā tad itikartavyatoktā |
śaṅkha-likhitābhyāṃ tv aṅguṣṭhaniveśane jānupātanaṃ pitṛdhyānaṃ coktam |
aṅguṣṭham upayamyedaṃ viṣṇur iti jānu niṣadya bhūmau pitṝn
dhyāyan manaseti |
etac ca pitrye daive viśvān devān dhyāyann iti veditavyam | jānunas tu niṣadanaṃ daive dakṣiṇasya, pitrye vāmasyeti vibhāgena pratyetavyam | etac ca sarveṣāṃ daivapitryadharmāṇām upalakṣaṇārtham |
kālikāpurāṇe ’nnamadhye 'ṅguṣṭhasya bhrāmaṇam uktam |
dhṛtvāṅguṣṭhaṃ dvijānāṃ tu āvartyājyamadhuplute |
pṛthivī ta iti mantreṇa havyakavye ca rakṣayet ||
'pṛthivī te' ity anena pṛthivī te pātram ityādi idaṃ viṣṇur ityādi viṣṇo havyam ityādyantam upalakṣitam | etac ca sarvaṃ japtvā dvijānām aṅguṣṭhaṃ pariviṣṭe ghṛtamadhuplute ’nne ‘āvartya' paribhrāmya' tadannaṃ tenāṅguṣṭhena rākṣasādibhyo rakṣayet |
viṣṇur hy aṅguṣṭharūpeṇa tasya cānnasya rakṣitā |
tad āha yamaḥ |
aṅguṣṭhamātro bhagavān viṣṇuḥ paryaṭate mahīm |
rākṣasānāṃ vadhārthāya kome ’dya prahariṣyati ||
tasmāt śrāddheṣu sarveṣu aṅguṣṭhaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ smṛtam |
niraṅguṣṭhaṃ tu yat śrāddhaṃ bahirjānu tu yad dhṛtam |
tat sarvama surair bhuktaṃ sarvam evāsuraṃ bhavet ||
[1379] hārīto ’pi |
niraṅguṣṭhaṃ tu yat śrāddhaṃ na ta tprīṇāti vai pitṝn |
tasmād aṅguṣṭham ākramya japen mantraṃ samāhitaḥ ||
idaṃ viṣṇur vicakrama iti |
yathānnaṃ nihitaṃ pātre pihitaṃ tad varṣīyasā |
akṣataṃ sthānam āyāti tadvad aṅguṣṭhasaṃskṛtam ||
aṅguṣṭhagrahaṇe mantrāntaraṃ tadbhrāmaṇe viśeṣaś coktaḥ pippalādasūtre |
aṅguṣṭham upayaman pātre pradakṣiṇaṃ daive ’pasavyaṃ pitre ato devā avantu no yato viṣṇur iti japej jānunī vibhajya bhūmāv iti |
'apasavyaṃ’ apradakṣiṇam |
ato devā avantu no yato viṣṇur vicakrame pṛthivyāḥ saptadhāmabhiḥ |
ity ayaṃ mantraḥ atra pratīkenopadiṣṭo grāhyaḥ | ayam api pūrvoktavaiṣṇavayajuḥśiraska eva prayojyaḥ | 'jānunī bhūmau vibhajya' ity atra dakṣiṇaṃ jānu daive, savyaṃ tu pitrya iti vibhāgo ’nusaṃdheyaḥ, na tu jānudvayam apy ekaikatreti |
kauśikasūtre |
aṅguṣṭham upayamya pradakṣiṇaṃ daive apasavyaṃ pitṛbhya idaṃ viṣṇur iti japej jānu niṣadya bhūmāv iti |
aṅguṣṭhagrahaṇe viśeṣāntaraṃ dhaumyenoktam |
parivṛtya dvijāṅguṣṭhaṃ dvijasyānne niveśayet |
rākṣasaṃ tad bhaved eva pitṝṇāṃ nopatiṣṭhate ||
svabhāvasthiter anyathākaraṇaṃ (?) 'parivartanam' | ato dvijahastaṃ 'parivṛtya' uttānīkṛtya, aṅguṣṭhaṃ na niveśayet ity uktaṃ bhavati | yajamānenāpi [1380] svakīyenottānena kareṇāṅguṣṭhagrahaṇaṃ na kāryaṃ tathākaraṇe hi tenaiva doṣasyoktatvāt |
uttānena tu hastena dvijāṅguṣṭhaniveśanam |
yaḥ karoti dvijaḥ mohāt tad vai rakṣāṃsi gacchati ||
iti pātrālambhajapāṅguṣṭhaniveśanāni |
athānnasaṃkalpaḥ |
tatra pitrādyuddeśenānnasaṃkalpaṃ kariṣyan gotrasaṃbandhanāmaviśiṣṭān vasvādirūpayuktān pitṝn devatātvena, annaṃ haviḥśabdena, brāhmaṇān āhavanīyārthatvena, śrāddhabhūmiṃ gayātvena, bhoktṝn gadādharatvena, (?) annapātraṃ rājatatvenānucintyānucintanadārḍhyārthaṃ tathānukīrtayet |
prabhāsakhaṇḍe |
dvijapātreṣu datvānnaṃ kṛtsnaṃ saṃkalpam ācaret |
darvyādisthena no teṣāṃ saṃbandho dṛśyate yataḥ ||
prakṛtaśrāddhasiddhyarthaṃ saṃpāditebhyo nānājātīyānnasamudāyebhyaḥ sarvebhyo 'py ekaikadvijatṛptiparyāptasamudāyāntaraniṣpādanasamarthatayā saṃbhāvitaparimāṇān ekadeśān uddhṛtya dvijānāṃ purataḥ sthāpiteṣu bhojanapātreṣu pariveṣya saṃkalpya pitrādyuddeśena tyāgaṃ kuryāt | yato darvīsthālyādisthitimātreṇa teṣāṃ pitrādīnāṃ tenānnena saha saṃbandho notpadyate kiṃ tu saṃkalpenaiveti saṃkalpaṃ kuryād ity arthaḥ | kṛtsnam annaṃ pātre datvā saṃkalpaṃ kuryād ity ukte ’pi pātrasaṃkoce sati parasparasaṃkareṇa svādutopaghātakāni yāni cānyonyaprāptapariveṣaṇakālāni ca yāni vismṛtya [1382] pūrvaṃ na pariviṣṭāni pariviṣṭāny api punar dvijāpekṣitatve nāvagatāni tāni bhuñjāneṣv api dvijeṣu pariveṣaṇīyāny eva | prasiddhabhojanaprakārānugrahasya śrāddhe ’pi saṃmatatvāt |
atra kecid āhuḥ |
śucinā śucaye deyaṃ saṃpradeyaṃ ca yac chuci |
saṃpradānasya duṣṭatvād ata evaṃ na yujyate ||
iti saṃpradānasyocchiṣṭakṛtenāśucitvena duṣṭatvāt bhuñjāneṣu dānaṃ na yujyata ity arthaḥ | kiṃ ca saṃkalpottarakāle dīyamānaṃ pitṝn na saṃbadhyata ity anarthakam eva syād iti |
atredam ucyate | bhaved eṣa doṣas tasya yaḥ pariviṣṭamātrasya saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt | na tu yaḥ parivekṣyamāṇasyāpi saṃpradānatvaśucitvakāla eva saṃkalpaṃ karoti tasyāpi | ata eva pariviṣṭaṃ parivekṣyamāṇaṃ ceti sarve’pi śiṣṭāḥ saṃkalpavākyaṃ prayuñjate | saṃkalpe ca kartṛnirṇayas trikāṇḍamaṇḍanena kṛtaḥ |
tyāgaṃ tu sarvathā kuryāt tatrāpy anyataras tayoḥ |
ubhāv apy asamarthau cet niyuktaḥ kaścana tyajet || iti |
'tayoḥ' daṃpatyor madhye, anyataraḥ | tyāgaś cāyaṃ dvijapāṇiṣv apośānajalam adatyaiva kāryaḥ | tasyānyathākaraṇe doṣam āha atriḥ |
apośānakare vipre saṃkalpaṃ yaḥ samācaret
tad annam asurair bhuktaṃ pitṝṇāṃ nopatiṣṭhate || iti |
atrānnasaṃkalpasya vaiśvadevikapūrvakatvaṃ prayogavākyaikadeśaś ca viṣṇunā pratipāditaḥ |
[1382]
namo viśvebhyo devebhya ity annam ādau prāṅmukhayor nivedayet pitre pitāmahāya prapitāmahāya ca nāmagotrābhyām udaṅmukheṣu |
namo viśvebhyo devebhya ity anena śabdena nivedanavākyaikadeśa evāyaṃ nivedanīyanirdeśarahitatvāt | 'prāṅmukhayor' iti vaiśvadevikadvijayoḥ | anayoś cāpasavyenāhavanīyasthānīyatayopadeśāt | tyajyamānahaviradhikaraṇabhūtatvena saptamyāḥ prayogaḥ | 'śrādāv' iti pitryaviprāpekṣayā, anena pitryavipreṣu paścād iti labhyate | tatrāpi pitre pitāmahāyetyādinārthāt prayogavākyaikadeśo darśitaḥ | etac cānnanivedanaṃ karagṛhītatilasahitodakaprakṣepeṇa kāryam | tathā pitṛvipreṣu svadhāśabdāntena vākyena |
tathā ca viṣṇudharmottare |
oṃ namo viśvebhya iti ca satilenodakena ca |
prāṅmukheṣu ca yad dattaṃ tad annam upamantrayet ||
udaṅmukheṣu yad dattaṃ nāmagotraprakīrtanaiḥ |
mantrayet prayataḥ prājñaḥ svadhāntaiḥ susamāhitaḥ ||
yad annaṃ yat pariviṣṭaṃ tan namo viśvebhya ityādinā tyāgavākyātmakena 'mantrayet’ prakāśayet | pitryeṣu tu yat pariviṣṭaṃ tat tyāgavākyāvayavabhūtaiḥ svadhāśabdāntair nāmagotraprakīrtanair mantrayet |
iha vaiśvadevike ’nnanivedanavākyasya svāhāntatāṃ, pitrye ca svadhāntatāṃ, nivedanīyanirdeśakaṃ śabdaṃ ca, nivedanakāle pātrālambhanaṃ cāha atriḥ |
hastenāmuktam annādyam idam annam udīrayet |
svāheti ca tataḥ kuryāt svasattāvinivartanam ||
tathā |
[1383] gotrasaṃbandhanāmāni idam annaṃ tataḥ svadhā |
pitṛkramād udīryeti svasattāṃ vinivartayet ||
'svasattāṃ' svattvasya sadbhāvaṃ, 'vinivartayet' manaḥkaraṇakasvatvatyāgavācakaṃ nameti prayuñjītety arthaḥ | 'amuktam' iti spṛśyamānaṃ, hastenety atra savyeneti veditavyam | dakṣiṇasya tyāgārthodakadhāraṇe vyāpriyamāṇatvāt | 'annādyam' ity annādyadhāraṇārthaṃ pātraṃ na tu sākṣād annam | ata eva caturviṃśatimate,
pātrālambhaṃ dvijaḥ kuryād idaṃ vo ’nnam itīrayan | iti |
atra daive pātrālambhe tyāgajalaprakṣepe ca devatīrthasaṃbandhas tyāgavākye ca oṃkārayogaḥ svadhāśabdānte namaḥśabdo 'py ukto brahmapurāṇe |
tato madhughṛtāktaṃ tu soṣṇam annaṃ tilānvitam |
gṛhītvā devatīrthena praṇavenaiva tat punaḥ |
etad vo ’nnam iti hy uktvā viśvān devāṃś ca saṃjapet ||
pariviṣṭam annaṃ madhughṛtatilānvitaṃ kṛtvā pātrālambhadvāreṇa savyakarasya devatīrthena gṛhītvā praṇavapūrvakaṃ viśvān devān anukīrtya etad vo 'nnam ity annanirdeśaṃ kṛtvā viśvān devān saṃjapet | etad vo ’nnam ity etad idam annam ity anena saha tulyārthatvād vikalpyate | etad va iti nirdeśād āmantraṇavibhaktyā devatānirdeśo ’tra vivakṣitaḥ |
ata evāsminn eva purāṇe pitryānnatyāgavākye spaṣṭam evaitad vibhaktiprayogaḥ pratipāditaḥ |
pitṛbhyaś ca tato dadyād annam āmantranena tu |
amukāmukagotraitat tubhyam annaṃ svadhā namaḥ || iti |
[1384] na cānnadāne caturthī syād ity anena virodho ’sya śaṅkanīyaḥ, āmantrya tubhyam ity abhidhānāt | amukāmukagotrety asyāpi pitre pitāmahāyetyādinā saha tulyārthatvād vikalpa eva |
sāṅkhyāyanagṛhye |
annaṃ cāsāv etat ta ity anudiśya bhojayet |
kaṭhasūtre |
pṛthivī te pātram iti saṃkalpaṃ kṛtvāmuṣmai svadhā namo ’muṣmai svadhā nama iti yathāliṅgam anumantrya bhojayet |
ity annasaṃkalpaḥ |
śratha pātrālambhādiprayogaḥ |
tatra daivadharmayuktaḥ kartā pūrvaṃ prathamopaveśitavaiśvadevikadvijapātrasthitam annaṃ sapraṇavavyāhṛtipūrvikayā sāvitryā prokṣyottānābhyāṃ karābhyāṃ pātram ālabhamānaḥ pṛthivī te pātram ityādikaṃ svāhāntaṃ mantram uktvā ato devā avantu na ity etām idaṃ viṣṇur vicakrama ity etāṃ vā ṛcam uccāryānuttānena dakṣiṇakareṇānuttānam eva dvijāṅguṣṭhaṃ gṛhītvā viṣṇo havyaṃ rakṣasvety anena vaiśvadevena yajuṣānne niveśayet | tato yavakuśānvitam udakaṃ gṛhītvā vāmena kareṇa pātraṃ spṛśan pururava-ādravaḥsaṃjñakā viśvedevā devatā idam annaṃ havyaṃ brāhmaṇas tvāhavanīyārthe gayeyambhūḥ (?) śaṅkhacakragadādharo bhoktā sauvarṇapātram ity abhidhāya pururava-ādravaḥsaṃjñakebhyo viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ sopaskaraṃ pariviṣṭaṃ parivekṣyamāṇaṃ ca brāhmaṇatṛptiparyāptam idam annaṃ svāhā namo nama oṃ tat sad iti tad udakaṃ devatīrthena bhūmau nikṣipet | anantaraṃ krameṇa dvitīyādiṣu vaiśvadevikadvijeṣu evam [1385] eva pātrālambhādikam annatyāgāntaṃ kuryāt | tadanantaraṃ pitradharmayuktaḥ kartā svāhāśabdasthāne svadhāśabdaṃ havyaśabdasthāne kavyaśabdaṃ ca prajujya prathamopaviṣṭapitradvijapātre pūrvavad aṅguṣṭhaniveśanāntaṃ kṛtvā dviguṇabhagnakuśatrayasahitaṃ satilaṃ jalaṃ dakṣiṇakare gṛhītvā savyakareṇa pātram ālabhamānaḥ amukagotrāsmatpitaro ’mukaśarmāṇaḥ sapatnīkā vasurūpā devatā ity abhidhāya gadādharo bhoktā ityantaṃ pūrvavad anukīrtya rājataṃ pātram iti coktvā gotrebhyo ’mukaśarmabhyaḥ sapatnīkebhyo vasurūpebhya ity abhidhāya sopaskaraṃ pariviṣṭaṃ parivekṣyamāṇaṃ ca brāhmaṇatṛptiparyāptam idam annaṃ svadhā namo nama oṃ tat sad ity uccārya tad udakaṃ pitṛtīrthena bhūmau nikṣipet | evaṃ krameṇa paitṛkadvijeṣu tyāgaṃ kṛtvā pitāmahanāmnā rudrarūpānukīrtanena ca paitāmahadvijeṣu prapitāmahanāmnā ādityarūpānukīrtanena ca prapitāmaheṣu dvijeṣv api kṛtvā svīyasvīyanāmnā vasvādirūpānukīrtanena ca mātāmahadvijeṣu kuryād iti |
iti pātrālambhādiprayogaḥ |
atha sāvitrījapādi |
tatra pāraskaraḥ |
saṃkalpya pitṛdevebhyaḥ sāvitrīmadhumajjapaḥ
śrāddhaṃ nivedyāpośānaṃ juṣapraiṣo ’tha bhojanam ||
devebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaś cānnaṃ 'saṃkalpya' yathoktavidhinā tyaktvā, 'sāvitrīṃ' savitṛdaivatyāṃ gāyatrīṃ, madhumatīṃ ca japtvā śrāddhaṃ ca nivedya darśayiṣyamāṇena prakāreṇa śrāddhasyācchidravācanaṃ kṛtvāpośānajalaṃ ca dvijakare datvā juṣadhvam iti praiṣeṇa
bhojayet |
[1386] anasya madhusaṃparkakaraṇe madhumatībhir anumantraṇe ca liṅgadarśanaṃ brahmapurāṇa
tilapūtaṃ pitṛṣv annam ājyapūtaṃ madhūkṣitam |
mantritaṃ pṛthivīty evaṃ madhuvātety ṛcaṃ jagau ||
jagau varāhaḥ |
etat madhusecanādikam acchidravācanaprakāraṃ cāha yamaḥ |
annaṃ madhumayaṃ kṛtvā madhuvāteti mantritam |
annahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ mantrahīnaṃ ca yad bhavet |
sarvam acchidram ity uktvā tato yatnena bhojayet ||
acchidram ity asyānantaraṃ jāyatām iti prayoktavyam, baudhāyanenāccidraṃ jāyatām iti prayogasya darśitatvāt | atra jāyatāṃ sarvam acchidram iti viprair vaktavyam | abhyarthanasyaitad vākyapravṛtyarthatvāt | etac cāpośānadānāt pūrvam eva kartavyam, paścātkaraṇe hi pracetasā doṣasyoktatvāt |
āpośānakarāgrāṇām acchidrasya tu bhāṣaṇāt |
nirāśāḥ pitaro yānti devaiḥ saha na saṃśayaḥ ||
atra yājñavalkyaḥ sāvitrījapasya vyāhṛtipūrvakatvam āha |
savyāhṛtikāṃ gāyatrīṃ madhuvātā iti tryṛcam |
japtā yathāsukhaṃ vācyaṃ bhuñjīraṃs te ’pi vāgyatāḥ ||
yathāsukhaṃ juṣadhvam iti vācyam ity arthaḥ |
mānava-maitrāyaṇīyasūtre tu praṇavapūrvakatvaṃ vyāhṛtisvarūpaṃ gāyatryās trir abhyāsa ityādayo viśeṣāḥ pradarśitāḥ | oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svas tat savitur iti trir uktvā madhuvātā ṛtāyata iti tryṛcaṃ madhv iti trir uktvā prīyantāṃ [1387] pitaraḥ pitāmahāḥ prapitāmahā vāgyataḥ sann iṣṭatamāny annāni dadyāt |
pracetās tv apośānadānānantaraṃ sāvitrījapam āha |
apośānaṃ pradāyātha sāvitrīṃ trir japed atha |
madhuvātā iti tryṛcaṃ madhv ity etat trikaṃ tathā ||
kātyāyano ’py apośānadānānantaram eva triḥ sakṛd vā gāyatrījapam āha |
apośānaṃ pradāyātha japed vyāhṛtipūrvikām |
gāyatrīṃ triḥ sakṛd veti |
ataś ca gāyatrījapādikaṃ svagṛhyasūtrādyanusāreṇāpośānadānāt pūrvaṃ paścād vā kartavyam |
brahmapurāṇe tv apośānadānāt pūrvaṃ tilādivikiraṇam apy uktam |
tilayuktaṃ ca pānīyaṃ sakuśaṃ teṣu cāgrataḥ |
vikiret pitṛbhyas tebhyo japann apahatā iti |
tebhyo dadyād apośānaṃ bhavantaḥ prāśayantv iti ||
apośāne ca kriyamāṇe bhuvi baliprakṣepo na kāryaḥ |
tathā ca bharadvājaḥ |
pitṝṇām annam ādāya baliṃ yas tu prayacchati |
steyena brāhmaṇas tena sa sarvasteyakṛd bhavet ||
'pitṝṇām annaṃ' daivapitrartham upakalpitam annam | atas tyāgāt pūrvam api citraguptādibhyo balir na deyaḥ |
ata eva atriḥ |
datte vāpy atha vādatte bhūmau yo nikṣiped balim |
bhojanāt kiṃcid annāgraṃ dharmarājāya vai balim |
[1388] datvātha citraguptāya vipraś cauryam avāpnuyāt ||
atra bhojanapraiṣe viśeṣo vārāha-viṣṇupurāṇayoḥ |
tānnaṃ mṛṣṭam atyartham abhīṣṭam atisaṃskṛtam |
datvā juṣadhvam icchāto vācyam etad aniṣṭhuram ||
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe tu |
bhājanālambhanaṃ kṛtvā datvā cānnaṃ yathāvidhi |
yathāsukhaṃ juṣadhvaṃ bhor iti vācyam aniṣṭhuram ||
atra ca
yajñaśvarohavyasamastakavyabhoktāvyayātmā harir īśvaro’ tra |
tatsaṃnidhānād apayāntu sadyo rakṣāṃsy aśeṣāṇy asurāś ca sarve"\ ||
ity uccārya “pitṛsvarūpī bhagavān yajñapuruṣaḥ prīyatāṃ” iti cābhidhāya kuśatilayukaṃ jalaṃ dakṣiṇakareṇa brāhmaṇasamīpe bhūmāv āsicya dvijān namaḥkuryād iti śiṣṭācārād avagantavyam | āha vyāsaḥ |
juṣadhvam iti te coktāḥ samyag vidhṛtabhājanāḥ |
kṛtamaunāḥ samaśnīyur apośānād anantaram ||
atrāniṣiddhanityabhojanavidhiprāptaṃ prāṇāhutigrahaṇam api kartavyam eva | atha yajamānaḥ “pitāpitāmahaś cetyādīnāṃ japaprakaraṇe pradarśitānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ japaṃ kuryāt |
āha kātyāyanaḥ |
aśnatsu japet vyāhṛtipūrvāṃ gāyatrīṃ sapraṇavāṃ sakṛt trir vā rakṣoghnān pitṛmantrān puruṣasūktam apratiratham anyāni ca pavitrāṇi || iti |
etac ca japaprakaraṇa eva vyākhyātaprāyam |
[1389] vārāha-viṣṇupurāṇayoḥ |
rakṣoghnamantrāṃś ca japet bhūmer āstaraṇaṃ tilaiḥ |
kṛtvā dhyeyāḥ svapitaras ta eva dvijasattamāḥ ||
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
akruddhaś ca naro dadyāt saṃstavena pralobhayan |
rakṣoghnāṃś ca japen mantrān tilaiś ca vikiren mahīm ||
atha yajamāno brāhmaṇān bhojayet bhakṣabhojyādīni nāprayacchan na prekṣeta | muhur muhuḥ prayacchan yācitaṃ prayacchan nāprayacchan vividhānnaguṇakīrtanena prarocayan dadāmīty avadat śanair udīrya kiṃcit kiṃcid darśayan havirguṇān pṛcchan antarāntarāsvādu śiśirasvacchaṃ payaḥ pāyayan bhuñjānān avalokayan śraddadhānaḥ pitṝn dhyāyan kāmakrodhalobhamohadambhāhaṃkāramatsaraparuṣabhāṣaṇadainyāśrupātādīn akurvan ananyamanāḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ bhojayed ity evamādayo bhojayitṛniyamās tatprakaraṇoktā anusaṃdheyāḥ | bhuñjānaiś ca brāhmaṇair maunibhir itas tato ’navalokayadbhir bhojanavyāpāravyatiriktam indriyacāpalyam akurvadbhiḥ krodhahāsatrāsavismayavidhuraiḥ pādena pādapādukāsanādy anākramadbhiḥ akṛtajānunipātanaiḥ parasparam aspṛśadbhiḥ pramādāt sparśe bhojanam atyajadbhir hastasaṃketenāpi havirguṇān akathayadbhiḥ pānīyapātrādivyatirekeṇa bhūtalāt pātram anuddharadbhir avimuktabhājanaiḥ abahiḥkakṣair abahirjānukarair avahiṣkṛtāṅguṣṭhatarjanīgrāsagrāhibhir akṛtaphūtkṛtādiśabdair apītāvaśiṣṭapāyibhir asvāditārdhaśiṣṭakhādibhir mukhādigalitadantacchinnāvaśeṣaṃ ca pātre ’nnam asthāpayadbhir [1390] mukhamārutenoṣṇam akurvadbhir aniṣṭhīvadbhir vāmahastenānna- śiraścaraṇavastīn pādena bhojanabhājanaṃ cāspṛśadbhir anatimātrabhojibhir dadhimadhudugdhasaktusarpirvarjam asarvāśibhir bhoktavyam ity evamādayo bhoktṛniyamās tatprakaraṇoktā veditavyāḥ |
iti sāvitrījapādi |
atha vikirādi |
tatra tāvat kramavidhī |
āha dharmaḥ |
keṣāṃcid vikiraḥ pūrvaṃ tṛptipraśnas tathāparaḥ |
praśnapūrvam athānyeṣāṃ vikiras tadanantaram ||
amṛtāpidhānāt pūrvaṃ ca keṣāṃcid vikiro mataḥ |
anyeṣāṃ tu tataḥ paścād viduṣām iti saṃmatam |
gāyatryādijapāt pūrvaṃ keṣāṃcit tadanantaram ||
amṛtāpidhānāt tṛptyādipraśnāt gāyatryādijapāt pūrvaṃ vikira ity etaṃ pakṣam āśrityāha kātyāyanaḥ |
tṛptān jñātvānnaṃ prakīrya sakṛt sakṛd apo datvā pūrvaṃ gāyatrīṃ japtvā madhumatīr madhu madhv iti ca tṛptāḥ stheti pṛcchati tṛptāḥ smety anujñātaḥ śeṣam annam anajñāpyeti tṛptān brāhmaṇān anumānena vijñāya prakṛtasarvajātīyam annam ekasmin pātre gṛhītvā vakṣyamāṇasaṃskārayuktāyāṃ bhuvi prakīrya viralaṃ prakṣipya pātramaunābhayavimocanārthaṃ amṛtāpidhānam asīty etanmantreṇa prāśya sakṛt sakṛd apaḥ pradāya triḥ sakṛd vā gāyatrīṃ madhuvātetyādiṛktrayaṃ ca japtvā madhuśabdaṃ ca trir uktvā tṛptāḥ stheti viprān yajamānaḥ pṛcchet |
[1391] atra tṛptisaṃvedanasya dṛṣṭaprayojanānupalambhāt sarvatra praśneṣu paṅktimūrdhanya eva praṣṭavyaḥ na punaḥ sarva eva praṣṭavyā ityevaṃvidhiniyamaḥ | na cātṛptatvena vijñātebhyaḥ punar annaṃ dīyata iti tṛptisaṃvedanasya prayojanaṃ vācyam | tṛptān jñātvaiva pātravimocanārthaṃ gaṇḍūṣasya dattatvāt | vikalpe caikasminn api bahuvacanaṃ pūjārtham |
atrocyate |
saty apy adṛṣṭārthatve bahuvacanopadeśāt sarve praṣṭavyāḥ yas tu vikalpaḥ so ’nyaviṣayo ’stu | taiś ca tṛptāḥ sma ity ukte śeṣam annaṃ kiṃ kriyatāṃ iti annaśeṣaviniyogānujñābhyarthane kṛte vipraiḥ śreṣṭhaiḥ saha bhujyatāṃ asmabhyaṃ dīyatām iti cokte sati piṇḍān dadyād ity uttareṇa saṃbandhaḥ | atra brāhmaṇā yad vidhiviniyogam abhyanujānīyus tadvidhaṃ kuryāt |
tathā ca yamaḥ |
tato bhuktavatāṃ teṣāṃ annaśeṣaṃ nivedayet |
yathā brūyus tathā kuryād anujñātas tu tair dvijaiḥ ||
bṛhaspatir api |
pṛcched viprāṃs tatas te tu yat brūyus tat samācaret || iti |
nāgarakhaṇḍe |
tṛptān jñātvā tato viprān agre annaṃ parikṣipet |
agnidagdhāś ca ye || ityādi |
sakṛt sakṛd apo datvā gāyatrītritayaṃ japet |
madhuvāteti saṃkīrtya tataḥ pṛcchet dvijottamān ||
tṛptā stha iti rājendra anujñāṃ prārthayet tataḥ |
[1392] bandhūnāṃ bhojanārthāya śeṣasyānnasya bhaktimān |
gobhilo ’py āha |
tṛptān jñātvā annaṃ prakīrya agnidagdhā ityādi sakṛt sakṛd apo datvā punar api madhuvāteti japet |
madhuvātety etat kātyāyanādyuktasya gāyatryādijapasyopalakṣakam |
kauśikasūtre ’pi |
tṛptān jñātvānnaṃ prakīrya datvā cāpaḥ sakṛt sakṛt || iti |
vārāhapurāṇe |
tṛpteṣu teṣu vipreṣu kired annaṃ mahītale |
dadyād ācamanārthāya tebhyo vāri sakṛt sakṛt ||
kūrmapurāṇe ’pi |
tato 'nnam utsṛjed bhukteṣv agrato vikiran bhuvi |
vikirann ity anena piṇḍībhūtasya nikṣepo nivartyate |
atra gāyatryādijapas tatas tṛptipraśnas tadanantaraṃ gaṇḍūṣadānam ity evaṃ kātyāyanādyuktakramaviparītaṃ kramam āśrityāha yājñavalkyaḥ |
ā tṛptes tu pavitrāṇi japtvā pūrvajapaṃ tathā |
annam ādāya tṛptāḥ stha śeṣaṃ caivānumanya ca |
tad annaṃ vikired bhūmau dadyāc cāpaḥ sakṛt sakṛt |
'pūrvajapaṃ' savyāhṛtīkāṃ gāyatrīm ityādinā pratipāditam | atra gāyatrīmadhumatyāder uccāraṇaṃ yathā brāhmaṇaḥ śṛṇvanti tathā kāryam |
tathā ca śaṅkhalikhitau |
gāyatrīm anuśrāvya tṛptān jñātvā śeṣam annam anujñāpya prakṛtānnavikiraṃ [1393] kuryāt |
tṛptān jñātvā gāyatrīm anuśrāvyety anvayaḥ | asyānantaraṃ madhumatīśrāvaṇaṃ kartavyam |
tathā ca śaunakaḥ |
tṛptān jñātvā madhumatīḥ śrāvayet |
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
pṛṣṭhais tṛptaiś ca tṛptāḥ stha tṛptāḥ sma iti vādibhiḥ |
anujñāto naras tv annaṃ vikired bhuvi sarvataḥ |
tad datvācamanārthāya dadyād ambhaḥ sakṛt sakṛt ||
vyāsaḥ |
tṛptāḥ stha iti pṛṣṭās te brūyus tṛptāḥ sma ity atha |
brahmapurāṇe |
bhuktavatsu ca vipreṣu pṛṣṭrā tṛptāḥ sva ityapaḥ |
tṛptāḥ smeti sakṛd devo dadau maunavimocanam ||
maunavimocanārthāya gaṇḍūṣārtham apo dadau, yajñavarāha ity arthaḥ |
mānavamaitrāyaṇīyasūtre |
tṛptāḥ stha iti pṛcchati tṛptāḥ sma ity uktaḥ sakṛd ācānteṣu bhūmau
vikiraṃ ninayet |
saurapurāṇe |
vikiraṃ prakṣipet paścāt śeṣam annam atho vadet |
brahmapurāṇe tu pūrvaṃ gaṇḍūṣodakadānaṃ tataḥ praśnottarāṇi tato vikiram ity etat kramam āśrityoktam |
datvāmṛtāpidhānaṃ ca viprebhyaś ca sakṛt sakṛt |
[1394] kiṃcit saṃpannam etan me bho viprā iti tān vadet ||
te ca prāhuḥ susaṃpannaṃ sa ca tān punar āha ca |
annair bhavantas tṛptāḥ stha tṛptāḥ smeti vadanti te ||
sa tān āha punaḥ śeṣaṃ kva deyaṃ cānam ity api |
śiṣṭebhyo dīyatāṃ caiva tad idaṃ pravadanti te ||
atha tṛptāṃs tu tān jñātvā bhūmāv evānnam utsṛjet ||
baudhāyanasūtre |

ye agnidagdhā iti |
iti kramavidhiḥ |
atha praśnottaraprapañcaḥ |
tatrāha pracetāḥ |
tṛptāḥ stha tṛptāḥ smaḥ prabhūtaṃ prabhūtam ity
uktavanta iti |
atraikaḥ prabhūtaśabdaḥ praśnaḥ, dvitīyas tūttaram |
viṣṇu-āśvalāyanau praśnāntaram āhatuḥ |
saṃpannaṃ pṛṣṭānnaṃ vikīrya | iti |
atra cārthād uttaram apy evaṃvidhaṃ gamyate |
viṣṇudharmottare tv etayoḥ praśnottarayoḥ pūrvoktābhyāṃ praśnottarābhyāṃ saha samucitayoḥ prayogo jānupātanaṃ ca darśitam |
praṣṭavyā brāhmaṇā bhaktyā bhūniviṣṭena jānunā |
tṛptā bhavantaḥ saṃpannaṃ bhavatāṃ kaccid eva tu ||
tṛptāḥ smeti ca tair uktaṃ saṃpannam iti cāpy atha |
dadyād ācamanaṃ bhaktyā śraddadhānaḥ samāhitaḥ ||
[1395] kūrmapurāṇe |
pṛṣṭvā tad annam asyaivaṃ tṛptān ācāmayet tataḥ |
ācāntān anujānīyād abhito ramyatām iti ||
atrārthad abhiratāḥ sma ity uttaraṃ gamyate |
iha śrāddhaviśeṣe praśnottaraviśeṣa ucyate |
tatra maitrāyaṇīyasūtre |
vikiraṃ pradāya tṛptān svaditam iti pṛcchet saṃpannam ity
ābhyudayika iti |
hārītaḥ |
tṛptān svaditam iti pṛcchet svaditam iti pratyāhuḥ | smṛtam iti daiveṣv āyuṣyam iti svair iṣṭvācānteṣu bhūmau vikiraṃ ninayet |
āha viṣṇuḥ |
pitrye svaditam ity evaṃ vācyaṃ goṣṭheṣu suśrutaḥ |
saṃpannam ity abhyudaye daive rocata ity api ||
iti praśnottaraprapañcaḥ |
athācamanadānagrahaṇaprakāraḥ |
tatrāha viṣṇuḥ |
udaṅmukheṣv ācamanam ādau dadyāt tataḥ prāṅmukheṣv iti |
annaliptaṃ hastam aprakṣālyaiva gaṇḍūṣagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam | asyānyathākaraṇe tu doṣam āha marīciḥ |
hastaṃ prakṣālya gaṇḍūṣaṃ yaḥ pibed avicakṣaṇaḥ |
āsuraṃ tad bhavec chrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ nopatiṣṭhate ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
[1396] hastau prakṣālya gaṇḍūṣaṃ yaḥ pibed avicakṣaṇaḥ |
sa tu daivaṃ ca pitryaṃ ca ātmānaṃ copaghātayet ||
varāhapurāṇe |
hastaṃ prakṣālya yaḥ paścād pibed bhuktvā dvijaḥ sadā |
tad annam asurair bhuktaṃ nirāśāḥ pitaro gatāḥ ||
ity ācamanadānagrahaṇaprakāraḥ |
atha vikiretikartavyatā |
tatra brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
tato vikiraṇaṃ kuryād vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā |
'vidhau’ śāstre, ‘dṛṣṭena' upalabdhena, 'karmaṇā' itikarttavyatārūpeṇa |
tatra vikirapradeśatatsaṃskāravikaraṇīyānnasvarūpasaṃskārāḥ |
tatra pādma-mātsyayoḥ |
tṛptān jñātvā tataḥ kuryād vikiraṃ sārvavarṇikam |
sodakaṃ cānnam uddhṛtya satilaṃ prakṣipet bhuvi ||
devalaḥ |
tataḥ sarvāśanaṃ pātre gṛhītvā vividhaṃ budhaḥ |
teṣām uccheṣaṇasthāne tena pātreṇa nikṣipet ||
‘teṣāṃ’ brāhmaṇānāṃ, ‘uccheṣaṇasthāne' bhojanabhājanasamīpe |
tathā ca manusmṛti-mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇayoḥ |
bhuktavatsu tatas teṣu bhājanopāntike nṛpa ||
sārvavarṇikam annādyaṃ saṃnīyāplāvya vāriṇā |
samutsṛjed bhuktavatām agrato vikiran bhuvi ||
[1397] 'sārvavarṇikaṃ' prakṛtaśrāddhārthasaṃpāditapāyasodanāpūpasūpaśākādinānājātīyam | anena vikaraṇīyānnasvarūpam uktam | 'saṃnīya' pākabhājanebhyaḥ stokaṃ stokaṃ samuddhṛtyaikasmin darvyādirūpe pātre saṃbhṛtya,
yad yan niveditaṃ kiṃcit pitṛbhyaś cātha tatra ca |
tasmāt tasmāc ca bhāgaṃ tu gṛhītvā camase śubhe ||
iti brahmapurāṇābhidhānāt | camasa iti praśastapātropalakṣaṇam | tiladarbhayuktena vāriṇā 'āplāvya'' prokṣya | anena vikaraṇīyānnasaṃskāro darśitaḥ | 'bhājanopāntika' ity atra pitryaviprabhājanopāntika iti jñeyam |
ata eva viṣṇudharmottare |
bhuktavatsv atha vipreṣu vidhiṃ me gadataḥ śṛṇu |
udaṅmukhānāṃ viprāṇāṃ purataḥ sodakaṃ tataḥ ||
annaṃ tu vikired bhaktyā pitṛbhāgas tu sa smṛtaḥ |
udaṅmukhānāṃ viprāṇāṃ purataḥ sodakaṃ tataḥ ||
udaṅmukhānāṃ viprānāṃ sodakaṃ pūrvam ākhyātenārthena prakṣepādhikaraṇabhūtabhūmau prokṣaṇārthena jalena sahitam | etad uktaṃ bhavati “tiladarbhasahitenodakena bhūmiṃ prokṣya tathāvidhenaiva ca tenānnaṃ pariplāvya tasyāṃ bhūmau tad annaṃ vikiret” iti | pitṝṇāṃ pramītānāṃ sapiṇḍādīnāṃ bhāgaḥ tṛptihetuḥ | yeṣāṃ yeṣām ayaṃ bhāgas te tu devatāprakaraṇe darśitāḥ | darśayiṣyamāṇamantraliṅgaiś ca pratyetavyāḥ | bhūmiprokṣaṇaṃ ca spaṣṭam evoktaṃ vāyupurāṇa-brahmāṇḍapurāṇayoḥ |
prokṣya bhūmim athoddhṛtya pūrvaṃ pitṛparāyaṇaḥ |
tasyāṃ ca bhuvi tilasahitadarbhāstaraṇam uktaṃ brahmapurāṇe |
ucchiṣṭe satilān darbhān dakṣiṇāgrān nidhāpayet |
[1398] 'ucchiṣṭa' ity ucchiṣṭasaṃnindhau |
viṣṇudharmottare tv annasaṃskāraviśeṣa uktaḥ |
annaṃ satṛṇam abhyukṣya māmekṣeṣveti mantrataḥ |
'satṛṇam' uparinihitadarbhaṃ, tat māmekṣeṣveti mantreṇābhyukṣya |
mantras tu |
māmekṣeṣva bahu me pūrtam astu brāhmaṇo me juṣatām atrānnaṃ sahasradhāram amṛtodakaṃ me puratas tv etat parame vyomann iti |
kaṭhasūtre ’pi |
māmekṣeṣveti satṛṇam annam abhyukṣyeti |
viṣṇuḥ |
bhuktavatsu brāhmaṇeṣu tṛptim āgateṣu māmekṣeṣvety annaṃ satṛṇam abhyukṣyānnavikiraṇam ucchiṣṭāgrataḥ kuryāt |
iti vikirapradeśatatsaṃskāravikaraṇīyānnasvarūpasaṃskārāḥ |
atha vikiramantrāḥ |
tatrādau vaiśvadevikasya vikirasya |
āha gobhilaḥ |
asomapāś ca ye devā yajñabhāgavivarjitāḥ |
teṣām annaṃ pradāsyāmi vikiraṃ vaiśvadevike ||
etanmantrapradeyas tu vikiraḥ liṅgād vaiśvadevikasaṃbandhīti gamyate | ataś cāyaṃ tatratyavaiśeṣikadharmayuktas tadarthadvijocchiṣṭabhājanasamīpe ca pradeyaḥ | daivatvāt pitryavikirāt pūrvam anuṣṭheyaḥ | ayaṃ ca bahubhiḥ śiṣṭair nānuṣṭhīyata iti kaiścid eva svācārānusārāt kāryaḥ |
[1399]
atha pitryasya vikiramantrāḥ |
kaṭhasūtre |
agnidagdhāś ca ye jīvā ity annaṃ vikiret bhuvi |
āha pracetāḥ |
tṛptiṃ buddhvānnam ādāya satilaṃ pūrvavaj japet |
tṛptiṃ pṛcched anujñāto ye agnīti bhuvi kṣipet ||
pippalādasūtre |
tṛptān jñātvā ye agnidagdhā iti vikiraṃ kuryāt |
bṛhaspatiḥ |
upaspṛṣṭodakānāṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ tathāgrataḥ |
sodakaṃ vikired annaṃ mantraṃ cemam udāharet ||
anagnidagdhā ye jīvā ye ’gnidagdhāḥ kule mama |
bhūmau dattena tṛpyantu tṛptā yāntu parāṃ gatim ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
ye ’gnidagdhā ye ’nagnidagdhā jīvā jātāḥ kule mama |
bhūmau dattena tṛpyantu tṛptā yāntu parāṃ gatim ||
gobhilaḥ |
agnidagdhā jīvā ye ’py anagnidagdhāḥ kule mama |
bhūmau dattena tṛpyantu tṛptā yāntu parāṃ gatim ||
pādma-mātsyayoḥ |
samutsṛjed bhuktavatām agrato vikiran bhuvi |
anagnidagdhās tu ye jīvā ye ’py adagdhāḥ kule mama |
[1400] bhūmau dattena tṛpyantu tṛptā yāntu parāṃ gatim ||
yeṣāṃ na mātā na pitā na bandhur
na cānnasiddhir na tathānnam asti |
tattṛptaye ’nnaṃ bhuvi dattam etat
prayāntu lokāya sukhāya te tu ||
brahmapurāṇe |
ye ’smatkule tu pitaro luptapiṇḍodakakriyāḥ |
ye cāpy akṛtacūḍās tu ye ca garbhād viniḥsṛtāḥ ||
yeṣāṃ dāho na kriyate agnidagdhāś ca ye ’pare |
bhūmau dattena tṛpyantu te 'pi yāntu parāṃ gatim ||
iti pitryavikiraṇamantrāḥ |
vikiraprakṣepānantaraṃ karaṇīyam uktaṃ brahmapurāṇe |
tataḥ prakṣālya hastau ca trir ācamya hariṃ smaret |
pretabhāgaṃ visṛjyātha prāyaścittopaśāntaye ||
savyāhṛtiṃ sapraṇavāṃ gāyatrīṃ ca paṭhet tathā |
paṭhen madhumatīḥ puṇyās tathā ca madhu madhv iti ||
atra vakṣyamāṇānekapadārthavyavahitaprayogāpi vikirapratipattir vikirasaṃbandhād atraiva pratipādyate |
tatra tāvat pratipattikālam āha gautamaḥ |
vikiram ucchiṣṭaiḥ pratipādayet || [1401]
'ucchiṣṭair' iti sahārthe tṛtīyā | tenāyam arthaḥ saṃpadyate | yadocchiṣṭāni pātradeśāt samādāya kasmiṃścit pradeśe nikṣipyante tadā vikirasyāpi yathopadeśaṃ pratipattiṃ kuryāt |
anyathā tu tatkaraṇe doṣam āha vyāsaḥ |
ucchiṣṭhair eva vikiraṃ sadaiva pratipādayet |
anyathā kurute yas tu nirāśās tasya devatāḥ ||
pratipattiviśeṣaṃ tvāha bhārgavaḥ |
piṇḍavat pratipattiḥ syād vikirasyeti taulvalir iti |
piṇḍavad iti | yādṛśī piṇḍānāṃ pratipattiḥ kriyate tādṛśī vikirasyāpi kartavyeti taulvalir nāma munir uktavān | ataś ca “piṇḍāṃs tu go’javiprebhyo dadyād agnau jale ’pi vā” ityādyuktā piṇḍapratipattir vikirasyāpi karttavyā |
ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
yad uktaṃ piṇḍadānasya tat karma vikirasya ca |
kṣipet piṇḍān jale ’gnau tu vikiraṃ tatra nikṣipet ||
atra kecin manyante | vaikalpikaṃ vikiraprakṣepāya sthānadvayam | tatraikam ucchiṣṭasaṃnidhau sthānam aparaṃ piṇḍasaṃnidhau | tatra yadocchiṣṭasaṃnidhau vikiro dīyate tadocchiṣṭapratipattikāla eva tatpratipattisadṛśī vikirasyāpi pratipattiḥ karttavyā | yadā tu piṇḍasannidhau vikiraḥ kriyate tadā tatpratipattikāle tadvat kartavyeti | te ca piṇḍasaṃnidhāne ’pi vikiraḥ kartavya ity atra kālikāpurāṇoktaṃ vacanaṃ darśayanti |
pūrvavad dāpayet pūjya piṇḍān arghyaṃ pṛthak pṛthak |
[1402] agnidagdhān agnidagdhān vai paścād annaṃ vikīrayet ||
atra piṇḍapūjānantaraṃ vikiravidhānād deśaviśeṣānupādānāc ca deśākāṅkṣāyāṃ piṇḍasaṃnidhāv iti gamyate |
dhūmraḥ |
kapitthasya pramāṇena piṇḍān dadyāt samāhitaḥ |
tatsamaṃ vikiran dadyāt piṇḍān teṣu ṣaḍaṅgule ||
iti vikirapratipattiḥ |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasakalakaraṇādhipatipaṇḍita
śrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau pariśeṣakhaṇḍe śrāddhakalpe
vikirādividhir nāma caturddaśo ’dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ ||
[1403]
atha pañcadaśeo’dhyāyaḥ |
kṣīrodanvadbahulalaharīvṛndasaṃdehabhūmiḥ
svarlokastrīkucaparisarāmuktamuktāvayasyā |
yasya proccair viharati sadā kīrtivallī sa eṣaḥ
śrīhemādriḥ kathayati puraḥ piṇḍadānaprakāram ||
atha piṇḍadānaṃ |
tatra kālāḥ |
iha tāvat kecit brāhmaṇabhojanāt pūrvam eva piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kurvanti, kecid upariṣṭāt ||
tad āha manuḥ |
piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kecit purastād eva kurvate || iti |
kecid grahaṇāt kecit purastāt kecid upariṣṭād iti dvaidhaṃ gamyate |
tathā ca sāṃkhyāyanagṛhyam |
bhuktavatsu piṇḍān dadyāt purastād eka iti |
śaṅkho ’pi |
ucchiṣṭasaṃnidhau kāryaṃ piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ budhaiḥ |
ādau vāpi tataḥ kuryād agnikāryaṃ yathāvidhīti ||'
kecit tu brāhmaṇabhojane varttamāna eva kurvanti |
tathācādatsu brāhmaṇeṣv ity anuvṛttau viṣṇuḥ | [1404]
ucchiṣṭasaṃnidhau dakṣiṇāgreṣu pṛthivīdarvir akṣitety ekaṃ
piṇḍaṃ pitre nidadhyādi tyādi |
tatra ye pūrvaṃ kurvanti te ’pi kecit brāhmaṇārcanānantaram agnaukaraṇāt pūrvam eva kurvanti kecit tv agnaukaraṇānantaram |
tatrārcanānantaram āha devalaḥ |
atha saṃgṛhya kalaśaṃ sadarbhaṃ pūrṇam ambhasā |
purastād upaviśyaiṣāṃ piṇḍāvāpaṃ nivedayet || ityādi |
yathokte śaṅkhavacane caiṣa eva piṇḍadānakālo dṛśyate |
manus tu bhojanāt pūrvakālīnasya piṇḍadānasyāgnaukaraṇānantaraṃ kartavyatām āha |
apasavyam agnau kṛtvā sarvam āvṛtpariśrutam |
apasavyena hastena nirvaped udakaṃ śuci |
trīṃs tu tasmād dhaviḥśeṣāt piṇḍān kṛtvā samāhitaḥ || iti ||
tasmād dhaviḥśeṣād ity agnaukaraṇahaviḥśeṣāt | śeṣaṃ pūrvam eva vyākhyātam | ye tūpariṣṭāt kurvanti te ’pi kecit brāhmaṇeṣv anācānteṣu kurvanti, kecid ācānteṣu kurvanti |
tathāca āśvalāyanagṛhyam |
bhuktavatsv anācānteṣu piṇḍān nidadhyād ācānteṣv eke || iti |
kātyāyano ’pi kṛtagaṇḍūṣeṣu samyaganācānteṣu brāhmaṇeṣu piṇḍadānam uktvāha |
ācānteṣv eke iti |
ācānteṣv api kurvāṇaḥ kecid vikiraṃ prakṣipya brāhmaṇ ebhyo gaṇḍūṣāya sakṛt sakṛd apo datvā gāyatryādijapaṃ [1405] kṛtvā tṛptapraśnottarapūrvakaṃ śeṣānnānujñāṃ kārayitvānantaraṃ kurvanti | ata eva kātyāyanena śeṣam annam ity ārabhyānujñāpyetyantaṃ yathoktakrameṇa pratipādyoktam |
sarvam annam ekata uddhṛtyocchiṣṭasamīpe darbheṣu trīṃs trīn piṇḍān avanejya dadyād ācānteṣv ity eke |
sarvam annam ekasmin pātre uddharet | sarvaśabdaḥ prakṛtānnajātisarvatvārthaḥ | ato māṃsapāyasaudanāpūpasūpādijātīyebhyaḥ prakṛtaśrāddhaprayogārthaṃ sādhitebhyaḥ sarvebhyo ’nnebhyaḥ kiṃcit kiṃcid ādāya piṇḍaparyāptaparimāṇam annasamudāyam ekasmin pātre saṃbhṛtyety etad uktaṃ bhavati | 'ucchiṣṭasamīpa' ity ucchiṣṭapradeśāt vyāmatryaratnibāhvādivyavahite deśe | atra piṇḍapitṛyajñavad upacāraḥ | pitrya iti sūtritavād darbhagrahaṇam upamūlasakṛdācchinopalakṣaṇārthaṃ | parisaṃkhyānārtham iti kecit | 'avanejya' pradāsyamānasyaikaikasya piṇḍasya sthāne uddeśyasya pitrāder (?) ekaikasya gotrasaṃbandhanāmāni saṃbudhya tāni samuccāryāvanenikṣveti pātreṇa satilaṃ jalaṃ ninīyety arthaḥ | 'trīṃs trīn' itivīpsā mātāmahādipiṇḍatrayam apekṣya, 'piṇḍān dadyāt', parasparasaṃśleṣād vibhāgaṃ parityajya saṅghātatāṃ prāptam annaṃ piṇḍaḥ | evaṃ saṃpūrṇam anācānteṣu pātravimocanārthaṃ sakṛtgṛhītagaṇḍūṣeṣu brāhmaṇeṣu gāyatrījapādi kṛtvā piṇḍān dadyād ity ekeṣāṃ matam abhidhāyānyeṣāṃ matam āha 'ācānteṣv eka' iti | 'eka' iti ekavacanād asya pakṣasya paramatatvam iti na mantavyam ubhayaśāstratvād vikalpa iti karkokteḥ | astu caika iti vacanāt prathame paratvāt pareṣām evaiṣa pakṣa iti | kecit tv anācānteṣv eva vikirārtham annam ādāya tṛptipraśnottarapūrvakaṃ śeṣānnānujñāvacanaṃ kārayitvā vikiraṃ [1406] prakṣipya brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sakṛt sakṛd apo datvānantaraṃ piṇḍadānaṃ kurvanti |
ata eva yājñavalkyenānnam ādāyety ārabhyāmunaiva krameṇa sakṛt sakṛd ityantam abhidhāyoktam |
sarvam annam upādāya satilaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ |
ucchiṣṭasaṃnidhau piṇḍān pradadyāt pitṛyajñavat || iti |
kecit tu bhuktavatsv anācānteṣv eva vikiraṃ datvā svadhāṃ ca vācayitvā piṇḍadānaṃ kurvanti |
tathā ca śaṅkhalikhitau |
gāyatrīm anuśrāvya tṛptān jñātvā svaditam iti pṛṣṭvā śeṣam annam anujñāpya prakṛtād annād vikiraṃ kuryāt | svadhāṃ vācayitvā viṣṭarāṃs trīn nidadhyāt trīṇy evādapātrāṇi satilāni sapavitrāṇi mṛnmayāśmamayaudumbarāṇi vā dhūpagandhamālyādarśa-pradīpāñjanādīni copaharet sarvānnaprakāram ādāya piṇḍān nidadhyāt |
asyārthaḥ | gāyatrīṁ ‘anuśrāvya' yathā te brāhmaṇaḥ śṛṇvanti tathoccārya, 'tṛptān' suhitān, jñātvā svaditam iti pṛṣṭvā śobhanam aditaṃ 'svaditaṃ' | arthāt susvaditam iti uttaraṃ gamyate | śeṣam annaṃ kiṃ kriyatām iṣṭhaiḥ saha bhujyatām iti praśnottarābhyāṃ anujñāpyānujñātād annāt kiyadannam uddhṛtya tasya bhūmau vikiraṇaṃ kuryāt | svadhāṃ vācayiṣya ityādinā prakāreṇa svadhāṃ vācayitvā nidhāsyamānasyaikaikasya piṇḍasyādhārabhūta ekaiko viṣṭara iti piṇḍatrayārthaṃ trīn viṣṭarān bhūmau nidadhyāt | pūrvāgranthitapañcaviṃśatidarbhapiñjūlātmako viṣṭaraḥ | ekaikasmin piṇḍe ekaikena pātreṇāvanejanaṃ kartuṃ trīṇy eva mṛcchilātāmrāṇām anyatamena nirmitāni [1407] pavitrasahitāny udapātrāṇi | 'dhūpaḥ' gugguluniryāsādiḥ | 'gandhāḥ' śrāddhe vihitāni surabhīṇy anulepanāni | 'mālyāni' śrāddhocitāni grathitapuṣpāṇi | ‘ādarśaḥ' darpaṇaḥ, ādṛśyate 'smin rūpam ity ādarśaḥ | ādiśabdāt prasādhanadravyaṃ sindūrādīti hariharaḥ | 'pradīpaḥ' prasiddhaḥ | 'añjanaṃ' sauvīrādi | ādiśabdo ’bhyañjanavāsaḥprabhṛtyupayogidravyāntarasaṃgrahārthaḥ | etāni ca 'upahareta' piṇḍadeśasamīpe nidadhyāt | sarvam annaprakāram ādāya tad ekīkṛtya tanmayān piṇḍān nidadhyād iti |
kecit tv anācānteṣv eva piṇḍadānaṃ kurvanti ācānteṣu vikiraḥ | ata eva bṛhaspatinā
tatsamīpe prakuryāc ca piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ tataḥ |
ityādinā piṇḍadānam uktvā, "upasṛṣṭodakānān tu" ityādinā vikiradānam uktam | ācānteṣv api kurvāṇāḥ kecid abhiramaṇānujñāvacanādipadārtham akṛtvaiva piṇḍadānaṃ kurvanti | kecit taduttarakālaṃ, kecit brāhmaṇavimarjanānantaram | tatrācānteṣv iti vacanād ācamanāvyavahitottarakālatā gamyate |
anujñāvacanādyuttarākālatāṃ tv āha yamaḥ |
ācāntāṃś cānujānīyād abhivādya kṛtāñjaliḥ |
bhavanto ramatām atra jñātvānujñātalakṣaṇam ||
svadheti ceti vaktavyaṃ prīyantāṃ pitaras tathā |
akṣayyam annadānaṃ tu vācyaṃ prītair dvijātibhiḥ |
tato nirvapaṇaṃ kuryāt piṇḍānāṃ tadanantaram || iti |
bhavanto ramatām ityādiślokārdham anujñāvacanam | anujñātasya lakṣaṇaṃ yathāsukhaṃ varttanam ity evaṃvidhaṃ svarūpaṃ jñātvā bhavantaḥ 'ramatāṃ' yathāsukhaṃ varttatām | kecit tu brāhmaṇavisarjanānantaraṃ piṇḍadānaṃ kurvanti |
[1408] tathā ca hārītaḥ |
tṛptān svaditam iti pṛcched ityādi vāje vāja ity anuvrajetyantaṃ bhojanottaramantram (?) uktvā āha śeṣasya piṇḍān pitṛyajñavan nidadhyād iti |
ete ca piṇḍadānakālāḥ śākhābhedena vyavasthitā veditavyāḥ |
tathā ca smṛtiḥ |
munibhir bhinnakāleṣu piṇḍadānaṃ tu yat smṛtam |
tat svaśākhāmataṃ yatra tatra kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
'yatra' yasmin kāle, kriyamāṇaṃ svaśākhayānumataṃ bhavati tasmin kāle kartavyam | upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat svagṛhyādyanumateḥ |
bhojanāt pūrvakālottarakālayor vyavasyāntaram āha laugākṣiḥ |
apraśasteṣu yāgeṣu pūrvaṃ piṇḍāvanejanam |
bhojanasya praśastaṃ tu paścād evopakalpayet || iti |
'apraśasteṣu yāgeṣu' saṃpiṇḍīkaraṇāt pūrveṣu pretaśrāddheṣu | 'avanejanaṃ' avācīnapāṇinā nirvapaṇaṃ, iti smṛticandrikākāraḥ | piṇḍanirvapaṇārambhapadārthenāvanejanākhyena piṇḍadānaṃ lakṣyata ity api śakyaṃ vyākhyātum | 'bhojanasya pūrvaṃ' bhojanāt pūrvam ity arthaḥ | 'praśastaṃ' sapiṇḍīkaraṇādiśrāddheṣu kriyamāṇaṃ bhojanāt paścād eva yathākālam | iyaṃ ca vyavasthā keṣāṃcid eva śākhinām | yato manvādismṛti-matsyādipurāṇeṣu ca
mukhyapārvaṇaṃ piṇḍānvāhāryakarma vādhikṛtya piṇḍadānasya bhojanāt pūrvam eva kālacodanā | ata eva pārvaṇaśrāddhe bhojanāt paścād eveti smṛticandrikākāroktir apy evam eva vyākhyeyā | yeṣāṃ tu gṛhyādau piṇḍadānasya kālaviśeṣā noktāḥ teṣāṃ tu saukaryād ācānteṣv eka ity ayam eva [1409] pakṣo grahītuṃ nyāyyaḥ | atra prasaṅgād vikiradānakālavikalpā api vyākhyātāḥ |
iti piṇḍadānakālāḥ |
atha piṇḍadānapradeśāḥ |
tatra tāvat piṇḍapitṛyajñe ’gnisamīpe piṇḍanirvāpaṃ vidhāya piṇḍapitṛyajñavad upacāraḥ | pitrya ityādiṣu ca piṇḍapitṛyajñavidhyantātideśād agnisadbhāve tatsamīpa eva piṇḍān dadyāt | tathā ca brāhmaṇabhojanāt pūrvakālīnaṃ piṇḍanirvāpaṃ varṇayatā devalena bhuvi piṇḍānāṃ saṃniveśanam añjanādibhis tadalaṃkaraṇaṃ coktvā anantaram agnaukaraṇahomam abhidhāya tasya homasya pūrvaniveśitapiṇḍasaṃnidhānam uktam |
hutvaivam agniṃ piṇḍānāṃ saṃnidhau tadanantaram |
pakvānnena baliṃ tebhyaḥ piṇḍebhyo dāpayet dvijaḥ ||
iti piṇḍānāṃ saṃnidhāv evamuktena prakāreṇāgniṃ hutvānantaram ebhyaḥ piṇḍebhyaḥ pakvānnena baliṃ naivedyarūpaṃ dadyāt | atrāgnau homasya piṇḍasaṃnidhānaṃ vadatārthāt piṇḍānām apy agnisaṃnidhānam uktam | agnyabhāve tu pūrvopanyasteṣu śaṅkha-kātyāyana- yājñavalkya-vacaneṣūcchiṣṭasaṃnidhāv ity upadeśād ucchiṣṭasamīpe dadyād iti madhuśarmaprabhṛtayaḥ |
tatra nairantaryeṇocchiṣṭasaṃnikṛṣṭasya deśasyāśucitvena piṇḍadānānarhatve ’pi vacanād arhatvaṃ parikalpya tatra piṇḍadānaṃ kartum adhyavasyato dātṝn vārayituṃ ucchiṣṭapradeśāt kiyadvyavadhānam āha vyāsaḥ |
aratnimātram utsṛjya piṇḍāṃs tra pradāpayet |
yatropaspṛśatāṃ vāpi prāpnuvanti na bindavaḥ || iti |
[1410] 'tatra’ tasmin śrāddhaprayoge, ucchiṣṭapradeśād aratniparimitaṃ pradeśaṃ parityajya yo deśo ’vatiṣṭhati tatra piṇḍān pradadyāt | sakaniṣṭhikaḥ karaḥ ‘aratniḥ’| etac ca vyavadhānam atikuśaleṣu suśīleṣu cācamanodakabindubhiḥ piṇḍadānapradeśam anupaghnatsu brāhmaṇeṣu vijñeyam | ācamanodabindūpaghāte tu tato ’dhikam api pradeśam utsṛjet |
tad āha |
yatropaspṛśatām ityādinā upaspṛśatām ācāmatāṃ viprāṇām udakabindavo yaṃ deśaṃ na prāpnuvanti tatra deśe vā piṇḍadānam |
tathā cāratnimātrād adhikaparityāgam āha pāraskaraḥ |
viprāṇāṃ bāhumātreṇa piṇḍadānaṃ vidhīyate |
śrāddhabhoktṝn viprān avadhīkṛtya bāhumātrāt pradeśāt parata ity arthaḥ | viprāṇām ity atra pātrāṇām iti pāṭhāntaram |
tatrāpy udabinduprāptiśaṅkāyām ucchiṣṭasaṃnidhivākyārthaṃ vivṛṇvan diṅaniyamaṃ copadiśan bāhumātrād apy adhikapradeśaparityāgam āha atriḥ |
pitṝṇām āsanasthānād agratas triṣv aratniṣu |
ucchiṣṭasaṃnidhānaṃ tatrocchiṣṭāsanasaṃnidhau 'pitṝṇāṃ' pitryabrāhmaṇānām | upalakṣaṇaṃ caitad devatrāhmaṇānām | taducchiṣṭavyavadhānasyāpekṣitatvena
tulyanyāyatvāt | ‘āsanasthānāt' avadhiyogyād āsannapradeśāt | sa ca taddeśasyārvakbhāga eva niyatavyavadhānalābhāt | anyathā saṅkaṭāsaṅkaṭavibhāgenāniyatavyavadhānaṃ prasajyeta | tathā ca kadācid ucchiṣṭasaṃspṛṣṭa eva deśe piṇḍadānam āpadyeta | niyatalābhe niyatakalpanānupapatteś ca | atha vā bhuñjānāḥ pitaro yāvatā pradeśena saṃyujyante tāvat pitṝṇām āsanasthānam | [1411] ataḥ pātrāṇy avadhitvena labhyante tāvatā hi pradeśena pitaraḥ saṃyujyante | 'agrataḥ' purastāt | na tu paścāt pārśvayor veti diṅniyamaḥ |
atrāpy udabinduprāptiśaṅkāyām adhikaparityāgam āha jātūkarṇyaḥ |
vyāmamātraṃ samutsṛjya piṇḍāṃs tatra pradāpayet |
yatropaspṛśatāṃ vāpi prāpnuvanti na bindavaḥ ||
tiryakprasāritayor bhujayoḥ sahorasā yan mānaṃ saḥ ‘vyāmaḥ' | yadā tu brāhmaṇa-sauśīlyādinācamanodabindūnāṃ aratnyādiparimitadeśaprāptir nāśaṅkyate tadocchiṣṭasaṃnidher vacanavihitatvena mukhyasyocchiṣṭasaṃnidhitāratamyasyānugrahāya aratnibāhvādiparimita eva deśe piṇḍadānaṃ kāryam ity abhipretyoktaṃ yatropaspṛśatāṃ vāpītyādi | ato 'ratnyādimānavavacanānām ācamanodabinduprāptivarjitochiṣṭasamīpadeśopalakṣaṇatvam eva na tu niyamārthatvam | saṅkaṭe tu śrāddhapradeśe prayatnaviśeṣeṇācamanodabindu-samucchalanaṃ saṅkocyāratnyādivyavahitapradeśānupaghātam āpādya tatra piṇḍadānaṃ kuryād iti vyavasthā |
brāhmaṇabhojanāt pūrvakālapradeyān piṇḍān prastutya deśaviśeṣādim
āha devalaḥ |
abhyajya madhusarpirbhyāṃ nānvapet kuśasaṃcaye |
chāyāyāṃ hastinaś caiva vastadauhitrasaṃnidhau ||
hasticchāyā rājñas tadanugṛhītasya vā piṇḍadāne | tadanyasya tatsaṃpādanaśaktivirahāt | yatra piṇḍadānaṃ kartavyaṃ tatra hasticchāyāsaṃpādanena taddeśavaiśiṣṭyam āpādyam | etac ca ṣāḍguṇyātiśayārthaṃ | yato’sya (?) [1412] hasticchāyāder vacanāntarataḥ śrāddhe praśastataratvam avagamyate | ato vināpi hasticchāyādikaṃ bhavaty eva piṇḍadānam | evaṃ sthite dvijabhojanottarakālīnam api piṇḍadānam asmin deśe ṣāḍguṇyasaṃpattaye vidheyam iti gamyate | atha vā śrāddhamadhyavartinā tīrthādikṛtyena svatantreṇa ca piṇḍadānena saṃyojyamāno ’yaṃ deśaviśeṣaḥ ṣāḍguṇyam āpādayiṣyatīti kiṃ prakaraṇāgraheṇa | etac ca gajacchāyāprakaraṇe vyaktam asti |
iti piṇḍadānadeśāḥ |
atha piṇḍadānaprayogaḥ |
tatrānujñāgrahaṇam | tac ca piṇḍadānaṃ cikīrṣato ’mbho'mṛtakumbhopādānapūrvakam āha devalaḥ |
atha saṃgṛhya kalaśaṃ sadarbhaṃ pūrṇam ambhasaḥ |
purastād upaviśyaiṣāṃ piṇḍāvāpaṃ nivedayet |
tatas tair abhyanujñāto dakṣiṇāṃ diśam etya saḥ ||
