piṇḍanirvāpārthaṃ darbhasahitaṃ sapavitraṃ ca 'ambhasā' jalena, paripūrṇaṃ kalaśaṃ ‘saṃgṛhya’ samyak karābhyāṃ gṛhītvā, brāhmaṇānāṃ purastād upaviśya piṇḍāvāpaṃ kariṣya ity anujñābhyarthanābhiprāyavatā praśnena kariṣyamāṇaṃ piṇḍāvāpam eṣāṃ nivedayet | tatas tair brāhmaṇaiḥ kuruṣvety anujñāto dakṣiṇāṃ diśam āgacchet | yady api ca brāhmaṇābhimukhyena praśnakaraṇāt svata eva yajamānasya dakṣiṇābhimukhyaṃ siddham | dvijānām agre piṇḍadānaṃ kartavyaṃ na pṛṣṭhata ity atriṇābhihitatvād uttarābhimukhāvasthitabrāhmaṇapaṅktyapekṣayā dakṣiṇādigāmanaṃ cāyuktam | tathāpi dakṣiṇābhimukhasyaiva [1413] sthitasya dakṣīṇāṃ diśam etyeti vidher arthavattvāya praśnasthānāt dvitrāṇi padāny āgatyeti gamyate | atha vā purastād upaviśyeti prāṅmukha upaviśya praśnaṃ kuryāt | tato dakṣiṇāṃ diśam etyeti dakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā piṇḍadānaṃ kuryād iti | kalaśasaṃgrahas tatra sarveṣām eva tasya piṇḍāvāpopayogimārjanāvanejanādisādhanajalopādānārthatvāt | atha vā kalaśasaṃgrahasya kalaśakāryārthatvād yeṣāṃ tataḥ pānīyakumbhena tarpayet 'prayataḥ pitṝn' ityādinā kalaśenaiva kiṃcit karma vihitaṃ teṣām eva tatsaṃgrahaḥ | avanejanādikaṃ tu sarvaśrāddhasādhāraṇapātrasthena jalena |
keṣāṃcid evāyaṃ kalaśasaṃgraha ity etam arthaṃ tatsaṃgraham antareṇaivānujñāgrahaṇaṃ vadan vyaktīkaroti śālaṅkāyanaḥ |
piṇḍāvāpam anujñāpya yatavākkāyamānasaḥ |
satilena tato ’nnena piṇḍān sarveṇa nirvapet ||
ity anujñāgrahaṇam |
atha piṇḍadānasthānakalpanā |
āha devalaḥ |
upalipte śucau deśe sthānaṃ kurvīta saikatam |
maṇḍalaṃ caturasraṃ vā dakṣiṇāvanataṃ mahat ||
'upalipte’ gomayagomūtrābhyām upalipte mahīpṛṣṭhe, 'gośakṛnmūtravāriṇā' iti matsyavacanāt | upalepe kṛte saty upalepāt pūrvasthitāśucitvanivṛttyā siddhe 'pi śucitve taduttarakālikopaghātajanyāśucitvanivṛttyarthaṃ śucāv ity uktam | upalipte ata eva śucāv iti vā | 'saikataṃ' sikatāmayaṃ sthānaṃ, 'kurvīta' piṇḍādhārabhūtaṃ sthalaṃ racayet | tasyākāram āha, 'maṇḍalaṃ [1414] caturasraṃ veti | 'maṇḍalaṃ' vṛttākāraṃ, 'caturasraṃ' catuṣkoṇaṃ vā | 'dakṣiṇāvanataṃ' dakṣiṇāpravaṇam | 'mahat' bhūpradeśāda vyaktāvabhāsaṃ piṇḍāvasthāpanaparyāptavaipulyayuktaṃ ca tāvatā vaipulyasyārthasiddhatve 'pi spaṣṭatvārtho ’nuvādaḥ | atha vā piṇḍadānāvasthāpanaparyāptavaipulyāt kiṃcid abhyadhikavaipulyārtho vidhiḥ | etac ca saikatasthānakaraṇaṃ keṣāṃcid eva | ata eva upalipte mahīpṛṣṭha iti matsyapurāṇe mahīpṛṣṭasyaiva sākṣāt piṇḍādhāratvaṃ vihitam |
iti piṇḍadānasthānakalpanā |
atha piṇḍadānasthānasaṃskāraḥ |
tatra tāvad upalepanam uktam eva | ullekhanādi tūcyate |
tatrāha devalaḥ |
ekadarbheṇa tanmadhyam ullikhet triś ca taṃ tyajet |
'tanmadhyaṃ’ piṇḍasthānamadhyam | 'ullikhet' rekhāyuktaṃ kuryāt | 'triḥ' trivāram |
nanu pitryartham ullekhanaṃ sakṛd eva kartavyam | tathā ca śatapathe |
piṇḍapitṛyajñabrāhmaṇam atha dakṣiṇenānvāhāryapacanaṃ sakṛd ullikhati tadvedibhājanam || iti |
'vedibhājanaṃ' vedisthānīyam | brahmāṇḍapurāṇe ’pi |
khaṇḍanaṃ peṣaṇaṃ caiva tathaivollekhanakriyā |
sakṛd eva pitṝṇāṃ syād devānāṃ tu trir ucyate || iti |
'khaṇḍanaṃ' barhirādeḥ chedanaṃ, 'peṣaṇaṃ' bhūmigharṣaṇādikam | 'ullekhanakriyā' lekhākaraṇam | 'pitṝṇāṃ' pitṛkārye, 'sakṛd eva syāt' | ataḥ katham atra trir ullekhanam |
ucyate | vikalpāt viśeṣaśāstrād vā bhaviṣyatīti | atha vaikaikapiṇḍārtham ekaikam ullekhanam ity evaṃ sakṛd api kriyamāṇaṃ triḥ [1415] saṃpadyate | atha vaikaikapitṛvargārtham ekaikam ullekhanam ity evaṃ triḥ kriyate hi kadācit pitṛmātṛmātāmahādivargāṇāṃ piṇḍadānam | anena ca yadā vargadvayasya piṇḍadānaṃ tadā dvirullekhanaṃ, yadā tv ekavargasya tadā sakṛd evety api darśitaṃ bhavati | 'ekadarbheṇety ekayā darbhaśikhayā | etac ca sphyālābhe | 'piṇḍapitṛyajñe sakṛt sphyenollikhyety āpastambādivacanāt piṇḍān dadyād vai pitṛyajavad iti yājñavalkyādivacanāc cātideśataḥ sphyaprāpteḥ | na ca darbhopadeśenāsya bādhaḥ |
yato bādhaśaṅkāyām evoktaṃ brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
vajreṇa vā kuśair vāpi ullikhet tan mahīṃ dvija iti |
'vajraḥ' sphyaḥ, "vajro vai sphya" iti śruteḥ | sphyenollikhed ity ukte arthāt karagṛhīteneti siddhe ’pi kim ekakaragṛhītena uta karadvayagṛhītenety evamādyākāṅkṣānivṛttyartham āha pāraskaraḥ |
karābhyām ullikhet sphyena kuśair vāpi mahīṃ dvijaḥ | iti |
karābhyām ity ukte kiṃ saṃniveśaviśiṣṭābhyām ity ākāṅkṣāyām uktaṃ brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
savyottarābhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ kuryād ullekhanaṃ dvijaḥ | iti |
'savyaḥ' vāmaḥ, sa yayoḥ pāṇyor madhye 'uttaraḥ' upariṣṭād avasthitaḥ, tau 'savyottarau' | etad uktaṃ bhavati | “ullekhanāya pāṇibhyāṃ nipīḍyamāne sphye dakṣiṇamuṣṭer upariṣṭād vāmamuṣṭiḥ sthāpanīya iti | sphyasthānapātād darbhasya tenāpy ullekhane savyottarāv eva karau kartavyau | ullekhanaṃ cābhimukham abhigacchatā sphyena darbheṇa vā na kāryaṃ kiṃ tu prāṅmukhatayā gacchantau (letters unclear) | tac cāgre ’py ābhimukhyenaiva kāryam | “dakṣiṇāprācīṃ parācīṃ [1416] vedim uddhṛtyety āpastambena piṇḍapitṛyajñe ’bhidhānāt | dakṣiṇaprācyor antarālabhṛtā yā koṇātmikāgnaiyīti prasiddhā dig vartate tadavacchinnāṃ dakṣiṇāprācīṃ, 'parācīṃ' parāṅmukhīm | yajamānāpekṣayā parāṅmukhaṃ gacchatā sphyenollikhyety arthaḥ | āśvalāyanenāpi dakṣiṇāprācīm eva prastutya paribhāṣāyām uktaṃ "sarvakarmāṇi tāṃ diśam" iti | tāṃ diśam āśritya sarvāṇy api pitryāṇi karmāṇi kāryāṇīty arthaḥ | anena kartur āgneyābhimukhyaṃ siddhyati | na hy anyābhimukho ’ñjasā tadabhimukhāni śaknoti karmāṇi kartum | ataś cāgneyyābhimukhaḥ san kartāgneyyābhimukhīṃ rekhāṃ kuryāt | ayaṃ vakṣyamāṇasya darbhāstaraṇasyāvanejanapiṇḍanirvāpādeś cāgneyyābhimukhyam eva | ullekhaṇaṃ hi saṃskāratvāt piṇḍādhāratvenopayokṣyamāṇāyā bhuvaḥ kriyate | ataḥ piṇḍādhārabhūtānāṃ darbhāṇām api tadābhimukhyenāstaraṇam | dakṣiṇābhimukhāstaraṇe tv anādhārabhūtabhūmyāstṛtānāṃ darbhāṇām anādhārataivopapadyate | yathādhāraṃ ca pitṝṇām upaveśanaṃ yathopaveśanam avanejanādīti sarvam āgneyyabhimukham | etac ca vaikalpikam | "dakṣiṇā dik pitṝṇām" iti śruter dakṣiṇābhimukhatvāder apy avagamāt dakṣiṇābhimukhatva-dakṣiṇāpavargatvāder api darśanāt | lekhākaraṇe ca mantro brahmapurāṇe |
nihanmi sarvaṃ yad amedhyavad bhavet
hatāś ca sarve suradānavā mayā |
rakṣāṃsi yakṣāḥ sapiśācasaṅghā
hatā mayā yātudhānāś ca sarve ||
asya mantrasya sārthavādako viniyogas tatraiva |
[1417] etena mantreṇa susaṃyatātmā
darbheṇa vediṃ sakṛd ullikhet tu |
śivāṃ hi vṛddhiṃ dhruvam icchamānaḥ
kṣiped dvijātir diśam uttarāṃ gataḥ ||
yasmin deśe padyate hy eṣa mantras
taṃ vai deśaṃ rākṣasā varjayanti ||
'kṣipet' ullekhanadarbham iti śeṣaḥ | 'uttarāṃ diśaṃ' kṣepyadarbhāpekṣayā | anena cātmāpekṣayā dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi kṣiped iti labhyate | apahatā ityādimantrāntaraṃ ca lekhākaraṇe dṛśyate |
tathā ca piṇḍapitṛyajñasūtre kātyāyanaḥ |
dakṣiṇenollikhaty apahatā ity apareṇa vā |
'dakṣiṇenāpareṇa veti agner dakṣiṇataḥ paścimato vā | 'apahatā asurā rakṣāṃsi vediṣada' ity anena mantreṇollikhed ity arthaḥ |
āpastambas tu kiṃcid adhikāvayavam etam eva mantram āha |
apahatā asurā rakṣāṃsi piśācā vediṣada ity antarā gārhapatyānvāhāryapacano dakṣiṇapūrveṇa vānvāhāryapacanam || iti |
vedim uddhṛtyety uttareṇa saṃbandhaḥ | ullikhya cābhyukṣaṇaṃ kartavyam | sphyena lekhām ullikhed aparatā asurā rakṣāṃsi vediṣada iti tām abhyukṣyety āśvalāyanena piṇḍapitṛyajñe 'bhidhānāt |
abhyukṣaṇānantaram āpastambena piṇḍapitṛyajñe āvāhanaprakāśakena mantreṇābhimantraṇam uktam |
avekṣyāyaṃ tu pitaro manojavasa ity abhimantrayati |
[1418] ullekhanānantaraṃ paścād ulmukanidhānam āha kātyāyanaḥ |
ulmukaṃ parastāt karoti ye rūpāṇīti |
śatapathe ’py ullekhanānantaram ulmukanidhānam uktam |
atha parastād ulmukaṃ nidadhāti sa yad anidhāyolmukam athaitat pitṛbhyo dadyād asurarakṣasāni haiṣām etad vimathnīraṃs tatho haitat pitṝṇām asurarakṣasāni na vighnate tasmāt parastād ulmukaṃ nidadhāti ye rūpāṇi pratimuñcamānā asurāḥ santaḥ svadhayā caranti parāpuronipuroye bharanty agniṣṭhān lokān praṇudāty asmād ity agnir hi rakṣasām apahantā tasmād eṣa nidadhātīti |
atha tatraikamūlatvādiviśeṣeṇa viśiṣṭānāṃ darbhāṇām āstaraṇaṃ kartavyam |
tathā ca devalaḥ |
tasmin sthāne tato darbhān ekamūlān śivān bahūn |
dakṣiṇāgrān udakpādān sarvāṃs tāṃs tṛṇuyāt [vṛṇuyāt?] samam ||
‘tasminn' iti yatra piṇḍāḥ pradātavyāḥ | tata' ity ullekhanādyanantaram | 'darbhān' kuśān | tadabhāve pūrvapradarśitān kāśādīn | ekamūlasaṃlagnabahuśikhān | 'śivān' iti sāgrān asphuṭitāgratvādiviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭān | bahuvacanaṃ tritva eva samāptiṃ prāpsatīty āśaṅkya 'bahūn' ity uktam | bahutvaṃ ca viśeṣānabhidhānād ekaikasmin piṇḍe tritvāt prabhṛti yathecchaṃ yathāsaṃbhavaṃ ca, bhūmyācchādanaparyāptasaṃkhyāniyamas tu nāsti, āstaraṇasya dṛṣṭārthatvāt | bhūvyavadhāyakādhārāntaratvāvagamān niyama iti cet | na | piṇḍādhārabhūtasarvabhūvyavadhānābhāve 'py ādhārabhūtabhūvyavadhānasya katipayair eva darbhaiḥ siddhatvāt | sarvavyavadhānāvagatis [1419] tu nāsty eva | dakṣiṇato ’graṃ yeṣāṃ te 'dakṣiṇāgrāḥ' | 'udakpādāḥ' udaṅmūlāḥ | 'stṛṇuyāt' vistārayet | 'samaṃ' samasthalatayā samāntaratayā samāgratayā samūlatayā veti | ekamūlatvavidhānād eva teṣāṃ samūlatvam api gamyate |
tad āha jātūkarṇyaḥ |
upamūlaṃ samāstīrya darbhān ucchiṣṭasaṃnidhau |
'upamūlaṃ' mūlasamīpe | mūlāny abhirakṣya, atra lūnān iti śeṣaḥ | tathā ca samūlatve taittirīyabrāhmaṇam |
yat paruṣi ditaṃ tad devānāṃ yad antarā tan manuṣyāṇāṃ yat samūlaṃ tat pitṝṇāṃ samūlaṃ barhir bhavati vyāvṛttyai |
upamūle lūnānāṃ sakṛdācchinnatvam uktaṃ śatapathe |
atha sakṛdācchinnāny upamūlaṃ ditāni bhavanty agram iva vai devānāṃ madhyam iva manuṣyāṇāṃ mūlam iva pitṝṇāṃ tasmād upamūlaṃ ditāni bhavanti sakṛdācchinnāni bhavanti sakṛduhyeva parāñcaḥ pitaras tasmāt sakṛdācchinnāni bhavanti |
'ditāni' khaṇḍitāni | do ’vakhaṇḍana ity asya niṣṭhāntaṃ rūpam |
taittirīyaśrutāv api |
sakṛdācchinnaṃ barhir bhavati sakṛd iva hi pitaraḥ |
āpastambaḥ |
samūlaṃ sakṛdācchinnaṃ barhir āharati sakadācchinnāni vā tṛṇāṇy
upamūlaṃ ditāni |
'bahiḥ' kuśāḥ | 'tṛṇāni' kāśādīni |
āśvalāyanaḥ |
[1420] sakṛdācchinair avastīrya |
lekhām iti śeṣaḥ |
tathā ca kātyāyanaḥ |
upamūlaṃ sakṛdācchinnāni lekhāyāṃ kṛtveti |
sā ca lekhā yadā dakṣiṇāgrā tadā darbhān api dakṣiṇāgrān āstṛṇuyāt |
tad uktaṃ devalena |
dakṣiṇāgrān udakpādān || iti |
taittirīyabrāhmaṇe ’pi |
dakṣiṇāstṛṇāni dakṣiṇāvṛddhi pitṛṇām || iti |
'dakṣiṇāvṛt' dakṣiṇāprakārakam |
sakṛdācchinnāni prakṛtya śatapathe ’pi |
tāni dakṣiṇopastṛṇānīti |
matsyapurāṇe ’pi |
nidhāya darbhān vidhivad dakṣiṇāgrān samāhitaḥ |
trīṃs trīn piṇḍān atho dadyāt sarvān eva tilair yutān ||
yadā tv āgneyīṃ diśam āśritya lekhā kriyate tadā darbhāṇām api dakṣiṇāgrāṇām evāstaraṇam |
etac ca viśeṣāntarasahitam uktaṃ vāyupurāṇe |
sakṛd evāstared darbhān piṇḍārthaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ (?) |
prāgdakṣiṇāgrān niyato dadyāt piṇḍān anantaram || iti |
'sakṛt' ekavāram | bahūnām apy āstaraṇaṃ śakyata eva sakṛt karttum | 'prāgdakṣiṇā' āgneyī dik |
[1421] atra āpastambena piṇḍapitṛyajñe darbhāstaraṇe mantro darśitaḥ |
sakṛdācchinnaṃ barhir ūrṇā mṛdu sthānaṃ pitṛbhyas tvā bharāmy ahaṃ asmin sīdantu me pitaraḥ | saumyāḥ pitāmahāḥ prapitāmahāś cānugaiḥ saheti, sakṛdācchinnena barhiṣā vediṃ stṛṇātīti |
atra śaṅkhalikhitābhyāṃ piṇḍabhūmau viṣṭaratrayanidhānam uktam |
viṣṭarāṃs trīn nidadhyāt || iti |
atra saṅkhyāsāmyād ekaikapiṇḍādhāratvenaikaiko viṣṭaro nidheya iti gamyate |
yamas tv atra viśeṣam āha |
viṣṭarāṃs trīn vapet tatra nāmagotrasamanvitān |
adbhir abhyukṣya vidhivat tilair abhyavakīrya ca || iti |
'nāmagotrasamanvitān' amukagotrasyāsmatpitur devadattaśarmaṇo ’yaṃ viṣṭara ityādivākyoccāraṇapūrvakam ity arthaḥ |
darbhāstaraṇānantaram āvāhanapūrvakaṃ pitṝṇāṃ sthānakalpanām āha devalaḥ |
atha sāñjalir utthāya sthitvā cāvāhayet pitṝn |
pitaro me prasīdantu prayāntu ca pitāmahāḥ ||
iti saṃkīrtayaṃs tūṣṇīṃs tiṣṭhet kṣaṇam anucchvasan |
āvāhayitvā darbhāgrais teṣāṃ sthānāni kalpayet || iti |
kare darbhān gṛhītvā pitre idaṃ sthānaṃ, pitāmahāyedaṃ sthānaṃ prapitāmahāyedaṃ sthānam ity eva krameṇa darbhagrair nirdiśet | śeṣaṃ vyaktam |
sthānakalpanānantaraṃ tatra mārjanaṃ tilavikiraṇaṃ cāha sa eva |
teṣv āsīneṣu pātreṇa prayacchen mārjanodakam |
prakṣālya vikiret tatra nānāvarṇaṃs tilān api ||
[1422] anena mārjane pātram uktam |
āpastambena tv añjalir mantraś coktaḥ |
mārjayantāṃ mama pitaro mārjayantāṃ mama pitāmahā mārjayantāṃ mama prapitāmahā ity ekarekhāyāṃ trīn udakāñjalīn ninayati |
prasavyaṃ ca atriḥ |
pariṣiñcati trīn udapātrān vājasaneyinaḥ samāmananti |
atra āśvalāyanena mantrāntaram uktam |
prācīnāvītī lekhāṃ trir udakenopanayec chundhantāṃ pitaraḥ śundhantāṃ pitāmahā prapitāmahā iti |
'lekhāṃ' sakṛdācchinnopastīrṇāṃ, 'udakenopanayet' udakena saṃyojayet |
sumantunā tu bhaviṣyatpurāṇe darbhāstaraṇānantaraṃ mārjanasthāne viśeṣāntarasahitam avanejanam uktam |
asāv avanenikṣveti puruṣaṃ puruṣaṃ prati |
tris trir ekena hastena vidadhītāvanejanam ||
asāv ity atra gotrasaṃbandhanāmāni saṃbuddhyan tāni krameṇoccāryāvanenikṣyety abhidhāyāvanejanāya pitṝṇāṃ karaśodhanāyodakaṃ dadyāt | tac ca puruṣaṃ puruṣaṃ prati triḥ | tathā ca pitaram uddiśya trivāram ityādy anusaṃdheyam |
nanu sarvatra mantreṣv asāv ity asya sthāne nāmamātraprayogaṃ manyamānā dṛśyante | asāv iti nāma gṛhṇātīti | śatapathe 'py evam eva śrūyate | tat katham atra gotrasaṃbandhanāmnāṃ trayāṇām api grahaṇaṃ vyākhyāyate |
maivam | asāv ity anena vyāvartakaśabdopasthāpanaṃ kriyate | gotrādīny api vyāvartakāny eva | [1423] na ca nāmnaiva vyāvṛttisiddher gotrādyagrahaṇaṃ vācyam | nāma gotraṃ ca saṃbadhaḥ prāpakaṃ havyakavyayor ityādinā tadgrahaṇasya vihitatvāt,
arghyadāne ’tha saṃkalpe piṇḍadāne tathā kṣaye |
gotrasaṃbandhanāmāni yathāvat pratipādayet ||
iti pāraskaravacanāc ca | na cātra piṇḍadānaśabdena pradhānamātrābhidhānād avanejanāsaṃgrahaḥ, sāṅge 'pi prayogadarśanāt,
piṇḍodakapradānaṃ tu nityanaimittikeṣv api |
ālapya nāmagotreṇa kartavyaṃ sarvadaiva hi ||
iti vyāsenāvanejane ’pi gotragrahaṇasyābhidhānāc ca | nāmagotreṇa ca 'ālapya' saṃbodhya, 'nityanaimittikeṣv api' piṇḍadāneṣu, 'piṇḍodakapradānaṃ' avanejanodakadānaṃ, kartavyam | nāmagotreṇety atra nāmagotrayoḥ paurvāparyam avivakṣitam | saṃbandhanāmagotraśabdānāṃ śāstreṣu nānākramadarśanād aicchikena krameṇa prayogaḥ kartavyaḥ | śākhābhedena vā kramasya vyavasthā | etac cāvanejanam ekenaiva hastena kartavyaṃ nāñjalinā na pātreṇa |
sarvāṇy api śrāddhīyāni secanāny ekahastena kartavyānīti tatraivoktam |
śrāddhasecanakāle tu dadyād ekena pāṇinā |
tarpaṇe tūbhyaṃ kuryād eṣa eva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
tarpaṇe tu 'ubhayaṃ' pāṇidvayaṃ sādhanībhūtaṃ kuryāt | ekenāpi hi hastena kriyamāṇam avanejanaṃ dakṣiṇenaiva hastena kartavyam |
tad āha manuḥ |
apasavyena hastena nirvaped udakaṃ śuci || iti |
'apasavyena' savyetareṇa hastena, 'śuci' anupahataṃ, udakaṃ piṇḍārtham āstīrṇadarbhopari ‘nirvapet' ninayet | tac codakaṃ tarjanyaṅguṣṭhamadhyamārgeṇa [1424] ninayet, tasya pitṛtīrthatvāt |
tathā ca mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
pitṛtīrthena toyaṃ ca dadyāt tebhyaḥ samāhitaḥ || iti |
'tebhyaḥ' pitṛbhyaḥ |
kātyāyanas tu pātreṇāvanejanam āha |
udapātreṇāvanejayaty apasavyaṃ savyena voddharaṇasāmarthyād asāv avanenikṣveti yajamānasya pitṛprabhṛtitrīn || iti |
udakānvitaṃ pātram udapātram | 'apasavyaṃ' pitṛtīrthena | 'savyena ' manuṣyatīrthena | ‘uddharaṇasāmarthyāt' "uddharanti manuṣyebhya" iti śatapathaśrutisāmarthyād ity arthaḥ | aśvāv avanenikṣveti mantraḥ | yajamānagrahaṇaṃ piṇḍapitṛyajñasyādhvaryukartṛkatvāt | apasavyādiśabdānāṃ pitṛtīrthādyarthatvam upādhyāyakarkeṇa vyutpāditaṃ |
lekhākaraṇolmukanidhānānantaraṃ śatapathe ’pi |
athodapātram ādāyāvanejayaty asāv avanenikṣveti | yajamānasya pitaram asāv avanenikṣveti pitāmaham asāv avanenikṣveti prapitāmahaṃ tad yathā śiṣyate ’bhiṣiñced evaṃ tat | tad yathā śiṣyata iti |
yathā bhokṣyamāṇasya puruṣasya hastādau jalaniṣecanam evam idaṃ pitṝṇām avanejanam ity arthaḥ |
rāṇāyanīyasūtre ’pi pātreṇaivāvanejanam āha gobhilaḥ |
savyenaiva pāṇinodapātraṃ gṛhītvāvasalaviḥ pūrvasyāṅkarṣvāṃ (?) darbheṣu ninayet pitur nāma gṛhītvāsāv avanenikṣve ye cātra tvāmanuyāṃ ayam anu tasmai te svadhety apa upaspṛśyaivam evetarayor iti |
[1425] savyena pāṇinodapātraṃ gṛhītvetyādivāmahastagṛhītenodapātreṇa dakṣiṇahaste niṣicyamānaṃ jalaṃ pitṛtīrthena ninayed ity arthaḥ | avasalaviśabdasyāpasavyaparyāyatvāt pitṛtīrthavācitvam | karṣūtrayaṃ cātra vedisthānīyalekhāsthāne | 'apām upasparśanaṃ' hastena salilasparśanamātram ity ācāravidaḥ | ‘itarayoḥ' śeṣayoḥ karṣvoḥ | etac ca jalasparśanaṃ piṇḍadānaṃ pratyavanejanagandhapuṣpadhūpadīpasatradāneṣu pratyekam eva kartavyam | gobhilācāryeṇa tatra tatra tathaiva vakṣyamāṇatvāt | etac cāvanejanodakaṃ satilaṃ pratyetavyam |
tathā ca uśanāḥ |
tilonmiśritenodakenāsicya darbhāstīrṇāyāṃ bhūmau
piṇḍaṃ nivedayet || iti |
atrāñjalyekahastodapātrāṇāṃ vikalpaḥ śākhābhedena vyavasthā veti veditavyam | na tu dakṣiṇahastaḥ pātradhāraṇenāvanejanasyopakaroti pātraṃ codakadhāraṇeneti dvārakāryabhedāt samucayo ’stu na hasteneti pātranirapekṣasya hastasyāvanejanasādhanatvāvagamāt | śaknoti cānapekṣya pātraṃ sākṣādudakādhāratvenaiva haste ’vanejanaṃ sādhayitum | atra kātyāyanādimatenāvanejanaprayogavākyam: "amukagotrāsmatpitar devadattaśarmann avanenikṣva" ityādi | āśvalāyanādibhis tu “śundhatāṃ pitaraḥ" ityādy uktam | āpastambādibhis tu "mārjayantāṃ mama pitaraḥ" ityādi | atrāpi pūrvavad vikalpavyavasthe | tathā sumantuprabhṛtibhis tu “śundhatāṃ pitaraḥ " ityādy uktam | kātyāyanena tu tataḥ prāg evoktam | ato ’vanejanabarhistaraṇayoḥ paurvāparye vikalpaḥ, yathāśākhaṃ vyavasthā veti | atra yady apy avanejanasya [1426] piṇḍasthānasaṃskāratā na vidyate | tathāpy udakaninayanātmakatvena tatsaṃskārasvarūpatvāt lekhābarhistaraṇasaṃdaṃśapatitatvāc ca tasya saṃskāreṣv abhidhānam | āvāhanasyāpi saṃdaṃśapātād evābhidhānam |
iti piṇḍadānasaṃskāraḥ |
atha piṇḍakaraṇam |
tatrāha jātūkarṇaḥ |
kṛtvāvanejanaṃ kuryāt trīn piṇḍāṃs tu yathāvidhi || iti |
atra trīn iti pitrādyekavargāpekṣayā | kātyāyanādivacaneṣu trīṃs trīn iti vīpsādarśanād amāvāsyāśrāddhe mātāmahādivargasyāpi piṇḍanirvāpāvagamāt |
tathā ca vārāhapurāṇe varāhakṛtaśrāddham adhikṛtyokte piṇḍārthānnavibhāgapratipādake vākye liṅgaṃ dṛśyate |
piṇḍapātraṃ samādāya jāyāyai pradadau tataḥ |
sā tad annaṃ dvidhā kṛtvā tridhaikaikam athākarot || iti |
'yathāvidhi' vidhyanatikrameṇa | vidhiś ca piṇḍārthānnaviṣayaḥ piṇḍaparimāṇaviṣayaḥ piṇḍakriyetthaṃbhāvaviṣayaś ca darśayiṣyate | tatretthambhāvaviṣayeṇa vidhinā mahānnavidhis tāvad ucyate | iha brāhmaṇabhojanāt pūrvakālīne agnaukaraṇāt pūrvaṃ kriyamāṇe piṇḍadāne ’gnaukaraṇādyarthena caruṇā piṇḍāḥ kartavyāḥ |
tad etat setikartavyatākam āha devalaḥ |
tataś carum upādāya sapavitreṇa pāṇinā |
[1427] caturdhā vibhajet piṇḍān ghṛtāktān bhājanena vai |
abhyajya madhusarpirbhyāṃ tān vapet kuśasaṃcaye ||
'carum upādāya' bhājane gṛhītvā taṃ pavitrasahitena pāṇinā caturdhā vibhajet | tadanantaram ekaikena carubhāgena ekaikaṃ piṇḍam ity evaṃ caturaḥ piṇḍān kuryāt | tāṃś ca ghṛtākān ghṛtamadhvaktān vā 'bhājanena' pātreṇa bhūtena, 'vapet' nidadhyāt | atra caturdheti cikīrṣitapiṇḍasaṃkhyākavibhāgopalakṣaṇārtham | agnaukaraṇottarakālaṃ tu kriyamāṇe piṇḍadāna agnaukaraṇaśeṣeṇa piṇḍāḥ kartavyāḥ |
tathā cāpasavyam agnau kṛtvety ārabhyāha manuḥ |
trīṃs tu tasmād dhaviḥśeṣāt piṇḍān kṛtvā samāhitaḥ |
audakenaiva vidhinā nirvaped dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ||
'tasmādd haviḥśeṣād ity agnaukaraṇahaviḥśeṣāt | 'apasavyena hastena nirvaped udakam ity ayam audako vidhiḥ | bhojanottarakālīne tu piṇḍadāne ’nnam āha kātyāyanaḥ |
sarvam annam ekata uddhṛtyocchiṣṭasamīpe darbheṣu trīṃs trīn piṇḍān
avanenijya dadyāt || iti |
sarvaśabdaḥ prakṛtānnasarvajātisarvatvārthaḥ na parimāṇasarvatvārthaḥ | ataḥ prakṛtaśrāddhārthasādhitabrāhmaṇabhuktāvaśiṣṭaudanapāyasāpūpasūpādisarvajātīyānna-samudāyebhyaḥ kiṃcit kiṃcid ādāyaikasmin pātre saṃbhṛtya tadannamayān piṇḍān kṛtvocchiṣṭapradeśād aratnyādivyavahite deśe sphyādibhiḥ kṛtalekhe pūrvapradarśitaprakāram avanejanaṃ kṛtvāstīrṇeṣu sakṛdācchinneṣu trīṃs trīn piṇḍān dadyāt | trīṃs trīn iti vīpsākaraṇam [1428] anekavargapiṇḍābhiprāyeṇa | etac ca sarvaprakāram annam agnaukaraṇāvaśiṣṭena caruṇā miśraṇīyaṃ |
tathā ca āśvalāyanaḥ |
yad yad annam upabhutaṃ tatas tataḥ sthālīpākena saha piṇḍārtham uddhṛtya piṇḍān nidadhyāt || iti |
yad annam upabhuktaṃ śrāddhīyabrāhmaṇair iti śeṣaḥ | tatas tataḥ kiṃcit kiṃcid uddhṛtyāgnaukaraṇaśiṣṭena sthālīpākena saha saṃyojya piṇḍān nidadhyāt | sthālīpākamiśraṇaṃ cāgnaukaraṇaśeṣapratipattiprakaraṇe vistareṇoktam | etac cānnaṃ madhvājyatilayuktaṃ kartavyam |
tathā ca vāyupurāṇe |
madhusarpistilayutāṃs trīn piṇḍān nirvaped budhaḥ |
na caitan madhvāditrayayuktatāniyamārthakaṃ kiṃ tu vaiśiṣṭyātiśanārtham |
ata eva madhutiladvayamātrayuktatām āha bṛhaspatiḥ |
sarvasmāt prakṛtād annāt piṇḍān madhutilānvitān |
pitṛmātāmahādīnāṃ dadyād gṛhyavidhānataḥ ||
nāpi madhutiladvayayuktatāniyamaḥ |
ata eva tilamātrayuktatām āha yājñavalkyaḥ |
sarvam annam upādāya satilaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ |
ucchiṣṭasaṃnidhau piṇḍān pradadyāt pitṛyajñavat ||
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe ’pi tilamātrayuktatoktā |
satilena tato ’nnena piṇḍāṃs trīn eva putraka |
pitṝn uddiśya darbheṣu dadyād ucchiṣṭasaṃnidhau ||
iti piṇḍārthānnaviṣayo vidhiḥ |
[1429]
atha piṇḍaparimāṇaviṣayo vidhiḥ |
tatrāha vyāsaḥ |
dvihāyanasya vatsasya viśaty āsye yathā sukham |
tathā kuryāt pramāṇaṃ tu piṇḍānāṃ vyāsabhāṣitam ||
'dvihāyanaḥ' dvivarṣavayaskaḥ |
parimāṇāntaravidhir brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
trīn piṇḍān ānupūrvyeṇa sāṅguṣṭhamuṣṭivardhanān |
'ānupūrvyeṇa' vakṣyamāṇena pitṛmātāmahādikrameṇa | sāṅguṣṭhamuṣṭir yavān tāvad vardhanaṃ puṣṭir yeṣāṃ te 'sāṅguṣṭhamuṣṭivardhanāḥ' sāṅguṣṭhamuṣṭhipramāṇā iti yāvat | atha vā sāṅguṣṭhaṃ muṣṭiṃ vardhayantīti sāṅguṣṭhamuṣṭivardhanāḥ | yeṣu sāṅguṣṭhamuṣṭiniveśiteṣu kiṃcid abhyadhikaparimāṇatayā alpāṅguṣṭhasamucchrāsāt muṣṭir vardhate |
parimāṇāntarāṇy apy āha aṅgirāḥ |
kapitthabilvamātrān vā piṇḍān dadyāt vidhānataḥ |
kukkuṭāṇḍapramāṇān vā yadi vāmalakaiḥ samān |
badareṇa samān vāpi dadyāc chraddhāsamanvitaḥ || iti |
piṇḍadānenāpi pitṝṇāṃ tṛptiprītisadgatayo bhavantīty evaṃvidhe vidhau śraddhāṃ baddhā badaramātrapramāṇān api piṇḍān dadyāt | na punaḥ kiṃ badaramātraiḥ pitṝṇāṃ bhaviṣyati ity evam aśraddhām āviṣkṛtya dadyād iti | eṣāṃ ca parimāṇānāṃ śaktibhedena vyavasthā veditavyā |
atra vyavasthāntarayuktāni kānicit parimāṇāny āha marīciḥ |
ādrāmalakamātrāṃs tu piṇḍān kurvīta pārvaṇe |
[1430] ekoddiṣṭe bilvamātraṃ piṇḍam ekaṃ tu nirvapet ||
navaśrāddhe sthūlataraṃ tasmāt piṇḍaṃ tu nirvapet |
tasmād api sthūlatagm āśauce prativāsaram ||
'pārvaṇe' ekoddiṣṭetaraśrāddhe | pārvaṇagrahaṇaṃ vyavasthārtham | prakaraṇāt pārvaṇānvaye labdhe pārvaṇagrahaṇam anuvāda iti tu smṛticandrikākāraḥ | sa tu ślokottarārdhaṃ na paryālocitavān iti manyāmahe | atrāmalakamātrān eva pārvaṇe kurvīteti na vyākhyeyam | kiṃ tv āmalakamātrān pārvaṇa eveti | ataś ca pārvaṇe ’py āmalakādhikaparimāṇapiṇḍanirvāīpācāra-darśanaṃ na virudhyate | bilvamātram ity anena bilvān nyūnam āmalakādiparimāṇam eva nivartyate na tv adhikam api | tathā ca śiṣṭācāro 'nugṛhīto bhavati | 'navaśrāddhaṃ' āśaucamadhye prathamatṛtīyādidineṣv ekādaśe ca dine vihitaṃ śrāddham | tasyaikoddiṣṭatve 'pi na tatra bilvamātraṃ kiṃ tu tasmād api sthūlataraṃ nirvapet | śrāddhamantareṇaivāśaucamadhye 'prativāsaraṃ' pratidivasaṃ navaśrāddhapiṇḍād api sthūlataraṃ piṇḍaṃ nirvapet |
pitrādyekaikavargasaṃbandhinaḥ piṇḍatrayasya yathottaraṃ parimāṇādhikyam uktaṃ maitrāyaṇīyapiṇḍapitṛyajñasūtre |
darvyoddhṛtyoddhṛteṣu piṇḍān nidadhāti pitur nāmnāsāv etat te ye cātra tvānu tasmai tebhyaś ca svadheti prathamaṃ pitāmahasya nāmnā sthavīyāṃsaṃ madhyamaṃ, prapitāmahanāmnā sthaviṣṭaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ, dvayoḥ parayor nāmanī gṛhṇan (?) mūladeśe lepaṃ nirmāṣṭi |
iti piṇḍaparimāṇaviṣayo vidhiḥ
[1431]
atha piṇḍanirvāpāṅgabhūtaṃ kartṛsaṃsthānam |
tac ca prācīnāvītasavyajānunipātanadakṣiṇāmukhatvaparācīnapāṇitvādirūpaṃ, idaṃ ca sakalapitryakarmasādhāraṇam api piṇḍanirvāpaikasaṃbaddhaitatpratipādaka-nānāvacanasañjighṛkṣayātra nirūpyate | tatra tāvat prācīnāvītaṃ kartavyam, “dakṣiṇataḥ prācīnāvītī” iti taittirīyaśruteḥ | "prācīnāvītī lekhāṃ trir udakenopanayet" ity avanejanāt prabhṛti prācīnāvītavidhāyakād āśvalāyanasutrāt | ata urdhvaṃ "prācīnāvītī karmāṇi karoti” iti mārjanāt prabhṛti prācīnāvītividhāyakād āpastambasūtrāt ,“prācīnāvītinā vāgyatena kṛtyaṃ” iti lekhākaraṇārambhe gobhilasūtrāc ca, “atha prācīnāvītī bhuvam upalipyollikhya" iti kaṭhasūtrāc ceti | tad etat prācīnāvītam upalepanād ārabhya piṇḍapratipattiparyantaṃ vakṣyamāṇāpavādasthānāni vihāya karmakatrā saṃpādyam | prācīnāvītavad upalepanāt prabhṛti bhūmau vāmajānunipātanam api kartavyam |
tathā ca brahmāṇḍapurāṇa-vāyupurāṇayoḥ |
madhusarpistilayutāṃs trīn piṇḍān nirvaped budhaḥ |
jānu kṛtvā tathā savyaṃ bhūmau pitṛparāyaṇaḥ ||
jānu kṛtvety anayā pūrvakālatābhidhāyinyoktvā (?) śrutyā pāṭhakramabādhena jānupātanasya piṇḍanirvāpāt pūrvakālam anuṣṭheyatā pratipādyate | savyamiti vacanādarthāddakṣiṇasya jānuno bhūmāvapātanaṃ gamyate | ataś ca śrāddhakarttotkaṭakambalāvasthitaḥ savyaṃ jānu bhūmau niveśya dakṣiṇaṃ cāniveśyopaviśed ity uktaṃ bhavati |
atha pūrvoktaparimāṇānyatamaparimāṇakaṃ piṇḍaṃ kṛtvā [1432] dakṣiṇapāṇinopādadīta,
audakenaiva vidhinā nirvaped dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ |
iti pūrvapradarśitān manuvacanāt | dakṣiṇapāṇigṛhīte khaḍgādipātre vā piṇḍam upādadīta, pātrāṇāṃ khaḍgapātreṇa piṇḍadānaṃ vidhīyate |
rājataudumbarābhyāṃ vā hastenaivātha vā punaḥ ||
iti marīcivacanāt |
'khaḍgaḥ' khaḍgākhyaśvāpadaviśeṣaḥ, tallalāṭāsthisaṃbhavaṃ pātraṃ 'khaḍgapātraṃ’| ‘rājataṃ’ rajatamayam | 'audumbaraṃ' tāmramayam | khaḍgādeḥ praśastatarasya prathamakalpatvenopādānāt tadabhāve yena kenacit pātraprakaraṇoktena pātreṇa piṇḍadānaṃ kartavyam | anantaraṃ saṃyojitasavyahastāṅguler dakṣiṇahastasyottānasya piṇḍasahitasya yathāsāmarthyam aṅguṣṭhena piṇḍam aspṛśataḥ pitṛtīrtham avanataṃ kuryāt |
tatra tāvat savyapāṇisaṃyojanaṃ śaṅkhalikhitābhyām uktam |
piṇḍaṃ nidadhyāt savyena pāṇinā dakṣiṇapāṇipuraḥsareṇa || iti
savyaṃ dakṣiṇena saṃyojya uttānahastatā tu brahmāṇḍapurāṇe ’bhihitā |
uttānena tu hastena nirvaped dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ || iti |
aṅguṣṭhasparśanaṃ tu devalenoktam |
apasavyam apāṅguṣṭham || iti |
darśayiṣyate caitad uttarasmin prakaraṇe vacanam | pitṛtīrthāvanamanaṃ ca āpastambena piṇḍapitṛyajñe ’bhihitam |
savyaṃ cānvācyāvācīnapāṇiḥ || iti |
uttāna evādharīkṛtapitṛtīrthapāṇir avācīnaḥ sa yasya kartuḥ sa tathā |
āvācīnam eva parācīnaśabdenāha āśvalāyanaḥ |
tasyāṃ piṇḍān nigṛhṇīyāt parācīnapāṇiḥ || iti
'tasyām' iti darbhāstīrṇāyāṃ kṛtodakaninayanāyāṃ ca lekhāyām | pitṛtīrthāvanamanaṃ ca tena tīrthena piṇḍanirvāpārtham |
ata eva śatapathaśrutiḥ pitṛtīrthena piṇḍadānam āha |
sa vā iti dadātīti ca vai devebhyo juhvaty uddharanti manuṣyebhyo ’thaivaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tasmād iti dadātīti |
dadātīti pitṛtīrthena dadato hastasyānukṛtiḥ pradarśyate | 'iti ca vai devebhya' ityādāv arthavāde ’nukaraṇabhaṅgayaiva devamanuṣyapitṛtīrthānāṃ devādipratiniyatahomoddharaṇa-dānasaṃbandhapratipādanāt |
ṣaṭtriṃśanmate ’py uktam |
savyaṃ jānu nipātyaiva bhūmau piṇḍān prayatnataḥ |
nirvapet pitṛtīrthena svadhākāram udāharan || iti |
iti kartṛsaṃsthānam |
atha devatāmantrakramasaṃkhyāvikalpasahitaṃ
piṇḍadānākhyaṃ pradhānam ucyate |
tatrāha kātyāyanaḥ |
yathāvaniktaṃ piṇḍān dadāty asāv etat ta iti ye ca
tvām anv iti caika iti |
'yathāvaniktaṃ' yatra yatra yena ca krameṇa yasya yasyāvanejanaṃ kṛtaṃ, tatra tatra tenaiva krameṇa tasya tasya piṇḍaṃ dadyāt | avanejane ca pitṛprabhṛti trīn iti vacanād yathāvaniktam ity anenaivoddeśyapitrādirūpadevatāsahitā piṇḍasaṃkhyāpi labdhā | piṇḍapitṛyajñaprakaraṇasthaṃ caitad vacanam | tatra ca pitrāditrayavargasyaivekasyoddeśyatvāt piṇḍānāṃ tritvasaṃkhyāniyamaḥ | [1434] amāvāsyādiśrāddhe tu vargāntarasyāpy uddeśyatvāt tritvaniyamo nāsti | ata evāha vājasaneyaśrāddhakalpe kātyāyanaḥ |
trīṃs trīn piṇḍān avanejya dadyāt || iti |
asāv ity asya sthāne gotrasaṃbandhanāmnām abhidhānaṃ kartavyatvena vivakṣitam |
ata evāha pāraskaraḥ |
arghyadāne ca saṃkalpe piṇḍadāne tathā kṣaye |
gotrasaṃbandhanāmāni yathāvat pratipādayet || iti ||
saṃkalpaśabdenātra dvijabhojanasya tyāgo ’bhidhīyate | atraitāni yathāvat pratipādayed iti kathane 'nanyatraiteṣv ekatamavaikalye ’pi na vaiguṇyam iti gamyate| atra gotrasaṃbandhanāmnāṃ kiṃvibhaktyantānām abhidhānaṃ kartavyam ity apekṣāyāṃ kaścit tāvad evaṃ manyate | etat te ity etanmantrasthaṃ te iti padaṃ na tāvat prathamāvahuvacanāntasya prathamādvivacanāntasya vā tadorūpam, tasya prakṛtānupayogāt | ata eva caturthyekavacanāntasya ṣaṣṭhyekavacanāntasya vā yuṣmadorūpaṃ vācyam | tatra devatāyāḥ saṃpradānasārūpyāt tadvācinaḥ śabdasya caturthyantataiva yuktā | ataś cānena sahānvayākāṅkṣiṇāṃ gotrasaṃbandhanāmnāṃ caturthyekavacanāntānām evābhidhānaṃ kartavyaṃ | pitrādīnāṃ devatātvaṃ caivaṃvidha evābhidhāne kṛte prakāśyate nānyathā | ato yathoktam abhidhānaṃ kartavyam iti | aparas tv āha | yuṣmadaḥ parokṣavyāvṛttavyaktiviṣayatvād bahuṣu samakṣasthiteṣv ekasyābhimukhīkaraṇārthatvena saṃbuddher evopayuktatamatvāt tadantānām eva gotrasaṃbandhanāmnām abhidhānaṃ yuktam | asāv [1435] iti prathamānirdeśasyāvivakṣāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāc ca | yas tu loke prayogaḥ "sa kathaṃ vīrāyate druhyati sa kutas tvāṃ caitraṃ jeṣyati” iti sa tu tadavasthasya kārakatābhidhāyakatvena vā prakārāntarābhimukhīkṛtayuṣmadarthādhiṣṭhānaviṣayatvena vā hetuparatvena vā praśaṃsārthatvena vopayujyate | prakṛte punar eteṣāṃ madhye naikasyāpi saṃbhavaḥ | pramītasya hi pūrvajanmapravṛttagotrasaṃbandhanāmnām idānīm avartamānatvena kṣetrajñaviśeṣopalakṣakatvāt kārakādirūpasvārthasamarpakatvāyogāt | ataḥ saṃbudhyantānām eva gotrādīnām abhidhānaṃ kartavyam | sūtrāntare caivam evābhidhānaṃ dṛśyate etat te pitar etat te pitāmahaitat te prapitāmahetyādi | etad ity ayaṃ nirvapsyamānasya piṇḍasya nirdeśaḥ |
nanu kathaṃ puṃliṅgasya napuṃsakaliṅgena śabdena nirdeśaḥ |
ucyate | "praviśya piṇḍīkuḍyasya piṇḍaṃ patati" iti mahābhāṣyādau piṇḍaśabdasya strīnapuṃsakayor api prayogadarśanāt napuṃsakena nirdeśo na virudhyate | upādhyāyakarkas tv annam ity adhyāhāraḥ kārya ity uktavān | tat tu smṛticandrikākāro na manyate | sa hy āha | ananyagatitve ’dhyāhāraḥ kriyeta | na cātrānanyagatitvaṃ, piṇḍaśabdasya napuṃsakaliṅgasya darśitatvād iti | atredam ucyate | nāyaṃ napuṃsakaprayogopapādanārtham adhyāhāraḥ | kiṃ tu mantravākyaparipūraṇārthaḥ | anumataś ca “iṣe tvetyādaucchidmītyāder vākyaparipūraṇārtho ’dhyāhāraḥ | dṛśyate cedaṃ kṣetram idaṃ gṛham idaṃ dhanaṃ tubhyaṃ dīyata iti loke prayogaḥ | upalakṣaṇārthaś ca karkabhāṣye ’nnaśabdaḥ | ataś caitat te ity asyānantaraṃ annam iti piṇḍam iti vādhyāhāraḥ kāryaḥ |
anayoś ca vyavasthām āha laugākṣiḥ |
[1436] mahālaye gayāyāṃ ca pretaśrāddhe daśāhike |
piṇḍaśabdaprayogaḥ syād annam anyatra kīrtayet ||
'mahālaye' tīrthaviśeṣe | 'pretaśrāddhe' iti sapiṇḍīkaraṇānteṣu śrāddheṣu | 'daśāhike' śrāddhavyatirekeṇāpi daśāhanirvartye piṇḍadāne | annaśabdasya cānantaraṃ svadhāśabdaḥ prayojyaḥ | mantrapūrvaṃ svadheti devalavacanāt |
svadhāśabdānantaraṃ namaḥśabdo ’pi prayojya ity āha śāṭyāyaniḥ |
asāv etat ta ity uktvā tadante ca svadhā namaḥ |
atra cābhiyuktāḥ svadhānamaḥśabdāntaṃ mantram uccārya punaś cedaṃśabdenānnaṃ nirddiśya tair eva gotrādibhiś caturthyantaiḥ pitrādīn uddiśya nama ity uccārayanti |
nanu mantragatenaiva te iti caturthyantena pitrādīnāṃ devatātvasya prakāśitatvāt kimarthaṃ punar gotrādīnāṃ caturthyantānāṃ prayogaḥ | atha gotrādibhir api devatāprakāśakair bhāvyam iti punaḥ prayoga iti matam |
tan na | devadattaitat te vāso dīyata ity atrāpi punaś caturthyantaprayogaprasaṅgāt | atra brūmaḥ | mantravākyena prakāśito ’pi tyāgaḥ punastarām ācārānusārāt laukikenāpi vākyenābhivyaktīkriyate | tatredaṃ prayogavākyam | amukagotrāsmatpitar amukaśarmann etat te’nnaṃ svadhānama idam amukagotrāyāsmatpitre amukaśarmaṇe na mameti | anyeṣāṃ tu prayogavākyāni tatra tatra darśayiṣyante | atra caike sūtrakārā asāv etat ta ity asyānantaraṃ ye ca tvām anv iti mantraśeṣam āmananti | sa tu mantraśeṣo vājasaneyibhir na prayojyaḥ | ata eva śatapathe asya nindārthavādapūrvakaḥ prayogo niṣidhyate | [1437]
sa dadāty asāv etat ta ity eva yajamānasya pitre ye ca tvām anv ity ūhaika āhuḥ tad u tathānubrūyāt svayaṃ vaiteṣāṃ saha yeṣāṃ saha tasmād brūyāt asāv etat ta iti yajamānasya pitre asāv etat ta iti pitāmahāyāsāv etat ta iti prapitāmahāyeti |
ye ca tvām ity asya pāramārthikas tāvad ayam arthaḥ | 'tvām anu' ye tvadanucarībhūya tvayā saha ye vartante, tebhyaś caiṣa piṇḍa iti nindā tv evaṃ, tvāṃ pramītam anu paścādbhāvena saha ye bhavanti tebhyo ’py ayaṃ piṇḍo ’stv iti | tad etad amaṅgalyam abhidhānaṃ bhavati | yato ’yaṃ piṇḍadānaṃ kurvāṇaḥ putrādibhir ye ca tvām anv iti mantreṇa yeṣāṃ pramītānāṃ sahety āha teṣāṃ paścādbhūtaḥ svayam eva saha bhavati | ataś cāsau svasmā eva piṇḍadānaṃ karotīti pratibhāti | tathā caitad amaṅgalyam | atas tathā na brūyād ity asyāḥ śruter arthaḥ | devalas tv etam eva mantraśeṣaṃ vidadhānas tritvādhikapiṇḍasaṃkhyām āha |
pitṛpūrvaṃ ca nāmāni trayāṇaṃ kīrtayec chanaiḥ |
apasavyam apāṅguṣṭhaṃ mantrapūrvaṃ svadheti ca ||
etat te tata ye ca tvām anv ity āvāpayet pituḥ |
tathā pitāmahasyāpi tatpituś ca tathā vapet
sāmānyam iti śeṣāṇāṃ caturthaṃ piṇḍam āvapet ||
asyārthaḥ | pitrādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ nāmāni pitṛpūrvaṃ pitrādikrameṇa kīrtayet | saṃbuddhyantāny abhidadhīta nāmānīti gotrādīnām upalakṣaṇam | anantaraṃ mantram uccārya svadheti brūyāt | etat te tata ityādinā mantro darśitaḥ | atrāpy etat ta ity asyānantaram annam iti piṇḍam [1438] iti vā prayojyam | evaṃ samantrakeṇa svadhāntena vākyenānnaṃ tyaktvā pūrvavac caturthyantagotrādiśabdātmakaṃ pitre na mameti laukikam api vākyam anukīrtya prathamaṃ piṇḍaṃ nirvapet | pitṛśabdasthāne pitāmahaśabdaṃ prayujya pitṛnāmasthāne pitāmahanāma ca prayujya pitāmahāya dvitīyaṃ vapet | evam eva saṃbandhanāmnor ūhaṃ kṛtvā prapitāmahāya tṛtīyaṃ vapet | śeṣāṇāṃ prapitāmahāt pareṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ sāmānyam etad annaṃ svadhā na mameti caturthaṃ vapet | ‘apasavyam apāṅguṣṭhaṃ' apagatasavyahastam aṅguṣṭhavarjitaṃ ca yathā bhavati tathā vapet asādhanībhūtāṅguṣṭhena dakṣiṇahastena vaped ity arthaḥ | atra savyahastasya piṇḍasparśo niṣidhyate na tu dakṣiṇahastānvārambho ’pi | atha vāpasavyam iti pitṛtīrthena | apasavyaśabdasya pitṛtīrthābhidhāyakatvam api karkādisaṃmatatvena gṛhyate | atra prayogavākyam | amukagotrāsmattatāmukaśarmann etat te ’nnaṃ ye ca tvām anu svadhā idaṃ amukagotrāyāsmattatāyāmukaśarmaṇe na mameti | ete ca piṇḍā dakṣiṇāpavargā deyāḥ | caturthaś ca vaikalpikaḥ | sa ca prapitāmahāt pareṣāṃ nāmagotrādigrahaṇaṃ vinaiva deyaḥ | tad etan mantrāntaraṃ darśayann āha āpastambaḥ |
sakṛdācchinne barhiṣi dakṣiṇāpavargān piṇḍān dadāty etat te tatāsau ye ca tvām anv ity etaiḥ pratimantraṃ tūṣṇīṃ caturthaṃ kṛtākṛtaḥ prapitāmahaprabhṛtīn nānāma gṛhītaṃ gacchati |
dakṣiṇato ’pavargaḥ samāptir yeṣāṃ te 'dakṣiṇāpavargāḥ' | etad uktaṃ bhavati | barhiṣi prathamaṃ piṇḍaṃ nidhāya tasmād dakṣiṇena dvitīyaṃ tasmād api dakṣiṇena tṛtīyaṃ tasmād api caturtham ity evaṃ dadyād iti, 'pratimantraṃ' ekaikena mantreṇaikaikaṃ piṇḍaṃ dadyād ity arthaḥ | mantrān darśayati 'etat ta' ityādinā | [1439] etat te tatāsau ye ca tvam anu etat te prapitāmaha ye ca tvām anv ityantaiḥ taittirīyabrāhmaṇe krameṇāmnātā mantrāḥ sūtrakāreṇa prathamamantroccāraṇena darśitāḥ | ‘asāv' iti vyākhyātārthaṃ | caturthaṃ tu piṇḍaṃ tūṣṇīm amantrakam evaṃ nirvapet | ‘kṛtākṛtaḥ’ vaikalpikaḥ | 'prapitāmahaprabhṛtīn' ity etad guṇasaṃvijñāno bahuvrīhiḥ | prapitāmahātparān trīn uddiśya cāyaṃ dātavya ity arthaḥ | atra hetum āha 'nānāmagṭahītaṃ gacchati' iti | nāmagrahaṇamantareṇa tyakaṃ havir devatāṃ na prāpnotīti | gotrasaṃbandhanāmānukīrtitapitṛvyatiriktānāṃ pramītasarvasaṃbandhānām uddeśenāyaṃ caturthaḥ piṇḍo dīyata iti mantrāntaraliṅgād avagamyate |
darśitaś cāsau mantro laugākṣiṇā |
pitṛvaṃśe mṛtā ye ca mātṛvaṃśe tathaiva ca |
guruśvaśurabandhūnāṃ ye cānye bāndhavā mṛtāḥ ||
ye me kule luptapiṇḍāḥ putradāravivarjitāḥ |
kriyālopagatā ye ca jātyandhāḥ paṅgavas tathā ||
virūpā āmagarbhaś ca jñātājñātāḥ kule mama |
tebhyaḥ piṇḍaṃ mayā dattam akṣayyam upatiṣṭhatām ||
āśvalāyanas tu pitrādipiṇḍadāne mantrāntaram āha |
etat te tatāsau ye ca tvāmantryānv (?) iti |
gobhilas tu mantrāntaram āha |
asāv eṣa te piṇḍo ye cātra tvānu yāṃś ca tvam anu tasmai te svadheti |
maitrapiṇḍapitṛyajñe |
etat te mama pitar asāv iti pitur nāma gṛhītvaitat te mama pitāmahāsāv [1440] iti pitāmahasyaitat te mama prapitāmahāsāv iti prapitāmahasya ye cātra tvānu tebhyaś ca svadhety anuṣajed etat te ’muṣya pitar etat te 'muṣya pitāmahaitat te ’muṣya prapitāmaheti pravasati yajamāno’dhvaryuḥ |
śaṅkhalikhitau |
sarvānnaprakāram ādāya piṇḍān nidadhyād ekaikaṃ trir abhimantrayāsāv etat ta iti darbheṣu |
"atraikaikaṃ piṇḍaṃ pṛthivī rakṣitetyādinaikaikena mantreṇa trir abhimantryāsāv etat ta iti nidadhyāt" iti mahārṇavaprakāśakārāḥ |
ekaikam ekaikasmin piṇḍe viniyuñjānas tān mantrān pratīkagrahaṇena
darśayati yamaḥ |
pūrvaṃ piṇḍaṃ prayacchet tu pitryaṃ tu pṛthivīti ca |
pitāmahāya tv aparam antarikṣeti dāpayet ||
prapitāmahāya tatas tṛtīyaṃ tu nivedayet |
dyaur darvir iti mantreṇa śrutir eṣā purātanī ||
viṣṇur apy āha |
ucchiṣṭasaṃnidhau dakṣiṇāgreṣu darbheṣu pṛthivī darvir akṣitety ekaṃ piṇḍaṃ pitre nidadhyāt | antarikṣaṃ darvir akṣiteti dvitīyaṃ pitāmahāya, dyaur darvir akṣiteti tṛtīyaṃ prapitāmahāyeti |
asyārthaṃ hariharo vyākhyātavān | pṛthivī darvir akṣitā tṛptiḥ svadhānupasnātāṃ pṛthivī darvim akṣitāṃ tṛptiṃ svadhām anupastām agnir iva pṛthivīm upajīvāsau ye cātra tvānveṣānte svadhā ity anena mantreṇaikaṃ piṇḍaṃ pitre nidadhyāt | antarikṣaṃ darvir akṣitā tṛptiḥ | svadhānupadasnāṃ tadantarikṣaṃ [1441] darvim akṣitāṃ tṛptiṃ svadhām anupadastāṃ vāyur ivāntarikṣam upajīvāsau ye cātra tvām anveṣā te svadheti dvitīyaṃ piṇḍaṃ pitāmahāya nidadhyāt | dyaur darvir akṣitā tṛptiḥ svadhānupadastā tāṃ divaṃ darvim akṣitāṃ tṛptiṃ svadhām anupadastāṃ sūrya iva divam upajīvāsau ye cātra tvāṃ tv eṣāṃ te svadheti mantreṇa tṛtīyaṃ piṇḍaṃ prapitāmahāya nidadhyāt |
mantrārtho ’pi tenaiva vyākhyātaḥ | yeyaṃ prasiddhā pṛthivī saiṣeyaṃ prathamapiṇḍarūpeṇāvasthitā | anena ca prathamapiṇḍe pṛthivībuddhiḥ kartavyeti gamyate | iyaṃ cānnasādhanatvāśrayatvābhyāṃ darvisārūpyād darvī | satkarmasādhanībhāvadvāreṇa dūritadāraṇād vā darviḥ | 'akṣitā tṛptiḥ’| avināśinī tṛptiḥ | carācarair bhūtair aharahas tṛptisādhanatvenopajīvyamānāpi na kṣīyata ity arthaḥ | 'svadhā' alaukikapitṛprītihetutvāt | 'anupadastā' dasur upakṣaye anupakṣīṇāpacayarahitety arthaḥ | tāṃ pṛthivīṃ darvim akṣitāṃ tṛptiṃ svadhām anupadastāṃ prathamapiṇḍarūpāṃ 'upajīva' bhuṅkṣva | 'asāvity atra prathamapiṇḍoddeśyasya pitrādeḥ saṃbuddhyantaṃ nāma prayojyaṃ, he pitaḥ he mātāmahetyādi | 'agnir iva' yathāgniḥ pṛthivyadhipatir bhūtvā prasiddhāṃ pṛthivīm upajīvati tathā anena ca prathamapiṇḍoddeśye ’gnitulyatābuddhiḥ kartavyeti gamyate | ‘ye ca tvām anu' ye cātra paraloke tvām anusthitāḥ tavānucarabhūtās te 'py upajīvantu | 'eṣā te svadhā' tvadarthā eṣā svadhā, bhavatīti śeṣaḥ | antarīkṣaṃ tamodāraṇād annasādhanatvād darviḥ | annasādhanaṃ tvaṃ ca tuṣṭihetutvāt | antarīkṣād dhi dṛṣṭir jāyate | 'vāyur iva' yathā vāyur adhipatir bhūtvāntarikṣam upajīvati tathā tvam etam evaṃrūpaṃ piṇḍam | anena dvitīyapiṇḍoddeśye pitāmahādau [1442] vāyutulyatābuddhiḥ kartavyeti gamyate | dyaus tu duḥkhadāraṇād darviḥ | svargasya niratiśayasukhātmakatvāt duḥkhadārakatvam | 'sūrya iva' yathā sūryo ’dhipatir bhūtvā divam upajīvati | anena tṛtīyapiṇḍoddeśye prapitāmahādau sūryatulyatvabuddhiḥ kartavyeti gamyate | 'asāv' ity atra tṛtīyapiṇḍoddeśyasya prapitāmahādeḥ saṃbudhyantaṃ nāma prayojyam | śeṣaṃ gatārtham | śaunakātharvaṇaśrāddhakalpe tv etair eva mantraiḥ piṇḍārthannoddharaṇam uktvā etat te prapitāmahaitat te pitāmahaitat te pitar iti mantraiḥ prapitāmahād ārabhya pitṛparyantaṃ viparītena krameṇa piṇḍadānam uktam | 'dyau darvir akṣiteti' tisṛbhiḥ sarvānnaprakāram uddhṛtyājyena saṃnīya trīn piṇḍān asaṃhatān nidadhāty etat te prapitāmaha iti | pippalādātharvaṇaśrāddhakalpe ’pi “pṛthivī darvir iti sarvānnaprakārān uddhṛtyājyena saṃnīya barhiṣada iti darbhān dakṣiṇāgrān paristīrya etat te tata iti trīn piṇḍān asaṃhatān dadyāt” iti | tad evam eṣu mantreṣu pitrādīnām agnivāyusūryopamatvābhidhānād arthāt teṣām agnyādisārūpyeṇānusaṃdhānaṃ kāryam iti gamyate |
vyāsavacane tu varuṇādirūpatvenānusaṃdhānaṃ kartavyam iti prakāśate |
prathamo varuṇo devaḥ prajāpatir athāparaḥ |
tṛtīyo ’gniḥ smṛtaḥ piṇḍa eṣa piṇḍavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ || iti |
atra piṇḍadevatārūpāḥ pitrādayo varuṇādirūpeṇa dhyeyā ity evaṃparam idaṃ vākyam iti smṛticandrikākāreṇoktam | "aniruddhaḥ svayaṃ devaḥ" ityādi bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaprakāreṇa vā piṇḍeṣu devatābhidhyānaṃ kartavyam | tatra hi śrāddhakartā svasvarūpam aniruddharūpeṇa dhyeyam | prathamoddeśyas tu pradyumnarūpeṇa, dvitīyas tu saṃkarṣaṇarūpeṇa, tṛtīyas tu vāsudevarūpeṇa dhyeya [1443] ity uktam | etac ca sarvaṃ pūrvam eva vistareṇa pratipāditam | atraitāvat saṃpannam | varuṇādirūpeṇa pitrādīn anusaṃdadhānas tān uddiśya piṇḍān dadyād iti |
piṇḍadāne mantrāntaram āha vyāsaḥ |
brūyāc chrāddheṣu sāvitrīṃ piṇḍe piṇḍe samāhitaḥ |
somāyeti ca vaktavyaṃ tathā pitṛmate ’pi ca ||
atha dvipitṛkaṃ kartāraṃ prati piṇḍapitṛyajñasūtre viśeṣam upadiśaty
āpastambaḥ |
yadi dvipitā syād ekaikamsin piṇḍe dau dvāv upalakṣayet || iti |
yo hi kṣetrajādir dvipitṛkaḥ syāt sa tu piṇḍān nirvapann ekaikasmin piṇḍe dvau dvāv upalakṣayed uddiśet prathame piṇḍe dvau pitarau, dvitīye dvau pitāmahau, tṛtīye dvau prapitāmahāv iti |
etad api pūrvam eva vistareṇoktam | pitrādīnām ajñāne tu piṇḍadāne mantrāntarāṇi darśayati sa eva |
yadi bandhuṃ na vindyāt svadhā pitṛbhyaḥ pṛthivīṣadbhya iti prathamaṃ piṇḍaṃ dadyāt | svadhā pitṛbhyo 'ntarīkṣasadbhya iti dvitīyam | svadhā pitṛbhyo diviṣadbhya iti tṛtīyam iti |
bandhuśabdena nāmābhidhīyate |
tathā ca gobhilaḥ |
yadi nāmāni na vindyāt svadhā pitṛbhyaḥ pṛthivīṣadbhya iti prathamaṃ piṇḍaṃ nidadhyāt | svadhā pitṛbhyo 'ntarīkṣasadbhya iti dvitīyam | svadhā pitṛbhyo diviṣadbhya iti tṛtīyaṃ nidhāya japaty atra pitaro mādayadhvam || iti |
[1444] gotrājñāne tu vyāghrapāt |
gotranāśe tu kāśyapa iti |
gotrājñāne kāśyapagotragrahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ, kāśyapagotrasya sarvasādhāraṇatvāt |
tathā ca śatapathaśrutiḥ |
tasmād āhuḥ sarvāḥ prajāḥ kāśyapya iti |
yad etat pitrādīnāṃ gotranāmnor ajñāne ’bhihitaṃ tan mātāmahādīnām api veditavyam |
jīvatpitṛkaṃ kartāraṃ tu pratipiṇḍadāne niṣedham āha āpastambaḥ |
yadi jīvatpitā na dadyād dhomān kṛtvā viramet || iti |
etac ca piṇḍapitṛyajñam adhikṛtyāpy uktaṃ tulyanyāyatvād anyad api piṇḍadānaṃ niṣeddhuṃ prabhavaty eva | vaikalpikaś cāyaṃ niṣedhaḥ | etac ca pūrvam eva prapañcenopapāditam | atra ṣaḍdaivatyādau śrāddhe piṇḍadāne ca svatantre vā mātāmahādidaivatye pitrādigotrasaṃbandha-nāmnāṃ sthāne mātāmahādigotrasaṃbandhanāmāni prayujya prayogo ’nuṣṭheyaḥ |
tad āha āpastambagṛhyabhāṣyārthasaṃgrahakāraḥ |
yojyaḥ pitrādiśabdānāṃ sthāne mātāmahādikaḥ |
annahome tathā sparśe jalapiṇḍādidānake |
yan me mātāmahītyādi tatrodāharaṇaṃ bhavet || iti ||
'annahome' yan me mātā pralulobha caraty anuvrajetyādibhir mantrair agnaukaraṇānnahome | ‘sparśe' eṣa te tata madhumān ūrmiḥ sarasvān ityādibhir mantrair brāhmaṇabhojanārthannasparśe | 'jalapiṇḍādidānake' mārjayantāṃ [1445] mama pitara ityādijaladānamantre etat te ’sau ye ca tvām anv ityādipiṇḍadānamantre ca pitrādiśabdānāṃ sthāne mātāmahādikaḥ śabdo yojyaḥ | 'yan me mātāmahītyādi tatrodāharaṇaṃ bhaved ity asyāyam arthaḥ | tathā ca pitrādisthāne mātāmahādiśabdaprayoge yan me mātā pralulobha caraty anuvratā tan me retaḥ pitā vṛṅanām iti mantre mātāmahānāṃ home kartavye mantragatamātṛpadasthāne mātāmahīpadaprakṣepeṇa yan me mātāmahī pralulobhety evaṃsaṃpanna ūhas tan me reto mātāmaho vṛṅnām ity evamādīnāṃ cikīrṣitānām ūhānām udāharaṇam | ayaṃ ca āpastambagṛhyānusāribhir ūho grahītavyaḥ | anyais tv etad udāharaṇīkṛtya svasvagṛhyābhimatamantragatāni pitrādipadāny ūhitavyāni | tatra ṣaḍdaivatye pitṛvargāya piṇḍārthāṃ lekhāṃ kṛtvā mātāmahavargāya piṇḍārthāṃ kuryāt | ekaikaśaḥ pitṛvargāya piṇḍatrayasthāne ’vanejanaṃ kṛttvā mātāmahavargīya piṇḍacayasthāne’vanejanaṃ kuryāt | evam anyam apy ekaikaṃ padārthaṃ pitṛvargīyapiṇḍeṣu samāpya mātāmahavargīyeṣu samāpayed ity eṣa padārthakramo 'nusaṃdheyaḥ | navadaivatye dvādaśadaivatye vā śrāddhe piṇḍadāne ca prastute sati tanmadhyavartini strīdaivatye svatantre vā taddaivatye strīliṅgāni gotrasaṃbandhanāmāni prayujya prayogaḥ kāryaḥ | ye ca tvām anv ity ayaṃ mantro yāś ca tvām anv iti prayojyaḥ | tatra navadaivatye pitṛvargīyapiṇḍāthāṃ lekhāṃ kṛtvā tataḥ paścimena mātṛvargīyapiṇḍārthāṃ tato 'pi paścimena mātāmāhavargīyapiṇḍārthāṃ kuryāt | avanejanabarhirāstaraṇādy apy anenaiva krameṇa kartavyam |
tad etad āpastambagṛhye pitṛvargamātṛvargāv āśrityoktam |
dvaidhaṃ dakṣiṇāgrān darbhān saṃstīrya teṣūttarair apo datvottarair [1446] dakṣiṇāpavargān datveti |
dvidhābhūtaṃ yathā bhavati tathā dakṣiṇāgrān darbhān ullikhitadeśe saṃstīrya tatra pūrvabhāge pitrādivargārthaṃ saṃstaraṇaṃ paścādbhāge tu mātrādivargārtham, strībhyaś ca piṇḍā iha paścimā syur iti gṛhyabhāṣyārthasaṃgrahakāravākyāt, tathādhikaṃ viśeṣam upadiśataḥ śāṅkhyanagṛhyakāravacanāt | bhuktavatsu piṇḍān dadyāt purastād eke piṇḍān paścimena tatpatnīnāṃ kiṃcid antardhāyeti pitṛvargapiṇḍebhyaḥ paścimena tṛṇādikaṃ kiṃcid antardhāya pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahapatnībhyaḥ piṇḍān dadyād iti |
matsyapurāṇe |
tataḥ kṛtāntare dadyāt tatpatnībhyaḥ kuśān budhaḥ |
tadvat piṇḍādikaṃ kuryād āvāhanavisarjanam || iti |
'uttaraiḥ' mārjayantām ityādibhir mantraiḥ punaḥ 'uttaraiḥ' etat te tatāsāv ityādibhiḥ |
śaunakātharvaṇaśrāddhakalpe tu pitṛvargād dakṣiṇato mātṛvargīyapiṇḍadānam
uktam |
dakṣiṇataḥ patnībhyaḥ idaṃ vaḥ patnyā iti |
devalena ca strīvarge catvāraḥ piṇḍā uktāḥ |
haviḥśeṣaṃ tato muṣṭim ādāyaikaikam āditaḥ |
kramaśaḥ pitṛpatnīnāṃ piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ caret ||
tataḥ piṇḍam upādāya haviṣaḥ saṃskṛtaṃ mahat |
jñātivargasya sarvasya sāmānyam iti nirvapet ||
[1447] tad evam etat siddhaṃ prathamaṃ pitṛvargāya piṇḍadānaṃ, tato mātṛvargāya, tato mātāmahavargāyeti (?) |
tad āha satyavrataḥ |
pitṝṇāṃ prathamaṃ dānaṃ mātṝṇāṃ tadanantaram |
tato mātāmahānāṃ ca kramaś caivaṃ prakīrtyate ||
ayaṃ ca kramaḥ sarvakālike navadevatye śrāddhe na tv aṣṭakākālanirvartya
evaikasmin |
yat tu brahmāṇḍapurāṇavacanam,
pitṛbhyaḥ prathamaṃ dadyān mātṛbhyas tadanantaram |
tato mātāmahebhyaś cety anvaṣṭakyaḥ kramaḥ smṛtaḥ || iti |
tat tūpalakṣaṇārtham | tad evaṃ navadaivatye mātṛvargasya deśataḥ kālataś ca madhye niveśa uktaḥ |
tasyānyathākaraṇe doṣam āha uśanāḥ |
antar mātāmahān kṛtvā mātṝṇāṃ yaḥ prayacchati |
śrāddhaṃ vā piṇḍadānṃ vā pitṝṇāṃ nopatiṣṭhate ||
āha satyavrataḥ |
antar mātāmahān kṛtvā mātṝṇāṃ yaḥ prayacchati |
śrāddhaṃ vā piṇḍadānaṃ vā narakaṃ sa tu gacchati ||
gārgyo 'py āha |
ante niveśayed yas tu mātṝḥ śrāddheṣu mānavaḥ |
sa mūḍho narakaṃ yāti kālasutram avākśirāḥ ||
yat tūktārthaṃ viruddhavacanam |
[1448] pitṛmātāmahāv ādau mātaras tadanantaram |
tarpaṇe ’nvaṣṭakāśrāddhe tīrthe cāyaṃ kramaḥ smṛtaḥ || iti |
tat yeṣāṃ pūrvapurūṣaparampaparayānuṣṭhitārthaṃ teṣām eva śreyase ’stu | yaś cāyaṃ mātṛvargasya madhye niveśo ’bhihitaḥ sa nāndīmukhavyatiriktanavadaivatye nāndīmukhe tv ādāv eva niveśaḥ |
ata eva ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
kṣayāhe kevalāḥ kāryā vṛddhāv ādau prakīrtitāḥ |
sarvatraiva hi madhyasthā nāntyāḥ kāryās tu mātaraḥ ||
'sarvvatra' iti mahālayānvaṣṭakāgayādiśrāddhapiṇḍadānādau |
atra yeṣāṃ gṛhyakārair amāvāsyādau mātṛśrāddhaṃ pṛthakvihitaṃ tair dvādaśadaivatyaṃ śrāddhaṃ kartavyam |
pitaro yatra pūjyante tatra mātāmahā dhruvam |
iti vacanāt mātāmahaśrāddhe ’pi kartavye prāpte prakṛtivad vikṛtir iti nyāyāt pṛthaṅ mātāmahīvargasyāpi śrāddhaṃ kartavyaṃ saṃmataṃ ca śiṣṭānāṃ pitṛśrāddhavikṛtitvaṃ mātāmahaśrāddhasya |
ata eva mātāmahaśrāddhe pitṛśrāddhadharmātideśa āpastambagṛhyabhāṣyārthasaṃgrahakāreṇa darśitaḥ |
mātāmahānām apy evaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryāt prayatnataḥ || iti |
atra mātāmahīvargasya mātāmahebhyaḥ paścimataḥ sarvānte niveśaḥ | uktaprāyaś cātra padārthānuṣṭhānakramaḥ | yeṣāṃ tu gṛhyakārair amāvāsyāyāṃ mātṛśrāddhaṃ pṛthak noktaṃ tair amāvāsyādau pitrādyuddeśe kriyamāṇe mapatnīkābhidhānaṃ kartavyam |
iti devatāmantrakramasaṅkhyāvikalpasahitaṃ
piṇḍadānākhyaṃ pradhānam |
[1449]
atha hastonmārjanam |
tac ca piṇḍanirvapānantaraṃ maitrāyaṇīyapiṇḍapitṛyajñasūtre darbheṣu piṇḍaṃ samantrakam uktam |
barhiṣi lepaṃ nimārṣṭi yātra pitaraḥ svadhā tathā yūyaṃ yathābhāgaṃ mādayadhvam ity atra pitaro mādayadhvam || iti |
mānavamaitrāyaṇīyapiṇḍapitṛyajñasūtre tu prathamamantrasya dakṣiṇāṃ diśam anvīkṣamāṇo japatīti dakṣiṇābhimukhyena japamātre viniyogo darśitaḥ | 'barhiṣi' iti darbheṣu |
atra darbhāṇāṃ mūlamadhyāgreṣu madhyaikasminn avalepamārjanaṃ kāryam ity apekṣāyāṃ mantrāntaram upadiśann āha viṣṇuḥ |
atra pitaro mādayadhvam iti darbhamūleṣu karāvagharṣaṇam || iti |
asya tu mantrasya piṇḍābhimukhyena japamātre viniyogo bahusaṃmataḥ | sa tu purastād darśayiṣyate |
vyāghro ’py āha |
darbhamūleṣu nimsṛjed dhastalepaṃ samāhitaḥ || iti |
iha kasya padārthasyānantaraṃ keṣāṃ ca darbhāṇāṃ mūle kāṃś ca pitṝn uddiśya lepamārjanam ity apekṣāyām āha manuḥ |
puṣpapiṇḍān pitṛbhyaś ca prayato vidhipūrvakam |
teṣu darbheṣu taṃ hastaṃ nimṛjyāl lepabhāginām ||
puṣpadarbheṣu nidhāya | 'prayataḥ' prayatnaviśeṣavān | atraikāgratvādirūpo manodharmaḥ padārthavismṛtirūpapramādaparihāropayogī prayatno grāhyaḥ | anuvādaś cāyaṃ sarvaprayogārthatvenāsya prāptatvāt | 'vidhipūrvakam' [1450] iti śāstrāntaradṛṣṭavidhyupasaṃgrahārthaṃ manuśāstroktavidhipūrvakatvābhidhāne tv asyānarthakyaṃ syāt | ‘teṣu darbheṣu' iti yeṣu piṇḍanirvāpaḥ kṛtaḥ | 'tam' iti yena piṇḍadānaṃ kṛtam | 'lepabhāginām' iti lepabhāginaḥ pitṝn uddiśya | te ca matsyapurāṇe darśitāḥ |
lepabhājaś caturthādyāḥ pitrādyāḥ piṇḍabhāginaḥ |
piṇḍadaḥ saptamas teṣāṃ sāpiṇḍyaṃ sāptapauruṣam || iti |
'caturthādyāḥ' vṛddhaprapitāmahaprabhṛtayaḥ | tad evam ayaṃ śrāddhakartā vṛddhaprapitāmahādīṃs trīn uddiśya teṣām ayaṃ bhāgo ’stv ity abhidadhānaḥ prathamapiṇḍādhārabhūtadarbhamūleṣu hastaṃ nimṛjyāt | nimārjanaṃ ca hastalagnasyānnasyodakasya vāparecanāya darbheṣu saṃśleṣaṇam | ataś ca yadi haste lepo ’sti tarhi tasya recanākhyapratipattyarthaṃ mārjanaṃ kartavyaṃ nānyathety ekaṃ mataṃ |
aparam api mataṃ medhātithi-hariharābhyāṃ darśitam | tad yathā |
yadi na kiṃcid api haste saṃśiṣyet tathāpi hastaṃ nimsṛjyād eva | na hy etat pratipattikarmaiva yenāsati recanaprayojane na kriyeta | na hy atra śrūyate hastalagnaṃ nimmṛjyād iti | kiṃ tarhi hastam eveti |
nanu ca lepabhāginām iti śrūyate, tatrāsati lepe na prāpnoti | ucyate | sākṣādrūpam annaṃ kadācin na śliṣyati | piṇḍeṣu tu vartamāneṣv annarasas tad uṣmā ca saṃkramaty eva haste | sa eva cānnalepa ity ucyate | ṣaṣṭhī cātra nimājanasya lepabhāgisasvandhitām (?) āha | na ca lepabhāginaḥ pratyakṣadṛśyāḥ santi yeṣāṃ svasvāmyādisaṃbandho (?) lepasya kriyate | tasmād avidyamāne ’pi sākṣād annalepe ’nnarasaṃ taduṣmāṇaṃ vā lepasaṃjñakaṃ haste saṃkrāntaṃ lepabhāginām ayaṃ bhāgo 'stv iti bruvan darbhamūleṣu nimsṛjyād eva |
[1451] ata eva viṣṇunā karamātragharṣaṇam uktam |
darbhamūleṣu karāvagharṣaṇam || iti |
hastalepamārjanānantaram udakumbhena tarpaṇam āha yamaḥ |
tato darbheṣu taṃ hastaṃ nimṛjyāt lepabhāginām |
tataḥ pānīyakumbhena tarpayet prayataḥ pitṝn ||
etac ca tarpaṇaṃ dakṣiṇādānānantaraṃ vadatā devalena tasya prakāro ’pi darśitaḥ |
tato muṣṭim upādāya haviṣo ’ntas tataḥ svayam |
kalaśaṃ jalasaṃpūrṇaṃ gṛhītvobhayam eva ca ||
pitṝṇāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca hastāgrāt prabhṛti kṣaran |
apasavyaṃ kramāt (?) sarvāṃs tāṃs tu piṇḍān bahirmukhaḥ ||
trir evaṃ pātragaṃ toyaṃ parītya śrāvayec chanaiḥ |
parikramya ca tat pātraṃ tatraivāpy avakubjayet ||
iti hastonmārjanam |
athācamanādayaḥ piṇḍadānodīcyāṅgabhūtāḥ padārthaḥ |
tatrāha manuḥ |
ācamyodak parāvṛtya trir āyamya śanair asūn |
ṣaḍ apy ṛtūn namaskuryāt pitṝn eva ca mantravat ||
hastamārjanānantaram ācamanaṃ kuryāt | etac cācamanaṃ hastaprakṣālanapūrvakaṃ triś ca kartavyam |
tathā ca brahmapurāṇe |
tato darbheṣu vidhivat saṃmārjya ca karau tataḥ |
prakṣālya ca jalenātha trir ācamya hariṃ smaret ||
[1452] trir iti nirvartya pitṛkarmāṇi "sakṛd ācamanaṃ cared" ity asyāpavādārtham | tac ca yajñopavītinā kartavyam | ācamanānantaraṃ pūrvadhṭtān darbhān parityajya darbhāntarāṇi dhārayet | etac cācamanaṃ pitṛbhyo gandhādidānānantaraṃ kecid ācaranti | apare tu tatra cātra cety ubhayam apy ācaranti | ācamanānantaraṃ 'udak parāvṛtya' udīcīṃ diśaṃ prati parivṛtya parivartanenottarābhimukho bhūtvety arthaḥ | 'triḥ' trivāraṃ, 'āyamya' nirudhya | 'śanaiḥ' yathā nātipīḍā bhavati | 'asūn' prāṇān | “praṇavasaṃyuktāṃ gāyatrīṃ śirasā saha" ityādivihitān trīn prāṇāyāmān kṛtveti medhātithiḥ | vinaiva mantraṃ prāṇān āyamyeti tu karkādibahusaṃmatam | te ca kātyāyanādivacaneṣu prāṇanirodhamātraśravaṇāt tāvanmātrasya vivakṣitatvaṃ manyante | ‘ṛtūn’ vasantādīn, namaskuryāt | pitṝn namaskuryāt | etac ca namaskāradvayaṃ 'mantravat' mantrasaṃyuktaṃ kartavyam |
tatra tu namaskāre mantro brahmapurāṇe |
vasantāya namas tubhyaṃ grīṣmāya ca namo namaḥ |
varṣābhyaś ca śaratsaṃjña-ṛtave ca namaḥ sadā ||
hemantāya namas tubhyaṃ namas te śiśirāya ca |
māsasaṃvatsarebhyaś ca divasebhyo namo namaḥ || iti |
pitṛnamaskāre tu mantraḥ |
namo vaḥ pitaraḥ iṣetyādi darśayiṣyate | atra piṇḍānumantraṇapūrvakam udakparāvartanam | tac ca savyam aṅgaṃ puraskṛtyāpasavyaṃ vā | prāṇāyāmaś cottarābhimukhasyaivāvasthitasya | namaskāras tu piṇḍābhimukhāvartanādinīvi[1453]mokṣāntakarmānantaraṃ vidheya ity ete viśeṣāḥ śāstrāntarāt grahītavyāḥ |
tatra tāvat kātyāyanasūtre |
atra pitara ity ukvodaṅgāsta ātamanād āvṛtyāmīmadanteti japati |
atra pitara iti pratīkagrahaṇena samagro mantro darśitaḥ | sa ca viniyogaḥ savyākhyānaś cāmnātaḥ śatapathe |
tatra japaty atra pitaro mādayadhvaṃ yathābhāgam āvṛṣāyadhvam iti yathābhāgam aśnītety etad āheti |
tatreti piṇḍeṣu nihiteṣu | piṇḍasaṃmukhaḥ sthitvātra pitara ityādikam āvṛṣāyadhvam ity antaṃ mantraṃ japet | yathābhāgam ityādi vyācaṣṭe, yathābhāgam aśnītetyādinā | ‘udaṅgāste’ udaṅmukho bhūtvā 'āste' āsīta | udaṅmukhībhāvaś cāpradakṣiṇāvartanenety upādhyāyakarkaḥ |
ukraṃ ca āśvalāyanasūtre |
nivṛtān anumantrayetātra pitaro mādayadhvaṃ yathābhāgam āvṛṣāyadhvam iti savyāvṛd udaṅgāvṛtyeti |
'nivṛtān' vidhipūrvakaṃ darbheṣu nihitān | 'savyāvṛt' savyaprakārakaṃ savyam aṅgaṃ puraskṛtyāpasapavyaṃ paścāt kurvan parivarteta apadakṣiṇaṃ parivartetety arthaḥ | udaṅgety anenodagantam evāvartanaṃ kartavyam iti gamyate |
viṣṇunāpy uktam |
datvā ca piṇḍān nivṛtān anumantrayetātra pitaro mādayadhvaṃ yathābhāgam āvṛṣāyadhvam iti | tataḥ savyāvṛd uṅmukhaḥ parāvṛtyeti |
etac ca savyāvṛd āvarttanaṃ keṣāṃcid eva kartṝṇāṃ na sarveṣām |
atra ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
vāmenāvartanaṃ kecid udagantaṃ pracakṣate |
[1454] sarvaṃ gautama-śāṇḍilyau śāṇḍilyāyana eva ca || iti ||
‘vāmena' vāmamaṅgaṃ puraskṛtyety arthaḥ | 'udagantaṃ' yāvad udaṅmukho bhavati tāvad eva nādhikam | 'kecid' iti gautama-śāṇḍilya-śāṇḍilyāyanākhyamunivyatiriktā munayaḥ | gautamādayas tu 'sarvaṃ' sarvaprakāraṃ savyenāpasavyena parāvartanaṃ pracakṣate | 'udaṅgāsta' ity asya kālāvadhim āha, ‘ātamanāt’ ‘tamanaṃ' glāniḥ, tadavadhi | atrodaṅmukhāvasthānamātreṇa tamanāsambhavāc chvāsanirodhanātmakaṃ śāstrāntaropadiṣṭaṃ tamanakāraṇam anuṣṭheyatayā sūcitam |
tad āha āśvalāyanaḥ |
yathāśakty aprāṇann āsitveti |
'yathāśakti' śaktim anatikramya | 'aprāṇan' prāṇānirodhanaṃ kṛtvety arthaḥ |
tad āha viṣṇuḥ |
yathāśakti prāṇānirodhanaṃ kṛtveti |
tadanantaraṃ 'āvṛtya' āvartanākhyakriyayā piṇḍābhimukham etya | āvartanaṃ ca tenaiva mārgeṇeti karkaḥ |
ata eva karmapradīpe |
āvṛtya prāṇam āyamya pitṝn dhyāyan yathārhataḥ |
japaṃs tenaiva cāvṛtya tataḥ prāṇan pramocayet || iti |
'japan' amīmadanteti mantram iti śeṣaḥ | 'tenaiva' vāmenaiva mārgeṇa | [1455] prāṇān 'pramocayet' ucchvased ity arthaḥ | atra japato ’bhyāvṛttiḥ pratipāditā | kātyāyanādau tv abhyāvṛttyuttarakālaṃ japa ity etāvān viśeṣaḥ | āvṛtyāmīmadanteti japati | atra pratīkagrahaṇena samagro mantro darśitaḥ |
tad etat sarvaṃ sārthavādake savyākhyānaṃ samagraitanmantrasahitaṃ śatapathe śrūyate |
atha parāṅ parāvartate tira iva vai pitaro manuṣyebhyas tira iva vai tad bhavati sa vai ātamitor āsītety āhur etāvān eva hy asur iti sa vai muhūrtam evāsitvāthopapallayya (?) japaty amīmadanta pitaro yathābhāgam āvṛaṣāyīṣateti yathābhāgam āśiṣur ity avaitad āheti |
'athetyatra pitara ityādimantrajapānantaram | 'parāṅ' piṇḍāpekṣayā parācīno yathā bhavati, udaṅmukha ity arthaḥ | 'parāvartate' upaviṣṭa evāpradakṣiṇaṃ bhramann iva gacchati | parāṅ paryāvartate na hetuvan nigadatulyo ’rthavādaḥ | 'tira iva vai pitaro manuṣyebhyaḥ’, ‘tiraḥ' tirohitāḥ | ivaśabdaḥ kilārthe hi śabdārthe vā, bhuñjānāḥ kila lajjayā pitaro manuṣyebhyas tirobhavitum icchanti |
tathā ca taittirīyabrāhmaṇe parāṅ āvartate hrīkā hi pitara iti |
'hrīkāḥ' hrīmanta ity arthaḥ | parāṅ paryāvartanaṃ ca 'tiraḥ' | dakṣiṇataḥ piṇḍarūpam annaṃ bhuñjānān pitṝn udaṅmukhasya kartus tirohitān karotīti kṛtvā tad etad anurūpam apekṣitaṃ ca kṛtvā pitṝṇāṃ kṛtaṃ syāt | 'ātamitoḥ' ātamanāt | śvāsanirodhajapīḍāvadhi | 'etāvān eva hy asuḥ' | etāvad eva jīvitaṃ yāvat tamanam iti avivakṣito ’yam avadhir ity āha | 'sa [1456] vai muhūrtam eveti | muhūrtaśabdenātra śvāsanirodhajanitaglāneḥ prācīnaḥ kiyān api kālo lakṣyate | 'upapallayya' punaḥ piṇḍābhimukham āvṛtya | 'āśiṣur' iti bhuktavanta ity arthaḥ |
āśvalāyano ’py āha |
abhiparyāvṛtyāmīmadanta pitaro yathābhāgam āvṛṣāyīṣateti |
anena mantreṇa piṇḍān anumantrayatety arthaḥ |
tad āha viṣṇuḥ |
paryāvṛtyāmīmadantety āmantryeti
rāṇāyaṇīyasūtrakṛtā gobhilena tv amīmadantety asya mantrasya japaḥ paryāvartamānena kartavya ity uktam |
piṇḍān nidhāya japaty atra pitaro mādayadhvaṃ yathābhāgam āvṛṣādhvam ity aparyavṛtya purocchvāsād (?) abhiparyāvarttamāno japed amīmadanta pitaro yathābhāgam āvṛṣāyīṣateti |
atra piṇḍanidhānānantaram āpastambena mantrāntarapradarśanapūrvakaṃ kātyāyanādyuktayor mantrayoḥ pāṭhāntareṇa saha viniyogo darśitaḥ |
yan me mātā pramamāda yac cacārānanuvrataṃ tan me retaḥ pitā vṛṅnāmāyur anyopapadyatāṃ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhāyibhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ, pitāmahebhyaḥ svadhāyibhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ, prapitāmahebhyaḥ svadhāyibhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ, ity upasthāyātra pitaro yathābhāgaṃ mādadhvam ity uktvāparāṅāvartate omaṇovyāvṛtteḥ upāste ’mīmadantaḥ pitaraḥ sāmyāḥ iti vyāvṛtta.uṣmāṇy abhiparyāvartate ’vyāvṛtto veti |
ā uṣmaṇo vyāvṛtteḥ piṇḍoṣmāpagamaṃ maryādīkṛtyety arthaḥ | tadanantaram [1457] amīmadantety anena mantreṇa piṇḍābhimukham āvarteta | atrāmīmadantety asyānantaraṃ kaiścit piṇḍāvaśiṣṭānnāvaghrāṇam uktvā pratyavanejanam uktam |
tathā ca āśvalāyanasūtre |
caroḥ prāṇabhakṣyaṃ bhakṣayen nityaṃ ninayanam || iti |
nāsikayā vahatā prāṇena bhakṣaṇam avaghrāṇaṃ tad yathā niṣpadyate tathā caroḥ piṇḍāvaśiṣṭasya bhakṣayet | piṇḍāvaśiṣṭam annam avajighred ity arthaḥ | anantaraṃ 'nityaṃ' niyamena, 'ninayanaṃ' udakaninayanaṃ pratyavanejanam ity arthaḥ |
viṣṇunāpy uktam |
amīmadantety anumantrya śeṣāvaghrāṇaṃ kṛtvā śundhantāṃ pitara iti pūrvavad udakaninayanam || iti |
āpastambasūtre tu piṇḍāvaśeṣasyāvaghrāṇam uktvā tasya samantrakaṃ kāmyaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ coktvā pratyavanejanam uktam |
yaḥ sthālyāṃ śeṣas tam avajighrati ye samānāḥ samanasaḥ pitaro yamarājye teṣāṃ lokaḥ svadhā namo yajño deveṣu kalpyatām, vīraṃ me datta pitara ity āmayāvinā prāśyānnādyakāmena prāśyo yo 'lam annādyāya tena vā prāśyaḥ pūrvavad ekasphyāyāṃ trīn udakāñjalīn upaninīyeti |
'āmayāvī' rogī | asyaucityād roganivṛttikāmatā acikitsyarogābhitaptasya viśiṣṭalokakāmitā veti gamyate | annādyam annaṃ tatkāmo ’pi bhakṣayet | yo vānnādyāya alaṃ samarthaḥ san nādyāt | annasaṃpanno bhūtvāpi tīkṣṇatarajaṭharavaiśvānaraviraheṇa haviḥprācuryābhāvād annaṃ bhuṅkte so 'pi rucikāmyayā prāśnīyād ity arthaḥ | etac ca dvayaṃ maitrāyaṇīyapariśiṣṭe namaskārānantaram uktam | śeṣam annam iva jighred [1458] āmayāvy annādyakāmo vā prāśnīyād iti |
atra śeṣāvaghrāṇasyārthavādatvam uktaṃ taittirīyabrāhmaṇe |
brahmavādino vadanti prāśyāṃ na prāśyām iti yat prāśnīyāj jaghanyam annam adyāt pramāyukaḥ syād yan na prāśnīyāt ahaviḥ syāt pitṛbhya āvṛścyeta avaghreyam eva tanneva prāśitam aprāśitam || iti |
'brahmavādinaḥ' vedavādinaḥ | 'vadanti' saṃśayya nirṇayanti | 'jaghanyaṃ' amaṅgalyam | ‘pramāyukaḥ’ apamṛtyumān | śeṣabhakṣaṇarūpapratipattyabhāvād āhaviṣṭvam (?) | ata eva tad annaṃ pitṛbhyaḥ 'āvṛścyeta' ucchidyetety arthaḥ | uktaṃ śeṣāvaghrāṇaṃ piṇḍāvaghrāṇaṃ tu purastād darśayiṣyate |
atrāmīmadanteti mantrajapānantaraṃ pratyavanejanāt prabhṛty ulmukanidhānāntāni piṇḍadānāny āha kātyāyanaḥ |
amīmadanteti japaty avanejya pūrvavat nīvīṃ visraṃsya namo va ity añjaliṃ karoty etad va ity upāsyati sūtrāṇi pratipiṇḍam ūrṇa daśā vā vayasy uttare yajamānalomāni vorjam ity apo niṣiñcaty adhāyāvajighrati yajamāna ulmukasakṛdācchinnāny agnau || iti |
atra pūrvavad avanejyeti saṃbandhaḥ | pūrvavad ity anena pūrvavanejanetikartavyatātidiśyate | sā codapātrādirūpā darśitaiva pūrvam |
śatapathas tu pratyavanejane ’pi tām upadeśenaiva darśayan sārthavādakaṃ pratyavanejanam āha |
athodapātram ādāyāvanenikṣyety eva yajamānasya pitaram asāv avanenikṣveti pitāmaham asāv avanenikṣveti prapitāmahaṃ tad yathā jakṣuṣe ’bhiṣiñced evaṃ tad iti |
[1459]
'jakṣuṣe' bhuktavate, 'nīviṃ visraṃsyeti vāmakakṣāyām antarīyavastradaśāsaṃgopanaṃ 'nīviḥ' tāṃ, 'visraṃsya' unmucya | visraṃsanavidhānād itaḥ pūrvaṃ tasyāḥ sādhāraṇaṃ kartavyam iti gamyate | 'namo va ity añjaliṃ karoti' namo vaḥ pitaro rasāyetyādibhir mantraiḥ pratinamaskāram añjaliṃ karoti | ''añjaliḥ' karasaṃpuṭaḥ, añjalim ābadhya piṇḍābhimukhaḥ pitṛbhyo namaskārān kuryād ity arthaḥ | te ca mantrāḥ vājasaneyibhir evaṃ paṭhyante |
namo vaḥ pitaro rasāya namo vaḥ pitaraḥ śoṣāya namo vaḥ pitaro jīvāya namo vaḥ pitaraḥ svadhāyai namo vaḥ pitaro ghorāya namo vaḥ pitaro manyave namo vaḥ pitaro namo va iti |
āśvalāyanasūtre |
athaitān upatiṣṭheta namo vaḥ pitara iṣe namo vaḥ pitara ūrje namo vaḥ pitaraḥ śubhāya namo vaḥ pitaro ghorāya namo vaḥ pitaro jīvāya namā vaḥ pitaro rasāya svadhā vaḥ pitaro namo vaḥ pitaro namaḥ etā yuṣmākaṃ pitara imāsmākaṃ vo jīvanta iha santaḥ syāma manonvāhavāmahe iti catasṛbhiḥ | manonvāhuvāmahe nārāśaṃsena somena | pitṝṇāṃ ca manmabhiḥ | āta etu manaḥ punaḥ kratve dakṣāya jīvase jyokte sūryaṃ dṛśe punar naḥ pitaro mano dadātu daivyo janaḥ | jīvaṃ vrātaṃ savemahauti |
āpastambasūtre |
vītoṣmasu piṇḍeṣu namo vaḥ pitaro rasāyeti namaskārān japati |
taittirīyabrāhmaṇe |
namaskaroti namaskāre hi pitṝṇāṃ namo vaḥ pitaro rasāya namo vaḥ pitaraḥ śuṣmāya namo vaḥ pitaro jīvāya namo vaḥ pitaraḥ [1460] svadhāyai namo vaḥ pitaro manyave namo vaḥ pitaro ghorāya pitaro namovoya etasmin loke stha yuṣmaṃs te ’nu ye ’smin loke 'mān te 'nu ya etasmin loke stha yūyaṃ teṣāṃ vasiṣṭhā bhūyāstha ye ’smiṃl loke ’hante vasiṣṭho bhūyāsaṃ manonvāhuvāmahe nārāśaṃsena somena | pitṝṇāṃ ca manmabhiḥ | śrāta etu manaḥ punaḥ kṛtve dakṣāya jīvase | jyokte sūryaṃ dṛśe | punar naḥ pitaro mano dadātu daivyo janaḥ | jīvaṃ vrātaṃ savemahīti |
maitrāyaṇīyasūtre |
nihute ’ñjaliṃ kṛtvā namo vaḥ pitaro manyave namo vaḥ pitaro iṣe namo vaḥ pitara ūrje namo vaḥ pitaraḥ suṣmāya namo vaḥ pitaro rasāya namo vaḥ pitaro balāya namo vaḥ pitaro yaj jīvaṃ tasmai namo vaḥ pitaro ghoraṃ tasmai svadhā vaḥ pitaro namo namo vaḥ pitaraḥ | ye ’tra pitaraḥ pretā yuṣmāṃs te ’nu ya iha pitaro jīvā asmāṃs te ’nu ye ’tra pitaraḥ pretā yūyaṃ teṣāṃ vaśiṣṭhā bhūyā stha ya iha pitaro jīvāḥ ahaṃ teṣāṃ vasiṣṭhā bhūyāsam || iti |
nihvanaṃ copari pāṇyoḥ karaṇam | atha te prastare nihnavatā ityādiṣu tathā prasiddheḥ |
rāṇāyaṇīyasutrakṛd gobhilaḥ |
atha nihnuvate pūrvasyāṃ karṣvāṃ dakṣiṇottānau pāṇī kṛtvā namo vaḥ pitaro jīvāya namo vaḥ pitaraḥ śoṣāyeti madhyamāyāṃ savyottānau namo vaḥ pitaro ghorāya namo vaḥ pitaro rasāyeti | uttamāyāṃ dakṣiṇottānau namo vaḥ pitaraḥ svadhāyai namo vaḥ pitaro manyava iti | athāñjaliṃ kṛtvā japati | namo vaḥ pitaraḥ pitaro namo vaḥ || iti |
[1461] 'dakṣiṇottānāv' iti dakṣiṇapāṇim uttānaṃ kṛtvā taduttarapārśve lagnaṃ savyaṃ pāṇim adhomukhaṃ kṛtvety arthaḥ | tadvaiparītyena savyottānatvam anusaṃdheyam |
āpastambena tu svagṛhye puṃdaivatyastrīdaivatyapiṇḍadānavibhāgenopasthānamantrā darśitāḥ |
tatra ye ca vo 'tra ye cāsmāsv āśasante ca vahantāṃ tṛpyantu bhavantas tṛpyata tṛpyata tṛpyatety etair mantraiḥ pitṛgavārthaṃ piṇḍopasthānam | yāś ca vo ’tra yāś cāsmāsv āśasante tāś ca vahantāṃ tṛpyata tṛpyata tṛpyatety etair mantraiḥ strīvargārthaṃ piṇḍopasthāne kāryam iti mantraliṅgād avagantavyam |
śākhāntare punar amī mantrāḥ |
tṛpyantu bhavantaḥ pitaro ye ca bhavanto ’nu ye cāsmāsv āśasante tṛpyantu cāsmāsv āśasante tapyantu pitāmahā ye ca bhavanto ’nu ye bhavantaḥ prapitāmahā ye ca bhavanto ’nu ye cāsmāsv āsaśante tṛpyantu bhavantyo mātaro yāś ca bhavatīr anu yāś cāsmāsv āśasante tṛpyata tṛpyantu bhavantyaḥ pitāmahyo yāś ca bhavatīr anu yāś cāsmāsv āśaṃsante tṛpyata tṛpyantu bhavantyaḥ prapitāmahyo yāś ca bhavatīr anu yāś cāsmāsv āśaṃsante hṛpyata tapyantu || iti |
vyākhyātāś caite harihareṇa |
he pitaraḥ bhavantas tṛpyantu ye ca 'bhavato ’nu' ye ’pi yuṣmadanucarāḥ, te ’pi tṛpyantu | bahuvacanaṃ pitṛvyādyapekṣyam, bhrātṝṇām ekajātānām ityādivacanāt | evaṃ pitāmahādiṣv api yathāyathaṃ yojanīyam | ye cāsmāsv āśaṃsante havirāśaṃsāṃ kurvanti adagdhādayas te ’pi tṛpyantv etena karmaṇā | ante tṛptipadābhyāso ’tiśayārthaḥ | spaṣṭārtham anyat |
kaṭhasūtre (?) |
atra nihnute namo vaḥ pitaro jīvanto bhūyāsmeti |
[1462] brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
savyottarābhyāṃ hastābhyāṃ vaden mantram imaṃ sadā |
namo vaḥ pitara iṣa iti samyag atandritaḥ ||
savyottarābhyāṃ dakṣiṇapāṇim uttānaṃ kṛtvā tadupari savyapāṇinā adhomukhenāñjaliṃ baddhvety arthaḥ | namaskārasaṃkhyām āha 'ṣaṭkṛtva' iti | etac ca sārthavādakaṃ śatapathe śrūyate |
atha nīvim uddhṛtya namaskaroti | pitṛdevatyā vai nīvis tasmān nīvim uddhṛtya namaskaroti | yajño vai namo yajñiyān evaitān etat karoti ṣaṭkṛtvo namaskaroti ṣaḍ vā ṛtavaḥ ṛtavaḥ pitaras tasmāt ṣaṭkṛtvo namaskarotīti |
atra śatapathe pratyavanejananīvimokṣānantaraṃ namaskāra uktaḥ |
manusmṛtau tu namaskārānantaraṃ pratyavanejanam uktam | tasya ca sthānaviśeṣaḥ pūrvāvanejanodakadeśasādhyatā coktā |
ṣaṭ pitṝṃś ca namaskuryāt pitṝn eva ca mantravit |
udakaṃ ninayec cheṣaṃ śanaiḥ piṇḍāntike punaḥ || iti |
yasyodakasyaikadeśaḥ pūrvapiṇḍasthāne ninītaḥ tasyaivodakasya śeṣam ekadeśāntaraṃ piṇḍāntike punaḥ piṇḍasamīpe ninayet avanejanarūpeṇa kṣārayet | pratipattiś ceyaṃ tasyodakasya | tathā ca śeṣaśabda upapanno bhavati | ataḥ kathaṃcit tasyābhāve nāsti ninayanam ity uktvāha medhātithiḥ | “gṛhye tu nityaṃ ninayanam ity uktam” iti | yuktaṃ caitat | ata eva āśvalāyanapiṇḍapitṛyajñe ’py uktaṃ | “nityaṃ ninayanaṃ” iti | atrāvanejananamaskāroktaḥ kramaḥ sākṣāt kātyāyana-śatapathābhyāṃ viruddhatvāt [1463] tadanusāribhir na grahītavyaḥ | bahusaṃmataś ca śatapathoktaḥ kramaḥ | yas tatrāvanejanasya sthānaviśeṣo jalaviśeṣaś ceoktaḥ sa tu pratyakṣaśāstravirodhādarśanāt grahītavyaḥ |
smṛtyantare tu piṇḍapātrakṣālanajalena pratyavanejanam uktam |
tatpātrakṣālanenātha punar apy avanejayet || iti |
vyāghro ’py āha |
adbhiḥ prakṣālya tat pātraṃ pratipiṇḍaṃ tu pūrvavat |
kṛtvāvanejanaṃ kuryāt piṇḍapātram adhomukham ||
atra piṇḍapātrasyāpi adhomukhakaraṇaṃ śatapathānusāribhir api gṛhyatāṃ | pātrakṣālanajalaṃ tu pratyavanejanāya tair na deyam eva | yataḥ “tad u tathā na kuryād yathā yasmā aśanam āharet tatpātranirṇejanaṃ pāyayed evaṃ tat tasmād u parāsyed evaitān” iti sruksaṃmārjanānām agnau praharaṇaṃ nindatā śatapathena bhojayitum abhīṣṭāya bhojyamānāya bhojitāya vā laukikasya pātranirṇejanadānasya ninditatvena prasiddhasya dṛṣṭāntatvenopādānaṃ kṛtantenaitenānyārthadarśanenānyatrāpi pātranirṇejanasyādeyatvam avagamyate | “etad vaḥ pitaro vāsaḥ" ity anena yajuṣā pratipiṇḍaṃ sūtrāṇi nidadhyāt | bahuvacanāt triṇi triṇīti gamyate | 'ūṛṇā vā' 'ūṇaḥ' meṣaromāṇi | 'daśā vā' 'daśāḥ' vastrāñcalasūtrāṇi | teṣām api sūtraśabdenaiva saṃgrahasaṃbhave ’pi sūtrāntarād daśānāṃ jaghanyatvaṃ khyāpayituṃ pṛthagupanyāsaḥ | ata eva daśānāṃ kvacin niṣedha eva smaryate |
daśāṃ vivarjayet prājño yady apy āhatavastrajām || iti |
'vayasy uttare yajamānalomāni vā', śatavarṣasyāyuṣaḥ samaṃ bhāgadvayaṃ parikalpya dve vayasī kalpete, [1464] uttare uparitane vayasi vartamānasya yajamānasya lomāni, tāni ca praśastāṅgatvād uparasthitāny eva grāhyāṇi, “uttare vayasy urolāmāni” iti sūtrāntaradarśanāt | vāśabdād asminn api vayasi sūtrādīnāṃ vikalpenāvakāśo darśitaḥ | etac ca sūtrādi vastrābhāve vastrasthāne dātavyam | sati tu vastre vastram eva | ata eva āśvalāyanena "vāso dadyād" ity uktvoktam |
daśām ūrṇāstukāṃ vā pañcāśadvarṣatāyā ūrdhvaṃ svalomaitad vaḥ pitaro vāso māno ’to ’nyat pitaro yuṅdhvam || iti |
'ūrṇāstukā' ūrṇākhaṇḍam |
vāyupurāṇe coktam |
vastrārthe sūtram eva vā || ti |
na caivaṃ mantavyaṃ vastrārthe sūtram eva deyaṃ na kadācid api vastram iti |
yata āha viṣṇuḥ |
atha vastram abhāve daśām ūrṇāyā etad vaḥ pitaro vāsomāno ’to ’nyat pitaro
yuṅdhvam || iti |
brahmapurāṇe ’pi |
dadyāt krameṇa vāsāṃsi daśāṃ vā śvetavastrajām || iti |
yad api vyāghreṇoktam,
etad vaḥ pitaro vāso daśāṃ dadyāt pṛthak pṛthak || iti |
tad api vastrābhāva iti vyākhyeyam | atra kātyāyanābhimatān mantrāntaraṃ viṣṇu-āśvalāyanābhyām uktavākye darśitam |
āpastamvenāpi mantrāntaraṃ darśitam |
etāni vaḥ pitaro vāsāṃsy ato 'nānyat pitaro māyoṣṭeti vāsaso [1465] daśāṃ chittvā nidadhyād ūrṇāstukāṃ vā pūrve vayasy uttara āyuṣi svaṃ lometi |
rāṇāyaṇīyasutrakṛd gobhilas tv apradakṣiṇatvādītikartavyatāviśeṣeṇa saha mantrāntaram āha |
savyenaiva pāṇinā sūtratantuṃ gṛhītvāpasalaviḥ pūrvasyāṃ karṣvāṃ piṇḍaṃ nidadhyāt | pitur nāma gṛhītvāsāv etat te vāso ye cātra tvānu yāṃś ca tvam anu tasmai te svadhety apa upaspṛśyaivam evetarayor iti |
atra nāmagrahaṇam upalakṣaṇaṃ gotrādigrahaṇasya |
ata eva brahmapurāṇe |
etad vaḥ pitaro vāsas tv iti jalpan pṛthak pṛthak |
amukāmukagotraitat tubhyaṃ vāsaḥ paṭhet tataḥ ||
maitrāyaṇīyapiṇḍapitṛyajñe tu kaścid viśeṣo darśitaḥ |
eṣāṃ yuṣmākaṃ pitara ity ūrṇāṃ daśāṃ vābhyasyati mā asmākam ity avaśiṣṭhāvekṣate lomottaravayasi nyased ato’nyaḥ pitaro ’nyā māyoṣṭeti |
mānavamaitrāyaṇīyapiṇḍapitṛyajñasūtre tu piṇḍeṣu dāsyamānasya daśādeḥ pūrvaṃ prokṣaṇam uktam |
vāsaḥ ūrṇāṃ daśāṃ vābhyukṣya piṇḍadeśe nidadhāti romottaravayasi chittvā vāsasovdaśāṃ vāto ’nyat pitaro 'nyā māyoṣṭeti nidadhyāt || iti |
mantrāntaram āha viṣṇuḥ |
ye ’ca pitaraḥ pretā ya iti vāso deyam || iti |
kaṭhānāṃ śrāddhakalpe ’pi |
ye ’tra pitaraḥ pretā iti vāsāṃsi nidadhyāt || iti |
atra pratīkagrahaṇena viniyukto mantraḥ samagraḥ pradarśyate | [1466]
ye ’tra pitaraḥ pretā yuṣmāṃs te ’nu ya iha pitaro jīvā asmāṃs te ’nu ye ’tra pitaraḥ pretā yūyaṃ teṣāṃ vasiṣṭhā bhūyāsma iha pitaro jīvā vayaṃ teṣāṃ vasiṣṭhā bhūyāsma etāni vaḥ pitaro vāsāṃsy ato no ’nyat pitaro māyuṣan vīrānnaḥ pitaro dhatteti |
atra kātyāyanasūtravyatirikreṣu bahutaraśākhākalpasūtrasmṛtipurāṇādiṣu sūtradānāt pūrvaṃ gṛhodīkṣaṇapiṇḍāvekṣaṇāñjanābhyañjanadānāny uktāni |
tatra tāvad āha gobhilaḥ |
gṛhān avekṣate gṛhānnaḥ pitaro datteti, piṇḍān avekṣate sadovaḥ
pitaro deṣmeti |
gṛhān naḥ pitaro dattety anena mantreṇa gṛhān avekṣate patnīṃ vā, gṛhāḥ panīti tenaivoktatvāt | 'sadova ityādinā piṇḍān avekṣata' | vājasaneyinas tu sadova ity asya sthāne satova iti paṭhanti |
śatapathe tv āśīrūpārthābhidhānād asya mantrasyopasthāne sādhanatvaṃ gamyate |
gṛhān naḥ pitaro datteti gṛhāṇāṃ hi pitara īṣata eṣo etasyāśīḥkarmaṇa iti gṛhān avekṣamāṃenāpy upasthānaṃ kartuṃ śakyata evety avirodhāt śatapathānusāribhir api gṛhān avekṣamāṇair eva piṇḍopasthānaṃ vidheyam |
asya mantradvayasyopasthāne viniyogam āha āpastambaḥ |
gṛhān naḥ pitaro datta sadovaḥ pitaro deṣmeti pitṝn upatiṣṭhata iti |
atrāpy avirodhād gṛhapiṇḍāvekṣaṇābhyām upasyanasya samuccayo ’nusaṃdheyaḥ |
añjanābhyañjane tu vāyupurāṇe |
añjanābhyañjanaṃ dadyāt sūtrapraṇayanaṃ tathā |
[1467] kāśaiḥ punarbhavaiḥ kāryam aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || iti ||
kāśair ity upalakṣaṇaṃ kuśādīnām | ato vihitānāṃ darbhāṇāṃ pavitratṛṇānāṃ vā madhye yathāprāśastyaṃ yathālābhaṃ vā kenacid ekenāñjanābhyāne kartavye | atrāñjanaśabdenākṣṇoḥ prasādhanāya kṣamaṃ kim api kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ dravyaṃ lokaprasiddham eva | abhyañjanaṃ ca snehadravyam | tadubhayadravyasādhye kriye añjanābhyañjanaśabdābhyām ucyete |
atrāpekṣitāḥ kecana viśeṣā brahmavaivarte darśitāḥ |
gṛhītair darbhapiñjūlais tribhiś caiva yathāvidhi |
apasavyaṃ pitṛbhyas tu dadyād añjanam uttamam ||
nāmāny uccārya pūrveṣāṃ vastrārthe sūtram eva ca |
ekaṃ pavitraṃ haste tu pitṝṇāṃ ca sakṛt sakṛt |
tailaṃ mantreṇa dātavyaṃ piṇḍebhyo 'bhyañjanaṃ hitam ||
atraikaikasmin piṇḍe tribhir darbhapiñjūlair añjanam ity eko viśeṣaḥ | apasavyam ity aparaḥ | ‘uttamaṃ’ śreṣṭhaṃ, traikakudaṃ dadātīty arthaḥ | 'nāmāny uccāryety atra gotrasaṃbandhanāmnām uccāraṇaṃ vivakṣitam | 'ekaṃ pavitraṃ' ekaśikhaṃ pavitraṃ, tat kare gṛhītvā pitṝṇāṃ piṇḍebhyas tena pavitreṇa tailarūpam abhyañjanam ekaikasmin piṇḍe kalpasūtrādiprasiddhena mantreṇa sakṛt pradīyamānaṃ ‘hitaṃ' śreyaskaraṃ saṃpadyate | añjanam api mantreṇaiva kāryam | 'sakṛt sakṛd' iti darśayiṣyamāṇena tris trir ity anena saha vikalpyate | avatiṣṭhate vā yathāśākham |
atrāñjane kaṇṭhoktyaiva traikakudatvarūpo viśeṣo ’bhyañjane tailatvāvāntaro ’pi viśeṣo brahmapurāṇe darśitaḥ |
śreṣṭham āhus trikakūdam añjanaṃ nityam eva ca |
tailaṃ kṛṣṇatilebhyas tu yatnāt suparirakṣitam || iti |
'trikakudaṃ' trikakutparvatodbhavaṃ nīlāñjanaśabdena loke prasiddhataram | tat piṇḍopacāre śreṣṭham āhur munayaḥ | 'śreṣṭham āhur' ity abhidhānāt tadabhāve kajjalābhyanujñā gamyate |
atrāñjanābhyañjanayoḥ kramaviśeṣaṃ mantraṃ cāha āśvalāyanaḥ |
asāv abhyṃkṣvāsvāv aṃkṣveti piṇḍeṣv abhyañjanāñjane vāso dadyāt || iti |
viṣṇur apy āha |
tato ’sāv asyaṃkṣvety abhyañjanaṃ dadyād asāv aṃkṣmety (?) añjanam || iti |
'tata' ity avanejanānantaram | 'asāv abhyaṃkṣvety abhyañjanaṃ piṇḍopari pratipiṇḍaṃ dadyāt | 'asāv' ity anena saṃbodhanarūpeṇa pitrādigotrasaṃbandhanāmnāṃ grahaṇaṃ vivakṣitam | 'asāv aṃkṣveti mantreṇa piṇḍopari pratipiṇḍam añjanaṃ dadyād iti |
rāṇāyanīyasūtrakṛd gobhilas tu vāyupurāṇoktam eva kramam anusaran mantrāntaram āha |
savyenaiva pāṇinā darbhapiñjūlīṃ gṛhītvāpasalaviḥ pūrvasyāṃ karṣvāṃ piṇḍe nidadhyāt pitur nāma gṛhītvāsāv etat ta āñjanaṃ ye cātra tvānu yāṃś ca tvam anu tasmai svadhety apa upaspṛśyaivam evetarayos tathā tailaṃ tathā surabhīti |
'darbhapiñjūlī' añjanābhyaktāṃ | 'surabhi'gandhamālyādikam |
maitrāyaṇaīyapiṇḍapitryajñe ’py etatkramasahitaṃ mantrāntaraṃ darśitam |
añjanāktāḥ śalākāḥ pratipiṇḍaṃ nidadhāty aṃkṣvāsāv ity añjanenābhyaṃkṣvāsāv ity abhyañjaneneti |
[1469]
'śalākāḥ' darbhaśikhāḥ |
mānavamaitrāyaṇīyasūtre ’pi |
aṃkṣvāsāv ity añjanasya pratipiṇḍaṃ lepaṃ nirmārṣṭhy abhyaṃkṣvāsāv ity añjanasyeti |
āpastambaḥ |
añjanābhyañjane vāsaś ca trir anupiṇḍaṃ dadāty aṃkṣva tato ’sāv āṃkṣva pitāmahāsāv āṃkṣva prapitāmahāsāv ity āñjanam evam abhyañjanam abhyaṃkṣveti mantraṃ sannamati, yadi nāmāni na vindyād āñjatāṃ mama pitara āñjatāṃ mama pitāmahā āñjatāṃ mama prapitāmahā ity añjanam evam abhyañjanam abhyañjatām iti mantraṃ sannamatīti | trir anupiṇḍaṃ dadyād iti |
'anupiṇḍaṃ' ekaikasmin piṇḍe, 'trir' iti trivāram | añjanādīni dadyāt | 'asāv' iti saṃbuddhyantāni pitrādināmāny uccārya | yadi śrāddhakartā pitrādināmāni na jānīyāt tadā āñjatāṃ mama pitara ityādiprayogaḥ āñjanaṃ dadyāt | evam evābhyañjanaṃ, evam ity ūhyamānapadenāñjanamantreṇaivoham āha ‘abhyañjanam' iti, 'mantraṃ sannamatīti | 'sannamanaṃ' vipariṇāmaḥ | ūrjjam ity apo niṣiñcatīti | ūrjjam iti pratīkagrahaṇena mantro viniyuktaḥ | sa ca “ūrjjaṃ vahantīr amṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ payaḥ kīlālaṃ | parisrutaṃ svadhā stha tarpayata me pitṝn” iti | anena mantrena piṇḍamūleṣu tilodakaniṣecanaṃ kāryam | asya ca vyākhyānaṃ harihareṇa kṛtam | atra sāmarthyād āpa ity adhyāhāraḥ, he āpaḥ 'svadhā stha pitṝṇāṃ havir bhavatha | tataś ca mama pitṝn tarpayata | kiṃ kurvantyaḥ | ūrjjādi vahatyaḥ | 'ūrjjaṃ' balaṃ prāṇān śaktiṃ vā | 'amṛtaṃ' amṛtatvakāraṇaṃ somarasaṃ vīyūṣaṃ vā 'ghṛtaṃ' ājyam | 'payaḥ' kṣīraṃ, 'kīlālaṃ' annarasam | 'parisrutaṃ' [1470] surām | evam anekavidhaspṛhaṇīyatamarasaṃ vahantyo bhūtvā pitṝṇāṃ akṣayyāṃ tṛptiṃ kurutety arthaḥ |
kaṭhānāṃ śrāddhakalpe tv etat mantrasādhyanyodakaniṣecanasya pariṣecanarūpatoktā | ūrjjaṃ vahantīr ity apaḥ pariṣicyeti |
parisamantāt tyakvā 'pariṣicya', pariṣecanaṃ cāpradakṣiṇaṃ
kartavyaṃ pitryatvāt |
āpastambagṛhye tu triḥ piṇḍapariṣecanam | tatra ca mantrāntaram uktam | uttarayodapātreṇa triḥ prasavyaṃ pariṣicyeti |
asyārthaḥ | putrān pautrān abhitarpayantīr apo madhumatīr imāḥ | svadhā pitṛbhyaḥ amṛtaṃ duhānā āpo devīr ubhayāṃs tarpayantv ity etayā ṛcā udakapūrṇapātreṇa sarvān piṇḍān prasavyaṃ triḥ pariṣiñced iti |
viṣṇunā tūrjjam ity anena mantreṇa sodakasyānnasya piṇḍānāṃ samantād apradakṣiṇaṃ vikiraṇam uktam |
ūrjjaṃ vahantīr ity anena sodakenāpradakṣiṇaṃ piṇḍānāṃ
vikiraṇaṃ hṛtveti |
śaunākātharvaṇasūtre tu mantrāntarasahitam annena parivikiraṇam uktam | idam āśaṃsūnām idam āśaṃsamānānām ity annena prasavyaṃ parivikiraṇam iti |
pippalādaśrāddhakalpe tu piṇḍaśeṣānnamiśrataṇḍulapravikiraṇam uktam | idam āśaṃsūnām iti śeṣeṇa triḥ prasavyaṃ taṇḍulān prakired iti |
annavikiraṇānantaram āha viṣṇuḥ |
arghyapuṣpadhūpānulepanānnādyabhakṣyabhojyāni nivedayed udapātraṃ madhutilābhyāṃ saṃyutaṃ (?) ceti |
[1471]
śālaṅkāyanaḥ piṇḍānāṃ vikiraṇaṃ kṛtvā puṣpadhūpānulepanānnābhakṣyabhojyaṃ nivedayed udapātraṃ madhughṛtatilaiḥ saṃyuktaṃ ca |
āha paiṭhīnasiḥ |
dhūpagandhamālyādarśapradīpāñjanādīni copaharet |
‘upaharet' upahārīkuryāt | atrāñjanādīnāṃ piṇḍebhyaḥ pradānaṃ vyākhyātaṃ |
itareṣāṃ gandhādikrameṇa vastradānāt pūrvaṃ piṇḍebhyo dānam āha vyāghraḥ |
gandhapuṣpāṇi dhūpaṃ ca dīpaṃ ca vinivedayet |
etad vaḥ pitaro vāso darśāṃ dadyāt pṛthak pṛthak || iti ||
ayaṃ hi śiṣṭasamācārānugṛhītaḥ pāṭhakramaḥ śaknoty eva darśayiṣyamāṇāni pāṭhakramāntarāṇy avivakṣitāni kartum |
bṛhaspatis tu pratyavanejanāt pūrvaṃ gandhādidānam āha |
dīpadhūpair mālyagandhais tathā vastrāñjanādinā |
samabhyarcyodapātraṃ tu teṣām upari nikṣipet || iti |
‘udapātram' ity udapātrastham udakam | ādiśabdena bhakṣyabhojyaphalatāmbūlādi gṛhyate |
ata eva devalaḥ |
evaṃ niveśya piṇḍāṃs tān alaṃkuryāc ca pūrvavat |
pakvānnena baliṃ tebhyaḥ piṇḍebhyo dāpayed budhaḥ ||
tato dattabalibhyaś ca piṇḍebhyo mantrapūrvakam |
piṇḍapātreṇa tenaiva dadyād ācamanodakam ||
[1472] 'pūrvavat' pūrvoktenāpasavyādividhinā | 'baliṃ' urupahāraḥ | 'ācamānodakaṃ' pratyavanejanam |
tathā |
dakṣiṇāṃ sarvabhogāṃś ca pratipiṇḍaṃ pradāpayet |
bhakṣyān apūpān ikṣūṃś ca vyañjanāny aśanāni ca ||
dakṣiṇāśabdenātra rajatahiraṇyādi |
atra piṇḍapradānadine siddhānāṃ bhokṣyabhojyādīnāṃ madhye kasyacid ekasyāpi piṇḍebhyo nivedanam antareṇa bhakṣaṇe yajamānasya doṣaḥ śaṅkhasmṛti-brahmāṇḍapurāṇayor uktaḥ |
yat kiṃcit pacyate gehe bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ vigarhitam |
anivedya na bhoktavyaṃ piṇḍamūle kathaṃcana ||
gandhādidāne savyajānunipātanādirūpaḥ ko 'pītikartavyatāviśeṣo matsyapurāṇe darśitaḥ |
gandhadhūpādikaṃ dadyāt kuryāt pratyavanejanam |
jānv (?) ācya savyaṃ savyena pāṇinā tv apradakṣiṇam ||
pitryam ā nidhanāt kāryaṃ vidhivad darbhapāṇinā |
dīpaṃ prajvālanaṃ tadvat kuryāt puṣpārcanaṃ budhaḥ ||
'ā nidhanāt' ā śrāddhasamāpter apavādavarjam |
brahmavaivarte tu gandhādidāne mantro darśitaḥ |
piṇḍān parikṣipet samyag apasavyam atandritaḥ |
etad vaḥ pitaro devā devāś ca pitaraḥ punaḥ |
puṣpagandhādidhūpānām eṣa mantra udāhṛtaḥ || iti |
[1473] piṇḍebhyo gandhapuṣpādi datvā brāhmaṇeṣv ācānteṣu yajamānenāpy ācamanaṃ kāryam |
tathā ca matsyapurāṇe |
gandhadhūpādikaṃ dadyāt kṛtvā pratyavanejanam |
dīpaprajvālanaṃ tadvat kuryāt puṣpārcanaṃ budhaḥ |
athācānteṣu vācamya vāri dadyāt sakṛt sakṛt ||
vāridānaṃ ca brāhmaṇahasteṣu 'śivā āpaḥ santv' ityādibhir mantraiḥ kartavyam | 'avadhāyāvajighrati yajamānaḥ' iti | avadhāyeti pratyavadhāya | bhūmau nihitān uddhṛtya sthālyāṃ nidhāyety arthaḥ | 'avajighrati' piṇḍānāṃ gandham upalabheta | sa cāyaṃ yajamānasaṃskāraḥ, "athāvajighrati pratyavadhāya piṇḍān sa yajamānabhāgaḥ" iti śatapathavacanāt | tataś ca nādhvaryur avajighrati | "athāvajighrati pratyavadhāya piṇḍān" iti prayogasāmarthyād adhvaryur eva pratyavadhatte | kvāprayogān neti cet, syāt kālārthatvāt | yathā nirūpyājyaṃ prātar dohinam iti |
manunā tu pratyavanejanānantaraṃ bhūmiṣṭhānām eva piṇḍānāṃ krameṇāvaghrāṇam uktam |
udakaṃ ninayec cheṣaṃ śanaiḥ piṇḍādike punaḥ |
avajighrec ca tān piṇḍān yathā nyuptān samāhitaḥ ||
'yathā nyaptān' ity anena nirvāpakrameṇa piṇḍānām avaghrāṇaṃ darśitam | “ulmukasakṛdācchinnāny agnāv" iti | atra ādadhātīti vākyaśeṣaḥ | tatra pūrvaṃ sakṛd ācchinnāni tata ulmukam, “sakṛd ācchinnāny agnāv abhyādadhāti punar ulmukam api sṛjati" iti śatapathaśruteḥ | sūtre tv [1474] ajāditvād alpākṣaratvāc colmukasya pūrvanipātaḥ | 'api sṛjatīti yasmād agner ulmukam āhṛtaṃ tena punaḥ saṃyojayatīty arthaḥ |
āpastambena tūlmukāpisarjane mantro darśitaḥ |
abhūn nohuto haviṣo jātavedā
āvāñchayātisurabhīṇi kṛtvā |
prādāt pitṛbhyaḥ svadhayā te asthan prajānan naḥ punar apy etu devān ity ekolmukaṃ pratyapisṛjyeti |
gobhilena tv etenaiva mantreṇolmukābhyukṣaṇam uktam |
abhūn nohṛto haviṣo jātavedā ity ulamukam adbhir abhyukṣya dvandvaṃ pātrāṇi prakṣālya pratyabhihārayet || iti |
āśvalāyanapiṇḍapitṛyajñasūtre tu manasvatījapānantaraṃ piṇḍapravāhaṇam uktam |
athaitān pravāhayet "paretanaḥ pitaraḥ somyāsogambhīrebhiḥ pathibhiḥ pūrviṇebhiḥ dattāsmabhyaṃ draviṇeha bhadraṃ rayiṃ ca naḥ sarvavīraṃ niyacchateti |
'pravāhayet' hastena yugapat sarvān pravāhayet |
āpastambena tu pravāhaṇāt pūrvam upasthānam uktam |
