uttiṣṭhata pitaraḥ pretaśūrā yamasya panthām anuvetā purāṇaṃ dhattād asmāsu draviṇaṃ yac ca bhadraṃ prāṇo brūtād bhāgadhī devatās tv iti pitṝn utthāpayati paretapitaraḥ somyā iti pravāhāṇyā pitṝn pravāhayatīti |
'utthāpayati' hastena yugapat sarvān piṇḍān bhūmeḥ kiṃcid utkṣiped ity arthaḥ |
maitrāyaṇīyasūtre ’pi | [1475]
prajāpate na tvad ity uttiṣṭhata pareta pitara iti yajamānaḥ pravāhaṇīṃ japati ubhau manasvatīr mano ’nvāhavāmaha iti tisraḥ vayaṃ somavrate tava manas tanuṣu bibhrataḥ prajāvantaḥ sacemahīti cākṣann amīmadanteti ceti ||
ity ācamanādayaḥ padārthaḥ |
athānvāhāryakākhyaśrāddhāṅgabhūtaṃ dvijabhojanāt pūrvakālīnam
agnimatkartṛkaṃ piṇḍapradānaṃ |
tatropakaraṇasaṃbharaṇaṃ mātsya-pādmayor uktam |
piṇḍabhūmau prayatnena tisraḥ karṣūś ca kārayet |
tā vitastyāyatīḥ kāryāḥ caturaṅgulavistṛtāḥ ||
darvītrayaṃ tu kurvīta khādiraṃ rajatānvitam |
aratnimātraṃ pariślakṣṇaṃ hastākārāgram uttamam ||
'karṣūḥ' avaṭaḥ | sā ca kaiścit salilena pūryate, kaiścit tatra piṇḍanirvāpaḥ kriyate | tritvābhidhānaṃ pitrādivargapiṇḍāpekṣayā | 'darvyaḥ' srugviśeṣāḥ | tāś ca haviruddharaṇa-piṇḍaprakṣepaṇārthaḥ kriyante | agnaukaraṇānantaraṃ ca tatraivoktam |
prācīnāvītinā kāryam ataḥ sarvaṃ vijānatā |
ṣaṭ ca tasmād dhaviḥśeṣāt piṇḍān kṛtvā tathodakam ||
dadyād udakapātrais tu salilaṃ savyapāṇinā |
jalaṃ triḥ savyaṃ yatnena darbhayukto vimatsaraḥ ||
udakapātreṇodakadānaṃ kāryam | aprādakṣiṇyena trir jaladānaṃ pariṣecanākhyam |
[1476] vidhāya lekhāṃ yatnena nivāpāyāvanejanam |
dakṣiṇābhimukhaḥ kuryāt tato darvīṃ (?) nidhāya vai ||
vidhāya piṇḍam ekaikaṃ darvyām ādhāya ca kramāt |
ninayed atha darbheṣu nāmagotrānukīrtanaiḥ ||
teṣu darbheṣu taṃ hastaṃ nimajjyāl lepabhāginām |
tathaiva ca budhaḥ kuryāt punaḥ pratyavanejanam ||
ṣaḍ apy ṛtūn namaskṛtya gandhadhūpārpaṇādibhiḥ |
evam āhṛtya tat sarvaṃ vedamantrair yathoditaiḥ ||
tataḥ kṛtvāntare dadyāt tatpatnībhyaḥ kuśān budhaḥ |
tadvat piṇḍādikaṃ kuryād āvāhanavisarjjane ||
tato gṛhītvā piṇḍebhyo mātrāḥ sarvāḥ krameṇa tu |
tān eva viprān prathamam āśayet yatnato naraḥ ||
'mātrā' leśaḥ |
yasmād dattā hṛtā mātrā bhakṣayanti dvijātayaḥ |
anvāhāryakam ity uktaṃ tasmāt tac candrasaṃkṣaye ||
pūrvaṃ datvā tu taddhaste sapavitraṃ tilodakam |
tatpiṇḍāgraṃ prayacchet tu svadhaiṣām astv iti bruvan ||
āha manuḥ |
piṇḍebhyas tv alpikāṃ mātrāṃ samādāyānupūrvaśaḥ |
tā eva viprān āsīnān vidhivat pūrvam āśayet ||
teṣāṃ datvā tu hasteṣu sapavitraṃ tilodakam |
tat piṇḍāgraṃ prayacchet tu svadhaiṣām asv iti bruvan ||
[1477] śeṣā tv itikartavyatā pūrvoktapiṇḍadānena samānā veditavyā | āśvalāyanapiṇḍapitṛyajñasūtre piṇḍapravāhaṇam uktam |
agniṃ pratyeyād agne tam adyāśvaṃ na stomair iti gārhapatyaṃ yad antarikṣaṃ pṛthivīm uta dyāṃ yan mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vājihiṃsim agnir mā tasmād enaso gārhapatyaḥ pramuñcatu karotu mām anenasam || iti |
pravāhaṇānantaram evāha āpastambaḥ |
prajāpate na tvad etān iti yajñopavītigārhapatyadeśaṃ gacchati yad antaritam iti paṅktyā gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhata iti |
maitrāyaṇīyasūtre |
pareta na pitara iti yajamānaḥ pravāhaṇīṃ japati | ubhau manasvatīr mano ’nvāhavāmaha iti tisro vayaṃ somavrate tava manas tanuṣu bibhrataḥ | prajāvantaḥ sacemahīti cākṣann amīmadanteti ca prāpyategna idhīmahīti gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhata iti |
mānavamaitrāyanīyasūtre |
pareta naḥ pitaraḥ somyāsa iti pravāhaya iti prajāpate na tvad ity etayopatiṣṭhaty akṣann amīmadanteti punar iti manasvatīr japann agne tam adyety etayā gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhata iti |
kaṭhānāṃ sūtre |
ā te agna iti dakṣiṇāgniṃ gatvā tasmin samidha ādhāyāvṛtya japati mano ’nvāhuvāmaha iti tisro yad antarikṣam iti gārhapatyam || iti |
śaunakātharvaṇapiṇḍapitṛyajñasūtre |
piṇḍanirvāpānantaram | āpo ’gnir ity adbhir agnim avasicya putraṃ pautram [1478] abhitarpayantīr ity ācāmata mama pratatāmahāstatāmahāstatāḥ (?) sapatnīkās tṛpyantv ācamantu | prasavyaṃ pariṣicya vīrān me pratatāmahādatta vīrān me tatāmahādatta vīrān me pitaro datta pitṝn vīrān yācate namo vaḥ pitara ity upatiṣṭhate akṣann ity uttarasruvam avadhūya parāpāteti parāpāya yathātaḥ pitryopavītiyajñopavītī yatra idaṃ pitṛbhyaḥ saha manobhūr iti mana upāhvayāmi mana upāhūyanti mano ’nvāhuvāmahe nārāśaṃsena stomena pitṝṇāṃ ca manmabhiḥ | āta etu manaḥ punaḥ kratve dakṣāya jīvasejyo kvaca sūryaṃ dṛśe punar naḥ pitaro mano dadātu daivyo janaḥ jīvaṃ vrātaṃ sacemahi vayaṃ somavrate tava manas tanuṣu bibhrataḥ prajāvantaḥ sacemahi | ye samānāḥ sumanaso jīvājīveṣu māmakāḥ | teṣāṃ śrīr mayi kalpyatām asmin goṣṭhe śataṃ samā iti | yac carusthālyāmovāvaśiṣṭaṃ bhavati | tasyoṣma bhakṣyaṃ bhakṣyayitvā brāhmaṇāya dadyāt | yadi brāhmaṇo na labhyeta svayam abhyavaharet nijāya dāsāyety eke paryukṣaṇiṃ samidhaś cādāya mā pragāmety āvarjyorjaṃ bibhrad iti gṛhān upatiṣṭhate | ramadhvam āvibhīta nāsmin goṣṭhe kariṣiṇaḥ ūrjaṃ duhānāḥ śucayaḥ śucivratāḥ gṛhājīvanta upavaḥ sademaḥ | ūrjaṃ me devā adaduḥ ūrjaṃ manuṣyā ūrjaṃ pitṛbhyaḥ māhārṣam ūrjasvanto gṛhā mama | payo devā adaduḥ payo manuṣyā uta payaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ māhārṣaṃ payasvanto gṛhā mama | vīryaṃ me devā adaduḥ vīryaṃ manuṣyā uta vīryaṃ pitṛbhyaḥ māhārṣaṃ payasvanto gṛhā mamety antarūpātītyato ’nto ’gnir abhyukṣyo yan no vasuvittamaḥ | asyopasavyaṃ māriṣāmā yaṃ rakṣatu naḥ prajām | asmin sahasraṃ puṣpā samedhamānaḥ sve gṛhe | ime samandiṣīmahyāyuṣmantaḥ [1479] sumedhasaḥ tvam agne īḍitaḥ | ātvāgna idhīmahītyabhūdūta ity agniṃ pariṇayati | yadi sarvaḥ praṇītaḥ syād dakṣiṇāgnau tadāhitāgner gṛhye ’py anāhitāhatāgneḥ | idaṃ cinve kṛtam astīdaṃ vikṣayābhipītaraś cinvāvedann iti yo ha yajate taṃ devā viduḥ, yo dadāti taṃ manuṣyāḥ, yaḥ śrāddhāni kurute taṃ pitaras taṃ pitaraḥ |
ity anvāhāryāntarbhūtapiṇḍadānam ||
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasakalakaraṇādhipati-
paṇḍitaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau pariśeṣakhaṇḍe śrāddhakalpe piṇḍadānaprakaraṇaṃ nāma pañcadaśo ’dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ ||
[1480]
atha ṣoḍaśo ’dhyāyaḥ |
atha suprekṣitādayaḥ padārthaḥ |
āha viṣṇuḥ |
tataḥ suprokṣitam iti śrāddhadeśaṃ prokṣya darbhapāṇiḥ sarvaṃ kuryāt | 'tata' iti paitṛkadvijapuraḥsaraṃ hastaprakṣālanapūrvakam ācamanodakaṃ datvā | 'sarvam' iti vakṣyamāṇam abdavācanādi brāhmaṇavisarjanāntam |
mānavamaitrāyaṇīyasūtre |
suprokṣitam astv akṣayyam astv akṣatāḥ santu || iti |
etac ca yajñopavītinā kartavyam ity uktaṃ nāgarakhaṇḍe |
namaskṛtya pitṝn paścāt suprokṣitam ataḥ param |
kṛtvā savyena rājendra yācayitvā varāśiṣaḥ ||
'āśiṣaḥ' vakṣyamāṇasvarūpāḥ |
atra pūrvadhṛtapavitrāṇām ucchiṣṭohatatvena dvijaiḥ parityakatvāt sapavitrakaratvārthaṃ suprokṣitānantaraṃ dvijapāṇiṣu darbhāḥ pradeyāḥ |
āha kātyāyanaḥ |
ācānteṣu udakapuṣpākṣatān akṣaryodakaṃ ca dadyāt || iti |
pādma-mātsyayor api |
tathācānteṣu cācamya vāri dadyāt sakṛt sakṛt |
tathā puṣpākṣatān paścād akṣayyodakam eva ca ||
akṣataśabdena yavā ucyante |
[1481] brahmapurāṇe |
ācānteṣūdakaṃ dadyāt puṣpāṇi sayavāni ca |
yavo ’sīti paṭhen mantraṃ śraddhābhaktisamanvitaḥ ||
yavadānaṃ ca vaiśvadevikadvijahasteṣv eva | pitryahasteṣu tu tiladānam eva kāryam |
tathā ca brahmapurāṇe |
tatas tv abhyukṣya tāṃ bhūmiṃ datvāpaḥ sumano ’kṣataiḥ |
bhūtilāmbu pitṛṣv ādau datvā deveṣu sākṣatam ||
'tata' ity ācamanadānānantaram |
atrodakādidāne mantrān āha śātātapaḥ |
apāṃ madhye sthitā devāḥ sarvam apsu pratiṣṭhitam |
brāhmaṇasya kare nyastāḥ śivā āpo bhavantu naḥ ||
lakṣmīr vasati puṣpeṣu lakṣmīr vasati puṣkare |
lakṣmīr vaset sadā some saumanasyaṃ sadāstu me ||
akṣataṃ cāstu me puṇyaṃ śāntiḥ puṣṭir dhṛtiś ca me |
yad yat śreyaskaraṃ loke tat tad astu sadā mama ||
atrodakadānādau yathāliṅgaṃ mantrāṇāṃ vibhajya viniyogo ’nusaṃdheyaḥ |
atra upādhyāyakarka āha |
idam ambupuṣpākṣatadānaṃ deveṣu tu savyena | pitrye tv apasavyena kāryam | kecit punaḥ pitrye sarvenecchanti |
tan na | piṇḍapitṛyajñavad upacāraḥ, pitrya ity atideśāt |
[1482] śaṅkhadharas tv āha |
na hy atrāmbuprabhṛtīnāṃ pitrādyuddeśena dānaṃ kriyate kiṃ tu haste prakṣepamātram ato ’sya pitrarthatvābhāvāt savyenaiva kartavyatociteti |
tathā ca vṛddhaśātātapaḥ |
tataḥ puṣpāṇi savyena sodakāni pṛthak pṛthak |
darbhapāṇiḥ pradadyāt tu yatavākkāyamānasaḥ || iti |
hastadattānāṃ cāmbupuṣpākṣatānāṃ ciradhāraṇaprayojakabhāvikāryabhāvān na daivakṛtakāryāṇāṃ kasmiṃścic chucau deśe viprāḥ prakṣepaṃ kuryuḥ | tataḥ punar api teṣāṃ dānaṃ kartavyam |
tathā ca matsyapurāṇe |
ācānteṣu punar dadyāt jalapuṣpākṣatodakam |
datvāśīḥ pratigṛhṇīyād dvijebhyaḥ prāṅmukho budhaḥ ||
punaḥśabdena pūrvam apy asya dānaṃ sūcitam | āśīr ity āśiṣaḥ |
matsyapurāṇavacane pāṭhāntaram |
tataḥ svadhāvācanikaṃ viśvedeveṣu codakam |
datvāśīḥ pratigṛhṇīyād dvijebhyaḥ prāṅmukho budhaḥ ||
āśiṣāṃ yācane tatpradāne ca vākyaṃ tatraiva darśitam |
aghorāḥ pitaraḥ santu santv ity ukte punar dvijaiḥ |
gotraṃ tathā vardhatāṃ nas tathety uktaḥ sa taiḥ punaḥ ||
dātāro no ’bhivardhantām annaṃ caivety udīrayet |
etāḥ satyāśiṣaḥ santu santv ity uktaś ca taiḥ punaḥ |
svastivācanikaṃ kuryāt piṇḍān uddhṛtya bhaktitaḥ ||
[1483] manu-viṣṇū |
visṛjya brāhmaṇāṃs tāṃs tu niyato vāgyataḥ śuciḥ |
dakṣiṇāṃ diśam ākāṅkṣan yācetemān varān pitṝn ||
dātāro no ’bhivardhantāṃ vedāḥ santatir eva ca |
śraddhā ca no māvyagamad bahudeyaṃ ca no ’stviti ||
'visṛjya' yathāsukhaṃ vihārāya pīṭhebhyaḥ samutthāyānuvrajaṃś caraṇakṣālanamaṇḍalasamīpam ānīya, dakṣiṇāṃ diśam avalokayan dātāro no ’bhivardhantām ityādikān varān abhilaṣitāni pitṛbhyaḥ 'yāceta' prārthayeta | dātāra ityādi bahu deyaṃ ca no ’stv ityantam uktvāha baudhāyanaḥ |
annaṃ ca no bahu bhaved atithīṁś ca labhemahi |
yācitāraś ca naḥ santu mā ca yāciṣma kaṃcana ||
varayācane kriyamāṇe brāhmaṇaiḥ prativacanaṃ varapradānavākyam uccāraṇīyam | tad yathā santv aghorāḥ pitaraḥ | vardhatāṃ vo gotram | abhivardhantāṃ vo dātāraḥ | abhivardhantāṃ vo vedāḥ | abhivardhatāṃ vaḥ santatiḥ | mā vigamad vaḥ śraddhā | astu vo bahu deyam | bhavatu vo bahu annam | labhadhvam atithīn | santu vo yācitāraḥ | mā yācadhvaṃ kaṃcana | santv etāḥ satyā āśiṣa iti | atra pūrvapradarśitair matsyapurāṇe visarjanāt prāg eva prāṅmukhena brāhmaṇebhyo varayācanaṃ kartavyam ity uktam |
manu-viṣṇubhyāṃ tu visarjanānantaraṃ dakṣiṇāmukhena pitṛbhyaś ca kāryam ity uktam | tad evaṃ virodhe vikalpaḥ śākhābhedena vyavasthā vā veditavyā | dvivāraṃ varayācanaṃ kartavyam |
atrāha saṃgrahakāraḥ |
[1484] dātāra iti yātroktā varārthaṃ prārthanā smṛtau |
tāṃ suraprītisaṃpraśnāt prāk pracetās tu manyate ||
yājñavalkyas tathā vakti praśne nirvartite sati |
pāraskaraḥ svasti vācyaṃ kṛtvāśīrvacanaṃ jagau ||
vivarjiteṣu vipreṣu vaśiṣṭheṣu manur jagau |
yāny atra kālabhedena karmāṇi munayo jaguḥ ||
svagṛhyoktānusāreṇa vikalpas teṣu yujyate |
na gṛhyādismatir yeṣāṃ śrāddhādāv upalabhyate |
kartum arhanti te kṛtsnaṃ yasya kasya muner matam ||
atra yad visarjanāt pūrvaṃ varayācanaṃ tan matsyapurāṇoktaprakārakam | yat punas tadanantaraṃ tan manu-viṣṇūktaprakāraṃ kāryam iti vivekaḥ | atha vaitayoḥ prakārayoḥ sāgnikānagnikakartṛkakaśrāddhabhedena vyavasthā | ata eva sāgnikaśrāddham adhikṛtya matsyapurāṇe evokam |
visarjya brāhmaṇāṃs tāṃs tu teṣāṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam |
dakṣiṇāṃ diśam ākāṅkṣan pitṝn yāceta sāgnikaḥ ||
atra yadā prāṅmukho varayācanagrahaṇaṃ kuryāt tadā yajñopavīty eva, yadā tu dakṣiṇāmukhas tadā prācīnāvītīti vivecyam | yadā tu pitṝn prārthayate tadā pitṝṇāṃ samukhamve ’pi parokṣavan nirdeśaprasaṅgād aghoratvasadbhāvadurabhiprāyānaucityāpātāc cāghorāḥ pitaraḥ santv ity etāvato lopa iti kaścit |
āha śātātapaḥ |
[1485] abhipretārthasiddhyartham iṣṭān kāmāṃs tu vācayet |
dīrghāḥ sūryahayā nadyo viṣṇos trīṇi padāni ca |
evam eṣāṃ pramāṇena dīrgham āyur avāpnuyām ||
dakṣiṇāyāṃ ca sarvatra bahudeyaṃ tathāstu naḥ |
evam astv iti tair vācyaṃ mūrddhā grāhyaṃ ca tena tat ||
āśīḥpratigrahānantaraṃ yajamānatatputrapautrādayaḥ piṇḍadevatānamaskaraṇaṃ kuryur iti kaścit | iha brāhmaṇavisarjanāt pūrvakālam anvavāyasyāśīḥpratigrahasyānantaraṃ piṇḍoddharaṇaṃ kṛtvā svastivācanaṃ kāryam iti yady api pūrvoktamatsyapurāṇavākye darśitaṃ tathāpi svastivācanāt pūrvaṃ pātrakṣālanaṃ kartavyaṃ |
ata eva pracetāḥ |
tatas tu sthāpayet piṇḍān viprapātrāṇi caiva hi || iti |
akṛtvā tu pātracālanasvastivācane doṣam āha nārāyaṇaḥ |
acālayitvā tat pātraṃ svasti kurvanti ye dvijāḥ |
nirāśāḥ pitaras teṣāṃ śaptvā yānti yathāgati ||
bṛhaspatir api |
bhājaneṣu ca tiṣṭhatsu svasti kurvanti ye dvijāḥ |
tad annam asurair bhuktaṃ nirāśaiḥ pitṛbhir gataiḥ ||
bhaviṣyottare ’pi |
bhājaneṣu ca tiṣṭhatsu svasti kurvanti ye dvijāḥ |
teṣāṃ nirāśāḥ pitaro bhaveyūr ākṣasārditāḥ ||
pātracālane kāṃścit kartṛtvenopadiśya kāṃścin niṣedhati jātūkarṇyaḥ |
[1486] pātrāṇi cālayec chrāddhe svayaṃ śiṣyo ’tha vā sutaḥ |
na strībhir na ca bālena nāsajātyā kathaṃcana ||
nāgarakhaṇḍe ’pi |
na strībhir na ca bālena nānyenaiva ca kenacit |
śrāddhe piṇḍaṃ ca pātraṃ ca svayam eva pracālayet ||
pātrāṇy utthāpayed ity anuvṛttāv āha pracetāḥ |
svayaṃ putro ’tha vā yaś ca vāñched abhyudayaṃ param ||
na striyo na ca bālaś ca nānyajātir na cāvrataḥ |
śrāddhe bhojanapātrāṇi svayam eva pracālayet ||
'svayam' iti punarvacanam ādarārtham | 'anyajātiḥ' yajamānajātim apekṣya hīnajātimān | ‘avrataḥ' anupanītaḥ, anupanītagrahaṇenaiva bālasyāpi nivṛttau siddhāyāṃ bālagrahaṇam upanītāder apy ajñasya nivṛttyartham, ajñe ’pi bālaśabdaprayogadarśanāt |
bhaviṣyottare |
cālayed viprapātrāṇi svayaṃ śiṣyo ’tha vā sutaḥ |
na strī pracālayet tāni hīnajātir na cāgrajaḥ ||
'agrajaḥ' jyeṣṭhabhrātā, yajamānam apekṣyādhikavayasko vā, brāhmaṇo vā, sa ca svāpekṣayā hīnajātīyena kṣatriyādinā śrāddhe kriyayāṇe [kriyamāṇe?] pātrāṇi na cālayet | etac ca prāyeṇottamajātīyopalakṣakaṃ bhavitum arhati | atra svastivācanādivisarjanānteṣu padārtheṣu nānākramasaṃgrahārtham avicchinnāny eva vacanāni likhyante |
pātracālanānantaram āha yājñavalkyaḥ | i
[1487] svastivācyaṃ tataḥ kuryād akṣayyodakam eva ca |
datvā tu dakṣiṇāṃ śaktyā svadhākāram udāharet ||
vācyatām ity anujñātaḥ prakṛtebhyaḥ svadhocyatām |
brūyura stu svadhety ukte bhūmau siñcet tato jalam |
viśvedevāḥ prīyantāṃ vipraiś vokta idaṃ japet ||
dātāro no ’bhivardhantām ityādi |
ity uktvoktvā priyā vācaḥ praṇipatya visarjayet |
vāje vāja iti prītaḥ pitṛpūrvaṃ visarjanam ||
yasmiṃs te saṃsravāḥ pūrvam arghyapātre niveśitāḥ |
pitṛpātraṃ tad uttānaṃ kṛtvā viprān visarjayet ||
‘svastivācyaṃ' svastivācanam | tac ca oṃ svasti bhavanto bruvantv ity evaṃvidhapraiṣarūpam eke manyante | svastīti brūte tv evaṃrūpam apare | pāraskareṇa svasti bhavān brūhīty uktam | brāhmaṇaiś ca oṃ svastīti vaktavyam | tataḥ purūravomārdravaḥsaṃjñakānāṃ viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ dattaṃ śrāddham akṣayyam astv ity abhidhāya vaiśvadevikasyaikaikasya dvijasya haste kuśayavasahitaṃ jalaṃ prakṣipet | vipraiś cāstv akṣayyam iti vaktavyam | tataḥ ṣaṣṭhyantapitrādigotrasaṃbandhanāmābhidhānapūrvakaṃ dattaṃ śrāddham akṣayyam astv ity uccārya krameṇa pṛthak pitryaviprakareṣu jalaṃ niṣiñcet vipraiś cāstv akṣayyam iti vaktavyam |
atrāha vṛddhaśātātapaḥ |
pitṝṇāṃ nāmagotreṇa kare deyaṃ tilodakam |
pratyekaṃ pitṛtīrthena akṣayyam idam astv iti ||
tato rajatavarjaṃ suvarṇādidravyarūpāṃ sāmyaguṇatāratamyaṃ puraskṛtya [1488] vaiṣamyeṇa vā yathāśakti vaiśvadevikadvijebhyo dakṣiṇāprakaraṇoktaprakāreṇa dakṣiṇāṃ datvā pitryebhyo rajatamayīṃ suvarṇādidravyamayīṃ vā yathāvibhavaṃ tathaiva tāṃ dadyāt | tataḥ svadhāṃ vācayiṣya iti viprān anujñāpya taiś ca vācyatām ity anujñāto ’mukagotrebhyo ’mukapitṛbhyo ’mukaśarmebhyaḥ sapatnīkebhyo vasurūpebhyaḥ svadhocyatām ity abhidadhīta |
ayaṃ ca svadhāvācanapraśnottaraprakāro atriṇā darśitaḥ |
vācayisye svardhā praśnam itthaṃ kuryād vijātiṣu |
vācyatām ity anujñāṃ tu prītā dadyuḥ samāhitāḥ ||
vadec ca tāṃs tato viprān pitrādibhyaḥ svadhocyatām |
astu svadheti taiḥ prokte niṣicyodīrya nityaśaḥ ||
(nir)deśayiṣyate (?) cāyaṃ prakāraḥ kātyāyana-gobhilavacanābhyām |
vipraiś ca astu svadhety ukte saty ūrjaṃ vahantīr amṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ payaḥ kīlālaṃ parisrutaṃ svadhā sthas tarpayata me pitṝn ity etaṃ mantram uccārya bhūmau jaladhārāṃ pātayet |
etac ca saviśeṣam uktaṃ kālakāpurāṇe |
bhūmau kirec chanair vatsa dhārāṃ caiva tilodakīm |
śucir bhūtvā tato yācet visarjya ca dvijān idam ||
atra keṣāṃcit śrāddhakalpe ṛce tvā ṛce tvā samyak sravanti sarito na dhenā antarhṛdā manasā pūyamānāḥ ghṛtasya dhārā abhivākaśīmi (?) hiraṇmayo vetaso madhye āsāṃ tasmin suparṇo madhumatkulāpī bhajann āste madhudevatābhyaḥ | tasya sate haraye saptatīrasvadhāṃ duhānāṃ amāttarathaṃ dhārām ity anena mantreṇa svadhādhārāprapātanam uktam | atraike dhārāniṣecanānantaraṃ svadhā saṃpadyatām iti bhavanto bruvanv iti yajamānena [1489] ukte saṃpadyatāṃ svadheti brāhmaṇair vaktavyam ity āhuḥ | kecic cārghyapātrasthitapavitrasahitān bhūmau darbhān āstīrya tatra svadhodakaniṣecanaṃ kurvanti | kātyāyanavacane caitad darśayiṣyate | kecit tu piṇḍānām upari svadhodakaṃ niṣiñcanti |
uktaṃ ca matsyapurāṇe |
svadhāvācanikaṃ sarvaṃ piṇḍopari samācaret || iti |
kecic cārghyasaṃsravajalena svadhāvācanam ācaranti |
uktaṃ ca brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
tataḥ saṃsravapātrebhyo jalam ādāya cārcitam |
ūjraṃ vahantīś ca japan piṇḍāṃś cāpy avasiñcati ||
atra atri-viṣṇu-manubhiḥ svadhāvācanapraśaṃsā darśitā |
svadhāstv iti ca taṃ brūyuḥ brāhmaṇās tadanantaram |
svadhākāraḥ parā hy āśīḥ sarveṣu pitṛkarmasu ||
viśvedevāḥ prīyantām iti yajamānena vaiśvadevikān viprān pratyukte vipraiś ca prīyantāṃ viśvedevā iti vaktavyam |
prītivācane prakāraviśeṣo brahmavaivarte darśitaḥ |
savyavad devatīrthena yavodakam atho dadet |
viśvedevāś ca yajñe 'smin prīyantām ity udāharet ||
dadet vaiśvadevikadvijahaste śrāddhakartā | tadanantaraṃ prīyantām iti pitryaviprān prati yajamānenokte sati vipraiś ca prīyantāṃ pitara iti vaktavyam | tadanantaraṃ dātāra ityādikam āśīḥślokaṃ paṭhet | ity uktvā [1490] dātāra ityādikaṃ ślokam uktvā dhanyo ’ham anugṛhīto ’haṃ bhavadbhir madanugrahārtham etāvataṃ kleśam aṅgīkṛtavanto bhavantaḥ yathā kathaṃcit saṃpāditenāśanena yūyam evaṃvidhāḥ śramaṃ prāpitāḥ stha tad asmākaṃ sarvaṃ bhavadbhiḥ kṣantavyam | bhavatprasādād adya me pitaraḥ svargalokaṃ prāptā ityādirūpā dvijān prati priyā vācaś ca vadet |
bṛhaspatiproktaḥ priyavāgrūpo mantraś ca japtavyaḥ | sa ca —
adya me saphalaṃ janma bhavatpādābhivandanāt |
adya me vaṃśajāḥ sarve yātā vo ’nugrahād divam ||
patraśākādidānena kleśitā yūyam īdṛśāḥ |
tatkleśajātaṃ cittaṃ tu vismṛtya kṣantum arhatha || iti |
tadanantaraṃ sarvaṃ saṃpūrṇam astv iti viprāḥ prārthayitavyāḥ |
tathā ca viṣṇuḥ |
mantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ saṃpaddhīnaṃ dijottamāḥ |
śrāddhaṃ saṃpūrṇatāṃ yātu prasādād bhavatāṃ mama || iti |
vipraiś ca sarvaṃ saṃpūrṇam ity uktvā annaguṇapraśaṃsā kartavyā |
tathā ca vasiṣṭhaḥ |
śrāddhāvasāne kartavyā dvijair annaguṇastutiḥ || iti |
atra guṇastutiḥ madhurādiguṇānāṃ pṛthak pṛthak na kartavyā kiṃ tu śobhanaṃ havir ity evam eva |
tathā ca smṛtiḥ |
havirguṇā na vaktavyā vaktavyaṃ śobhanaṃ havir || iti |
[1491] tadanantaraṃ bhūmau jānunī nidhāya tān viprān praṇamya visarjayet |
tathā ca viṣṇudharmottare |
jānubhyām avaniṅ gatvā praṇipatya visarjayet || iti |
visarjanaṃ nāma brāhmaṇānām āsanebhya utthāpanam |
ata eva mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |
vāje vājeti tūtthāpya kṛtvā caiṣāṃ pradakṣiṇam |
etac ca nyubjīkṛtapitṛpātrottānaṃ kṛtvā kartavyam | tac ca
vāje vāje vata vājino no dhanaṣu viprā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ |
asya madhvaḥ pivata mādayadhvaṃ tṛptā yāta pathibhir devayānaiḥ ||
ity etaṃ mantram uccārayatā kartavyam |
śaunakena tu |
upacīyoṃ svadheti visṛjed astu svadheti cety uktam |
maitrāyaṇīyasūtre tu |
praṇavam uktvā svadhāstv iti visarjayet || iti |
darbhāgreṇa visarjanaṃ kartavyam |
tathā ca matsyapurāṇe |
vāje vāja iti japan kuśāgreṇa visarjayet |
apasavyena kartavyaṃ sarvaṃ śrāddhaṃ yathāvidhi |
sūktastotrajapaṃ kṛtvā viprāṇāṃ ca visarjanam ||
kuśāgreṇaikaikaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dakṣiṇakareṇa spṛśann utthāpayed ity arthaḥ | atraikaikasmin brāhmaṇe mantraṃ parisamāpyaikaikasya brāhmaṇasyotthāpane kriyamāṇe bahūnāṃ yugapad ekapraiṣānvayenaivopapadyamānaṃ (?) yātetimantragataṃ bahuvacanam [1492] avivakṣitaṃ syāt | ataḥ krameṇa sarvān darbhagreṇa spṛśan sakṛn mantram uccārayan yugapat pitrān pūrvam utthāpyānantaraṃ vaiśvadevikān utthāpayet | tadanantaram evaṃ mātāmahe ’py utthāpayet |
ata eva viṣṇudharmottare |
paścād visarjayed devān pūrvaṃ paitāmahān dvijān |
mātāmahānām apy evaṃ saha devaiḥ kramaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
pracetā api |
svastivācyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pitṛpūrvaṃ visarjanam |
atra viprāṇām utthāpanenaiva tatrāvāhitadevapitṝṇām apy udvāsanaṃ siddham iti | yady api tat smṛtiṣu pṛthak noktaṃ tathāpi tadanusaṃdhānārtham uttiṣṭhata pitaro devaḥ saheti vaktavyam |
akṣayyodakam uktvāha kātyāyanaḥ |
aghorāḥ pitaraḥ santu santv ity ukte, gotraṃ vardhatāṃ vardhatām ity ukte,
dātāro no ’bhivardhantāṃ vedāḥ santatir eva ca |
śraddhā ca no mā vyagamad bahudeyaṃ ca no ’stu ||
iti āśiṣaḥ pratigṛhya svadhāvācanīyān sapavitrān kuśān āstīrya svadhāṃ vācayiṣya iti pṛcchati vācyatām ity anujñātaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ pitāmahebhyaḥ prapitāmahebhyo mātāmahebhyaḥ pramātāmahebhyaḥ vṛddhapramātāmahebhyaś ca svadhocyatām ity astu svadhety ucyamāne svadhāvācanīyeṣv apo niṣiñcaty uttānaṃ pātraṃ kṛtvā yathāśakti dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād viśvedevāḥ prīyantām iti daive japitvā vāje vāja iti visṛjyāmāvājasyety anuvrajya pradakṣiṇīkṛtyopaviśet |
atra sāṃpradāyikā vyācakṣate | svadhāvācanārtham upakalpitāḥ kuśāḥ [1493] 'svadhāvācanīyāḥ' pavitrāṇy arghyapātrasthitāni āstīrya piṇḍānām uttarato dakṣiṇāgrān teṣu piṇḍāvanejanapātrasthitam udakaṃ dakṣiṇakare gṛhītvā ūrjaṃ vahantīr ityādikaṃ mantram uccārya tṛpyateti trir uktvā pitṛtīrthena niṣecanīyam | visarjane kṛte gṛhān nirgacchato brāhmaṇānām āvājasyety etatpratīkavatā mantreṇānuvrajya dvāram āgatān pādaprakṣālanamaṇḍalapradeśe cordhvībhūtān anenaiva mantreṇa pradakṣiṇīkṛtya,
āyuḥ prajāṃ dhanaṃ vidyāṃ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ sukhāni ca |
prayacchantu tathā rājyaṃ prītā nṝṇāṃ pitāmahāḥ ||
ityādikā brahmapurāṇoktā āśiṣaḥ pratigṛhya tān upaveśyopaviśet |
brahmavaivarte |
dadyād athākṣayajalaṃ tilājyamadhusaṃyutam |
daridro ’pi yathāśaktyā dadyād vipreṣu dakṣiṇām ||
kṣamāpya viprān brūyāt tu prāñjaliḥ sa ca śāśvatān |
aghorāḥ pitaraḥ santu māṃ pratīti samāhitaḥ ||
te ca taṃ praṇataṃ brūyur bhavantu ca sanātanāḥ |
pitṛbhis tuṣṭais tṛptaiś ca māmakaṃ susamāhitaiḥ |
gotraṃ pravardhatāṃ putra jananārogyapuṣṭidaiḥ ||
tatas te ūcuḥ sarve ’pi vardhatām iti sādaram |
prāñjaliś ca tataḥ prāha sa ca tat satyavādinaḥ ||
dātāro no ’bhivardhantām annaṃ ca na itīva hi |
evam astv iti te taṃ ca kathayanti samāhitāḥ ||
atha caivaṃ kṛte vipro brūyāc ca jalapūrvakam |
viśvedevāñ ca prīyantām iti mantraṃ samāhitaḥ |
[1494] evam astv iti te taṃ ca kathayanti prahṛṣṭavat ||
visarjayec ca pitaro vāje vāja iti smaran |
anuvrajet pitṝn sarvān supuṇyaṃ vimukhe sthitān ||
amāvājeti mantraṃ tu paṭhitvā ca pradakṣiṇam |
dvāropānte tataḥ kṛtvā saṃyataḥ praviśed gṛhe ||
āmāvājasyetyādikaṃ tu samagraṃ mantram āha gobhilaḥ |
aghorāḥ pitaraḥ santu santv ity ukte, gotraṃ no vardhatāṃ vardhatām ity ukte svadhāninayanīyān sapavitrān kuśān āstīrya svadhāṃ vācayiṣya iti pṛcchati vācyatām ity anujñātaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ pitāmahebhyaḥ prapitāmahebhyo mātāmahebhyaḥ pramātāmahebhyo vṛddhapramātāmahebhyaś ca svadhocyatām ity astu svadhety ucyamāne svadhāninayanīyeṣu dhārāṃ dadyād ūrjaṃ vahantīr iti, viśvedevāḥ prīyantām iti daive vācayitvā piṇḍapātrāṇi cālayitvā yathāśakti dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt | dātāro na ityādyā āśiṣaḥ pratigṛhya vāje vāja iti visṛjya,
āmāvājasya prasavojagamyā dyāvā pṛthivī viśvarūpe |
āmāgantāṃ pitarā mātarā cāmāsomo ’mṛtatvena gamyāt ||
ity etayānuvrajyābhivādya pradakṣiṇīkṛtya vāmadevyaṅgītvopaviśati | vāmadevyaṃ nāma sāma tad gītvā | chandogaviṣayam etat | brāhmaṇān upaveśyopaviśed yajamānaḥ tatas tāṃs tāmbūladānādinā paritoṣayet | tadanantaraṃ ca teṣāṃ svasthānagamanārthaṃ punar viṣarjanaṃ kāryam |
tathā ca śātātapaḥ |
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu śaktyā dadyāc ca dakṣiṇām |
pratigṛhyāśiṣaṃ teṣāṃ kṛtvā viprān pradakṣiṇam ||
[1495] tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya punas teṣāṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ |
uktvā caiva priyāṃ vācaṃ praṇipatya vimarjayet ||
asya ca visarjanasya dvijacaraṇāvamardanapūrvakatvaṃ kiyadadhvānuvrajanavaiśiṣṭaṃ coktaṃ nāgarakhaṇḍe |
pādāvamardanaṃ kṛtvā āsīmāntam anuvrajet |
'āsīmāntaṃ' svagṛhasīmāparyantam |
matsyapurāṇe tv anuvrajane maryādāntaraṃ viśeṣāntarasahitam uktam |
bahiḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt padāny aṣṭāv anuvrajet |
bandhuvargeṇa sahitaḥ putrabhāryāsamanvitaḥ ||
anuvrajya nivarteta |
atra visarjane kramaviśeṣo nivartane brāhmaṇānujñāgrahaṇaṃ coktaṃ
vārāha-viṣṇupurāṇayoḥ |
visarjanaṃ ca prathamaṃ pitrye mātāmaheṣu ca |
visarjayet prītimanāḥ saṃmānyābhyarcya tāṃs tataḥ |
nivartetābhyanujñāta ādhārāt tān anuvrajet ||
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe ’pi |
visarjayet priyāṇy uktvā praṇipatya ca bhaktitaḥ |
ādhāram anugacchet tu āgacchec cānumoditaḥ ||
'anugacchet' brāhmaṇān anuvrajet | 'ādhāraṃ' niveśanadvāraparyantam | 'anumoditaḥ' brāhmaṇair anujñātaḥ |
atra nāgarakhaṇḍe akṣayyādayaḥ padārthāḥ svadhāvācanaprakārāntarasahitā darśitāḥ |
[1496] akṣayyaṃ salilaṃ deyaṃ ṣaṣṭhyā caiva tataḥ param |
pavitrāṇi samādāya oṃ svadheti ca kīrtayet ||
astu svadheti tair ukee piṇḍopari vinikṣipet |
tato madhu samādāya pāyasaṃ ca tilodakam ||
ūrjaṃ veti ca mantreṇa pitṝṇām upari kṣipet
uttānam atha pātraṃ tu kṛtvā dadyāc ca dakṣiṇām ||
hiraṇyaṃ devatānāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ rajataṃ tathā |
tataḥ svastyudakaṃ dadyāt pitṛpūrvaṃ ca savyataḥ |
tataḥ kṛtvāñjalir bhūtvā prārthayet pārthivottama |
dātāro no ’bhivardhantām ityādi |
vāje vāje vartety evaṃ visṛjet tān dvijottamān |
āmāvājasyety etena pradakṣiṇam atha kramet |
visarjanaṃ ca kurvīta vinayena samanvitaḥ ||
'tata' iti brāhmaṇakareṣu puṣpākṣataṃ datvārghyapātrasthitāni pavitrāṇy ādāya piṇḍānām upari sthāpayitvā madhupāyasatilamiśram udakaṃ pātre gṛhītvā ūrjaṃ veti mantram uccārya pitṝṇāṃ piṇḍānām upari piteṣu (?) pavitreṣu dhārayā tad udakaṃ ninayet | tato ’rghyapātrottānatādi kuryād itya rthaḥ |
piṇḍapūjānantaraṃ vārāha-viṣṇupurāṇayor uktam |
pūjayitvā dvijāgryāṇāṃ dadyād ācamanaṃ budhaḥ |
paitrebhyaḥ prathamaṃ bhaktyā tanmanasko dvijeśvaraḥ |
susvadhety āśiṣā yuktāṃ dadyāc chaktyā ca dakṣiṇām ||
[1497] datvā ca dakṣiṇāṃ tebhyo vācayed vaiśvadevikān |
prīyantām iti ye viśvedevās te va itīrayet ||
tatheti cokte tair vipraiḥ prārthanīyās tathāśiṣaḥ |
visarjanaṃ tu kurvīta tato bhaktisamanvitaḥ ||
mānavamaitrāyaṇīyasūtre |
ucchiṣṭebhyaḥ utthāya vāje vāja ity abhivrajya śramāvājasyeti pradakṣiṇaṃ
kṛtvā rajataṃ dadyāt |
saurapurāṇe |
hastaprakṣālanaṃ datvā kuryād vai svastivācanam |
dadyād vai dakṣiṇāṃ śaktyā svadhākāram udīrayet ||
dātāro no ’bhivardhantāṃ vāje vājeti vai ṛcam |
japtvā tu brāhmaṇān stutvā namaskṛtya visarjayet ||
vāyupurāṇa-brahmapurāṇayoḥ |
svadhāṃ vācya tato viprān vidhivat bhūridakṣiṇān |
annaśeṣam anujñāpya satkṛtya dvijasattamān |
prāñjaliḥ prayataś caiva anugamya visarjayet ||
bṛhaspatiḥ |
vāje vāja iti procya brāhmaṇāṃs tān visarjayet |
viprān pradakṣiṇīkṛtya pitṛbhyaḥ prārthayed varān ||
śaṅkhaḥ |
bhojayitvā dvijān bhaktyā svadhāntān dattadakṣiṇān |
[1498] svasti vācya dvijān bhaktyā anuvrajya visarjayet ||
hārītaḥ |
pratyācānteṣu samūladarbhatilaṃ brāhmaṇapāṇiṣu ninayet oṃ svadhety āhur astu svadheti pratyāhuḥ | tato ’nujñāvacanam abhiramyatām ity eke ’bhiratāḥ smeti pratyāhur vāje vāja ity abhivrajya piṇḍān pitṛyajñavan nidadhyāt |
uśanāḥ |
svardhā vācayet piṇḍān avadhāya toyena pratiṣicyodakabhājanāny utsṛjet |
svadhāvācanānantaram āha atriḥ |
āyuḥputradhanārogyaśāntyarthaṃ caiva vācayet |
dvijān iti śeṣaḥ |
sāgnikaṃ tu praty āha vyāghraḥ |
akṣayyam annadānaṃ ca vācyaṃ prītair dvijātibhiḥ |
agniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇāṃs tu visarjayet ||
nigamaḥ |
svastivācya oṃ svadhocyatām ity uktvābhiramyatāṃ yathāsukham iti ca saṃpūjyānuvrajet |
devalaḥ |
atha vā vaiśvadaivatyān brāhmaṇān svasti vācayet |
akṣayyaṃ vācayet pitryāṃś caramaṃ satilodakam ||
atha viprān gṛhītārthān saṃtṛptān abhivādayet |
yathāvad vaiśvadaivatyān pitṛpūrvaṃ punaḥ pitṝn ||
pūrvam utthāpayet pitryān ṛdhyatām iti ca bruvan |
[1499] utthitān anugacchec ca tebhyaḥ śeṣaṃ ca saṃharet ||
brahmapurāṇe |
akṣayyam astv iti pitṝn prīyantām iti devatāḥ |
prīṇayitvā parāvṛtya trir japed aghamarṣaṇam ||
tato vivṛtya ca japej janmanāma iti tyṛcam |
vīrānnaḥ pitaro datta vīrāṃś ca pradadau tataḥ ||
arghyapātraṃ tu piṇḍānāṃ antare sapavitrakam |
nikṣipyorjaṃ vahantīti kokātāyam ayojayat ||
himaṃ kṣīraṃ madhu tilān pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ dadau |
svastīty ukte paitṛkais tu viśvān hemnā hy atarpayat ||
rajataṃ dakṣiṇāṃ datvā pitryān devo gadādharaḥ |
saṃvibhāgaṃ manuṣyebhyo dadau svaditi ca bruvan ||
kaccit saṃpannam ity uktvā pratyuktas tair dvijottamaiḥ |
abhiramyatām uvāca procus te ’bhiratāḥ sma vai ||
śiṣṭam annaṃ ca papraccha tair iṣṭaiḥ saha coditaḥ |
pāṇāv ādāya tān viprān kurvaṃś cānugatiṃ tathā ||
vāje vāja iti paṭhan bahirvedyā vinirgataḥ |
koṭitīrthajalenāsāv apasavyaṃ samutkṣipan ||
svalagnān vipulān bālān prārthayāmāsa cāśiṣam |
dātāro no ’bhivardhantāṃ tais tatheti samīritaḥ ||
pradakṣiṇam upāvṛtya kṛtvā pādābhivandanam |
[1500] āsanāni dadau caiṣāṃ śrāvayāmāsa sūkaraḥ |
viśrāmyatāṃ praviśyātha piṇḍaṃ jagrāha madhyamam ||
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
gandhamālyādisaṃyuktān dadyād ācamanaṃ tataḥ |
datvā ca dakṣiṇāṃ śaktyātha svadhāstv iti tān vadet ||
taiś ca tuṣṭais tathety ukte vācayed vaiśvadevikān |
prīyantām iti bhadraṃ vo viśvedevā itīrayan ||
baudhāyanasūtre |
yathopapādaṃ sampūjyākṣayaṃ vācayitvopasaṃgṛhya svadhāṃ vācayitvopasthāpya prasādya pradakṣiṇīkṛtya śeṣam anujñāpya yathā brūyus tathā kuryāt anujñāto dakṣiṇāgniṃ darbhān saṃstīrya piṇḍān dadyāt |
viṣṇuḥ |
tataḥ prāṅmukheṣūdaṅmukhāgrato yan me rāma iti pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā pratyetya ca yathāśakti dakṣiṇāṃ datvābhiramantu bhavanta ity uktvā tair ukte 'bhiratāḥ smeti devāś ca pitaraś cety abhijapet | akṣayyodakaṃ ca nāmagotrābhyāṃ japtvā viśvedevāḥ prīyantām iti ca prāṅmukhebhyaḥ tataḥ prāñjalir idaṃ tanmanāḥ sumanā yāceta dātāro no 'bhivardhantām ityādi |
vāje vāja iti tato brāhmaṇāṃs tān visarjayet |
pūjayitvā yathānyāyam anuvrajyābhivādya ca ||
yan me rāma iti pratīkaviniyukro ’yaṃ mantraḥ | ya nme rāmaḥ śakuniḥ śvāpadaś ca yan me śucir mantrakṛtaś ca prāśata vaiśvānaraḥ savitā tat punātu tasmin pūte devatā mādayantām | tena pūtena pitaro madantāṃ | devāś ca pitaraś cety [1501] ayam api mantro likhyate | devāś ca pitaraś cety etatpūrtam atropajīvatām asmin loke māṃ dhatta jīvema śaradaḥ śataṃ paśyema śaradaḥ śatam ūrjaṃ dhatta jyotir dhattājaranna āyuḥ | yad antarikṣaṃ pṛthivīm uta dyāṃ yan mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vājihiṃsima | agnir nas tasmād enaso gārhapatyaḥ pramuñcatu cakramayāni duritā |
viṣṇudharmottare |
dadyād ācamanaṃ bhaktyā śraddadhānaḥ samāhitaḥ |
yan me rāmaḥ śakunir iti kṛtvā caiva pradakṣiṇam ||
pratyetya tarpayed vidvān dakṣiṇābhiḥ svaśaktitaḥ |
bhavanto ’bhiramantv iti vācyā viprās tv anantaram ||
tair ukte ’bhiratāḥ smeti dvijānāṃ purataḥ sthitaḥ |
devāś ca pitaraś ceti japen mantram atandritaḥ ||
pitṝṇāṃ nāmagotreṇa jalaṃ deyam anantaram |
brāhmaṇānāṃ dvijair vācyam akṣayyaṃ manujeśvara |
tatas tu prārthanā kāryā mantreṇānena bhūmipa ||
dātāro na ityādi |
vāje vāja iti proktvā kṛtvā caitān pradakṣiṇam |
praṇamya ca tatas tāṃs tu bhaktyā viprān visarjayet ||
kaṭhasūtre |
tṛptān ācāmayitvā yan me rāma iti pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā pratyetyābhiramantu bhavanta ity uktvā devāś ca pitaraś cety anuvākaśeṣeṇopatiṣṭheta |
pippalādasūtre |
ācamanīyaṃ datvā dakṣiṇaṃ dadyāt | putrān pautrān ity ekam udapātram [1502] āpo ’gnim iti dvitīyaṃ dvābhyāṃ tṛtīyam udapātraśeṣaṃ brāhmaṇahasteṣu ninayet pitṛbhyaḥ pitāmahebhyaḥ prapitāmahebhyaḥ svadhāvad astv akṣayyam astv iti brāhmaṇavacanaṃ dātāro na ityādivarān yācitvā namo vaḥ pitara iti namaskaroti parāyata iti dvābhyāṃ parāṇīya vāje vāja iti japet | sūryasyāvṛttam iti pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya mano ’nvāhuvāmaha ity ukaṃ piṇḍapitṛyajñenopavītiviśeṣasya |
kauśikasūtre |
ācamanīyaṃ datvā puṇyāhaṃ vācayed dakṣiṇāṃ ca datvā yathāśakty udapātraśeṣaṃ sapavitreṣu brāhmaṇahasteṣu ninayet putraṃ pautram ity ekam āpo ’gnim iti dvitīyaṃ yuktābhyāṃ tṛtīyaṃ putraṃ pautram ity ekayaivodapātram iti kauśikaḥ | prapitāmahebhyaḥ pitāmahebhyaḥ pitṛbhyo mātulamātāmahebhyo nirdiṣṭaṃ tebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ sapatnīkebhyaḥ svadhāvad akṣayyam astu akṣayyam astv iti brāhmaṇavacanād dātāro no ’bhivardhantām ityādi varān yācitvā namo vaḥ pitara ityevamādi mano ’nvāhuvāmaha ity evamantaṃ ye samānāḥ sapiṇḍāḥ pitṛyajñe madhyamapiṇḍapradāne ceti vāje vāje vata vājina ityādinā brāhmaṇān hasteṣu gṛhītvotthāpya pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt | eṣa śrāddhavidhiḥ |
atra pātrottānatākaraṇanānāmuniproktān kramān upasaṃgṛhya saṃgrahakāraḥ kathitavān |
yājñavalkyo visargāt prāk pātram uttānam icchati |
yamo visarjanaṃ kṛtvā gṛhyakṛc cāpi śaunakaḥ |
prītipraśnān tu devānāṃ pūrvaṃ kātyāyanādayaḥ ||
eṣāṃ ca pakṣāṇām āśīrgrahaṇapakṣavad vyavasthā vaktavyā |
[1503] atra svadhāvacanānantaraṃ pavitravimocanam uktvā pātrottānatām āha śāṭyāyaniḥ |
mātāmahānām apy evaṃ tato darbhapavitrake |
piṇḍapārśve tato muktvā nyubjaṃ pātraṃ vivartayet ||
prītivācanāt pūrvaṃ puṇyāhavācanākhyaṃ padārthaṃ svastivācanānantaraṃ pātrottānatāṃ cāha pracetāḥ |
oṃ puṇyāhaṃ viśvedevāḥ prīyantām iti vācayet |
vādam ity evam uktvāsau dakṣiṇāṃ śrāvayet tataḥ ||
svastivācyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā nyubjaṃ pātraṃ vivartayet |
visarjayet tatas tāṃs tu bahiś caiva pradakṣiṇam ||
kṛtvā viśrāmya tatraitān saṃmānya ca punas tathā |
visṛjed bhaktisaṃyuktaḥ sīmāntaṃ cāpy anuvrajet |
nivartetābhyanujñātas tair vipraiḥ svagṛhaṃ prati ||
āha devalaḥ |
nirvartya pitṛmedhaṃ tu dīpaṃ pracchādya pāṇinā |
ācamya pāṇī prakṣālya jñātīn śeṣeṇa bhojayet ||
pracchādyeti nirvāpya |
iti suprokṣitādayaḥ padārthaḥ |
atha piṇḍapratipattayaḥ |
tāś ca piṇḍaprāśanavarjaṃ patnyasaṃnidhānādinimittavihitapratipattivarjaṃ darśayiṣyamāṇāt saṃyogapṛthaktvān nityakāmyarūpatvena dvyātmikāḥ | [1504] tatra kālaviśeṣaviśiṣṭaṃ pratipattidvayam āhatuḥ śaṅkhalikhitau |
evaṃ varān yācitvā namaskṛtya piṇḍān agnau vāpsu vā kṣiped iti namaskṛtya brāhmaṇān | ayaṃ ca karmasamāpyātmakaḥ kṣamāpanarūpo namaskāro jñeyaḥ |
viṣṇudharmottare tu pratipatticatuṣṭayam uktam |
piṇḍāṃś ca go’javiprebhyo dadyād agnāv atha kṣipet || iti |
devalas tu pratipattipañcakam āha |
tataḥ karmaṇi nirvṛtte tān piṇḍāṃs tadanantaram |
brāhmaṇo ’gnir ajo gaur vā bhakṣayed apsu vā kṣipet ||
yājñavalkyo ’py āha |
piṇḍāṃs tu go’javiprebhyo dadyād agnau jale ’pi vā |
prakṣiped dakṣiṇām icchan diśaṃ pitṛparāyaṇaḥ ||
manus tv etām eva pañcavidhāṃ pratipattim abhidhāya ṣaṣṭhīm apy ekīyamatena darśitavān |
evaṃ nirvapaṇaṃ kṛtvā piṇḍāṃs tāṃs tadanantaram |
gāṃ vipram ajam agniṃ vā prāśayed apsu vā kṣipet |
vayobhiḥ khādayanty anye prakṣipanty analeṣu vā ||
analeṣu veti pūrvoktasyaivānuvāda (?) iti [on MDh 3.251] medhātithiḥ |
pādma-mātsyayos tu saptavidhā pratipattir uktā |
piṇḍāṃs tu go’javiprebhyo dadyād agnau jale ’pi vā |
viprānte vātha vikired vayobhir atha vāśayet ||
atra piṇḍānvāhāryakaśrāddhasaṃbandhinaḥ piṇḍān prakṛtya kālikāpurāṇe |
[1505] avajighret tato gatvā piṇḍāṃs tāṃś ca samāhitaḥ |
tebhyo bhūyo ’lpikāṃ mātrām ādāya prāśayed imān ||
pitāvatiṣṭhate vatsa taṃ caivāpy evam āśayet |
taccheṣam agnau vipre vā apsu go'jāmukhe huvet ||
piṇḍān eva tato yatnāt pitṝn dhyāyan vicakṣaṇaḥ |
pṛṣṭhataś ca tato kṛtvā naivekṣed vartrya (?) cānanam ||
yadi jīvatpitṛkaḥ śrāddhakartā tarhi piṇḍamātrāṃ taṃ (?) pitaram āśayet | agnyādau huteṣu piṇḍeṣu tatas tān pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā mukhaṃ parāvṛtya nāvekṣeta | piṇḍamātrāśanavidhis tu piṇḍapradānaprakaraṇa eva darśitaḥ |
yamena tv ekaikasya piṇḍasya pṛthak pṛthak pratipattir uktā |
apasv ekaṃ plāvayet piṇḍam ekaṃ patnyai nivedayet |
ekaṃ ca juhuyād agnau trayaḥ piṇḍāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
vārāhapurāṇe ’pi |
juhvate prathamaṃ tv agnau patnyai deyaṃ tu madhyamam |
tṛtīyam udake dadyāc cheṣaṃ vā lehayet svayam |
kṣāmayec ca namaskṛtya bhūmiṃ daivīṃ tadantare ||
ābhiś ca pratipattibhiḥ prīṇanīyān āha yamaḥ |
yat piṇḍaṃ plāvayaty apsu candraṃ prīṇāti tena saḥ |
śaśī prīṇayate devān pitṝṃś caiva mahāyaśāḥ ||
yat tathā madhyamaṃ piṇḍaṃ patnī prāśnāti vāgyatā |
putrakāmāṃ saputrāṃ tāṃ kurvanti prapitāmahāḥ ||
yad eva prathamaṃ piṇḍaṃ juhoty agnau dvijottamaḥ |
[1506] śāśvatān prāpyate lokāṃs tuṣṭaiḥ sa prapitāmahaiḥ ||
hārītas tv āha |
yad agnāv apsu vipre vā piṇḍān ādadhate punaḥ
tadguṇās te hutā dadyāt yathākāmaṃ viśanti hi ||
agnyādyāśrayatvād agnyādiguṇā ye hutādisaṃjñakāḥ (?) pitaras tāṃs te 'gnyādau pratipāditāḥ piṇḍāḥ 'yathākāmaṃ' ayatnenaiva 'viśanti' praviśanti tarpayantīty arthaḥ | atra madhyamapiṇḍabhakṣaṇasya kāmasaṃbandho viṣṇudharmottare pratipāditaḥ |
madhyamaṃ putrakāmā vā patnī piṇḍaṃ hi bhakṣayet |
āha devalaḥ |
teṣāṃ vā madhyamaṃ piṇḍaṃ putrakāmā hi bhakṣayet |
pitṛprasādāt putraṃ vā labhate hi mahāguṇam ||
tad evaṃ yā sarvathā putraṃ na labhate yā vā guṇavantaṃ na labhate sā tathāvidhaputralābhāya madhyamaṃ piṇḍam aśnīyāt | āvaśyakaś cāyaṃ kāmaḥ, "eṣa vā anṛṇo yaḥ putrīti" śruteḥ | “mahāguṇaṃ sutaṃ sūte” ity uktam |
tatra putraguṇān pratipadapāṭhena bhakṣaṇayogyatāpādakān patnīguṇāṃś cāhatur
manu-bṛhaspatau |
pativratā dharmapatnī pitṛpūjanatatparā |
madhyamaṃ tu tataḥ piṇḍam adyāt patnī sutārthinī ||
āyuṣmantaṃ sutaṃ sūte yaśomedhāsamanvitam |
dhanavantaṃ prajāvantaṃ dhārmikaṃ sātvikaṃ tathā ||
bhakṣaṇayogyatāpādakaṃ patnīsaṃbandhiviśeṣāntaram āhatuḥ śaṅkhalikhitau |
[1507] patnī vā madhyamaṃ piṇḍam aśnīyād ārtavānvitā |
'ārttavaṃ' rajaḥ, tannimittaṃ caturthe ’hani snānaṃ kṛtavatī |
asmiṃś ca piṇḍabhakṣaṇe viśeṣam āha hārītaḥ |
yā patnī putrakāmā syān madhyamaṃ piṇḍam aśnuyāt |
prājāpatyena vidhinā sa tasyāḥ putradaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
prajāpatidṛṣṭo vidhiḥ 'prājāpatyaḥ' | sa ca mantraviśeṣeṇa bhakṣaṇam ity evaṃrūpaḥ |
mantraś ca pādma-mātsyayoḥ pratīkena viniyuktaḥ |
patnīṃ tu madhyamaṃ piṇḍam āśayed vinayānvitām |
ādhatta pitaro garbhaṃ mantraḥ santānavardhanaḥ ||
brahmapurāṇe ’pi |
viśrāmya tān praviśyātha piṇḍaṃ jagrāha madhyamam |
chāyāmayī mahāpatnī tasyai piṇḍam adāt prabhuḥ ||
ādhatta pitaro garbham ity uktvā sā surūpiṇī |
piṇḍaṃ gṛhītvā viprāṇāṃ cakre pādābhivandanam ||
amuṃ ca mantraṃ saṃpūrṇam āha āśvalāyanaḥ |
piṇḍānāṃ madhyamaṃ patnīṃ prāśayet ādhatta pitaro garbhaṃ kumāraṃ puṣkarasrajam | yathāyamarayā asad iti | chandogānāṃ tasmin mantre pāṭhāntaram | "ādhatta pitaro garbhaṃ kumāraṃ puṣkarasrajam | yatheha puruṣaḥ syāt" iti |
āpastambas tu bhakṣaṇāya patnīkare piṇḍārpaṇe mantraṃ prāśanamantre apāṃstvoṣadhīnāṃ ca pāṭhāntaram āha |
apāṃ tv oṣadhīnāṃ rasaṃ prāśayāmi bhūtakṛtaṃ garbhaṃ dadhatsveti madhyamaṃ piṇḍaṃ patnyai prayacchaty ādhatta pitaro garbhaṃ [1508] kumāraṃ puṣkarasrajaṃ yatheha puruṣo ’sad iti taṃ patnī prāśnātīti |
bṛhaspatis tu piṇḍabhakṣaṇāyogyāyāṃ patnyāṃ madhyamapiṇḍasya pratipattyantaram āha |
anyadeśagatā patnī garbhiṇī rogiṇī tathā |
tadā taṃ jīrṇavṛṣabhaś chāgo vā bhoktum arhati ||
vāyupurāṇe |
anyadeśagatā patnī naṣṭā vā yadi vā mṛtā |
tatra madhyamapiṇḍasya kā gatiḥ kiṃ prayojanam ||
vatso vā yadi vānaḍvān bhakṣayet tatra madhyamam |
tasminn evātha vā deśe nikṣiped apsu vā tataḥ ||
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe ’pi |
patnī yasya videśasthā ārttavaṃ ca vimuñcati |
śrāddhakāle samutpanne tasya piṇḍasya kā gatiḥ ||
gatavīryas tu yo hy aśvo ’naḍvāṃś caiva tathāvidhaḥ |
tayoḥ piṇḍaḥ pradātavyo yayor bījaṃ na rohati ||
āpastambaḥ |
yadi patnī videśasthā utsṛṣṭā yadi vā mṛtā |
durātmānanukūlā vā tasya piṇḍasya kā gatiḥ ||
ākāśaṃ gamayet piṇḍaṃ jalastho dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ |
pitṝṇāṃ sthānam ākāśaṃ dakṣiṇā caiva dig bhavet ||
athānyā api kāmasaṃbandhayuktāḥ pratipattayaḥ | tatra madhyamaṃ piṇḍaṃ patnīṃ prāśayed ity uktvāha āśvalāyanaḥ | [1509]
apsv itarāv ati praṇīte vā yasya vā gantur anukāmyābhāvaḥ sa prāśnīyāt mahārogeṇa vābhitaptaḥ prāśnīyād anyatarāṃ gatiṃ gacchati | rogavimukte viśiṣṭalokaprāptirūpayor gatyor madhye ’nyatarāṃ prāpnoti |
āpastambena tu yajamānakartṛke piṇḍabhakṣaṇe mantro ’bhihitaḥ |
ye samānāḥ samanaso jīvā jīveṣu māmakāḥ |
teṣāṃ śrīr mayi kalpatām asmin loke śataṃ samāḥ |
ity avaśiṣṭhānām ekaṃ yajamānaḥ prāśnātīti |
atra rogābhitaptena prathamo ’nnādyakāmena tu caramaḥ piṇḍo bhakṣaṇīya iti vivekaḥ |
tathā ca hārītavacane ’nyārthadarśanam |
āyurdaḥ prathamaḥ piṇḍo dvitīyaḥ putradḥ smṛtaḥ ||
ṛddhidas tu tṛtīyo vai tasmān madhyamam āśayet ||
putrakāmā yajamānapatnīti śeṣaḥ |
vāyupurāṇa-brahmāṇḍapurāṇayoḥ |
piṇḍam agnau sadā dadyād bhogārthī satataṃ naraḥ |
patnyai prajārthī dadyād vai madhyamaṃ mantrapūrvakam ||
uttamāṃ gatim anvicchan gobhyo nityaṃ prayacchati |
ājñāṃ prajāṃ yaśaḥ kīrtim apsu piṇḍaṃ nidhāpayet ||
prārthayan dīrgham āyuś ca vāyasebhyaḥ prayacchati |
saukumāryam athānvicchan kukkuṭebhyaḥ prayacchati ||
ākāśaṃ gamayed apsu sthito vā dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ |
pitṝṇāṃ sthānam ākāśaṃ dakṣiṇā dik tathaiva ca || iti |
iti piṇḍapratipattayaḥ |
[1510]
athocchiṣṭodvāsanam |
tatra bhojanadeśasaṃśodhanārthaṃ tadudvāsanaṃ gṛhajanabālabāndhavādibhojanārtham ucchiṣṭasthalādiprakṣālanaṃ cārthaprāptaṃ na śāstre pratipādyate | tatsaṃbandhī tu kālaviśeṣa ucyate | sa ca sūryāstamayāt parato mukhyaḥ pūrvatas tu jaghanyaḥ | tatra jaghanyaniṣedhabhaṅgyā mukhya uktaḥ kūrmapurāṇe |
nodvāsayet taducchiṣṭaṃ yāvan nāstamitā raviḥ |
etāvatkālaparyantaṃ anudvāsanaṃ prayojanasahitam āha vaśiṣṭhaḥ |
śrāddhe nodvāsanīyāni ucchiṣṭānyādinakṣayāt (?) |
ścotante vai sudhādhārās tāḥ pibanty akṛtodakāḥ ||
yāvad ucchiṣṭāni nodvāsyante tāvat tebhyaḥ 'sudhādhārāḥ' amṛtasya dhārāḥ, 'ścotante' niḥsaranti | tāḥ yeṣāṃ pramītānāṃ udakadānaṃ niṣiddham aniṣiddham api vā yeṣāṃ kaiścin na kṛtaṃ te pretādiyonau vartamānāḥ santaḥ pibanti |
kālikāpurāṇe |
ucchiṣṭamārjanaṃ yāvan na kṛtaṃ dvijasattama |
tāvad aśnanti pitaraḥ sudhārasavimiśritam ||
vārāhapurāṇe |
viprocchiṣṭāni yāvanti yāvat tiṣṭhanti bhūtale |
āpyāyamānāḥ pitaras tāvat tiṣṭhanti te gṛhe ||
pitara ity atrocchiṣṭabhāgina iti śeṣaḥ | te ca pūrvoktā akṛtodakāḥ |
ye ca brahmāṇḍapurāṇe darśitāḥ |
ucchiṣṭaṃ na pramṛjyāt tu yāvan nāstamito raviḥ |
kṣīradhārās tato yānty akṣayyāḥ saṃcarabhāginaḥ ||
'saṃcaraḥ' mārgaḥ | etac cāśucipradeśopalakṣaṇam | tataś cāśucipradeśaṃ ye bhajante bhūtapretapiśācādiyonigatāḥ śrāddhakartṛsapiṇḍasamānodakādaya ity arthaḥ |
manur api śrāddhocchiṣṭabhāginaḥ pratipādayati |
uccheṣaṇaṃ bhūmigatam ajihmasyāśaṭhasya ca |
dāsavargasya tat pitrye bhāgadheyaṃ pracakṣate ||
dāsavargo ’tra mukhyapitṛsaṃbandhī pramīto veditavyaḥ |
āha vaśiṣṭhaḥ |
prāk saṃskārāt pramītānāṃ sapreṣyāṇām iti sthitiḥ (śrutiḥ) |
bhāgadheyaṃ manuḥ prāha ucchiṣṭoccheṣaṇe ubhe ||
'bhāgadheyaṃ' bhajanīyo 'ṃśaḥ | ucchiṣṭaṃ nāma bhuñjāneṣu yat pātrakaramukheṣu saṃśliṣyate bhūmau ca papāta, tat tu sutṛptatvena kāraṇāntareṇa vā muhyamānād annarāśer buddhipūrvakam avaśiṣyate tad uccheṣaṇaṃ, tad etad ubhayaṃ 'sampreṣyāṇāṃ’ dāsānāṃ, ‘bhāgadheyam' iti śrutir ity etan manuḥ prāha |
uccheṣaṇam api na pātrasthitaṃ teṣāṃ bhāgadheyaṃ kiṃ tu bhūmau nihitam | atas tad brāhmaṇair buddhipūrvakaṃ bhūmau nidheyam iti gamyate | tac ca pretādiyonigataṃ dāsādivargam uddiśya yajamānena tyājyam |
tad etad āha vaśiṣṭhaḥ |
uccheṣaṇaṃ bhūmigataṃ vikiraṃ lepam audakam |
[1512] anupreteṣu visṛjed aprajānām anāyuṣām ||
anu mukhyapitryanugamanabuddhyā pramītebhyo dāsavargebhyaḥ prajārahitebhyo vālya evaṃ mṛtebhyaś ca visṛjet | amukasmā amukasmai pretāyedam ucchiṣṭam uccheṣaṇaṃ vopatiṣṭhatām ity abhidhāya pitṛtīrthāvapāditena satilena jalena tyajet |
manu-viṣṇū |
asaṃskṛtapramītānāṃ tyāgināṃ kulayoṣitām |
ucchiṣṭaṃ bhāgadheyaṃ syāt darbheṣu vikiraś ca yaḥ ||
'asaṃskṛtāḥ' akṛtopanayanāḥ, akṛtavivāhāś ca striyaḥ | tyāgino nāma jalānalaviṣaśastrodbandhanabhṛgupātādibhir ātmaghātinaḥ | kulayoṣitām akṛtodakānām evam | atha vā kāraṇam antareṇa kulayoṣitāṃ ye tyāgaṃ kṛtavantaḥ teṣām iti vyākhyeyam | astaṃgate ravāv ucchiṣṭodvāsanaṃ uktaṃ tac ca sthalaprakṣālanasyāppupalakṣaṇam |
yat tu,
astaṃgate tataḥ sūrye viprapātrāṇi cāmbhasi |
nikṣipet prayato bhūtvā sarvāṇy adhomukhāny api ||
dvitīye ’hani sarveṣāṃ bhāṇḍānāṃ kṣālanaṃ tathā |
anantā (?) jāyate tṛptiḥ pitṝṇām api sarvadā ||
iti brahmapurāṇe yad astamayānantaraṃ jalamadhye ’nyubjabhojanapātrasthāpanam uktvā dvitīyadine prakṣālanam uktaṃ tatpātrāntarasadbhāve sati veditavyam | yac ca sāyaṃkālaparyantam ucchiṣṭhasthāpanam uktaṃ tad api putramitrādibhojanārthaṃ gṛhāntarasadbhāve sati veditavyam |
[1513] ata evāha pracetāḥ |
bhṛtyavargavṛto bhuṅkte kavyaśeṣaṃ sagotrakaiḥ |
ā sāyaṃ śrāddhaśālāyāṃ dvijocchiṣṭaṃ na mārjayet ||
atra śrāddhaśālāyām ucchiṣṭam iti viśeṣaṇaṃ, tad etasyāṃ bhojanaśālāyāṃ bhuktaṃ iti gamyate |
gṛhāntarabhojanapātrāntarābhāve tu jaghanyaṃ kālāntaraṃ manu-matsyapurāṇayor darśitam |
uccheṣaṇaṃ tu tat tiṣṭhed yāvad viprā visarjitāḥ |
tato gṛhabaliṃ kuryād iti dharmo vyavasthitaḥ ||
amum eva kālaṃ kālāntaraniṣedhabhaṅgyāha yājñavalkyaḥ |
satsu vipreṣu dvijocchiṣṭaṃ na mārjayet || iti |
'satsu’ svasthānagamanārtham avisarjiteṣu |
atra yadi śrāddhabhoktā brāhmaṇena bhojanayogyaṃ kiyad annam uccheṣitam asti tarhi tat tadīyāya śiṣyāya sutāyocchiṣṭabhojanayogyāya dīyamānaṃ na duṣyati śudrādibhyas tu dīyamānaṃ duṣyaty eva |
ata eva śātātapenoktam |
śrāddhaṃ bhuktvā (?) ya ucchiṣṭaṃ vṛṣalāya prayacchati |
sa mūḍho narakaṃ yāti kālasūtram avākśirāḥ ||
anena vṛṣalaniṣedhena bhoktṛdvijocchiṣṭabhojanayogyāya sutaśiṣyabhāryādes traivarṇikāya taducchiṣṭadāpanam anumataṃ bhavati |
traivarṇikāyāpy anupanītāya na dātavyam |
tathā ca brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
[1514] śūdrāya cānupetāya śrāddhocchiṣṭaṃ na dāpayet |
yo dadyād rāgato mohān na tad gacchati vai pitṝn ||
tasmān na deyam ucchiṣṭam annādyaṃ śrāddhakarmaṇi |
anyatra dadhisarpirbhyāṃ śūdrādibhyaḥ kadācana |
kāmaṃ dadyāc ca sarvaṃ tu śiṣyāya ca sutāya ca ||
anyatra dadhisarpirbhyāṃ ity anenocchiṣṭayor dadhisarpiṣor anupanītāya śūdrāya ca dānam anumataṃ kṛtam |
āha jātūkarṇyaḥ |
dvijabhuktāvaśiṣṭaṃ tu sarvam ekatra saṃharet |
śucibhūmau prayatnena nikhatyācchādayed budhaḥ ||
atra tāvat sutaśiṣyādidattāvaśiṣṭaṃ nikhanet | yadi tu tadgrahītāraḥ sutādayo na santi tadā sarvam eva nikhanet | atra yadi dvijavisarjanānantaram evocchiṣṭodvāsanaṃ kriyate tadā tadanantaraṃ śrāddhaśeṣeṇa pañcamahāyajñanirvapaṇaṃ kāryam | yadi tv astamayaparyantaṃ ucchiṣṭāni sthāpyante tadā visarjanānantaram eva | tac ca pūrvam evokta |
ity ucchiṣṭodvāsanam |
atha śeṣabhojanam |
tatra brahmapurāṇe |
evaṃ samyak gṛhasthena devatāḥ pitaras tathā |
saṃpūjyā havyakavyābhyāṃ annenātithibāndhavāḥ ||
bhūtāni bhṛtyā vikalāḥ paśupakṣipipīlikāḥ |
[1515] bhikṣavo yācamānāś ca ye cānye yācakā gṛhe ||
'vikalāḥ' andhabadhiramūkādayaḥ |
manuḥ |
prakṣālya hastāv ācamya jñātiprāyaṃ prakalpayet |
jñātibhyaḥ satkṛtaṃ datvā bāndhavān api pūjayet ||
'jñātayaḥ' pitṛpakṣīyāḥ sapiṇḍāḥ, śrāddhāvaśiṣṭam annaṃ yathā tān prāpnoti tathā kuryāt tenānnena tān bhojayed ity arthaḥ | tebhyaḥ satkārapūrvakaṃ tad annaṃ datvā 'bāndhavān' mātṛśvaśurapakṣīyān, pūjayedity arthaḥ | atra yadi śeṣam annaṃ kiṃ kriyatām iti veditam annaṃ brāhmaṇair asmabhyaṃ dīyatām ity evam uktvā svayaṃ svīkṛtaṃ tadā pākāntareṇa jñātibāndhavādayo bhojanīyāḥ | yadi tv iṣṭhaiḥ saha bhujyatām ity evam anujñātaṃ tadā taccheṣeṇa | atha vā śeṣam annam ity ukte iṣṭebhyo dīyatām iti te brūyur iti nityavad āmnānān na grahītavya eva dvijair annaśeṣa iti tenaiva jñātyādayo bhojanīyāḥ |
devalasmṛti-kūrmapurāṇayoḥ |
prakṣālya hastāv ācamya jñātīn śeṣeṇa bhojayet |
jñātiṣv api ca tṛpteṣu svān bhṛtyān bhojayet tataḥ |
ādityapurāṇa-brahmapurāṇyoḥ |
bhaginyo bāndhavāḥ pūjyāḥ śrāddheṣu ca sadaiva hi |
dāridropahato dīnaś chinnāṅgaś cādhikāṅguliḥ ||
vṛthājātā viraktāś ca vyādhinā ca prapīḍitāḥ |
ete bhojanam arhanti bhoktuḥ sarvatra sarvadā ||
[1516] vandimāgadhasūtāś ca tauryatrikavidas tathā |
alabdhalābhāḥ śrāddheṣu nāśayanti mahad yaśaḥ |
tasmāt te ’pi vibhaktavyāḥ sakalaṃ saṃvibhajya ca ||
‘vṛthājātāḥ’ ṣaṇḍāndhapaṅgvādayaḥ | vandyādayaḥ pūrvam eva vyākhyātāḥ | 'tauryatrikaṃ' nṛtyagītavādyāni | 'alabdhalābhāḥ' aprāptānnāḥ, 'vibhaktavyāḥ' atra bhāginaḥ kartavyā iti | evaṃ jñātyādīn bhojayitvā svayam api bhuñjīta |
tathā ca nigamaḥ |
anujñāto gṛhān bālavṛddhāṃś ca paritoṣya bhuñjīteti |
'anujñātaḥ' iṣṭaiḥ saha bhujyatām ity evaṃ śrāddhabhoktṛbhir anujñātaḥ | anena śrāddhaśeṣam annaṃ bhuñjīta nānyad ity api sūcitam |
ata evāha śātātapaḥ |
śeṣam annam anujñātaṃ bhuñjīta tadanantaram |
iṣṭaiḥ sārddhaṃ tu vidhivad buddhimān susamāhitaḥ ||
'iṣṭaiḥ sārddham' ity anena svapaṅktibhojibhiḥ sahaikapaṅktāv ity ucyate | 'vidhivad' ity anenāpośānādītikartavyatāviśiṣṭatā pātradhāraṇamaunādinityabhojanadharmayuktatā ca pratipāditā | 'buddhimān' bhojanavidhijñaḥ | 'samāhitaḥ' pāṇyādicāpalaracitaḥ |
tatra maunayuktatā bhaviṣyottare darśitā |
mitrabandhujanaiḥ sārddhaṃ śeṣaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ |
'sārddham' ity anenaikapaṅktāv ity api labhyate | evam uttaratrāpi vyākhyeyam | atra jñātibhṛtyabhojanānantaram uktam |
[1517] kūrmapurāṇe |
paścāt svayaṃ ca patnībhiḥ śeṣam annaṃ samācaret |
atra pakṣāntaram api kātyāyanena darśitam |
pūrvo vā gṛhapatir iti |
ato gṛhapatiṃ bhojayitvā patnyo bhuñjīran paṅktau vā |
āha bṛhaspatiḥ |
evaṃ devān pitṝṃś caiva tarpayitvā dvijottamaḥ |
putramitrādisahito gṛhastho bhoktum arhati ||
brahmapurāṇa-mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇayoḥ |
tatas tad annaṃ bhuñjīta saha bhṛtyādibhir naraḥ |
vārāhapurāṇe |
bhuñjīyāc ca samaṃ pūjya bhṛtyabandhubhir ātmanaḥ |
tathānyān prayataḥ samyak sakhisaṃbandhibāndhavān ||
uśanāḥ |
tair anujñāto śeṣam iṣṭebhyo dadyāt svayaṃ ca bhuñjīta |
yājñavalkyaḥ |
pradakṣiṇam anuvrajya bhuñjīta pitṛsevitam |
padmapurāṇe |
iṣṭaiḥ saha tataḥ śānto bhuñjīta pitṛsevitam |
'pitṛsevitaṃ' pitryabrāhmaṇair yad yad annaṃ bhuktaṃ tasya tasya śeṣaṃ bhuñjīta | ataś ca yat pramādena śrāddhabhoktṛbhyo na dattaṃ tan na bhokavyam eveti gamyate | pitṛniṣevitaṃ ca sarvam api stokaṃ stokaṃ bhoktavyam |
[1518] tathā ca matsyapurāṇe |
tatas tu vaiśvadevānte sabhṛtyasutabāndhavaḥ |
bhuñjītātithisaṃyuktaḥ sarvaṃ pitṛniṣevitam ||
atra māṣamāṃsādikaṃ pitṛniṣevitam apy anvādhānakṛtā śrāddhe na bhakṣayitavyam, “amāṣam amāṃsaṃ vrataṃ vratayet” iti śrutyā pratiṣedhāt | akṛtānvādhānenānagninā ca pañcadaśyām api pitṛniṣevitaṃ māṃsādikaṃ bhakṣayitavyaṃ "pitṛniṣevitaṃ sarvaṃ bhuñjīta” iti vacanāt | yas tu “hanyād āsaptamaṃ kulaṃ māṃsāśane pañcadaśī” iti niṣedhaḥ, sa rāgaprāptabhakṣaṇaviṣayatvān na vaidhaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ bādhituṃ kṣamate | yenāpy amukakālaparyantaṃ sarvadā vā madhumāṃsādikaṃ mayā na bhakṣyam iti niyamo ’bhyupagataḥ tenāpi tac chrāddhādau bhakṣaṇīyam |
tathā ca bṛhaspatiḥ |
kratau śrāddhe tadaṅgatvād viprājñābhaṅgato vṛtaḥ |
bhakṣyatvād anuyoge ’pi khādan māṃsāny api vratī ||
'kratau' paśubandhe, śrāddhe ca bhavatāsmin bhojane māṃsaṃ bhakṣaṇīyam ity evaṃvidhāyā viprājñāyāḥ 'abhaṅgataḥ' abhaṅgahetoḥ, yajamānaḥ tena ca yaḥ ‘vṛtaḥ’ ṛtvik, saḥ ‘anuyoge
pi' abhakṣaṇavrate 'pi, māṃsāny api khādan vraty eva bhavati | na tu bhagnavrataḥ māṃsāny apīty anena kim utānyat khādann iti sūcitam |
tathā |
rogeṇa yuktā vidhivad dhutaṃ vipravṛtas tathā |
māṃsam adyāc caturṣv eṣā parisaṃkhyā prakīrtitā ||
[1519] 'rogeṇa’ māṃsabhakṣaṇaikacikitsyena | 'vidhivat' madhuparkaśrāddhādividhiniveditam | 'hutaṃ' paśubandhe yajamānaḥ, tena ca vipreṇa vṛtaḥ ṛtvik vratavān api māṃsam adyāt | eṣā caiteṣu caturṣu sthāneṣu 'parisaṃkhyā' māṃsabhakṣaṇaniyamasya vyāvṛttiḥ | anye tv abhakṣaṇavrate śrāddhe tadavaghrāṇam āhuḥ |
tathā ca jātūkarṇyaḥ |
madhumāṃsanivṛttas tu śrāddhe karmāṇi cācaret |
pātrasthaṃ gandham āghrāya pitṝṇām anṛṇo bhavet || iti |
'pātrasthaṃ' bhojanapātrasthitamāṃsādyāśritaṃ, 'pitṝṇām anṛṇa' ity anena piṭaniṣevitānnabhojanād avaghrāṇāc ca pitṝṇāṃ tṛptir bhavatīti sūcitam |
tathā ca brahmavaivarte |
pitṛdvijebhyaḥ sarvebhyo yad yad atra niveditam |
aśnann eva hi tat sarvaṃ pitṝn prīṇāti mānavaḥ ||
etac ca bhojanaṃ sati sāmarthye tṛptiparyantaṃ kartavyam | tadabhāve tu pitṛniṣevitebhyo ’nnebhyaḥ kiṃcit kiṃcid ādāyaikagrāsaparimāṇam api samudāyaṃ saṃpādya bhojanaṃ kartavyam |
tad āha āpastambaḥ |
sarvataḥ samavadāyottareṇa yajuṣāśeṣasya grāsāvarārdhaṃ prāśnīyāt || iti |
prāṇe niviṣṭo ’mṛtaṃ juhomi brahmaṇi me ātmāmṛtatvāyeti |
uttaraṃ yajuḥ anena ca bhojanasyāvaśyakatvam uktam |
ata eva śrāddhadine upavāsaniṣedham āha vyāsaḥ |
āditye ’hani saṅkrāntāv asitaikādaśīgrahe |
vyatīpāte kṛte śrāddhe putrī nopavased gṛhī ||
[1520] devalas tūpavāse doṣam apy āha |
śrāddhe datvā tu yo vipro na bhuṅkte ’tha kadācana |
devā havir na gṛhṇanti kavyāni pitaras tathā ||
upavāsadine śrāddhakartā pitṛniṣevitaṃ sarvam avaghrātavyam evety ayam api pakṣo brahmavaivarte vicārapūrvakaṃ pratipāditaḥ |
upavāsadinaṃ prāpya yadā bhavati nārada |
pitṛśrāddhaṃ tathānyac ca tadā kāryaṃ ca tac chṛṇu ||
vratabhaṅgo mahat pāpaṃ muktaśeṣasya sevayā |
tatra vai yat prakartavyaṃ tac chṛṇuṣva mayeritam ||
sarvam annaṃ samuddhṛtya dakṣikṣena kareṇa tu |
avaghrāṇaṃ tataḥ kuryāt vratabhaṅgo ’nyathā bhavet ||
akṛte tu muniśreṣṭha hy avaghrāṇe ca nārada |
śrāddhalopaḥ kṛtas tena mātṛhā pitṛhā bhavet |
evaṃ jñātvā tu vidvadbhir upāyaś cintito dvijaiḥ || iti |
vyāso ’py āha |
upavāso yadā nityaḥ śrāddhaṃ naimiytikaṃ bhavet |
upavāsaṃ tadā kuryād āghrāya pitṛsevitam ||
'naimittikam' ity anena nityaśrāddhe upavāsadine ’vaghrāṇaṃ na kāryam iti sūcitam |
śivarātrivratopavāsaṃ puraskṛtyoktaṃ prabhāsakhaṇḍe |
puroḍāśo ’pi deveśi saṃprāpte śivavāsare |
abhakṣyeṇa samaḥ proktaḥ kiṃ punaś cānyamatkiyā ||
[1521] caturdaśyāṃ yadā caiva śrāddha naimittikaṃ tathā |
upavāsaṃ tadā kuryād āghrāya pitṛsevitam ||
evaṃ yasmin śivarātryekādaśyām upavāse kriyamāṇe mahat puṇyaṃ tyajyamāne vā bahu pāpaṃ tasminn avaghrāṇam eva kartavyam | yasmiṃs tu dvayam etad anyaṃ tasminn avaghrāṇam ayācitam ekabhaktaṃ vā kartavyam |
ata evopavāsāyācitakaibhaktānāṃ pratyekaṃ phalaviśeṣaḥ prabhāsakhaṇḍe evoktaḥ |
upavāsadine śrāddhaṃ kathaṃcid yadi jāyate |
upavāse ’śvamedhākhyaṃ rājasūyam ayācite |
vājapeyaṃ labhed bhoktā ekabhakte ’gnihomajam ||
'agnihomajaṃ' puṇyam iti śeṣaḥ | ataś copavāsadine śrāddhe kṛte śeṣānnāvaghrāṇaṃ bhojanaṃ vā kartavyam iti sthitam |
tatra bhojanakālam āha jātūkarṇyaḥ |
ahany eva tu bhoktavyaṃ kṛte śrāddhe dvijanmabhiḥ |
anyathā hy āsuraṃ śrāddhaṃ parapāke ca sevite ||
nāgarakhaṇḍe |
baliṃ ca nikṣipet tasmād bhojanaṃ ca samācaret |
maunena dṛśyate sūryo yāvat tāvan narādhipa ||
yaś caivāstamite sūrye bhuṅkte ca śrāddhakan naraḥ |
vyarthatāṃ yāti tac chrāddhaṃ tasmād rātrau na bhojayet ||
iti śeṣabhojanam |
iti mukhyakalpikaḥ pārvaṇaśrāddhaprayogaḥ |
athānukalpikāḥ pārvaṇaśrāddhaprayogāḥ |
[1522]
tatra mukhyakalpāśaktasyānukalpenānuṣṭhānam āha kātyāyanaḥ |
caritārthā śrutiḥ kāryā yasmād apy anukalpataḥ |
ato deyaṃ yathāśakti śrāddhakāle samāgate ||
mukhyāśaktau cānukalpānuṣṭhāne mukhyaphalāvāptim āha śātātapaḥ |
yathā kathaṃcin nityāni kuryād indukṣayādiṣu |
pātradravyādyasaṃpattau so ’pi mukhyaphalaṃ labhet ||
'yathā kathaṃcit' kiyadaṅgahānyā, 'nityāni' yāvajjīvam anuṣṭheyatayā vihitāni darśapūrṇamāsapiṇḍapitṛyajñaśrāddhādīni | 'indukṣayādiṣu' amāvāsyādikāleṣu | 'pātrāṇi' pūrvoktalakṣaṇā brāhmaṇāḥ | 'dravyaṃ' madhumāṃsapāyasodanasūpaśākādi |
bhaviṣyottare |
śrāddhānukalpaṃ yaḥ kuryāj jātyavasthādyapekṣayā |
śraddhāvān so ’py avāpnoti mukhyaśrāddhaphalaṃ naraḥ ||
'jātyapekṣayā' yathā śūdraḥ svakīyāṃ śudratām apekṣya mantrarūpāṅgahīnaṃ pakvāṅgahīnaṃ cānukalparūpaṃ śrāddhaṃ karoti, yathā vā strī mantrahīnam | yady api strīśūdrayos tathāvidham eva śrāddhaṃ mukhyaṃ tathāpi dvijakartṛkaṃ mukhyaṃ śrāddham apekṣyālpāṅgatvād dvijair anuṣṭhīyamānam ivātrānukalpaśabdena vyavahriyate | 'avasthāpekṣayā' yathānupanīto mantrahīnam apatnīkaḥ pravāsī cāmāhemaśrāddhayor anyatarat | ādiśabdena pātradravyādyasaṃpatyāpekṣāpi saṃgṛhyate |
mukhyānuṣṭhānaśaktimāṃs tv anukalpam anutiṣṭhan karmaphalaṃ na prāpnotīty āha vyāsaḥ |
śaktaḥ prathamakalpasya yo ’nukalpena vartate |
[1523] sa nāpnoti phalaṃ tasya paratreti suniścitam ||
atrānekabrāhmaṇasaṃpattyabhāve anekabrāhmaṇabhojanaparyāptānnāsaṃbhave caikenaiva brāhmaṇena ṣaḍdaivatyaṃ ṣapiṇḍaśrāddhaṃ kuryāt |
tathā ca prabhāsakhaṇḍe |
dravyābhāve dvijālābhe vidhiṃ vakṣyāmi tattvataḥ |
ekenāpi hi vipreṇa ṣaṭpiṇḍaṃ śrāddham ācaret ||
ṣaḍdarbhān dāpayet tasmai ṣaḍbhyo dadyāt tathāsanam |
ṣaḍ apy āvāhayet tatra ṣaḍbhyo dadyāt tathā haviḥ ||
'dvijālābha' ity anekadvijālābhe | yadā ca ṣaḍdaivatyam ekenaiva vipreṇa kuryāt tadā sarvaguṇasaṃpannaṃ vipraṃ nimantrayet |
uktaṃ hi kūrmapurāṇe |
api vā bhojayed ekaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam |
śrutaśīlādisaṃpannam alakṣaṇavivarjitam ||
ekenāpi hi vipreṇa ṣaḍdaivatyaṃ śrāddhaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ vaiśvadevikayuktam eva kartavyam |
tatra dvijābhāve ’pi vaiśvadevikānuṣṭhānaprakāram āha vasiṣṭhaḥ |
yady ekaṃ bhojayec chrāddhe daivaṃ tatra kathaṃ bhavet |
annaṃ pātre samuddhṛtya sarvasya prakṛtasya ca |
devatāyatane kṛtvā tataḥ śrāddhaṃ pravartayet ||
prakṛtaśrāddhārthaṃ saṃpāditasya tattajjātīyasyānnasya pratyekam ekadeśaṃ samuddhṛtya devatāyatane vaiśvadevikadvijopaveśanocite sthāne pātram āsādya tatra pariveśya tatratyāsane ca viśvān devān āvāhya tān purovartina ivānudhyāya pṛthivī te pātram ityādikaṃ japitvā purūravārdravaḥ[1524]saṃjñakebhyo viśvebhyo devebhya idam annaṃ svāhā oṃ tat sad ity uktvā 'śrāddhaṃ' pitryakarma pravartayed ity arthaḥ |
kūrmapurāṇe |
uddhṛtya pātre cānnaṃ tat sarvasmāt prakṛtāhṛtāt |
devatāyatane caibhyo nivedyānyat pravartayet ||
śaṅkho ’py āha |
bhojayed atha vāpy ekaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ paṅktipāvanam |
devai kṛtvā tu naivedyaṃ pañcāt tasya tu nirvapet ||
'tasya' pitryasya dvijasya sthāne |
āha śātātapaḥ |
devebhyaś ca namaskṛtya pūrvaṃ bhāgaṃ pradāpayet |
'pūrvam' iti pitṛbhyaḥ pūrvam | 'bhāgam' iti tatpradeyam annam |
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe tu vaiśvadevikasthāne ’gnisthāpanam uktam |
eka eva yadā vipro dvitīyo nopapadyate |
pitṝṇāṃ brāhmaṇe yojyo daive tv agniṃ niyojayet ||
atra pitrye ’nnasaṃkalpaprakāram āha bṛhaspatiḥ |
yady ekaṃ bhojayec chrāddhe svalpatvāt prakṛtasya tu |
stokaṃ stokaṃ samuddhṛtya tebhyo ’nnaṃ vinivedayet ||
ekabrāhmaṇatṛptisamarthanānājātīyānnasamudāyāt tajjātīyānnaikadeśam uddhṛtyoddhṛtya ṣaṭsamudāyān saṇpādyaikasminn anne ekasmin vā pātre pariveṣyaikaikaṃ samudāyaṃ pitrādikrameṇaikaikasmai śrāddhadevatārūpāya nivedayet | ekasmād eva vānnasamudāyāt stokaṃ stokaṃ samuddhṛtya buddhyaiva [1525] pṛthak parikalpya nivedayet | daive pitrye kramād annaṃ saṃkalpya gāyatrījapādikaṃ kṛtvā pitryaviprabhojanakāle vaiśvadevikasyānnasya pratipattiviśeṣaḥ kāryaḥ |
tam āha vasiṣṭhaḥ |
prāśyed agnau tad annaṃ tu dadyād vā brahmacāriṇe |
kūrmapurāṇe |
prāśyed annaṃ tato ’gnau tu dadyād vā brahmacāriṇe |
'tata' iti bhojanānujñāparyantaṃ pitryaṃ kṛtvā |
atraikasmin brāhmaṇe anekeṣāṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptiprakāram āha śātātapaḥ |
ekas tu brāhmaṇaḥ śrāddhe svalpaṃ ca prakṛtaṃ bhavet |
trayaś ca pitaraḥ proktāḥ kathaṃ tṛpyantu te trayaḥ ||
urasy aśnanti pitaro vāmapārśve pitāmahāḥ |
prapitāmahā dakṣiṇataḥ pṛṣṭhatas tv anuyāyinaḥ ||
'anuyāyinaḥ' pitṛpatnīprabhṛtayaḥ | 'anuyāyina' ity atra 'piṇḍatarkakā' iti pāṭhāntaraṃ, tac ca piṇḍalepabhāgino vṛddhaprapitāmahādaya iti vyākhyeyaṃ |
prabhāsakhaṇḍa-devalasmṛtyos tu |
pitā bhuṅkte dvijakare mukhe bhuṅkte pitāmahaḥ |
prapitāmahas tu tālusthaḥ kaṇṭhe mātāmahaḥ smṛtaḥ |
pramātāmahas tu hṛdaye vṛddho nābhau tu saṃsthitaḥ || iti ||
'vṛddhaḥ' vṛddhapramātāmahaḥ |
atraikasyāpi brāhmaṇasyālābhe ’nukalpāntaram uktaṃ prabhāsakhaṇḍe |
[1526] alābhe brāhmaṇasyaiva kauśaḥ kāryo baṭuḥ priye |
evam apy ācarec chrāddhaṃ ṣaḍdaivatyaṃ samāhitaḥ |
vibhaktiṃ kārayed yas tu pitṛhā sa prajāyate |
'kauśaḥ' kuśamayaḥ, 'baṭuḥ' laghumanuṣyapratikṛtiḥ, taṃ baṭuṃ brāhmaṇatvena parikalpya sarvaṃ śrāddham ācaret | 'vibhaktiḥ' karmaṇaḥ chedo lopa iti yāvat | taṃ na kuryāt :
baṭuṣu śrāddhaprakāram āha devalaḥ |
nidhāya vā darbhabaṭūn āsaneṣu samāhitaḥ |
praiṣānupreṣasaṃyuktaṃ vidhānaṃ pratipādayet ||
'āsaneṣu' brāhmaṇopaveśanociteṣu | svāgataṃ bhavatāṃ, śrāddhaṃ kariṣye, śrāddhe kṣaṇaḥ kriyatāṃ, devān pitṝn āvāhayiṣye, agnaukaraṇaṃ kariṣye ityādayaḥ praśnāḥ ‘praiṣāḥ' eṣām uttarāṇi 'anupraiṣāḥ', tadubhayasaṃyukaṃ 'vidhānaṃ" śrāddhetikarttavyatākāṇḍaṃ, svayam eva kuryāt | tatra saṃkalpitasyānnasya yat kartavyaṃ tad api sa evāha |
pātrābhāve paraṃ kṛtvā pitṛyajñavidhiṃ naraḥ |
nirdiśyāpy annam uddhṛtya yatra pātraṃ tato gatiḥ ||
pātrābhāve kṣiped agnau gave dadyāt tathāpsu vā |
na tu prāptasya lopo ’sti paitṛkasya viśeṣataḥ || iti |
mukhyadravyāsaṃbhave cānye ’py anukalpāḥ |
tatrāmaśrāddhākhyāḥ |
iha parāśarasmṛti-viṣṇupurāṇa-vārāhapurāṇeṣūktam |
asamartho ’nnadānasya dhānyamāśaṃ svaśaktitaḥ |
[1527] pradadyāt tu dvijātibhyaḥ svalpām api ca dakṣiṇām ||
asyārthaḥ | pakvānnābhāve śrāddhayogyānnaprakṛtībhūtaṃ yavagodhūmataṇḍulādidhānyam eva viśvān devān pitṝṃś coddiśya pakvānnavat tyaktvā nimantritadvijebhyaḥ samarpayet | tatra dhānyasya sākṣād anadanīyatvād bhojanābhāve tatsaṃbandhino dharmajātasya lopaḥ, aśyata ity āśaḥ dhyānyaviśeṣaṇena cāśabdenaitat sūcyate yat svasthānaṃ gatvā tair brāhmaṇais tad dhānyam aśanayogyaṃ kṛtvā bhoktavyaṃ na tu kāryāntare viniyoktavyam iti | anyathāśam ity anarthaṃ syāt |
asya kartṛviśeṣavādam āha vyāsaḥ |
hiraṇyamātraṃ śrāddhīyaṃ labdhaṃ yat kṣatriyāditaḥ |
yatheṣṭaṃ viniyojyaṃ syād bhuñjīyād brāhmaṇaḥ svayam ||
'kṣatriyāditaḥ' kṣatriyavaiśyamūrddhāvasiktādibhyaḥ | atra yady api 'yatheṣṭaṃ viniyojyam' iti sāmānyenoktaṃ tathāpi śrāddhādau na viniyojyaṃ devatoddeśena tyaktasya punar devatāntaroddeśena tyāgasyāyuktatvāt | ato laukike bhājane kriyādau cālaukike ’pi śrutismṛtivihite dakṣiṇādau nityanaimittike viniyojyam ity avagantavyam | brāhmaṇāt tu labdhaṃ svayam eveti niyamyate | atra yāvatpratigṛhītaṃ tāvat svayam eva bhojyam iti niyamo na mantavyaḥ kiṃ tu tṛptiparyantaṃ svayaṃ bhuktvānyasya śrāddhaśeṣocitā pratipattiḥ kartavyeti niścetavyam | śūdrāt tu pratigṛhītaṃ kasmiṃścid api nityanaimittike na viniyojyaṃ kiṃ tu svakīye parakīye vā bhojana evopayojyam ity uktaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
āmaṃ śūdrasya yat kiṃcic chrāddhikaṃ pratigṛhyate |
[1528] tat sarvaṃ bhojanāyālaṃ nityanaimittike na ca ||
atra pradeyadhānyaparimāṇam itikartavyatāṃ cāha vyāsaḥ |
āmaṃ dadyāt tu kaunteya dadyād annaṃ caturguṇam |
siddhānne tu vidhir yaḥ syād āmaśrāddhe ’py asau vidhiḥ ||
āvāhanādi sarvaṃ syāt piṇḍadānaṃ ca bhārata |
dadyādyac ca dvijātibhyaḥ śṛtaṃ vāśṛtam eva vā |
tenāgnaukaraṇaṃ kuryāt piṇḍāṃs tenaiva nirvapet ||
ṣaṭtriṃśanmate piṇḍadāne pakṣāntaram apy uktam |
āmaśrāddhaṃ tadā kuryād vidhijñaḥ śrāddhakṛt tadā |
haste ’gnaukaraṇaṃ kuryād brāhmaṇasya vidhānataḥ ||
caturguṇam ity ekaikabrāhmaṇatṛptiparyāptānnasiddhisamarthād dhānyāc caturguṇaṃ tāvat tv ekaikasmai brāhmaṇāya dadyād ity arthaḥ | caturguṇadānāśaktau pakṣāntaram api tenaivoktam |
āmaṃ dadad dhi kaunteya tad dānaṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavet |
triguṇaṃ caturguṇaṃ vāpi na tv ekaguṇam arpayet || iti |
āvāhanādītyādiśabdena arghyādikaṃ gṛhyate |
tathā ca bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
āvāhanaṃ bhavet kāryam arghyadānaṃ tathaiva ca |
eṣa eva vidhir yatra yatra śrāddhaṃ pravartate ||
kūrmapurāṇa-yamapurāṇyoḥ |
āmena vartayen nityaṃ brāhmaṇo vyasanānvitaḥ |
tenāgnaukaraṇaṃ kuryāt piṇḍāṃs tenaiva nirvapet ||
[1529] ṣaṭtriṃśanmate piṇḍadāne pakṣāntaram apy uktam |
āmaśrāddhaṃ yadā kuryāt piṇḍadānaṃ kathaṃ bhavet |
gṛhapākāt svam uddhṛtya saktubhiḥ pāyasena vā |
piṇḍān dadyāt yathālābhaṃ tilaiḥ saha vimatsaraḥ ||
vikirādikam apy āmadravyeṇaiva kartavyam |
tathā ca pracetāḥ |
āmaśrāddhapradaḥ piṇḍāṃs tathāgnaukaraṇaṃ ca yat |
tad dadyāt tatra tenaiva yat kiṃcicc hrāddhikaṃ bhavet ||
'yat kiṃcit' yad anyad api vikirādi tad api, 'tenaiva' āmenaiva, kartavyam ity arthaḥ |
āvāhane svadhākāre mantrā japyā visarjane |
anyakarmaṇy anūhyāḥ syur āmaśrāddhe vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
āvāhanamantre atta va ity atra svīkarta va ity ūhaḥ | svadhākāre namo vaḥ pitara ityādimantre iṣa itipadasthāne āmadravyasyety ūhaḥ | visarjane vāje vāja iti mantre tṛptā ity asya sthāne tarpasvety ūhaḥ kārya ity arthaḥ | śūdreṇa tu pakvānnasaṃbhave ’pi āmaśrāddhaṃ kartavyam iti pūrvam evokam | tadanuṣṭhānaprakāras tu bhaviṣyottare darśitaḥ |
dharmepsavaś ca dharmajñā yadi śūdrāḥ prakurvate |
agnaukaraṇamantraś ca namaskāro vidhīyate ||
āvāhanādi kartavyaṃ yathā śūdreṇa tac chṛṇu |
devānāṃ devatānāṃ tu pitṝṇāṃ nāmagotrataḥ |
piṇḍādīn nirvaped vīra nāmato gotratas tathā ||
[1530] 'namaskāraḥ' nama itiśabdaḥ | agnaye kavyavāhanāya namaḥ | somāya pitṛmate namaḥ | agnaukaraṇa ity upalakṣaṇaṃ, anyatrāpy ayam evāsya mantraḥ |
tathā ca śūdraṃ prakṛtya matsyapurāṇādiṣūktam |
namaskāreṇa mantreṇa pañcayajñān na hāpayet | iti |
ayaṃ ca mantraḥ śūdrasyānyamantranivṛttyā vidhīyate | evaṃ tasya mantrāntaranivṛttir matsyapurāṇe ’bhihitā |
sarvaṃ śrāddhaṃ ca kartavyaṃ śūdreṇāpy evam eva tu |
mantravarjaṃ hi śūdrasya sarvam eva vidhīyate ||
'evam eva' pārvaṇaśrāddhavidhinaiva | atra śūdrāṇāṃ gotrasyāvidyamānatvād dvijotpannaśūdraviṣayaṃ gotra ity etad bhavitum arhati | atha vā "tasmād āhuḥ sarvāḥ prajāḥ kāśyapyaḥ” iti śruteḥ sarveṣām eva śūdrāṇāṃ kāśyapaṃ gotraṃ bhavitum arhati | ata eva vyāghrapādā pratipāditaṃ "gotranāśe tu kaśyapaḥ" iti |
āmānnasyāpy asaṃbhave hemaśrāddhaṃ kartavyam |
tathā ca marīciḥ |
āmānnasyāpy abhāve tu śrāddhaṃ kurvīta buddhimān |
dhānyāc caturguṇenaiva hiraṇyena surociṣā ||
āmaśrāddhe yāvad ekaikasmai brāhmaṇāya dhānyaṃ dīyate tāvataś caturguṇaṃ yāvatā hiraṇyena labhyate tāvad ekaikasmai brāhmaṇāya hemaśrāddhe hiraṇyaṃ deyam ity arthaḥ | iha ye śaktitāratamyālocanayā āmaśrāddhe dhānyadvaiguṇyādipakṣāḥ pratipāditāḥ tadanusāreṇaiva hemno ’pi pramāṇabhedo ’nukta evārthād gamyate |
[1531] dharmas tv āha |
āmaṃ tu dviguṇaṃ proktaṃ hema tadvac caturguṇam |
annābhāve dvijātīnāṃ brāhmaṇasya viśeṣataḥ ||
ekaikabrāhmaṇatṛptiparyāptānnasamarthaṃ dhānyaṃ yāvatā labhyate tāvataś caturguṇaṃ hema ekaikasmai brāhmaṇāya ity arthaḥ | anena dviguṇadhānyād dviguṇaṃ hema pradeyam ity uktaṃ bhavati |
bhaviṣyottare |
annābhāve dvijābhāve pravāse putrajanmani |
hemaśrāddhaṃ saṃgrahe ca tathā strīśūdrayor api ||
vyāsaḥ |
dravyābhāve dvijābhāve pravāse putrajanmani
hemaśrāddhaṃ prakurvīta yasya bhāryā rajasvalā ||
hemaśrāddhasya kvacid apavādaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
annābhāve dvijābhāve pravāse putrajanmani |
hemaśrāddhaṃ prakurvīta varjayitvā kṣaye ’hani ||
iha smṛtyantara-purāṇāntareṣu yatra yatrāmaśrāddhaṃ vihitaṃ tatra tatra hemaśrāddhaṃ vidhīyamānam āmadravyāsaṃbhava eveti vyākhyeyam | evaṃ hy āmadravyahemnor aṣṭadoṣo vikalpo na bhaviṣyati | annaprakṛtibhūtatvena śrāddhavidhyantaraṅgasya dhānyasya sati saṃbhave bahiraṅgād dhemnaḥ pūrvam upādānaṃ cānugṛhītaṃ bhavati | putrajanmanimitte pakvāmayor annayoḥ sadbhāve ’pi hemaśrāddham eva |
ata eva saṃvartaḥ |
putrajanmani kurvīta śrāddhaṃ henmaiva buddhimān |
na pakvena na cāmena kalyāṇāny abhikāmayan ||
piṇḍadānaprakāro ’py atra bhaviṣyottara eva darśitaḥ |
gṛhapākāt samuddhṛtya saktubhiḥ pāyasena vā |
piṇḍapradānaṃ kurvīta hemaśrāddhe kṛte sadā ||
śūdras tu gṛhapākena tatpiṇḍān nirvapet tathā |
saktu mūlaṃ phalaṃ tasya pāyasaṃ vā bhavet smṛtam ||
piṇḍanirvapaṇārtham iti śeṣaḥ |
ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
nāmantraṇāgnaukaraṇaṃ vikaro naiva dīyate |
tṛptapraśno ’pi naivātra kartavyaḥ kenacid bhavet ||
śūdraśrāddhe pratigṛhītaṃ dhānyaṃ nityanaimittike na viniyojyam ity abhidhāyoktaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
hiraṇyaṃ tat punaḥ śrāddhe gṛhītaṃ naiva duṣyati |
tena nityakriyāḥ kāryya hiraṇyaṃ nānnamucyata iti ||
yastu piṇḍapradānādibahuvidhānayuktam āvāhanādivitatānekāṅgayuktaṃ ca śrāddham anuṣṭhātum aśaktaḥ sa sāṃkalpaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryāt |
tathā ca saṃvartaḥ |
samagraṃ yas tu śaknoti kartuṃ naiveha pārvaṇam |
api saṃkalpavidhinā kāle tasya vidhīyate ||
pātrabhojyasya cānnasya tyāgaḥ saṃkalpa ucyate |
tatprayukto vidhir yas tu sa tena vyapadiśyate |
tāvanmātreṇa saṃbaddhaṃ śrāddhaṃ māṅgalyam ucyate ||
[1533] atra yad yat pradhānam aṅgaṃ vā na kartavyaṃ tad āha vyāsaḥ |
sāṃkalpaṃ tu yadā kuryān na kuryāt pātrapūraṇam |
nāvāhanaṃ nāgnaukaraṇaṃ piṇḍāṃś caiva na dāpayet ||
pātrasyārghyasya jalādinā paripūraṇaṃ na kartavyam | arghyo na dātavya ity arthaḥ | āvāhanaṃ ca samantrakaṃ niṣiddhyate na tv āvāhanamātraṃ, tena vinā devatāsaṃnidhānābhāvāc chrāddhaniṣpattyasaṃbhavāt | kecit tu śrāddhe vikiradānam api na kartavyam ity uktvā saṃvādāya kasyacid vacanaṃ paṭhanti |
sāṃkalpaṃ tu yadā śrāddhaṃ na kuryāt pātrapūraṇam |
vikiraṃ tu na dātavyaṃ piṇḍān naiva vinikṣipet || iti ||
āvāhanāgnaukaraṇādisaṃpādanasamarthenāpi kadācit saṃkalpavidhinaiva śrāddhaṃ kartavyam iti chāgaleyaḥ |
piṇḍaṃ yatra nivarteta maghādiṣu kadācana |
saṃkalpaṃ tu tadā kāryaṃ niyamāc chraddhayā dvijaḥ ||
kartṛviśeṣaṃ prati ca niyamena saṃkalpaśrāddham āha vyāsaḥ |
tyaktāgneḥ pārvaṇaṃ naiva naikoddiṣṭaṃ sapiṇḍanam |
atyaktāgnes tu piṇḍoktis tasmāt saṃkalpya bhojayet ||
yasmād atyaktāgner eva sapiṇḍaśrāddhoktis tasmāt tyaktāgninā saṃkalpaśrāddham eva kāryam ity arthaḥ |
ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
anagniko yadā vipra utsannāgnis tathaiva ca |
tadā vṛddhiṣu sarvāsu saṃkalpya śrāddham ācaret ||
sāgnikas tu saṃkalpavidhinā badarādimiśrapiṇḍapradānayuktaṃ vā [1534] vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ kuryād ity arthād iha gamyate | yadā tu sarvāṅgopasaṃhārāśaktyā śrāddhaṃ kuryāt tadā brāhmaṇāt prārthanāviśeṣam āha vyāsaḥ |
aṅgāni pitṛyajñasya yadā kartuṃ na śaknuyāt |
sa tadā vācayed viprān sakalā siddhir astv iti ||
vācanaprakāras tu asya śrāddhasya sakalā siddhir astv iti bhavato bruvantv iti yajamānenokte sakalā siddhir astv iti brāhmaṇā brūyur iti |
brāhmaṇabhojanaparyāptoktaparimāṇapakvāmarūpobhayavidhānnāsaṃbhave sarvaśrāddhayogyadvijālābhe cānukalpam āha devalaḥ |
piṇḍamātraṃ pradātavyam alābhe dravyaviprayoḥ |
śrāddhe ’hani tu saṃprāpte bhaven niraśano ’pi vā ||
bhaviṣyottare tūdakakumbhādidānam apy uktam |
kiṃcid dadyād aśaktaś ced udakumbhādikaṃ dvije |
vivāsam eva vā dadyāt piṇḍaṃ vāthābhinirvapet ||
tilodakais tarpayed vā pitṝn snātvā samāhitaḥ |
agninā vā dahet kakṣaṃ śrāddhakāle samāgate |
tasmin vopavased ahni japed vā śrāddhasaṃhitām |
yathāśaktyā tu dātavyaṃ śrāddhakālasamāgame ||
'kakṣaṃ' parvatadarī, 'śrāddhasaṃhitāṃ' sarvamantrasahitaṃ śrāddhakalpam |
vṛddhavasiṣṭhaḥ |
kiṃcid dadyād aśaktas tu udakumbhādikaṃ dvije |
tṛṇāni vā gave dadyāt piṇḍān vāpy atha nirvapet |
tiladarbhaiḥ pitṝn vāpi tarpayet snānapūrvakam ||
[1535] kūrmapurāṇe |
api mūlaiḥ kuśair vāpi prakuryan nirdhano dvijaḥ |
tilodakais tarpayed vā pitṝn snātvā samāhitaḥ ||
hārītaḥ |
api mūlaiḥ phalair vāpi tathāpy udakatarpaṇaiḥ |
avidyamāne kurvīta na tu prāptaṃ vilaṅghayet ||
devalaḥ |
yad eva tarpayaty adbhir āhitāgnir dine dine |
pitryaṃ tenaiva prāpnoti vārṣikādikriyāphalam ||
satyavrataḥ |
śākamūlaphalānnais tu vāsogobhūmikāñcanaiḥ |
adbhir vā viprasaṃvādāt pitṝṇāṃ prītim āvahet ||
'viprasaṃvādāt' yasya kasyacid brāhmaṇasyānujñayā |
kālikāpurāṇe |
annābhāve phalair vāpi yad aśnāti naraḥ svayam |
tena śrāddhaṃ prakurvīta pitṝṇāṃ tṛptikāmataḥ ||
vārāhapurāṇe |
tatrāpy asāmarthyayutaḥ karāgrāvasthitaṃs tilān |
praṇamya dvijamukhyebhyo dadyādcuddiśya vai pitṝn ||
tilaiḥ saptāṣṭabhir vāpi samavetaṃ jalāñjalim |
bhaktinamraḥ samuddiśya pitṝn dadyāt samāhitaḥ ||
[1536] yataḥ kutaścit saṃprāpya gobhyo vāpi gavāhnikam |
pitṝn uddiśya viprebhyo dadyāc chraddhāsamanvitaḥ |
sarvābhāve vanaṃ gatvā skandamūlapradarśakaḥ ||
kakṣāmūlapradarśaka iti pāṭhāntaram |
pūrvādilokapālānām idam uccaiḥ paṭhed budhaḥ
na me ’sti vittaṃ na dhanaṃ na cānyat
śrāddhopayogyaṃ svapitṝnn ato ’smi |
tṛpyantu bhaktyā pitaro mayaitau
kṛtau bhujau vartmani mārutasya ||
ity etat kathitaṃ sarvaṃ pitṛbhaktiparāyaṇaḥ |
yaḥ karoti kṛtaṃ tena śrāddhaṃ bhavati vai dvija ||
purāṇāt |
parādhīnaḥ pravāsī ca nirdhano vāpi mānavaḥ |
manasā bhāvayuktena śrāddhaṃ kuryāt tilodakam ||
tathā smṛtyantare dṛṣṭāntadvāreṇoktam |
yad vācā karmaṇā kartuṃ kathaṃcit tu na śaknuyāt |
tat sarvaṃ sādhayed vidvān manemā pitṛyajñavat ||
ity anukalpikāḥ pārvaṇaśrāddhaprayogāḥ |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasakalakarṇādhipati-
paṇḍitaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau pariśeṣakhaṇḍe
śrāddhakalpe mukhyakalpānukalpikapārvaṇaprayogo nāma
ṣoḍaśo ’dhyāyaḥ ||
[1537]
atha saptadaśo ’dhyāyaḥ |
vidyādivṛddhān vividhopacārair
ānandayan yo mudam ādadāti |
hemādrisūriḥ karaṇeśvaro ’sau
vṛddhīritaśrāddhavidhiṃ bravīti ||
atha vṛddhiśrāddhaprayogaḥ |
tatra tāvad etac chrāddhaṃ maṇḍapadevatākuladevatāsthāpanapūrvakaṃ mātṛkāpūjāṃ vidhāya vasor dhārāś ca kṛtvā kāryam |
tathā ca caturviṃśatimate |
ābhyudayike saṃprāpte devatāsthāpanaṃ smṛtam |
jātidharmakulāmnātaṃ lokānāṃ vṛddhikārakam ||
ābhyudayikaśrāddhe kartavyatayā prastute sati brāhmaṇakṣatriyādijātivibhāgena śrutyādiṣu samāmnātaṃ kulavṛddhaiś copadiśyamānaṃ devatānāṃ pratiṣṭhāpanaṃ kartavyatayā smṛtam | tad dhi lokānāṃ vṛddher maṅgalaparaṃparāyāḥ kāraṇam | asyānantaraṃ mātṛpūjanaṃ kartavyam |
tathā ca kūrmapurāṇe |
pūrvaṃ tu mātaraḥ pūjyā bhaktyā vai sagaṇeśvarāḥ |
etac ca mātṝṇāṃ pūjanaṃ nāmāni coktāni caturviṃśatimate |
tisraḥ pūjyāḥ pituḥ pakṣe tisraḥ pūjyās tu mātṛke |
ity etā mātaraḥ proktāḥ pitṛmātṛṣvasāṣṭamī ||
[1538] brahmāṇyādyāḥ smṛtāḥ sapta durgā kṣetragaṇādhipāḥ |
ādau vṛddhau sadā pūjyāḥ paścān nāndīmukhān pitṝn ||
gaurī padmā sacī dakṣā sāvitrī vijayā jayā |
devasenā svadhā svāhā mātaro lokamātaraḥ |
etās tv abhyudaye pūjyā ātmadevatayā saha ||
'pituḥ pakṣe' pitṛvarge, 'tisraḥ' mātṛpitāmahīprapitāmahyaḥ pūjyāḥ | tathā 'mātṛke' mātāmahavarge, 'tisraḥ' mātāmahīmātuḥpitāmahīmātuḥprapitāmahāḥ pūjyāḥ | 'pitṛmātṛṣvasāṣṭamī' pitṛṣvasā saptamī mātṛṣvasāṣṭamī ca pūjyā | ity aṣṭau manuṣyamātaraḥ proktāḥ, etāś ca pratyakṣāḥ pratyakṣam eva kuṅkumakusumavastrābharaṇabhojanaiḥ pūjanīyāḥ | parokṣās tu vakṣyamāṇadevamātṛvad akṣatādipuñjeṣv āvāhya pūjanīyāḥ | ‘brahmāṇyādyāḥ smṛtāḥ sapta' brāhmī vaiṣṇavī māheśvarī aindrī vārāhī kaumārī cāmuṇḍety etāḥ saptadevamātṝḥ, tathā 'durgā kṣetragaṇādhipāḥ' durgaṃ kṣetrādhipaṃ gaṇādhipaṃ ca 'vṛḍyādau vṛddhiśrāddhāt prāk, ṣoḍaśabhir upacāraiḥ pūjayitvā paścān nāndīmukhān pitṝan śrāddhena pūjayed iti | 'ātmadevatā' svakīyakuladevatā, tayā sahaitāḥ pūjyāḥ | śāstrāntare brahmāṇyādyās tv aṣṭau darśitāḥ | brahmāṇī māheśī kaumārī vaiṣṇavī ca vārāhī indrāṇī cāmuṇḍā mahālakṣmīś ca mātaraḥ proktāḥ |
āha śātātapaḥ |
gaurī padmā śacī medhā sāvitrī vijayā jayā |
devasenā svadhā svāhā mātaro lokamātaraḥ ||
dhṛtiḥ puṣṭis tathā tuṣṭir ātmadevatayā saha |
[1539] ābhyo ’rghyaṃ gandhapuṣpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ nivedayet ||
etac ca mātṛpūjanaṃ karmāṅgaśrāddhe ’pi kāryam iti ṣaṭtriṃśanmata evokam |
karmādiṣu ca sarveṣu mātaraḥ sagaṇādhipāḥ |
pūjanīyāḥ prayatnena pūjitāḥ pūjayanti tāḥ ||
āsāṃ ca pūjādhiṣṭhānaṃ vasor dhārānirmāṇādi ca tatraivoktaṃ |
pratimāsu ca śubhrāsu likhitā vā paṭādiṣu |
api vākṣatapuñjeṣu naivedyaiś ca pṛthagvidhaiḥ ||
kuḍyalagnā vasor dhārāḥ pañca dhārā ghṛtena tu |
kārayet saptadhārā vā nātinīcā na cocchritāḥ |
āyuṣyāṇi ca śāntyarthaṃ japtvā tatra samāhitaḥ ||
'āyuṣyāṇi' ā no bhadrīyād ity āśīḥpradhānāni sūktāni tathā tathāvidhamantrādhārāṇi sāmāni ca | 'tatreti yatra mātṛpūjā vasor dhārā ca kṛtā |
etanmātṛpūjanasyākaraṇe bhaviṣyatpurāṇe doṣo darśitaḥ |
akṛtvā mātṛyajñaṃ (?) tu yaḥ śrāddhaṃ pariveṣayet |
tās tasya krodhasaṃpannā hiṃsāṃ kurvanti dāruṇam ||
mātṝṇāṃ pratimāsvarūpaṃ mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
haṃsayuktavimānasthā sākṣasūtrakamaṇḍaluḥ |
āyātā brahmaṇaḥ śaktir brahmāṇī sābhidhīyate ||
māheśvarī vṛṣārūḍhā triśūlavaradhāriṇī |
mahāhivilayā prāptā candrarekhāvibhūṣaṇā ||
[1540] kaumārī śaktihastā ca mayūravaravāhanā |
yoddhum abhyāyayau daityān ambikā guharūpiṇī ||
tathaiva vaiṣṇavī śaktir garuḍopari saṃsthitā |
śaṅkhacakragadāśārṅgakhaḍgahastābhyupāyayau ||
yajñavārāham atulaṃ rūpaṃ yā vibhrato hareḥ |
śaktiḥ sāpyāyayau tatra vārāhīṃ vibhratī tanum ||
vajrahastā tathaivaindrī gajarājopari sthitā |
prāptā sahasranayanā yathā śakras tathaiva sā ||
ādye brahmapurāṇe |
mahālakṣmīś ca kartavyā nṛtyamānā kapālinī |
kārtikī tuṅgakhaṭṭāṅgatrimālāmbujadhāriṇī |
kūṣmāṇḍayā tu pretasthā danturā varvaraṃ śiraḥ ||
siddhārthapṛcchāyām |
candrārdhanavacakṣurbhyāṃ bhāskareṇa ṛṣeṇa ca |
vidyotante karā yasyāḥ padmā sā ca prakīrtitā ||
kīrakavyajinī caiva vyajanaṃ samidhaṃ tathā |
yā bibharti karāgraiḥ sā śacī nāmnā prakīrtitā ||
dhatte yā samidhaṃ hastaiḥ rajanīkīrakāv api |
kramatas tālavṛntaṃ ca sā ca medhābhidhīyate ||
akṣasūtraṃ sruvaṃ caiva śaktikāṃ ca kamaṇḍalum |
kalayanti karā yasyāḥ sāvitrī sā prakīrtitā ||
kārmukaṃ cārghyapātraṃ ca yogamudrāṃ kṛpāṇikāṃ |
[1541] pāṇibhir yā kramād dhatte sā durgā parigīyate ||
yogamudrāṃ ca cāpaṃ ca krameṇaivārdhabhājanam |
kṛpāṇīṃ caiva yā dhatte sā cāmuṇḍā prakīrtitā ||
yā kapālaṃ ca kośaṃ ca pīyūṣaṃ pāśam eva ca |
yā bibharti karāṃ bhojair vijayā sā prakīrtitā ||
kramāt kośakapāle ca pīyūṣaṃ ca sapāśakam |
āśritya yat karāgrāṇi vijayante jayā ca sā ||
yac ca sāgarasaṃhitāyām |
darpaṇaṃ paṅkajaṃ padmaṃ puṣṭikāṃ dadhatīṃ smaret |
puṣṭiṃ lakṣmīṃ sitāṃ saumyāṃ paṅkajāsanasaṃsthitām ||
vajraṃ padmaṃ tathādarthaṃ pīyūṣaṃ dadhatīṃ smaret |
sā vai tuṣṭir mahālakṣmīḥ sthitā vīrāsanopari |
matsyapurāṇe vināyakapratimāsvarūpam |
svadantaṃ dakṣiṇakare utpalaṃ ca tathāpare |
laḍḍukaṃ paraśuṃ caiva vāmataḥ saṃprakalpayet |
saṃyuktaṃ buddhiṛddhibhyām adhastān mūṣikānvitam ||
tad evaṃ viśeṣataḥ kāsāṃcin mātṝṇāṃ svarūpaṃ darśitaṃ sāmānyākāreṇa tu sarvāsāṃ mahāpañcarātre ukam | pūjyāś citre ’tha vārcāyāṃ varadābhayapāṇayaḥ | tad evam idaṃ devatāpratiṣṭhāpanāt prabhṛti vasor dhārāparyantaṃ kṛtvā nāndīśrāddham ārabheta |
tathā ca caturviṃśatimate |
ṣaḍbhyaḥ pitṛbhyas tadanu śrāddhadānam upakramet |
[1542] vasiṣṭhokto vidhiḥ kṛtsno draṣṭavyo ’tra nirāmiṣaḥ ||
‘tadanu’ mātṛpūjādyuttarakālam | pitṛvargīyebhyas tribhyaḥ mātāmahavargīyebhya ity evaṃ ṣaḍbhyaḥ | 'vaśiṣṭhokto vidhiḥ' vaśiṣṭhādimuniprokto vidhiḥ | āmiṣaṃ māṃsaṃ tadvarjitaḥ | etac ca śrāddhadvayaṃ mātṛśrāddhapūrvakaṃ kartavyam |
tathā ca krameṇa śrāddhatrayam āha śātātapaḥ |
mātṛśrāddhaṃ tu pūrvaṃ syāt pitṝṇāṃ tadanantaraṃ |
tato mātāmahānāṃ ca vṛddhau śrāddhatrayaṃ smṛtam ||
matsyapurāṇe ’pi
mātaraḥ prathamaṃ pūjyāḥ pitaras tadanantaram |
tato mātāmahāḥ pūjyāḥ viśvedevās tathaiva ca ||
āha vasiṣṭhaḥ |
mātṛbhyaḥ kalpayet pūrvaṃ pitṛbhyas tadanantaram |
tato mātāmahānāñ ca kuryāc chrāddhaṃ krameṇa ca ||
atra kecin mātāmahāditridaivatyaṃ caturtham api śrāddham ācakṣate |
tathā ca caturviṃśatimate mātṛpūjāṃ pratipādyoktam |
pūjayec ca tataḥ paścāt tatra nāndīmukhān pitṝn |
mātṛpūrvān pitṝn pūjya tato mātāmahān api |
mātāmahīs tataḥ kecid yugmā bhojyā dvijātayaḥ ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
savyena pāṇinā vīra vidhivat khagamattama |
mātre pramātre tanmātre nirvapet pūrvatomukham ||
[1543] pitṛmātre tu tanmātre nirvaped vidhivat khaga |
vṛddhāyai prapitāmahyai tathānte nirvapet khaga |
evam uddiśya vai mātṝḥ śrāddhapiṇḍāṃś ca nirvapet ||
brahmapurāṇe |
prapitāmahīparyantā nāndīmukhyaś ca mātaraḥ |
mātāmahyaḥ pitāmahyaḥ pramātāmahya eva hi ||
atra mātāmahyādiśrāddhavidher arthavādo vyāghreṇa darśitaḥ |
yathā manuṣyās tuṣyanti dṛṣṭvā patnīḥ supūjitāḥ |
pūjitāsv iha patnīṣu tuṣyanti pitaras tathā ||
mātṛśrāddhe brāhmaṇasaṃkhyām āha śātātapaḥ |
pitrāditrayapatnīnāṃ bhojyā mātṝḥ prati dvijāḥ ||
strīṇām eva tu tad yasmān mātṛśrāddham ihocyate |
mātṝḥ pratītyekamiṃ strīvarge caturādiyugmasaṅkhyakā brāhmaṇa bhojanīyāḥ | tathā ca mātṛvarge ca catvāraḥ mātāmahīvarge (?) catvāra ity evam aṣṭau saṃpadyante
ata evokaṃ bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
bhojayec ca dvijān aṣṭau mātṛśrāddhe khageśvara |
navamaṃ sarvadevatyaṃ bhojayed dvijam āgatam ||
sati saṃbhave caitad veditavyam | asaṃbhave tv ekaikasmin varge dvau dvāv api
bhojanīyau |
brāhmaṇālābhe tu vṛddhavasiṣṭhenokaṃ |
mātṛśrāddhe tu viprāṇām alābhe pūjayed api |
[1544] patiputrānvitā bhavyā yoṣito ’ṣṭau mudānvitāḥ ||
pitrādivarge ’pi caturādisaṅkhyakā eva brāhmaṇā bhojanīyāḥ |
tathā ca padmapurāṇe |
yugmā dvijātayaḥ pūjyā vastrakārtasvarādibhiḥ
'kārtasvaram' suvarṇam |
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
yugmāś cātra dvijāḥ kāryās te pūjyāś ca pradakṣiṇam |
viṣṇupurāṇe |
yugmāṃs tu prāṅmukhān viprān bhojayen manujeśvara |
brahmapurāṇe |
yugmāṃs tu bhojayed vṛddhau brāhmaṇān niyataḥ śuciḥ |
mātṛpitṛmātāmahaśrāddhe yugmān brāhmaṇān āha vṛddhaśātātapaḥ |
triṣv apy eteṣu yugmāṃs tu brāhmaṇān niyataḥ śuciḥ |
yugmasaṅkhyāsu tatsaṃkhyāviśeṣādarārtham āha chāgaleyaḥ |
ekaikasya tu vargasya dvau dvau viprau samarcayet |
vaiśvadeve tathā dvau ca na prasajyeta vistare ||
evaṃ cātrāṣṭau brāhmaṇāḥ saṃpadyante |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe tu navamo ’py uktaḥ |
pūrvāhṇe bhojayed viprān aṣṭau evaṃ pradakṣiṇam |
tathā ca navamaṃ vipraṃ caturasre khagottama ||
caturasre maṇḍale caraṇakṣālane kriyamāṇe yaḥ kaścid atithir āgacchet sa navamo ’pi tatra bhojanīya ity arthaḥ | pakṣāntaram (?) apy uktaṃ tatraiva |
[1545] nāndīmukhān samuddiśya pitṝn pañca dvijottamān |
bhojayed vidhivat prājño vṛddhiśrāddhe pradakṣiṇam ||
asya ca nāndīśrāddhatrayasya vaiśvadevikapūrvakatvam āha vṛddaśātātapaḥ |
pradakṣiṇaṃ tu savyena bhojayed devapūrvakam |
viśvān devān uddiśya kriyamāṇaṃ śrāddhaṃ vaiśvadevikam | vṛddhiśrāddhe ca satyavasusaṃjñakāḥ karmāṅge ca kratudakṣasaṃjñakā viśvedevā iti pūrvam eva devatāprakaraṇe pratipāditam | pitaras tv atra nāndīmukhasaṃjñakāḥ pūjyā iti tatraiva darśitam | ihāpi tatra darśayiṣyate | athāsmin vṛddhiśrāddhe ’nye ’pi dharmaviśeṣāḥ pratipādyante |
tatrāha śātātapaḥ |
kartavyaṃ cābhyudayikaṃ śrāddham abhyudayārthinā |
savyena copavītena ṛjudarbhaiś ca dhīmatā ||
pitṝṇāṃ rūpam āsthāya devā annaṃ samaśnute |
tasmāt savyena dātavyaṃ vṛddhiśrāddhe tu nityaśaḥ |
yathaivopacared devāṃs tathā vṛddhau pitṝn api ||
ślokakātyāyano ’pi |
sadā paricared bhaktyā pitṝn apy atra devavat |
anena vaiśvadevike ye dharmās te sarve ’py atra kartavyā na pitryaśrāddhadharmā ity uktaṃ bhavati |
ata eva tilakārye yatra prayoga uktaḥ padmapurāṇe |
tilārthas tu yavaiḥ kāryaḥ savyenaivānupūrvaśaḥ |
[1546] maṅgalāni ca sarvāṇi vācayed dvijapuṅgavān ||
viṣṇudharmottare ’pi |
vṛddhiśrāddheṣu kartavyās tilasthāne yavās tathā |
