pitryadharmāntarasthāne dharmāntaraprayogas tūko brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
svāhāśabdaṃ prayuñjīta svadhāsthāne ca buddhimān ||
vṛddhiśrāddhe sadā savyaṃ yajñasūtraṃca kārayet |
kuśasthāne ca dūrvāḥ syur maṅgalasyābhivṛddhaye ||
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
udaṅmukhaḥ prāṅmukho vā yajamānaḥ samāhitaḥ |
vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ prakurvīta nānyavaktraḥ kadācana ||
atrodaṅmukhatvaprāṅmukhayor vyavasthoktā āśvalāyanagṛhyapariśiṣṭe |
ābhyudayike yugmā brāhmaṇā amūlā darbhāḥ prāṅmukhebhya udaṅmukho dadyād udaṅmukhebhyo vā prāṅmukho dvau darbhau pavitra iti |
āha pracetāḥ |
prāṅmukho devatīrthena vṛddhau paricaret pitṝn |
savyenaivopavītena kṣipraṃ deśavimārjanam ||
ucchiṣṭasya mārjanaṃ kṣipram eva kāryaṃ na tu pārvaṇavat kadācid āsāyaṃ pratīkṣed
ity arthaḥ |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
sarvaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kāryaṃ pūrvāhṇa upavītinā |
tasya puṣṭir athaiśvaryam āyuḥ santatir eva ca ||
yadi vibhrājate lakṣmā mokṣaṃ ca labhate kramāt |
[1547] ṛjavaḥ kutapā deyā na bhaṅktā vidhivat khaga ||
kuryād yavais tilārthaṃ tu dadyād arghyaṃ tathaiva ca |
gandhadhūpādikaṃ sarvaṃ kuryād vīra pradakṣiṇam |
pūrvāgrāṃs tu kuśān dadyāt savyenaiva hi buddhimān ||
'kutapāḥ' darbhāḥ | 'savyaṃ' savyaskandhasthitaṃ yajñopavītam |
bhaviṣyottare |
vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ daivikaṃ ca kāryaṃ yajñopavītinā |
pradakṣiṇaṃ prāṅmukheṣu yugmeṣu ca yavais tathā ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
devavat sarvam eva syān na vai kāryāḥ tilaiḥ kriyāḥ |
darbhāś ca ṛjavaḥ kāryā yugmān vai bhojayed dvijān |
devapūrvaṃ pradadyād vai na kuryād apradakṣiṇam ||
pitryadharmaniṣedhāś cātra bhavanti |
tatra ślokakātyāyanaḥ |
nipāto na hi savyasya jānuno vidyate kvacit |
nātrāpasavyakaraṇaṃ na pitryaṃ tīrtham iṣyate ||
madhu madhv iti yas tatra trirjapaḥ śreya icchatā |
gāyatryanantaraḥ so ’tra madhumantravisarjitaḥ ||
yas tasya vikiro ’nnasya tilavān yavavāṃs tathā |
ucchiṣṭasaṃnidhau so ’tra tṛpteṣu viparītakaḥ ||
vaiśvadevikaḥ 'yavavān', pitryaḥ 'tilavān' | 'viparītakaḥ' sarve ’pi yavavān ity arthaḥ |
[1548] āha pracetāḥ |
na japet paitṛkaṃ japyaṃ na māṃsaṃ tatra dāpayet |
atra japyaśabdāt yo bhuñjāneṣu dvijeṣu pitṛliṅgakānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ japaḥ sa eva niṣidhyate, na tu padārthānuṣṭhānakaraṇībhūtānām api |
ata eva jātūkarṇaḥ |
pitṛliṅgena mantreṇa yat karama munibhiḥ smṛtam |
tenaiva tad vidhātavyam amantram akṛtaṃ yataḥ ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
raktapuṣpaṃ tilāṃś caiva apasavyaṃ ca varjayet |
jalodbhavam apy atra raktapuṣpaṃ na dātavyam ityetadartho ’yaṃ niṣedhaḥ |
āha śātātapaḥ |
apasavyaṃ na kurvīta na kuryād apradakṣiṇam |
apasavyena yo dadyād vṛddhau kiṃcid atikramāt |
na tasya devās tṛpyanti pitaraś ca yathāvidhi ||
etac ca pitryadharmavivarjitaṃ daivadharmayuktaṃ ca nāndīmukhadaivatyaśrāddham evaṃ kartavyam |
atrāha jātūkarṇyaḥ |
pūrvedyus taddine vātha devapūrvaṃ nimantraṇam |
kṛtvā viprān samāhūya pūrvāhṇe niyataḥ śuciḥ ||
kṛtvā maṇḍalakaṃ teṣāṃ kṣālayec caraṇāṃs tataḥ |
ācāntān kṛtasatkārān āsaneṣūpaveśayet ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
[1549] kṛtvā maṇḍalakaṃ vīra caturasraṃ pradakṣiṇam |
pūrvāgrāṃs tu kuśān kṛtvā puṣpāṇāṃ prakaraṃ tathā |
bhojayed bho dvijān vīra gandhapuṣpavibhūṣitān ||
atra ślokakātyāyanaḥ |
ataḥ paraṃ pravacyāmi viśeṣa iha yo bhavet |
prātar āmantritān viprān yugmān ubhayatas tathā |
upaveśya kuśān dadyād ṛjūn eva hi pātitān ||
asyārthaḥ | pūrvedyus tadahar vābhimantritān viprān 'prātar eva pūrvāhṇa eva, āhūya candanākṣatakusumārcite caturasramaṇḍale (?) satyavasusaṃjñakān viśvedevān nāndīmukhasaṃjñakāṃś ca pitrādīn anukīrtya taccaraṇakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā āsaneṣūpaveśya ṛjubhūtair eva darbhair āsanaṃ dadyāt | 'ubhayata' iti caturaḥ pūrvamukhān ekata upaveśyānyataś catura udaṅmukhān upaveśayet |
tathā ca bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
prāṅmukhāṃś caturaś caiva caturaś ca udaṅmukhān |
niveśya ṛjubhir darbhair dadyād āsanam ādarāt ||
atha vā sarve ’pi prāṅmukhā upaveśyāḥ |
tathā ca chāgaleyaḥ |
sarvān eva tu tān viprān prāṅmukhān upaveśayet ||
ādye brahmapurāṇe |
viprān pradakṣiṇāvarte prāṅmukhān upaveśayet |
śakrāgniyamabhānvambho’nilacandraśivāṃśakān ||
samān praśastān subhagān puṣpamālyavibhūṣitān |
[1550] dadyād darbhāsanaṃ devān pitṝn uddiśya teṣu ca ||
ślokakātyāyanaḥ |
pitṛbhya iti datteṣu upaveśya kuśeṣu tān |
gotranāmabhir āmantrya pitṝn arghyaṃ pradāpayet ||
chāndogyagranthe ’rghyapātrasaṃkhyoktā |
catvāry evārghyapātrāṇy ābhyudayika iti |
etāni mātrādiśrāddhatraye trīṇi, vaiśvadevike caikam ity evaṃ vibhajanīyāni |
pātrapūraṇādividhiś ca kātyāyanenoktaḥ |
pātrāṇāṃ pūraṇādīni daivenaiva hi kārayet |
jyeṣṭhottarakarān yugmān karāgrāgrapavitrakān |
kṛtvārthaṃ saṃpradātavyaṃ naikaikasya pradīyate ||
daivena darbhārjava eva savyadevatīrthādinā vaiśvadevikadharmeṇa jyeṣṭhasya yugmādyasya viprasya karoyugmadvitīyaviprakarasyottaro yeṣu te tathā | karāgre 'graṃ pavitrāṇāṃ yeṣu te 'karāgrāgrapavitrakāḥ' | evaṃvidhān kṛtvā arghyaṃ pradadyāt | pūrvokena saṃsthānena dvayor dvayor hastau melayitvā tatra tatra ca pūrvāgrau dvau kuśau sthāpayitvaikaikasmin mātṛpitrādivarge vaiśvadevike ca sakṛd evārghaḥ pradeyo naikaikasya viprasya kara ity arthaḥ |
padmapurāṇe |
saṃpannam ity abhyudaye dadyād arghyaṃ dvayor dvayoḥ |
tṛptipraśnasthāne saṃpannam iti pṛcchet | arghyaṃ ca dvayor dvayor viprayor hastau melayitvā dadyād ity arthaḥ | atrārghyapātre tilasthāne yaveṣu [1551] prakṣepaṇīyeṣu tilo ’sīty ayaṃ mantro yavo ’sītyādyūhavān prayojyaḥ | ata eva āśvalāyanagṛhyapariśiṣṭe ūhitasyaiva mantrasya prayogo darśitaḥ | sopayāmāni pavitrāṇi catvāri śan no devīr ity anumantritāsu yavān āvapati |
yavo ’si somadevatyo gosavo devanirmitaḥ |
pratnavadbhiḥ pṛktaḥ puṣṭyā nāndīmukhān lokān prīṇayāhi naḥ svāheti |
tathā | viśvedevā idaṃ vo ’rghyaṃ nāndīmukhāḥ pitara iti yathāliṅgam arghyadānaṃ pitaraḥ prīyantām ity apāṃ pratigrahaṇaṃ visarjanaṃ caivam uttarayor api pitāmahaprapitāmahayoḥ arghyadānaṃ cāvāhanapūrvakaṃ kartavyam |
tathā ca caturviṃśatimate |
nāndīmukhān pitṝn pūjya pitṛkārye vidhānavat |
āsanaṃ ca tato dadyāt kuryād āvāhanādikam ||
āvāhanārghyādikaṃ pārvaṇoktaṃ padārthajātaṃ tad uktenaiva krameṇa kuryād ity arthaḥ |
āvāhanaprakāraś ca ādye brahmapurāṇe darśitaḥ |
nāndīmukhān pitṝn bhaktyā sāñjaliś ca samāhvayet |
paṭhet pavitraṃ mantraṃ tu viśvedevāsa āgata ||
arghyadānānantaraṃ gandhapuṣpādikaṃ deyam |
tathā ca bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
kṛtvā yavais tilārthaṃ tu dadyād arghyaṃ vidhānataḥ |
gandhadhūpādikaṃ sarvaṃ kuryād vīra pradakṣiṇam ||
[1552] etac ca gandhādikam ekaikasya haste dvir dviḥ pradeyam |
tathā ca āśvalāyanagṛhyapariśiṣṭe |
pradakṣiṇam upacāro yavais tilārthaḥ sarvaṃ dvir dviḥ || iti |
gandhādidānānantaraṃ cāgnaukaraṇaṃ kartavyam | etad api tatraivoktam |
nityaṃ cāgnau karaṇaṃ svāhākāreṇa homaś ca || iti |
atra pāṭhāntaraṃ |
pāṇau hāmo ’gnaye kavyavāhanāya svāhā somāya pitṛmate svāhā || iti |
tathā |
pṛṣadājyamiśra odano haviḥ sarvatra tasyārddhena dve dve āhutī juhuyāt || iti |
sarvatrety agnaukaraṇadvijabhojanavikiraṇapiṇḍadāneṣu, dadhimiśram ājyaṃ 'pṛṣadājyam', tanmiśrasya odanasya pūrvāparārddhe vibhāgaṃ kalpayitvā dvir avadāya homaḥ kārya
ity arthaḥ |
ādye brahmapurāṇe |
rakṣoghnīr juhuyād agnau samidarthe mahauṣadhīḥ |
'rakṣoghnīḥ' palāśaśaṅkhinīviṣṇukrāntādyāḥ |
kṛte cāgnaukaraṇe dvijapātreṣu pariveṣaṇaṃ kartavyam | tatra pariveṣaṇīyam annam uktaṃ bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
pṛṣadājyena saṃyuktaṃ dadyād odanam āditaḥ |
pāyasaṃ ca tathā bhavyaṃ modakādirasottaram |
madhuraṃ bhojanaṃ dadyān na cāmlaṃ pariveṣayet ||
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
maṅgalyaṃ bhakṣyabhojyādi dadyād annaṃ pṛthagvidham |
guḍamiśraṃ khagaśreṣṭha sājyaṃ caivodanaṃ param |
rasālān modakāṃś caiva na cāmlakaṭukādikam ||
[1553] ādiśabdenātrodvejakatiktādirasasaṅgrahaḥ kriyate |
ādye brahmapurāṇe |
annaṃ dadyāc ca daivena tīrthena ca japan svadhām |
pariveṣya cānnaṃ pātrābhimantraṇādi kartavyam |
tatra āśvalāyanagṛhyapariśiṣṭe |
ato devā avantu na ity aṅguṣṭhagrahaṇam idaṃ viṣṇur vicakrama ity anyatra ato devā avantu na ity etayarcā nāndīśrāddhe ’ṅguṣṭhagrahaṇam |
'anyatra' śrāddhāntare ’nyarcety arthaḥ | akṣannamīmadanteti ca ṣaṣṭhītipāṭhāntaram |
bhuñjāneṣu japo ’pi tatraivoktaḥ |
pāvamānīḥ śambatīraudraṃ cāpratirathaṃ ca śrāvayīta |
ādye brahmapurāṇe |
paṭhet tu śakrasūktaṃ tu svastiyuktaṃ śubhaṃ tathā |
yuktām aśrumukhānāṃ tu na paṭhet pitṛsaṃhitām ||
'śakrasūktam' āśuḥ śiśāna ityādikaṃ sūktam | 'svastiyuktam' svastiśabdayukaṃ yat kiṃcit sūktam | śubham anyad api paṭhet | śubhatarāśīḥpradhānaṃ kiṃcid ṛgyajuḥprabhṛtikaṃ tad api paṭhet |
madhumatījapaniṣedhaṃ kṛtvā kātyāyanaḥ |
anyatra ca japaḥ kāryaḥ somasāmādikaḥ śubhaḥ |
caturviṃśatimate |
vikiraṃ ca tathā piṇḍān dadyāc ca niyamaṃ vinā |
brūyāt tṛpteṣu saṃpannaṃ vṛddhiśrāddhe samāhitaḥ (?) ||
āha kātyāyanaḥ |
[1554] saṃpannam iti tṛptāḥ stha praśnasthāne vidhīyate |
susaṃpannam iti prokte śeṣam annaṃ nivedayet ||
brahmapurāṇe |
kaccit saṃpannam etan me tān pṛcchec ca praharṣitān |
susaṃpannaṃ ca te brūyuḥ sarvaṃ siddhaṃ tataḥ kṣipet ||
sarvajātīyasiddham annam ekapātre samuddhṛtya vikiraṃ kuryād ity arthaḥ |
vṛddhavaśiṣṭhaḥ |
tṛptapraśne tu saṃpannaṃ daive rocata ity api |
saṃpannaṃ pitrye, daive tu rocata iti |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
evaṃ bhukteṣu vipreṣu dadyāt piṇḍān samāhitaḥ |
dadhyakṣatair vimiśrāṃs tu badaraiś ca khagādhipa |
viṣṇudharmottare |
karkandhudadhisaṃmiśrān tathā piṇḍāṃś ca nirvapet |
brahmapurāṇe |
śālyannaṃ dadhimadhvaktaṃ badarāṇi yavāṃs tathā |
miśrīkṛtya tu catvāri piṇḍān śrīphalasaṃnibhān |
dadyān nāndīmukhebhyaś ca pitṛbhyo vidhipūrvakam ||
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
piṇḍāṃś ca dadhisaṃmiśrān dadyād yavasumiśritān |
vṛddhavasiṣṭhaḥ |
dadhikarkandhusaṃmiśrāḥ piṇḍāḥ kāryā yathākramam |
[1555] 'karkandhuḥ' badarīphalam |
caturviṃśatimate |
saṃbhojyaiva dvijān dhīras tataḥ piṇḍāṃs tu nirvapet |
padmapurāṇe |
pradakṣiṇopacāreṇa dadhyakṣataphalodakaiḥ |
prāṅmukhodaṅmukho vāpi pradadyād badarair yutān ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
dadhibadarākṣatādyāṃś ca piṇḍān savyena bhārata |
nirvapen maṇḍale vīra caturasre vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
pavitrapāṇir ācānta upaviṣṭaḥ samāhitaḥ |
pradadyāt prāṅmukhaḥ piṇḍān vṛddhau savyena vāgyataḥ ||
piṇḍapradānaṃ cātra vaikalpikam |
tathā ca viṣṇupurāṇe |
dadhyakṣataiḥ sabadaraiḥ prāṅmukhodaṅmukho ’pi vā |
devatīrthena vai piṇḍān dadyāt kāmena vai nṛpa ||
'kāmena' icchayā | icchābhāve tu na dadyāt |
piṇḍadānakaraṇākaraṇayor vyavasthoktā bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kuryān naiva kuryān narādhipa |
vṛddhiśrāddhe mahābāho kuladharmam avekṣya vai ||
anena yeṣāṃ kule vṛddhaparaṃparayā vṛddhiśrāddhe piṇḍadānam anuṣṭhīyate taiḥ kartavyam | yeṣāṃ tu kule nānuṣṭhīyate tair na kartavyam iti vyavasthā darśitā | iyaṃ ca vyavasthā niranikānām eva ca | sāgnikais tu sarvadā kartavyam evety uktam ādye brahmapurāṇe |
[1556] yo ’gnau tu vidyamāne 'pi vṛddhau piṇḍān na nirvapet |
patanti pitaras tasya narake sa tu pacyate ||
atra piṇḍadānāya pradeśaviśeṣam āha vṛddhaśātātapaḥ |
pradadyāt prāṅmukhaḥ piṇḍān vṛddhau nāmnā sa bāhyataḥ |
'saḥ' śrāddhakartā, 'bāhyataḥ' bhojanaśālāyā bahiḥ, na tūcchiṣṭasamīpa ity arthaḥ |
āha pracetāḥ |
prāṅmukho devatīrthena prākkūleṣu kuśeṣu ca |
pitṛpiṇḍāṃs tu kurvīta piṇḍapātram adhomukham ||
'prākkūlāḥ' prāgagrāḥ |
āśvalāyanagṛhyapariśiṣṭe piṇḍabhūmer gomayenopalepanam uktam |
āśayeṣu piṇḍadānaṃ gomayopalipteṣu prāgagrān kuśān āstīryeti |
caturviṃśatimate |
dvau dvau cābhyudaye piṇḍāv ekaikasmai vinikṣipet |
ekaṃ nāmnāparaṃ tūṣṇīṃ dadyāt piṇḍān pṛthak pṛthak ||
ādye brahmapurāṇe |
prāṅmukhāṃs tv atha dabhāṃs tu dadyāt kṣīrāvanejanam |
nāndīmukhānāṃ kurvīta prājñaḥ piṇḍodakakriyām |
prājāpatyena tīrthena yac ca kiṃcit prajāyate ||
āha kātyāyanaḥ |
prāgagreṣu ca darbheṣu ādyam āmantrya pūrvavat |
apaḥ kṣipen mūladeśe ’vanenikṣveti nistilāḥ ||
[1557] dvitīyaṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ ca madhyadeśāgradeśayoḥ |
'āmantrya' gotrasaṃbandhanāmabhiḥ saṃbodhya, tathā 'dvitīyaṃ' pitāmahaṃ ca, 'tṛtīyaṃ' prapitāmaham |
mātāmahaprabhṛtīṃs tu eteṣām eva vāgyataḥ |
sarvasmād annam uddhṛtya vyañjanair upasicya ca ||
saṃyojya yavakarkandhudadhibhiḥ prāṅmukhas tataḥ |
avanejanavatpiṇḍān dadyād bilvapramāṇakān ||
tatpātrakṣālanenātha punar apy avane japet |
uttarottaradānena piṇḍānām uttarottaraḥ ||
bhaved adhaś ca karaṇād adharaḥ śrāddhakarmasu |
tasmāc chrāddheṣu sarveṣu vṛddhimatsv itareṣu ca ||
mūlamadhyāgradeśeṣu īṣatsaktāṃś ca nirvapet |
gandhādīn nikṣipet tūṣṇīṃ tataś cācāmayed dvijān ||
anyatrāpy eṣa eva syād yavādirahito vidhiḥ |
atra piṇḍadānaṃ cādhikṛtyoktam ādye brahmapurāṇe |
arghyaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ ca praśastam anulepanam |
vāsaḥ sādhv ahataṃ śuddhaṃ deyaṃ ca sadṛśaṃ samam ||
drākṣāmalakamūlāni yavāṃś cātha nivedayet |
tāny eva dakṣiṇārthaṃ tu dadyād vipreṣu sarvadā ||
athākṣayyodakasthāne datvā kṣirayavādikam |
nāndīmukhebhyaś cākṣayyam idam astv iti saṃjapet ||
kātyāyanas tv āha |
[1558] akṣayyodakadānaṃ ca arghyadānavad iṣyate |
ṣaṣṭhyaiva nityaṃ tat kuryān na caturthyā kadācana ||
prapitāmahasaṃjñāś ca nāndīmukhyaś ca mātaraḥ |
mātāmahyaḥ pitāmahyaḥ prapitāmahya eva hi ||
mātāmahebhyaś ca tathā nāndīvaktrebhya eva ca |
pramātāmahasaṃjñebhyo bhavadbhiś ca svadhocyatām |
astu svadheti te taṃ ca jalpanti prahasanti ca ||
baudhāyanasūtre |
teṣu bhuktavatsu svadhāyai sthāne madhumaniṣye madhujaniṣya ity etad yajur japitvā nāndīmukhāḥ pitaraḥ prīyantām ity apo ninayati svadhaivaiṣoktir bhavati |
āha śātātapaḥ |
nāndīmukhās tu pitaras tṛpyantām iti vācayet |
ādye brahmapurāṇe |
viśvedevāś ca prīyantām iti dātābravīd imān |
prītā bhavantu te taṃ ca vadanti madhurākṣaram ||
brahmapurāṇe |
nāndīmukhān tu pitaraḥ prīyantām iti vācayet |
caturviṃśatimate |
prīyantām iti ca brūyāt piṇḍān svāheti nikṣipet |
āśvalāyanagṛhyapariśiṣṭe |
nāndīmukhāḥ pitaraḥ prīyantām iti visṛjet || iti |
[1559] ādye brahmapurāṇe |
camūṣu vājinam iti paṭhaṃs tāś ca visarjayet |
atha nāndīmukhībhyaś ca mātṛbhyaḥ śrāddham uttamam |
anena vidhinā kāryaṃ sīmantonnayanādiṣu ||
āha kātyāyanaḥ |
athāgrabhūmim āsiñcet susuprokṣitam astv iti |
śivā āpaḥ santv iti ca yugmān yavodakena ca ||
saumanasyam astv iti ca puṣpadānam ataḥ param |
akṣataṃ cāriṣṭaṃ cāstv ity akṣatān pratipādayet |
akṣayyaṃ ca tataḥ kuryād daivapūrvaṃ vidhānataḥ ||
atra dātāra ityādiprārthanāślokān pūrvaṃ prayojya ślokāntaram uktaṃ bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
mātā pitāmahī caiva tathaiva prapitāmahī |
etā bhavantu me prītāḥ prayacchantu ca maṅgalam ||
anantaraṃ kartavyam āha kātyāyanaḥ |
prārthanāsu pratiprokte sarvāsv eva dvijottamaiḥ |
pavitrāntarhitān piṇḍān siñced uttānapātrakṛt ||
yugmān eva svastivācyam aṅguṣṭhagrahaṇaṃ sadā |
kṛtvā dhuryasya viprasya praṇamyānuvrajet tataḥ ||
'dhuryaḥ' paṅktimūrdhanyaḥ |
caturviṃśatimate |
[1560] śeṣam annam anujñāpya vaiśvadevakriyāṃ tataḥ |
śrāddhāhni śrāddhaśeṣeṇa vaiśvadevaṃ samācaret ||
vaiśvadevagrahaṇam annasādhyānāṃ devapitryamānuṣabhautikakarmaṇām upalakṣaṇārtham | atra prāguktaviśeṣātiriktaṃ dharmajātaṃ pārvaṇavat kartavyam |
tathā ca viṣṇudharmottare |
vṛddhau samarcayed vidvān nityaṃ nāndīmukhān pitṝn |
saṃpādito viśeṣas tu śeṣaṃ pārvaṇavad bhavet ||
'viśeṣaḥ' pitṝṇāṃ nāndīmukhasaṃjñakatvam ity eṣaḥ | upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat prāguktānāṃ vaiśeṣikāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ dharmāṇām |
padmapurāṇe |
evaṃ śudro ’pi sāmānyaṃ vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ tu sarvadā |
namaskāreṇa mantreṇa kuryād dānādi vai budhaḥ ||
atra kātyāyanoktā prayogapaddhatiḥ |
ābhyudayike pradakṣiṇam upacāraḥ, pitryamantravarjaṃ japaḥ, ṛjavo darbhāḥ, yavais tilārthāḥ, saṃpannam iti tṛptipraśnaḥ, susaṃpannam itītare brūyuḥ, dadhibadarākṣatamiśrāḥ piṇḍāḥ, nāndīmukhān pitṝn vācayiṣya iti pṛcchati, nāndīmukhāḥ pitaraḥ pitāmahāḥ prapitāmahā mātāmahāś ca prīyantām iti na svadhāṃ prayuñjīta, yugmān āśayet || iti |
asyārthaḥ | ‘ābhyudayike' putrajanmavivāhādirūpābhyudayanimittake śrāddhe | pradakṣiṇagrahaṇena yajñopavītitvaprāgudaṅamukhatvaprāgudaksaṃsthatvaṃ copalakṣitam | ‘upacāraḥ’ anuṣṭhānam | 'pitryamantravarjaṃ japaḥ' sa cāyam aśnatsu pitryamantrajapaḥ pratiṣidhyate, āyantu na ityādi pitṛśabdavanmantravarjam | [1561] 'ṛjavo darbhāḥ' na tu dviguṇabhugnāḥ | 'tilārthaḥ' tilakāryaṃ yavair eva kartavyam | atra tilosītyādimantro yavo 'sīty evaṃ prayojya iti karkaḥ |
tṛptāḥ sthety asya sthāne saṃpannam iti praśnaḥ kāryaḥ | brāhmaṇaiś ca susaṃpannam ity uttaraṃ pradeyam | pitṝn āvāhayiṣya ity asya sthāne nāndīmukhān pitṝn āvāhayiṣya iti prayogaḥ | evaṃ yatra yatra pitṛpadaprayogaḥ tatra tatra nāndīmukhapadaṃ pūrvam prayojyam iti jñeyam | svadhāvācanasthāne ca nāndīmukhān pitṝn svāhāṃ vācayiṣya iti pṛcchati | vācyatām iti brāhmaṇair anujñātā nāndīmukhebhyaḥ svāhocyatām iti preṣyati astu svāheti brāhmaṇairanujñātaḥ ūrjam ityādimantre svāhā sthety ūhaṃ vidhāya bhūmāv āstṛtāsu dūrvāsu jalaṃ niṣiñcet | atra yugmān brāhmaṇān bhojayed iti |
gobhiloktā prayogapaddhatiḥ |
ābhyudayike śrāddhe yugmā brāhmaṇāḥ pradakṣiṇam upacāraḥ ṛjavo dabhā yavais tilārtho dadhibadarākṣatamiśrāḥ piṇḍā nāndīmukhāḥ prīyantām iti daive vācayitvā nāndīmukhebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ pitāmahebhyaḥ prapitāmahebhyo mātāmahebhyaḥ pramātāmahebhyo vṛddhapramātāmahebhyaḥ svāhocyatām iti svadhāvācanasthānena svāhāṃ prayuñjīta |
baudhāyanokā prayogapaddhatiḥ |
athāto nāndīmukham ādita eva dvau viprau nimantryāparāṃś ca pitrathān atha śmaśrukarmābhyañjanasnānair yathopapādaṃ saṃpūjyāgnimupasamādhāya saṃparistīryājyaṃ vilāpyotpūya dadhnā saṃvipūya sruvaṃ saṃmṛjya daive dau viprāv upaveśyālaṃkṛtyānuddiśya dvipavitram eva yavodakaṃ nidhāya puṣpaphalākṣatamiśraṃ [1562] bhojanasthāneṣv āsaneṣu yavān sikatāḥ saṃprakīrya pitrarthān upaveśya teṣu sapavitreṣu nāndīmukhāḥ pitaraḥ prīyantām ity anena mantreṇa pātrāntareṇopayujya yavodakaṃ dvir athālaṃkṛtyaivam eva datvāgnaukaraṇam anusthāpyālaṃkṛtya pṛṣadājyān sruveṇopahatya nāndīmukhebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svāhety etāvad agnau kṛtvānnam upastīrṇābhighāritaṃ pātreṣūddhṛtya pṛṣadājyena saṃsṛjya dakṣiṇenāgniṃ darbheṣu sādayitvā darbhaiḥ pracchādya nāndīmukhānām iti mantram ūhayitvā viprebhyo dvir upastīryābhīṣṭhasyānnasya dvir dvir avadāya dvir dvir abhighārya yathāvad bhojayet | pitṛsāmānyavācauni svadhāyuktāni brāhmaṇāny abhiśrāvya bhuktavatsv ācānteṣu dadhyodanaṃ saṃprakīrya saṃkṣālanena dvir dviḥ pariṣicya pūrvavad yavodakaṃ datvā dakṣiṇāḥ pradāya nāndīmukhāḥ pitaraḥ prīyantām iti vācayitvābhivādya svadhāsthāne dakṣiṇaṃ jānu nidhāya savyam uddhṛtya dūdhād eva bhūr iti japitvānte ’nuvākasya nāndīmukhāḥ pitaraḥ prīyantām ity apo ninīya samutthāpya prasādya pradakṣiṇīkṛtya śeṣam anujñāpya daivataṃ ca visṛjya pradakṣiṇenāgniṃ prāgagreṣu darbheṣu nāndīmukhebhyaḥ pitṛbhyo dadyān nāndīmukhebhyaḥ svāheti saṃkṣālanena pradakṣiṇaṃ pariṣiñcaty ūrjaṃ vahantīr iti ihāpi jāyādyarthena kālahomān pṛṣadājyena pūrvavad dhomaṃ sakṛd itthaṃ tyaktam etat |

pitṛlokeṣu pānīyaṃ maddattam upatiṣṭhatām ||
brahmapurāṇe |
kartavyaṃ tu sacelaṃ tu snānaṃ sarvamalāpaham |
[1587] tataḥ pāṣāṇapṛṣṭhe tu sarvair deyaṃ tilodakam ||
pretaśya sapiṇḍair dakṣiṇāmukhair jalāśaye kṛtāpasavyaiḥ sakṛd eva snātvā pāṣāṇasyopari pretoddeśenāñjalinā pitṛtīrthena tilodakaṃ deyam |
ekaikena tu deyās tu viprāyāñjalayo daśa |
dvādaśa kṣatriye deyā vaiśyāya daśapañca ca |
triṃśat śūdrāya devās tu pretabhūmiṃ gatāya ca ||
apasavyaṃ kvacit kṛtvā vastrayajñopavītakaiḥ |
dakṣiṇābhimukhair viprair deyaṃ tasyāñjalitrayam ||
vāmāṅguṣṭhapravāheṇa bhūmāv evātha vā kvacit |
asāv amukagotras tu pretas tṛpyatv idaṃ paṭhan ||
ayaṃ tu mahāpātakarahitāya tilodakadānaprakāraḥ | patitāya tv anya evocyate |
patitasya tu kāruṇyād yas tṛptiṃ kartum icchati |
sa tu dāsīṃ samāhūya savarṇāṃ dattavetanām ||
aśuddhaghaṭahastāṃ tu yathāvṛttaṃ bravīty api |
he dāsi gaccha mūlyena tilān ānaya satvaram ||
toyapūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ cemaṃ satilaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhī |
upaviṣṭā tu vāmena caraṇena tataḥ kṣipa ||
kīrtayer mṛtasaṃjñānaṃ pibeti ca vader muhuḥ |
niśamya tasya vākyaṃ sā labhdhamūlyā karoti tat |
evaṃ (?) kṛte bhavet tṛptiḥ patitānāṃ na cānyathā ||
iti patitāya tilodakavidhiḥ |
[1588]
tilodakapraśaṃsā ca ādityapurāṇe |
yathā yodhasahasreṇa vṛtorājānugacchati (?) |
tadvat tilasamāyuktaṃ jalaṃ preteṣu gacchati ||
atha pretapiṇḍaprayogaḥ |
tatra dattatilodakeṣu gṛham āgateṣu jñātiśv āha śaṅkhaḥ |
dūrvāṃ pravālam agniṃ vṛṣabhaṃ cālabhya gṛhadvāre pretāya piṇḍaṃ datvā paścāt praviśeyuḥ |
pretapiṇḍaṃ prakṛtyāha śunaḥśephaḥ |
dvāradeśe pradātavyo devatāyataneṣu vā |
vṛddhapracetās tv āha |
dvāradeśe pradātavyo na devāyatane kvacit |
ādityapurāṇe coktam |
dvāradeśeṣu dātavyo na devāyatane kvacit |
evaṃ ca devatāyatanasya vihitapratiṣiddhatvād vikalpaḥ piṇḍo dātavya ity anuvṛttāv asminn eva purāṇe |
śucau tu deśe nadyāṃ vā jīrṇatoye pravāhayet |
padmapurāṇe |
pretāya piṇḍadānaṃ tu dvādaśāhaṃ samācaret |
pātheyaṃ tasya tat proktaṃ yataḥ prītikaraṃ mahat ||
vārāhapurāṇe |
sthaṇḍilapretabhāgaṃ tu dadyāt pūrvāhṇa eva tu |
kṛtvā tu piṇḍasaṃkalpaṃ nāmagotreṇa sundari ||
[1589] paścād aśnanti gotrāṇi sakulyās tv ekabhojanāḥ |
na dadyād anyagotrāya bhuñjate yata ekataḥ ||
caturṇām api varṇānāṃ pretakāryeṣu mādhavi |
evaṃ dattena prīyante pretalokagatā narāḥ ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
daśāhaṃ bāndhavāḥ snātvā sarve caiva susaṃyatāḥ |
piṇḍaṃ pratidinaṃ dadyuḥ sāyaṃ prātar yathāvidhi ||
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
pretībhūtasya satataṃ bhuvi piṇḍajalaṃ tathā |
satilaṃ sakuśaṃ dadyād bahir jalasamīpataḥ ||
brahmapurāṇe |
grāmād bahiś ca kartavyaṃ jalāśayasamīpataḥ |
piṇḍadānaṃ daśāhāni pretāyāraṇyam āśritaiḥ ||
araṇye piṇḍadānaṃ tu mohān na kriyate yadi |
tadā rauravam āyāti pramītaḥ prathame ’hani ||
punnāmasaṃjñaṃ tv apare mahārāvaṃ tṛtīyake |
tāmisrākhyaṃ caturthe tu prayāty api sudāruṇam ||
pañcame cāndhatāmisraṃ ṣaṣṭhe ghoraṃ ca suprabham |
amedhyapūyasaṃpūrṇaṃ saptame ’hani pātakam ||
asipatravanaṃ ghoram aṣṭame ’hani sarvathā |
mahārauravasaṃjñaṃ tu navame yāti mānavaḥ ||
avīcir iti vikhyātaṃ daśame ’hani bhīṣaṇam |
[1590] taṇḍulaiḥ saktubhiḥ śākaiḥ phalair vā śraddhayā tataḥ |
deśakālānusāreṇa kuryāt pretasya tarpaṇam ||
āha viṣṇuḥ |
yāvad āśaucaṃ pretasyodakaṃ piṇḍam ekaṃ ca dadyuḥ |
brahmapurāṇe |
pretāya divase piṇḍo deya ekakrameṇa hi |
āha śātātapaḥ |
tryahāśaucasya hrāse ’pi piṇḍān dadyād daśaiva tu |
piṇḍam ekam atha śrāddhe saṃpradadyād yathāvidhi ||
tatra tryahāśauce daśapiṇḍadānaprakāram āha pāraskaraḥ |
prathame divase deyās trayaḥ piṇḍāḥ samāhitaiḥ |
dvitīye caturo dadyād asthisaṃcayanaṃ tathā |
trīṃs tu dadyāt tṛtīye ’hni vastrādikṣālanaṃ tathā ||
brahmapurāṇe tu sadyaḥśaucaviṣaye yugapaddaśapiṇḍadānam |
tryahāśauce pradātavyaḥ prathame tv eka eva hi
dvitīye ’hani catvāras tṛtīye pañca caiva hi ||
jātyuktāśaucatulyāṃs tu varṇānāṃ kvacid eva hi |
deśadharmān puraskṛtya pretapiṇḍān vapanty api ||
deyasstu daśamaḥ piṇḍo rājñāṃ vai dvādaśe ’hani |
vaiśyānāṃ pañcadaśame deyas tu daśamas tathā |
śūdrasya daśamaḥ piṇḍo māsi pūrṇe ’hni dīyate |
pāraskaraḥ |
[1591] brāhmaṇe daśapiṇḍās tu kṣatriye dvādaśa smṛtāḥ |
vaiśye pañcadaśa prokrāḥ śūdra triṃśat prakīrtitāḥ ||
uktasaṃkhyāyāmasarthān (?) prati saṃkhyāntaram āha sa eva |
pretebhyaḥ sarvavarṇebhyaḥ piṇḍān dadyād daśaiva tu |
śrāddhakarmaṇi saṃprāpte piṇḍa eko vidhīyate ||
āha pracetāḥ |
asaṃskṛtānāṃ bhūmau piṇḍaṃ dadyāt saṃskṛtānāṃ kuśeṣu |
śunaḥpucchaḥ |
phalamūlaiś ca payasā śākena ca guḍena ca |
tilamiśraṃ tu darbheṣu piṇḍaṃ dakṣiṇato haret ||
tūṣṇīṃ prasekaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ tathaiva ca |
śālinā satkubhir vāpi śākair vāpy atha nirvapet |
prathame ’hani yad dravyaṃ tad eva syād daśāhikam ||
bhaviṣyottare |
odanāmiṣasakūnāṃ śākamūlaphalādiṣu |
prathame ’hani yad dadyāt tad dadyād uttare ’hani ||
gṛhyapariśiṣṭe |
asagotraḥ sagotro vā yadi strī yadi vā pumān |
prathame ’hani yo dayāt sa daśāhaṃ samāpayet ||
brahmapurāṇe |
prathame ’hani yo dadyāt pretāyānnaṃ samāhitaḥ |
[1592] annaṃ navasu cānyeṣu sa eva pradadāty api ||
bhaviṣyottare |
gṛhadvāre śmaśāne ca tīrthe devagṛhe tathā |
yatrādyo dīyate piṇḍas tatra sarvaṃ samāpayet ||
āha pracetāḥ |
navāny ādāya bhāṇḍāni ālukaṃ carukaṃ tathā |
toyārthaṃ tu tato gacched gṛhītvā puruṣaṃ puraḥ |
gṛhītalakuṭaṃ mārgāt sarvaduṣṭanivāraṇam ||
tato gṛhaṃ saṃpraviśet pretasyāhṛtya taṇḍulān |
teṣāṃ prasṛtim ādāya kartavyaṃ piṇḍakarma tu ||
triḥ prakṣālya tu tān samyak caruṃ saṃpādayet tataḥ |
taṃ saṃpādya samādāya darbheṣu viniveśayet ||
dakṣiṇāgrāṃś ca darbhāṃś ca sa ca vai dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ |
piṇḍaṃ kṛtvā samuddhṛtya nāmnā gotreṇa cārpayet ||
ādityapurāṇe |
tilamiśreṣu darbheṣu kartā vai dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ |
nāmagotrapramāṇena dadyāt piṇḍaṃ tv amantrakam ||
āha marīciḥ |
pretapiṇḍaṃ bahir dadyād darbhamantravivarjitam |
prāgudīcyāṃ caruṃ kṛtvā snātaḥ prayatamānasaḥ ||
ādityapurāṇe |
pitṛśabdaṃ svadhāṃ caiva na prayuñjīta karhicit |
[1593] anuśabdaṃ tathā ceha prayatnena vivarjayet ||
upatiṣṭhatām ayaṃ piṇḍaḥ pretāyeti samuccaret ||
tūṣṇīṃ dhūpaṃ prasekaṃ ca dīpaṃ puṣpaṃ tathaiva ca |
aśuddhas triṣu varṇeṣu idaṃ dadyān na saṃśayaḥ ||
śātātapaḥ |
vāgyataḥ prayataś caiva tiṣṭhet piṇḍasya saṃnidhau |
tato bāṣpe nivṛtte ’sya nadyāṃ tu prakṣipet tataḥ ||
brahmapurāṇe |
mṛṇmayaṃ bhāṇḍam ādāya navaṃ snātaḥ susaṃyataḥ |
lakuṭaṃ sarvaduṣṭaghnaṃ gṛhītvā toyam ānayet ||
tataś cottarapūrvasyām agniṃ prajvālayed diśi |
taṇḍulaṃ prasṛtiṃ tatra triḥ prakṣālya pacet svayam ||
sapavitrais tilair miśraṃ kṛmikeśavivarjitam |
dvāropānte tataḥ kṣiptvā suśuddhāṃ gauramṛttikām ||
tatpṛṣṭhe prastared darbhān yāmyāgrān deśasaṃbhavān |
tato ’vanejanaṃ dadyāt saṃsmaran gotranāmanī ||
tilasarpirmadhukṣīraiḥ saṃsiktaṃ taptam eva hi |
dadyāt pretāya piṇḍaṃ tu dakṣiṇābhimukhasthitaḥ ||
phalamūlaguḍakṣīratilair miśraṃ tu kutracit |
arghyaiḥ puṣpais tathā dhūpair dīpais toyaiś ca śītalaiḥ ||
ūrṇātantumayaiḥ śuddhair vāsobhiḥ piṇḍam arcayet |
[1594] prayāti yāvad ākāśaṃ piṇḍād bāṣpamayī śikhā |
tāvat tatsaṃmukhaṃ tiṣṭhet piṇḍaṃ toye kṣipet tataḥ ||
ekas toyāñjaliś caiva pātram ekaṃ ca dīyate |
dvitīye dvau tṛtīye trīn caturthe caturas tathā ||
pañcame pañca ṣaṣṭhe ca saptame sapta eva ca |
aṣṭame ’ṣṭau ca navame navaiva daśame daśa ||
yena syuḥ pañcapañcāśat toyasyāñjalayaḥ kramāt |
toyapātrāṇi tāvanti saṃyuktāni tilādibhiḥ ||
ekādaśendriyabadhāḥ santi buddhibadhaiḥ saha |
sarveṣām eva bhūtānāṃ paralokasamakrame ||
pretabhāgavatānāṃ tu rauravādiṣu vartatām |
pañcabhiḥ pañcabhis tv ebhiḥ pātrair añjalibhis tathā |
ekādaśaivendriyāṇi pūyante śāstradarśanāt ||
vṛddhaśātātapo ’pi |
dine dine ’ñjalīn pūrṇān prakṣipet pretakāraṇāt |
tāvad vṛddhiś ca kartavyā yāvat piṇḍaḥ samāpyate ||
piṇḍasyodakadānasya ca phalam uktam ādityapurāṇe |
svagotrā vānyagotrā vā striyaś ca puruṣās tathā |
pretās tu piṇḍasaṃbandhā mucyante tena karmaṇā |
vāyubhūtās tu tiṣṭhante kālakṣepeṇa sarvadā ||
brahmapurāṇe |
[1595] pretāya piṇḍadānaṃ tu kartuṃ gacchanti ye narāḥ |
niṣkramanti gṛhāt te tu jyeṣṭhaṃ kṛtvā puraḥsaram ||
hrasvān puraḥsarān kṛtvā praviśanti gṛhaṃ tu te |
ullaṅghya śastrapāṣāṇau praviśanti gṛhaṃ kramāt ||
ekāhaṃ dvāradeśe tu jalapātraṃ nidhāya ca |
kṣīraṃ pātraṃ ca kāruṇyāt pretāyeti viniścayaḥ ||
pretāsmin śītale toye snāhi dugdhaṃ tataḥ piba |
iti japaṃs trirātraṃ tu bhaktamuṣṭiṃ kṣipet tathā ||
āha śātātapaḥ |
jalam ekāham ākāśe sthāpyaṃ kṣīraṃ ca mṛnmaye |
'ākāśe' bhūmer anyatra śikyādau, pretam uddiśya jalaṃ kṣīraṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak mṛnmaye pātre prathamam ahorātraṃ sthāpayed ity arthaḥ |
atra dinasaṃkhyādhikyam uktaṃ padmapurāṇe |
yasmāt pretapurīṃ preto dvādaśāhena nīyate |
gṛhaputrakalatraṃ ca dvādaśāhaṃ prapaśyati ||
tasmān niyatam ākāśe daśarātraṃ payas tathā |
sarvatāpopaśāntyartham adhvaśramavināśanam ||
sthāpayed iti śeṣaḥ |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasakalakaraṇādhipatipaṇḍitaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau pariśeṣakhaṇḍe śrāddhakalpe tīrthaśrāddhādiprayogaprakaraṇam
nāma ūnaviṃśo ’dhyāyaḥ ||
[1596]
śatha viṃśo ’dhyāyaḥ |
atha pretaṭaptikaraśrāddhādīnāṃ prayogaprakaraṇam |
tatra daśapiṇḍaniṣpādyāvayavā brahmapurāṇe |
śiras tv ādyena piṇḍena pretasya kriyate sadā |
dvitīye tanukarṇākṣināsikāś ca samāsataḥ ||
galāsyabhujavakṣāṃsi tṛtīyena yathākramam |
caturthena tu piṇḍena nābhiliṅgagudāni ca ||
ūrū jaṅghe tathā pādau pañcamena ca sarvadā |
sarvacarmāṇi ṣaṣṭhena saptamena ca nāḍayaḥ ||
dantalomāny aṣṭamena pūrṇatvaṃ kṣudviparyayaḥ |
jāyate navamenātha daśamena tathā kramāt ||
ādityapurāṇe |
prathame ’hani yaḥ piṇḍas tena mūrddhā prajāyate |
cakṣuṣī śrotranāsaṃ ca dvitīye ’hani jāyate ||
bhujau vakṣas tathā grīvā tṛtīye ’hani jāyate |
hṛdayaṃ kukṣir udaraṃ prāṇasthānaṃ caturguṇam ||
kaṭisthānaṃ gudaṃ snigdhaṃ pañcame ’hani jāyate |
ūrū ṣaṣṭhe tu vijñeyau saptame ’ṅgulayas tathā ||
pādau tu navame jñeyau daśame vīryacakṣuṣī |
[1597] ādau vigraham utpannaṃ tathā caiva śubhāśubham ||
daśāhe pretapiṇḍena jñānaṃ preteṣu jāyate |
daśāhe kriyate yasmāt nāmādigrahaṇakriyā ||
saṃbhavaṃ nāmamātreṇa nāmato jīvasaṃjñakam |
nāmamātrapratiṣṭhā tu avinaṣṭe vidur budhāḥ ||
atha pretaśrāddhānāṃ prayogaḥ |
tatra tāvan navasaṃjñakānāṃ eṣāṃ ca saṃkhyādhikārakālāḥ pūrvam eva pratipāditāḥ | prayojanaṃ tv āha vyāghrapāt |
deyāni veśmaśuddhyarthaṃ navaśrāddhāni yatnataḥ |
tataḥ pretaviśuddhyarthaṃ mṛtāhani tu vatsaram ||
'tataḥ' iti navaśrāddhottarakālam | māsi māsi mṛtāhe yāvat saṃvatsaraṃ pretatvavimuktyarthaṃ śrāddhāni deyānīty arthaḥ |
vṛddhavasiṣṭhas tv āha |
alabdhvā tu navaśrāddhaṃ pretatvāt tu na mucyate |
arvāk tu dvādaśāhasya labdhvā tarati duṣkṛtam ||
anena navaśrāddhānām api pretatvavimuktiḥ prayojanam ity uktaṃ bhavati | 'duṣkṛtaṃ' pretatvahetubhūtaṃ, dvādaśāhasyārvāk mṛtāham ārabhyaikādaśāhāntaṃ śrāddhāni labdhvā tarati | anena dvādaśāhāt pūrvaṃ kriyamāṇānāṃ śrāddhānāṃ navaśrāddhasaṃjñakatvam api gamyate |
pretaśrāddheṣv adatteṣu pretatvamuktir na bhavatīty āha yamaḥ |
yasyaitāni na dattāni ekoddiṣṭāni ṣoḍaśa |
piśācatvaṃ sthiraṃ tasya dattaiḥ śrāddhaśatair api ||
[1598] 'piśācatvaṃ' pretaśabdavācyaprāṇirūpatvam |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe tv adhogatinivṛttiprayojanam uktam |
navaśrāddhaṃ tripakṣaṃ ca ṣaṇmāsaṃ māsikāni ca |
na karoti suto yas tu tasyādhaḥ pitaro gatāḥ ||
tathottaraśrāddhādhikāro ’py eṣāṃ prayojanam ity api tatraivoktam |
navaśrāddhādiśrāddhāni na kṛtāni tu yasya vai |
nādhikārī bhavet tatra māsaṣaṇmāsikābdike ||
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
navaśrāddhāni kurvīta pretoddeśena yatnataḥ |
ekoddiṣṭavidhānena nānyathā tu kadācana ||
āha chāgaleyaḥ |
śāve tu sūtakaṃ cet syān niśāśauce tathaiva ca |
navaśrāddhāni deyāni yathākālaṃ yathākramam ||
atra kramakālau pūrvam eva kālaprakaraṇe darśitau | navaśrāddheṣu keṣāṃcit padārthānām ananuṣṭhānam uktaṃ gṛhyapariśiṣṭe |
anudakam adhūpaṃ ca gandhamālyavivarjitam |
navaśrāddham amantraṃ ca piṇḍodakavivarjitam ||
'anudakaṃ' anarghyapiṇḍodakam avanejanapariṣecanarūpam |
tathā |
ekoddiṣṭeṣu sarveṣu na svadhā nābhiramyatām |
nāgnaukaraṇamantraś ca ekaṃ cātha tilodakam |
anūddiśya tu pretāya sarvatraiva pradīyate (?) ||
[1599] anapatyeṣu sarveṣu na svadhā nābhiramyatām |
svasty astu visṛjed evaṃ sakṛt praṇavavarjitam ||
ekoddiṣṭasya piṇḍe tu anuśabdo na vidyate |
pitṛśabdaṃ na kurvīta pitṛhā copajāyate ||
sapiṇḍīkaraṇāt prāktanaikoddiṣṭaviṣayam etad iti bahubhir vyākhyātam | pretāyety anena pretaśabdo ’tra prayoktavyo na tu pitṛśabda ity uktaṃ bhavati |
āpastambaḥ |
naimittikaṃ śrāddhaṃ bahir grāmāt śucayaḥ śucau deśe saṃskurvanti | tatra navāni dravyāṇi yair annaṃ saṃskriyate yeṣu ca bhujyate tāni bhuktavadbhyo dadyāt samuditāṃś ca bhojayen na tāvadguṇāyocchiṣṭaṃ prayacched evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ teṣām uttamalohenājena kāryaṃ mānaṃ ca kārayet praticchanne tasyottarārdhe brāhmaṇān bhojayed ubhayān paśyati brāhmaṇāṃś ca bhuñjānān ātmaneva pitṝn ity upadiśanti | kṛtākṛtām ata ūrdhvaṃ śrāddhena tṛptiṃ hi vedayanti pitaraḥ |
naimittikaśabdena pretaśrāddhāny ucyante |
ata evāha gālavaḥ |
dāhād ārabhya dātavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ naimittikaṃ budhaiḥ |
niyamād vatsaraṃ yāvad iti gālavabhāṣitam ||
navaśrāddhaśeṣam annaṃ yajamānenānyena vā na bhoktavyam iti |
āha aṅgirāḥ |
navaśrāddheṣu yac chiṣṭaṃ gṛhe paryuṣitaṃ ca yat |
dampatyor bhuktaśiṣṭaṃ ca tan na bhuñjīta karhicit ||
kā tarhi navaśrāddhe śeṣasya pratipattiḥ kartavyā ity apekṣāyām āha devalaḥ |
[1600] ekoddiṣṭeṣu śeṣaṃ tu brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samutsṛjet |
tataḥ kāmaṃ tu bhuñjīta svayaṃ maṅgalabhojane ||
navaśrāddhasaṃjñakeṣv ekoddiṣṭeṣu śeṣaṃ śrāddhabhoktṛbhyo brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samarpayet | tadanujñayā jalādau vā prakṣipet na tu svayaṃ bhuñjīta na cānyaṃ kam api bhojayet | ‘tataḥ' tadanantaraṃ kriyamāṇe, 'maṅgalabhojane' sāṃvatsarikādau, śrāddhaśeṣaṃ jñātyādīn bhojayet | svayaṃ ca yajamāno bhuñjīta | śrāddhaśeṣād anyenānnena tu jñātidīnānāthādayo bhojanīyāḥ | tathā ca navaśrāddhāny abhidhāyoktaṃ brahmapurāṇe |
kartavyaṃ tu naraiḥ śrāddhaṃ deśakālānurodhataḥ |
sapiṇḍās tu sajātīyās tathānye ’pi bubhukṣitāḥ |
dīnānāthāś ca kṛpaṇās tathānnam upabhuñjate ||
ajñātinā tu bhukte ’sminn anne prāyaścittam apy atraivoktam |
dvābhyāṃ tu taptakṛcchrābhyāṃ śuddhiḥ syāt tu vivekinām |
tṛtīye pañcame snānaṃ kartavyaṃ navame tathā |
iti navasaṃjñakānāṃ śrāddhānāṃ prayogaḥ |
athaikādaśādhikānāṃ śrāddhānāṃ prayogaḥ |
tatra kūrmapurāṇe |
ekādaśe ’hni kurvīta pretam uddiśya bhāvataḥ |
dvādaśe vāhni kartavyaṃ anindye 'py atha vāhani ||
ekaṃ pavitram eko ’rghyaḥ piṇḍapātraṃ tathaiva ca |
[1601] evaṃ mṛtāhni kartavyaṃ pratimāsaṃ tu vatsaram ||
padmapurāṇe |
tatas tv ekādaśāhe tu dvijān ekādaśaiva tu |
gotrādisūtakānte ca bhojayed ayujo dvijān ||
dvitīye ’hni punas tadvad ekoddiṣṭaṃ samācaret |
āvāhanāgnaukaraṇadaivahīnaṃ vidhānataḥ ||
ekaṃ pavitram eko ’rghyaḥ ekaḥ piṇḍo vidhīyate |
upatiṣṭhantāṃ ta iti deyaṃ paścāt tilodakam ||
svaditaṃ dvikare brūyād visarge cābhiramyatām |
śeṣaṃ pūrvavad atrāpi kāryaṃ vedavido viduḥ |
anena vidhinā sarvam anumāsaṃ samācaret ||
brahmapurāṇe |
tṛtīye ’hani kartavyaṃ pretadāhāvanau dvijaḥ |
sūtakānte gṛhe śrāddham ekoddiṣṭaṃ pracakṣate ||
dvādaśe ’hani māse ca tripakṣe ca tataḥ param |
māsi māsi tu kartavyaṃ yāvad āvatsaraṃ dvija ||
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
mṛtāhani tu kartavyam ekoddiṣṭaṃ śṛṇuṣva tat |
devahīnaṃ tathaikārghyaṃ tathaivaikapavitrakam ||
āvāhanaṃ na kartavyam agnaukaraṇavarjitam |
pretasya piṇḍam ekaṃ ca dadyād ucchiṣṭasaṃnidhau ||
tilodakaṃ cāpasavyaṃ tannāmasmaraṇānvitam |
[1602] akṣayyam amukasyeti sthāne caivopatiṣṭhatām ||
iti brūyāt prayatnena kartā vipravisarjane |
abhiramyatām iti brūyāt brūyus te ’bhiratāḥ sma ca |
pratimāsaṃ bhaved etat kāryam āvatsarān naraiḥ ||
baudhāyanasūtre |
athaikoddiṣṭeṣu nāgnaukaraṇaṃ nātiśrayaṇaṃ na pūrvaṃ na daivaṃ na dhūpaṃ na dīpaṃ na svadhānamaskārau nātrāpūpaṃ sarvaṃ siddhaṃ samānīyāyugmān brāhmaṇān suprakṣālitapāṇipādān apa ācamayya darbhopakḷpteṣv āsaneṣu upaveśya sarvasmāt sakṛt sakṛt samavadāyābhighārya dakṣiṇato bhasmamiśrānaṅgārān nirūhya teṣu juhuyāt | pretāyāmuṣmai yamāya svāheti taddhutam ahutaṃ ca havaty amuṣmai tṛptir astv ity apāṃ pratigrahaṇaṃ visarjanaṃ cāmuṣmā upatiṣṭhaty anuddiśya yeṣv eva piṇḍadānaṃ tṛpyasveti saṃkṣālanaṃ tṛptir astv iti visṛjet | namo ’stu tṛptir itītareṣāṃ prativacanaṃ pretasya dvitīyāprabhṛtibrāhmaṇair ekottaravṛddhir ādaśāhād atra navaṃ vicchidyataikādaśyāṃ śrāddhaṃ tṛtīye pakṣe dvitīyaṃ santatam ekaikenaikādaśamāsān nayanti taddvādaśamāsam abhyārohati |
baudhāyanaḥ |
ekoddiṣṭaṃ śva eva syād dvādaśe’ hani vā punaḥ |
atha vorddhvam ayugme tu kurvītāha svaśaktitaḥ ||
arddhamāse ’tha māse vā ṛtau saṃvatsare ’pi vā |
nimantraṇaṃ tu pūrvedyur daivam agnaukṛtis tathā ||
na svadhāśrāvaṇāpūpadhūpadīpau namaṣkṛtiḥ
[1603] agniṃ samṛdhya paryukṣya paristīrya ca sādayet ||
darvīm audumbarīm ājyasthālīṃ ca sruvam eva ca |
pātrīṃ ca prokṣaṇīṃ caiva tilodakavaraṃ tathā ||
prokṣyaitat sadviśeṣānnam ānīyājyaṃ nirūpya ca |
adhiśritya ca paryagniṃ kṛtvā tad ubhayaṃ tataḥ ||
sruvandarvī ca saṃmṛjya tv annam udvāsya ghāritam |
kṛtvā tilodakaṃ puṃsāṃ strīṇāṃ coditamantravat ||
pitṛśabde kṣipet pretaṃ svadhāvarjaṃ tu sarvataḥ |
pretam āvāhya viprāṃś cāpy upaveśya nimantrya ca ||
amuṣmai tṛptir astv evaṃ tilodakam ihārpayet |
tṛptir astv iti cānyo ’pi brūyād datvāpy alaṃkṛte ||
kariṣyāmīty anujñāya kuruṣveti ca coditaḥ |
upastīryātha darvyāṃ tu sarvānnebhyaḥ sakṛt sakṛt ||
abhighāryātha juhuyād aṅgārān bhasmamiśritān |
pṛthag dakṣiṇataḥ kṛtvā pretāyetyādinā tataḥ ||
api mṛśyānnam ūhitvā nikṣipyānudiśet tataḥ |
amunā upatiṣṭhantv ity atha mantraiḥ samīkṣya tān ||
bhuktvācānteṣu kṛtvā ca svaditaṃ ca tilodakam |
vikīryotsicya datvā ca dakṣiṇām udite kṣaye ||
abhivādya tu tān brūyāt tṛptir astv iti te ’pi ca |
astu tṛptir iti brūyur anujñānāntam ācaret ||
anujñāto ’nnaśeṣeṇa piṇḍaṃ datvā prasicya ca |
[1604] tṛpyasvety etam ādāya piṇḍam ucchiṣṭam eva ca ||
apām ante tad utsṛjya snātvā gacched gṛhān prati |
puṇyāhamuktadīpaṃ ca pūrṇakumbhādimaṅgalam ||
gṛhadvāre sa dṛṣṭvānnaṃ śeṣaṃ bhuñjīta kāmataḥ |
kṣatriyasnātamātras tu spṛśed vāhanam āhitam ||
vaiśyaḥ pratodaṃ rasmiṃ vā yaṣṭiṃ śūdraḥ kṛtakriyaḥ |
aikoddiṣṭānta evāyaṃ saṃskartā mucyate tv aghāt ||
tṛtīye pakṣa āyāte kuryad eva dvitīyakam |
māsi māsi ca kāmaṃ tu naṣṭe pūrṇe kathaṃcana |
vatsare vatsare kecit kurvate ’sya mṛtāhani ||
bṛhatpracetāḥ |
na paitṛko japaḥ kāryaḥ svaditaṃ ca nodāharet |
bahvṛcagṛhyapariśiṣṭe |
ekoddiṣṭapiṇḍe anuśabdo na vidyate pitṛśabdaṃ na kurvīteti |
bhṛguḥ | (?)
ekoddiṣṭe kuśāḥ samūlā iti sakṛdācchinnaniṣedhaḥ | avanejanaṃ pratyavanejanaṃ kuryāt | dhūpacandanamālyādi ca na kuryāt,
anūdakamadhūpañca gandhamālyavivarjitam |
navaśrāddham amantraṃ ca piṇḍodakavivarjitam ||
iti vacanāt | śeṣam annam iti vacanāt śeṣam annam iti ca na vaktavyam | śeṣam api tasmai dadyād apsu vā prāsyet nānyena bhoktavyam | ekādaśāhe sāgnikenāpi vaiśvadevaḥ paścāt kartavyaḥ |
tathā ca pariśiṣṭam |
[1605] saṃprāpte pārvaṇaśrāddha ekoddiṣṭe tathaiva ca |
agrato vaiśvadevaḥ syāt paścād ekādaśe ’hani ||
tathā ca śayyādidāne viśeṣaḥ, yathāha satyavrataḥ |
sadyaḥśauce ’pi dātavyaṃ pretasyaikādaśe ’hani |
sa eva divasas tasya śrāddhaśayyāsanādiṣu ||
tac chrāddhaṃ na kevalaṃ brāhmaṇasyaikādaśe ’hni api tu kṣatriyāder apy asyādyaśrāddhasyāyam eva kālaḥ |
tathā ca paiṭhīnasiḥ |
ekādaśe ’hni yac chrāddhaṃ tat sāmānyam udāhṛtam |
caturṇām api varṇānāṃ sūtakaṃ tu pṛthak pṛthak || iti ||
na ca kṣatriyāder aśucitvena tatra śrāddhānadhikāra ity āśaṅkanīyaṃ, aśuddhasyāpy ayaṃ vācaniko ’dhikāra iti |
tathā ca śaṅkhaḥ |
ādyaṃ śrāddham aśuddho 'pi kuryād ekādaśe ’hani |
kartus tātkālikī śuddhir aśuddhaḥ punar eva saḥ || iti ||
'ādyam' iti sarvaikoddiṣṭaprakṛtibhūtam ekādaśāhākhyam ity arthaḥ |
etacchrāddhānantaraṃ snātvā bhuñjateti |
tathānye viśeṣāḥ |
āśiṣo dviguṇā dabhā jayāśīḥ svastivācanam |
pitṛśabdaś ca saṃbandhaḥ śarmaśabdas tathaiva ca ||
āvāhaḥ pātralambhaś ca ulmukollekhanādikam |
[1606] tṛptapraśnaś ca vikaraḥ śeṣapraśnas tathaiva ca ||
pradakṣiṇavisargaś ca sīmāntaṃ gamanaṃ tathā |
aṣṭādaśapadārthāṃs tu pretaśrāddhe vivarjayet ||
manuḥ |
asapiṇḍakriyākarma dvijātaiḥ saṃsthitasya tu |
adaivaṃ bhojayec chrāddhaṃ piṇḍam ekaṃ tu kārayet ||
yājñavalkyaḥ |
ekoddiṣṭaṃ daivahīnam ekārghyekapavitrakam |
āvāhanāgnaukaraṇavarjitaṃ hy apasavyavat ||
upatiṣṭhatām akṣayyasthāne vipravisarjane |
abhiramyatām iti vaded brūyus te’ bhiratāḥ sma ha ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
athaikoddiṣṭam eko ’rghya ekaṃ pavitram ekaḥ piṇḍo nāvāhanaṃ nāgnaukaraṇaṃ nātra viśvedevāḥ svaditam iti tṛptapraśnaḥ upatiṣṭatām ity akṣayyasthāne 'bhiramyatām iti visargo 'bhiratāḥ sma itītare |
sāṅkhyāyanaḥ |
athāta ekoddiṣṭam ekapavitram ekārghyam ekaṃ piṇḍaṃ nāvāhanaṃ nāgnaukaraṇaṃ nātra viśvedevā svaditam iti tṛptipraśnaḥ upatiṣṭhatām akṣayyasthāne abhiramyatām iti visargaḥ saṃvatsaram evaṃ prete |
'ekaṃ pavitraṃ' ekaśikhaṃ pavitram |
nāgarakhaṇḍe tu dviśikham apy uktam |
ekoddiṣṭaṃ daivahīnam ekārghyaikapavitrakam |
[1607] āvāhanaṃ parityakaṃ kāryaṃ pārthivasattama ||
tṛptipraśnas tathā kāryaḥ svaditeti sakṛt tataḥ |
abhiramyeti mantreṇa brāhmaṇasya visarjanam ||
acchinnāgram abhinnāgraṃ kuryād darbhatṛṇadvayam |
pavitraṃ tad vijānīyād ekoddiṣṭe vidhīyate ||
bhaviṣyottare |
ekādaśāhe yac chrāddhaṃ tat sāmānyam udāhṛtam |
ekādaśebhyo viprebhyo dadyād ekādaśe ’hani ||
bhojanaṃ tatra caikasmai brāhmaṇāya mahātmane |
vastrālaṃkāraśayyāḍhyaṃ pitur yad vāhanādikam |
gogṛhāsanadāsīs tu dadyāt saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ ||
vārāhapurāṇe |
ekādaśāhe kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ pretāya yatnataḥ |
śvaḥ kariṣya iti jñātvā brāhmaṇamantraṇakriyā ||
snātvā caiva śucir bhūtvā pretaṃ vipreṣu yojayet |
gato ’si divyalokaṃ tvaṃ kṛtāntavihitāt pathaḥ ||
manasā vāyubhūtena vipre tvāhaṃ niyojaye |
pūjayiṣyāmi bhogena evaṃ vipraṃ nimantrayet ||
astaṃ gate tathāditye gatvā vipraniveśanam |
datvā tu pādyaṃ vidhivat namaskṛtya dvijottamān ||
pādau saṃsrakṣya tailena pretasya hitakāmyayā |
prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryām udite ca divākare ||
[1608] śmaśrukarma tu kartavyaṃ nakhachedas tathaiva ca |
snapanābhyañjanaṃ dadyād viprāya vidhipūrvakam ||
gṛhītvā bhūmibhāgaṃ ca sthaṇḍilaṃ tadanantaram |
nipānadeśaṃ saṃgṛhya kartavyaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ mahat |
nadīkule nivāse vā pretabhūmiṃ vinirdiśet ||
akṛtvā pṛthivībhāgaṃ nivāpaṃ ye tu kurvate |
tadadhīnaṃ jagad bhadre taducchiṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet ||
na devāḥ pitaras tasya gṛhṇantīha kadācana |
patanti niraye ghore tenocchiṣṭena sundari ||
sacelaṃ snapanaṃ kṛtvā gatvā caiva mahānadīm |
tīrthāni manasā dhyātvā taiḥ svam abhyukṣayed budhaḥ ||
evaṃ śuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā brāhmaṇaṃ śīghram ānayet |
āgataṃ ca dvijaṃ dṛṣṭvā kartavyā svāgatakriyā ||
arghyaṃ pādyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā hṛṣṭatuṣṭena mādhavi |
āsanaṃ copakalpeta mantreṇa vidhipūrvakam ||
tathā |
upaveśyāsane bhadre chatraṃ tatra prakalpayet |
āvaraṇārthaṃ tac chatraṃ brāhmaṇāya pradīyate ||
paścād upānahau dadyāt pādasparśakare śubhe |
saṃtaptavālukāṃ bhūmim ahikaṇṭakitāṃ tathā ||
saṃtārayati durgāṇi pretaṃ dadad upānahau |
tilopacāraṃ kṛtvā tu viprāya niyatātmavān ||
[1609] nāmagotram udāhṛtya pretāya tadanantaram |
śīghram āhvānayed bhūmiṃ darbhahasto ’tha bhūtale ||
mantraḥ |
ihalokaṃ parityajya gato ’si paramāṃ gatim |
evam āhvānite gandhapuṣpadhūpaiḥ samarcayet ||
tato vastrāṇi viprāya sarvāṇy ābharaṇāni ca |
tataḥ pakvānnakaṃ caiva kalpayec caiva sundari ||
evamādīni dravyāṇi pretabhāgāni sarvaśaḥ |
pādaśaucāditaḥ kṛtvā cāturvarṇasya mādhavi ||
bṛhaspatiḥ |
ekoddiṣṭavidhānena yadaikasya pradīyate |
āvāhanāgnaukaraṇavarjitaṃ daivavarjitam ||
vastrālaṃkāraśayyāḍhyaṃ pitur yad vāhanāyudham |
gandhamālyaiḥ samabhyarcya śrāddhabhoktre tad arpayet ||
bhojanaṃ cānekavidhaṃ kārayet vyañjanāni ca |
yathāśakti pradadyāc ca gobhūhemādikaṃ tathā ||
śrotriyā bhojanīyās tu nava sapta trayodaśa |
jñātayo bāndhavā vāpi tathā vātithayo ’pare ||
pradadyād dakṣiṇāṃ teṣāṃ sarveṣām anurūpataḥ |
hatam aśrotriyaṃ śrāddhaṃ hato yajñas tv adakṣiṇaḥ ||
tasmāt paṇaṃ kākiṇīṃ vā phalaṃ puṣpam athāpi vā |
pradadyād dakṣiṇāṃ yajñe tayā śataguṇo bhavet ||
[1610] satyavrataḥ |
prātar utthāya pretabrāhmaṇān ekādaśāmantrya parāhṇe nānābhakṣānnarasavinyāsaiḥ ekaikam uddiśya vidhivat piṇḍadānaṃ vāso hiraṇyadāsyupānacchatrodakumbhadakṣiṇā guṇavati pātre śayyāpradānaṃ tataḥ svastyayanādidharmāḥ pravartante | daśamyām atītāyām ekaikam uddiśya bhojayet teṣām evaikasmai guṇavate śayyā deyā |
viṣṇuḥ |
athāśaucavyapagameṣu snātaḥ suprakṣālitapāṇipādaḥ svācāntas tv evaṃvidhān eva brāhmaṇān yathāśakty udaṅmukhān gandhamālyavastrālaṃkārādibhiḥ pūjitān bhojayed ekavan mantrān ūhetaikoddiṣṭa ucchiṣṭasaṃnidhāv ekam eva tannāmagotrābhyāṃ piṇḍaṃ nirvapet | bhuktavatsu brāhmaṇeṣu dakṣiṇayābhipūjiteṣu pretanāmagotrābhyāṃ dattākṣayyodakeṣu caturaṅgulapṛthvīs tāvadantarās tāvadadhaḥkhātā vitastyāyatās tisraḥ karṣūḥ kuryāt | karṣūṇāṃ samīpe cāgnitrayam upasamādhāya paristīrya tatraikasminn āhutitrayaṃ juhuyāt | somāya pitṛmate svadhā namaḥ agnaye kavyavāhanāya svadhā namaḥ yamāyāṅgirasvate svadhā namaḥ | sthānatraye prāgvat piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kuryāt | tato dadhimadhughṛtamāṃsaiḥ karṣūtrayaṃ pūrayitvaitat ta iti japet | evaṃ mṛtāhe pratimāsaṃ kuryāt |
laghuhārītaḥ |
ekoddiṣṭaṃ prakurvīta pākenaiva sadā svayam |
abhāve pākamātrāṇāṃ tadahaḥ samupoṣaṇam ||
ity ekādaśāhikādīnāṃ śrāddhānāṃ prayogaḥ |
[1611]
atha mṛtaśayyādānavidhiḥ |
sa ca jīvacchayyādānetikartavyatātideśaparipūraṇīya iti tatpūrvako ’bhidhīyate |
tatra bhaviṣyottare |
śayyādānaṃ pravakṣyāmi tubhyaṃ yadukulodvaha |
yāṃ datvā śivabhāgī syād iha loke paratra ca ||
śayyādānaṃ praśaṃsanti sarve devadvijottamāḥ |
anityaṃ jīvitaṃ yasmāt paścāt ko ’nyaḥ pradāsyati ||
tasmāt sabandhuḥ sapitā yāvaj jīvati bhārata |
mṛtomṛta iti jñātvā kṣaṇāt sneho nivartate ||
tasmāt svayaṃ pradātavyaṃ śayyābhojyajalādikam |
ātmaiva hy ātmano bandhur iti saṃcinya cetasi ||
ātmaiva yadi cātmānaṃ dānair bhogair na pūjayet |
ko ’nyo hi itaras tasmād yaḥ paścāt pūjayiṣyati ||
tasmāc chayyāṃ samāsādya sāradārumayīṃ dṛḍhāṃ |
dantapatrānvitāṃ ramyāṃ hemapaṭṭair alaṃkṛtām ||
haṃsatūlīpraticchannāṃ śubhagaṇḍopadhānakām |
pracchādanapaṭīyuktāṃ gandhadhūpādhivāsitām ||
tasyāṃ saṃsthāpayed dhaimaṃ hariṃ lakṣmyā samanvitam |
ucchīrṣake ghṛtabhṛtaṃ kalaśaṃ parikalpayet ||
vijñeyaḥ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha sanidrākalaśo budhaiḥ |
[1612] tāmbūlakuṅkumakṣodakarpūrāgurucandanam ||
dīpikopānahacchatraṃ cāmarāsanabhājanam |
pārśveṣu sthāpayed bhaktyā saptadhānyāni caiva hi ||
śayanasthasya bhavati yad anyad upakārakam |
bhṛṅgārakarakāḍhyaṃ tu pañcavarṇaṃ vināyakam ||
śayyām evaṃvidhāṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇāya pradāpayet |
sapatnīkāya saṃpūjya pūṇye ’hni vidhipūrvakam ||
yathā na kṛṣṇaśayanaṃ śūnyaṃ sāgarajātayā |
śayyā mamāpy aśūnyāstu tathā janmani janmani ||
yasmād aśūnyaṃ śayanaṃ keśavasya śivasya ca |
śayyā mamāpy aśūnyāstu tathā janmani janmani ||
datvaivaṃ tasya sakalaṃ praṇipatya visarjayet |
evaṃ śayyāpradāne tu vidhir eṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
ekādaśāhe ’pi tathā vidhir eṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
dadāti yadi dharmārthaṃ bāndhavo bāndhave mṛte ||
viśeṣaṃ cātra rājendra kathyamānaṃ niśāmaya |
tenopabhuktaṃ yat kiṃcit kiṃcit pūrvaṃ gṛhe sthitam ||
tadgātralagnaṃ ca tathā vastravāhanabhājanam |
yad yad iṣṭaṃ ca tasya syāt tat sarvaṃ parikalpayet ||
tam eva puruṣaṃ haimaṃ tasyāṃ saṃsthāpayet tadā |
pūjayitvā pradātavyā mṛtaśayyāṃ yathoditā ||
padmapurāṇe |
mṛtakānte dvitīye ’hni śayyāṃ dadyād vilakṣaṇām |
kāñcanaṃ puruṣaṃ tadvat phalavastrasamanvitam ||
saṃpūjya dvijadampatyaṃ nānābharaṇabhūṣitam |
upaveśya tu śayyāyāṃ madhuparkaṃ tato vadet ||
rajatasya tu pātreṇa dadhidugdhasamanvitam |
asthi lālāṭaṃ saṃgṛhya sūkṣma kṛtvā savajrakam ||
pāyasair dvijadampatyaṃ nānābharaṇabhūṣitam |
bhojayet prayataḥ prājño vidhir eṣaḥ sanātanaḥ |
eṣa eva vidhir dṛṣṭaḥ pārvatīyair dvijottamaiḥ ||
śayyāyāṃ brāhmaṇopaveśanavidhir brāhmaṇakartavyaṃ ca vārāhapurāṇe |
saṃgṛhya pāṇinā pāṇau mantreṇotthāpayed dvijam |
dadyāc chayyāsanaṃ caiva tathaivāñjanakaṅkatīm ||
añjanakaṅkatīṃ gṛhya śayyām ākramya sa dvijaḥ |
muhūrtaṃ tatra viśramya nivāpasthānam āgatam |
gavāṃ lāṅgūlam āśritya brāhmaṃ hastaṃ samādadet ||
śayyādānaphalaṃ tu bhaviṣyottare |
svarge purandaragṛhe sūryaputrālaye tathā |
sukhaṃ vasaty asau jantuḥ śayyādānaprabhāvataḥ ||
sūryaputrālaye caiva tathā vaivasvate pure |
pīḍayanti na taṃ yāmyāḥ puruṣā bhīṣaṇānanāḥ ||
na gharmeṇa na śītena bādhyate sa naraḥ kvacit |
[1614] api pāpasamāyuktaḥ svargalokaṃ sa gacchati ||
vimānavaram ārūḍhaḥ sevyamāno ’psarogaṇaiḥ |
ābhūtasaṃplamaṃ yāvat tiṣṭhaty ātaṅkavarjitaḥ ||
śayyāpradānam amalaṃ tava pāṇḍuputra
saṃkīrtitaṃ sakalasaukhyanidhānabhūtam |
yo vai dadāti vidhinā sa hi viṣṇuloke
kalpaṃ vikalparahitaḥ sa vibhāti martyaḥ ||
atra prasaṅgān mṛtaśayyāpratigrahaniṣedho ’bhidhīyate padmapurāṇe |
atiduṣṭā pretaśayyā na grāhyā dvijasattamaiḥ |
gṛhītāyāṃ tu tasyāṃ tu punaḥ saṃskāram arhati ||
vede caiva purāṇe ca śayyā sarvatra garhitā |
grahītāras tu jāyante sarve nirayagāminaḥ ||
iti śayyādānavidhiḥ |
ekādaśāhād ārabhya| saṃvatsaraparyantaṃ pratidinaṃ pretāyodakumbho dātavyaḥ |

āha hārītaḥ |
mṛte pitari vai putraḥ piṇḍaṃ medhyaṃ samāvapet |
annakumbhaṃ ca viprāya pretanirdeśadharmataḥ ||

aha āpastambaḥ |

ity udakumbhaḥ |
atha vṛṣotsargaḥ |
tatra tāvad asya vidhikāladeśāḥ iha caikādaśe ’hani pramītamanuṣyoddeśena vṛṣotsargaḥ kāryam ity uktaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
ekādaśāhe pretasya yasya notsṛjyate vṛṣaḥ |
piśācatvaṃ sthiraṃ tasya dattaiḥ śrāddhaśatair api ||
bhaviṣyottare tu dvādaśe ’hani vṛṣotsargo ’bhihitaḥ |
[1616] kārttikyām atha vāmāvāsyām ayane vā yudhiṣṭhira |
caitryāṃ vāpi tṛtīyāyāṃ vaiśākhyāṃ dvādaśe ’hni vā ||
viṣṇudharmottare tu yasmin kasmiṃścin mṛtāhe ’pi vṛṣotsargo ’bhihitaḥ |
aśvayuk śuklapakṣasya pañcadaśyāṃ narādhipa |
kārtike ’py atha vā māsi vṛṣotsargaṃ tu kārayet ||
grahaṇe dve mahāmukhye tathā caivāyanadvaye |
viṣuvaddvitaye caiva mṛtāhe bāndhavasya ca |
utsṛjen nīlakaṇṭhaṃ vai kaumudyāḥ samupāgame ||
'nīlakaṇṭhaḥ’ nīlavṛṣaḥ | 'kaumudī' aśvinakārtikayoḥ paurṇamāsī | pitrādyuddeśena vṛṣotsargam akurvāṇasya nindā matsyapurāṇe |
na karoti vṛṣotsargaṃ sutīrthe vā jalāñjalim |
na dadāti suto yas tu pitur uccāra eva saḥ ||
'uccāraḥ’ purīṣotsargaḥ | atra nīlasaṃjñakaḥ sarvottamo vṛṣaḥ |
vṛṣotsargapradeśā devīpurāṇe |
sa tv araṇye bhavet tīrthe utsargo gokule ’pi vā |
brahmapurāṇe |
prāgudakpravaṇe deśe manojñe nirjane vane
vṛṣotsargaḥ kārya iti śeṣaḥ |
kālikāpurāṇe |
araṇye catvare vāpi goṣṭhe vā mocayed vṛṣam |

iti vṛṣotsargavidhikāladeśāḥ |

dhenum ādau parīkṣeta suśīlāṃ lakṣaṇānvitām |
avyaṅgām aparikliṣṭāṃ jīvavatsām arogiṇīm ||

āvartair dakṣiṇāvartair yuktā dakṣiṇataś ca yā |

mṛdusaṃhatatāmroṣṭhī raktajihvā supūjitā |
aśyāvadīrghāsphuṭitaraktajihvā tathā ca yā ||

vaidūryamadhuvarṇaiś ca jalabududasaṃnibhaiḥ ||
raktasnigdhaiś ca nayanais tathā raktakanīlakaiḥ |
sapta caturdaśadantā bhaved aśyāvatālukā ||
ṣaḍunnatā supārśvoruḥ pṛthupañcasamāyatā |
aṣṭāyatā śirogrīvāyutā yā śubhalakṣaṇā ||
ṣaḍunnatā bhavet keṣu keṣu pañcasu cāyatā |
āyatāś ca tathaivāṣṭau dhenūnāṃ ke śubhāvahāḥ ||
matsya uvāca |
[1618] uraḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ śiraḥ kukṣī śroṇī ca vasudhādhipa |
ṣaḍ unnatāni dhenūnāṃ pūjayanti vicakṣaṇāḥ ||
karṇau netre lalāṭaṃ ca pañcaiva ratinandana |
samāyatāni śasyante pucchaṃ sāmnā ca sakthinī ||
catvāraś ca stanā rājann evam aṣṭau manīṣibhiḥ
śirogrīvāyutā caiva bhūmipālāyatā bhṛśam ||
tasyāḥ sutaṃ parīkṣeta vṛṣabhaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam |
unnataskandhakakudam ṛjulāṅgūlakambalam ||
mahākaṭitaṭaskandhaṃ vaidūryamaṇilocanam |
pravālavarṇaśṛṅgāgraṃ sudīrghamṛdubāladhim ||
navāṣṭadaśasaṃkhyair vā tīkṣṇāgrair daśanaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
mallikākṣaś ca moktavyo gṛhe ’pi dhanadhānyadaḥ ||
varṇatas tāmrakapilo brāhmaṇasya praśasyate |
śveto raktaś ca kṛṣṇaś ca gauraḥ pāṭala eva ca ||
indranīlābhapṛṣṭhaś ca śabalaḥ pañcakālakaḥ |
pṛthukarṇo mahāskandhaḥ ślakṣṇaromā ca yo bhavet ||
raktākṣaḥ kapilo yaś ca raktaśṛṅgaś ca yo bhavet |
śvetodaraḥ kṛṣṇapṛṣṭho brāhmaṇasya ca śasyate ||
snigdho raktena varṇena kṣatriyasya praśasyate |
kāñcanābhena vaiśyasya kṛṣṇenāpy antyajanmanaḥ ||
yasya prāgāyate śṛṅge svamukhābhimukhe sadā |
sarveṣām eva varṇānāṃ sa ca sarvārthasādhakaḥ ||
[1619] mārjārapādaḥ kapilo dhanyaḥ kapilapiṅgalaḥ |
śveto mārjārapādas tu dhanyo maṇinibhekṣaṇaḥ ||

svacchapādaśirāś caiva dvipādaḥ śveta eva ca ||
kapiñjalanibho dhanyas tathā tittirasaṃnibhaḥ |
ākarṇamūlācchvetaṃ (?) tu mukhaṃ yasya prakāśate ||

vṛṣabhaḥ sa samudrākhyaḥ satataṃ kulavardhanaḥ |
mallikāpuṣpacitraś ca dhanyo bhavati puṅgavaḥ ||

atasīpuṣpavarṇaś ca tathā dhanyataraḥ smṛtaḥ |
ete dhanyās tathādhanyān kīrtayiṣyāmi te nṛpa ||
kṛṣṇatālvoṣṭhadaśanā rūkṣaśṛṅgaśaphāś ca ye |
avyaktavarṇā hrasvāś ca vyāghrabhasmanibhāś ca ye |
dhvāṅkṣagṛdhrasavarṇāś ca tathā mūṣakasaṃnibhāḥ |
kuṣṭhāḥ kāṇās tathā khañjāḥ kekarākṣās tathaiva ca ||
viṣamaśvetapādāś ca udbhrāntanayanās tathā |
na te vṛṣāḥ pramoktavyā na te dhāryās tathā gṛhe |
moktavyānāṃ ca dhāryāṇāṃ bhūyo vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam ||
svastikākāraśṛṅgāś ca meghaughasadṛśasvanāḥ |
mahāprāṇāś caiva tathā mattamātaṅgagāminaḥ ||

śvetāny etāni śasyante kṛṣṇasya tu viśeṣataḥ ||
bhūmau karṣati lāṅgūlaṃ susthūlā caiva bāladhiḥ |
purastād udyato nīlo vṛṣabhaś ca praśasyate ||
śaktidhvajapatākābhā yeṣāṃ rājī virājate |

ete dhāryāḥ prayatnena moktavyā yadi vā vṛṣāḥ |
