tyāgaḥ | eṣa pūrva āghāraḥ | tata indrāya svāhety agnau dakṣiṇato hutvā idam indrāyeti tyāgaḥ | eṣa uttara āghāraḥ | agnaye svāhety uttarapūrvārdhe hutvā idam agnaya iti tyāgaḥ | eṣa āgneya ājyabhāgaḥ | somāya svāheti dakṣiṇapūrvārdhe hutvā idaṃ somāyeti tyāgaḥ | eṣa saumya ājyabhāgaḥ | tadanantaram anvārabdhe pāyasena godhajñokadevatābhyo (?) homaḥ tad yathā oṃ agnaye svāhā | idam agnaye | oṃ rudrāya svāhā | idaṃ rudrāya | oṃ sarvāya svāhā | idaṃ sarvāya | oṃ paśupataye svāhā | idaṃ paśupataye | oṃ ugrāya svāhā | idam ugrāya | oṃ aśanaye svāhā | idam aśanaye | oṃ bhavāya svāhā | idaṃ bhavāya | oṃ mahādevāya svāhā | idaṃ mahādevāya | oṃ īśānāya svāhā | idaṃ īśānāya | atha pauṣṇacarorekāhutiḥ | pūṣā gā anvetu naḥ pūṣā ca rakṣatv arvataḥ pūṣā vājān sanotu naḥ | idaṃ pūṣṇe | atha brahmaṇānvārabdhe sviṣṭakṛn mahāvyāhṛtayaḥ sarvaprāyaścittaṃ prājāpatyaṃ caruṃ juhuyāt | tataḥ agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā | idam agnaye sviṣṭakṛte | [1625] iti pauṣṇapāyasābhyāṃ sviṣṭakṛddhomaḥ | mahāvyāhṛtyādihomas tv ājyena | oṃ bhūḥ svāhā | idam agnaye | oṃ bhuvaḥ svāhā | idaṃ vāyave | oṃ svaḥ svāhā | idaṃ sūryāya | iti tisro mahāvyāhṛtayaḥ | atha tvan no agna ityādibhiḥ svāhāntaiḥ pañcabhir mantraiḥ sarvaprāyaścittam | oṃ satvan no agne pramumugdhyasmat svāhā idam agnīvaruṇābhyām | oṃ sa tvaṃ no agne suhavo na edhi svāhā | idam agnīvaruṇābhyām | oṃ ayāś cāgne syanabhi bheṣajaṃ svāhā | idam agnaye | oṃ ye te śataṃ svarkāḥ svāhā | idaṃ varuṇāya savitre viṣṇave viśvebhyo devebhyo marudbhyaḥ svarkebhyaḥ | oṃ uduttamaṃ aditaye syāma svāhā | idaṃ varuṇāya | atha prājāpatyam | oṃ prajāpataye svāhā | idaṃ prajāpataye | tataḥ saṃśravaprāśanaṃ, mārjanaṃ, pavitrapratipattiḥ, dakṣiṇādānam iti | evaṃ homaṃ parisamāpya vṛṣasyāṅkanādikaṃ kuryāt |
tatrāha viṣṇuḥ |
gavāṃ madhye susamiddham agniṃ paristīrya pauṣṇaṃ caruṃ śrapayitvā pūṣābhigandhe numa iha ratir iti ca hutvā vṛṣabham ānīyāyaskaram āvāhayet |
'ayaskaraḥ' lohakāraḥ |
saurapurāṇe |
tato vṛṣabham ānīya agner uttarataḥ sthitam |
savyasphici likhec cakraṃ śūlaṃ vāhau tu dakṣiṇe ||
'savyasphici' vāmakaṭibhāge |
kuṅkumenāṅkayitvādau brāhmaṇaḥ susamāhitaḥ |
taptena dhātunā paścād ayaskāro ’ṅkayed vṛṣam ||
[1626] devīpurāṇe |
taptena vāmataś cakraṃ pārśve śūlaṃ samālikhet |
dhātunā hematāreṇa āyasenātha vāṅkayet ||
'hema' suvarṇaṃ' 'tāraṃ' rūpyaṃ, 'āyasaṃ' loham |
viṣṇuḥ |
ekasmin pārśve cakreṇāparasmin śūlenāṅkitaṃ ca 'hiraṇyavarṇeti' catasṛbhiḥ 'śan no devīr' iti ca snāpayet |
viṣṇudharmottare |
aṅkitaṃ snāpayet paścāt snāne tasya tathā paṭhet |
hiraṇyavarṇeti ṛcaś catasro manujeśvara |
āpohiṣṭheti tisraś ca śan no devīti cāpy atha ||
'hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā' ityādyāś catasro 'bhiṣecanīyā ṛco ’tharvavede prasiddhāḥ |
pāraskaraḥ |
akālamūlān kalaśān aṣṭau sragdāmabhūṣitān |
savastrāṃś ca saratnāṃś ca cūtapallavaśobhitān ||
sthāpayitvā caturbhis tu saṃsnāpyo vṛṣabhaḥ puraḥ |
caturbhir vatsikāḥ svāpyās tataḥ sarvān vibhūṣayet |
ṛcaḥ samudrajyeṣṭhāś ca kīrtayed abhiṣecane ||
'samudrajyeṣṭhāḥ salilasya madhyād' ityādyā ṛco bahvṛcānāṃ prasiddhāḥ | etac ca vṛṣasya vatsikānāṃ ca snāpanādikaṃ tasya tābhiḥ saha vivāhaṃ kartum |
etac ca vatsikāsaṃkhyādividhipūrvakam devīpurāṇe spaṣṭīkṛtam |
[1627] catasro vatmikā bhadrā dve cāsaṃbhavato 'pi vā |
vatsaḥ sarvāṅgasaṃpūrṇaḥ kanyakā vaśikā bhavet ||
alaṃkṛtya yathāśobham utsargaṃ kārayen mune |
vivāhas tv ekavatsaryā nīlena bhavate sadā ||
'kanyakā' anubhūtamaithunā | 'ekavatsarī' ekavarṣavayaskā |
tathā |
aṣṭābhir dhenubhir yuktaṃ caturbhir atha vā kramāt |
trihāyanībhir dhanyābhiḥ surūpābhiś ca śobhitaḥ ||
'trihāyanyaḥ' trivarṣavayaskāḥ |
sarvopakāreṇopetaḥ sa sarvasya varo mahān |
utsraṣṭavyo vidhānena api smṛtinidarśanāt ||
ādityapurāṇe |
visarjyasyātha gurviṇyo deyā gāvo vṛṣasya ca |
aṣṭau vātha catasro vā yathālābham athāpi vā ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
vatsataryaś catastraś ca taṃ vṛṣaṃ ca narādhipa |
alaṃkuryāt tataḥ paścād gandhamālyaiś ca śaktitaḥ |
kiṅkiṇībhiś ca ramyābhis tathā cīnāṃśukaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
'kiṅkiṇyaḥ' ghargharīkāḥ |
ādityapurāṇe |
ghaṇṭāṃ lohakṛtāṃ dadyāt śṛṅge ca paṭalaṃ śubham |
'paṭalaṃ' suvarṇādinirmitaḥ kośaḥ |
devīpurāṇe |
aṅkitvotsṛjyate pūrvaṃ gāvo ’laṃkṛtya sarvataḥ |
śivadharmottare |
raktapītaiś ca kusumaiḥ kuṅkumādyaiś ca varṇakaiḥ |
yathāśobhaṃ samālabhya vibhavaiḥ pūjayed vṛṣān ||
kiṅkiṇīravakopetāṃ ghaṭikāñcarakānvitām |
svastikair ardhacandraiś ca nānāratnopaśobhitām ||
'svastikaḥ' vicchandaprabhedaḥ |
aṣṭāṅgulapravistīrṇāṃ hemapadmavinirmitām |
rājatīṃ carmaṇo vāpi mālām urasi vinyaset ||
tadvidhāṃ pṛṣṭhamālāṃ ca puṭāntakakudañcitām |
nānābharaṇasaṃyuktām udarārdhapralambinīm |
hemarājatakauṣīṃ vā nānāratnopaśobhitām ||
'kauṣī' tāmramayī |
paṭṭavastrair vicitraiś ca yathāśobham alaṃkṛtām |
kāryaṃ śṛṅgadayaṃ tasya sadvastracāmarānvitam |
padmaṃ śirasi sauvarṇaṃ candraṃ candrakabhūṣitam ||
'candrakaḥ' mayūrapiccham |
bhramarāśvatthapatraiś ca badhnīyād ratnasaṃyutam |
graiveyakena divyena nānāvastropaśobhinā ||
'graiveyakaṃ' kaṇṭhabhūṣā |
ghaṇṭāṃ kāṃsyamayīṃ śuddhāṃ gale badhnīta susvanām |
[1629] khuraiḥ sauvarṇaraupyaiś ca keyūrāṅgadabhūṣitām |
paṭṭavastrair vicitraiś ca yathāśobham alaṃkṛtām ||
pāraskaraḥ |
athālaṃkṛtya tān sarvān rudrādhyāyaṃ samāhitaḥ |
śrāvayet pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ tathā pratirathāni ca ||
'āśuḥ śiśāno vṛṣabho na bhīma' ityādyā dvādaśaṛcaḥ pratirathasaṃjñāḥ |
viṣṇuḥ |
snātālaṃkṛtaṃ snātābhiḥ catasṛbhir vatsatarībhiḥ sārdham ānīya rudrān puruṣasūktaṃ kūṣmāṇḍīś ca japet | pitā vatseti ca mantraṃ vṛṣabhasya dakṣiṇe karṇe japet |
viṣṇudharmottare |
mantraṃ pitāvatseti pratītaṃ japed apasavye vṛṣabhasya karṇe |
'apasavye' dakṣiṇe | pitā vatseti mantro ’tharvavede prasiddhaḥ |
pitā vatsānāṃ pratirathyānāṃ atho pitā mahatāṃ gargāṇāṃ vatso jarāyuḥ pratidhukpīyūṣa āyuṣyā ghṛtaṃ tadvasya retaḥ || iti |
ādityapurāṇe |
sāvitrīṃ ca japet tatra tathā caivāghamarṣaṇam |
karṇajapaṃ ca dadyāt tu vṛṣabhasya na saṃśayaḥ ||
'aghamarṣaṇaṃ' 'ṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ cābhīddhāt tapasa' ityādiprasiddham |
viṣṇudharmottare |
tato ’ṅkite japen mantram imaṃ prayatamānasaḥ |
[1630] vṛṣo ’si bhagavān dharmaś catuṣpādaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
vṛṇomi tam ahaṃ bhaktyā sa māṃ rakṣatu sarvataḥ ||
pāraskaras tv etam eva mantram abhidhāya |
iti prārthya vṛṣendraṃ taṃ gṛhītakusumāñjaliḥ |
triḥ pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya namaskuryād yathāvidhi ||
pratyaṅmukhānāṃ tu gavām etāvān vidhir iṣyate |
athaiśānyābhimukhataḥ kuryād gāvo vṛṣaṃ tathā ||
gāvo vṛṣasyobhayato vṛṣamadhye niveśya ca |
sarveṣāṃ kaṇṭhavastrāṇi śleṣayet tu parasparam |
ayaṃ hi vo mayā dattaḥ sarvāsām patir uttamaḥ |
tubhyaṃ caitā mayā dattāḥ patnyaḥ sarvā manoramāḥ ||
saṃyojyeti vṛṣaṃ tābhiḥ pitṛbhyas taṃ nivedayet |
savyena pāṇinā pucchaṃ samālambya vṛṣasya tu ||
dakṣinenāpa ādāya satilāḥ sakuśās tataḥ |
tato gotraṃ samuccārya amukasmā iti bruvan ||
vṛṣa eva mayā dattaḥ taṃ tārayatu sarvadā |
sahema satilaṃ bhūmāv ity uccārya vinikṣipet ||
idaṃ tu pāraskareṇaikapramītoddeśena vṛṣotsargavākyam uktam | anekapramītoddeśena tu nīlotsarge mantra uktaḥ vārāhapurāṇe |
narā ye cātra tiṣṭhanti patitāḥ pitṛbāndhavāḥ |
teṣām bhavatv ayaṃ trātā nīlo mukto yathāvidhi ||
[1631] gṛhītvodumbaraṃ pātraṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇatilodakam |
kareṇa puccham ādāya pitṛṇām utsṛjet vṛṣam ||
'udumbaraṃ' tāmram |
brahmapurāṇe |
svadhā pitṛbhyo mātṛbhyo bandhubhyaś cāpi tṛptaye |
mātṛpakṣāś ca ye kecid ye cānye pitṛpakṣajāḥ ||
guruśvaśurabandhūnāṃ ye kuleṣu samudbhavāḥ |
ye pretabhāvam āpannā ye cānye śrāddhavarjitāḥ ||
vṛṣotsargeṇa te sarve labhantāṃ tṛptim uttamām |
dadyād anena mantreṇa tilākṣatayutaṃ jalam |
pitṛbhyaś ca samāsena brāhmaṇebhyaś ca dakṣiṇām ||
anena mantreṇa bahupitryuddeśena vṛṣam utsṛjet |
viṣṇuḥ |
etaṃ yuvānaṃ patiṃ vo dadāmi tena krīḍantīś caratha priyeṇa | māhāsmahi prajasāṃ mā tanūbhir māraṃ dhāma dviṣate somarājan |
vṛṣaṃ vatsatarīyuktam aiśānyāṃ kālayed diśi |
'kālayet' praṇodayet | anena mantreṇeti śeṣaḥ |
viṣṇudharmottare |
etaṃ yuvānaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ dadāmi
gavāṃ patiṃ yūthapatiṃ sadarpam |
[1632] anena sārdhaṃ carata prakāmaṃ
kāmaṃ tathā prāktanavatsataryaḥ |
prakālayet taṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tatas tu
pūrvāṃ diśaṃ vatsatarīś ca sarvāḥ ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
jīvavatsāyāḥ payāśvinyāḥ putre yūthe ca rūpasvittamaḥ syāt tam alaṃkṛtya yūthe mukhyāś catasro vatsataryas tāś cālaṃkṛtyaitaṃ yuvānaṃ patiṃ vo dadāmi tena krīḍantīś caratha priyeṇa mānaḥ sāptajanuṣā saṃvidānā rāyaspoṣeṇa samiṣā mademety etayaivotsṛjerann abhyastham abhimantrayate mayobhūr ity anuvākaśeṣeṇa |
brahmapurāṇe |
atha vṛtte vṛṣotsarge dātā vakroktibhiḥ padaiḥ |
brāhmaṇān āhvayat kiṃcid yenotsṛṣṭaṃ tu nirjane |
tat kaścid anyo na nayed vibhājyaṃ na yathākramam ||
atra nirjane yena kenāpi yat kiṃcid utsṛṣṭaṃ tad anyena kenacin na neyaṃ na ca vibhājyam iti brāhmaṇān prati dātur uktiḥ |
atha moktavyasthānam āha pāraskaraḥ |
bahutoyatṛṇe ’raṇye kṣepaṇīyaḥ sa gopatiḥ |
vatsataryaś ca tāḥ sarvās tenaiva saha kālayet |
atha vā gokule kṣepyā bahugodhanamaṅgale ||
[1633] śivadharmottare |
evaṃvidhaṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ gopatiṃ godhanakṣamam |
vatsikājananaprāyaṃ bahukṣīrāvahaṃ gavām ||
nānābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ pūrvaśobhāsamanvitam |
gomātaraś ca saṃpūjya visṛjec chivagokule ||
evaṃ visṛjya svastivācanādikaṃ kuryāt |
pāraskaraḥ |
niṣkānte gopatau tatra brāhmaṇān svasti vācayet |
dadyāc ca dakṣiṇāṃ teṣāṃ brāhmaṇān bhojayet tataḥ ||
sahiraṇyaṃ rudrakumbhaṃ tathā snānaghaṭān api |
hotre pradadyāt tat sarvaṃ dhenuṃ caiva payasvinīm ||
vārāhapurāṇe |
viprāṇāṃ vacanaṃ kṛtvā yathāśaktyā ca dakṣiṇām |
'viprāṇāṃ vacanaṃ' vipraiḥ svastivācanam |
viṣṇudharmottare |
vāsoyugaṃ hotur atha pradeyaṃ
suvarṇayuktaṃ saghṛtaṃ ca kāṃsyam |
śilpipradhānasya tathaiva mūlyaṃ
deyaṃ tathā tuṣṭim upaiti rājan |
viprās tathānnaṃ dadhisarpiṣā yutam
saṃbhojanīyāḥ payasā ca miśram ||
tac ca brāhmaṇabhojanaṃ rudrasyāgre kartavyaṃ tathācoka .. [broken letters]
[1634] rudrasyāgre bhojayec ca brāhmaṇān vai yathāvidhi |
evaṃ vidhinā muktasya vṛṣabhasya dhāraṇādiniṣedham āha pāraskaraḥ |
vidhārayen na taṃ kaścin na ca kaścin na vāhayet |
na dohayec ca tāṃ dhenuṃ na ca kaścana bandhayet ||
brahmapurāṇe |
nāsau vāhyo na tatkṣīraṃ pātavyaṃ kenacit kvacit |
śivadharmottare |
ye vṛṣāḥ sādhubhir muktāḥ triśūlāṅkāḥ śivapriyāḥ |
tān vāhayanti ye mūḍhāḥ pāpācārā narādhamāḥ ||
te mahāpralayaṃ yāvad aśeṣanarakādiṣu |
pacyante vividhair ghoraiḥ patnīputrādisaṃyutāḥ ||
rājñaś ca viṣaye yasya janā yatra narādhamāḥ |
vāhayanti vṛṣaṃ pāpāḥ pāpaṃ tasyāpi tatsamam |
tasmān nivārayed rājā vāhyamānāṃś ca tair vṛṣān ||
devīpurāṇe |
evaṃ kṛtvā hy avāpnoti phalaṃ vājimakhoditam |
yam uddiśyotsṛjed vatsaṃ sa labhetāvicāraṇāt ||
evaṃ vṛṣotsargavidhiṃ naro yaḥ
karoti bhaktyā nijapūrvajānām |
uddhṛtya tān durgatipaṅkamagnān
svayaṃ salokaṃ samupaiti śambhoḥ ||
bhaviṣyottare |
[1635] svecchāvihāriṇaṃ dṛptaṃ garjantaṃ sukhadaṃ gavām |
kakudminaṃ yūthapatiṃ dhanyā muñcanti govṛṣam |
vṛṣotsṛṣṭaḥ punāty eva daśātītān daśāparān ||
yat kiṃcit spṛśate toyaṃ samuttīrya jalān mahīm |
vṛṣotsṛṣṭaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tad akṣayyaṃ samudāhṛtam ||
yaiś ca yaiś ca spṛśet toyaṃ lāṅgūlādibhir antataḥ |
sarvaṃ tad akṣayaṃ tasya bhaven naivātra saṃśayaḥ ||
śṛṅgaiḥ khurair vā yad bhūmim ullikhaty aniśaṃ vṛṣaḥ |
madhukulyāḥ pitus tasya akṣayyās tā bhavanti vai ||
sahasranalvamātreṇa taḍāgena pathā śrutiḥ |
pitṝṇāṃ yā bhavet tṛptis tāṃ vṛṣas tv atiricyate (?) ||
yo dadādi tilair miśrāṃs tilān vā śrāddhakarmaṇi |
madhu vā nīlakhaṇḍaṃ vā akṣayyaṃ sarvam eva tat ||
'nīlakhaṇḍaḥ’ nīlavṛṣaḥ |
yad bhūmim ālikhati śṛṅgakhuraiḥ sa dṛpto
yad bhāṃ karoti pratimallavṛṣān nirīkṣya |
kālaṃ samastam api tat savivāhakartuḥ
santoṣam āvahati śakrasabhāgataś ca ||
iti vṛṣotsargaḥ |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasakalakaraṇādhipati-
paṇḍitaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau pariśeṣakhaṇḍe
śrāddhakalpe pretatṛptikarāṇāṃ tilodakaśrāddhādīnāṃ prayogo nāma
viṃśo ’dhyāyaḥ ||
[1636]
athaikaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ |
yenādāvavanī vanīyakathāśūnyāvadānādimat-
śrīmaddakṣiṇapāṇipallavabhṛtā samyak kṛtā sampadā |
homastomaparamparābhir anu sā dyaur apy anārttīkṛtā
so ’yaṃ vakti sapiṇḍanāvidhim atho hemādrisūriḥ kṛtī ||
atha sapiṇḍīkaraṇaprayogaḥ |
tatra saṃvatsaraparyantaṃ pretārthāni karmāṇy abhidhāyokaṃ mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
atha saṃvatsare pūrṇe yathāvat kriyate naraiḥ |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ śrāddhaṃ tatrāpi vidhir ucyate ||
atra 'saṃvatsare pūrṇe' ity ayam autsargikaḥ kālaḥ, kāraṇāntaraprayuktās tv asaṃpūrṇe ’pi saṃvatsare yasyāpavādikāḥ kālās te sarve ’pi pūrvam eva kālaprakaraṇe pratipāditāḥ | sapiṇḍīkaraṇalakṣaṇaṃ tu śrāddhabhedaprakaraṇe pratipāditam | tasya caitāvat saṃkṣepato rūpam | acirapramītapretībhūtamanuṣyoddeśenaikoddiṣṭavidhinā pitṛtvaprāpta-tatpūrvamanuṣyoddeśena pārvaṇavidhinā yugapad ekaprayogātmakatvena brāhmaṇabhojane ’nuṣṭhīyamāne pretārghyodakaṃ pitrarghyapātreṣu pretapiṇḍaś ca pitṛpiṇḍeṣu vibhavya prakṣipyata iti sapiṇḍīkaraṇasya vidhir ucyata iti pratijñāyāsminn eva purāṇe ’bhihitam |
[1637] pretoddeśena kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ tatra samāhitaiḥ |
tac cāpi daivarahitam ekārghyaikapavitrakam ||
naivāgnaukaraṇaṃ tatra tac cāvāhanavarjitam |
apasavyaṃ ca tatrāpi bhojayed ayujo dvijān ||
pitṛtrayārtham api ca bhojayec ca tathāparān |
viśeṣas tatra cānyo ’sti pratimāsakriyādhikaḥ ||
taṃ kathyamānam aikāgryād gadato me niśāmaya |
tilagandhodakair yukaṃ tatra pātracatuṣṭayam ||
kuryāt pitṝṇāṃ tritayam ekaṃ pretasya putraka |
pātratraye pretapātram athārghyaṃ ca prasecayet ||
ye samānā iti japan pūrvavac cheṣam ācaret |
strīṇām apy evam evaitad ekoddiṣṭam udāhṛtam ||
sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ tāsāṃ putrābhāve na vidyate |
ekoddiṣṭaṃ tu vai tāsāṃ kartavyaṃ bandhubhiḥ sadā ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
pātrāṇi kṛtvā catvāri pūrayitvā tilāmbubhiḥ |
triṣv ekaṃ pitṛpātreṣu prasiñcen nāmagotrataḥ ||
yājñavalkyaḥ |
gandhodakatilair yukaṃ kuryāt pātracatuṣṭayam |
arghyārthaṃ pitṛpātreṣu pretapātraṃ prasecayet ||
ye samānā iti dvābhyāṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavad ācaret |
etat sapiṇḍīkaraṇam ekoddiṣṭaṃ striyā api ||
[1638] gandhaiś candanādibhir udakena tilaiś ca yuktaṃ pātracatuṣṭayaṃ pretādibhyo 'rghyapātraṃ kuryāt | tatra pretāyārghyaṃ datvā śeṣaṃ tatpātrasthaṃ jalaṃ pitāmahādipātreṣu ye samānā iti dvābhyāṃ mantrābhyāṃ yathākramaṃ pitṛdaivatyābhyāṃ prasiñcet | śeṣaṃ tu karma brāhmaṇanimantraṇādi pārvaṇavad ācaret | etaduktaprakāraṃ pitāmahadaivatyaṃ pārvaṇaṃ pretadaivatyaṃ caikoddiṣṭaśrāddhaṃ sapiṇḍīkaraṇasaṃjñakaṃ veditavyam | striyā api caitat kāryaṃ na punaḥ puruṣasyaiva |
caturviṃśatimate |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ cābde saṃpūrṇe ’bhyudaye ’pi vā |
dvādaśāhe tu keṣāṃcin mataṃ vaikādaśe tathā ||
pūrvaṃ kṛtvā navaṃ pretam uttarān prapitāmahān |
caturbhiḥ pitṛbhir yuktaṃ pārvaṇaṃ tu vidhīyate ||
catvāri cārghyapātrāṇi arcayet pūrvavac chuciḥ |
pretapātraṃ pitṝṇāṃ tu pātreṣu ninayed budhaḥ ||
madhuvātātryṛcaṃ japtvā saṃgacchadhvam iti tryṛcam |
ye samānā iti dvābhyāṃ kecid icchanti sūrayaḥ |
evaṃ piṇḍeṣu kartavyaṃ paramaṃ tu visarjayet ||
āśvalāyanagṛhyapariśiṣṭe |
atha sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ catvāry udapātrāṇy ekaṃ pretasya trīṇītareṣām | prathamaṃ pātraṃ triṣu pātreṣu niyojayet | samānīva ākūtānīty evaṃ prathamaṃ piṇḍeṣu niyojayet | madhumatībhiḥ saṃgacchadhvam iti dvābhyām evaṃ caturtho 'nujñāpito bhavatīti | na cātra daivaṃ bhojayet, prāg eva daive ’rghyam annādyaṃ ca [1639] datvā gandhamālyaiḥ pātram arcayitvā hutaśeṣaṃ pitṛbhyaḥ pāṇiṣu dadyāt |
kātyāyanaḥ |
tataḥ saṃvatsare pūrṇe catvāri pātrāṇi satilagandhodakāni pūrayitvā trīṇi pitṝṇām ekaṃ pretasya pātraṃ pitṛpātreṣv āsiñcati ye samānā iti dvābhyām etena piṇḍo vyākhyātaḥ |
kūrmapurāṇe |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ proktaṃ pūrṇe saṃvatsare punaḥ |
kuryāc catvāri pātrāṇi pretādīnāṃ dvijottamāḥ ||
pretārghyaṃ pitṛpātreṣu pātram āsecayet tataḥ |
ye samānā iti dvābhyāṃ piṇḍān apy evam eva hi ||
sapiṇḍīkaraṇaśrāddhaṃ devapūrvaṃ vidhīyate |
pitṝn āvāhayet tatra punaḥ pretaṃ ca nirdiśet ||
vaijavāpaḥ |
atha sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ saṃvatsaram ekaṃ piṇḍam anuddiśya samāpte saṃvatsare catvāry udapātrāṇi prayunakti tatraikaṃ pretāya trīṇi pitṛbhyas tat pretapātraṃ pitṛpātreṣv āsiñcati ye samānā iti dvābhyām evaṃ piṇḍo 'thābhimṛśaty eṣa vo ’nugataḥ pretaḥ pitaras taṃ dadhāmi vaḥ | śivam astv iti śeṣāṇāṃ jāyatāṃ cirajīvitā | samānīva ākūtāni samānā hṛdayāni vaḥ | samānam astu vo mano yathā vaḥ sumahāsati |
saṃgacchadhvaṃ saṃvadadhvaṃ saṃ vo manāṃsi jānato devā bhāgaṃ yathā pūrve saṃjānānā upāsate ity abhiśastapatitabhrūṇahananaḥ strī (?) vāticāriṇī nātidiśet |
[1640] 'atideśaḥ' pitṛbhiḥ saha saṃsarjanam |
āha hārītaḥ |
samāpte ’bde paśuśrāddhaṃ vidhivat pratipādayet |
caturo nirvapet piṇḍān prathamaṃ teṣu sandhayet ||
vapāṃ paśuvapāṃ caiva hy avadānāni yāni ca |
hutvā tāni vidhānena śeṣaṃ piṇḍāt samāvapet ||
tataḥ prabhṛti vai pretaḥ pitṛsāmānyam āpnuyāt |
vidate pitṛlokaṃ ca tataḥ śrāddhaṃ pravartate ||
vidhinā ca niyuktasya yāval lomāni vai paśoḥ |
tāvad varṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ||
āha viṣṇuḥ |
saṃvatsarānte pretāya tatpitre tatpitāmahāya tatprapitāmāya ca brāhmaṇān daivapūrvān bhojayed atrāgnaukaraṇam āvāhanaṃ pādyaṃ ca kuryāt | saṃsṛjantu tvā pṛthivī samānīva iti pretapātraṃ pātratraye yojayet, ucchiṣṭasaṃnidhau piṇḍacatuṣṭayaṃ kuryāt, pretapiṇḍaṃ pātrapādyodakavat piṇḍatraye nidadhyāt karṣūtrayasaṃnikarṣe ’py evam |
kāṭhakagṛhye |
caturthaṃ piṇḍam utsṛjya traidhaṃ kṛtvā piṇḍeṣu nidadhyāt saṃsṛjantu tvā pṛthivī vāyur agniḥ prajāpatiḥ saṃsṛjadhvaṃ pūrvebhiḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha samānāḥ saṃ vo manāṃsīty evam udakam || iti |
brahmapurāṇe |
caturbhyaś cārghyapātrebhya ekaṃ vāmena pāṇinā |
gṛhītvā dakṣiṇenaiva pāṇinā ca tilodakam ||
[1641] saṃsṛjatu tvā pṛthivī ye samānā iti smaran |
pretaviprasya haste tu caturbhāgaṃ jalaṃ kṣipet ||
tataḥ pitāmahādibhyas tanmantraiś ca pṛthak pṛthak |
ye samānā iti dvābhyāṃ taj jalaṃ tu samarpayet ||
arghyān tenaiva vidhinā pretapātrāc ca pūrvavat |
tebhyaś cārghyaṃ nivedyaiva paścāc ca svayam ācamet ||
atha tenaiva vidhinā darbhamūle ’vanejanam |
pitur datvā tu piṇḍaṃ tu dadyād bhaktyā tu pūrvavat ||
datvā piṇḍam athāṣṭāṅgaṃ dhyātvā tantrastham īśvaraṃ |
suvarṇarūpyadarbhais tu tasmin piṇḍaṃ tatas tridhā ||
kṛtvā pitāmahādibhyaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ pretam arpayet |
saṃsṛja tvānu pṛthivī vāyur agniḥ prajāpatiḥ ||
etan mantraṃ japed bhaktyā samānīvantam eva ca |
ye samānā iti dvābhyāṃ pitṛbhyaḥ pretam arpayet ||
suvartulāṃs tatas tāṃs trīn piṇḍān kṛtvā prapūjayet |
arghyapuṣpais tathā dhūpair dīpamālyānulepanaiḥ |
mukhyaṃ tu pitaraṃ kṛtvā munayaś ca yathākramam ||
atra kaścin manubhāṣyakāra āha |
yady api pretāya brāhmaṇān bhojayet tatpitre tatpitāmahāya ca [1642] tatprapitāmahāya ceti smaryate, tathāpi pṛthakśabdābhāvāt sahatvānugrahāc ca preto ’pi pitāmahādyartheṣv eva triṣu brāhmaṇeṣu niveśyate | yathāmāvāsyādiśrāddheṣu kadācid ekasmin brāhmaṇe pitrādayastrayo ’pi bhojyante evam atrāpi pitāmahādyartheṣu triṣv api brāhmaṇeṣu preto ’pi niveśyata iti |
asti ca smṛtau punaḥśabdaḥ |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ śrāddhaṃ devapūrvaṃ nivedayet |
pitṝn āvāhayet tatra punaḥ pretaṃ vinirdiśet ||
sa eva punaḥśabdas tadopapadyate yadā teṣv eva triṣu brāhmaṇeṣu preto ’pi niveśyate nāpi pṛthag iti | evaṃ ca sati sarvatas tasya saṃsargaḥ kṛto bhavati | saṃsarjanārthaṃ hīdaṃ karma kriyate | pretasyāpi teṣv evāhṛtatvāt pretārtham api tadbhojanaṃ bhavati, "pitrye ayugmān bhojayed" iti ca smaryate tad apy evam anugṛhītaṃ bhavati pretāya pṛthakbrāhmaṇakalpanāyāṃ caturādisaṃkhyakeṣu brāhmaṇeṣu tadvirudhyeta |
kiṃca | pretapātraṃ pitṛpātreṣv āsiñcaty ārghyam ity api na saṃgaccheta tathā hi yadi pretārghyadānāt pūrvam evāsecanaṃ kriyate tadā tatpātrasya riktībhāvāt kutaḥ pātrāt pretasyārghyadānaṃ bhavet | na cāsecitāt pitṛpācād iti vācyam | na hy anyārtham upakalpitenānyasyārghyadānaṃ yujyate | pitāmahādyarthaṃ hi tatkalpitaṃ na pituḥ |
atha pretārghyadānānantaram āsecanaṃ kriyate tadā kṛte ’rghyadāne na tadarghyadānārthād āsecanaṃ syāt, uktena tu prakāreṇa na kaścid virodhaḥ |
tad etad ayuktam | yataḥ "pretāya brāhmaṇān bhojayed" ityādinā smṛtāv ekaikaṃ [1643] pitaram uddiśyaikaikaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayed ity ukaṃ | tatra pratipuruṣanirdeśāt pṛthakaśabdāpekṣaiva kartuṃ na yujyate |
athāsti pṛthakśabdena bhavatām atīva prayojanaṃ tarhi śṛṇvantu smṛtipurāṇakṛtāṃ vacanam | tatrāhatur uśanaḥ-sumantū 1
sapiṇḍīkaraṇe viprān bhojayet pārvaṇe yathā |
pṛthak prakalpyaṃ pretārtham ekoddiṣṭaṃ vidhānataḥ ||
sapiṇḍīkaraṇe vīra kuryāc chrāddhadvayaṃ nṛpa |
ekoddiṣṭaṃ pārvaṇaṃ ca ity āha bhagavān śivaḥ ||
nanu naivaṃ sati punaḥśabda upapanno bhavati |
maivaṃ, punaḥśabdād ayam artho ’vagamyate pitṝṇām āvāhanaṃ kṛtvā paścāt pretasya kuryyād iti | na caivaṃvidhaṃ kvacid api vākyam asti teṣv eva brāhmaṇeṣu pretaś cāvāhayitavya iti |
nanv evaṃ sati sahatvānugraho na syāt |
hanta tarhi sahatvam anugṛhṇatāṃ sarvadaika eva sarvārtham api bhojayitavyo bhavet | na caitad upapadyate, na tv evaikaṃ sarveṣāṃ piṇḍair vyākhyātam iti śaunakavacanāt | yad apy ekaikam api vidvāṃsaṃ daive pitrye ca bhojayed iti manuvacanaṃ tasyāpi sapiṇḍīkaraṇaviṣayatvaṃ vaktum aśakyaṃ yato yatraikasmā eva dīyate tad ekoddiṣṭam abhidhīyate, tribhyaś ca yatra dīyate tac ca pārvaṇam iti | yadā tu yugapad ekasminn eva kāle pārvaṇaikoddiṣṭe syātāṃ tadā sapiṇḍīkaraṇam iti tad etad ekabrāhmaṇapakṣe ’vaśyaṃ vinaśyet pṛthagekoddiṣṭābhāvāt | ato yathā brāhmaṇabhede pārvaṇasāhityam evam atrāpi vācyam |
yac coktaṃ pitāmahādivipreṣv eva prete ’py āhūyamāne pitrye ayugmān ity asyānugrahaḥ syād iti | tatraitayoḥ pārvaṇaikoddiṣṭayor vibhinnatvāt [1644] militayos tayoś caturbhir api dvijaiḥ saṃpannair ekaikasminn ayugmatvānapāyāt pakṣāntare ’py anugraho ’syāsty eva | yad api yadi pretārghyadānāt pūrvam āsecanam ityādinā vikalpoktaṃ tad api na kiṃcit arghyadānāyaiva hi na niḥśeṣīkṛtya prasicyate | tataś cārghyadānam āsecanaṃ cety ubhayam api syād eva na kṛtsnenārghyodakena secanaṃ kartavyam ity evaṃvidhaṃ smaraṇam asti | ataḥ pitryesv eva vipreṣu pretasyāvāhanaṃ kartavyam ity anupapannam | aparigṛhītaś cāyaṃ patraḥ śiṣṭaiḥ | ataḥ pretārthaṃ pṛthak pitāmahādyarthaṃ ca pṛthak brāhmaṇān parikalpya sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kāryam iti sthitam |
iha kecid yājñavalkyavyākhyātāraḥ pitṛpātreṣu pretapātraṃ prasiñcayed ity atra pretaśabdam evaṃ vyācakṣate, prakarṣeṇa itogataḥ piṇḍadānādeḥ sakāśāt pracyuta iti cirapramīto vṛddhaprapitāmahaḥ pretaśabdenocyata iti | atas tadīyam arghyapātraṃ pitrarghyapātreṣu prasecanīyaṃ tadīyaś ca piṇḍaḥ piṇḍeṣu saṃsarjanīya iti | yadi tv aciramṛtaḥ pretaśabdenābhidhīyate tadā tadarghyapātrodake pitṛpātreṣu prasikte sati tatpātrariktībhāvāt pretasyārghyadānaṃ na syāt | yadi tu ciramṛtaḥ pretaśabdenābhidhīyate tadā na kaścid doṣaḥ, tasya nīrasyārghyadānābhāvāt | prayuktaś ca pretebhyo dadātītyādiṣu pramītamātre pretaśabdaḥ | ato mṛtamātravācini pretaśabde yatrāyam upapanno bhavati sa evātra grahītuṃ yujyate |
kāṭhakagṛhyakṛtā ca sphuṭoktyaiva vṛddhaprapitāmahapiṇḍāntareṣu saṃsarjanam uktam | tad yathā |
caturthaṃ piṇḍam utsṛjya traidhaṃ kṛtvā piṇḍeṣu nidadhyāt || iti |
[1645] ata eva vṛddhaśātātapaḥ |
nirūpya caturaḥ piṇḍān piṇḍadaḥ pratināmataḥ |
ye samānā iti dvābhyām ādyaṃ tu vibhajet tridhā ||
ādyaśabdaś cātrāpi puruṣapiṇḍābhiprāyeṇa | katham iti cet, kāṭhakagṛhyavākyānusārāt | na ca pramītapiṇḍasyātrāntimatvāt tadabhiprāyeṇa tv ādyaśabdānupapattir eva | yadi vā ciramṛtaḥ pretaśabdenocyeta tadā,
yaḥ sapiṇḍīkṛtaṃ pretaṃ pṛthakpiṇḍe niyojayet |
sa tu pāpaṃ samāpnoti pitṛhā copajāyate ||
ity etan nopapadyeta, sapiṇḍīkaraṇānantaraṃ tasya pratyabdam ekoddiṣṭasya vihitatvāt, ciramṛte tu vṛddhaprapitāmahe pretaśabdābhidheye sapiṇḍīkaraṇānantaraṃ tasya pṛthakpradānābhāvād eṣa niṣedho ’vakalpyate | tasmād vṛddhaprapitāmahārghyasyārghyeṣu piṇḍasya piṇḍeṣu saṃsarjanaṃ kāryam iti tad etad ayuktaṃ evaṃ hi sati vṛddhaprapitāmahārghyapiṇḍayor anyair bahubhir arghyāpiṇḍaiḥ saha samparkasyāpādyamānatvāt tasyaiva sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ syāt | na tv aciroparatasya pretasya | ato nūtanapramītasyaivārghyapiṇḍayor anyeṣu saṃsarjanaṃ kāryam ity eva yuktam | yat tūktaṃ evaṃ kriyamāṇe nūtanapramītasyārghyadānaṃ na syād iti |
tan na, pitṛpātraprasiktāvaśiṣṭenodakena tadarghyadānasiddheḥ | na hi niḥśeṣaṃ prasecanīyam iti kiṃcid vacanam asti | yad api prakarṣeṇetaḥ preta ity anayā vyutpattyā vṛddhaprapitāmahaḥ pretaśabdenocyata ity ukaṃ tad apy anālocyaiva, yato yājñavalkyena,
piṇḍayajñāvṛtā deyaṃ pretāyānnaṃ dinatrayam |
ity āśaucaprakaraṇe pratipādya, saṃprati punar abhihitaṃ "pretapātraṃ prasecayet" iti | ato nūtanapramīta eva prakṛtatvāt buddhau viparivartamānaḥ pretaśabdenābhidhātuṃ [1646] yujyate nāprakṛtatvāt sthavirataraḥ | yadi cātra vṛddhaprapitāmahaḥ pretaśabdenābhidhīyate tadā,
pretatvāt pratimucyeta sapiṇḍīkaraṇe kṛte |
pitṛtvaṃ labhate martyāḥ pratisaṃvatsaraṃ tataḥ |
mṛtāhe tasya kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ samyak samāhitaiḥ ||
ityādinā pretatvavimuktir ucyamānā tāvan na saṃgaccheta | na hi tadā vṛddhaprapitāmahasya pretatvam apaiti, prakarṣeṇa na vā pramītatvaṃ nivartate, nāpi pretaśabdavācyāvasthāviśeṣanivṛttyā pitṛsaṃjñā syād avasthāviśeṣas tasya tadotpadyate, pūrvam eva tasya pitṛtvasampatteḥ | na ca pratisaṃvatsaraṃ vidhīyamānaṃ śrāddham api tasya yujyate | na caturthaṃ piṇḍo gacchati,
trayāṇām udakaṃ kāryaṃ triṣu piṇḍaḥ pravartate |
caturthaḥ saṃpradātaiṣāṃ pañcamo nopapadyate (?) ||
ityādibhis tanniṣedhāt | gāryeṇa ca vyaktataram evābhinavapramītaḥ pretaśabdeṇābhihitaḥ |
samānte pitṛbhiḥ pretaṃ yojayet pitaraṃ sutaḥ |
tadādi pārvaṇaṃ śrāddhaṃ mṛtāhany api nānyathā ||
yadā tu 'tadādi pārvaṇaṃ śrāddham' ity anenokaṃ tadābhinavapramīta evātra pretaśabdenāvagantuṃ yogyo na vṛddhaprapitāmahaḥ | na hi tadādi pārvaṇaṃ śrāddhaṃ kartuṃ yujyate, "na parebhyo nādhikārād" iti niṣedhāt ācāravirodhāc ca | kiṃ ca vṛddhaprapitāmahavacane pretaśabdasya "pretāya brāhmaṇān bhojayet tatpitre tatpitāmahāya tatprapitāmahāya ca" iti viṣṇuvacanāt vṛddhaprapitāmahapitrādyudeśena brāhmaṇabhojanaṃ syāt | na ca tad upapannam ity uktam | yad apy uktaṃ pretebhyo dadātīti pramītamātre pretaśabdo dṛśyata iti vṛddhaprapitāmaho ’pi pretaśabdenābhidhātuṃ śakyata iti tad api na | tatrāpi pradānayogyasyaiva tena śabdenābhidhānam | na ca tadayogyasya vṛddhaprapitāmahasyāpi | yat tu caturthapiṇḍam utsṛjya traidhaṃ kṛtvā piṇḍeṣu [1647] nidadhyād ity uktaṃ tad apy asmatpakṣa eva ghaṭate, na yudmatpakṣe | catuḥsaṃkhyāpūrako hi caturtha ity ucyate | tathāvidhaś ca na cātītasyaiva piṇḍo bhavati | yataḥ,
śrāddhadvayam upakramya kurvīta sahapiṇḍatām |
tayos tripuruṣaṃ pūrvam ekoddiṣṭaṃ tataḥ param ||
iti purāṇe navapramītārthasyaikoddiṣṭasya pārvaṇottarakālam anuṣṭhāne vihite tatpiṇḍasya vihitatvena catuḥsaṃkhyāpūrakatvāt |
kaṭhapariśiṣṭe coktam |
datvā piṇḍān pitṛbhyo ’tha paścāt pretāya dharmataḥ |
taṃ tu piṇḍaṃ tridhā kṛtvā ānupūrvyā tu santataḥ |
nidadhyāt triṣu piṇḍeṣu eṣa saṃsarjane vidhiḥ || iti |
yadi ca "ādyaṃ tu vibhajet tridhā" ity atrādipuruṣābhiprāyeṇādyaśabda ity abhidhīyate | tataś ca "ādyaḥ pitā tatpitā yas tasyāpi yaḥ pitā" ity evamādāv ādyaśabdasya prathamābhidhānād avyavasthādoṣo bhavet |
kiṃ ca | "caturthaṃ piṇḍam utsṛjya traidhaṃ kṛtvā piṇḍeṣu nidadhyād" iti etasmād vacanāc caturthasyotsarjanād anantaram eva vibhajanaṃ piṇḍeṣu saṃsarjanaṃ ca pratīyate| tac ca vṛddhaprapitāmahapiṇḍaviṣayatve na ghaṭate | tathā hi pūrvam anuṣṭhīyamānapitāmahādidevatyapārvaṇapadārthībhūtavṛddhaprapitāmahapiṇḍadānasya tadanantaram anuṣṭhīyamānanavapramītārthaikoddiṣṭapadārthībhūtapiṇḍapradānena vyavadhāne vibhāgasaṃsargayor api vyavadhānāt | navapramītapiṇḍaviṣayatve tu piṇḍāntarapradānavyavadhānābhāvāt samanantaram eva pratipādyamānau vibhāgasaṃsargau upapannatarau bhavataḥ | na cādyaṃ tu vibhajet tridhety asya navapramītaviṣayatvānupapattiḥ, ādyaśabdena mukhyatvābhidhānāt | mukhyaś cātra navapramītasya piṇḍaḥ | sapiṇḍīkaraṇasya navapramītasaṃskārārthatvāt [1648] | asti ca "mukhyaṃ tu pitaraṃ kṛtvā" ityādikaḥ purāṇoktaḥ, "saṃvatsarānte pretāya tatpitre tatpitāmahāya" ityādikaḥ smṛtyukto navapramītapiṇḍasya pitāmahādipiṇḍo yaḥ pūrvakālatāvidhir api tadabhiprāyeṇa cādyaśabdasya prayuktatvād uktadoṣānavakāśāt | yac coktaṃ sapiṇḍīkaralānantaraṃ navapramītoddeśena pratisaṃvatsaram ekoddiṣṭasya vihitatvād "yaḥ sapiṇḍīkṛtaṃ pretam" ityādiko niṣedhas tatra nopapadyata iti tad api na, tatrāpi vaikalpikapārvaṇavidhyarthatvena aurasādiputrakartṛkasāṃvatsarikaviṣaye vyavasthitatvena vā caturdaśīvyatiriktakālikāśastrahataśrāddhaviṣayatvena vā tasyopapatteḥ, varaṃ vṛddhaprapitāmahapiṣayatva evāyaṃ niṣedhaḥ nopapadyate | “trayāṇām udakaṃ kāryam" ityādinā sarvātmanaiva tasya mṛtāhādau piṇḍaniṣedhād apṛthakpiṇḍadānasya prasaktyabhāvāt pṛthakpiṇḍadānaniṣedhas tatra kimartho bhavet | asti ca kaścid grahabhūtapiśācādivat pretākhyaḥ prāṇiyoniviśeṣaḥ | asti ca smṛti-purāṇapramāṇakaṃ sapiṇḍīkaraṇāntaurdhvadehika-kriyānivartanīyaṃ navapramītasya tadrūpatvam |
tathā ca brahmapurāṇe |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇāt pūrvaṃ preto bhavati vai mṛtaḥ |
kṛte sapiṇḍīkaraṇe pitṛtvaṃ pratipadyate || iti |
ato navapramītasyāvasthāviśeṣe rūḍhyā pretaśabdo vartate | vṛddhaprapitāmahe tu yogeṇa, yogāc ca ruḍhir balīyasī | kiṃ ca yasyaiva ṣoḍaśa śrāddhāni tasyaiva sapiṇḍīkaraṇam |
ata eva śātātapaḥ |
saṃvatsare tu vijñeyaṃ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ tv iha |
[1649] sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṇantā vai jñeyā pretakriyā budhaiḥ || iti |
anena ca yo māsikādau pretaśabdābhidheyaḥ sa eva sapiṇḍīkaraṇe ’pīti gamyate, ato navapramītasya pitrāder arghyapātraṃ pitāmahādyarghyapātreṣu, piṇḍeṣu piṇḍaḥ saṃyojanīya iti sthitam | pitāmahe dhriyamāṇe yadi pitā pramītaḥ syāt pitāmahaṃ parityajya prapitāmahāt prabhṛti puruṣatrayeṇa saha sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kāryam |
tathā ca brahmapurāṇe |
mṛte pitari yasyātha vidyate tu pitāmahaḥ |
tena deyās trayaḥ piṇḍāḥ prapitāmahapūrvakāḥ ||
tebhyaś ca paitṛkaḥ piṇḍo niyoktavyas tu pūrvavat |
na deyo jīvate piṇḍaḥ sa ca yasmān mṛto bhavet ||
piṇḍas tu jīvato haste śiraśchedasamo bhavet ||
ayaṃ ca jīvatpitāmahakasya pitṛsapiṇḍīkaraṇaprakāro jīvatpitṛkādyadhikārikapiṇḍaṃ pitṛyajñaprakārāṇām upalakṣaṇārtham ity anusaṃdheyam |
atra pitāmahādibhiḥ saha sapiṇḍīkaraṇe kṛte ’pi pitāmahoparame sati tadaurdhvadehike sapiṇḍīkaraṇānte punaḥ pitāmahenāpi saha pituḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kartavyam | anyathāmāvāsyādikālānuṣṭheyaṃ śrāddhaṃ na niṣpadyeteti kecit | dhriyamāṇāyāṃ pitāmahyāṃ mātuḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇe yathoktaḥ pitṛsapiṇḍīkaraṇanyāya evānusaṃdheyaḥ |
tathā cāsminn eva purāṇe ’bhihitam |
mātary atha mṛtāyāṃ tu vidyate ca pitāmahī |
prapitāmahītaḥ sarvaḥ kāryas tatrāpy ayaṃ vidhiḥ || iti |
[1650]
atha strīsapiṇḍīkaraṇe ’nyo 'pi viśeṣa ucyate |
tatra tāvad bhaviṣyatpurāṇe śatānīkaḥ praśnabhaṅgyā saṃdeham upanyasyati |
mātuḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kathaṃ kāryaṃ bhavet sutaiḥ |
mātāmahena saṃyojyā kiṃ vā patikulaṃ nayet ||
kiṃ mātāmahādibhiḥ saṃyojyā sapiṇḍanīyā kiṃ vā patikulena sahety asyārthaḥ |
atra nirṇayaṃ varṇayiṣyann āha sumantuḥ |
aho vata mahat kaṣṭaṃ durvijñeyaṃ tvayeritam |
dvibhāvo hy atra lokānāṃ tathāpi śrūyatāṃ nṛpa ||
dhruvā dyaur dhuvā pṛthivī dhruvaṃ viśvam idaṃ jagat |
dhruvāś ceme nagāḥ sarve dhruvāḥ patikule striyaḥ ||
anena mātāmahādibhiḥ saha sapiṇḍanīyety amuṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ vidhāya patikulena saha saṃyojanīyeti siddhāntam ity avagamyate |
kiṃ ca | mṛtāyā api nāryyāḥ piṇḍodakādiṣu bhartṛgotrayogo dṛśyate na tadviyogaḥ |
tathā ca hārītaḥ |
svagotrād bhraśyate nārī vivāhāt saptame pade |
svāmigotreṇa kartavyās tasyāḥ piṇḍodakakriyāḥ ||
uśanā āha |
ekatvaṃ sā gatā bhartuḥ piṇḍe gotre ca srutake |
[1651] tasmād udakapiṇḍau tu bhartṛgotreṇa nirvapet ||
bṛhaspatiḥ |
caturthīhomamantrais tu māṃsamajjāsthibhiḥ saha |
ekatvam āgatā bhartus tasmāt tadgotrabhāginī ||
pāṇigrahaṇikā mantrāḥ pitṛgotrāpahārakāḥ |
bhartur gotreṇa nārīṇāṃ deyaṃ piṇḍodakaṃ tataḥ ||
tathā |
bhartṛgotreṇa nāmnā ca mātuḥ kuryāt sapiṇḍanam |
tūṣṇīṃ dampatipiṇḍābhyāṃ kuśair antarayan pitṝn || iti |
'antarayan' tirodadhānaḥ |
āha vyāsaḥ |
śvaśurasyāgrato yasmāt śiraḥpracchādanakriyā |
putrair darbheṇa sā kāryā mātur abhyudayārthibhiḥ ||
tad evaṃ pitṛkulena saha bhāryāyāḥ sapiṇḍanaṃ kartavyam iti sthitam | tatrāpi kena saheti saṃśayapūrvakatvam āha śātātapaḥ |
mātuḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kathaṃ kāryaṃ bhavet sutaiḥ |
pitāmahyāḥ sahaivāsyāḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇakriyā ||
pitāmahīprapitāmahīvṛddhaprapitāmahībhiḥ sahety arthaḥ |
atra pakṣāntaram āha gārgyaḥ |
patyaivaikena (?) kartavyaṃ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ striyaḥ |
sā mṛtāpi hi tenaikyaṃ gatā mantrāhutivrataiḥ ||
'mantrāḥ ' yad etad dhṛdayaṃ tava tad astu hṛdayaṃ mametyādayaḥ, 'āhutayaḥ' [1652] vivāhahomādyantargatāḥ, 'vratāni' brahmacaryākṣāralavaṇādīni, tair ity arthaḥ |
smṛtyantare ’pi |
mātuḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ patyā sārdhaṃ vidhīyate |
yasmāt pativratānāṃ vai sa eva gatir iṣyate ||
uktaṃ ca bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
puruṣasyārdhadehaṃ tu bhāryā vedeṣu gīyate |
ardho hi vātmano hy eṣa yaj jāyeti ha vai nṛpa ||
tasmāt patyā sahaivāsyāḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ smṛtam |
vivāhe caiva nirvṛtte caturthe ’hani rātriṣu |
saṃdhitā sā yato mantrair asthimāṁsatvagādibhiḥ ||
mantrās tu "prāṇais te prāṇān saṃdadhāmy asthibhir asthīni māṃsair māṃsāni tvacā tvacam" iti | tad evaṃ keṣucid vacaneṣu mātuḥ pitāmahyādibhiḥ saha sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kartavyam ity uktaṃ keṣucic ca patyā saheti | tatraiva viṣayavyavasthā bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
jīvatpitā pitāmahyā mātuḥ kuryāt sapiṇḍanam |
pramītapitṛkaḥ pitrā tatpitrā putrikāsutaḥ ||
'tatpitrā' mātuḥ pitrety arthaḥ |
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
mātuḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ saṃvatsare sutaiḥ |
pitāmahyā sahaivāsyāḥ patir yadi tu jīvati ||
āha logākṣiḥ |
pitāmahyādibhiḥ strībhir mātaraṃ tu sapiṇḍayet |
[1653] pitari dhriyamāṇe tu tenaivoparate sati ||
āha śātātapaḥ |
mṛtā yānugatā nāthaṃ sā tena sahapiṇḍatām |
arhati svargavāsaṃ ca yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam || iti |
evaṃ ca sati pitari jīvati pitāmahyādibhir eva saha sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kāryam | pramīte tu pitary anvārūḍhāyāṃ mātari pitraiva saha sapiṇḍīkaraṇam | ananvārūḍhāyām api pitāmahyādibhir vā saheti vyavasthā pratipāditā bhavati | yadi tv ananvārūḍhāyām api mātari pitraiva saha sapiṇḍanaṃ syāt tadānvārūḍhāviṣayaṃ vacanam anarthakaṃ bhavet | tasyānvārūḍhā bhartraiva aha sapiṇḍanīyeti niyāmakatvena sārthakatve "pramītapiṭakaḥ pitrā" iti vacanaṃ na niyamaparaṃ śakyaṃ vakum ity aniyamasiddhiḥ (?) |
yat punar aparārke jīvantyāṃ pitāmahyāṃ pitraiva saha mātuḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇam ity uktam, tan na, evaṃvidhe viṣaye prapitāmahyādibhiḥ saha sapiṇḍīkaraṇasya brahmapurāṇoktasya darśitatvāt |
atha vāstu pitṛpitāmahyor ubhayor jīvane brahmapurāṇokaṃ prapitāmahyādibhiḥ saha sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ, jīvantyāṃ pitāmajhāṃ mṛte ca pitari pitraiva saha sapiṇḍanam iti vyavasthā |
yat tv āha śātātapaḥ |
mṛte pitari mātus tu na kāryā sahapiṇḍatā |
pitur eva sapiṇḍatve tasyā api taṃ bhavet || iti |
tad atyantāśaktaputraviṣayam | keṣāṃcid vā matam ity anusaṃdheyam |
[1654] yadā tu patiḥ patnyāḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kuryāt, tadā svakīyamātrādibhir eva sahety āha paiṭhīnasiḥ |
aputrāyāṃ mṛtāyāṃ tu patiḥ kuryāt sapiṇḍanam |
śvaśrvādibhiḥ sahaivāsyāḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ bhavet ||
evaṃ ca sati patyur api strīsapiṇḍīkaraṇādhikāre pratipādite sati sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ strīṇāṃ puruṣābhāve na vidyata iti | ayaṃ niṣedhaḥ patyābhāvasahite putrābhāve veditavyaḥ |
vyāsaḥ |
aputrāyāṃ mṛtāyāṃ tu patiḥ kuryāt sapiṇḍanam |
śvaśrubhis tisṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ evaṃ dharmeṇa yujyate ||
tad evam etāvatā prapañcena pitāmahyādibhiḥ pitrā vā saha bhartṛkula eva mātuḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kāryam ity uktam | asti ca mātāmahakule ’pi sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kāryam ity ayam api pakṣaḥ |
āpastambaḥ |
kokilasya yathā putrā anyasaṃbandhajīvinaḥ |
puṣṭās te svakulaṃ yānti evaṃ nārī mṛtā satī ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
ākāśasthaṃ yathā toyaṃ patitaṃ dharaṇītale |
yoniṃ svakīyāṃ gacchet tu tathā nārī mṛtā satī ||
pitur gotraṃ samutsṛjya na kuryād bhartṛgotrataḥ |
janmany eva vipattau ca nārīṇāṃ paitṛkaṃ kulam ||
gavāṃ śatasahasreṣu vatso vindati mātaram |
[1655] evaṃ strī paitṛkaṃ yāti tyaktvā patikulaṃ nṛpa ||
tyaktvā sthalaṃ yathā hy āpo nimnaṃ yānti narādhipa |
tathā patikulaṃ hitvā mṛtā nārī svakaṃ vrajet ||
pitā pitāmaho yonyaḥ pūrṇe saṃvatsare sutaiḥ |
mātā mātāmahe tadvad ity āha bhagavān śivaḥ ||
'yojyaḥ' sapiṇḍanīyaḥ |
tathā ca brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
pituḥ pitāmahe yadvat pūrṇe saṃvatsare sutaiḥ |
mātur mātāmahe tadvad uśanoktā sapiṇḍatā ||
tad evaṃ pitṛkulena saha sapiṇḍanīyeti kaiścit pratipāditam | mātāmahakulena vety aparair iti virodhe viṣayavyavasthocyate brāhmadaivārṣaprajāpatyākhyānāṃ vivāhānām anyatamena pariṇītāyāḥ patikulena saha saṃyojanaṃ tadgotreṇa piṇḍādidānaṃ ca kartavyam | sā hy anaupādhikena dānena pitrā pariṇetṛsvāmikā kṛteti mṛtāpi na tatkulagotre parityājayituṃ yogyā | gāndhavāsurarākṣasapaiśācānām anyatamena tu pariṇītāyā mātāmahakulena saha saṃyojanaṃ tadgotreṇa piṇḍādidānaṃ ca kartavyam | na hi sā svarūcyā pitrā niṣpratidvandvaṃ varāya datteti na mātāmahakulāt tagotrāc ca pracyāvayituṃ yogyā |
ata āha bṛhacchātātapaḥ |
brāhmādiṣu vivāheṣu yā rūḍhā kanyakā bhavet |
bhartṛgotreṇa kartavyāḥ tasyāḥ piṇḍodakakriyāḥ |
āsurādiṣu cānyeṣu pitṛgotreṇa dharmavit ||
[1656] atra prakārāntareṇa vyavasthā |
atrāha vyāsaḥ |
mātāmahasya gotreṇa mātuḥ piṇḍodakakriyām |
prakuryāt putrikāputra eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ||
patyā sahaikatā tāvat yāvatputro na jāyate |
putrikāyāḥ sutotpattau patyaikatvaṃ nivartate ||
yac cānyad vacanaṃ “tatpitrāt putrikāsutaḥ” iti tatpūrvam eva darśitam |
atrāpi vyavasthocyate |
yenāsya pitaro yātā yena yātā pitāmahāḥ |
tena yātāḥ satāṃ mārgāḥ tena gacchan na duṣyati ||
iti vacanāt yais tu kulaparamparayā pitṛkulena saha sapiṇḍanaṃ kriyate tais tathā kāryam anyais tv anyatheti | asminn eva viṣaye parasparaviruddhāni vacanāni upanyasya bhaviṣyatpurāṇe sumantunābhihitam |
evaṃ śāstragatir bhinnā sarvakarmasu bhārata |
udite ’nudite caiva homabhede yathā bhavet |
tasmāt kulakramāyātam ācāraṃ ca cared budhaḥ || iti |
iti strīsapiṇḍane viśeṣaḥ |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasakalakaraṇādhipatipaṇḍitaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau pariśeṣakhaṇḍe śrāddhakalpe sapiṇḍīkaraṇaprayogo nāma ekaviṃśo ’dhyāyaḥ ||
[1657]
atha dvāviṃśo ’dhyāyaḥ |
atha sāṃvatsarikaśrāddhaprayogaḥ |
athaitāḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇāntāḥ pretakriyāḥ keṣāṃcit saṃvatsarāt prāk nārāyaṇabaliṃ kṛtvā ca na kāryāḥ |
tatrāha gautamaḥ |
pāpakarmaṇo na saṃsṛjeran striyaś cābhicāriṇīḥ |
vṛddhayājñavalkyaḥ |
sarpaviprahatānāṃ ca śṛṅgidaṃṣṭrisarīsṛpaiḥ |
śrāddham eṣāṃ na kartavyaṃ brahmadaṇḍahatāś ca ye |
saṃvartaḥ |
mahāpātakināṃ caiva tathā caivātmaghātinām |
udakaṃ piṇḍadānaṃ ca śrāddhaṃ caiva tu yat kṛtam |
nopatiṣṭhati tat sarvaṃ rākṣasair vipralupyate ||
smṛtyantarāt |
vidyudgonṛpaviprāmbuśṛṅgidaṃṣṭryagnighātitāḥ |
vṛthotpannamahāklībabratino nodabhājanāḥ ||
‘udabhājanāḥ' arghyodakasaṃsargabhājanā ity arthaḥ |
tathā ca |
brāhmaṇādihate tānte patite saṅgavarjite |
[1658] vyutkramāc ca mṛte deyaṃ yebhya eva dadāty asau ||
'saṅgavarjitaḥ' bhikṣuḥ |
bhaviṣyottarāt |
svecchayā maraṇaṃ viprāt śṛṅgidaṃṣṭrisarīsṛpaiḥ |
antyāntyajaviṣodbandhair ātmanā caiva tāḍanaiḥ ||
saṃpūrṇasarvagātrāṇāṃ viṣād ākarṣato ’tha vā |
jalāgnigarbhapātaiś ca nirāhārādibhis tathā ||
yeṣām evaṃ bhavet te vai kathitāḥ pāpakarmiṇaḥ |
pāṣaṇḍam āśritāś caiva mahāpātakinas tathā ||
striyaś ca vyabhicāriṇya ārūḍhapatitās tathā |
na teṣāṃ snānasaṃskārau na śrāddhaṃ na sapiṇḍanam |
śrāddhāni ṣoḍaśoktāni nānyāny api bhavanti hi ||
vaitānaṃ prakṣipet toye gṛhyāgniṃ ca catuṣpathe |
pātrāṇi nirdahed agnau sāgnike pāpakarmaṇi ||
ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
vyāpādayed ya ātmānaṃ svayam agnyudakādibhiḥ |
vihitaṃ tasya nāśaucaṃ nāpi kāryodakakriyā ||
sarpaviprahatānāṃ ca śṛṅgidaṃṣṭrisarīsṛpaiḥ |
ātmanas tyāgināṃ (?) caiva śrāddham eṣāṃ na kārayet ||
caṇḍālād udakāt sarpād brāhmaṇād vaidyutas tathā |
daṃṣṭribhyaś ca paśubhyaś ca maraṇaṃ pāpakarmiṇām ||
udakaṃ piṇḍadānaṃ ca śrāddhaṃ caiva tu yat kṛtam |
[1659] nopatiṣṭhati tat (?) sarvam antarikṣe ca tiṣṭhati ||
nārāyaṇabaliḥ kāryo lokagarhābhayān naraiḥ |
tasmāt tebhyo ’pi dātavyam annam eva sadakṣiṇam ||
nārāyaṇabalis tu purastād vakṣyate | 'tasmāt ' nārāyaṇabaler anantaram |
tathā |
kṛtvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ kriyāḥ kāryā yathāvidhi |
nārāyaṇabaliḥ kāryo lokagarhābhayān naraiḥ ||
annam iṣṭaṃ priyaṃ caiva vipre dadyāt sadakṣiṇam |
piṇḍodakakriyāḥ paścād vṛṣotsargādikaṃ ca yat |
ekoddiṣṭāni kurvīta sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ tathā ||
yo ’yam agnyudakādimṛtānāṃ nārāyaṇabalir uktaḥ sa tu krodhamadaśokādiyogena yair ātmaghātinas teṣām eva na tu pramādato vidito vā |
tathā ca bhaviṣyottare |
atha kaścit pramādena mriyate ’gnyudakādibhiḥ |
saṃskārapramukhaṃ tasya sarvaṃ kuryād yathāvidhi ||
kvacid etasyāpavādam āha |
pramādād icchayā vāpi na gacchet sarpato mṛtaḥ |
‘na gacchet' saṃskārādikarma prati na gacchet vakṣyamāṇaprakāranāgapūjāṃ vinā tan nārhatīty arthaḥ |
ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
atha kaścit pramādena mriyate ’gnyudakādibhiḥ |
tasyāśaucaṃ vidhātavyaṃ kartavyā codakakriyā ||
[1660] baudhāyanaḥ |
buddhipūrvaṅgahantṝṇāṃ kriyālopo vidhīyate |
teṣām eva ca saṃskartur deṣaśrutir udāhṛtā ||
dāhayitvā śavaṃ teṣāṃ śūdrair eva vidharmakam |
anyeṣāṃ pāpamaraṇaṃ prāptānāṃ pāpakarmaṇām ||
pūrvavat dehadāho ’tha śarīrasya prakalpanam |
pālāśavṛntaiḥ saṃskuryāt pitṛmedhavidhānataḥ ||
āhitāgnīnāṃ pāpamṛtānāṃ pratikṛtivarjanaṃ mukhyam eva śarīram āhitāgnim agnibhir dahanti yajñapātraiś cety ete na saṃskurvanti |
āha brahmagargaḥ |
yo ’nuṣṭhātuṃ na śaknoti mahāvyādhyupapīḍitaḥ |
so ’gnyudakamahāyātrāḥ kurvan nāmutra duṣyati ||
vivasvān |
sarvendriyaviraktasya vṛddhasya kṛtakarmaṇaḥ |
vyādhitasya smṛtaṃ tīrthe maraṇaṃ tapaso ’dhikam ||
tathā gāgryo ’pi gṛhastham evādhikṛtyāha |
mahāprasthānagamanaṃ jvalanāmbupraveśanam |
bhṛguprapatanaṃ caiva vṛthā necchet tu jīvitum ||
'bhṛguḥ' parvatakaṭakaḥ | 'vṛthā' dharmānuṣṭhānaśūnyam |
manur vānaprastham adhikṛtyāha |
aparājitāṃ cāsthāya vrajed diśam ajihnagaḥ |
ātipātāc charīrasya brahmaloke mahīyate ||
[1661] 'aparājitā ' pūrvottarā, tām ā śarīrapātād akuṭilaṃ jalam anilaṃ vā bhatayan samāhito vrajet |
sthitvā maharṣicaryāyāṃ tyaktvā pāpamayīṃ tanum |
vītaśokamayo vipro brahmabhūyāya kalpyate ||
gobrāhmaṇahatānāṃ tu viśeṣaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
gobrāhmaṇahatānāṃ ca patitānāṃ tathaiva ca |
urdhvaṃ saṃvatsarāt kuryāt sarvam evaurdhvadehikam ||
atha nārāyaṇabaliprayogaḥ |
tatra tāvat saṃskārādividheḥ baudhāyanasūtre |
athāto nārāyaṇabaliṃ vyākhyāsyāmo ’bhiśastapatitasurāpātmatyāgināṃ brāhmaṇahatānāṃ ca dvādaśavarṣāṇi trīṇi vā yatra yatra maraṇaṃ jātaṃ yasya syāt tatra tatra kurvīta | sahitānāṃ pālāśānāṃ grāme vāhūya | parṇasarūpāṇāṃ kṛṣṇājine puruṣākṛtiṃ karoti, hotṛkalpanena vā pitṛmedhikena vā saṃskāraṃ kuryāt | aṅgaprayogamantrān uddhṛtya puruṣasūktasya pratyṛcaṃ mantrāṇāṃ sthāne pṛthak prayogo bhavati ity api vā tūṣṇīṃ sarvaṃ kriyeta yāmyasūkto na poṣaṇaṃ pauruṣeṇopasthānaṃ samānam anyat tīrthe snātvā pretāyodakakriyāṃ kṛtvā nāma gotraṃ manasā dhyātvā nārāyaṇāyaitat te udakam iti cābhivyāhared evam eva sāyaṃ prātar daśarātraṃ karoti trirātreṇa vā piṇḍapradāne ’sāv etat te piṇḍa iti viśeṣaḥ | ekādaśyām ekoddiṣṭaṃ kurvanti |
saṃskāravidhiṃ prakṛtyoktaṃ tatraiva |
sarpamṛtānāṃ namo ’stu sarpebhyas tisra āhutīr hutvā udake mṛtānāṃ [1662] samudrāya vāyunāpetyāhutīr hutvā tasya kruddhaṃ satyaṃ na vidmaḥ dehasaṃskārapakṣo jñānamṛtadehinām ity āhuḥ, sarveṣām iti cāpare |
nārāyaṇabaliprayogas tu ṣaṭtriṃśanmate darśitaḥ |
teṣāṃ putrāś ca pautrā vā dāyādāḥ samabhiplutāḥ |
yathā śrāddhaṃ pratanvanti viṣṇunāmapratiśrutam ||
tathā vaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi namaskṛtya svayaṃbhuve |
ekādaśīṃ samāsādya śuklapakṣasya vai tithim ||
nārāyaṇabaliḥ kārya iti śeṣaḥ | atra viśeṣo bhaviṣyottare darśitaḥ |
pūrṇe saṃvatsare teṣām atha kāryaṃ dayālubhiḥ |
ekādaśīṃ samāsādya śuklapakṣasya vai tithim ||
viṣṇuṃ yamaṃ ca saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādibhis tathā |
daśa piṇḍān ghṛtābhyakān darbheṣu madhusaṃyutān ||
yajñopavītī satilān dhyāyan viṣṇuṃ yamaṃ tathā |
dakṣiṇābhimukhas tūṣṇīm ekaikaṃ nirvapet tu tān |
uddhṛtya niyatān piṇḍāṃs tīrthādyambhasi nikṣipet ||
etac ca viṣṇudhyānapūrvakaṃ kartavyam ity uktaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
viṣṇuṃ buddhau samāsādya nadyambhasi tataḥ kṣipet ||
bhaviṣyottare |
kṣipaṃs tān kīrtayen nāma viṣṇor vai pretakasya ca |
[1663] punar abhyarcayed viṣṇuṃ yamaṃ kusumacandanaiḥ ||
dhūpadīpaiḥ sanaivedyaiḥ bhakṣyabhojyasamanvitaiḥ |
tasmiṃś copavased ahni viprāṃś caiva nimantrayet ||
kulavidyātapoyuktān rūpaśīlasamanvitān |
nava saptātha vā pañca svasāmarthyānusārataḥ ||
baudhāyanasūtre |
athāto nārāyaṇabaliṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | dakṣiṇāyane vottarāyaṇe vā aparapakṣasya dvādaśyāṃ kriyeta pūrvedyuḥ ṣaṭ dvādaśa vā brāhmaṇān nimantrayeta yonigotraśrutavṛttasaṃpannān |
bhaviṣyottare |
apare ’hani saṃprāpte madhyāhne susamāhitaḥ |
viṣṇuṃ yamaṃ ca saṃpūjya viprāṃs tān upāśyate ||
udaṅmukhān yathājyeṣṭhaṃ pitṛrūpam anusmaran |
āvāhanārghyadānādīn viṣṇusaurisamannitān ||
pretasthāne smaran pretaṃ viṣṇor vai nāma kīrtayet |
yajñopavītī kurvīta pretanāma prakīrtayet |
pretaṃ yamaṃ ca viṣṇuṃ ca smaran śrāddhaṃ samāpayet ||
baudhāyanasūtre |
tathāparedyur devagṛhe nadītīre agnim upasamādhāya saṃparistīrya praṇītābhyaḥ kṛtvotthāyāgreṇāgnidevatām āvāhayati puruṣasūktena dve ṛcau japitvā vyāhṛtibhir devatām āvāhayati | athainaṃ snāpayati puruṣasūktenāthainaṃ gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpair aṣṭākṣareṇārcayitvādbhis tarpayati keśavaṃ [1664] tarpayāmīti dvādaśanāmadheyaiḥ paridhānaprabhṛtyāgnimukhāt kṛtvā pakvānnāj juhoti viṣṇor anukramiti puronuvākyām anūcya paromātrayeti yājyayā juhoti āvāhyāhutīr upajuhoti keśavāya svāhety etair eva nāmadheyair guḍapāyasaghṛtamiśram annaṃ nivedayati devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ puṣṇor (?) hastābhyāṃ viṣṇave nivedayāmīti saptavyāhṛtibhiḥ svāhākāreṇa japati | vyāhṛtibhir ācamanīyam atha brāhmaṇān āhūya sadarbhopakṛtasthāneṣūpaveśyāthaitān vastragandhapuṣpadhūpadīpamālyair abhyarcyābhyanujñāpya ghṛtamiśraṃ haviḥ samidhāyujya hastena juhoti pitṛbhyaḥ svadhā namo nārāyaṇāya svāheti pitāmahebhyaḥ svadhā namo nārāyaṇāya svāhā, agnaye kavyavāhanāya sviṣṭakṛte svadhā namo nārāyaṇāya svāheti brāhmaṇān annena paritoṣayitveti |
vakṣyamāṇaṃ kuryād iti śeṣaḥ |
bhaviṣyottare |
tṛptān jñātvā tato viprān tṛptiṃ pṛṣṭvā yathāvidhi |
annebhyas tv atha sarvebhyaḥ piṇḍadānārtham uddharet ||
pṛthakdarbheṣu piṇḍāṃs tu pañca dadyāt krameṇa tu |
prathamaṃ viṣṇave dadyāt brahmaṇe ca śivāya ca ||
sabhṛtyāya yamāyātha pretāyāpi ca pañcamam |
nāmagotraṃ smaret tasya viṣṇuśabdaṃ ca kīrtayet ||
namaskāraśiraskaṃ tu pañcamaṃ piṇḍam uddharet |
dadyād ācamanaṃ paścāt tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ tathā ||
ekaṃ vipraṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ hiraṇyena prapūjayet |
[1665] gobhūmivastrapānādyaiḥ śaktyā pretaṃ smaraṃś ca tam |
tatas tilāṃs tu viprāṇāṃ darbhayukteṣu pāṇiṣu |
nāma gotraṃ smaran dadyād viṣṇuḥ prīto ’stv iti bruvan ||
anuvrajya dvijān paścāt tilāmbho dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ |
kīrtayen nāmagotre tu bhuvi prīto ’stv iti kṣipet |
mitrabandhujanaiḥ sārdhaṃ śeṣaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
baudhāyaṇasūtre |
ācamayya teṣāṃ yathāśakti dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti | pradakṣiṇīkṛtya śeṣam anujñāpya dakṣiṇenāgniṃ prāgagrān darbhān saṃstīrya teṣu baliṃ dadāti | viśvebhyo devebhyo namaḥ sādhyebhyo devebhyo namaḥ sarvebhyo devebhyo namaḥ sarvābhyo devatābhyo namaḥ viṣṇave nārāyaṇāya namaḥ yajñātmane namo yajñapuruṣāya namaḥ sarveśvarāya namaḥ iti sviṣṭakṛtprabhṛtiṣiddham ā dhenuvarapradānāt (?) sarvān pitṝn samadhigacchati brahmaloke mahīyate brahmaloke mahīyate ity āha bhagavān baudhāyanaḥ |
nārāyaṇabaliṃ (?) prakṛtya bhaviṣyottare |
evaṃ kṛte gamiṣyanti svarlokaṃ pāpakarmiṇaḥ |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇādau tu kṛte naivāpnuvanti te ||
tathā |
evaṃ viṣṇumate sthitvā yo dadyād ātmaghātine |
samuddharati taṃ kṣipraṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
iti nārāyaṇabaliprayogaḥ |
atha nāgapūjāvidhiḥ |
[1666]
bhaviṣyottare |
pramādād icchayā vāpi nāgād vā sarpato mṛtaḥ
pakṣayor ubhayor nāgān pañcamīṣu prapūjayet ||
kuryāt piṣṭamayīṃ lekhāṃ nāgapratikṛtiṃ bhuvi |
arcayet tāṃ sitaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sagandhaiś candanena tu ||
pradadyād dhūpadīpaṃ tu taṇḍulāṃś ca sitān kṣipet |
āmapiṣṭaṃ tathaivānnaṃ kṣīraṃ ca vinivedayat ||
upasthāya vaded evaṃ muñca muñcāmukaṃ tv iti |
madhuraṃ taddine dadyād evam abdaṃ samācaret ||
sauvarṇaṃ śaktito nāgaṃ tato dadyād dvijottamaḥ |
gāṃ savatsāṃ tato dadyāt prīyatāṃ nāgarāḍ iti ||
yathā vibhāgaṃ kurvīta karmāṇi prāktanāny api |
nāgād vimokṣaṇārthaṃ tu proktam apy adhikaṃ tv idam |
dvijān vimokṣayitvā tu saṃprītāḥ santu pannagāḥ ||
iti nāgapūjāvidhiḥ |
atha proṣitamṛtadāhādiprayogaḥ |
tatra ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
deśāntaragatāḥ kecid adṛṣṭā ye mṛtāḥ śrutāḥ |
kathaṃ teṣāṃ kriyāḥ kāryā dahanādyāḥ savistarāḥ ||
atra kālaviśeṣam āha vṛddhamanuḥ |
proṣitasya yadā kālo gataś ced dvādaśābdikaḥ |
prāpte trayodaśe varṣe pretakarmāṇi kārayet ||
[1667] bhaviṣyottare |
pitari proṣite tasya na vārtā naiva vāgamaḥ |
ūrdhvaṃ pañcadaśād varṣāt kṛtvā tatpratirūpakam ||
kuryāt tasya tu saṃskāraṃ saṃskāravidhinā tataḥ |
tadādīny eva sarvāṇi śeṣakarmāṇi kārayet ||
atra pratirūpakaraṇam asthnām alābha eva veditavyam | tatsadbhāve tu śāstrāntarokto viśeṣaḥ | tad yathā |
atra proṣitamṛtasya viśeṣaḥ kathyate | prāg dāhād agnihotraṃ hotavyaṃ prācīnāvītinā saṃparistaraṇaṃ tasyaivāpradakṣiṇaṃ paryukṣaṇaṃ na kuryād dakṣiṇata uṣṇabhasmanirūhaṇaṃ tatrādhiśrayaṇaṃ nāvadyotanāsekaḥ dakṣiṇata udvāsanaṃ sakṛn nidhānaṃ praiṣarahitaṃ sakṛd unnayanaṃ srucaḥ samiddhāraṇaṃ savyajānunipātanaṃ samidādhānaṃ sakṛt sarvaprakṣepaḥ tataḥ kṛṣṇājine ’sthnāṃ puruṣākṛtikaraṇaṃ ghṛtābhyañjanaṃ ūrṇābhiḥ pracchādanaṃ pūrvavat pātrayojanaṃ saṃtāpajāgnibhir dāhaḥ | caturthe ’hni saṃcayanādi pūrvavad iti |
ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
dāhas tasyāsthināśe tu brahmadarbhaiḥ kṛtasya tu |
uktaṃ kātyāyanenedaṃ pretābhāve manīṣiṇā ||
kuryād darbhamayaṃ pretaṃ kuśais triśataṣaṣṭibhiḥ |
palāśair vā samidbhis tu saṃkhyā caivaṃ prakīrtitā ||
pretākāraṃ tataḥ kuryād dhastapādādicihnitam |
[1668] apeta iti japtvā vai daheta vidhipūrvakam ||
atra śirogrīvādipretaśarīrāvayavabhedena kuśādeḥ saṃkhyāvibhāgam āha yajñapārśvaḥ |
catvāriṃśac chiraḥsthāne grīvāyāṃ ca daśaiva tu |
uraḥsthāne śataṃ dadyāt ṣaṣṭiś ca jaṭharodare ||
bāhvoḥ sthāne śataṃ dadyād viṃśatir jānujaṅghayoḥ |
dadyāc catvāri śiśne tu ṣaḍ dadyād vṛṣaṇadvayoḥ |
pādāṅgulīṣu ca daśa kalpayed asthisaṃgraham ||
urṇābhiḥ pracchādya ghṛtenābhyajya pūrvavat pātrayojanaṃ kṛtvā saṃtāpajāgnibhir eva dahed iti |
bhaviṣyottare |
śirasy aśītyardhaṃ dadyād grīvāyāṃ tu daśaiva tu |
vāhvoś caiva śataṃ dadyād viṃśatiṃ ca tathorasi ||
udare viṃśatiṃ (?) dadyāt triṃśac ca kaṭideśayoḥ |
ūrvoś caiva śataṃ dadyāt triṃśac ca jānujaṅghayoḥ |
pādāṅgulīṣu ca daśa eṣā ca pretakalpanā ||
atra kṛṣṇājine kuśaiḥ puruṣākṛtiṃ kṛtvā palāśavṛntanidhānaṃ tatraiva saṃkhyāvibhāga iti madhuśarmamiśrāḥ |
bhaviṣyottare |
gṛhasthe proṣite yas tu kvacic cet mriyate gṛhe |
āśauce ’pagate tatra prārambhe śrāddhakarmaṇi ||
pratyāgataś cet jānāti pūrvavṛttaṃ gṭahe tadā |
[1669] aśaucaṃ gṛhiṇas tatra taddravyādes tadā bhavet ||
aputrādinā yat prārabdhaṃ śrāddhaṃ tat tena cākhilam |
samāpanīyaṃ tatrāpi gṛhī tiṣṭhet sudūrataḥ ||
anantaraṃ yat kartavyaṃ tad āha vṛddhamanuḥ |
amṛtaṃ mṛtam ākarṇya kṛtaṃ yasyaurdhvadehikam |
prāyaścittam asau smārtaṃ kṛtvāgnīn ādadhīta ca || iti |
prāyaścittam atra jātakarmādivivāhāntaṃ punaḥsaṃskaraṇaṃ veditavyam |
ata evoktaṃ tenaiva |
jīvan yadi sa āgacched ghṛtakuṇḍe nimajya tam |
uddhṛtya snāpayitvāsya jātakarmādi kārayet ||
tathā |
dvādaśāhaṃ vratacaryā trirātram atha vāsya tu |
snātvodvahet tato bhāryām anyāṃ vā tadabhāvataḥ ||
agnīn ādhāya vidhivad vrātyastomena vā yajet |
tathaindrāgnena paśunā giriṃ gatvā tu tatra tu ||
iṣṭim āyuṣmatīṃ kuryād īpsitāṃś ca kratūṃs tataḥ |
‘āyuṣmatīm iṣṭiṃ' āyuḥkāmeṣṭim ity arthaḥ |
iti proṣitamṛtadāhādikarmaprayogaḥ |
atha sāṃvatsaraṃ śrāddhaṃ brūte hemādripaṇḍitaḥ |
khaṇḍitāśeṣadoṣorminirmalīkṛtamānasaḥ ||
atha sāṃvatsarikaśrāddhaprayogaḥ |
tatra kālādhikāridevatāḥ pūrvameva pratipāditāḥ
[1670] āha logākṣiḥ |
śrāddhaṃ kuryād avaśyaṃ tu pramītapitṛkaḥ svayam |
indukṣaye māsi māsi vṛddhau pratyabdam eva ca ||
svayaṃgrahaṇam ādarārthaṃ na punaḥ putraśiṣyavargādinivṛttyartham, "asāv etat ta iti mantreṇa yajamānasya pitre ṛtvigādiḥ piṇḍān dadyād" iti smṛtyantare ’bhidhānāt | etac ca yajamānasyāsāmarthye gurutarakāryāntaravyagratvena kālātipattiviṣaye vā draṣṭavyam |
jābāliḥ |
uparāgasahasrāṇi amāvāsyāyutāni ca |
akṣayaṃ tu bhavec chrāddhaṃ yas tu dadyān mṛte ’hani ||
akaraṇe doṣam āha kārṣṇājiniḥ |
ūṣare tu yathā kṣiptaṃ bījaṃ na pratirohati |
tathā ca tad bhavet teṣāṃ yan na dattaṃ mṛtāhani ||
tena mṛtāhe avaśyaṃ dātavyam ity abhiprāyaḥ |
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
saṃvatsare kecid ekasmai dānaṃ tribhyaḥ pare jaguḥ |
ataḥ smṛtyavirodhena nirṇayaṃ śrotum arhatha |
'ekasmai dānam' ity anena ekoddiṣṭavat sāṃvatsarikaśrāddhaprayoga uktaḥ | 'tribhya' ity anena pārvaṇavad iti | ekoddiṣṭavidhāyakāni tāvad vākyāni likhyante | tatrāha yamaḥ |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇād ūrdhvaṃ pratisaṃvatsaraṃ sutaḥ |
ekoddiṣṭaṃ prakurvīta pitror anyatra pārvaṇam ||
[1671] vyāsaḥ |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇād ūrddhvaṃ yatra yatra pradīyate |
tatra tatra trayaṃ kāryaṃ varjayitvā mṛtāhani ||
pratisaṃvatsaraṃ yatra mātāpitroḥ pradīyate |
adaivaṃ bhojayec chrāddhaṃ piṇḍam ekaṃ ca nirvapet ||
gārgyaḥ |
kṛte ’pi sahapiṇḍatve gaṇasāmānyatāṃ gate |
pratisaṃvatsaraṃ śrāddham evāsyaiva vidhīyate ||
laugākṣir apy āha |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇāt pūrvam ekoddiṣṭaṃ sutaḥ pituḥ |
ūrddhvaṃ ca pārvaṇaṃ kuryāt pratyabdam itareṇa tu ||
'itareṇa' ity ekoddiṣṭavidhānenety arthaḥ |
śātātapa āha |
saṃkrāntyāv uparāge ca parvotsavamahālaye |
nirvapet trīn sutaḥ piṇḍān ekam eva kṣaye ’hani ||
āpastambaḥ |
ekasya prathamaṃ śrāddhaṃ arvag abdāc ca māsikam |
pratisaṃvatsaraṃ caiva śeṣaṃ tripuruṣaṃ viduḥ ||
yamena tv ekoddiṣṭaṃ sāṃvatsarikaṃ vidhāya tasyākaraṇe doṣa uktaḥ |
ekoddiṣṭaṃ parityajya pārvaṇaṃ kurute yadi |
akṛtaṃ tad vijānīyāt sa mātṛpitṛghātakaḥ ||
adhunā pārvaṇavidhāyakāni vacanāni likhyante |
[1672] tatra śātātapaḥ |
pradānaṃ yatra yatraiṣāṃ sapiṇḍīkaraṇāt param |
tatra pārvaṇavac chrāddhaṃ jñeyam abhyudayārthinā ||
ye sapiṇḍīkṛtāḥ pretā na teṣāṃ tu pṛthakkriyā |
na pṛthak piṇḍadānaṃ tu tasmād ūrdhvaṃ vidhīyate |
pretatvāc ceha nistīrṇāḥ prāptāḥ pitṛgaṇāṃs tu te ||
yataś caivam ata eva punar āha |
yaḥ sapiṇḍīkṛtaṃ pretaṃ pṛthak piṇḍe niyojayet |
vidhighnas tena bhavati pitṛhā copajāyate ||
pulastyaḥ |
ekoddiṣṭaṃ tu kartavyaṃ yāvat pitroḥ sapiṇḍanam |
tataḥ sapiṇḍanād ūrdhvam ekoddiṣṭaṃ nivartate ||
prajāpatir apy āha |
asapiṇḍīkṛtān pretān ekoddiṣṭena vartayet |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇad ūrdhvaṃ tribhiḥ sāmānyam ucyate ||
yataś caivam ata eva dharmaḥ,
pārvaṇaṃ parvakāle tu tathā kāmārthasampadā |
vṛddhau vṛddhividhānena ekasya saha yojanāt ||
iti pratipādyordhvaṃ ca sapiṇḍīkaraṇād ekoddiṣṭaṃ na saṃbhavatītyāha sa eva |
saṃnītānāṃ sadaikas tu varteta na kathaṃcana |
sahasaṃskārahetutvāt pṛthaktvaṃ nopapadyate ||
evaṃ sapiṇḍīkṛtasyaikoddiṣṭaṃ nirākṛtya [1673] māsikādyekoddiṣṭhānānuvādena pratyabdaṃ mṛtāhani pārvaṇam āha sa eva |
ekasya prathamaṃ śrāddham arvāg abdāc ca māsikam |
paraṃ saṃnayanāt pitror mṛtāhany api pārvaṇam ||
tathā |
saṃnītau pitarau yena putreṇa vidhisaṃpadā |
vṛddhāv abhyuditaṃ tasya pārvaṇaṃ tad ato ’nyathā ||
ato vṛddhiśrāddham utsṛjyānyatra sarvadā sarvatra mṛtāhādiṣu kṛtasapiṇḍīkaraṇasya pituḥ pārvaṇam eva kartavyam iti |
tathā |
devatvapadavīṃ nītaḥ pitā vai mantrasaṃpadā |
pretatvaṃ na punar yāti nīyamāno ’pi putrakaiḥ ||
svatantrā devatāḥ sarvāḥ svatantrā ca sapiṇḍatā |
bhūyaḥ pṛthak tatkaraṇaśūnyaṃ pretaniveśanam ||
uttamāṃ gatim āsthāya pitṛdevarṣayo yathā |
necchanti kugatiṃ yadvat pretā apy ekaśaḥ kṛtāḥ ||
pāraskaraḥ |
pretaṃ pitṛṣu saṃnīya piṇḍadānārghyadānayoḥ |
uddhṛtya narakāt pretaṃ bhūyas tatra na pātayet ||
āha śambhuḥ |
sahapiṇḍakriyāyāṃ tu vidhinā sarvakālikam |
tatsahatvabalīyastvāt sarvatraiva tripauruṣam ||
ata eva jātūkarṇyaḥ |
[1674] ata ūrdhvaṃ na kartavyam ekoddiṣṭaṃ kadācana |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇāntaṃ ca tat proktam iti mudgalaiḥ ||
tathā |
tataḥ saṃvatsare pūrṇe sapiṇḍīkaraṇe kṛte |
nirāśāḥ pitaro yānti ekasyāvāhane kṛte ||
āvāhanaṃ cātrāmantrakaṃ vivakṣitam |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
rājan saṃvatsare pūrṇe sapiṇḍīkaraṇe kṛte |
nirāśāḥ pitaro yānti ekasyāvāhane kṛte ||
ekoddiṣṭaṃ tu kartavyaṃ yāvat pitroḥ sapiṇḍanam |
rājan sapiṇḍanād ūrdhvam ekoddiṣṭaṃ nivartate ||
na pṛthak piṇḍadānaṃ tu tasmād ūrdhvaṃ vidhīyate |
pretānām iha sarveṣāṃ yo mantreṣu niyojitaḥ ||
pretatvaṃ caiva nistīrṇaḥ prāptaḥ pitṛgaṇaṃ tu saḥ |
cyavate pitṛlokāt tu pṛthakpiṇḍaniyojanāt ||
pariṇītā yathā yoṣin na gacchet paitṛkaṃ kulam |
preto ’py evaṃ mahārāja saṃyuktaḥ pitṛbhiḥ sadā ||
saṃvatsaraṃ bhaved yāvad ekoddiṣṭaṃ ca tad bhavet |
saṃvatsare vyatīte tu tribhiḥ sāmānyam ucyate ||
kṛtārthās tv iha saṃvṛttāḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇe kṛte |
te gaṇā pitṛlokaṃ tu yathāha bhagavān śivaḥ ||
[1675] sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā kuryāt pārvaṇavat sadā |
pratisaṃvatsare vidvān ity evaṃ viṣṇur abravīt ||
śrutir api |
daivā vā asurān hatvā pitṛtvaṃ samavindata sarvānavaṣṭabdhāḥ sahaiveti bruvan ye naḥ samānās te vaḥ parasyānusvaṃ bhāgaṃ pratigṛhanty evam evābhūd iti |
'ye naḥ samānā' iti ye pitaro no 'smākaṃ samānāḥ sadṛśās tulyāḥ sapiṇḍīkṛtāḥ ity arthaḥ | te devās te pitaraḥ vo yuṣmākaṃ paścāt svaṃ bhāgaṃ pratigṛhṇantīty evam evābhūd iti | tena sapiṇḍīkaraṇād ūrdhvaṃ yadā pitṛbhyo dātavyaṃ tadā pūrvaṃ devebhyo datvā paścāt pitṛbhya ity avagamāt pratyabdaṃ mṛtāhani pārvaṇaṃ śrāddhaṃ kartavyam ity adhyavasīyate, viśeṣato ’pi tatra pārvaṇavidhir dṛśyate |
āha jātūkarṇyaḥ |
pituḥ pitṛgaṇasthasya kuryāt pārvaṇavat sutaḥ |
pratyabdaṃ pratimāsaṃ ca vidhir jñeyaḥ sanātanaḥ ||
'pitṛgaṇasthḥ' kṛtasapiṇḍīkaraṇaḥ | 'sanātanaḥ' āvaśyakaḥ |
śātātapaḥ |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā kuryāt pārvaṇavat sadā |
pratisaṃvatsaraṃ vidvān chāgaleyodito vidhiḥ ||
jamadagniḥ |
devatārahitaṃ śrāddham uddiṣṭam aphalaṃ yataḥ |
ataḥ śrāddheṣu sarvatra mṛtāhany api pārvaṇam ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
[1676] ekoddiṣṭaṃ praśaṃsanti kecid rājan mṛtāhani |
kecit tu pārvaṇaṃ rājan praśaṃsanti mṛtāhani ||
kṛtvā tu pārvaṇaṃ śrāddham ekoddiṣṭaṃ na kārayet |
kurvan narakam āyāti viśeṣāc ca mṛtāhani ||
pretaḥ prayojito vīra niyuktaḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha ||
na vartate kṣaṇam api yathā mātrā vinā sutaḥ ||
bālavatsaṃ (?) yathā mātrā viyojya narakaṃ vrajet |
tathā pretaṃ niyojyāśu ekoddiṣṭena mānavaḥ ||
abdam ekaṃ prakurvīta ekoddiṣṭaṃ mṛtāhani |
tataḥ paraṃ tu saṃnīte pārvaṇaṃ syān mṛtāhani ||
ata ūrdhvaṃ na kurvīta ekoddiṣṭaṃ kadācana |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇād ūrdhvaṃ varṣe varṣe mṛtāhani ||
kartavyaṃ pārvaṇaṃ rājan naikoddiṣṭaṃ kadācana |
udakumbhaś ca dātavyo mṛtāhani sadā tathā ||
gārgya āha |
samānte pitṛbhiḥ pretaṃ yojayet pitaraṃ sutaḥ |
tadādi pārvaṇaṃ śrāddhaṃ mṛtāhany api nānyathā ||
śrutir api |
māsi māsy ṛtāv ṛtau pratihemantagrīṣmavarṣāsu pratisaṃvatsare ca devāś ca pitaraś ca sahāstām iti |
viśvedevāḥ pitṛpitāmahādayaś ca śrāddhaṃ bhokuṃ saha tiṣṭhantītyarthaḥ |
sumantuḥ |
[1677] kartavyaṃ pārvaṇaṃ rājan naikoddiṣṭaṃ kadācana |
bahūni atra vākyāni munigītāni vakṣyate ||
alpetarāṇi rājendra ekoddiṣṭaṃ pracakṣyate |
tasmād vacanasāmarthyāt pārvaṇaṃ syān mṛtāhani || iti |
'vacanasāmarthyāt' bahutarāṇāṃ vacanānāṃ sāmarthyād ity arthaḥ |
ayam evārtho jaiminināpy uktaḥ |
vipratiṣiddhadharmasamavāye bhūyasāṃ syāt sadharmatvaṃ tad evaṃ vacanadvaidhe sati viṣayavyavasthā kartavyā |
āha jābālaḥ |
śrutidvaidhaṃ tu yatra syāt tatra dharmāv ubhau smṛtau |
smṛtidvaidhe tu viṣayaḥ kalpanīyaḥ pṛthak pṛthak ||
tatra tāvat pārvaṇavidhāyakāni vākyāny aurasaputraviṣayāṇi veditavyāni |
ata eva jamadagniḥ |
āpādya sahasapiṇḍatvam auraso vidhivat sutaḥ |
kurvīta darśavac chrāddhaṃ mātāpitroḥ kṣaye ’hani ||
putrāṇām aurasaḥ putraḥ putramātrās tathāpare |
pituḥ pitṛgaṇasyasya nityaṃ kuryāt sa pārvaṇam ||
aurasagrahaṇaṃ kṣetrajasyāpy upalakṣaṇam |
ata eva jābāliḥ |
aurasakṣetrajau putrau vidhinā pārvaṇena tu |
pratyabdam itare kuryuḥ ekoddiṣṭaṃ sutā daśa ||
[1678] sumantuḥ |
pratyabdaṃ pārvaṇenaiva vidhinā kṣetrajaurasau |
kurvāte ’nye sutāḥ kuryur ekoddiṣṭaṃ sutā daśa ||
pituḥ pitṛgaṇasthasya kuryātāṃ darśavat sutau |
pratyabdaṃ pratimāsaṃ ca vidhijñau kṣetrajaurasau ||
'pratyabdaṃ' mṛtāhani, 'pratimāsaṃ' darśādāv iti | darśagrahaṇāc ca putrikāputrasyāpi mātur mṛtāhani pārvaṇam evāvagamyate tasyaurasena saha tulyatvāt darśānām evaikoddiṣṭaniyamāc ca |
āha dharmaḥ |
mṛtāhany ekam uddiśya saṃnītānāṃ dvigotriṇaḥ |
pārvaṇaṃ tad ato ’nyatra yatra yatrādhikārataḥ ||
sapiṇḍīkaraṇāt pūrvaṃ māsi māsi mṛtāhany ekam uddiśya śrāddhaṃ putrikāputreṇa kāryam | saṃnītānāṃ kṛtasapiṇḍīkaraṇānāṃ tu kṣayāhe tato ’nyatra saṃkrāntivyatīpātādāv api pārvaṇam eva kartavyam ity arthaḥ I
śāṭyāyanaḥ |
sahapiṇḍakriyāyāṃ tu yaḥ putro ’dhikṛtaḥ pituḥ |
sa eva darśavac chrāddhaṃ vidadhīta mṛtāhani ||
etac caurasādiṣu bahuṣv eva putreṣu satsu draṣṭavyam | bahuputreṣu satsv api mukhyatayā aurasādīnām eva sapiṇḍīkaraṇādhikārāt |
tad uktaṃ gāruḍapurāṇe |
mukhya eva sutaḥ kuryāt sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ pituḥ |
aurasas tu suto mukhyas tad ṛte kṣetrajas tathā ||
[1679] aurasādibhir api pratyabdaṃ mṛtāhni pārvaṇaṃ sāgnibhir eva kartavyam |
yata āha manuḥ |
na paitṛyajñiyo homo laukike ’gnau vidhīyate |
na darśena vinā śrāddham āhitāgner dvijanmanaḥ ||
'darśena' darśopalakṣitena vidhinā, varjitaṃ śrāddhaṃ āhitāgninā na kartavyaṃ kiṃ tu darśaśrāddhavidhinaiva kartavyam ity arthaḥ | na tu darśaśrāddhaṃ vinānyacchrāddham eva na kartavyam iti vyākhyeyam | tasya kṣayāhaśrāddhāder apy abhāvaprasaṅgāt |
yamo ’py āha |
śrāddhakriyaikatānteṣu praśastān manur abravīt |
na darśena vinā śrāddham āhitāgner dvijanmanaḥ ||
manuḥ |
bahvagnayaś ca ye viprā ye caikāgnaya eva ca |
teṣāṃ sapiṇḍanād ūrdhvam ekoddiṣṭaṃ na pārvaṇam ||
atraikoddiṣṭaṃ neti saṃbadhaḥ |
ata eva kārṣṇājiniḥ |
agnipradhānaṃ sarveṣām anuṣṭhānaṃ gṛhāśrame |
tadyogāt kṛtasāmarthyāḥ sarvatrārhanti pārvaṇam ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
varṣe varṣe tu kuryād vai pārvaṇaṃ yo ’gnimān dvijaḥ |
kuryād anagnimān vīra ekoddiṣṭaṃ mṛtāhani ||
tasmāt sāgnibhir aurasakṣetrajaputrikāputraiḥ pratyabdaṃ mṛtāhani pārvaṇam eva kartavyam naikoddiṣṭam iti |
[1680] yat tu gārgyavacanam |
pramītapitṛkaḥ śrāddhaṃ parvakāle yathāvidhi |
mṛtāhani yathārucyā vṛddhāv abhyuditā kriyā ||
yathārucyā pārvaṇaikoddiṣṭayor madhye vikalpenaikasyānuṣṭhānam iti, tan niragnikaurasakṣetrajaputrikāputraviṣayam |
yata āha dharmaḥ |
vidhitritayam āmnātaṃ sāgner nāsty agnivarjite |
ekoddiṣṭavidhānena kriyā tasyocyate na ca ||
asāv etat ta iti yajamānasya pitre, asāv etat ta iti pitāmahāya, asāv etat ta iti prapitāmahāyety etad vidhitritayam | etac ca sāgner eva, niragnes tu ekoddiṣṭaṃ pārvaṇaṃ veti vikalpaḥ | tathāpi yeṣāṃ paramparayā pārvaṇam eva kriyate tais tad eva kartavyaṃ yeṣām ekoddiṣṭam eva kriyate tair ekoddiṣṭam eveti,
yenāsya pitaro yātā yena yātāḥ pitāmahāḥ |
tena yāyāt satāṃ mārgaṃ taṃ na gacchan na duṣyati ||
iti manuvacanāt |
tena niragnikaurasakṣetrajaputrikāputrair mṛtāhani pārvaṇaṃ vikalpena kartavyam | sāgnikais tu pārvaṇam eva anyais tu dattakādibhir daśabhiḥ putrair ekoddiṣṭam eveti sthitam |
uktaṃ ca bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
niragner aurasasyoktam ekoddiṣṭaṃ mṛtāhani |
pratyabdaṃ pārvaṇaṃ sāgner anyeṣāṃ tu na pārvaṇam ||
[1681] anyeṣāṃ dattakādīnāṃ daśavidhānām |
pulastyaḥ |
pratyabdam etad ekasya kuryuḥ śrāddhaṃ sutā daśa |
anagnimān aurasaś ca kuryāt sāgnis tu pārvaṇam ||
nanu ca —
parvakālo mṛtāhaś ca yady ekatra dvayaṃ bhavet |
pārvaṇaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ naikoddiṣṭaṃ kadācana ||
amāyāṃ vākṣayo yasya pretapakṣe ’tha vā bhavet |
pārvaṇaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ naikoddiṣṭaṃ kadācana ||
iti vacanāt,
pretapakṣe pramītasya pituḥ kurvīta pārvaṇam |
pitṛvyabhrātṛmān nṛṇām ekoddiṣṭaṃ na pārvaṇam ||
iti vacanāc ca, pretapakṣāmāvāsyākṣayāha eva sāgninām aurasaputrāṇāṃ pārvaṇavidhir astu na sarvatreti ucyate | niragnikānām aurasādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ pretapakṣāmāvāsyākṣayāhe pārvaṇam ebhir vākyair niyamyate | tathāhi 'naikoddiṣṭaṃ kadācana' ityādivākyaśeṣeṇaikoddiṣṭaṃ niṣidhya pārvaṇaniyama ebhir vākyaiḥ kriyate | ekoddiṣṭaprāptiś ca niragnikānām eva na sāgnikānām | 'na darśena vinā śrāddham āhitāgner dvijanmanaḥ' iti vākayena teṣāṃ pārvaṇasya niyatatvāt | ato niragnikānāṃ pakṣaprāptaṃ pārvaṇaṃ pretapakṣāmāvāsyākṣayāhe niyamyate | atredam eva kartavyaṃ naikoddiṣṭam iti |
[1682] kiṃ ca |
sāgnīnām aurasādīnāṃ trayāṇām amāvāsyāpretapakṣakṣayāha eva pārvaṇaṃ nānyatreti niyamyamāne teṣāṃ pretapakṣāmāvāsyākṣayāhād anyatra kṣayāhe śrāddhābhāvaprasaṅgaḥ | tatra pārvaṇaniyamād anyatraikoddiṣṭaprāptir iti cet |
na, 'ekoddiṣṭaṃ sutā daśa' iti vākyena dattakādīnāṃ daśavidhānām eva tasya niyamitatvād iti | etac ca sāṃvatsarikaśrāddhaṃ pārvaṇetikartavyatākam api pitṛkṣayāhe pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahānāṃ trayāṇām eva kartavyaṃ na mātāmahānām api |
śraha saṃgrahakāraḥ |
yājñavalkyena kālas tu amāvāsyādinoditaḥ |
aviśeṣeṇa pitrasya tathā mātāmahasya ca ||
yugapac ca sa vijñeyo vacanād vakṣyamāṇakāt |
kālābhedena tantraṃ syād deśābhedena caiva hi ||
tasmāt tantravidhānāt tu yaugapadyaṃ pratīyate |
amāvāsyādikāleṣu mātāmahasahakriyā |
mṛtāhani tu tadbhāvān na yujyeta pṛthakkriyā ||
asyārthaḥ | amāvāsyāṣṭakāvṛddhir ityādinā yājñavalkyavacanena pitṛśrāddhasya mātāmahaśrāddhasya ca sāmānyenāmāvāsyādikāla uktaḥ | sa ca [1683] yugapadanuṣṭhīyamānayoḥ pitṛśrāddhamātāmahaśrāddhayor aṅgatvenāvagantavyaḥ,
mātāmahānām apy evaṃ tantraṃ vā vaiśvadevikam |
iti tasminn eva prakaraṇe vaiśvadevikatantratvābhidhānasya yugapadanuṣṭhīyamāna evopapadyamānatvāt | ata ekakāla evānuṣṭhīyamānatvenāvagatayoḥ paitṛkamātāmahaśrāddhayoḥ samānatantratā yujyate | mṛtāhe tu pratipuruṣam āyuḥpramāṇabhedāt pitṛmātāmahakṣayāhabhedena mātāmahaśrāddhasyāpi pitṛkṣayāho na kāla itarannibandhanā samānatantratā na yujyate |
nanv anenaiva nyāyena pitṛpitāmahakṣayāhabhedāt pitṛkṣayāhe pitāmahādīnāṃ śrāddhaṃ na kartavyaṃ syāt |
maivaṃ | 'kurvīta darśavac chrāddham' ityatideśavacanāt pitāmahaprapitāmahayor api pitṛkṣayāhe devatātvam | na ca vācyaṃ 'darśavad' ityatideśavacanād eva, "pitaro yatra pūjyante tatra mātāmahā dhruvam" iti vacanāc ca mātāmahādīnām api devatātvam iti |
āha vyāsaḥ |
darśavat syāt trayoddeśaḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇe kṛte |
pāraskaraḥ |
pitur gatasya devatvaṃ aurasasya tripauruṣam |
sarvatrānekagotrāṇām ekasyaiva mṛtāhani ||
'devatvaṃ gatasya' sapiṇḍīkaraṇena pitṛtvaṃ prāptasya, 'pituḥ' kṣayāini 'aurasasya' putrasya, 'tripauruṣaṃ' tridevatyaṃ, śrāddhaṃ kartavyam | 'anekagotrāṇāṃ' bhinnagotrāṇāṃ dauhitrādīnāṃ, anapatyamātāmahādiśrāddham ekodiṣṭam evety arthaḥ | tena darśavad ity atideśaprāpte (?) ṣaḍdevatye tripauruṣam iti punarabhidhānāt pitṛkṣayāhe mātāmahādīnāṃ parisaṃkhyā [1684] bhavati |
nanu yat tripuruṣaṃ tadaurasasyeti tripauruṣoddeśenaurasasya niyantritasya coddeśyaviśeṣaṇatvenāvivakṣitatvān mātāmahādiparisaṃkhyā |
maivaṃ, kṣayāhani tridaivatyaśrāddhaprāptyabhāvāt | 'darśavat syāt trayoddeśa' iti vacanāt sapiṇḍīkaraṇottarakālaṃ mṛtāhe ’pi sāmānyena tridaivatyaprāptir iti cet | evaṃ tarhy anenaiva mātāmahādīnāṃ parisaṃkhyā bhaviṣyati | kiṃ ca | 'aurasasya tripauruṣam' ity atra trigrahaṇasyāvivakṣite tvavākyam (?) evānarthakaṃ syāt | na hi mṛtāhe pauruṣam apauruṣaṃ ca śrāddham asti yena pauruṣam aurasasya apauruṣam anyeṣām ity evaṃ vyavasthāpanārthaṃ vākyaṃ bhavet | anenaiva ca nyāyena na sapanīkānām uddeśaḥ kāryaḥ | na ca 'svena bhartrā samaṃ śrāddhaṃ mātā bhuṅkta' ityādivacanāt pārvaṇavat sapatnīkānām uddeśa iti vācyam |
yata āha vyāsaḥ |
anvaṣṭakāṣu vṛddhau ca pratisaṃvatsare tathā |
atra mātuḥ pṛthak śrāddham anyatra patinā saha ||
yadāpi pitṛsāṃvatsarikaśrāddhakālo mātṛsāṃvatsarikaśrāddhakālaś ca daivād eka āpannas tadāpi pitṛsāṃvatsarikaśrāddhe pitrādīnāṃ sapatnīkānāṃ uddeśo na kartavyaḥ, idaṃ tu maraṇapaurvāparyānusāreṇa tayoḥ sāṃvatsarikaśrāddhadvayaṃ tantreṇa śrapaṇaṃ kṛtvā nimantraṇādi dvijavisarjanāntaṃ pṛthag eva kāryam | yadā tu maraṇapaurvāparyam ajñātaṃ tadā pūrvaṃ pituḥ sāṃvatsarikaṃ paścān mātur ity evaṃ śrāddhadvayaṃ kāryaṃ pitur mukhyatvāt | evam eva bhrātrādisāṃvatsarikaśrāddhadinaike ’pi jyeṣṭhādikrameṇānekaśrāddhaṃ kartavyam | etac ca sarvaṃ kālasaṃnipātaprakaraṇe vistareṇa pratipāditam |
[1685] anvārohaṇaviṣaye tu dampatīśrāddhaprakāram āha laugākṣiḥ |
mṛtāhani samāsena piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ pṛthak |
navaśrāddhaṃ ca dampatyor anvārohaṇa eva tu ||
'samāsena' saṃkṣepeṇa, piṇḍanirvapaṇam |
yathā dvipitṛkaśrāddhe dvayoḥ pitror amukanāmne amukanāmne cety uddiśya eka eva piṇḍo dīyate tathehāpy ekasmin piṇḍe dvayor mātāpitror asukāyāmukāyai cety uddeśaṃ kṛtvā eka eva piṇḍo deyaḥ | etac ca śrāddham anekoddeśyaśālitvarūpāl liṅgāt pārvaṇadharmakam | tenātra vaiśvadevikaṃ tantreṇa kāryam | 'pṛthak navaśrāddhaṃ ca dampatyoḥ' iti | navaśrāddhaṃ prāg daśāhāt navaśrāddhadineṣu kriyamāṇaṃ śrāddhaṃ pṛthak pitur mātuḥ kāryam |
yat tu gārgyeṇoktam,
ekacityāṃ samārūḍhau dampatī nidhanaṃ gatau |
pṛthak śrāddhaṃ tayoḥ kuryād odanaṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak ||
'odanaṃ' odanapiṇḍaḥ – tat tu navaśrāddhaviṣayaṃ na tu sāṃvatsarikaviṣayam apīti na pūrvavacanavirodhaḥ |
yat tu bhṛguṇoktam,
yā samārohaṇaṃ kuryād bhartuś cityāṃ pativratā |
tāṃ mṛtāhani saṃprāpte pṛthakpiṇḍe niyojayet |
pratyabdaṃ ca navaśrāddhaṃ yugapat tu samāpayet ||
tad eṣāṃ dattakādīnām ekoddiṣṭavidhānena mātāpitroḥ sāṃvatsarikaśrāddhaṃ vihitaṃ tadviṣayaṃ navaśrāddhaṃ yugapat tu samāpayed ity asyāyam [1686] arthaḥ | mātāpitror mṛtāhaikye mātrā caikacityām anvārohaṇe kṛte pitur navaśrāddhaṃ mātur navaśrāddhaṃ caikakālam ekapākena prādhānyāt pūrvāṅgakalāpaṃ kṛtvā prathamaṃ pitre paścān mātre ca śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā pāścātyāṅgakalāpaṃ ca tantreṇa kuryād iti | anekamātṛbhir ekacityām anvārohaṇe kṛte pitur anantaraṃ sākṣān mātus tadanantaram upamātur ity evaṃ jyeṣṭhādikrameṇa navaśrāddhaṃ kuryād iti mātuḥ sāṃvatsarikaśrāddham iti |
sāṃvatsarikaśrāddhaprakāro viṣṇudharmottare |
pratisaṃvatsaraṃ kāryam ekoddiṣṭaṃ naraiḥ striyaḥ |
mṛtāhani yathānyāyaṃ nṛṇāṃ yadvad ihoditam ||
yadvat puruṣāṇāṃ samantrakaṃ śrāddhaṃ tadvad dvijātistrīṇāṃ kṛtavivāhānāṃ samantrakam eva śrāddham iti |
āha marīciḥ |
strīṇām amantrakaṃ śrāddhaṃ tathā śūdrāsu tasya ca |
prāg dvijāter vratādeśāt te ca kuryus tathaiva tat ||
amantrakam iti vaidikamantroccāraṇarahitam | amantrakam ity anena nāmagotroccāraṇam eva kartavyam ity arthaḥ | tatrāpi "svagotrād bhraśyate nārī" ityādinā bhartṛgotreṇa dātavyam iti pratīyate |
pitṛgotraṃ samutsṛjya na kuryād bhartṛgotrataḥ |
ityādinā pitṛgotreṇaiveti | tad evaṃ vipratipattāv āsurādivivāhapariṇītāyāḥ putrikākaraṇena prattāyāś ca pitṛgotreṇaiva, brāhmādivivāhapariṇītāyās tu bhartṛgotreṇeti vyavasthā | tac ca kṛtavivāhastrīśrāddhaviṣayam | apariṇītānāṃ saṃskārahīnatayā vaidikamantrānuccāraṇayogyatvāt | "te ca kuryus tathaiva tad" iti te [1687] pāraśavakaraṇādayaḥ | prāgvratāc ca dvijātayaḥ asaṃskṛtatvāt saṃskṛtānām api pitṛpitṛvyādīnām amantrakaṃ śrāddham arhantīti |
atraikoddiṣṭapārvaṇavyavasthām āha kātyāyanaḥ |
pratyabdaṃ yo yathā kuryāt putraḥ pitre sadā dvijaḥ |
tathaiva mātuḥ kartavyaṃ pārvaṇaṃ vānyad eva vā ||
'anyat' ekoddiṣṭam | yat tu tenaivoktaṃ
pitṛvyabhrātṛmātṝṇām ekoddiṣṭaṃ sadaiva tu |
iti, tat pitṛvyādisamabhivyāhārān mātṛsapatnīparaṃ veditavyam |
aputrāṇāṃ sāṃvatsarikaśrāddham āha āpastambaḥ |
aputrā ye smṛtā kecit striyo vā puruṣāś ca ye |
teṣām api ca deyaṃ syād ekoddiṣṭaṃ na pārvaṇam ||
mitrabandhusapiṇḍebhyaḥ strīkumārībhya eva ca |
dadyād vai māsikaṃ śrāddhaṃ sāṃvatsaram ato ’nyathā ||
pracetāḥ |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇād ūrdhvaṃ ekoddiṣṭaṃ vidhīyate |
aputrāṇāṃ ca sarveṣām apatnīnāṃ tathaiva ca ||
'apatnīnāṃ' akṛtavivāhānām |
atriḥ |
bhrātre bhaginyai putrāya svāmine mātulāya ca |
pitṛvyagurave śrāddham ekoddiṣṭaṃ na pārvaṇam ||
jātūkarṇyaḥ |
pitṛvyabhrātṛmātṝṇām aputrāṇāṃ tathaiva ca |
mātāmahasyāputrasya śrāddhādi pitṛvad bhavet || iti |
[1688] avaśyakartavyatāvadyotanārthaṃ saṃnyāsināṃ tu kṣayāhe sarvair api sutaiḥ pārvaṇam eva kartavyam ity āha pracetāḥ |
ekoddiṣṭaṃ yater nāsti tridaṇḍigrahaṇād iha |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇābhāvāt pārvaṇaṃ tasya sarvadā ||
śātātapaḥ |
ekoddiṣṭaṃ jalaṃ piṇḍam āśaucaṃ pretasatkriyām |
na kuryāt pārvaṇād anyad brahmabhūtāya bhikṣave ||
ataḥ sarvadā yateḥ kṣayāhe sarvaputraiḥ pārvaṇam eva kartavyam naikoddiṣṭam iti |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasakalakaraṇādhipatipaṇḍitaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau pariśeṣakhaṇḍe śrāddhakalpe
sāṃvatsarikaśrāddhaprayogo nāma dvāviṃśo ’dhyāyaḥ ||
[1689]
atha trayoviṃśo ’dhyāyaḥ |
śrāddhatvāparapakṣike vidhim amuṃ viśvopakāravratī
sarvaśrīkaraṇeśvaraḥ sukṛtinām agresaro bhāṣate |
hemādriḥ paripākanirmalarasaprasyandivāgvaibhavaḥ
karṇābhyarṇasurasyasāragharasāsārair nirāṅgumphanaiḥ ||
atha bhādrapadāparapakṣaśrāddhaprayogaḥ |
tatra yadi tāvat pākabrāhmaṇaśarīrasāmarthyādisarvopapattir bhavati tadā sāgnyanagnividhavābrahmacāriprabhṛtayaḥ sarve pratipatprabhṛti pratidinaṃ caturdaśīvarjam amāvāsyāparyantaṃ sarveṣāṃ kuryuḥ | caturdaśyāṃ tu śastrahatasyaiva | yadā punaḥ pākādyanupapattis tadā ekasminn api dine sarveṣām avaśyaṃ kuryuḥ "śākenāpy aparapakṣaṃ nātikrāmet" iti vacanāt | bhādrapadāparapakṣākhyamukhyakālāsaṃbhave dīpotsavapañcadaśyāṃ kartavyam ity etad bhādrapadāparapakṣakālaprakaraṇe pratipāditam | etac ca śrāddhaṃ navadaivatyaṃ kartavyam |
āha dharmaḥ |
mahālaye gayāśrāddhe vṛddhau cānvaṣṭakāsu ca |
navadaivatyam atra syāc cheṣaṃ ṣāṭpauruṣaṃ viduḥ ||
'śeṣaṃ' ṣoḍaśaśrāddhādivyatiriktaṃ śrāddham |
āha kātyāyanaḥ |
[1690] karṣūsamanvitaṃ muktvā tathādyaṃ śrāddhaṣoḍaśam |
pratyābdikaṃ ca śeṣeṣu piṇḍāḥ syuḥ ṣaḍ iti sthitiḥ ||
karṣūśabdena sapiṇḍīkaraṇam ucyate | navadevatyatā cātraivaṃ ekaḥ pitṛvargaḥ | dvitīyo mātṛvargaḥ | tṛtīyo mātāmahavargaḥ iti | mātāmahavarge ca strīṇāṃ sahaivoddeśo na pṛthak |
tathā ca karmapradīpaḥ |
na yoṣidbhyaḥ pṛthag dadyād avasānadinād ṛte |
svabhartṛpiṇḍamātrebhyas tṛptis tāsāṃ prakīrttitā |
chāgaleyaḥ |
kṣayāhe kevalāḥ kāryā vṛddhāv ādau prakīrtitāḥ |
sarvatraiva hi madhyasthā nāntyāḥ kāryās tu mātaraḥ ||
sarvatra mahālaye ’nvaṣṭakāgayāśrāddhe ca madhya eva niveśaḥ |
satyavrataḥ |
pitṝṇāṃ prathamaṃ dānaṃ mātṝṇāṃ tadanantaram |
tato mātāmahānāṃ ca pitṛvyasyāstu tasya ca ||
uśanāḥ |
antarmātāmahān kṛtvā mātṝṇāṃ yaḥ prayacchati |
śrāddhaṃ vā piṇḍadānaṃ vā narakaṃ sa tu gacchati ||
jābālaḥ |
ante niveśayed yas tu mātṝḥ śrāddheṣu mānavaḥ |
sa mūḍho narakaṃ yāti kālasūtram avākśirāḥ ||
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
[1691] pitṛbhyaḥ prathamaṃ dadyān mātṛbhyas tadanantaram |
tato mātāmahebhyaś cety anvaṣṭakye kramaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
caturviṃśatimate |
kṣayāhaṃ varjayitvā tu strīṇāṃ nāsti pṛthagvidhiḥ |
kecid icchanti nārīṇāṃ pṛthakśrāddhaṃ dijottamāḥ ||
ācāryaguruśiṣyebhyaḥ sakhijñātibhya eva ca |
sarvebhyaś ca pitṛbhyaś ca tatpatnībhyas tathaiva ca |
piṇḍān ebhyaḥ sadā dadyāt pṛthag bhādrapade dvijaḥ ||
atra pārvaṇaikoddiṣṭavyavasthām āha jātūkarṇyaḥ |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇād ūrdhvaṃ pitror eva hi pārvaṇam |
pitṛvyabhrātṛmātṝṇām ekoddiṣṭaṃ sadaiva hi ||
atra pārvaṇaikoddiṣṭayoḥ paurvāparyaniyamam āha marīciḥ |
yady ekatra bhaveyātām ekoddiṣṭaṃ ca pārvaṇam |
pārvaṇaṃ cābhinirvartya ekoddiṣṭaṃ samāpayet ||
atra tantreṇaiva pākaḥ kartavyaḥ |
tathā ca atriḥ |
bahunā vātha vā dvābhyāṃ śrāddhaṃ cet syāt same ’hani |
tantreṇa śrapaṇaṃ kṛtvā pṛthak śrāddhāni kārayet ||
pulastyaḥ |
mahālaye gayāśrāddhe gatāsūnāṃ kṣaye ’hani |
tantreṇa śrapaṇaṃ kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ kuryāt pṛthak pṛthak ||
etac ca bhādrapadakṛṣṇapakṣapratipatprabhṛtiṣu caturdaśīvarjam [1692] amāvāsyāparyantāsu tithiṣu pratyaham aśaktau tanmadhya eva yathāsaṃbhavaṃ navadevatyaṃ pārvaṇavidhānena pitṛvyādīnām aputrāṇām anyeṣāṃ caikoddiṣṭavidhānena tantreṇa pākaṃ kṛtvā pṛthak pṛthag aparapakṣaśrāddhaṃ kartavyam iti sthitam |
idānīṃ kṛṣṇapakṣa eva kāsucit tithiṣu śrāddhaprayogaviśeṣa ucyate | tatra tāvat pañcamīśrāddhaṃ baudhāyanasūtre |
putrārthaṃ pañcamīśrāddhaṃ kariṣye tadarthe puṇyāhaṃ vācayiṣye iti saṃkalpya puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā puṇyāhadevatāgniḥ prīyatām ity uktvā puṇyāhaṃ vācayet | etac ca mārgaśīrṣamāsam ārabhya kuryāt | vicchinnāgnisaṃdhānaṃ kṛtvā agnimukham ārabhya praṇītāntaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇenāgniṃ svadhāpātraṃ sthāpayet | āmāgantu pitaro devayānāt tilo ’si somadaivatyo gosavo devanirmitaḥ | pratnavadbhiḥ prattaḥ svadha ehi pitṝn imāṃl lokān prīṇayāhi naḥ svadhā namaḥ | madhuvātā ṛtāyate iti tisṛbhiḥ somasya tviṣir asi nirastaṃ na mucyeḥ śiraḥ | śan no devīr abhiṣṭaya ity etaiḥ svardhāṃ miśrīkṛtya gandhapuṣpākṣataiḥ pitṛbhyo namaḥ | pitāmahebhyo namaḥ | prapitāmahebhyo nama ity arcayitvā darbhaiḥ pracchādayet | bhojanasthāne apahatā asurā rakṣāṃsi piśācā pitṛṣadaḥ ye kṣayanti pṛthivīm anu anyatreto gacchantu yatraiṣāṃ gataṃ mana ity adbhir evokṣati udīratām avara utparāsa unmadhyamāḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ asuṃ ya īyur avṛkā ṛtajñās te no ’vatu pitaro haveṣu pitṝn āvāhayati āyāta pitaraḥ somyaḥ gambhīraiḥ pathibhiḥ pūrvaiḥ prajām asmabhyaṃ dadate rayiṃ ca dīrghāyuṣṭvaṃ ca śataṃ śāradaṃ ceti dvau devau kṛtvā viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ kṣaṇaḥ karyavya iti kṛtvā vastrālaṃkārabhojanaṃ datvā gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpāṃś ca pitrarthe trayāṇāṃ [1693] brāhmaṇānāṃ padaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā pitṛbhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ pitāmahebhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ prapitāmahebhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ iti svadhāṃ datvā vastrabhojanagandhapuṣpadhūpādibhiḥ arcayitvā pitṝn anujñāpyāgnau kariṣyāmīti saṃkalpya ājyasaṃskāraṃ kṛtvā sruksaṃmārjanaṃ vidhāya paridhīn sthāpayitvā idhyānabhyajyedhyaṃ nidhāya pariṣecanaṃ kṛtvāghārāvāghārayati, yukto ’vahavatasta āśāḥ ānobhadrāḥ virupākṣam āvirūpākṣam ahaṃ yā tiraścī saṃrādhanyai prasādhanyai vyāhṛtayaś ceti hutvā prācīnāvītīyāḥ prācīr antardadhe ṛtubhir yan me mātā yad vaḥ kravyād iti pañca ṛcāhutīr hutvā caruṃ tridhā kṛtvā somāya pitṛmate śuṣmiṇe juhamo havir vājinīdaṃ juṣasva naḥ svāhā havyaṃ devebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ svāheti ekena bhāgena juhoti, dvitīye bhāge ’vadāya aṅgirasvantamūtaye ṣamaṃ pitṛmantam āhuḥ vaivasvatedamahinaḥ svāhā havyaṃ devebhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ svāheti tṛtīye bhāge ’vadāya agnaye kavyavāhanapitṛnyakṣi (?) ṛtāvṛdhaḥ pradevebhyo vaha havyaṃ pitṛbhyaś ca svāhā havyaṃ devebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ svāheti trayaṃ hutvā etair eva mantrais tribhir apūpāhutitrayaṃ kuryāt | pitṛbhojanārthaṃ pakve ’nne tilān miśrayitvā tarpaṇamantrair viṃśatyāhutīḥ kṛtvā agnaye kavyavāhanāya sviṣṭakṛte svadhā namaḥ svāhety agnau dakṣiṇapūrvabhāge homaṃ kṛtvā śeṣam annaṃ caruśeṣaṃ ca pitṛtvena kḷptān brāhmalān bhojayet | bhojanārambhe annaṃ spṛṣṭvā japet pṛthivīsamantasya te ’gnir upasṛṣṭā ṛcas te mahimā guptasyāpramādāya pṛthivī te pātraṃ pitāmahānām antarikṣaṃ samantasya te puruṣa śrotā yajūṃṣi mahimā dattasyāpramādāya pṛthivī te pātraṃ pitāmahapātraṃ spṛṣṭvā dyauḥ [1694] samantasya te ādityo ’nukhyātā sāmāni te mahimā dattasyāpramādāya pṛthivi te pātraṃ oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ sva iti annam aṅguṣṭhena sparśayitvā pitṛbhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ pitāmahebhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ prapitāmahebhyaḥ svadhā nama iti dadyād amṛtopastaraṇam asi prāṇāya svāhāpānāya svāhā vyānāya svāhodānāya svāhā samānāya svāheti pañcāhutīr yajamāno japati brahmaṇi cātmāmṛtatvāya sarvaiḥ kāmais tarpayatety uktvā amṛtāpidhānam asi bhojanānte udakam annaṃ ca gṛhītvā bhūmau vikiret | ye agnidagdhā ye jīvā ye tv adagdhāḥ kule mama | bhūmau dattena tṛpyantāṃ tṛptā yāntu parāṃ gatiṃ iti tilodakaṃ gṛhītvā tṛpyadhvam iti tṛptebhyaḥ svadhāṃ datvā bhuktidakṣiṇām api brāhmaṇān pradakṣiṇīkṛtya visarjayet | dakṣiṇenāgniṃ caturviṃśatipiṇḍān pitṛbhyaḥ svadhā nama ity ārabhya sarvābhyaḥ svadhā nama iti dadyāt | caruśeṣeṇa tisra āhutīḥ kuryād yan me mātā yan me pitāmahī yan me prapitāmahītijapādi pratipadyate, pariṣecanāntaṃ kṛtvā saṃvatsarād arvāk putraṃ labhate satyam ity āha bhagavān baudhāyanaḥ |
athāṣṭakāhomaḥ |
baudhāyanasūtre |
athāṣṭakāhomas taiṣe māsy aparapakṣasyāṣṭamyāṃ kriyeta evaṃ māghaphālgune yadi vā vihato yadi vā samasta upariṣṭān māse paurṇamāsyām aparapakṣasaptamyām aṣṭamyāṃ navamyāṃ iti kriyate yadi vāṣṭamyām eva śvaḥ kariṣyāmīti brāhmaṇān nimantrayet yonigotraśrutavṛttasaṃpannān asaṃbaddhān ity eke kāmaṃ saṃbaddhān api śrutavṛttasaṃpannān śrutavṛttayonibhiḥ svadhā [1695] nidhīyata ity upadiśanti tān śmaśrukarmābhyañjanasnānādibhir yathopapādaṃ sampūjya svayam āplutya śrucau same deśe devayajanollekhanaprabhṛtyāpraṇītābhyaḥ kṛtvā bahir ādāya mām upākaroti pitṛbhyaḥ svāhā pitāmahebhyaḥ svāhā prapitāmahebhyo juṣṭām upākaromīti tūṣṇīm ity eke ’thainām adbhiḥ prokṣati pitṛbhyaḥ svāhā pitāmahebhyaḥ prapitāmahebhyaḥ juṣṭāṃ prokṣāmīti tūṣṇīm ity eke mām atraiva pratīcīnnaśireṣaṃ (?) dakṣiṇapadaṃ saṃjñapayanti tasyaiva saṃjñatādbhir abhiṣekaṃ prāṇān āpyāyayati tūṣṇīṃ vapām utkhidya hṛdayam udvaheti prajñānāni cāvadānāni tāny eteṣv eva śūle pūpan nikṣipyaitasminn evāgnau śrapayati prathamaṃ māsaṃ codanaṃ cāpūpān śrapayati anyāṃś ca viśeṣān sarvaṃ siddhaṃ samānīya yugmān brāhmaṇān suprakṣālitapādān apa ācamayya sadarbhopakḷpteṣv āsaneṣu prāṅmukhān upaveśayanty udaṅmukhāna vā yadi prāṅmukhān dakṣiṇāpavargān yady udaṅmukhāḥ prāgapavargaḥ prāpnotu bhavān iti prāptavān iti itare pratyāhuḥ athaitānyavamiśrā āpaḥ pratigrāhayaty amuṣmai svadhā namo ’muṣmai svadhā nama iti tribhis tilodakam eke samāmananti puro ’nnaṃ dvis tilodakaṃ dadyāt bhukyavatsu ca tṛtīyam athaitān vastragandhadhūpadīpamālyair yathopapādaṃ saṃpūjya pṛcchaty udhriyatām agnau ca kriyatām iti kāmam udhriyatāṃ kāmam agnau kriyatām itītare pratyāhuḥ | api cāgnau kariṣyāmīti kuruṣveti pratyāhuḥ | athābhyanujñātaḥ paridhānaprabhṛtyagnimukhān kṛtvā śrutāyāṃ vapāyāṃ pañca sruvāhutīr juhotīti vā purastād vyākhyātaṃ tredhā vapāṃ vicchidyaudumbaryā darvyā juhotīti tat purastād vyākhyātam athāṣṭakāhomān juhotīyam eva sā yā prathamā vidhaucchad ity aṣṭau pañcadaśīye puṣṭaye pūrvatarām apaśyann ity ekāṃ saṃvatsarasya [1696] pratimām ity ekāntāḥ saptadaśāpūpam aṣṭadhā vicchidya trīṇy avadānāni vapāyāḥ kalpena hutvāthetarāṇi brāhmaṇebhyo ’tra tāny avadānānīḍāsu pracchidyaudanaṃ māṃsaṃ pūpam ity ājyena samadāyuty audumbaryā darvyāpidhānaṃ juhoti pitṛbhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ svāhā pitāmahebhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ svāhā prapitāmahebhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ svāhā mātṛbhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ svāhā pitāmahībhyaḥ
