tenaiva pathena gatvānnaśeṣaṃ nivedayet yathā brūyus tathā kuryāt tais tv abhyanujñāto dakṣiṇenāgniṃ dakṣiṇāgrān darbhān saṃstīrya teṣv annaśeṣaiḥ piṇḍān dadāti pitṛbhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ pitāmahebhyaḥ athānvaṣṭakāśrāddhaṃ viṣṇudharmottare |
anvaṣṭakāsu ca strīṇāṃ śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ tathaiva ca |
aṣṭakāvidhinā hutvā krameṇaitāsu pañcakam ||
mātre rājan pitāmahyai viśvedevapuraḥsaram |
piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kāryaṃ tasyāṃ tu pitṛvan nṛpa |
bhuktavatsu ca vipreṣu tatra karma nibodha me ||
prādeśamātrā rājendra caturaṅgulam āyatā |

āha gobhilaḥ |

viṣṇudharmottare |
pratyekaṃ karṣūmūleṣu paristīrya hutāśanam |
agnīṣomayamānāṃ ca yāgaṃ kṛtvā yathā purā ||

piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ prāgvad ekaikasmin yathāvidhi ||

dadhnā māṃsena payasā karṣūṇāṃ caiva pūraṇam ||

[1699] viṣṇuḥ |
aṣṭakāsu daivapūrvaṃ śākamāṃsāpūpaiḥ śrāddhaṃ kṛtvānvaṣṭakāsu ca vahnau hutvā devapūrvam evāpi ca mātre pitāmahyai ca pūrvavad brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā dakṣiṇābhiś cābhyarcyānuvrajya visarjya tataḥ ṣaṭkarṣūḥ kuryāt | tanmūle ca prāgagny upasaṃdhānaṃ kṛtvā hutvā ca piṇḍatrayanirvapaṇaṃ prakṛtyaikasmin karṣūmūle kuryāt | karṣūtrayeṣu karṣūṇāṃ mūlatraye strīṇāṃ puruṣakarṣūtrayaṃ sānnenodakenāpūrayet | strīkarṣūtrayaṃ sānnena payasā dadhnā māṃsena payasā pratyekaṃ karṣūtrayaṃ pūrayitvā japed etad bhavatībhyo ’stu cākṣayam |
viṣṇudharmottare |
āmaśrāddheṣu kāmyeṣu hutvā prathamapañcakam |
madhyamaṃ pañcakaṃ hutvā śukraśrāddheṣu saṃyataḥ ||
amāvāsyāsu sarvāsu hutvā cottamapañcakam |
hutvā ca pañcakāny etāny aṣṭakātritayaṃ kramāt |
anvaṣṭakāsu ca tathā bhojayet prayato dvijān ||
trayodaśīśrāddhe tu pitrāditrayasya mātāmahāditrayasya cety evaṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ pārvaṇavidhānena kartavyam iti tat sarvam aparapakṣaśrāddhakālaprakaraṇapratipāditam |
atha caturdaśīśrāddhaprayogaḥ |

ekoddiṣṭaṃ sutaiḥ kāryaṃ caturdaśyāṃ mahālaya iti ||
[1700] ayam abhisaṃdhiḥ, 'samatvam āgatasya' sapiṇḍīkṛtasya, 'mahālaye' bhādrapadāparapakṣacaturdaśyāṃ, śastrahatasyaiva nānyasyeti niyamyate | na punaḥ śastrahatasya caturdaśyām eveti ataś ca kṣayāhādau śastrahatasyāpi yathāprāptam eva śrāddhaṃ kartavyam | yadā caturdaśyāṃ śastrahataḥ pitā jananī vā tadā kṣayāhanimittaṃ pārvaṇaṃ vinivartyāparapakṣanimittaṃ śastrahatasyaikoddiṣṭam api kartavyam eveti |

atha caturviṃśo’dhyāyaḥ |
atha saṃnyāsāṅgaśrāddhaprayogaḥ |
tatra saṃnyāsam adhikṛtya baudhāyanasūtre |
ādāv agnimān pārvaṇavidhināṣṭau śrāddhāni kuryāt | anagnimān ekoddiṣṭavidhinā daivamātrārṣakadivyapitryamāṛkamānuṣabhautikāny aṣṭau śrāddhāny ātmanaś cānte kuryāt |
tathā |
atha saṃnyāsavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | tatra saṃnyāsasaṃkalpapūrvam aṣṭamyā ārabhya śrāddhādikaṃ kuryāt | paurṇamāsyām amāvāsyāyāṃ vā devaśrāddhaṃ ṛṣiśrāddhaṃ divyaśrāddhaṃ mānuṣaśrāddhaṃ bhūtaśrāddhaṃ pitṛśrāddhaṃ mātṛśrāddham ātmanaḥ śrāddhaṃ ceti| devaśrāddhe devatātrayaṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | ṛṣiśrāddhe devatātrayaṃ devarṣibrahmarṣikṣatrarṣayaḥ | divyaśrāddhe devatātrayaṃ vasurudrādityāḥ | manuṣyaśrāddhe devatātrayaṃ sanakasanandanasanātanāḥ | bhūtaśrāddhe devatātrayaṃ pṛthivyādāni bhūtāni cakṣurādīni karaṇāni caturvidho bhūtagrāmaḥ | pitṛśrāddhe devatātrayaṃ pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahāḥ mātāmahamātuḥpitāmahamātuḥprapitāmahāś ca | mātṛśrāddhe devatātrayaṃ mātṛpitāmahīprapitāmahyaḥ | ātmanaḥ śrāddhe devatātrayaṃ ātmapitṛpitāmahaḥ |
athātaḥ śaunakaprotaṃ saṃnyāsavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | pūrvedyur nāndīmukhaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryāt | devarṣidivyamanuṣyabhūtapitṛmātrātmanaś ca pṛthakpiṇḍadānair yugmair brāhmaṇaiḥ piṇḍodakaṃ kuryāt | devaśrāddhe devatātrayaṃ [1703] brahmaviṣṇumāheśānāḥ piṇḍatrayaṃ dadyāt | ṛṣiśrāddhe devatātrayaṃ devarṣikṣatrarṣimanuṣyarṣayaḥ piṇḍatrayaṃ dadyāt | divyaśrāddhe devatātrayaṃ vasurudrādityāḥ piṇḍatrayaṃ dadyāt | manuṣyaśrāddhe devatātrayaṃ sanakasanandanasanātanāḥ piṇḍatrayaṃ dadyāt | bhūtaśrāddhe pṛthivyādīni bhūtāni piṇḍatrayaṃ dadyāt | mātṛśrāddhe devatātrayaṃ mātṛpitāmahīprapitāmahāḥ piṇḍatrayaṃ dadyāt | ātmaśrāddhe devatācayaṃ ātmapitṛpitāmahāḥ piṇḍatrayaṃ dadyāt | nāmagotrasaṃbandhāt piṇḍodakaṃ dadyāt | anantaraṃ puṇyāhaṃ vācayet |

ayam arthaḥ | utsannāgniś cet pṛṣṭodivītipakṣeṇāgnim ādhāya svagṛhyoktavidhinā pūrṇāhutiṃ vidhāyāgnipradānamantreṇājyaṃ hutvā pratikṛtiṃ dahet |
akṛtāgniparigrahaś ced etat kuryād ity āha |
niragnir atha vā bhūmiṃ yamaṃ rudraṃ ca saṃsmaran |
hutvā prādhānike sthāne paścād dāhāpayec ca tām ||
pṛṣṭodivipakṣam āha kātyāyanaḥ |
anvagnir iti mantreṇa grāmāgniṃ tu samāharet |
pṛṣṭodivīti cādadhyāt sāvitryā jvālayed atha ||
tat savitur vareṇyaṃ tu viśvānīti smṛto ’paraḥ |
'grāmāgniḥ’ laukikāgniḥ | sa ca śrotriyāgārād āneyaḥ | 'ādadhyāt’ praṇayet |
śrapayec cāpare vahnau mugamiśraṃ caruṃ tataḥ |
tilataṇḍulamiśraṃ tu dvitīyaṃ sapavitrakam ||
aparagrahaṇaṃ yatra pratikṛtidāhaḥ kṛtas tato ’nyasminn ity arthaḥ | tasmāc caruśrapaṇārthaṃ pūrveṇa prakāreṇāgnim utpādayet | 'sapavitrakam' iti sapavitrakaras taṇḍulāvapanaṃ śṛtābhikṣāraṇaṃ ca |
śrapaṇānantaraṃ kartavyam āha |
[1707] madhukṣīraghṛtāmbhobhiḥ pūrayet karṣukātrayam |
tadupānte tu samudgapātrāṇi trīṇi pūrayet ||
oṃ pṛthivyai namas tubhyam iti caikaṃ nivedayet |
oṃ yamāya namaś ceti dvitīyaṃ tadanantaram ||
oṃ namaś cātha rudrāya śmaśānapataye tathā |
tato dīptaṃ samiddhāgniṃ bhūmau prakṛtidāhakam ||
kravyādam agniṃ taptāyai bhūmyai nama iti smaran |
kṣīrāktaṃ jalakumbhaṃ tu vikiret tatpraśāntaye ||
nābhimātraṃ tatas toyaṃ praviśya yamadiṅmukhaḥ |
saptabhyo yamasaṃjñebhyo dadyāt sapta jalāñjalīn ||
yamāya dharmarājāya mṛtyave cāntakāya ca |
vaivasvatāya kālāya sarvaprāṇaharāya ca ||
svadhākāranamaskārapraṇavaiḥ saha saptadhā |
oṃ namaś cātha rudrāya śmaśānapataye smaran ||
lājodakābhyāṃ pūrṇaṃ tu kumbhaṃ ca vikired bhuvi |
yāmyonmukheṣu darbheṣu pradadyāc cāvanejanam ||
svadhāyai ca svadhārūpirudro nama iti smaran |
amukāmukagotraitat tubhyam astu tilodakam ||
sūkṣmadehaiṣa te piṇḍas tv arghyapuṣpasugandhimān |
dhūpo dīpo balir vātha svargyaiṣā tubhyam akṣayā ||
daśapiṇḍāṃs tato datvā viṣṇoḥ saumyabhukhān smaret |
niruṣmaṇas tu tat toyaṃ nābhimātraṃ praviśya ca ||
[1708] prakṣipet pūrṇakumbhaṃ tu jalamadhye pṛthak pṛthak |
pradadyāt pañca pañcāśat kumbhāṃś cātha jalāñjalīn ||
dvāropānte gṛhe vātha kṣīraṃ toyaṃ ca nikṣipet |
jīvātra snāhi dugdhaṃ ca pibedaṃ cāpy anusmaran ||
yāmyonmukheṣu darbheṣu svapet paścād udamukhaḥ |
amāvāsyāyāṃ kuryāc ca jīvacchrāddham ataḥ param ||
ghṛtānnamāṃsadadhibhiḥ pūrayet karṣukātrayam |
kuryāc ca māsikaṃ māsi sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ tataḥ ||
aśaucānte tataḥ sarvam ātmano vā parasya vā |
kuryād asthiratāṃ jñātvā bhaktyārogyadhanāyuṣām ||
atha baudhāyanoktajīvacchrāddhaprayogaḥ |
jīvacchrāddhavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmo yas tv ātmanaḥ śreyaḥ samicchati aparapakṣe trayodaśīm upetya tasminn ahani saṃbhārān upakalpayet | aurdhvadehike mṛtānāṃ vastraṣaṭkaṃ sauvarṇasūcitaṃ aṅkuśaṃ navapālāśaṃ skandharajaṃ palāśavṛndaṃ kṛṣṇājinam audumbarīm idhmāsandīṅkalaśādīty api tasminn evāhani śvobhūte snātvā madhyāhne jale sthitvā upary evotthāya puṇyāhaṃ svastyayanam iti vācayitvā vastrāṅgulīyakadakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt tair eva pāyasaṃ dakṣiṇāmukho ’śnīyād atha svagṛhyoktavidhināgnim upasamādhāya sa paristīryāghārāvājyabhāgāv iṣṭvā srucā tisra ājyāhutīr agnimukhān hutvā pakvānnena juhoti, catvāri śṛṅgeti, puro’nuvākyām anūcya tat savitur vareṣyam iti yājyayā juhoti ye ca puro’nuvākyām anūcya [1709] vasūnīti puro’nuvākyām anūcya yā tiraścāṃ nipadyateyam iti yājyayā juhoti | athājyājatīr upajuhoti pauruṣeṇa sūktenāṣṭādaśarcena ghṛtaṃ hutvā gāyatryāṣṭasahasram aṣṭāviṃśatiṃ vā juhuyāt | sviṣṭakṛtprabhṛtiṣiddham ādhenuvarapradānād vāryya ekaśirasam āste na catuṣpathaṃ datvā sūcisaṅkulāṃ skandhāṃ rajjum iti kṛṣṇatanavaḥ bhūḥ svāheti datvā prīyantāṃ yamakiṅkarādaya iti vācayitvā vrīhiṣu kalaśaṃ sādayet tantunā pariveṣṭya jalapūrṇāṃ puruṣākṛtiṃ kṛtvā trīṇi śīrṣe mukhe trīṇi grīvāyām ekaviṃśatiḥ śarīre catuṣṭayaṃ bāhvor dve dve liṅgasyaikaṃ pādayoḥ pañca pañceti prīto ’stu bhagavān yamakiṅkara iti āsandīṃ kṛtvā pañcagavyena prakṣālya palāśavṛntaiḥ kṛṣṇājine puruṣākṛtiṃ kṛtvā kalaśapuruṣe prāṇān abhiniveśya vṛntaśarīre deham abhiniveśya madhye svapet | udite sūrye kalaśair dehaṃ svayaṃ secayet | pauruṣeṇa sūktena pañcagavyena śuddhodakena sāyāhne satilam annaṃ sarpiṣāśnīyāt | brāhmaṇān api yamakiṅkaratṛptaye bhojayet | caturthīṃ yantradāha udakapiṇḍaṃ tvāmukagotrāya marutomatsapiṇḍam amuṣmin svadheti namaskārāntaṃ kṛtvā samāpayet | tatrāśaucaṃ daśāhaṃ syāt svasya mantrāhuter na vidyate | ekādaśyām ekoddiṣṭam iti pratipadyatām apy udāharanty āpattau strī ca śūdraś ca yantrair dagdhāṃ svakāṃ tanuṃ dahen madhyāhne jale sthitvā na ca kriyāḥ sarvāḥ kuryād ity eva hi śrutiḥ | strīṇāṃ tūṣṇīṃ samantrakaṃ vā māsi māsy evaṃ saṃvatsarād ūrdhvaṃ pratisaṃvatsaram ādvādaśābdāt tato nivṛttiḥ, yadā svayaṃ na śaknuyāt tadā putrādayaḥ kuryuḥ amukagotrāyāmuṣmā iti śeṣaṃ samāpayet |

[1710] jīvann evātmanaḥ śrāddhaṃ kuryād anyeṣu satsv api |
yathāvidhi pravṛttyāśu sapiṇḍīkaraṇād ṛte ||
iti tasyoktakāraṇena vilambayet | yato ’nityaṃ jīvitam iti śeṣaṃ samāpayed ity āha bhagavān baudhāyanaḥ |
liṅgapurāṇe |
jīvacchrāddhavidhiṃ vakṣye samāsāc chrutisaṃmatam |
munaye devadevena kathitaṃ brahmaṇā purā ||
viśiṣṭāya vaśiṣṭhāya bhārgavāya ca sāṃpratam |
śṛṇvantu sarvabhāvena sarvasiddhikaraṃ param ||
śrāddhamārgakramaṃ sākṣāt śrāddhārhāṇām api kramam |
viśeṣam api vakṣyāmi jīvacchrāddheṣu yaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
parvate vā nadītīre vane devālaye ’pi vā |
jīvacchrāddhaṃ prakartavyaṃ mṛtyukāle prayatnataḥ ||
jīvacchrāddhe kṛte jīvo jīvann eva vimucyate |
karma kurvann akurvan vā ajñāno jñānavān api ||
śrotriyo ’śrotriyo vāpi brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo ’pi vā |
vaiśyo vā nātra saṃdeho yogamārgarato yathā ||
parīkṣya bhūmiṃ vidhinā gandhavarṇarasādibhiḥ |
svalpam uddhṛtya yatnena sthaṇḍilaṃ saikataṃ bhuvi ||
madhyato hastamātreṇa kuṇḍaṃ caivāgrataḥ śubham |
sthaṇḍilaṃ vā prakartavyaṃ iṣumātraṃ punaḥ punaḥ |
upalipya vidhānena collikhyāgniṃ nidhāya ca |
[1711] anvādhānaṃ yathāśākhaṃ parisamūhya sarvataḥ ||
paristīrya svaśākhoktaṃ pāraṃparyakramāgatam |
samāpyāgnimukhaṃ sarvaṃ mantrair etair yathākramam ||
saṃpūjya sthaṇḍile vahniṃ homayet samidādibhiḥ |
ādau kṛtvā samiddhomaṃ caruṇā ca pṛthak pṛthak ||
ghṛtena ca pṛthak pātre śobhitena pṛthak pṛthak |
juhuyād ātmanoddhṛtya tac ca bhūtāni sarvataḥ ||

viriñcāntaṃ purā proktaṃ sṛṣṭimārgeṇa suvratāḥ ||
punaḥ paśupateḥ patnīṃ tathā paśupatiṃ kramāt |
saṃpūjya pūrvavan mantrair hotavyaṃ vai krameṇa ca |
sarvāntam ājyaṃ pūrvaṃ ca samidantaṃ samāhitaḥ ||
oṃ sarvadharāṃ me chindhi prāṇo gandhaṃ chindhi me ’ghaṃ jahi bhūḥ svāhā | bhūr bhuvaḥ svāhā |
evaṃ pṛthak pṛthak hutvā kevalena ghṛtena ca |
sahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā śatam aṣṭottaraṃ tu vā ||
vidhāyaivaṃ ghṛtenaiva śatam aṣṭottaraṃ pṛthak |
prāṇādibhyaś ca juhuyāt ghṛtenaiva tu kevalam ||
oṃ prāṇe niviṣṭo ’mṛtaṃ juhomi śivo māviśāpradāhāya prāṇāya svāhā | prāṇādhipataye rudrāya pṛṣātakāya svāhā | bhūḥ svāhā | bhuvaḥ svāhā | svaḥ svāhā | bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ svāhā |
evaṃ krameṇa juhuyāt yathoktaṃ ca yathākramam |
saptame ’hani viprendrān śrāddhārhān vipra bhojayet ||
sarveṣāṃ caiva viprāṇāṃ vastrābharaṇasaṃyutam |
vāhanaṃ śayanaṃ kāṃsyam āsanādi ca bhājanam ||
haimaṃ vā rājataṃ dhenutilakṣetraṃ ca vai gṛham |
dāsīdāsagaṇaś caiva dātavyo dakṣiṇā api ||
piṇḍaṃ ca pūrvavad deyaṃ pṛthag uktaprakārataḥ |
[1714] brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasraṃ ca bhojayec ca sadakṣiṇam ||
ekaṃ vā yoganirataṃ brahmaniṣṭhaṃ jitendriyam |
tryahaṃ caiva tu rudrasya mahācarunivedanam ||
viśeṣam etat kathitam aśeṣaṃ śrāddhacoditam |
mṛte kuryān na kuryād vā jīvanmukto yataḥ svayam |
nityanaimittikādīni kuryād vā saṃtyajeta vā ||
bāndhave ’pi mṛte tasya naivāśaucaṃ na vidyate |
sūtakaṃ ca na saṃdehaḥ snānamātreṇa śudhyati ||
paścāj jāte kumāre ca svakṣetre vātmano yadi |
tasya sarvaṃ prakartavyaṃ putro ’pi brahmavid bhavet ||
kanyakā yadi saṃjātā paścāt tasya mahātmanaḥ |
ekavarṇātha vāpy anyā savarṇā sā ca suvratā ||
bhavaty eva na saṃdehaḥ tasya svānvayajā api |
mucyante nātra saṃdehaḥ pitaro narakād api |
mucyante sarvakarmāṇaḥ mātṛtaḥ pitaras tathā ||
kālaṃ gate dvije bhūmau khaned vāpi daheta vā |
putrakṛtyasaśeṣaṃ (?) vā kṛtvā doṣo na vidyate ||
karmaṇā cottareṇaiva gatir asya mahātmanaḥ |
brahmaṇā kathitaṃ sarvaṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām ||
purā sanatkumārāgrāc chrutaṃ caiva niyogataḥ |
[1715] etad vaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ ghṛṇayā tena dhīmatā ||
kṛṣṇadvaipāyanāyaiva kathitaṃ brahmasūnunā |
prasādāt tasya devasya vedavyāsasya dhīmataḥ ||
jñātaṃ mayā kṛtaṃ caiva niyogād eva tasya tu |
etad vaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ rahasyaṃ sarvasiddhidam |
naiva duṣṭāya dātavyaṃ na cābhaktāya suvrata ||
asya liṅgapurāṇasya vyākhyā vakṣyata iti sūtaḥ śrotṝn pratyāha, 'śrāddhamārge' jīvacchrāddhādyadhikāre, 'kramaṃ' prakāraṃ viśeṣadeśakālādirūpaṃ, ‘mṛtyukāle’ maraṇakāle samāmanne, 'jīvann eveti' sattvaśuddhidvāreṇa tattvajñānalābhān mucyata evety arthaḥ, 'agrata iti madhye sthaṇḍilādibhyo 'cārcanārthāt (?) prāgdiśi, kuṇḍaṃ sthaṇḍilāntaraṃ vā homārthaṃ kāryaṃ, 'etair' vakṣyamāṇair brahmādimantraiḥ sthaṇḍile brahmādīn saṃpūjya tair evāgnau samidādīn juhuyāt, ‘ātmanoddhṛtyeti ātmasthāni tattvāni bhūtāni ca tattanmantraprakāśitāny ekaśaḥ samuddhṛtya pṛthakkṛtānīva bhāvayitvā tato devatām uddiśya juhuyāt, tatas tat tattvaṃ śuddhaṃ bhāvayet | atra namo’ntaḥ pūjāyāṃ svāhānto home mantraḥ | tatra brahmāditriprathamāṣṭake tat tad devānāṃ pūjāhomau tathā sarvādipaśupatyantānāṃ sapatnīkānāṃ dharāditattvayuktānāṃ ca pūjāhomau | evaṃ sṛṣṭikrameṇa dvicaturviṃśatimantrān uktvā saṃhāre tadvaiparītyapradarśanārthaṃ prathamāṣṭakaprāntamantram ādyatvenodāharati, 'oṃ śivāya satyam' ityādi | 'evam' iti sṛṣṭikrameṇa [1716] prāguktaviriñcyādiśivāntadevatāṣṭakamantreṣu punaḥ saṃhārakrameṇāgniṃ śivāya satyaṃ svāhetyādi brahmaṇe svāhetyantaṃ, tathā paśupatipatnyādisarvāntaṃ uktakrameṇa saṃpūjya ghṛtacarusamitkramāt pratyekaṃ hotavyam | oṃ sarvetyādi kevalājyahomamantras tatra sarva dharām iti vākyatrayānte bhuvaḥ svāheti tṛtīyaḥ, bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ svāheti caturthamantraḥ | 'evaṃ pṛthak pṛthag' iti, tathā śivasya patnīty ete catvāro mantrā ūhyāḥ | evaṃ bhava jalaṃ me chindhi jihvāyāṃ rasaṃ bhava me ’ghaṃ jahi bhūḥ svāhetyādibhir ūhitaiś caturbhir mantrair homaḥ | tathā virajamantraiś ca tathā prāṇe niviṣṭa ityādiṣaṇmantraiś ca śrāddhoktaḥ svagṛhyoktaḥ pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahādyuddeśe homaś ca | evaṃ saptāhaṃ pratyahaṃ hutvā saptame dine bhuvāditattaddevatoddeśāt viprān abhyarcya sarvādibhyo ’ṣṭau piṇḍā deyāḥ (?) | evaṃ kṛte jīvacchrāddhe svabāndhave mṛte nāśaucaṃ na sūtakam | evaṃ tasmād utpannaḥ putro ’pi pitrādijātakarmādinā saṃskāryaḥ sa ca jñānī bhavet | evaṃ duhitā ca | tathā caitatsantatau yoginā jāyante iti |

jīvacchrāddhaprayogaprakaraṇaṃ samāptam |

śrāddhaklpapraśaṃsā |
matsyapurāṇe |
etāvad uktaṃ tava bhumipāla
śrāddhasya kalpaṃ munisaṃpradiṣṭam |
pāpāpahaṃ puṇyavivarddhanaṃ ca
loke tu mukhyatvakaraṃ tathaiva ||
satpuṇyāṅkuriteṣu yasya gahanārambho ’ṅghripeṣu kvacin
nāsīt ko ’py avakeśitā spṛśati yaṃ leśena kenāpi na |
tena śrīkaraṇeśvareṇa racito hemādriṇāyaṃ mahā-
granthaḥ śrāddhanibandhaśabdaviṣayo muṣṇātu mohaṃ satāṃ ||
iti śrāddhakalpaḥ samāptaḥ |
